-sunny balcony

name: Groot familiehuis (15' van het centrum)
description: Our house is in the Watergraafsmeer in a quiet street, within walking distance of the Middenweg, with nice restaurants, shops for grocery shopping/shopping. Close to the Frankendaelpark and tram stop "Hogeweg" (line 19/direction city center), our house offers a lot for a stay for both a family with children and two couples. There are 2 floors, and an adjacent kitchen (60m2). The top two floors are rented separately (long stay). The hall/stairs are shared.

name: Glorious Duplex on Amsterdam Canal
description: Spacious and light apartment in the old centre of Amsterdam with a magnificant view on canal. 4th and 5th floor, with elevator. Two bedrooms,one large, one small, both with double beds. Kitchen with all conveniences. Close to Rembrandt's house

name: Central Amsterdam Japandi apartment.
description:
Freshly renovated and perfectly positioned, this bright 1-bedroom apartment is designed for connection. The open living space flows seamlessly into the kitchen and dining area, keeping you close whether you're relaxing or preparing a meal. Step outside and discover charming local markets for groceries, leafy parks just moments away for a stroll, and the city's famous canals and culture right on your doorstep. A central stay, styled for comfort and convenience.

Its my personal home (:

name: Nice apartment in Helmersbuurt
description: Stylish and spacious apartment (62 m2) in one of the best locations of Amsterdam. Ideal for single travelers, couples or friends (maximum 2 persons) looking to explore the city. Museum square and Vondelpark in walking distance.

name: Spacious design house near museum district
description:
Beautiful large, light and luxury design townhouse. Located in the hip and centrally located Oud-West neighbourhood, which is only 10min on foot from the city center, Museumdistrict and Vondelpark

King size bed (5star hotel quality), guest room, garden with Weber bbq, open living room/kitchen, Spa Bathroom, Netflix, Sonos, High speed wifi

name: Spacious, light, cosy apt. in the Jordaan district
description: An apartment in a typical 17th century building in the heart of the Jordaan, two minutes from the Anne Frank house, the Westerchurch, shops and restaurants.

name: Premium apartment - Serenity & central location
description:
Welcome to your stylish base in Amsterdam. This premium apartment is especially for working professionals or luxury travelers who value comfort, serenity, and a central location.

Whether you are in the city for a temporary project, a conference, a longer-term assignment, or just a nice getaway, this is the perfect base for you.

Enjoy a high-quality interior, modern amenities, and a peaceful environment close to all key locations and a subway station around the corner.

name: Gezellig gastenverblijf gratis fietsen en parkeren
description:
Very nice cosy and private room for 1/2/3 persons and 4 if really needed.+/_ 22 square meter. Free parking and free bike's, with terms of use. Distance to centre by bike 15 minutes public transport 20 minutes walk. Comfortable 2p bed and a 1p bed. Enjoy the garden in the summer. We don't want people who use drugs. Normal smoking is only allowed in the garden. Please send us a message if you need more information. We are pleased to answer.
The price as shown includes 40%!!! TAXES.

name: Apartment next to the park
description: Apartment in the creative part of Amsterdam with a great mixture of culture, food, entrepreneurs in the creative field, markets, summerfestivals and a great park.

name: Cute place in popular Westerpark (420 friendly)
description: Westerpark is one of the most fantastic areas of Amsterdam! The space is 7min. from the station with the bus, 2 min. on the bike to the  gorgeous & 'happening' (for all ages!) Wester Park itself, a 15 min. stroll to the Jordaan & canals, centre 20min

name: Apartment
description: 85 square cm apartment in the heart of the centre of Amsterdam. Large double bedroom and large single bedroom (with double bed).  Ideal for transport links, tourist attractions and bars. Large lounge and dining area, bathroom and separate WC.

name: Private Studio on a houseboat; with windmill views
description:
When you open the gate to enter our mooring, you get the feeling you've found paradise in
Amsterdam .....and its true!
Private studio on board with your own kitchen, bathroom, Entrance and sundeck with the view of the windmill, green surroundings..

If you leave the room clean; We do not charge extra cleaning cost like most AirBNB rentals!!!

name: Lovely family house with garden (and a cat)
description:
A charming family home in Amsterdam's northside, perfect for families with children. Our 2-bedroom house features a sunny garden and is located in a relaxed area, just 12 minutes by bike or 5 minutes by car from the city center.
We have a cat, her name is Komma, she is shy and independent 🐈‍⬛. We kindly ask you to feed her, which won't require much of your time.
ONLY FAMILIES WITH KIDS, NO PARTYING, NO GROUPS.

name: Quiet, no traffic, garden, optional breakfast
description: In a dead-end street in Amsterdam North, we own a beautiful house with lovely garden on a small canal. No city noises and exhaust fumes, but singing birds and the smell of flowers. Supermarket and bus stop at 500 meters. The very hip NDSM area is 10 bicycle minutes away. Getting to the city center takes about 30 minutes, either via bicycle and free ferry (from NDSM) or bus and metro. Paid parking in the street. And for musicians: we do have a grand piano, guitars, African drums and love jamming.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Luxury apartment. Prime location
description:
Large luxurious penthouse on the Keizersgracht canal in Amsterdam. In the 17th century merchant's house.
Private elevator. Large living room with a canal view, kitchen, 2 bed rooms, bathroom with a bath and a toilet, a seprate toilet. Canal view.

name: Charming apartment in the heart of Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to my charming, bright, and comfortable apartment, located on a quiet street in the popular Amsterdam-West neighborhood.

Within walking distance of the Jordaan, 9 Straatjes, museums, Vondelpark, and the best cafés, restaurants, and boutiques. Ideal for couples or solo travelers who want to experience the city like a local.

My apartment is fully equipped, including a uniquely spacious balcony, so you can feel completely at home in an oasis of peace, yet right in the heart of Amsterdam!

name: Peace & Happiness
description: Cozy & colorful: if you love a warm welcome, you've come to the right place! Do you also enjoy breakfast or a cup of tea at home, so you can calmly consider your plans for the rest of the day? You have a view of the square and are quickly accessible from all other parts of the city, on the Amsterdam highway, and right in the Jordaan district! The apartment is my own and includes pets. Cats are welcome! The bathroom is small and the stairs are quite steep and narrow; there is no elevator.

name: New & specious house in Amsterdam (Metro Noord)
description:
Experience the best of both worlds in our spacious 140m² home (3 floors) located in a peaceful neighborhood. This is the perfect retreat for families who want to explore Amsterdam by day and unwind in a quiet, leafy setting by night.
Start your morning with coffee in the garden while the kids play safely, then take a 12-minute stroll to the "Noord" metro station. From there you arrive to Amsterdam Central Station in just 5 minutes.

.

name: Spacious Family House | Garden | Near RAI & PIJP
description:
★ Located in the Rivierenbuurt
★ Fully equipped kitchen
★ Garden!

description:

name: Prachtig, ruim en luxe appartement op toplocatie
description: A beautiful, spacious (165 m2) and luxurious apartment in the center of Amsterdam. This 2-storey house, with its own entrance, has no less than 4 bedrooms and a very luxurious bathroom. The very spacious and bright living room offers a beautiful view on both sides, a luxurious kitchen with a cooking island and American refrigerator, a lovely sitting area with fireplace, a spacious dining table, a wing and access to 1 of the 2 sunny terraces.

name: PRIVATE AND COSY ROOM FOR 2
description:
Private room, nice room for couple, cosy, clean and sunny. Bathroom with shower and toilet right next to the room, which you share with our housemates.
Note: no acces to kitchen, but there is a kettle to boil water, there is coffee and tea, plates, glasses, cutlery, and I alway leave some fruit and chocolate.
Our house is in a quiet neighbourhood, only 10 minutes from the city centre.

name: Spacious 2BDR loft near Vondelpark.
description: Our spacious apartment, situated in an old school building, has high ceilings, a lovely bathroom, two bedrooms, large windows and a very well equipped kitchen. The famous Vondelpark is around the corner, as are numerous bars, restaurants and markets.

name: Bedroom (B&B) in the center of Amsterdam
description: De Pijp district is the best location to stay in Amsterdam and discover the city by walk.

name: Luxury 17th century monument home with canal views
description: New Holland House is in an idyllic location within the world heritage central canal ring in Amsterdam.  It has been ranked the #1 short term rental in Amsterdam.  It is a picture perfect house with lots of authentic old Amsterdam character and charm, modern amenities  and little luxuries.  This is a serious wow factor  home in an amazing location.

name: Private studio Modern Houseboat Large Roof Terrace
description: Beautiful designed top floor studio in houseboat with a large terrace and amazing views over the water. The studio is very light. Enjoy living on the water with easy and quick access to the inner city centre (with a free private parking place).

name: Charming. Very well located family appartement
description: Charming historic but modern apartment located on a quiet canal. Around the corner you find the characteristic Prinseneiland with his old houses. The funniest shopping street in the Netherlands and the Jordan on a five minutes walk. Tram on the corner.

name: Beautiful big 5-star luxury apartment  (130m2)
description: Our beautiful spacious apartment (130 m2) with big roof terrace (60m2) and  2 balconies and king size beds, is located in the popular neighborhood Old West, right next to the city center and the famous Foodhallen. Only 5-10 minutes’ walk from Leidsesquare, Vondelpark, Rijksmuseum, Jordaan & 9 streets.

name: Unique family apmnt Amsterdam, private parking
description:
Spacious open, loft-style family apartment in a great neighborhood in the center of Amsterdam. Modern and homey. Perfect house to relax after a day in Amsterdam. Close to public transport to all major sights. Three bedrooms with double beds. Unique kitchen, well equipped. Outside terras for sunny days and breakfast outside, this space can also be used as a private parking place right outside the house! Wifi in the whole house.
Sorry we are not renting the house to students and people under 25.

name: Cosy apartment in Amsterdam East!
description: Nice and cosy 2-person apartment in the lively Amsterdam Centrum-East, 10 minutes from the the city center! On the corner of Oosterpark, close to Tropen Museum and perfectly connected with public transport from and to the Airport/Central station (there is a direct train every 15/20 minutes to and from Airport, station is 5 minute walk away)

name: Lovely cosy houseboat in A'dam East
description: The character of this typical self catering B&B on this Houseboat rental is best described as cosy, quit and unique. The stairway gives way to the 30 sqm living/bedroom with a large double bed, comfortable sleeping couch and dining room.

name: Buenas Noches - The Loft
description: Right in the beating heart of Amsterdam, Buenas Noches is found nestled in a quiet cul-de-sac of a verdant lane called Oude Braak. You may find us at number 15, right at the end of the lane, fronted by a private green square.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

description:
★★★★★ PREPARE FOR THE TRIP OF A LIFETIME ★★★★★

Downtown, on a canal, with a 150 sqr m roofterras full of flowers, with shower, lounge area and wonderful views! Only minutes walking from the Anne Frank House, Dam Square, the famous flower market & the Jordaan district. Enjoy!

name: Cozy private studio | Centre of Amsterdam | 2P
description: Always wanted to stay in a monumental house in Amsterdam? This recently renovated studio apartment is located within a 5 minute walk from the main tourist attractions the city has to offer! The studio is great. I am sure you will have a great time at this studio during your stay in Amsterdam!

description:

In summer : bookings of 3-day or more.

name: Lovely luxurious apartment in the Pijp (75m2)
Top location, quiet guesthouse, 2p
description: Everything you need is provided in this two room guesthouse with kitchen and bedroom. Perfect location, in the middle of Amsterdam. Walking distance to all museums, restaurants, shops etc. The guesthouse and patio are no smoking area's.

name: Modern & Stylish Apartment Amsterdam Westerpark
description:
Enjoy a cosy fourth-floor apartment in Amsterdam’s charming Westerpark neighborhood. This inviting home features one comfortable bedroom with a king-size bed, a modern bathroom, a fully equipped kitchen, and an open-plan living space with a dining area and relaxing seating area.

Step onto the private balcony overlooking a picturesque canal and soak in the local atmosphere.

Surrounded by great cafés, shops, and parks, it’s the perfect base for exploring the city.

10th SUPERHOST YEAR!

description:
Welcome aboard the Amsterdam Houseboat Family!

Part of the Amsterdam Houseboat Family, Michele has two delightful compact modern studios situated on her boat in ‘de Pijp’. Each private studio comes with all the necessary amenities needed for a comfortable stay in Amsterdam plus access to a large roof terrace for your summer bbq or swim. It is ideally situated for easy access to every part of the city and is located on an extremely charming and peaceful canal in ‘de Pijp’.

name: Bright & comfy private room, close to Vondelpark
description: Stylish private room situated in one of the most popular neighbourhood (Old South) of the city. The location is perfect for your visit to Amsterdam. You will be close to the infamous Vondelpark and Museum Square, where you will find Rijksmuseum and many more museums who are worth a visit. The canals are close by, you can cycle or take the tram to visit all the beautiful sights. All you need for an amazing stay in the city!

name: Fantastic Family House De Pijp directly at Park
description: This Monumentale House (1898) with garden is situated at the most beautiful spot at the park, behind the famous Albert Cuyp Market and within walking distance of Museum Square, Concert hall. Limitless restaurants and bars in the area and the Park 10 meters away. Also the most beautiful shops and boutiques are near.

name: Deluxe Modern Amstel Canal View
description:
A deluxe and modern renovated 1st floor apartment with fascinating River view, 1 Master Bedroom, Rain Shower, app.: 861 ft.²

2 French balconies in front (Amstel River View) and 1 in the back.

It's like a Presidential Suite with a spectacular view!

name: Nice 45m2  private room with shower & roof terrace
description:
Clean, quiet and spacious room.

Please be aware that I also live in the apartment with my son/co-host Evan. Guests will occasionally encounter us. Guests have their own private shower room and sink right next to their private bedroom.
The spaces shared with the residents are two toilets, the kitchen and the living room.

name: Cosy apartment nexto Amstel River
description: Right nexto the beautiful Amstel River with its nice boulevard, cafes, restaurants and picknick places, you will immidiately feel at home in this stylish renovated apartment. Perfect for a couple or two friends. The Amstel Station is on walking distance in case you want to explore the rest of this amazing city.

name: Cosy Studio, with outdoor Swimming
description: Cosy studio with full privacy in a quiet spot, right in the city center. Fully renovated in 2025 for that true ‘hotel chic’ feel. Swim outside in spring/summer, relax at the waterfront lounge for breakfast or a romantic dinner. Towels and picnic blanket provided. Bars, cafés, restaurants, and a local shopping strip just around the corner. Nature nearby for walks or cycling. A great yoga studio in 2 minutes walk. Includes optional laundry service (€20).

name: Cosy guest suite in Old City, Amsterdam
description: A cosy private SMOKE FREE guest suite, newly renovated located in the heart of the Amsterdam old city for 2 persons. The guest suite is located on the 1st floor in a Rijksmonument house which has been build more than 300years ago. Comfortable and spacious, with a private bathroom and shower . cosy day bed, nothing is shared.

description:
Lovely new, clean and spacious eco family house, suitable for 4 adults or a family with 2 kids.

Cat living in the house needs to be looked after. Does not have access to bedrooms.

description:
Welcome to the historic city center of Amsterdam!

Looking forward to seeing you in Amsterdam! :)

P.S. No (weed) smoking in or around the house.

name: Stylish houseboat for 2
description:
Gorgeous houseboat moored on historic canal. The B&B is 60 m2, with ample living space, an open kitchen, a bedroom and bathroom. Outside is a large deck.

Perfect for a couple, not for guests who have trouble with steep stairs

We live in the rear end of the boat and our guests stay in the front.

description:
Bed and Bath.

name: Light modern house with terrace
description:
The living room is spacious & light. And furnished with a mix of modern and vintage design. The kitchen is open. It is a place to feel home.

The apartment is central located between the airport Schiphol and the city centre of Amsterdam.

name: Citycenter Canal-house 5 * non-shared room+ensuite
description: Luxury room with private entrance door next to the elevator in historic Canal-house. Totally private, nothing shared. Located just a 10-minute walk away from the buzzing Dam Square is this comfortable room with en-suite.  There is a coffee maker, watercooker, refrigerator, TV and high-speed internet. Free Wi-Fi
Free Ferry to Amsterdam Central & back!
CLEAN, COMFORTABLE & spacious rooms!
Full Kitchen and equipement including refrigerator!

Just 15 min to Amsterdam Central very close to city center!

Lots of hip cafe's, restaurants and the best festival area!

name: The North is The Place to Be! Private and Calm
description:
The North is happening right now ! Covid19-free Area ! Extra cleaning after each visit ! The room is like an apartment and very private . A Real Big Balinese lounge-bed to sleep in. Mattress is 2meters 55 cm long ! Big spacious room .City Center is only 10 min away by Bus and Metro . Rental of Bikes is possible . Quiet area. Shopping mall only 50 meters away. Working Pinball machine inside !
Shower and toilet straight opposite the room. Washing sink inside the room with cold running water.

name: Room3-Jordaan Marina/Pool Table/Spa bath/Roof area
description:
"Meet me at Michelles" is living on a marina, on a main canal in the Jordaan, near Anne Franks house. 16 boats out front for hire, no license required

Guests use pool table; piano; spa bath; baby roof area; kitchen; massage chair; internet; sports equip/half rack

Centrally located, 15 mins ish to Westerpark (Nth), Leidseplein/Vondelpark (Sth), Museumplein (SSE), Dam Sqr (SE), C.S (E) we're in the centre of it all :)

I also live here. Guests live like a local/flatmate; make yourself at home 😊

name: Monumental Boutique Apartment w. garden
description: This ground-floor apartment is part of a protected 17th-century former weaver’s house in the heart of old Amsterdam. Fully renovated and ideal for couples or families, it has one master bedroom with a super king-size bed and a beautiful wooden loft bed for two. The sunny, spacious patio is a rare gem for the city center. Clean, comfortable, and full of charm, perfect for those seeking a unique and restful stay.

name: De Cornelia, large houseboat
description:
Welcome to The Cornelia,
The Cornelia, once a sturdy working vessel, was converted into a unique houseboat in the 1980s. Four seasons a year we enjoy the tranquility and rusticity here at our special place in Amsterdam-North. Living in a metropolis and living outside with the elements. Rowing and swimming or walking in the forest right on the other side of the gangway. And with only twenty minutes by bike or subway we are in the middle of the splendor and bustle of our beloved city.

name: Private Room- Ma Chambre.
description:
*** Please read the full details and profile before booking your stay.**
A cozy bed room in an apartment building of 3 floors, built in the year of 1936.
A classic big and bright bedroom nicely located in the suburb and an easy
access to places of Amsterdam and neighbouring cities. Walking distance to the the RAI convention center.
Transportations are a +/-15 minutes walk either tram or the metro line.
Kindly read “Other things to note” to avoid any inconvenience during your stay”

name: Bright & authentic apartment in lively Old West
description: Welcome to our peaceful, cozy oasis in vibrant Oud-West. The perfect place to unwind after a day in the city. This bright, characterful apartment is located close to the center, within walking distance of hotspots like De Hallen, the Jordaan, and the Negen Straatjes. With plenty of shops, cafés, and restaurants just around the corner, you’ll experience the true Amsterdam here – lively, yet with a feeling of coming home. Also perfect for families with little children.

name: Charming house close to city center
description: Our lovely house is located in a cosy , beautiful little street in the great West part of town. In a lively neighbourhood with bars, restaurants, parks and playgrounds for children. Trams stop around the corner, the city centre is closeby. You can even walk. The house offers tranquility in the bustling, lively city. A place to love! In a city to love.

name: Reijgershof - Yurt Experience with garden view

Welcome to Guesthouse Reijgershof - Mongolian Yurt Experience 🌿

Guesthouse Reijgershof is a charming retreat with 4 private suites and this one of a kind Mongolion Yurt, each featuring its own bathroom and access to the large garden. Located on the edge of Amsterdam, this accommodation combines the peace of nature with the vibrant energy of the city. Whether for one night or a longer stay, it’s the perfect place where both body and mind can come to rest.

name: Luxury city apartment

Super central location, only 100 metres from the Leidseplein and 200 metres from the world famous Rijksmuseum. Completely renovated. The apartment is located on the ground floor (no stairs!) and has full privacy.
With private patio, fully equipped kitchen, airco, modern bathroom, smart tv etc.

name: Cherry Tree Bed & Breakfast
description:
A cozy Bed & breakfast located in Amsterdam South offering a luxurious room with an en-suite bathroom and separate guest toilet, garden and sleeping arrangement for 2 people.
Within walking distance from Tram 2 stop with which you will reach Central Station in 40 minutes. Leidseplein square can be reached in 20 minutes and the Museum Square in even less.

Very central apartment, perfectly located next to the Heineken experience.

1 large bedroom & large living with open kitchen. As it is my own place, you won't end up in a impersonal hotel style place; it's a personal, cosy & warm environment, with anything available you might need.

description:
As an artist and independent minded traveller I created a room in my house as I like to stay in.
The house is located in a unique quiet street in Amsterdam, it feels as a village in the middle of Amsterdam center, the lively neighbourhood De Pijp.

More than 100 year old traditional dutch sailing ship (refurbished in 1998 ;-) with cosy mess room, 5 cabins for max. 16 guests, 2 showers and toilets and central heating... about 20 minutes to go from Central Station (about 10 minutes by bus).
To book the ship in Amsterdam is only possible in combination with a sailing trip of at least one day - a unique experience for you and your group. The trip is included in the price. Ask for the possibilities.
NO GROUPS FOR PARTIES OR NIGHTLIFE!

name: Beautifull designed apartment AMS

This beautiful room is situated near Amsterdam city center. It has 2 single beds next to each other. Its on the ground floor.
Its my daughters room so I use it when she is away. No partys. Please not that its a room! NOT the whole house .

Nestled on a quiet residential street in, you’re within walking distance of major attractions. Just a 30-minute bus ride from Schiphol Airport and 17 minutes by tram from Amsterdam Central Station.

Ground-floor apartment in the CENTER of Amsterdam in a peaceful area. Museums, red-light district, parks, and central attractions are close by! Your private room has a mini fridge, hot water maker, lockable door, and private access to a small garden in the courtyard.

You can use the shared fully-stocked kitchen. It's easy-going environment! Free fast wifi. 4/20. We have a kitten.

name: Bright garden view room, airco, private bathroom
description:
Spacious room within a villa with a new king size pocket spring bed, luxury all cotton bedlinnen, your own ensuite bathroom and a big balcony with chairs and a little table. Super fast wifi. With airconditioning in a quiet, residential area in Amsterdam South. Public transport a 4 minute walk and easy, quick access to the city center, by tram, bus and metro.
G oogle, Accenture, Akzo, RAI all within walking distance. The city center is quickly reached by tram 5, metro 52 , and on foot.

name: Luxury Delft Blue room, airco, private bathroom
description:
Enjoy a spacious and bright room in our home. Relax in a king-size pocket spring bed with soft cotton linens, a balcony, and enjoy your own modern ensuite bathroom.
We offer fast WiFi, a work friendly room and an air conditioning/converter. Nestled in a small, residential area of Amsterdam South, our home offers free parking and is just a 4-minute walk from public transport, providing quick and easy access to the city center. The Zuidas and RAI congress center are within walking distance.

name: Spacious apartment near Jordaan
description: This comfortable & spacious apartment is situated close to the Centre and on the edge of the famous Jordaan. It has a great open kitchen, two double beds, a lovely small garden, a nice bathroom with tub, and it's tastefully decorated.

name: Traditional Dutch "Dyke House" 1914
description: This tradional Dutch "Dyke House" is built in 1914 against a dyke. This means that at the front you enter mid-level in the living. Downstairs the garden and the front is in the old dyke.  Situated directly at a park. Only 5 min from city center!

name: Family Loft overlooking canals
description: We live in a beautiful modern loft (old warehouse) in the center of Amsterdam but on a quiet street. 124 m2 in size and almost 4 meters high. Big open kitchen, beautiful bathroom (only shower), and 3 bedrooms; 1 with a double bed, 2 with single beds. Our sunny balcony overlooks a canal and the view is wonderful. The elevator takes you straight into the house. By foot, it only takes 10 minutes to the well-known 'Jordaan' area, with lovely restaurants, markets,  and cozy spots for coffee or wine.

name: ★ 3BED ★ 2BATH ★ CITY CENTER ★ ROOFTOP TERRACE ★
description:
Our lovely three floors apartment is 120 m2 big with three bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Guests will have the entire apartment to themselves, no facilities are shared and there is a free acces to Wifi/internet.

The apartment fits 4 persons and is situated in the centre of town.
All major sightseeings are in walking distance from the house.
Busses and trams to different area's/locations in town stop in front of the apartment.
The major shopping area of Amsterdam is just 10 minutes walk from here.

name: 1 bedr appt in quiet neighbourhood
description: Nice Comfy 1 bedroom appt (75m2), modern, lots of light. Fully equiped kitchen, small balcony. 700 meter to closest train station. 15 mins to city center. Very close to supermarket. LONG TERM guests are welcome!

name: Cosy and Light Apartment Modern
description:
Spacious and light appartment, 100m2, on the 6th floor with elevator.
Large and stylish living room, open modern kitchen, 2 large bedrooms and and lovely bathroom. Sunny living room and nice balcony.
Open view, free feeling and very quiet. Very good beds. Incheck until 20.00 hours. Leaving unti.12.00 hours

name: Cozy modern "Loft" apartment in canal district
description:
Discover a new kind of business hotel in the heart of the canal district.

Located within 1 mile of Amsterdam Central Station, Zoku is designed for professionals, business travelers, and remote workers who are on the lookout for a trendy & sustainable apartment hotel for 1 day, to 1 month, to 1 year.

When you feel like leaving your private Loft to socialize, the rooftop Social Spaces are open 24/7 and cater to your fun, practical, and professional needs - all while providing amazing views!

name: Dubbel bovenhuis met dakterras
description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

name: Light family house in Amsterdam
description: Our light house with south-facing garden is situated in hip Amsterdam Noord. Quiet area, free parking and less than 10 minutes cycling to the ferry that brings you right in the historic city centre of Amsterdam. Ideal for families.

name: The Studio
description: Sleep quietly in New Amsterdam, visit spectacular Old Amsterdam. We live five minutes from the canals and the historic center of Amsterdam. We love to welcome you.

name: Sunny Apt in Centre Amsterdam
description: The modern and bright apartment is situated in one of the best parts of Amsterdam, walking distance from Vondelpark and Museumplein and with lotsa hip bars and restaurants around.

name: Fabulous family House (3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms)
description:
Experience the joys of this peaceful area while being close to the liveliness of Amsterdam.

Our spacious 3-bedroom house is situated in the trendy Northern part of the city. It is 1 metrostop away from the central station of Amsterdam and 10-15 minutes by bike & (free) ferry from the city center.

Our house is located opposite a nice chill park in a residential area without many tourists.

All utilities and amenities are included, so all you need to do is bring your suitcase!

name: Amsterdam Centre Studio - Sarphati
description:
Comfortable, nicely decorated and practical bed/livingroom suited for two persons.
Own entrance directly from the street, with a small street patio to drink your morning coffee.
Private bathroom with shower and toilet .
Basic kitchen facilities.

name: Private Studio in the “Pijp” near hotspots
description: The Studio is a all in one apartment on the ground floor, with all necessary things like a own small kitchen, television, wifi etc., and a own shower and toilet en suite. The electric slatted bed (1.80 x 2.00) can function as a sofa. The main feauture of the studio is the location: Situated on the ground floor in a very popular neighbourhood. (de Pijp), , on walking distance of the Albert Cuypmarkt, the Rijksmuseum, van Gogh museum and Stedelijk Museum.

name: Wellness & Comfort Apartment Amsterdam RAI, 165 m²
description:
Welcome to this beautifully renovated and spacious apartment in Amsterdam Zuid. Perfectly located near the RAI, metro, tram, and Schiphol Airport, with easy access to the city centre.

✨ Highlights:
• 5 minutes from RAI, metro & tram
• Bus stop in front of the apartment
• Ideal for business travelers
• Baby bed & high chair available
• Fast WiFi & comfortable workspace
• Smoke detectors for your safety

Enjoy comfort, convenience, and a relaxing stay in Amsterdam.

name: Vrijstaand kindvriendelijk huis in Amsterdam!
description:
Beautiful and comfortable detached house with south-facing garden. Intended for families. Quiet neighborhood 20 minutes bike ride from downtown. Nice family home with a wonderfully bright kitchen-diner, a green south-facing garden and 3 bedrooms, with all the comforts. The kitchen-living room has a cozy dining table, a seating area and a spacious countertop with an induction stovetop.
Sweet cat present that needs food daily.

name: Spacious house for family / friends
description: This is a wonderful newly built family house of 140m2 home where you can completely relax with your family. It is fully equipped, also for the children. Modern furnishings, comfortable couch, comfortable large dining table, large wel equipped kitchen, floor heating, nice rug on the floor, enclosed garden to play, free parking in front of the door. And around the corner you can jump into the water from the bathing jetty. You can park in the streets (paid).

name: Stylish house with big sunny garden, near Zuid As.
description: This beautiful 140m2 ground floor apartment, situated in a high end neighborhood, is decorated with great care. The street is quiet. Nearby you will find all you need; the Beethovenstraat with it's wonderful shops, cafe's and restaurants, the Vondelpark, the Museumsquare, Beatrixpark etc. If you are here on business: we are very near to the Zuid-As and the RAI. Public transport and the train station Amsterdam Zuid WTC are nearby and will take you all over town and the rest of Holland.

name: Family apartment (max. 4) in centre of Amsterdam
description:
A two floor family apartment in the middle of the historic center of Amsterdam, perfectly suitable for max. 4 adults or 2 adults and 2 children. You are within walking distance of everything Amsterdam has to offer. The apartment has two bedrooms, each with a double bed. There is a bathroom, a living room, a fully equipped kitchen and a small terrace. If you and your friends or family are interested in culture and the old center of Amsterdam, you are very welcome.

Rob and Francés

name: Luxurious spacious suite Jordaan
description: Het Behouden Huis is located in the Jordaan, in the historical center of Amsterdam. In the 1980’s, many houses in the neighborhood were torn down. The owner of this house, by renovating singlehandedly, made sure this house was saved.

name: Luxurious boutique suite in City Center
description: If a spacious, neat and stylish suite in the city centre of Amsterdam is what you are looking for, then this is the perfect location for your stay in Amsterdam. The room is bright, modern and you will feel right at home. The room is accommodated with a double bed. It is located next to Museum Square, Leidse Square and the famous Vondelpark, plus the beautiful canals are right around the corner. I am sure you will have a great time here! This quiet area appreciates responsible guests.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: 3p family apartment with great view and 2 cats!
description: Bright, two bedroom apartment, warm atmosphere, cozy balcony, where you can really 'live' Amsterdam, perfect location, nearby centre, in quiet parque. 3 minutes walk to public transport. Located in lovely area of A'dam, close to tourist sites. And... with two ragdoll cats of 4 years old! So you must like cats-:), they need taking care while we are away.

name: modern, spacious appartment.
description: Modern, spacious appartment in one of the most trendy neighbourhoods of Amsterdam-West.

name: Luxurious family home 210m2  in the city center
description: We have a very spacious, loft-like luxurious family home in the middle of the Oud-West area. It's a perfect home for families with 2 or 3 children, furthermore the master bedroom is furnished with a kingsize bed (180x200cm) and the spare room is furnished with a queen size bed (160x200cm). Also you may use both of the bathrooms and the back garden. The biggest plus-point of our house that it is nearby the FOODHALLEN. You can try a wide selection of cuisine over here

name: Bright room in city center park
description: Our apartment is centrally located in an award winning housing project in a unique city center park close to Amsterdam's main attractions. Public transport (bus, tram) is just around the corner providing you with options to easily get around.

name: Comfortable 4-Person Apartment in De Baarsjes
description: I would love to welcome you to my apartment for up to 4 guests, located in a cool neighborhood close to the city center. The apartment is situated Amsterdam Old West. Within walking distance, you’ll find many coffee spots, cafés, bars, restaurants, boutiques, and two large parks.

name: Cosy apartment, only for small families
description:
Our comfortable and romantically lit apartment in the city centre (58 square meters) is suitable for, AND WILL ONLY BE RENTED TO, small families (two adults and a child, and a baby). There is a large double bed and, in the second room, a double sofa bed.
The apartment is on the top (4th) floor and can be reached by elevator. Prize is all-inclusive. Free wifi.

name: Jolly Horses
description: This apartment has a spacious living room, fully equipped kitchen and 1 bedroom! Located in walking distance from CENTRAL STATION!  The apartment is situated on the third floor, the firts flight off stairs is very steep!!! ,and overlooks the city.

name: Cosy Prinsengracht Canal View Private Room – Suite
description: Charming BnB guestroom with a private bathroom and stunning views over the Prinsengracht Canal. The room is bright and tastefully decorated, and features a TV, Nespresso coffee machine, and direct access to a private bathroom.

name: Nice quiet room for one person only
description:
The room is situated near a recreational area and has good access via subway to Amsterdam city; The neighborhood is quite and green.
So it combines the city and the country side. You have access to the kitchen and your own refrigerator.

name: Unique studio on cutter 'Rosita'
description: 'Rosita' is a seaworthy shrimper, built in 1948, converted into a comfortable yacht for two people. The entire boat is at your disposal, centrally heated, shower, small kitchen etc. The yacht is moored in the centre of Amsterdam on a very quiet spot.

name: Spacious house  family and business, non smoking
description: We offer a whole house (140m2), 2 floors with a sunny garden in the south part of Amsterdam. A nice and quiet neighborhood but full of atmosphere, shops and great restaurants, close to the city center, a 5 min walk to the Vondelpark and Museum district. the city center is 10 minutes walk and 5 minutes by bike or tram.

name: Canal View Loft
description: Five windows overlooking the most beautiful canal junction in the historic city centre make this modern minimalist appartment in a 17th century monument a most wanted location to enjoy Amsterdam at its very best!

name: Cozy appartment in the center!
description: Bright, renovated place nearby city center ( 10 min walk to Jordaan, 3 min to take tram to Museum area). Well equipped kitchen, comfortable bathroom with a shower and a bath where you can relax! Space living room with a pull out comfy sofa that is made into a bed in your arrival

name: Family Home with Rooftop Terrace
description:
Perfect for families or couples, a bright, open plan apartment on floors 3-5 with a sunny roof terrace in a very quiet, local neighbourhood just outside the heart of Amsterdam (not really suitable for groups of friends, sorry!).

Spacious open plan living area and separate level for sleeping. Just a 5 min walk to the canals, + 15 min to the Anne Frank museum. Great choice of local bars, restaurants and children's playgrounds with a multitude of things to do in the beautiful Westerpark.

name: Beautiful 2-storey apt. Vondelpark
description: Our comfortable and recently revovated 120 square meter apartment with 40 sqm garden combines the peace and quiet of the Vondelpark with the liveliness of the city. Perfect for families or couples who want to go for the luxury experience.

name: Spacious and light private apt
description: Spacious and light private apartment in one of the most green and pretty areas of central Amsterdam. 1 bedroom (double bed) with ensuite bathroom, large living room with open kitchen, sunny balcony. Walking distance from several sights and museums

name: Canal view apartment
description:
Light & modern apartment in the city of Amsterdam. Amazing view over the canal. Near the centre, Westerpark and a lot of nice bars & restaurants (5 minute walk). Transport around the corner.
Not allowed to sleep on the couch:)

name: HISTORISCH WOONSCHIP TJALK (1908)
description: Rustic berth in Amsterdam, located in the tranquility, near bustling Amsterdam. You will find everything in one place: comfort, privacy, nature, history and culture. Floating in the clean swimming and fishing waters of the IJ, you will (re)discover our capital city.

name: Lovely 50m2 renovated appartement near Vondelpark
description: My little boudoir is a 50 m2 two room appartement with balcony, centered on the first floor. The bedroom is a double bed light spacious room with two big windows with a great view of the Jan Pieter Heijestraat. The apartment has been renovated  in april 2023

name: Spacious loft with 4 bedrooms
description: This beautiful 195 m² duplex penthouse is located in the vibrant De Pijp area, just steps from the famous Albert Cuyp Market. Situated on the 4th floor and accessible by elevator, the apartment offers comfort and space. A private roof terrace provides stunning views of the Rijksmuseum and the RAI. With excellent tram connections to East and West Amsterdam, a 10-minute walk to the RAI, 5 minutes by tram to the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh, and close proximity to Vondelpark, this penthouse is stunning

name: Beautiful room with balcony
description: Our room comes along with its own private bathroom, own shower, own balcony and own entrance. You have your own key and only share the main entrance but you do not have to pass through our house. Come and stay in our light and sunny room with your own entrance,  bathroom and balcony.

name: Single Sunny Room with great views over the water
description:
Free ferry to Central Station // Free WiFi

This cozy bedroom is located on the ground floor of our houseboat and offers beautiful views over the water.

Next to the room you’ll find a shared bathroom and a mostly private toilet.

Enjoy a unique stay that combines the tranquility of nature with the convenience of city life.

Public transport and a supermarket are just 500 meters away.

Tip: book your Anne Frank House tickets in advance, as they sell out quickly.

name: Perfect house boat in Amsterdam
description:
This houseboat is located at the Da Costakade, near the city center. The apartment is newly renovated and clean. There is a comfortable living area, a kitchen, 1 bedroom (with a double bed) and bathroom. The houseboat has open terraces on the waterside and the streetside. The houseboat is suited for two persons.

-Perfect location

name: House for families & cat lovers only close to NDSM
description: Our cozy family home with cat for 2 adults + kids is located in a typical 30s neighborhood built for the shipbuilding workers on the NDSM shipyard . 100m2 garden incl. trampoline for children and biking distance of both city and nature, the perfect location!

name: Big room, privately on 1thfloor and own entrance.
description: Spacious and bright room (30m) en suite bathroom. The room covers the whole first floor in a nice and quiet neighbourhood in the north of the city. Private door that gives access  without entering any shared spaces. Supermarket only a stone throw away. Easy access to the city center in 25 minutes by public transport with a busstop just across the street. Amenities include; a minifridge, Nespresso, watercooker, microwave and cutlery. Free use of our garden with a picnic table at the waterfront.

name: De Pijp B&B, Garden View
description:
It is rare to find tranquility in the midst of a bustling, thriving neighborhood. This room offers just that, a clean, cozy hide away. A few minutes walk from the city center and the river Amstel! Early bag drop off and late pick up is possible.

The Bathroom is shared with max. two other people.

name: Top studio with garden & inhouse parking
description:
Recently renovated studio at top location. Quiet area with nice restaurants. 5 minute walk to the main attractions: Van Gogh, Stedelijk and Rijksmuseum, Concertgebouw (10min), Leidseplein(5).
Vondelpark(3) & Pijp.
In house parking included!

name: De Pijp B&B
description:
It is rare to find tranquility in the midst of a bustling, thriving neighborhood. This room offers just that, a clean, cozy hide away. A few minutes walk from the city center and the river Amstel! Early bag drop off and late pick up is possible!

The bathroom is shared with max. two other people.

name: Modern & sunny apartment in Centre
description: Our house is a light and comfortable apartment of 110m2. It is situated in a booming area, located on a modern canal with a still working windmill. It's in the Centre (on the East side), lovely quiet at night, very much an up-coming area. Very good situated to explore Amsterdam

name: Lovely light apartment RAI Zuid-As
description: A cozy light two room apartment in Amsterdam. Nearby WTC, Zuid-As and RAI confention center. Perfect connections for train, metro and tram to both Shiphol Airport and Amsterdam City Center. Allso next to an Luxerious shoppingmall Groot Gelderland Plein.  And with good restaurants in The neigbourhood.

name: Nice apartment with balcony and Whirlpool
description: Nice apartment (for 2 persons) with a cozy balcony and whirlpool in a 60m2 apartment  in Amsterdam.  The apartment is fully equipped and perfectly located, close to a supermarket, restaurants, public transport and just 10 minutes to centre and 20 min the airport.

name: Near RAI, modern ground floor appt+garden
description: Our ground floor appartment with garden in the Rivierenbuurt is in a very nice and quiet street, 100 meters from the RAI convention centre and very close to Schiphol Aiport. The city center is close by and can easily be reached by public transportation or by bike.

name: LaCorteSconta B&B - Family Room
description: A unique stay in a floating villa, a truly special experience. Bright and welcoming, the Family Room is perfect for friends or families with young children, with up to 2 separate bedrooms plus an extra room with a French bed. Each room offers Wi-Fi, TV with international and sports channels, Disney+, Wi-Fi headphones, fridge, coffee pod machine, blankets and pillows. The private bathroom has bathtub or shower and separate toilet, while a unique water-level view completes this unforgettable stay.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Nice apartment close to City Centre
description: Great apartment with two levels and very close to central station. Within 10 minutes walk to city center. Large bedroom with queensize bed, clean bathroom with big shower and bath. Nice kitchen with a little balcony. Free WIFI.

name: Historical Downtown Amsterdam | prime location
description:
CONTINENTAL BREAKFAST GOODIES IN YOUR ROOM
If you love the historical roots of Amsterdam this is the ultimate destination to stay downtown.
The house is located on an island in the historical downtown city of Amsterdam. You can access your apartment suite 24/7
Located 5 minutes from Central Station and 20 minutes from Schiphol airport.
We operate secure clean & take care of your safety.

name: kramerskamer
description: It is a small studio, like a big camper. The studio is near the river Amstel and in an quiet neighboorhood in the old jewish part of Amsterdam. Public transport around the corner, lots of restaurants, musea, open markets and nice pubs nearby.

name: Cosy apartment in center of Amsterdam
description: This apartment is located in the center of Amsterdam on the canal site, with own entrance and private bathroom with shower. There is no kitchen, but there is the possibility to make some food. This 1-bedroom apartment is part of our family home, with complete privacy (day & night) during your entire stay. It is easy to reach the Amsterdam Central Station, Schiphol Airport and other places with public transport. Please note that the apartment is on the 4th floor and SMOKING IS NOT ALLOWED.

name: Cosy appartment located in a lovely area.
description: In a very nice, relaxed neighborhood 10 minutes walk from the city center is located this nice ground floor apartment. The apartment is perfect for two people. The appartement has a bathroom with a bath and a separate shower, a living room and an open kitchen and a large bedroom. The apartment is 3 minutes walk from the Vondelpark and 15 minutes from the Olympic Stadium.

name: Intimate studio
description: An intimate studio in quiet neighborhood  of Amsterdam. Less than 20 minutes away from Schiphol airport and Amsterdam Central station, The Dam square and most museums. The public transport is nearby, tramway,metro, train, and bus are about 5 and max 8 minutes from here.  You share the front door. There are three separate floors with separate doors with a lock.

name: Stylish suite with private bathroom at Vondelpark
description:
The suite is located in the heart of Amsterdam next to Vondelpark. You have a view on the popular street Overtoom. Full of local restaurants and bars within a few minutes walk. Famous Museumplein and Leidseplein is 15mins walk across the beautiful Vondelpark or 5/10mins by tram.
Tram stop right in front of the house

Bike rental next door and across the street
Supermarket Albert Heijn 80meters away

King bed
Cleaning fee included
Self checkin with keypad 24/7
Maximum of two guests

name: Lovely renovated light apartment!
description: Completely renovated very light apartment located in the Amsterdam West District. The fully furnished 3-room apartment meets all your needs for a perfect stay in Amsterdam city!

name: New and light apartment!
description:
Welcome to our light and beautiful home. We just completely renovated the place, adding all our favourite furniture and touches. We hope you will love it as much as we do!

We offer a spacious bedroom with double bed, living room, kitchen, and bathroom.

name: Amsterdam from above
description:
On the top 16th floor of the complex Rembrandt Residences,
recently renovated apartment of 107 sqm with elevator and balcony on the south / west. The light apartment at the rear of the complex and has a wonderful view over the city

name: Houseboat 'Jupiter' Amsterdam
description:
Voted the most beautiful houseboat in the Netherlands!
With its unique location right next to the Skinny Bridge (Magere Brug), this houseboat offers a unique Amsterdam experience with breathtaking views.

Wake up to the sound of lapping water beneath you, sip your coffee on the deck, and experience the city like a local. This houseboat offers comfort, tranquility, and a unique atmosphere. Close to the city center, yet far from the hustle and bustle. An authentic stay you won't soon forget!

name: Perfect Luxury for business travelers and families
description:
3 minute walk from RAI convention Center

120m2 very light and warm spacious house with huge garden, filled with high quality furniture.

Master bedroom with king sized hotel quality bed and double doors which open to the garden.

Large extra bedroom and smaller 3rd bedroom, large bathroom with bathtub and separate walk in shower.

The open kitchen is fully equipped and connects to the garden.

Close to a variety of bars & restaurants.

Only available for business travelers and families.

name: Private room adjacent to the Garden room
description:
Our lovely apartment is located in a quiet & green neighberhoud.
The apartment have own entrance ground floor with private entrance and own bathroom and toilet.

name: Cozy apartment with garden (close to Westerpark)
description: This unique place is located in one of the best areas of Amsterdam: Westerpark. A quiet neighbourhood, right opposite of a great nature park and yet only a 10-15 minute walk from the center. The park is ideal for walks, cycling, culture, museums, dinner and drinks.

name: Cosy, comfortable, quiet bedroom
description:
Good bed in pleasant surrounding. One bedroom (the one with the painting and not the one with the mirror), and sharing of bathroom.

Ideal situated for airport, metro, bus and tram. Quiet surroundings and
the different city centres (Pijp, Jordaan, Museumquarter, Vondelpark, Eye,
Central Station) are easily reached by public transport.

No breakfast and no use of kitchen.

name: Cozy Family Suite by Museum Square
description: Ideal for family: two connected bedrooms with own private entry at the ground floor of 1912 historic building in the heart of Museum District. Own bathroom incl. shower. No kitchen. But fridge, microwave, tea and Nespresso machine at your disposal.

name: Charming Luxury Apartment in Canal Area
description: We live in the heart of Amsterdam in the Fokke Simonszstraat. This is quiet street within the "grachtengordel". Tourist activities are easily accessible by foot or by bike.

name: Lovely apartment in the City center
description: Comfortable 2-room apartment only 5 minutes by bike from Amsterdam Central Station! Within walking distance you could go to the famous and popular shopping street Haarlemmerstraat/Haarlemmerdijk or go for food and drinks at the Westergasterrein (bars and restaurants). Public transport (trams and busses) stop within 2 min walking from the apartment.

name: Artistic loft in green oasis with view on windmill
description:
Modern and light apartment in green oasis with garden and view on the old windmill.

It has a spacious living room, a sleeping room with a big comfortable bed, a fully equipped kitchen and a bathroom with shower. There is also a private garden.

The place is located in a quiet street (no traffic) in the centre/east side of the city. Only 10 minutes away from Central Station by bike/public transport. Walking distance to Artis (the zoo) and other highlights.

name: Amazing ground floor apt. in city centre @Jordaan!
description: I would love to welcome you in this delightful ground floor apartment in an old factory downtown. There is room for 3 people and a baby. It is a functionally classified studio with all modern conveniences, such as very comfortable beds, your personal entrance at ground level, modern bathroom and fresh towels and linnen. If you are looking for a home away from home, you will not find a better location in the authentic Jordan. The area is full of great restaurants, café's, canals and shops.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Your Luxury Home at Vondelpark
description: I love meeting interesting people with a diverse cultural background, thus decided to share my space and let you fully embrace the beauty of the city.

name: Charming studio in Amsterdam noord
description:
My cosy studio is the perfect place to stay in Amsterdam
The thoughtfully designed room blends with modern amenities to ensure a comfortable stay providing a home-away-from-home experience. Easy Access to the City Center: The subway station is conveniently located nearby, providing a direct connection to Amsterdam's city center in just minutes. You'll be exploring the iconic canals, museums, and vibrant streets in no time!



Prepare for a unique and comfortable stay!

name: Quiet & Central Canal View Apartment
description: Escape to our stylish retreat in a charming central neighborhood. This bright, canal-side apartment comfortably fits 4 guests. Enjoy nice canal views, a king bed and modern amenities. It's the perfect quiet haven, just steps from the city's buzz, offering a unique village-like atmosphere. Ideal for couples, small families, or remote workers seeking comfort and style.

name: Houseboat Trijntje, Prinsengracht, Amsterdam,
description: Welcome on our gorgeous lazy design houseboat which is stylish, authentic and super comfortable! Including sun deck with comfy deckchairs, priceless canal views with the 17th century merchant houses.

name: Centre apartment w/ garden | Westerpark | CS 5min
description:
Spacious three-bedroom apartment with a large garden, right next to the vibrant Westerpark – the place to be during Amsterdam summers (bars, restaurants, food markets, festivals, Fashion Week). Just 600 meters from the Jordaan and the city centre.

Only a 5-minute taxi ride from Central Station, or 10 minutes by bus (running every 15 minutes).
The apartment comfortably accommodates 2 adults and 1 or 2 young children. The 80 m² garden is quiet and perfect for relaxing.

name: Room in hip Amsterdam East
description:
Room with a king-size bed. Cute kitchen.

The living room and balcony is at the south side and has great light coming in throughout the day. A balcony overlooking a garden that makes you wonder if you are really in the heart of Amsterdam.

This apartment is ideally located to make the most of the best that Amsterdam has to offer. A neighborhood full or restaurants, parks, cinema, coffee bars and the tram, train and bus are all close by.

name: Luxurious apartment near Westerpark + city center
description:
Have nice easy-going time in this cozy, complete apartment. It's nicely stylized and has everything you need to have a relaxed stay! Go out into the city for drinks, dinner or parties and come home to a warm and relaxing environment.

Or just stay at home to watch a movie, Netflix, Amazon Prime and Disney plus are available on the Apple TV.

To make the place feel natural there are a lot of plants. :D

name: Charming & cozy apartment - Close to Jordaan
description: Welcome to our renovated apartment in the Frederik Hendrikbuurt, the base for exploring Amsterdam! The Jordaan is within 10 minutes walking distance: with countless restaurants, bars and sights (such as the Anne Frank house). Enjoy the charming canals and local market (tip: Noordermarkt). Our cozy house is located just outside the hustle and bustle of the city center, but has a supermarket and restaurants around the corner. Perfect for both a city break and for working remotely, with high-speed Wi-Fi.

name: Quiet Bright Apartment - 2-4p.
description: Light and clean apartment. Located very central in a canal-street. Private entry. Good public transport connection and within walking distance of Jordaan and Rijks museum.

We are situated is in the hearth of the trendy neighborhood Watergraafsmeer with multiple (local) shops, restaurants, cafe's within walking distance. We are happy to tell you our favorite spots!

The apartment is a 5 minute walk from Central station, you will have easy access to public transportation. The house is close to a lot of pittoresque shopping streets and restaurants. The Jordaan , Dam Square and the Anne Frank house are within walking distance.
The apartment is cosy and clean and offers everything you need.

This apartment has a lot to offer!

Come and enjoy!

name: Relaxing city experience

Enjoy your stay in the capital at his best with comfortable bath, fireplace, fully equiped kitchen, floating terrace and an amazing view over the water. Lot's of shops, bars restaurants and every wednesday a biological market. Also populair attractions like Artis Zoo, tropical museum and the Dappermarkt closeby.

name: Clean comfy private studio in De Pijp central
description:
Beautiful and characteristic 1-room studio with private bathroom, toilet and kitchenette on the second floor of an old Dutch building (1886) in vibrant neighbourhood 'De Pijp', central Amsterdam.

RAI conference center can easily be reached within 15 minutes.

This studio is for two people only and not suitable for children and infants under 12 years old.

The property has solar panels and listed energy label A.

name: Green Terrace Studio

name: Private canal view guest room with free bikes !

A cozy room in Amsterdam-West! 7 minutes walk from Sloterdijk station and within 15 minutes you are in the center by tram, 5 minutes to Amsterdam Central Station by train. You share the house with two nice women, a dog, and a cat.
We rent out 2 rooms in total, so you may encounter other guests during your stay. The bathroom is shared and there is an extra toilet downstairs.

name: ★★★★★ | BEST LOCATION | UNIQUE EXPERIENCE | ★★★★★

On the second floor, there are two bedrooms with king/queen

name: Amstel Imperial
description:
📍Prime City Location – Walk everywhere!

The Pijp is the 'quartier Latin' of Amsterdam with many nice restaurants and bars. The subway station is in the same street, but most city highlights are within walking distance. Almost next to Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh!

We are plant lovers and created this green oasis in the middle of the bustling city. Welcome!

name: Recently modernized house + sunny private garden

The lovely living kitchen at the front side of the house connects with the living room at the back side of the house with access to the sunny private garden. The master bedroom also has access to the garden. Furthermore, 1 room with a single/double bed and a smaller bedroom with single/double bed. The bathroom is equipped with a shower and bath.

name: Stylish apartm & garden near city centre and RAI
description:
Want to explore Amsterdam like a local?
Enjoy our spacious and stylish ground floor apartment and garden. Located in a lovely neighbourhood (Riverside) with shops and cute coffee places. Walking distance from the hip and bustling the “Pijp” neighbourhood with many great restaurants and bars, the Amstel river ánd RAI convention center. Only a 5min tram ride (stops right outside door) from museum square and so many other fun areas and parks. We’re happy to give you the best local tips!

name: Modern Apartment located in Amsterdam East
description:
Light and cozy appartment. Completely renovated in 2020. Located in lovely Amsterdam East. Oosterpark, Beukenplein and Amstel river are around the corner, with lots of cafes, bars and restaurants in the area. Supermarket 200 meters away.
Multiple tram stops nearby and metro station Wibautstraat (+-3 min) and metro/train station Amstel (+-8 minutes) takes you to Central Station within 7min. Ground floor app so no steep Ams stairs.
Let me know if you want cute cat Maya to stay during your visit.

name: Spacious & Light 2 bedr aptm near RAI and Center
description: Spacious and light aptm very near to the Center of Amsterdam in a cosy environment with lots of restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, shops and entertainment in walking distance. A spacious double floor loft in a quiet street in the old Centre of Amsterdam

name: Own floor-2 rooms up to 4 pers. very picturesque

name: Spacious Houseboat in Amsterdam

A modern and well equipped houseboat. The center of Amsterdam is easy to reach (few minutes). In the neighbourhood you can find many nice restaurants, supermarkets, two large parks and playgrounds for children.

You can book this apartment directly on the next link: https://www.airbnb.nl/rooms/18382396?preview_for_ml

The center of Amsterdam is nearby, with the tram you can reach it in 3 stops, approx. 10 minutes. The highway is nearby and we have one free parking space.

The House of 60 m2 is facing south; inside it is light.

A unique beautifull house with sunny garden situated in the cute old Dutch neighborhood Sloten (south west of Amsterdam), perfect for those who want to visit musea, restaurants and shops in the city but also enjoy the quiet "village" experience.

- UNESCO world heritage canal ring
- The famous museums
- The Anne Frank house etc.

Welcome to our bright and comfortable apartment in one of Amsterdam’s most loved neighborhoods: Oud-West. Just steps away from De Hallen and the Jordaan, this is the perfect base for couples, solo travelers or business guests looking to experience the city like a local.

The apartment combines classic Amsterdam charm with modern comfort, peaceful atmosphere in a lively neighborhood.

name: Penthouse Studio: Kitchen+Bath+Balcony (renovated)

PRIVATE BATHROOM! The house sits quietly along a small canal, while the front faces a green, car-free street. Just around the corner, you’ll find the Jordaan district, full of cosy cafés and great restaurants.

The ground floor features a bright kitchen area. Downstairs you’ll find a cosy TV room. The four bedrooms are spread over three floors.

Vondelpark is nearby, and public transportation to the city center is just a short walk away. You’ll find plenty of local shops, cafés and restaurants right around the corner. name: Amazing City Appartment (double floor)
description:
Our bright and spacious 130 m² two-floor apartment is located in Amsterdam’s upscale Old South, just steps from Vondelpark.

Enjoy a stylish stay with shops, museums and cafés around the corner. The city centre is 10 min away, and the beach just a 20-minute drive!

Our home is designed with families in mind and is especially comfortable for guests traveling with children. The space, layout, and neighborhood make it ideal for a peaceful and family-friendly stay!

name: a big (family) house in Amsterdam
description:
Our house is perfect for a family. There are two double beds and one single bed. The house is very light and has a nice cosy garden. Behind our house there is place to swim.
There are several nice beaches. There is a huge park,a lovely harbour, several restaurants and the city centre is by tram 26 only 15 minutes away.
Also acentral place to discover more beautifull surrounding of the Netherlands: Zaanse schans, waterland, Muiderslot, wadden-islands and more. Free parking at the house!!

name: Attractive space along Amsterdam canal
description: Beautifully restored 17th century space in the heart of Amsterdam,  independent guest space in our residence. The historic building is situated on one of the best well kept secrets of Amsterdam, one of the most picturesque canals of the city, with old sailing ships right in front of the house. It is a 10-minute walk from the Central Station. The space is unique and  renovated and the guest doesn't share anything with other people.

name: Cozy apartment in quiet area with good connection
description: Clean apartment  in a quiet side of Amsterdam but only 25 min away from the city center.

name: Spacious sunny house (100m2) in Amsterdam Oost
description:
Imagine relaxing on a spacious porch in a lovely green area after a full day of taking in the beautiful canals and historic places in Amsterdam’s iconic and exciting city center.

We offer you the best of both worlds, conveniently accessible via public transport (20 minutes to the city center) with the hustle and bustle of Amsterdam's many attractions -- start and finish your day in our lovely Amsterdam Oost neighborhood, full of restaurants, shops, markets, parks, and areas to walk or run.

name: COZY ROOM ★ 17TH CENTURY CANAL HOUSE ★ CITY CENTER
description:
If you want to get everything out of your stay in Amsterdam, you should stay in this cosy and authentic & historical accommodation!

Enjoy your stay!

Make your stay to Amsterdam memorable...

description:
This bright and quiet bedroom offers the peace and rest you’re looking for. On sunny days, enjoy the spacious balcony — perfect for a morning coffee or a relaxing evening.

Located in the vibrant eastern part of the city center, the apartment sits in a calm, non-touristic area with a lovely park nearby. Shops, cafés, and daily amenities are within walking distance, and public transport takes you to the heart of Amsterdam in just 10 minutes — the perfect balance between tranquility and city life.

name: Nice Room Amsterdam, EnsuiteBathroom/Netflix/Bikes
description:
Our Nice room offers a 1.40 x 2.00 bed and a tiny private bathroom (toilet, shower, sink).

* Silence hours 22.00 - 07.00.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Saint Claire 3
description:
Saint Claire is located in one of the smallest streets and in one of the oldest neighborhoods, while still in the middle of the centre (only 5 minutes walk from Dam Square). When you spend some nights here, you will feel the atmosphere of the real Amsterdam.
The Studio itself has been finished very cozy, it is perfect for two people wanting to explore Amsterdam. You will be able to use a kitchenette and your own bathroom. The pictures will speak for themselves!
Hope to welcome you here!

name: Lovely apartment of 76m2.
description: Lovely apartment of 76m2 incl balcony with an amazing view.

name: Cozy and tidy space in beloved Adam West
description:
‘De Baarsjes’ is one of the most desired areas of A'dam. Strolling for a coffee and breakfast at the waterside and with 10mins (bike/tram) you will reach the centre.

Hidden restaurants around the corner and Vondel-, Erasmus-, Wester- and Rembrandtpark all in walking distance. Swimming is possible in Erasmuspark which makes this a convenient place to stay during summertime.

The apartment is perfect for families.

name: Cozy, romantic, captain's corner in Amsterdam
description:
To enjoy Amsterdam while staying on a floating houseboat, will surely be something hard to forget!

The location of the houseboat is quiet, visually spacious thanks to the harbor and river, but it's also very Central.
Amsterdam Central Station is 13 to 15 minutes walking or (4 min by bus). Also the famous "Jordaan" area is right on walking distance.

Smoking is NOT allowed inside the boat.and yes you have your own shower and toilet

name: Staying in luxurious house near the Vondelpark
description:
At a beautiful location near the famous Vondelpark, you will find a luxurious and spacious house, for a fantastic stay in Amsterdam.
Our stylish house with authentic details, consists of 2 floors of 145 square meters in total and a sunny garden of 85 square meters and a terrace. On the ground floor you will find a tv-room with a fire place, a dining room and a new open kitchen. Our first floor has 3 bedrooms and a bathroom with a bath and a shower. We can accomodate max. 4 adults and 1 toddler

name: Modern design house in a green area of Amsterdam
description: If you are looking for a quiet stay, just 23min away from a busy centre of Amsterdam (direct tram connection), then you are at the right address. This modern, stylish house is fully equipped with everything you need and you can enjoy the sunny garden. Just 5min away you have Sloterpark: swimming pools, lake beach, tennis, kayaking, frizby, biking, walking and running routes, sportclubs and amazing restaurants. The airport Schipol is also only 15min away with the cab.

name: Cozy/nearby centrum/fast WIFI
description:
🔸 Great location - in the most cosmopolitan and hip neighborhood of Amsterdam - the PIJP , bordering CENTER.

name: Comfortable family home near centre
description:
Comfortable, spacious single-family home in Amsterdam, for 4 adults and possibly extra children. Two double beds. One double bed is in a children's bedroom. The single bed is a bunk bed in a children's room. The house is located in Amsterdam Noord, with a shopping center and public transportation to the center of Amsterdam nearby. The city center can be reached within 10-15 minutes by metro. The Amsterdam ring road is within 1 km.
We have a preference for families.

name: Apt near Vondelpark in Oud-West
description: Cosy & Stylish Apartment Near Vondelpark – Ideal for City Breaks or Remote Work. Welcome to your home away from home in one of Amsterdam’s trendiest neighborhoods—just steps from the beautiful Vondelpark and right on the tram line into the city center. This bright, stylishly furnished apartment offers the perfect base for a weekend getaway or a few days of remote work. Enjoy local cafés, leafy streets, and easy access to museums, canals, and everything Amsterdam has to offer.

name: Chill & quiet oasis just on the edge of Amsterdam
description:
Nice and quite place just outside of the highway (the ring) of Amsterdam. Perfect place to explore Amsterdam during the day and evening and feel satisfied at home afterwards.

Chill out on a summer evening in the lovely garden, enjoy a BBQ or just a little drink.

3 double bedrooms (2nd & 3rd floor) and a 1 children bedroom with a 1 person bed (normal length), so 4 beds in total for 7 persons.

There is 1 bathroom, with shower and bath. A wash/dry-machine is there as well. There are 2 toilets.

name: Authentic apartment with a view on the canal
description:
An cosy authentic romantic apartment with a view on the canal. Its situated in a quiet street and close to the famous Vondelpark,leidse plein,foodhallen complex and museums such as Rijks,Van Gogh and Stedelijk
Restaurants and bars within 200 mtrs walk to the public transport.
Old-west is one of the most famous divers neighbourhoods in town. You find almost everything! This multi-culti area, with laid back attitude,is home to cool mix ofstores and many hotspots.

name: Sunny family home near historic centre Amsterdam
description:
A comfortable, non smoking family home (140m2/460 Sq ft) w garden in a quiet, green and safe neighbourhood close to the center of Amsterdam. Plusses: bright house, kids' playground in front of the house, huge bathroom with bath tub and big shower.
You are in Amsterdam, but with a very green feel. Max. 10 min. walking from all major transport systems. Our comfortable home has 3 bedrooms and sleeps up to 4 people. Close by: City beach, park(s), shops and restaurants.

name: Private cosy place with 24/7 access. And 2 bikes

name: Historic Amsterdam Flat - Central!
description: Get the true Amsterdam experience in our entire beautiful historic home, nestled between one of the most beautiful canals in the city, the Brouwersgracht and a trendy and independent high street, the Haarlemmerstraat.

The first floor has a large living room including kitchen and a toilet. The second floor includes  two bedrooms, one with a big double bed and the other  with  a single bed (child),   a  big bathroom and a toilet. It includes large windows and is located at the third floor of a protected monument which  does not include elevator.

name: Apartment next to Vondelpark
description:
This recently renovated apartment combines modern comfort with warm, inviting design.

Located in a quiet street, yet within walking distance of cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, Vondelpark, and public transport, it offers the perfect balance between relaxation and city life. Whether you’re visiting Amsterdam for the festive season, working remotely, or spending time with family and friends, you’ll have everything you need for a comfortable stay.

Your stay will be in your own bedroom (two individual rooms for rent) upstairs. Shared bathroom and terrace is on the same floor as your bedroom.

There is no stove/microwave. Loft is on 2nd floor via steep stairs in historic monument on a lively street in the center (which means that all attractions are around)  For 2 guests only (no visitors). Not for nit-pickers. Be quiet and respect the neighbors. Smoking allowed (no lingering smoke smell thanks to cross-ventilation)

name: Lovely bright double bedroom by terrace
description: Stunning bright room with garden view located in the lovely Oud West area of Amsterdam! 15 minutes walk to Vondel park, 5 minutes walk to Rembrandt park,  25 mins to city center (Dam Square, Leidseplein, and museum plein). 30 minutes to Schiphol Airport by public transportation. 5 minutes walk to supermarket. Your stay will be in your own bedroom (two individual rooms for rent) upstairs. Shared bathroom and terrace is on the same floor as your bedroom.

name: Loft apartment in canal district
description: Beautiful open-plan loft in the Jordaan part of Amsterdam's canal district. Overlooks the Noordermarkt square and its early 17th-century church. Situated in a monumental building that housed the Jordaan's police department for over a century.

name: Amsterdam Farm Lodge: Sustainable Stay 6–8
description:
The best of both worlds: a peaceful stay in nature with fast access to Amsterdam city centre. This spacious 75m² apartment for 6–8 guests is located on a unique urban farm. Bike to the ferry and reach the centre in minutes — then return to calm, space and fresh air.

Staying with a larger group? We have 7 apartments.

Please note that we're not located directly in the city center so check our location before booking.

description:
Our apartment is particularly suited for families with 1 or 2 children.

Our large living room merges with the kitchen and is bathing in light, since our corner house has windows in virtually all directions. The second floor has 3 bedrooms (of which 2 children's bedrooms) and a bath room (with bath).

You'll be very close to the city centre : walk to the IJ-river and the ferry brings you to the heart of Amsterdam.

Enjoy Wifi, free car parking, and play the piano

name: nice family home

After a day hustle and bustle in the centre you will enjoy our great family house ( 4 persons) in calm area in the Nord with a beautiful green garden full with flowers in the summer. Sit relax in the lounge corner or enjoy a meal at the outside dinner.

description:
Cozy and bright apartment with a balcony situated in the centre of Amsterdam. It's a 48 m2 one bedroom apartment located right between the quiet Westerpark and the popular Jordaan that is known for its many shops, restaurants and markets.
Quiet and central at the same time, it is a perfect base for sightseeing and exploring Amsterdam’s many attractions by public transport, bike or on foot.

The guest house apartment is very private, safe and convenient.

name: Monumental warehouse apartment on historic canal
description:
On the corner of a quiet backstreet in The Jordaan, where it seems like time has stood still, you find our home: an apartment on the ground floor of a listed monumental warehouse facing original Dutch houseboats and the canal.

Our apartment has a real "homey" atmosphere and is perfect for a family with children. It has high ceilings with original wooden ceiling-beams. There is a little bench on the pavement where you can enjoy your coffee in the morning sun.

name: Appartement Amsterdam

A big seating area, flatscreen with chromecast and computer is also available.  It is possible to have a open fire in the garden[campfire]

Delightful tiny gem for 1-2 or three guests, tucked away in a perfect location in Amsterdam City.

Romantic, charming, comfortable, clean & safe!

For a 3th guests, there is a comfortable sofa bed in the living room.

This unique apartment is in the hearth of the city in Amsterdam. It is near the tram station, bars and restaurants. The area is called the Pijp which is very lively.

There is a nice big (12m2) and sunny roof terrace with a free view over the lovely square which is a very popular place to have a drink or dinner.

The apartment has a lot of light in the living kitchen and there is one sleeping room. You will absolutely sure fall in love with this place.
