description:
ONE GUEST ONLY - please no inquiry for 2 guests.

Old style apartment in beautiful old west canal district is 6 minutes by bike, tram and bus to the Center District. Bus and tram stop a 2 minute walk.

Usually no wait for toilet and shower rooms.

Amsterdam West is TIME OUT magazine's 2023 top ten ''coolest'' districts on the planet.

Cafés, restaurants, bars, shops, boutiques and supermarkets are minutes walking from this quiet street. Diverse architecture and theaters.

name: Loft Leidsegracht - Private studio
description: The lively Leidse square area has plenty of bars, restaurans and nightlife suitable for all ages and budgets. Close to the Loft is the famous Vondelpark and cultural attractions like the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, and the Stedelijk Museum.

name: Houseboat with modern interior in the city center
description:
For an authentic Amsterdam experience, why not stay on a traditional Dutch houseboat?

Conveniently located in the heart of the city near the canals, the Utrechtsestraat, and the iconic Rembrandtplein, the houseboat is directly opposite the Stopera (opera house) and within walking distance of the city's most beautiful landmarks and museums.

Enjoy panoramic views of Amsterdam and the Amstel River from both the wheelhouse and the terrace on the deck!

name: Light Apartment in Amsterdam Oost, Modern & Light
Beautiful family house (100m2) with garden.

description: Welcome to this little treasure in the heart of Amsterdam! The studio (20m2) is located on the ground floor of a historic canal house, (dated 1680) on the Herengracht. Many interesting places are within walking distance: Anne Frank House, Dam Square and Madame Tussaud's. The high end shopping district of the Nine Streets, Jordaan and many great restaurants, bars and cafes are nearby. The Van Gogh Museum, the Rijksmuseum and the Concertgebouw are also within easy reach.

name: ★★DAM CENTRAL★★
description:
In the heart of Amsterdam. Leidseplein, Vondelpark and Museumplein are all within 10-15 min walking distances.

"A wonderful host, helpful, accommodating, welcoming and super hospitable. He accepted my last min request. I am a solo traveller and felt very comfortable. The room is very clean, bright, super comfortable and great views of typical historic buildings. Overall a great authentic local experience!" - Guest

name: Unique Peaceful Houseboat next to the city centre
description: Our houseboat is an authentic houseboat, located very close to the city centre of Amsterdam. From our home you will have an amazing view over the water, you will be very close to the canals and the hotspots of the Jordaan but at the same time very relaxed and quiet.

name: Private Stairway to heaven
description:
Privat trendy loft studio at the attick of an authentic old Amsterdam house from 1880
Located in "hip" neighborhood near de Foodhallen en daily outdoor market.
Authentic old dutch house with steep narrow stairs.
Not suitable for elderly, disabled or very large suitcases, for you have 3 times 15 steps to climb.

name: Modern and sunny corner Apartment close to centre
description:
Looking for a last minute Summer getaway?
Our warm corner apartment has just been renovated with a brand new kitchen and receives lots of sunlight giving a spacious feeling. The living -, bed- and bathroom are also much up to standard.

The apartment is located in an amazing area with plenty of restaurants, bars and coffee places.
The popular Jordaan area is only a 10 minute walk away, making it the perfect base to explore the city on foot

Access: Central Station is only a 12 minute busride.

name: Cozy Room in Charming Dutch Home, City Centre
description:
Looking for a real Amsterdam experience in an original Dutch build charming home? Our cozy rooms bring you to the busy heart of Amsterdam, with all of the famous canals right around the corner! Most of the sight-seeing is within a 5-10 minute walk.
The room is perfect for couples to explore the city and easily accessible from Central Station.
Good for a short-stay.

name: Relaxed Amsterdam - Family Home 5 bedrooms&parking
description: After a busy day visiting Amsterdam and its surroundings you can relax in this large family house. Look onto the water on the front side and see nice architecture from the garden. Take a dive from the neighborhood jetty or take a capuchinno in the restaurant around the corner. You can also just sit back and enjoy Netflix or good music or prepare a meal in our kitchen.

name: Designed Penthouse, Amsterdam city center
description:
Modern-designed penthouse apartment with rooftop terrace in quiet neighbourhood De Baarsjes on westside of Amsterdam.
30 mins to Amsterdam Schiphol airport. 2 Mins walk to bus/tram stops. Direct transport within 15 mins to city center and all famous tourist resorts, Amsterdam Center, Amsterdam Sloterdijk etc. train stations.

name: Charming and quiet room in City Center!
description:
This renovated and licensed B&B is set on Amsterdam's oldest canal in the beautiful center of Amsterdam. The bedrooms are quiet and full of charm.

Dam square, the Royal Palace and the bustling red light district all within a minute's walk. Perfectly positioned to explore all the wonders Amsterdam has to offer.
The spacious room is located at the quiet back of the building, situated around a court yard. The bathroom is shared in the BnB.
The rooms have an iron + hairdryer.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Canalhouse in the Center
description:
This beautiful canal house is a charming place conveniently located in the heart of Amsterdam’s Canal District near 'Het IJ'. The estuary where during the Golden Age, merchandise and spices were supplied and stored from all corners of the world.

The canal house is situated within walking distance of the main museums, popular shopping areas, and historic landmarks.

The house is just renovated and geüpgraded in January 2024.

name: House on the water. Oasis in the bustling town.
description:
Spacious and sunny family home with garden on the water in a quiet neighborhood at 6 minutes walking distance from Amsterdam Muiderpoort station (from there in 6 minutes by train to Amsterdam Central). Close to all kinds of amenities such as restaurants and shops.
Most suitable for families with child(ren) up to 18 years old. Legal maximum number of 4 people (according to municipal regulation)

name: Amsterdam Farm Lodge: lastminute availability July
description:
Escape the crowds and stay in a spacious 75m² apartment on a unique urban farm in Amsterdam. Enjoy peace, greenery and fresh air, while the city centre is just a short bike ride away. Perfect for families and groups of 6–8 looking for a relaxed, comfortable stay with a special atmosphere.

If you travel with a larger group, we have 7 apartments available.

We are not located in the center of Amsterdam, check the location before booking.

name: Top location, private bathroom & roof terrace
description: Enjoy a spacious guestroom and the privacy of your own bathroom on the 4th floor of a lately renovated merchant's house from 1896. 5 min walking from the Canal belt, Jordan, and De Hallen, and 15 min walking to the Vondelpark and main museums. Quiet street, yet plenty of restaurants close by. Private roof terrace!

name: Excellent Location
description:
Spacious Private Room ( 25mm) with lockable door in a great location. Within walking distance to Museum square, Leidseplein, and the ring of canals. Private bathroom and toilet, space to warm food in microwave, coffee and tea, and refrigerator. Wireless internet. No TV. Entrance through my living space.
Room is located on the second floor. Amsterdam staircase. No elevator. Room is suitable for two adults.

name: Cosy single room with a view
description:
How comfortable a room can be, and how warm a welcome?
One feels at home here right away. Any questions? I'll try to help.

name: Amsterdam Farm Lodge: Group Stay 6–8
description:
Traveling with friends? Stay together in this large 75m² apartment for up to 8 guests. Enjoy a unique farm setting, relaxed vibes and plenty of space to hang out. Close to Amsterdam’s hotspots, but far from the noise — the perfect balance for a memorable group trip.

name: Houseboat near Jordaan: unique canal view & garden
description:
Houseboat with a beautiful view and private garden, in a quiet neighbourhood and only 5 minutes from the Jordaan! We have a direct public transport connection to Central Station and the Westerpark is around the corner.

Please note: we do not allow pets, drugs, smoking (also not in the garden) or parties. Our boat is perfect for people who come to Amsterdam to enjoy the city but not for those who come to party.

name: BnJoy 4Pers/ Clean, Cozy & Central/ Stunning View!
description:
Two comfy and clean private bedrooms in a authentic canal house with amazing views. In the common hallway, there is a bathroom and a separate toilet to share. A kitchenette offers the possibility to make some coffee or tea, a small breakfast, or a nighttime snack.

Only 5 minutes walking distance from the central station with public transport in all directions. Attractions like China town, Red Light District, Dam Square, and the famous 9 Streets are within walking distance.

Also Bikes 4 Rent!

name: 2Bedroom Riverview appartment + Balcony
description: Welcome to our stunning 2-bedroom mid-century apartment located in the heart of Amsterdam! With its breathtaking river view, spacious balcony, and recent renovation in 2022, this gem promises an unforgettable stay in this vibrant city.

name: Private Room in Penthouse Tower w/ Panoramic view
description:
This is a shared apartment

name: Canal house apartment in famous Jordaan district
description:
After living in various cities worldwide, we would love to share our beautiful canal house apartment in the heart of the famous Jordaan district.

Inside, you’ll find warm, stylish modern decor with wooden floors, wooden ceiling beams, and contemporary furnishings throughout.

name: Wonderful Amsterdam 2 or 3 p private place!

There is a closet for clothes

name: Amsterdam Farm Lodge: Apartment 6-8 persons

We are not located in the center of Amsterdam, check the location before booking.

name: Light and cozy appartment near Vondelpark
description:
Welcome to our bright, inviting, and cozy apartment!

This apartment is the perfect base for couples to explore everything Amsterdam has to offer, with easy access to the city center, parks, restaurants, and shopping areas.

name: Charming and quiet rooms in City Center!
description:
This licensed B&B is set on Amsterdam's oldest canal in the beautiful city center of Amsterdam.
With Dam square, the Royal Palace and the bustling red light district all within a minute's walk - you will be very well positioned to explore all the wonders Amsterdam has to offer.

Beautifully located newly renovated bedroom. Only 8 walking minutes away from shops and metro station Reigersbos, from where it is a 19 min. trip to Amsterdam Center.

description:
2 bedroom apartment in Amsterdam Oost next to Oosterpark.

10 minutes to De Pijp

15 minutes to Museumplein

Lovely cafés and bars in the immediate area

name: Amsterdam city centre, modern and cosy apartment
description:
Live as a local in the heart of Amsterdam city centre. The apartment is located in the Jordaan district around the corner of the famous 'Nine Streets'. On walking distance from the best places to go like the Anne Frank house, The Dam, Leidseplein, Noordermarkt, Museum quarter and all the great restaurants and nightlife Amsterdam has to offer.

Located super central, only 8 minutes from Central Station with public transport so a great location if you would like to explore more of the Netherlands.

name: Stylish apartment w rooftop terrace in A'dam-Zuid
description: Cosy and stylish brand new flat in one of the nicest parts of Amsterdam (Amsterdam Oud Zuid) – next to Museumplein (with Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum) and Vondelpark. Three bedrooms and spectacular 80m2 rooftop terrace, overlooking all of Amsterdam. Perfect for families (is our private flat that we rent out sometimes) and to discover and enjoy Amsterdam.

name: Luxurious, cosy and private studio Fountain view
description:
Close to center in nice neighborhood a luxurious, comfortable and spacious private studio. Nice view over a square with fountain.

name: Perfect place to stay in beautiful Amsterdam.
description:
Perfect place to stay in beautiful Amsterdam.

Located in a peaceful neighborhood in the City Center.

name: Near RAI convention center! Light and spacious
Beautiful ground floor apartment in Amsterdam!
description: We’re happy to invite you in our (family)home, while we´re exploring the world. You can enjoy a full kitchen, living/dining room a big nice bed and brand new shower. A baby cot is available if you want to book with your child (<3 years). We have a small garden to relax and enjoy the fresh air and sun.

name: Amsterdam Farm Lodge: Spacious Apt 75m²
description:
Spacious, quiet and unique – your ideal stay in Amsterdam.
Large 3-bedroom apartments for families and groups up to 6–8 guests, set on a green urban farm. Enjoy free parking nearby, plenty of space and a peaceful setting, while reaching the city centre quickly by bike and ferry.

name: Stylish guest suite @ the Amsterdam centre canals
description:
This is just the perfect place and location to explore Amsterdam.

The accommodation is fully private, with your own entrance and bathroom, and is located in a quiet, residential building, situated right at the famous canal belt in the hearth of Amsterdam.

In the direct surrounding there is ample choice of hundreds of nice local shops, restaurants, bars and sighseeing activities.

Make your stay memorable and experience the real Amsterdam vibes.

name: Amsterdam Central in 10 min - nearby metro
description:
"NOTE: If this listing is unavailable, feel free to check out my other listing"

name: Family Home | Garden · Rooftop · Parking
description:
Family home of 170m² in Amsterdam-Oost. Playground at the door, child-friendly neighbourhood, pedestrianised shopping centre 200m away.

Master bedroom, guest room with sofa bed and children's room. 1 bathroom. Garden 60m², rooftop terrace 15m² and private parking on property.

Oosterpark, Flevopark and Frankendael all within 5 min by bike. Tram, metro and train nearby, city centre 10 min.

New build, fully decorated and ready for your family holiday. Staying 2+ weeks? Ask for a discount.

name: Cosy double floor apartment in heart of Amsterdam
description:
I just moved to this new apartment of two floors with large living spaces.

Fully equipped with sonos, piano and lots of art and plants. Sleeping peacefully next to a courtyard while being super close to the city centre and its effervescent qualities. I’d like to rent out my apartment to people who respect, appreciate and are trustworthy. If you want you can also borrow my bike! Hope to meet you soon!

name: Modern family house in Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our 3 floor new build house with garden in calm area in North part of Amsterdam. At the ground floor you find an open kitchen with a bright living room and access to the garden.  Then at the first floor we have the master bedroom with 1 double bed (160-200), the second bedroom with two single beds (80x200) and one batroom.  At the second floor we have the second livingroom where you can relax at the roofterras and can make use of the other bathroom.

description:
FREE FERRY // FREE WIFI

name: Big & Bright Modern Apartment with Roof Terrace
description: Our home is a big and bright, recently remodelled apartment in Amsterdam west, spread over three floors with a private roof terrace. It's filled with beautiful modern furniture, new beds & mattresses, multiple bathrooms & showers, bathtub, and all the amenities. At this time our home is only available to couples or families with children.

name: Bright, central and newly renovated apartment
description:
Nice and bright apartment located in the centre of Amsterdam within walking distance to most tourist sites and central canal belt.

Apartment is newly renovated and fully fitted with appliances, bedding, kitchenware, walk-in shower and seperate toilet.

Location is very well suited to transportation links with metro 150m from the apartment and tram stops outside the apartment.

No parties, pets or smoking within the apartment. Smoking is allowed on either of the 2 balconies.

name: Clean comfy private studio in De Pijp central
description:
Charming, characteristic B&B studio with private bathroom, toilet, and kitchenette on the second floor at the back of an 1886 Dutch building in vibrant 'De Pijp,' central Amsterdam.
Two typical steep 19th-century staircases, lead to the studio, adding historic charm.

RAI conference center can easily be reached within 15 minutes.

This studio is for two people only and not suitable for children and infants under 12 years old.

The property has solar panels and is listed energy label A.

name: 18th Century Groundfloor Canal House with patio
description: With its picturesque canal view, rich history and modern design, this 2 floor house is a unique city destination. Each area of Amsterdam has its own character and charm. This listed monument dating back to the 18th century, and completely renovated, is truly a quiet retreat and a hidden treasure. Situated directly in the heart of the city, the oldest and most beautiful part of town, this canal house is part of Amsterdam’s iconic Canal Ring and listed as a UNESCO’s World Heritage Site.

name: House of the Cat king
description:
This house is located in one of Amsterdams most central & classical neighbourhoods: Het Waalseiland

Waking up in this neighbourhood you'll be surrounded by Crooked houses, tall trees with singing birds, broad canals and houseboats together with a beautiful sight of the "Montelbaans toren"
This romantic getaway will be a beautiful addition to your Amsterdam experience

Located in the middle of Amsterdam, everything you desire will be
walking distance and 5 minutes from Central station.

name: JorDam Bed & Coffee Loft , city center Jordaan.
description:
The Lindenstraat is a continuation of the Noordermarkt, a quiet charming street in the heart of the Jordaan neighbourhood. The Jordaan is famous for its specialty restaurants, bars, galeries and Saturday and Monday markets.From here you are a short walking distance to most of the city's places of interest. "nine little streets" boutique shopping and Anne Frank House are literally around the corner.
The loft is a modern and bright room on the 3th floor with private bathroom with rain shower.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Lovely family house in trendy Amsterdam North
description:
Cozy family home in a quiet and safe neighborhood in Amsterdam North, just minutes from the city centre. You’ll have the whole house to yourself: a comfy living room, fully equipped kitchen, 1 master bedroom, 2 kids’ rooms (single bed & small double), a modern bathroom, and a garden with BBQ. Great restaurants and local hotspots nearby. Perfect for families!

Whether you’re here for a city break or a peaceful getaway, you’ll feel right at home. We’d love to welcome you!

name: Bright and cozy apartment in Oud- West
description: Welcome to my lovely apartment. It is bright and spacious and equipped with all conveniences. The apartment is located across from the Hallen, where you have not only fun shops but also a food court and a cinema. The Vondelpark, the Jordaan, and Leidseplein are also within walking distance (about ten minutes). There’s a tram just around the corner! As well as the Ten Katemarkt with delicious eateries and fresh food. This location truly has everything you need for a wonderful stay.

OUR 3 FLOOR TOWNHOUSE comprises a sauna, garden, 4 bedrooms, 2 toilets, bath & separate shower, laundry room. The large living room, with a modern-rustic feel to it, has an open kitchen and sun room which opens to the garden.

BEDROOMS:

Bedroom 3: large couch that turns into a comfortable double bed.

description: If you want a clean, nice, cosy place,  close from the city center, you found the good one. The best way to live as a local. The apartment is clean, well decorated, with 2 sleepingrooms, a balcony, kitchen and livingroom... Lots of several, cheap, tasty restaurants around 5 minutes walking distance from our apartment.

description:
Enjoy your own Tiny House, completely renovated in November 2025!

name: Amsterdam Farm Lodge: Unique Farm Stay
description:
Not your typical Amsterdam stay. Wake up surrounded by nature, animals and open space — all within the city. This spacious 75m² apartment for 6–8 guests offers a magical, peaceful atmosphere you won’t find elsewhere. A hidden gem for those who want something special.

Travelling with more persons? We have 7 apartments to offer.

description:
Elegant, stylish, non-smoking, apartment in a calm spot in the centre of Amsterdam.
Perfectly located for culture & shopping.

The apartment has been fully renovated in 2017 & decorated with fine art and design. Has 2 bedrooms, double beds, so place for 4.

A living with fire place. A fully equipped, modern open kitchen.
Bathroom with 2 showers & wc.
Two bedrooms, double beds.

description:
Spacious and super clean apartment close to the Vondelpark. With beautiful canal view and bedroom access to the cosy roof terrace.

A well-equipped kitchen, quiet bedroom, and a living room with open doors to the canal view balcony.

Situated in a calm street but great hip neighborhood with loads of hotspots: boutique shops, nice bars and restaurants. And the Vondelpark is around the corner!

This furnished sunny 2 room apartment is overlooking the Amstel. The apartment is inside a 2 level watervilla. it has a private entrance. 12 min walking from the Amstel (train) station and 5 minutes from the metro. This houseboat is surrounded by the Amstel , and is nearby the centre of the City Amsterdam. Nearby there are a few good restaurants.
There is a little fridge, coffee machine and watercooker.

Museumsquare, nine streets and the Vondelpark are (among other go-to's in Amsterdam) within 5 minutes walking distance. We live in a lively area, but if you seek a more peaceful and quiet area after a day of strolling Amsterdam, you can relax in our large backyard garden. Our home really has best of both ways with livelyhood on the front and peace and quiet at the backside!

name: Appartement in Amsterdam Zuid

name: Modern Suite with private bathroom near Vondelpark
description:
The modern Souterrain Suite is perfect for couples who want to explore Amsterdam and experience local life.
You are right next to the beautiful Vondelpark where you will enjoy a relaxing walk or bike ride to the Museumplein or Leidseplein. With the tram stopping in front of the door, you can easily access train station (15 min) or airport (20min). Many local restaurants, bars and supermarkets within walking distance.

Please note, Amsterdam municipality allows maximum two guests in the suite.

name: Nathalie and Dave's Studio
description: The studio is in a quiet residential area in the East of Amsterdam.  Off the beaten tourist track it offers a great variety of bars, cafes and restaurants.  With a subway line nearby it offers a 5 minute direct link with downtown Amsterdam.

name: Charming Loft Canal View in the Heart of Amsterdam
description:
Step into this cozy and character-filled loft, tucked away on the top floor of a traditional Amsterdam building. With its high slanted ceilings and large windows overlooking the canal, this bright and stylish space offers a perfect blend of comfort and charm.

The loft is thoughtfully designed with a mix of industrial elements and bohemian touches, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Natural materials, soft lighting, and carefully curated decor make it feel both homey and inspiring.

name: City Centre Amsterdam Cozy Big Bright Apartment

name: Big family house- 20 min to centre- Free Parking

Our bright modern home is best suited for a quiet and comfortable stay for up to max 4 guests, for example 2 adults and 2 children or teenagers, plus a baby.

It is located near NDSM Wharf, with easy access by ferry to the city centre. This area offers restaurants, creative places and a lively local atmosphere. Amsterdam North is vibrant, relaxed and full of character.

The neighbourhood is very child friendly and peaceful. Our two cat usually stay outside and occasionally come by for food.

name: A nice family home with garden

The house is situated in the upcoming and multicultural neighborhood Amsterdam Nieuw-west! It is cozy, light, has 4 rooms and a bathtub. We are so happy with it and we think you will be too.

name: B&B Urban Oasis
description: This in 2023 build, luxury design appartment, is located on the ground floor of our mansion in a beautiful, quit street in Amsterdam IJburg. The whole appartment is separate from the house, so our guests will have full privacy. The accommodation has a private entrance with a free private parking under the carport and access to a cozy, green private outdoor terrace (also just acces for the guests). A comfortable kingsize bed and bathroom with separate toilet. Free WiFi, mini-bar, coffee and tea.

name: Beautiful 3 floor family house with garden (4bdr)
description:
Spacious & light house in Watergraafsmeer: the perfect combination of livelihood and residential living. Bars, restaurants, shopping and the Frankendael park around the corner. Easy access to public transport and highway. 15 min from the city centre. Large living room, 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (with bad) and a sunny garden. The house is ideal for a family with (young) kids. Lots of toys are available and we have a garden trampoline.
We also welcome (expat) couples. No pets. No (weed) smoking.

name: Beautiful separate topfloor room in floating house
description: Beautiful top floor room designed under architecture in a very modern houseboat with a large 35m2 terrace and a beautiful view over the water. The room is very light and suitable for two people. It has a double bed, sofa, private shower (cabine in the room), private toilet, airconditioning and a fridge. Enjoy the special area, living on the water and there is an easy and quick access by public transport to the inner city centre (5min walk to tram /13 min tram to central station).

name: Staying on a characteristic classic yacht
description: The accommodation  is a small appartement with all the amenities that you need. You have your own private terras on the front deck, with view of the water.

name: Unique Family Villa Amsterdam
description:
You are welcome to stay in our safe, clean and comfortable family villa on the outskirts of Amsterdam. This house is a perfect place to relax from all the recreation activities the area has to offer. It’s located on the edge of a residential area with a panoramic view on the Amsterdam-Rijn canal

Feel free to grab any of our bikes to explore the surrounding recreational areas (Diemerbos, Gein, Gaasperplas), the historical town of Weesp or of course Amsterdam. Free parking on premises.

name: Modern and spacious duplex apartment w/ large deck
description:
Welcome to our 3-bedroom modern and spacious apartment, perfect for families with children. Located in the charming Plantage quarter, this two-story home offers a 116m / 1250 sq ft. of living space. The master bedroom features a comfortable king size bed, and the entire house is bathed in natural light.

Our home beautifully blends the charm of an old house with modern design furniture.

Relax on our roof terrace in the evening and wake up to the delightful sound of birds in the morning.
﻿

name: City Centre Canal Studio
description:
In the heart of the city centre cosy private room on the lowest floor of an original 1800 canal house with everything for a comfortable stay in the heart of Amsterdam. You have your own private entrance and a spacious and stylish room with ensuite bathroom to yourself.
This bnb is in the heart of the city centre in Amsterdam. Its on the famous amstel river and very central with walking distance of everything interesting!
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Modern Apartment | Parking | fast public transport
description:
Cozy, modern, clean and bright apartment (70m), located on the 3rd floor (accessible by elevator or by stairs) for 2 people. Perfect for a wonderful stay just outside the bustling heart of Amsterdam.
The apartment has an open kitchen, living room with large TV, bathroom with bath / shower, a spacious bedroom with king size bed, balcony and private parking on the enclosed courtyard.
Public transport direction center, department stores and the beautiful Rembrandtparc are within walking distance.

name: Beautiful apartment in City Centre (Jordaan)
description: Lovely apartment with canal view in the heart of Amsterdam. Bright, spacious and stylish apartment on the 3rd and 4th floor located in the quietest area of the Jordaan, the most typical neighborhood in the Netherlands. The house is surrounded by the city's gems of the Canal Ring, Museum District, Vondelpark, 9 Streets, Leidse square, Anna Frank's house and more.

name: Spacious apartment with garden close to Vondelpark
description: A stylish, calm Amsterdam home with a private garden, perfect for a couple or a small family with young children. This 95m² ground floor home is located in Amsterdam West in De Baarsjes, a popular local neighborhood close to the Jordaan, city centre and Museum Quarter. Restaurants, cafés, boutiques, Vondelpark and Rembrandtpark are nearby. Public transport is a two minute walk. A quiet, comfortable base to explore Amsterdam.

name: Piet Mondriaan apartment Canal view
description: The modernly furnished, one bedroom, Piet Mondriaan apartment has a street view. The Piet Mondriaan apartment is located at the beautiful canal Keizersgracht, in the city centre of Amsterdam. It is near the main attractions, like the Rijksmuseum and many more. From here you can easily get to the RAI congress centre.

name: Jeroen Bosch apartment garden view + access
description: The cozy Jeroen Bosch apartment is located at the Keizersgracht in the city centre of Amsterdam. From this apartment there is access to the beautiful garden. The apartment is near the main museums like the Van Gogh museum. There is also a very good connection to the Rai Convention Centre.

name: Frans Hals apartment garden view
description: The modernly furnished, one bedroom, Frans Hals apartment has a garden view. The Frans Hals apartment is located at the beautiful canal Keizersgracht, in the city centre of Amsterdam. description: The modernly furnished, one bedroom, Vincent van Gogh apartment has a garden view plus access and use of the garden.
