name: Family house close to centre with lovely garden
description: Very spacious (approx. 120m2), peaceful, beautiful house on the ground floor with a large garden at the back, close to the city centre, Oosterpark and the Albert Cuyp market.

name: Luminous Amsterdam apartment
description: A lovely cosy apartment in the centre of Amsterdam in a quiet car-free street. The apartment is great for couples to explore the city from a quiet neighbourhood close to the centre. The kitchen is fully equipped, bathroom has a washing machine, and  rain shower. The apartment is located within walking distance of city centre, Westerpark and Haarlemmerdijk shopping street. Busses and tram are around the corner take take you directly to the Museum District. Supermarket is a short walk.

name: 3 slaapkamer familie apt. - Charmant, licht & ruim
description: This beautiful, colourful and spacy apartment is situated in a highly sought-after neighborhood (Da Costabuurt) with numerous dining options, including De Hallen, and a variety of popular cafes, restaurants, and diverse shopping opportunities. This section of the Da Costagracht offers a lively yet tranquil passage. Easily accessible by public transport (various tram and bus stops), with the Marnixstraat/Elandsgracht bus station just around the corner. The Jordaan is also within walking distance

name: Karel Appel apartment with canal view + terrace
description:
This design penthouse, with a view over the Keizersgracht and the inner garden and is named after the modern Dutch painter Karel Appel.
What makes this apartment so special is that it has a private roof terrace overlooking the beautiful courtyard. Furthermore, the apartment is fully equipped with a wooden floor, it has original wooden beams and a sloping roof.

name: Spacious apartment with garden near Museum quarter
description:
Nice and bright apartment located in a trendy neighbourhood in the South of Amsterdam. It has a spacious large sunny garden and there is a double bed in the bedroom.
There is a bathroom with a bath (incl. television) and a separate shower.

The perfect base to explore the nicest area of the city; check out all the coffee bars, taverns and nicest shops. If the weather is good, you'll enjoy the private and spacious garden. It's a great apartment where you can relax after a long day of sightseeing.

name: Hotel schip Johanna Engelina
description:
You will never forget your stay in this unique accommodation. Stay on this traditional Dutch clipper from 1897. In the past, the Johanna Engelina transported cargo using her sails. Nowadays, a comfortable guest house has been created in the old cargo space with all modern comforts.

The ship is located on the NDSM site, a stone's throw from the free ferries to Amsterdam Central Station.
If you want to come with more than 16 people, please contact us.

name: Family house with garden in Amsterdam North
description:
Characteristic and cosy family home on the North side of Amsterdam. The house has a living room and kitchen on the ground floor connected to the private garden. On the 1st floor, there are 2 bedrooms and a bathroom. The third bedroom is in the attic. There are two double beds, and a single matras on the floor.

You can park your car all around the neighborhood for a small fee. It is a 20 min ride by public transport to the city centre.

The house is perfectly suitable for couples and families.

name: private room tuin
description:
You'll have a very comfortable stay in a chill and safe neighborhood. There is a supermarket close by, along with many restaurants, bars, coffeeshops.
Bus and tram are easily reachable as they are here in the street.

Leidseplein, Central Station and Anne Frank House are in walking distance, as well as the hippest district of Amsterdam, Jordaan. You'll have a quiet and relaxing stay at home; fun and entertainment when you're out.

name: Spacious 4p canal apartment in perfect location
description: This great canal apartment on the quiet Bloemgracht (Flower Canal) is located right in the most beautiful neighborhood of Amsterdam called the Jordaan, where most city hotspots can be found within walking distance! The apartment is specially fitted for 4 people, ideal for 2 couples or a family with 2 children. There are two bedrooms, both with their own private bathroom, a fully equipped living room and a nice and cosy kitchenette for preparing coffee (Nespresso machine) and tea.

name: Beautiful renovated apartment
description:
A beautiful, classic, bright apartment in Amsterdam’ Oud West district next to the Vondelpark.
It’s a classic hook appartement build in 1893 at the first floor and has been fully renovated in 2022.

The apartment is located next to the Vondelpark and close to the city centre (15min walk). Public transport stops in front of the door.

The apartment is fully equipped with the luxurious necessaries, such as a bath, dishwasher, dryer and a washing machine. TVs with all streaming subscriptions.

name: Creative apartment along the canals
description:
Situated in a calm residential area in the center of Amsterdam around the corner of the Museum plein this apartment is located along the beautiful canals to which Amsterdam owes its fame, among other things

The apartment will feel like a home. You will find many personal details, objects and paintings that I collected over the years. I’m an interior designer and lighting specialist my house is a never ending project that I love to tweak and twist.

name: Captains Logde / privé studio houseboat
description:
Be welcome in the modern bed and breakfast aboard houseboat Sequana. With a mooring on the shore of the IJmeer.

We look forward to seeing you at the captain's cabin of this beautiful houseboat. The spacious private studio (30 m2) has a lovely 2-person sofa bed in the living room, a private bathroom and toilet and a full kitchen. You can use a kettle and coffee machine and a fridge. There is free coffee, tea, sugar and spices. You will feel right at home here!

name: Stunning houseboat in center of Amsterdam
description:
Very nice hidden location on the amstel river close to the famous Carre theater, with international musicals and shows and the even more famous neighbour Amstel Hotel, where international pop stars stay when they do concerts in holland.
Next door is the amazing Lempica bar for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, or just coctails, if you don't want to cook yourself. Close by the Albert Cuyp market, for fresh fruits and vegatables, and 10 minutes walk from the flee market, and the opera house!

name: Casa Karen – Houseboat studio with private terrace
description:
This is a private and comfortable studio on a houseboat which is very nicely decorated. Through the big sliding window door you can enter your own private deck which will give you a nice view over the water. You can enjoy 2 bikes for free at the property to explore the neighbourhood and ofcourse the city! The houseboat is located in a peaceful neighbourhood and suitable for people who are looking for a quiet base to discover Amsterdam.

It's important to note that music or any parties/events are not allowed at this accommodation, since this houseboat is located in a quiet and peaceful houseboat neighbourhood.

name: Beautiful Houseboat Amsterdam
description: Welcome! I'd like to invite you to come stay at my recently renovated houseboat. Surrounded by nature and only 20 min. from the city center!

name: Studio Bosboom
description: Studio Bosboom is a spacious and sunny apartment situated on the front side of the house. The room with a private entrance  is equipped with a kitchenette and includes all necessary amenities such as an oven,a microwave, a Nespresso machine, a water boiler anda  fridge.. The apartment, has is a private bathroom with a shower.

name: Budgetroom met ontbijt inbegrepen
description:
This room is 8 km from the tourist center, but is located next to the shopping center of A'Dam Southeast with two concert halls (Ziggo and AFAs). The tourist center is easily accessible by bus and Metro.
From Schiphol, but also by train and car, the B&B is easily accessible.

Parking in front of the door or in the street. Paid during the day. Free after 9 p.m. Shared shower. Shared use of the kitchen. Swimming pool "around the corner", close to Theatre, park, and multicultural shopping hall.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: COMPLETE NEW FAMILY HOUSE 10MIN FROM CITY CENTER
description: Spacious family house in 3 floors with garden and terrace, open space kitchen and two bedrooms. Build in 2017 and has all new appliances, wooden floor, modern kitchen and bathroom with bathtub and shower cabin, extra toilet on the ground floor. The house is located in a new modern neighbourhood Zeeburgereiland, only 4 tram stops from Amsterdam main train station Amsterdam Centraal and 15 min by public transport from the city center. 20 min by taxi to Amsterdam airport. Easy access to/from highway, paid public parking available in front of the house (free of charge from 19.00 till 09.00 and om Sunday's).

name: Stylish 1BR Apartment in Popular Amsterdam West
description: Stylish 1BR apartment in Amsterdam West – ideal mix of quiet local neighborhood vibes & vibrant city life. Located in trendy De Baarsjes, steps from Foodhallen, cozy cafés, hip hotspots & beautiful parks (Vondelpark nearby!). Perfect for couples, remote workers & city explorers seeking an authentic Amsterdam stay. You’ll truly feel at home here!

name: Houseboat close to the city centre of Amsterdam.
description:
The area and facilities

The yacht is 12.5 meters or 41 feet long (42m2 or 452 square feet), so the ship offers plenty of room. It feels like an apartment on the water. It’s an extraordinary experience which will undoubtedly stay with you.

-Free internet on board
-Fridge with small freezer
-Coffeemaker
-Water cooker
-Microwave-oven
-Cooking facilities
-Heating
-Free parking

name: Calm and cozy apartment - central Amsterdam
description:
My place is bright and clean, a complete apartment with 1 bedroom and private bathroom. Easy access from airport and public transport. Loads of restaurants, bars, park and shops just a few steps away. Westerpark is right at your doorstep.

This home is a great place because of the coziness, light and chillnes of the house and location. Central but also good to recharge after a day exploring. Experience Amsterdam as a local.

name: Spacious loft suited for a family on the canals
description: This spacious design loft is home to a family with small children under the age of 10. It is situated on the  ground floor of a canal house on one of the rare quiet canals in the city centre. It used to be part of an old diamond factory in the diamond area of the city centre and dates back to the 1900’s. The loft is very closely situated near the metro and tram (metro is 4 stops from central station), grocery shop is 5 min walk away

name: Bright design apt with garden in a trendy area
description: Bright mid-century design apartment in a vibrant, green neighbourhood in Amsterdam east. It is a trendy but peaceful area with plenty of nice bars, restaurants, markets and shops around the corner. The house is located next to one of Amsterdam's canals. The city center is just 15-20 minutes by bike or public transport or 30 minutes by foot. The place has everything you need for a great stay. A big, comfy bed, good coffee and a nice garden!

name: Unique apartment in coolest area of Amsterdam!
description:
Welcome to your perfect Amsterdam getaway!

Just east of the city center you'll find my apartment. The apartment is spacious, comfortable and located in the hottest area of the city. Just a minute walk from the famous Javastraat and 5 minutes away from Amsterdam Muiderpoort train station and multiple tram stops leading you right to the center in just a few minutes!

Rental license number/vergunningnummer: Z/24/2321606

name: Sunny & Cozy Apartment with Sweet Cat Near Centre
description: Bright, cozy apartment for two near Westerpark & the Jordaan! ☀️ Enjoy morning coffee or evening drinks on one of two sunny balconies. Our sweet cat Miesje will keep you company—just refresh her water and feed her once a day. Bedroom on the top floor, piano available, and quick tram/bus access to the city center. This is our personal home, so expect a warm and authentic stay. 🐾

name: Easy Family house
description:
Hallo I am Ellen, together with my husband and 2 kids, I live in this cosy family house in the North part of Amsterdam. We have a holiday outside Amsterdam and during our stays we offer our house for rental. When you love to stay in beautiful historical calm area, close to the centre, you will love our home.

Our home is suitable for families up to 4 persons. The large living-room provide enough space for playing, reading and relaxing.

We don't rent our home to a group of young people under 26

name: Lovely 1 bedroom apartment with balcony
description:
This lovely apartment of 45m2 with sunny balcony is perfect for couples, located next to the famous daily Dapper market. The neighborhood is vibrant with lots of restaurants, bars and shops around, including a park to relax during the day.

The location is an excellent base to get around in Amsterdam. Trams, trains and buses all stop within 1-2mins walk from the house. It will take you to any area you like (Dam square, Leidse square, Nieuwmarkt, RAI and many more).

name: Classic APT in Classy South!
description: This classic apartment is spacious and the perfect place for a loverly stay. Located very close to the city center and the RAI  in a trendy  neighborhood, this apt has 3 bedrooms, one bathroom, a living room and a balcony!

name: Bright, Stylish, Cozy Familyhouse 4 p, 3BR
description: Beautiful 3-story house in an old town house just outside the center of Amsterdam.  Recently renovated with wooden floors, a spacious bathroom, two toilets and a modern kitchen. Stunning Roof Terrace on both the first floor and the third floor. This place is great for a family with children.

name: Private Houseboat Stay – Romantic Amsterdam Escape
description: Enjoy a fully private stay with your own entrance, bathroom, and deck on a spacious houseboat in vibrant De Pijp. Perfect for a honeymoon or city break, just minutes from Amsterdam’s centre. Relax, sip wine, and watch boats glide by for an authentic Amsterdam experience!

name: Modern Apartment close to Vondelpark
description:
Modern, stylish apartment close to Vondelpark. This apartment offers all you need, including a fully equipped kitchen (with Quooker), Smart TV, dining area, outside eating area, an office (including a sleeping couch that can be used for children), and a large bedroom.

The apartment is centrally located, close to the Vondelpark, the metro station Heemstedestraat, and train station Lelylaan.

name: Spacious New 4 floor Family Home, 184m2, Parking
description:
A nice & large family townhouse in a popular and quiet neighbourhood in Amsterdam. The spacious house (184m2) has four floors.
The house has room for 2 adults and 4 children or 4 adults. Around the house and in the garden, children can play and relax. The private parking space can be used as well. You enter on the ground floor where the kitchen and dining room is. The living room is on the first floor. The house has two bathrooms and three toilets.

name: Canal Suite | City Centre
description: In the heart of the city centre a private suite. it is situated in an original Amsterdam canal house. This is Location, location,located!! This stylish and well decorated brand new suite apartment is located on the first floor. This is a typical Amsterdam Canal house located on the Amstel river.Everything is within walking distance: you're literally in the city centre! Rembrandtplein is 3 minutes by foot. Here you'll find a lot of cool bars, lovely restaurants.

name: Private entrance and bathroom, cheapest parking.
description:
In the northern part of Amsterdam is our family house, a former bathhouse. It was used as such until 1970. The bath house is a municipality monument.

You park your car on the public road; there are sufficient parking spaces. Our neighborhood has the lowest parking rates in Amsterdam. Paid parking is from Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 19:00. €1.72 per hour with a maximum of €10.30 per day. Free after 19:00, always free on Sundays.

You can safely park your bicycles in our enclosed backyard.

name: Houseboat, B&B in the back stern (BK 53).
description:
B&B BK 53 consists of the partly original rear end of the ship, with the bathroom in the former engine room. And literally on top of this, the use of the wheelhouse or captain's cabin. Great view from there.

(Amsterdam registration number: 0363 CE49 9B0B C7FA 79D6) .

name: Hermitage museum boat with amstel river vieuw
Room with a view
description: Stylish room with a nice view on Disteldorp, a cosy ‘village’ in Amsterdam. Here you are in the calm area of Amsterdam-Noord (North) , only 10 minutes walk to  the city centre. You can stay here alone or with a friend. One bed is in the attic, which you reach by stairs in your room. There is a desk and a chair to relax in.  The height of the room gives it a spacious feel. Another bed is placed downstairs in the room when you book the room for 2.

name: New detached villa with gym and workplace (210 m2)
Canalhouse 150m2 amazing view with private garden
description:
Spacious 2 floor apartment  with balcony, private garden on the water side with own jetty ( aanleg steiger )

View of the only wind mill in the city.

Tram and bus across the street.

Hop on Hop off around the corner

Amsterdam East is an up and coming neighborhood with a lot of Bars and Restaurants and of course the Dappermarkt .


Muiderpoort rail station is a 10 minutes walk and Central station 20 minutes.

name: Luxurious 3BR 100m2 apt near center of Amsterdam
description:
130m2 big apt, renovated 2018, very light with 8 windows, open kitchen, master bedroom and 2 smaller bedrooms. The open kitchen is furnished with modern applicances as:
Quooker,
dishwasher,
Combi oven with microwave and one oven with steam
Induction stove
Espresso machine
Washing machine
Fridge.
The bathroom is modern and stylish with bath and open shower.
Wooden floor and double glass around.
Close to public transport. 3rd floor, no elevator.

name: Amsterdam penthouse with amazing views
description:
Great penthouse apartment in the heart of IJburg in Amsterdam. IJburg is the newest area, with many interesting architectural projects, like the largest community of houses on water.
This apartment is 100 meters from the marina, which has a mediterranean atmosphere with its boats and cafe's around it.
Shops for daily groceries are at walking distance (within a 5 minutes walk).
The apartment has a roof terrace of over 200 m2.
But also from inside there are unlimited views on both sides.

name: Lovely Family home with garden @ Amsterdam West
description:
Welcome to our family house: a bright & comfortable home for two (!) adults and two kids with everything you need for a great stay in Amsterdam.

Our house is located in a quiet area, but the city center is just 15 minutes away by excellent public transport links (tram or bus) or bicycle.

We live in neighborhood 'Bos and Lommer', aka BOLO. It is a nice upcoming area with a range of shops, supermarkets, bakeries and restaurants. Nearby is Erasmuspark for relaxation, coffee and a playground.

name: B&B Studio Old South
description:
This studio is like a Bed & Breakfast, but without breakfast. Located in the upscale residential area “Oud Zuid”, a very nice area, relatively quiet and just next to the famous Vondel Park. Not far from Amsterdam centre, the Van Gogh Museum can be reached in 12 minutes on foot. 2 bedrooms for max 4 persons, in each room there are
2 twin beds. Kitchen can be used to prepare breakfast, but cooking full meals is not possible. Note : located on 4th floor, without elevator (about 75 steps).
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Lovely B&B in city centre-private-quiet-luxurious
description:
GOODNIGHT AMSTERDAM welcoming guests for over 18 years

Enjoy beautiful Amsterdam from your own cosy and comfortable apartment on a very central and quiet location
Based in a typical Amsterdam house (build 1882)

Your own characteristic apartments (2 pers) with high ceiling
Private luxury bathroom with shower, toilet and double washbasins
This means you’ll have complete privacy

Cleanliness is key

Very convenient: the AMSTERDAM AIRPORT EXPRESS bus arrives every 8 min. 200 meters from our house

name: Exceptional  lake view house for romantic stay
description:
Rent this unique and fully equipped house (incl. garage) on a traffic free dyke, close to Amsterdam city center and within travel distance to Zandvoort (beach) and Veluwe NP.

Enjoy your morning coffee looking at the sunrise while ships find their way to Amsterdam harbor. Or have your drink in a romantic setting during sunset while swimmers pass by. This unique location is only a direct 15 mins tram ride away from Amsterdam center. Come to experience an unexplored part of Amsterdam!

name: Luxurious gateway to hip Amsterdam
description: Luxuriously furbished 70m2, 1 bedroom appartement, with a stylish living room, open kitchen, and comfy Scandi bedroom. There is a bali-styled bathroom with whirlpool bath and "rainfall" shower. A french balcony up front - looking out over the street - and a larger balcony in the back.

name: Sweets hotel - Theophile de Bockbrug
description: Comfortable bridge house on the doorstep of Amsterdam’s vibrant Vondelpark. Your bedroom window is the perfect spot for watching locals on their daily bicycle commute. Skip across to the park and enjoy the greenest part of the city, or relax at one of the street-side cafés. The neighbourhood has a village feel, but in a 30-minute walk you are at the Leidseplein or the music venue Paradiso. Enjoy the public picnic table on the banks of the canal, directly adjacent to your bridge house.

name: Amsterdam Baarsjes Apartment
description: Welcome to my beloved apartment in the lively Baarsjes, Amsterdam! Located in the heart of the uprising neighbourhood with its vibrant streets filled with local shops, cafes, natural wine bars, sourdough bakeries and community gardens. Come immerse yourself in the city's dynamic culture, whether strolling through the nearby Erasmus park, discovering the hidden local gems, or with accessible public transportation and bicycle lanes explore Amsterdam's most  iconic landmarks and cultural scene.

name: Spacious family home in the Baarsjes
description:
Watch out: this is our own house, we only host when we are on vacation ourselves. So there are personal items and our own belongings in the cabinets.

We are a family of 4 and we live with great pleasure in this nice apartment in the Baarsjes. We have 1 large bedroom with 180cm bed and two small rooms with cots. It is not possible to sleep in these rooms as an adult.

name: Ruim huis+tuin op het zuiden (30+ & families only)
description: Our spacious house with south-facing garden is located in the popular part of Amsterdam East. All amenities are within walking distance: shops for daily groceries, trendy shops, restaurants, recreational area Oosterpark and Frankendael, swimming pool, the Tropenmuseum and public transportation. Tram 7 (Leidseplein) and tram 3 (Museumplein) stop in front of the Oosterpark. Trams 9 and 14 will take you to the Central Station. By car, you can quickly drive out of the city to, for example, the Zaanse Schans.

name: Long stay Jordaan Apartment
description: This modern two-bedroom apartment is located in the Jordaan area within 100 meters from Anne Frank house. New bathroom and separate restroom. The apartment is smokers friendly.

name: 3km from Central Station Private Entry | King bed
description:
Guest suite with private entrance & private bathroom. No shared spaces! 3.0 km from Central Station! King Size bed, fast WiFi. Near hotspot NDSM.

Bus stops near house. No 35, 36. 38, 391 & 394

In our house we created a lovely private place with its own entrance. 100% privacy.

Ceiling 3.30m, feels spacious

Fridge, water cooker & Nespresso machine in the room.

Small park on the water just behind the house.

The awesome bed has both hard and soft pillows. You will sleep well :)

name: Cosy, stylish fully private studio - perfect for 2
description:
Welcome to B&B Studio North!
Experience the best of both worlds in Amsterdam North, a lively yet peaceful area just 20 min from Central Station. Our cozy studio is nestled in a quiet residential neighborhood, offering a calm and safe place to unwind after a day in the city. Perfect for couples, solo travelers and business guests who value comfort, local charm and easy access to Amsterdam’s highlights.

Book now and enjoy Amsterdam!

name: Amsterdam Woning
description:
Spacious, luxurious, modern and cozy family home in a quiet neighborhood. The house has three bedrooms, a study, a spacious living room, a kitchen and a front and back garden.
The house is equipped with good beds, bath, wood stove, high quality equipment, fitness equipment, Sonos and HBO.
The house is just over 10 minutes' walk and three bus stops from the metro, the NZ line (No. 52) and 5 minutes' walk from the shopping center.
When the weather is nice, you can swim in the canal just behind the house.
NO SMOKING!

name: Beautiful & clean apartment near the Museumsquare
description:
General information:
The apartment is not suitable or intended as a base for groups of young people who come to Amsterdam to party for a weekend.
This beautiful apartment is located in the 'Museum Quarter'. It is spacious (60m2), very light and offers a lot of comfort. There a fully equipped kitchen (without gas stove), air conditioning and good beds. Within walking distance of all museums.

name: Anny's warehouse city centre!
description: Sleeping up to 2 guests this fantastic bed and breakfast makes the perfect choice for your stay in the heart of Amsterdam! The building is a monumental warehouse founded in 1646, even Rembrandt has passed my beautiful house!

name: Charming 3-bedroom family house (120m2) & garden
description:
A beautifully located, spacious (120m2) comfortable family home with a view on a green park. It is situated close to the city centre (8 min) and near to RAI. It has 3 bedrooms, a big living room and a kitchen. Kick back and relax in the sunny garden incl. a picnic table and a trampoline!
The popular 'De Pijp' is just a stone's throw away from the apartment. Bus stops, metro, restaurants, green parks and grocery stores are around the corner.

name: Double floor appt 10 minutes biking from center
description: One of the most laidback neighbourhoods in the shelter of the center.

name: SWEETS hotel Scharrebiersluis
description: A tiny character-filled bridge house in the heart of old Amsterdam, neighbouring a traditional Dutch brown café. This adorable house is a stone’s throw from the river IJ, the Scheepvaart (National Maritime) Museum and the impressive NEMO Science Museum. The surrounding neighbourhood offers quaint cafés for a bite to eat or to sample a local brew. Amsterdam Central Station is directly accessible by bus (10 minutes).

name: 207 - Nieuwe Amstelbrug
description: A cosy bridge house on the Amstel river in a vibrant neighbourhood near the popular Albert Cuyp market. The interior is divided into two floors with bathroom facilities on the lower level and a playful mezzanine bedroom above. Stroll to local cafés in the fashionable neighbourhood of De Pijp or take a walk into the centre of Amsterdam along the Amstel river (25 minutes).

name: Sweets hotel - Westerdoksbrug
description: A playful bridge house with 360 views over the river IJ at walking distance from Amsterdam Central Station (6 minutes). Marvel at some of Amsterdam’s newest architecture from your bedroom window, including the acclaimed EYE film museum and the Palace of Justice. Take a stroll to the tourist-friendly Haarlemmer street with some of the city’s best bars, restaurants and patisseries. Or visit the popular Noordermarkt, a paradise for organic food lovers and antique fans.

name: SWEETS hotel Kattenslootbrug
description:
A 1950s bridge house in the late ‘Amsterdam School’ style, bordering the popular Jordaan area and the heart of Amsterdam.

Take a stroll to the tourist-friendly Haarlemmer street (8 minutes) with some of the city’s best bars, restaurants and patisseries. The popular Noordermarkt, open on Saturdays and Mondays is a paradise for organic food lovers and antique fans, within walking distance (9 minutes). Amsterdam Central Station is directly accessible by bus or tram (17 minutes).

name: Sweets hotel - Beltbrug
description: Wake up to a view of a 16th century Dutch windmill, nestled close to local cafés in hip west Amsterdam. Take a leisurely 20-minute stroll to the popular 9 Streets for shopping nirvana or stay closer to home for an expert espresso and a delicious local pastry. Amsterdam Central Station is directly accessible by bus (14 minutes).

name: Sweets hotel - Wiegbrug
description: Located in popular west Amsterdam, close to bars, cafés and shops with a bird’s eye view of a canal. The interior has a spaceship feel, you are the captain, Amsterdam is your adventure. Pop into any of the local fashion stores around the neighbourhood and sample Vietnamese spring rolls in the popular Foodhallen (food market) within 8-minutes walk. Heads up curious travellers, this bridge house is located on a busy tram line and can be noisy, suitable for deep sleepers and night owls.

name: SWEETS hotel Kinkerbrug
description:
In the bustling heart of west Amsterdam, at walking distance from the city’s fashionable cafés and bars. Cocoon in this intimate interior designed in the style of the 1920s Amsterdam School.

Sip G&Ts or sample Vietnamese spring rolls in the popular Foodhallen (food market) within walking distance (9 minutes). Amsterdam Central Station is directly accessible by tram (21 minutes). Reach the museum district by bicycle (10 minutes) or the popular Leidseplein square (9 minutes).

name: Spacious family house with garden
description: In the lively area de Baarsjes, our house is 120m2 and has 2 adult bedrooms (accommodating 4). Downstairs is a large and light living space - including kids corner with toys! The kitchen is equipped with a fridge, stove, washing machine, quooker and coffee machine. There is a toilet in the hall downstairs. Upstairs there is a bathroom with another toilet, bath, seperate shower and sink. Close to shops, bars and a parc! The house comes with our 2 lovely cats, that we ask you to feed and cuddle!

name: Luxury suite 4p - 2 Bedrooms
description: Welcome to our luxury suite for 4 persons, your perfect retreat in the vibrant yet serene Amsterdam Noord. Nestled in a peaceful neighborhood, our accomodation offers a harmonious blend of easy access to the city life and natural beauty, being just minutes away from the bustling Amsterdam centre and the tranquil Twiske Nature reserve.

name: Brand new 120m2 designer apartment
description: Welcome to my 120 m2 designer apartment in Amsterdam's hip hotspot Amsterdam Noord, the 'sunny side of Amsterdam'. Although it is getting very popular among locals/visitors, it's still a chill area as most of the main tourist spots are on the other side of the water, just 10-15 minutes away by bike or public transport. So if you want to be close to the center and at the same time be able to relax away from the crowds and discover the more edgy North-side, you have found your place to stay!

name: Sunny and spacious apartment with cute cat
description:
I would like to offer my spacious and pleasantly furnished apartment as a nice accommodation in iconic Amsterdam Architecture. The apartment is fully equipped. The balcony is spacious and sunny from noon to evening.
The apartment is located in De Baarsjes, a dynamic and popular neighborhood in Amsterdam-West that is easily accessible by public transport and is 7 minutes by bike from the city center.

name: Cognac Suite, Amsterdam City Centre
description: Discover the beautiful and abundant city of Amsterdam from the heart of its historic city centre. Our newly renovated private suite is tucked away in a quiet alley next to Amsterdam’s main attractions and famous canals. Private bathroom, coffee & tea amenities, linens & towels etc are available upon arrival.

name: Chess Suite, Amsterdam City Centre
description: Discover the beautiful and abundant city of Amsterdam from the heart of its historic city centre. Our newly renovated private suite is tucked away in a quiet alley next to Amsterdam’s main attractions and famous canals.

name: The Dutch Suites
description: We are pleased to welcome you to the heart of the beautiful historic city centre of Amsterdam. Discover the city from your private and newly renovated Dutch-style decorated floor with suites, tucked away in a quiet alley amongst Amsterdam’s main attractions.

name: Charming City Center apartment along the canal
description:
Welcome to the Mothership of all Casa Tomi!
Indulge your senses in this luxurious floral canal house residence that is located in an exquisite neighbourhood along the canal.

To unleash the full potential of your Amsterdam’s journey and experience, the possibility to rent an open boat is indeed offered.

name: Cosy guest room w/ private bathroom & bikes
description:
Our cosy guest room with private bathroom is part of our home and includes two bikes which are free to use. It’s just a 3-minute walk from the metro, and you can reach the city center within 10 minutes.

You’ll feel at home right away with Canvas, Volkshotel and many local cafés and bars nearby. Oosterpark is just around the corner - perfect for relaxing and enjoying the sun.

name: Private floor, near Rai, Zuidas & metro to centre
description: Private floor in our house on the ground floor with your own keys and privacy. Located in Amsterdam Zuid / Buitenveldert, only 3 minutes walk to tram 5 and metro 51 with direct access to Amsterdam city center. Easy connections to RAI Convention Center, Zuidas/WTC, Museumplein, Dam Square and the Heineken Experience. Amsterdamse Bos is also nearby. Perfect for city trips and business visitors attending events at the RAI or working in the Zuidas area.

name: Cozy  Room Whirlpool Bath, Wifi, Near Center
description:
Spring in Amsterdam! If you like to stay in
a stylish, affordable room with cheap parking possibilities nearby and tram and bus in front of the door to the city centre, then I would be more than happy to welcome you as my guest!

name: Sweets hotel - Overtoomsesluis
description: Squeezed in between two large green parks and many cafés, restaurants and shops, this exceptionally cosy bridge house is the perfect starting point to experience Amsterdam like a local. Get a sense of Amsterdam’s history from this 1940s tiny house in ‘Late Amsterdam School’ style, and cuddle up in the snug alcove bed – a peaceful retreat in the midst of the city’s daily rush. A scenic 25-minute walk through the Vondelpark takes you to Museum Square and the city centre, or just take tram 11!

name: Huis Roomolen
description:
Studio Huis Roomolen is located at Roomolenstraat in the center of Amsterdam, a little street beween canals, yet; in the middle of things.
Three large windows give a nice view over the Roomolenstraat. The size of the luxurious studio is 26m² including private kitchen, shower and toilet. Private roof terrace of 10m² at the backside enclosed by the neighbor buildings.
The place is very warm and personal, perfectly suited for a single traveler or couple to retreat as well as to discover Amsterdam.

name: Room private
description:
You'll have a very comfortable stay in a chill and safe neighborhood. There is a supermarket close by, along with many restaurants, bars, coffeeshops.
Bus and tram are easily reachable as they are here in the street.
Leidseplein, Central Station and Anne Frank House are in walking distance, as well as the hippest district of Amsterdam, Jordaan. You'll have a quiet and relaxing stay at home; fun andentertainment when you're out.
long term booking is available,
1900m to DAM center2300m cent stati

name: House boat on one of the beautiful canals
description: This beautiful boat is situated in the heart of Amsterdam in the lively and charming Jordaan district. Its only a 10 minute walk from the Amsterdam Central Station. The 75m2 space at the rear end of the boat, with great views over the water, has wifi and fully a furnished kitchen and bathroom. It's best suited for a small family, couples and solo adventurers.

name: Light filled canal-side apartment in Amsterdam
description:
Gorgeous light filled treehouse canal-side apartment in the centre of Amsterdam with three balconies. Stunning views to the canal and park from the lounge and bedroom.
Our suburb Bos and Lommer is filled with great coffee, bars and restaurants.
Well located with 2min walk to 3 supermarkets, 5 minute walk to 2 different parks, tram, metro and bus all within 5minute walk. 15 minute bike ride to the main shopping/tourist district. And only 25 minutes by public transport from the airport.

name: Amsterdam house
description:
In the center of Amsterdam, yet in a quiet area for relaxing after a busy daytrip. Few minutes from Artis (the zoo), Hortus Botanicus (Botanic Garden), Jewish Historical Museum. The famous Waterloo plein Markt is around the corner. The house is for 2 persons max and has all the needs for a pleasant stay in Amsterdam, including a garden. Please mind: sleeping on the couch is not allowed.

Bedroom is quiet small(1.60x3.40m including wardrobe). Height bed is 1.10m from floor.
Size bed: 2x1.40m

name: Amsterdam Modern HOUSEBOAT with TERRACE
description:
Authentic but modern Houseboat in one of the oldest parts of Amsterdam. This city center neighbourhood is a 'hidden' and quiet top spot with all the action around the corner!
My houseboat is provided with all the luxury you might expect from a regular house with the extra benefits of a terrace with all day sun and airco in the bedroom. In summer we swim in the canal.
The boat fits 2 adults and a child.
Just 5 minutes walk from central station.
No smoking inside and on the rooftop. No parties

name: Urban Jungle Room
description:
Inspiring, tastefully decorated Urban Jungle room, with kitchenette in the green district of Amsterdam. In a quiet area within walking distance of tram, bus and metro. and the Sloterpark and the WFC. In 15 minutes you are on the Leidseplein, RAI or WTC by tram. Wifi is available.
Are you curious and interested? Then book our connect-inn accommodation in Amsterdam or contact us.

name: Captain's House
description:
Neat and Clean, two floor apartment in historic building (1652), central located in a quiet pedestrian street.

Very central and so easy to reach and to explore from, in a quiet pocket of the the heart of the old center.

Apartment is plug and play with all you might need, orientation tour is included (where to do groceries, eat and where not and other information you might need over the city etc.)

I do not take groups in their 20ties or anybody coming for partying/festivals.

name: Ground floor with garden 5mins from Rijksmuseum
description: Modern and newly renovated ground floor apartment in one of the trendiest locations in Amsterdam. Situated on a quiet no-through road, you are moments away from the hustle and bustle but without the noise. Equipped with both an en-suite bath and a separate bathroom, desk for working and modern appliances (Smart TV x 2, Alexa, Nespresso machine, full fridge and freezer, dishwasher, washing machine).

name: Wonderful rooms with private bathrooms for four!
description:
We are located in a friendly neighbourhood in the Watergraafsmeer. Our area is well known for being relaxed and easy-going while at the same time remaining hip and fashionable. Within a 5-minute stroll from Fleur d’Amsterdam you will find a number of restaurants, parks, shops, bars.
At Fleur d’Amsterdam, you will find two comfortable rooms with each a private bathroom a quiet oasis, close to the centre of Amsterdam. A home away from home after an enjoyable day in Amsterdam.

Welcome!
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Wonderful Apartement in Historical City Centre
description:
Wonderful apartment in a 18th century canal house. The stunning view is the canal and a beautiful Wertheim park across. Located in a very quiet and posh area and yet very close to the lively centre. The famous Waterlooplein (flee market), Rembrandthouse (museum), the Hermitage and lots more.

You will only share the entrance with me, once you are inside it's all yours and private.
The apartment has just been completely renovated (2019).

name: Cute apartment in the east
description:
Perfect getaway form the crowded city centre of Amsterdam and Utrecht.
Spacious home perfect for large groups of coworkers or a big family.

14 minute walk to the local train station, from which it takes you roughly 30 minutes to the hart of Amsterdam or Utrecht.
Even though the big cities are close by, everything you might need on a relaxing holiday is whit in grasp.
The house is ideal for the combining of leisure and work.

By car 35 minutes tot international airport Schiphol Amsterdam.

name: Duplex I Amsterdam Centre
description:
Designer's duplex apartment in a typical Dutch house in a quiet and beautiful canal street in the heart of Amsterdam.

Lots of light, tasteful furnishing and agreeable view over courtyards.
Very well located and close to many restaurants, bars, markets, museums…

Central Station is a 8 min walk from the apartment and the nearest metro station 7 min. Schiphol Airport is a 27 min ride away.

name: Sweets hotel - Gerben Wagenaarbrug
description: Sit on high! A soaring 3-storey bridge house close to Amsterdam North’s favourite bars and cafés. Cocoon in this colourful bridge house with a view of the boats moored on the North Holland canal. This is the largest of all our bridge houses, including a living room, bedroom and bathroom. This bridge house is a perfect overnight stop for cyclists on the LF7 cycle route. Amsterdam Central Station is accessible by a short walk (12 minutes) and a ferry ride (6 minutes).

name: Zen City Rooftop Appartment Amsterdam
description: Zen City Rooftop Apartment is a lovely bright apartment of 48 m2 with balcony and a large roof terrace (13 m2), located on a quiet canal. The house is a 7-minute bike ride from the center of Amsterdam (e.g. the Jordaan) and Central Station. Near all the ‘must sees’, in a quiet part of town with a relaxed vibe. The canal is characterized by modern warehouses and unique (Venetian) bridges, where you can swim during the summer. The apartment has recently been completely renovated.

name: ONE OF A KIND 2STORY DUTCH TOWN HOUSE WITH PATIO
description:
Come spend a night in this one of a kind authentic and stylish typical Dutch town house dating from 1906. The spacious apartment comes with beautiful hardwood floors, tasteful furniture and a quaint private patio. The apartment has 2 separate bedrooms, a large bathroom with and a separate toilet. It comfortably sleeps up to 4 people.

The charming street is quiet, but a stone’s throw away from famous landmarks such as the the Jordaan district, the 9 streets and the museum district.

name: All the best from Old West
Authentic Houseboat B&B in the City Centre!
description:
Cozy and charming two-bedroom apartment on a historic freight ship. From the wheelhouse you have a panoramic view over the wonderful canals of Amsterdam. Perfect location in the heart of the Jordaan, at the corner of the Prinsengracht. The Jordaan is a very nice, charming neighborhood with lots of restaurants, boutique shops and markets. Close to Anne Frank House, the famous Nine Streets and Amsterdam Central Station.
Nice, private lounge deck and table to sit outside while enjoying city life!

name: Modern and cosy apartment in Amsterdam
description: Beautiful and spacious just renovated apartment close to the city center. The apartment is located in the west part of Amsterdam 'the Baarsjes',  with lots of hip bars and restaurants just around the corner.

name: Houseboat.712; Unique! First class experience!
description:
I finally did it! This brandnew houseboat is designed with you in mind. Meaning private entrance and amenities, sound proof walls and the best view in Amsterdam overlooking the Amstel River.
On the left you see the Grand Amstel Hotel and the Royal Theater Carre, opposite Amsterdam oldest rowing club.
The light is reflected over the water. Have you ever seen a Swan lifting up out of the water? Nature at its best straight in the center of the Pijp area with little restaurants and bars gallore.

name: Licht app. met 2 slaapkamers en terras nabij metro
description:
Welcome to your bright and spacious retreat in the peaceful Zuid-Oost neighborhood of Amsterdam!

Families and couples will feel right at home here, with plenty of space to unwind and even welcome your furry friends. Nearby, you can take scenic walks around the beautiful Gaasperplas lake, just a short stroll from your door. There are good public transport connections.

Whether you need to catch up on work or plan your adventures in the city, there’s a desk with WiFi for your convenience.

name: 2-bedroom apartment in the Amsterdam city center
description: Lovely spacious (112 m2) and light 2-bedroom apartment in the center of Amsterdam, close to Brouwerij 't Ij, central station and Artis. A perfect spot to explore Amsterdam; rent a bike around the corner or travel the city by tram which stops at the end of the street. Come home to a quiet and well-furnished place where you can relax and be yourself.

name: Sweets hotel - Sluis Haveneiland
description: If you are looking for a hotel room with a view in Amsterdam, this is it! Located in upcoming neighbourhood IJburg, bridge house 'Sluis Haveneiland' has the most magical view across the IJ lake. Watch sailing boats entering and leaving the harbour through the lock next to your bridge house, and enjoy sunbathing on the jetty. Directly behind Sluis Haveneiland, a ferry leaves for Fort Pampus and Castle Muiderslot. Tram 26 takes you from Sluis Haveneiland to Amsterdam Central Station (30 minutes).

name: Bright, stylish and cozy appartment
description:
City Center authentic apartment in Jordaan area. Stylish and a quiet cozy bright space.
Its close to the Ann Frank house and around the corner of the 9 streets (negen straatjes).
Cool bars and places for a coffee or lunch are around every corner and at the same time the street is quiet as there is almost no traffic.

name: Lovely home in west side Amsterdam
description:
The apartment is situated in a real nice and lively area of Amsterdam. Very close to the shops, museum quarter with Rijksmuseum, van Gogh and more. Also a small 5 min. walk will take you to Amsterdams greatest park "Vondelpark"

“Maximum 4 guests total, including children and babies, in accordance with Amsterdam regulations.”

name: Pearl Suite
description: We are pleased to welcome you to the heart of the beautiful historic city centre of Amsterdam. Discover the city from your private and newly renovated Dutch-style decorated floor with suites, tucked away in a quiet alley amongst Amsterdam’s main attractions.

name: Delft Blue Suite
description: Discover the beautiful and abundant city of Amsterdam from the heart of its historic city centre. Our newly renovated private suite is tucked away in a quiet alley next to Amsterdam’s main attractions and famous canals.

name: Beautiful and spacious apartment, great location
description: Beautiful, stylish and spacious 3 bedroom apartment in a typical Amsterdam house, with a small garden and a terrace. The apartment has a modern design yet has kept some of its original details. It has all you need to give you a comfortable and worry-free stay in the most beautiful area of Amsterdam.  Location is perfect, bordering Vondelpark and Museumsquare, and is on walking distance from nice and trendy restaurants and boutiques. Maximum four adults. Note: live-in au pair

name: Beautiful apartment in most popular area Amsterdam
description:
Spacious apartment on one of Amsterdam's nicest streets (Utrechtsestraat). Great for a city trip to Amsterdam. The complete apartment is available to the guests and has two seperate bedrooms with both a kingsize bed, kitchen amenities, a large bathroom, and a great authentic view.

All famous museums are on walking distance and the apartment is located a few minutes from the Amstel river.

Public transport, supermarkets and amazing restaurants/bars are all within 2 minutes walking distance.

name: Luxurious Amsterdam family villa
description:
Our family townhouse is ideal for other families or couples traveling to Amsterdam while we are traveling abroad.

Very green neighborhood with lots of playgrounds. Tram 1 is a 5 minute walk from our home with a direct connection to the city centre. It takes about 20 minutes. Tram 1 brings you to all the hotspots in town like Rijksmuseum, Leidseplein, Van Gogh museum, etc.

With a 8 minute walk from our home you will also find a big supermarket, butcher, baker, cheese shop, fish shop, etc.

name: Designer Loft by Daan - Amsterdam West
description:
Lovely newly built 60m² studio (2018) located in one of Amsterdam’s most vibrant and upcoming neighbourhoods: Amsterdam New West. Just around the corner from the beautiful Rembrandtpark and the urban beach at Sloterplas, while the famous Vondelpark and Museum District are only a short ride away. Schiphol Airport can be reached in just 15 minutes by public transport.

Perfect for couples, families, friends, or business travellers. The metro is only a 2-minute walk away, making it easy to explore
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Cozy apartment in Amsterdam city center
description:
Stylish Apartment Between Jordaan & Westerpark – Prime Location!

Welcome to this charming and comfortable apartment, perfectly located between the vibrant Jordaan district, the lively Westerpark, and Amsterdam’s historic city center. Ideal for solo travelers or couples looking to explore the city from a quiet yet super central base.

✨ Location, location, location!

name: Nemo Guests House
description:
People from all backgrounds are welcome in my home. The double room is located on the 1st floor and situated in the middle of the private house with typical Dutch steep stairs, no elevator. The room has private bathroom ( shower & toilet ), small area to make tea/coffee or toast & small fridge.
The house was build around XVIII Century and was reconstructed inside a few times.

Parking Info :

Within the centre the parking rate €7,50 per hour. Also finding a free parking spot can be challenging.

name: Keizers House
description:
The Keizer House occupies a picturesque location in the heart of AMS. Built in 1696, this five-story residence embodies the elegance and inviting character of its era, with enchanting views over the Keizersgracht canal. Thoughtfully renovated with respect for its original features, it seamlessly blends modern comfort with historic beauty.
Highlights include original fireplaces, a custom-made bar, carefully selected antique furnishings, and curated artwork making the ideal retreat for visitors.

name: Beautiful House | 8min. to city center
description:
Welcome to our lovely and spacious 160m² home, featuring a large garden and a modern open-plan living area with a fully equipped kitchen and bar. The house offers two bedrooms, a big bathroom with an extra-large bathtub, and a separate toilet for your convenience.

Just around the corner, you'll find a small shopping center for all your essentials and the metro station -only a 5-minute walk away- offers quick access to the city center.

Perfect for couples, families, or business travellers.

name: Jacuzzi, BBQ with 5* Hotel Bed
description: Our apartment is located in the old part of Amsterdam West near the Foodhallen of Amsterdam. It is on a typical Dutch local market where you can buy all sorts of delicious Dutch produce. It's a lively area with a lot of restaurant, bars, and shops. Central station is 10 min. by public transport and the center is 5 min. away. We have a bright apartment with a garden,  jacuzzi and BBQ. The boxspring is of luxury brand Serta, which is used in Hilton, Sheraton and Waldorf.

name: Private Studio Centre; near park restaurant musea
description: Tranquil, elegant and impeccably clean studio with its own entrance, set on a private floor of a classic Amsterdam townhouse. Located in the lively city center close to Vondelpark, Leidseplein, the 9 Streets, top museums and great local dining. Fully renovated, it offers a double bed, ensuite bathroom and compact kitchen, plus smart TV and high-speed WiFi. Easy access to public transport and a direct link to the airport. The perfect blend of comfort, privacy and city life

name: Beautiful Studio on ground floor in Westerpark
description:
Comfortable studio on ground floor in the Westside area of Amsterdam Centre.
Accommodation is for two people maximum.
5 minutes walk from the well known Westerpark area. shopping facilities nearby: supermarket, bakery et cetera. Near tramline 5 stop.
Everything you need is in the apartment to make your stay comfortable: kitchen, shower and toilet.
Comfortable double bed, size 180x200 cm.
Plenty of cupboard space when needed.

Wifi included.

Not intended for party people. Respect the neighbors

name: Art nouveau houseboat overvieuwing Amstel river
description: Very comfortable Houseboat, mahony wooden walls, art nouveau style, with terras on very central location overvieuwing the river. After a break of 4 coronayears, we are back into bussiness. In that 4 years we took the chance to renew our bathroom, renew our steering wheel cabin, a lot of painting on the deck, 3 new roofdeck ligts, and some technical adjustments you cannot see, but will make your stay more comfortable. there is centtral heating and airco for hot summer days.

name: Luxurious boutique studio apartment with garden
description:
We welcome “non-smokers” to our fully self-contained luxury modern studio (35m2) with a sunny garden.
Our house is not located in the city center (downtown). There are 2 trams in 15 min walking distance. Trams take you to city center in 30 min based on traffic jam & your destination.
We are close to the airport. If you take a taxi or Uber, we are in 15 min drive from Schiphol airport. If you want to use public transportation, there is a bus, scheduled every 30 min, with the bus it will be 25 min

name: Spacious 2BR apartment next to Museum District
description:
This cozy, newly renovated apartment is located in the most vibrant neighborhoods in Amsterdam: De Pijp (center). Where you can find many trendy restaurants, boutique shops, Brown cafe's, Amsterdam's most famous open air market, the 'Albert Cuypmarkt' and the museum district at 5 minutes walking distance.

With the metro right around the corner, you can be both at Central Station and Station Zuid in 5 minutes. This 70 m2 apartment with 2 double bedrooms is your fully private home!

name: Private studio in central located townhouse
description: Small (18m2) but comfortable studio with private entrance, bathroom and kitchenette with micro wave and one portable induction hob (you can warming up food but not cooking) fridge, coffee machine and a cooker. You have your own patio and parking space for your bycicle. It is well located, only 5 min from the well known neighbourhood De Pijp. You are in 10 min in the middle of the city centre because metro (Spaklerweg) and train (Amstelstation) are very nearby.

name: Light and modern studio in Jordaan area
description:
Light and modern studio in Jordaan area.

Spacious, clean and bright attic studio with well equipped open-plan kitchen, living/dining area and two single beds or one double bed.
The studio has a private bathroom with shower, sink and toilet.

name: Cosy studio  bijzonder pand  Amsterdam- IJburg
description: Private room with indoor bathroom, adjacent, the toilet, on the ground floor of a special building on Steigereiland IJburg. The toilet is cleaned extra well and is always sparkling clean. In the vicinity, a café restaurant, natural quiet environment, swimming water, park for hiking. Excellent connection to the city center. Also possibility to rent bicycles at the central station.

name: Luxurious & spacious 5* oasis
description:
Luxurious, bright, newly renovated and spacious 3-storey family home with parking. Right near the Amsterdamse Bos entrance and just 15 mins via tram/bus to city centre. Free parking in our driveway.

If you would like to stay for longer, please message me/request a special offer for for a discounted rate.

name: Comfortable and stylish apartment on quiet street
description: Recenly renovated, comfortable and stylish apartment in a trendy neighborhood. Includes all amenities WiFi tv Bluetooth speakers ironing board etc. Close to bars, restaurants but still on a quiet street.

name: Lovely retro room with private bathroom
description:
Be welcome my private room with private bathroom in the lovely 'Oud West' neighbourhood. The bed is huge and comfy, the bathroom is smallish but newly tiled and painted.

The area is bustling with small cafes and lovely restaurants. Only a 5 minute walk away from the green of Vondelpark. Rent a bike and you'll be everywhere within 10 mins. Also public transport is ideal, only 10 mins to places such as the centre, Museum square, Anne Frank house, the gay street and many other places...

name: Private Apartment with Canal-View & Roof Terrace
description: SPACIOUS (~70m2)  and BRIGHT private apartment located in vibrant Amsterdam-West neighbourhood with panoramic view over the canal and a sunny roof terrace: the perfect place for a couple to stay and enjoy all that Amsterdam has to offer!

name: Comfy and equipped apartment at the best location!
description:
Modern and comfy apartment for two in the popular neighbourhood Oud-west.
Kickstart your day on the assault bike, enjoy an excellent home made coffee, and you're ready to explore the city by foot!
We also have a nice home desk setup to have a productive remote working day.
In the evening, grab dinner at one of the numerous local cafe's and restaurants or stay in and watch a movie on the big screen!

name: The little townhouse
description: Welcome to our lovely private townhouse in the center of de Pijp, the Quartier Latin of Amsterdam. We are centrally located within walking distance to all the museums and other highlights in de Pijp, one of the hippest neighborhoods in Amsterdam.

name: Luxury family home Amsterdam-Noord
description:

Perfect for families with kids. Given that this is a family home we rent out only to families and couples, no groups of friends! (Sorry no exceptions, so please do not inquire if you are a group of friends we have strict house rules)

In the studio there is one double bed and a sofabed (baby cot is available), the private bathroom has a shower and toilet. UNIQUE DESTINATION!

Perfectly located along the UNESCO World Heritage Herengracht canal in Amsterdam’s City Center. The building housing the suites is an authentic piece of Dutch history, built in 1637. Each suite is inspired by one of the great Dutch masters of the 17th century.

name: Oud West living

Beautiful spacious apartment on a canal close to the canal rings. Top location outside of the bustle, but still very vibey. Great restaurants and cafes nearby. Close to Vondelpark (great for a jog or a stroll).

A large, bright, L- room (24 m2, 4th floor) in the centre, Jordaan.

This beautiful large Houseboat is nicely decorated and located at one of the best locations in this part of Amsterdam and 5 minutes’ walking distance from the city centre near the famous area "The Jordaan” district, Saturday "Noordermarkt" and much more.

name: Historic canal house in the middle of De Jordaan!
description: Welcome to Morningstar! Located right in the heart of Amsterdam. We can cater up to 4 persons in the apartment, which is part of our canal house, with a master bedroom (kingsize bed) and a sleeping sofa in the living room. We welcome guests that are looking for a unique stay in a historic canal house. We like to give families with (little) children a family experience in our apartment, a vibrant place in a picturesque Dutch canal house, overlooking the Westerkerk and Anne Frank House.

name: Amsterdam Noord, gateway to the wetlands
description:
Welcome!
Come over and explore Amsterdam and its surroundings by bike, car, bus, train!
Our house is situated in the North of Amsterdam, above the IJ (river). It will take you about 15 minutes to bike to the (free!) ferry, which will take you to the centre of Amsterdam.

The appartement is 82m2 containing 3 bedrooms, bathroom with shower, separate toilet, sunny livingroom, well equiped kitchen.
The apartment is situated on the 5th floor, elevator available.

name: Artist loft on the canal in a chill area
description:
Welcome to our cozy Amsterdam nest! Our colorful loft is facing a canal, tucked away in a quiet and local district with many hidden gems, only 5-minute walk from the vibrant Jordaan and the iconic Westerpaark.

We've poured love into crafting this space for chill vibes and cooking. The well-equipped kitchen will be very much appreciate by cooks while the large premium bed will be loved by everyone.

We love Amsterdam and we'll be super happy to share our tips to ensure you'll love it too.

name: Bright room with spectacular canal view @ Jordaan
description: You will love this room, it’s a bright room with a spectacular (canal) view in a historical house. Located in the center of Amsterdam, near the Anne Frank House, (Jordaan).The Jordaan, one of the most famous neighbourhoods in Amsterdam is undoubtedly the most sung, described and romanticized city district of the Netherlands. Favorite neighborhood for students, artists and young entrepreneurs. A popular area, specially for its history, culture, monuments, canals, shops, restaurants and cafes.

name: Spacious Canal House Loft | City center
description:
This is a luxurious private canal house loft, located in the middle of Amsterdam Jordaan.

name: One Bedroom Apartment at Wittenberg by Cove
description: Ideal if you like to keep your sleep space separate, this one-bed apartment is kitted out with all the living essentials.

name: Studio Apartment at Wittenberg by Cove
description: Well-appointed and truly beautiful, this neat studio apartment has everything you need to feel at home.

name: Two Bedroom Apartment at Wittenberg by Cove
description:
Four people can stay comfortably in this apartment.

Sleep peacefully with UK king-size beds, blackout blinds, crisp linen and a smart heating/cooling system.

Work comfortably with super-fast, privately secured WiFi, a multi-purpose/dining table, and an Apple TV box. Plus, get a desk on request.

name: Three-Bedroom Apartment at Wittenberg by Cove

name: Three Bedroom House at Wittenberg by Cove
description: Make yourself at home in this unique, totally private, two-bedroom heritage home with your own front door and sofa bed.

name: Light Top Floor Apartment with Roof Terrace
description:
Private, quiet, sunny, fourth-floor (walk-up) apartment located in the popular Pijp district of Amsterdam within walking distance of the Albert Cuyp street market, Heineken Experience, van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, Stedelijk Museum, Amsterdam Museum, Concert Hall, a variety of shops, multi-cultural restaurants, cafes, Sarphati Park and the Amstel river.

The apartment is close to tram lines 3 and 4 as well as metro line 52 which offers a quick connection to major train stations.

name: Sparkling, stylish home in City Center - 4 people!
description: This apartment in the city center is only 5 minutes walking distance from Amsterdam Central Station. Truly a top tier location! Close to Dam Square, the Red Light District and several great local bars, restaurants and coffeeshops. Smoking is allowed inside the apartment as well. There is a main king size bed and additionally the sofa turns into a king size sleeping bed with the bottom pulled out (see pictures). The apartment is suitable for 4 people in total.

name: #NORD ROOM
description: Soft tones, stylish design and innovative materials make up the characteristics of this bedroom. Located on our first floor street side, the room offers a king size bed, flat screen TV, desk and sitting area and rainshower

property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Houseboat Apartment  Amsterdam Center
description: This nice houseboat apartment is located in a cargo boat from 1907 in the old Amsterdam harbor of the 16th century. The boat is moored in between the oldest part of the historic city centre and the modern architecture of the Oosterdok Island, between Central Station and the Technology Museum. The boat and the surrounding boats form a quite little  village right in the center of town. Central heating makes the apartment nice and warm in the winter.

name: Cosy houseboat studio in the old city center
description: This cosy studio apartment is ideal for a couple or three friends. The studio is located in a cargo boat from 1907 in the old Amsterdam harbor of the 16th century. The boat is moored in between the oldest part of the historic city centre and the modern architecture of the Oosterdok Island, between Central Station and the Technology Museum. The boat and the surrounding boats form a quite little  village right in the center of town. Central heating makes the studio nice and warm in the winter.

name: Peaceful apartment with a stunning private rooftop
description:
In the heart of Amsterdam’s city centre, a beautiful family apartment is available for up to four guests. The apartment features an absolutely unique and private 30 m² rooftop terrace, offering stunning views of the iconic Westerkerk tower and much of the Amsterdam skyline.
Unfortunately, groups of friends are not permitted; the apartment is suitable only for a couple (without or with maximum 2 children) or two adult guests.

THIS PLACE CAN ONLY BE RENTED IN 2026 FOR A MAX OF 4 NIGHTS.

name: Step into 1923 Houseboat on Iconic Amstel River
description: Escape the ordinary and immerse yourself in the enchanting beauty of Amsterdam like never before. Welcome aboard our meticulously restored 1923 houseboat, nestled gracefully in the heart of Amsterdam on the picturesque Amstel River. This is not just a place to stay; it's an experience that transports you back in time while providing all the modern comforts you desire.

name: My sunny houseboat. A great family place!
description: Stay up to 4 guests in my luxurious HOUSEBOAT. The boat and deck are surrounded by fencing, making it safe for small children. This fantastic and unique location makes the perfect choice for your stay!  This gorgeous houseboat is excellently designed with your comfort in mind.. A warm inviting living space features nice flooring throughout and deliciously contemporary furniture. Enjoy the outdoor space and the unique feeling of staying on a boat in the beautiful surroundings of Amsterdam.

name: Old Pijp Studio
description:
This studio is located in very hip area of Amsterdam called “De Pijp”, with all kinds of restaurants and bars and also the touristic city centre is very close.
Staying in this studio will give you a typical taste of how the Dutch people live in Amsterdam.

name: New Pijp Studio
description:
This apartment is located in very hip area of Amsterdam called “De Pijp”, with all kinds of restaurants and bars and also the touristic city centre is very close.
Staying in this apartment will give you a typical taste of how the Dutch people live in Amsterdam.

The studio has a very comfortable bed and a spacious bathroom. The studio has a little kitchenette with coffee and tea facilities.

name: Sweets hotel - Meeuwenpleinbrug
description: A 1960s bridge house perched between a neighbourhood park and a bustling intersection in Amsterdam North; a perfect overnight stop for cyclists on the LF7 cycle route. Explore the hottest spots in the city with the new North-South metro line; station 'Noorderpark' is right across the street! (2 minutes to Amsterdam Central Station) Or discover trendy Amsterdam North with the Eye Film Museum, A'DAM Lookout and De Ceuvel. In summer, the neighbouring Noorderpark is a popular leafy oasis for locals.

name: Luxury  spacious design apartment in city centre
description:
This property is extremely suitable if you are looking for a luxurious home, close to the city centre and still want to be in a quiet location. The property is located in de Pijp, one of Amsterdam's nicest neighbourhoods with lots of nice restaurants and amenities.
The famous Albert Cuyp market is a 5-minute walk away, the canal belt is a 10-minute walk.
The house is luxuriously equipped, cool in summer and quiet in terms of noises.

name: Eastern Docklands Studio
description: Welcome to our studio on Borneo island in Eastern Docklands. Surrounded by water and modern architecture, you're just a quick hop away from the city centre. Nearby, you'll find everything you need - shops, cafes, restaurants, bike rentals, public transportation hubs, parks, cinemas, and more. You can enjoy outdoor swimming in the summer and explore old villages with two nearby ferries. Our quiet studio is the perfect retreat after a bustling day in Amsterdam and its surroundings.

name: Bright Family Home in Amsterdam Noord
description:
Welcome to your bright 120 m² home in Amsterdam Noord — a warm, family‑friendly space with two bedrooms, a full bathroom, and fast Wi‑Fi. Relax in the small garden, on the sunny roof terrace, or with a swim nearby after exploring the city.

Close to NDSM, EYE, and the A'DAM Tower, and only 15 minutes from the center by ferry, bus, or metro. From this peaceful yet central spot, discover Amsterdam at your own pace.

Stay a week and enjoy a 15 % discount — your home away from home in the city.

description: Wonderful bright and spacious house with garden in a child-friendly neighborhood where you can play outside. The house is located between Eye and NDSM in Amsterdam Noord. Everything can be reached by bike. Also there is a metro and the ferry to CS within a 20-minute walk.

name: PRIVATE apartment in Canal House, Jordaan, Center
description: Do you WANT TO GET OUT and enjoy the CANALS of Amsterdam? This spacious INDEPENDENT apartment is located in a historic CANAL HOUSE in the most romantic neighborhood in the center. The artistic and the creative soul of the city is concealed in this charming area which is like a village in the center of Amsterdam, with lovely ROMANTIC bridges creating that ultimate holiday feeling AND close to the main city’s attractions and public transfer.

name: Lovely apartment at the water with a sunny balcony
description: The apartment is bright, sunny, warm and has a homey atmosphere. The south-facing balcony gives you the opportunity to enjoy the sun all afternoon, so you hardly want to leave the door. But the nearby area also has so much to offer!

name: Knus appartement met tuin en WFH
description:
Cozy apartment in Amsterdam East.
Equipped with 1 bedroom with king size bed.
The bedroom offers access to the cozy garden.
The living room + kitchen has a nice corner sofa and large TV. In the evening, it is wonderfully quiet, and you can eat comfortably in the garden with the evening sun.

In the garden is the home office with 2 luxurious workplaces, where you can work perfectly remotely.

There is a bike rental around the corner, to easily move around the city.

name: Studio anno 1659 - City Centre - Central Station
description: Situated in an authentic Dutch canal house, our quaint studio apartment with view over Amsterdam's famous "Koepelkerk" is the perfect getaway for two in the heart of Amsterdam's old city centre. Conveniently located a five minute walk from Amsterdam Central Station and within walking distance of famous sights such as Dam square, the Anne Frank house and the vibrant Jordaan district, you will be able to enjoy Amsterdam as we do ourselves on a daily basis. We hope to welcome you to our city soon!

name: Private island in the heart of Amsterdam
description:
Romantic private island in the heart of Amsterdam – a once in a lifetime experience! Stare across the Amstel River from your bed and enjoy an enchanting view of the Skinny Bridge. This is your dream destination, perfect for honeymoons and other special occasions. Once arrived at this magical hotel suite in Amsterdam centre, life seems to reduce itself to only one wish: to stay here forever.

Included in your booking are 2 single boat crossings with a private captain and a late check-out (12.00).

We have  2 luxery bathrooms ,4 sleeping rooms and a  nice garden .You can swim and dive from the boat . Its 300m2 space,and have 2 floors .

description:
Our apartment is very spacious and light throughout the whole day thanks to the windows all around the living room and kitchen. The open kitchen has a bar and long dining table which sets the scene for you to have a cosey dinner. No need to say that our apartment is clean and properly taken care off.

Within one minute you'll bump into nice (food)shops, coffee corners and typical Amsterdam cafe's and within 5 minutes you'll be in the famous 'Vondelpark'.

Easy accessible: near the train/tram station 'Muiderpoort'

Located near the city centre (10 min by bike) in the lovely Indische buurt. Next to the Javastreet where you can find a lot of shops and cute bars/restaurants!

name: The New Lake - Boathouse
description:
Beautifully located houseboat.

Wake up in your own private studio with a unique view, open your curtains and enjoy the view of your own terrace doors by the water.
There are free parking places just 5 minutes away. In the weekends it's also possible to park your car for free in front of the boat.
Club Multipla recently opened around the corner, a nice place where you can have breakfast and lunch. On weekends it is open for dancing in the evenings, a fun experience!

name: Beautiful and spacious family house (220 m2)
description:
Very bright and luxurious 5-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam. There is a lovely garden (including trampoline!) and a big balcony as well.

If you are looking for a spacious place to stay, this house is definitely what you are looking for.

We have 3 children, so enough toys to play with if you come over with small children.

Public transport is nearby, where you can take a tube/metro to the city center (5 min) or to Schiphol airport (20 min) or to RAI congress center (3 min by metro). Or bike!!

description:
• Great location, in a safe quiet block but lively area
• Apartment on square with playground
• Good public transport
• 5 min. walk to bars, restaurants, shops, parks..
• 10 min. walk to city center, Ten Kate market, De Hallen etc..
• 5-15 min. tram/bike to Central Station or Sloterdijk Station, Dam, Museum Square, Vondelpark, Westerpark, Nightlife, Anna Frank, Red Light etc...

name: Bright Apartment in Rembrandtpark with Balcony
description:
Brand new!

If you're looking for a stylish apartment for two in Amsterdam, this beautiful home in the west side is the perfect choice. Ideally located right in front of Rembrandtpark and just minutes from the vibrant De Baarsjes area.

The apartment features a curated design, blending modern furniture and art with unique vintage touches, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

Enjoy fast and reliable internet, along with a sit-stand desk — perfect for working comfortably from home.

name: “Gezellig” home
description:
Reach in a few min’ walk:
- 5’ wallk (n.5 or 25) to Zuid station or Museum plein, Leidseplein, Jordan, Pijp and stops all the way to central station through centre (total time 30’)
- 15’ walk, Amsterdamse Bos or Amstel park and river and windmill.

- middle polder with its fauna
- Amstel river banks (gorgeous walk to Oudekerk and Amstellande area)

description: Welcome to our lovely home in the vibrant neighbourhood The Pijp! The apartment has a spacious open living plan downstairs, with a chef-worthy kitchen with balcony and a fireplace in the sitting area. Upstairs there is the master bedroom which has airconditioning, very nice on those hot summer days and very rare in Amsterdam! The other bedroom has a comfy double bed and some closet space. You have full acces to our private roof terrace with Big Green Egg BBQ. We hope you enjoy your stay here:)!

name: 2-Bedroom Apartment | The July - Twenty Eight
description: Nestled in the heart of leafy Amsterdam South, The July - Twenty Eight location takes it’s name from the Olympic Games hosted in the neighbourhood in 1928. An effortless mix of hotel style and service with the comforts of an apartment.

By law in Amsterdam we can Airbnb to max 4 ppl at the same time. Due to this legal reason, and whilst my home can comfortably host 6 persons, I will not rent it to more than 4 persons. Any big families requirements send me a message.

description:
Walking distance from the Museum District (15min), Vondelpark (5min), Leidseplein (13min). Lots of bars, restaurants, shops and public transportation around. The apartment itself is located on a quiet street (mind you: it has steep stairs).

Big windows, on both the south and north side, with a garden view. Ceiling with traditional ornaments. Decent kitchen. Big bed. Small bathroom, but omg look at those beautiful tiles.

Perfect for a couple.

25min to Airport by public transportation.

The Rijksmuseum, Vondelpark and Amsterdam Canals are around the corner. The apartment consists of a spacious living room with open kitchen, bedroom, office room, and bathroom with toilet. Feel welcome!

description:
Spacious three bedroom ground floor family apartment on a quiet square in Amsterdam. This is a light, newly renovated apartment that can easily host a family of four. The large downstairs living area offers an open plan area with living room, dining room and kitchen. The 1st floor has a bathroom, two bedrooms and a TV room.

The friendly local area has many supermarkets, shops, small bars, cafes and restaurants. We are close to the Vondelpark and a short tram or cycle ride from the canal area.

name: Guestroom/Familiy room on a houseboat, 3 persons
description:
This strikingly off-beat boat is probably the most photographed vessel on the Amstel River. Your hosts offer a nice guestroom, 1 double and 1 single bed, with a beautiful bathroom with tub and shower. At the end of the day you can escape the crowds and relax in the garden.
This guestroom is also a great place for (a) parent(s) with one or two kids!

Your host writes children’s books; she lives on this boat as well with her husband and 4 kids. They only rent out this space in spring and summer.

Swim directly from the sunny backyard in clean open water and enjoy the outdoor shower with warm water afterwards. The beach is just a 5-minute walk away, while Amsterdam Central Station is only 12 minutes away by tram 26.

Nice apartment with a lot of light, a well equipped kitchen and an office. Perfect for young families.

It is easily accessible from both Schiphol Airport (30 min by train) and Amsterdam Central Station (20 min by bus).

Luxury Apartment with Private Rooftop Terrace
