The ideal combination of being close to the city centre of Amsterdam and the tranquillity of living outside in a water-rich area. From the living room, you have access to a large and sunny garden. There is also a free private parking space, if requested.

Elegant duplex just 1 minute from the Amstel River in central Amsterdam.

50 m², ideal for up to 4 guests: open bedroom upstairs with a double bed, and a sofa bed for two in the downstairs living area.

Set in a lively neighborhood with cafés, bars, restaurants, and supermarkets nearby, while remaining quiet at night.

Metro close by, and the city center, museums, etc are just 7 minutes away by bike.

A stylish, romantic base to explore Amsterdam.

We offer our house to families and families who want to experience an unforgettable summer. Anyone who steps on the jetty immediately gets the holiday feeling.

Front and back garden, private (free) parking in front of house! Bike rental and supermarkets nearby.

Enjoy the many museums, shops, concerts, parks and many more beautiful things Amsterdam has to offer!

Whether you're here to relax or explore, this is the perfect place to experience the best of Amsterdam.

Bike rental (1 minute)
Restaurants (2 minutes)

description: This Cosy apartment is perfect for three guests. Close to the city center, nice restaurants within walking distance and much more! f you want to spend your Amsterdam city trip in the best way possible, then look no further. Located in a residential neighborhood, with public transport just around the corner, the old city center within a 10 minute ride. Lot's of great local stuff to do, eat and drink in the direct neighborhood, shops en supermarkets available and much more!

name: Entire Unit. Amsterdam Classic. Amazing Location.
description: Cozy and spacious, 3 rooms full of light and good vibes, suitable for couples, or friends travelling. Two balconies, one sunny in the morning one in the evening, comfortable space, very close to Vondelpark and centre.

name: Quiet Cozy Garden retreat
description: It is rare to find tranquility in the midst of a bustling, thriving neighbourhood. This private room in a modern 1930’s garden apartment offers just that, a clean & cozy hide away. A few minutes walk from the Vondelpark and Amsterdam’s trendy Oud-Zuid (Old South), it’s a cozy place to recharge after a vibrant day in Amsterdam.

name: Beautiful home-away-from-home with gardens!
description: This home is a lovely family house in a quiet residential area. It is mostly suitable for a family, as mainly families live around here. It has lovely private gardens, both in the back and in the front of the house, and is just an ideal place to get some rest after visiting all the lovely things Amsterdam has to offer. On top of this all, it is literally around the corner from the city beach, where you can relax and dine in style, with a beautifull view over the local pond.

name: Generator - Bed in 4 bed Dorm
description: Book a bed (or more) in our shared 4-Bed Dorm at Generator Amsterdam. This room features 2 bunks (4 beds) and a private bathroom, offering a comfortable stay for travelers. Each bunk is equipped with a light, personal shelf, USB charging station, and under-bed lockers. Pillow, duvet, and linen are included. Towels are available at reception for a small fee. Please note, this room is for guests aged 18 and over only. Perfect for those seeking a social yet comfortable experience.

name: Stunning Apartment in Central Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our home! It is a 75m2 bright and cosy apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. The perfect place to have the experience of an Amsterdam local!

The apartment is located in the heart of the lively neighbourhood 'The Pijp' in one of the most beautiful streets of Amsterdam: just between the Sarphatipark, the Amstel and the Canals

A lot of buzz and cool places to explore. And if you want to discover the historical centre, it’s just around the corner.

name: Beautiful house in the city centre of Amsterdam
description:
Beautiful (family) house in the city centre of Amsterdam. It's situated just around the corner of cultural hotspot 'De Hallen', Bellamy Square and “Ten Katemarkt”. In addition, from our house its walking distance to Museum Square, Leidse square and the Jordaan.

Our house is specious and modern. Downstairs there is a large kitchen (with canal-view) and living room. Upstairs there are 5 bedrooms.

We live here with our 4 kids, so it's is perfect for 4 adults or a family with kids.

name: Amsterdam Fairytales
description:
Cozy shared terraced house, located in a quiet neighborhood, surrounded with a tiny park and farm fields.

House has 3 floors and 3 bedrooms. Only 2 bedrooms are for rent.

Bedroom #1 - (Name: Bled): Spacious room on the 3rd floor with 160cm-wide double bed and contains working space and the Laundry.

Bedroom #2 - (Name: St. Petersburg): Smaller room on 2nd floor with a 140cm-wide double bed. (Only offered in case of more than 1 guest)

Third bedroom (Name: Barcelona) is for the host.

name: Tiny charming flat in Jordaan (Amsterdam center)
description:
Small (28m2) but charming 1 bedroom flat in the best neighborhood of Amsterdam.

Up a short staircase, you enter the bright living room with wooden floors, open kitchen, sofa and dining/work table. 3 large windows to the street. Small bedroom has afternoon sun, and looks to typical Amsterdam courtyard.

No TV or Internet, but the city is at your door. The flat is located on a charming street in the trendy and historic Jordaan area, one block from Anne Frank house

First time Airbnb.

name: groundfloor-apartment in quiet central cityparc
description:
Spacious, groundfloor apartment in a green parc right in centre of town. To be close to everything Amsterdam has to offer, and still have a quiet green space to live in, is unique in this city.
In a lovely and civilised neighbourhood/shops and cafés around the corner.
Public transport (tram / bus) to all museums, shopping areas and cafes, is close by. Some sights are at walking distance. Rembrandthouse, Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, Anne Frank house etc

name: Charming house with beautiful view / free parking
description: This unique dyke house (140 m2) is tasteful, light and has a fully equipped kitchen, dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, WiFi, shower. The huge garden at the back of the house, has a fantastic view over the meadow with cows, sheep, geese and the setting sun. From this quiet place you are in the heart of Amsterdam within 25 minutes. No smoking in the house. We also have 3 chickens living in our garden now (every day fresh eggs!) it would be great if you could feed them daily

name: Home away from home
description: This centrally located, luxuriously furnished apartment is the ideal place to relax after a day of sightseeing or working. It features a spacious kitchen that is equipped with all comforts and a bathroom with a wonderful bath. In the bedroom, you can create the ultimate home theater experience, and there is also a separate work corner to study or work in a concentrated manner. Comfort, relaxation and style come together here for an unforgettable stay.

name: Luxury house  with roofterrace by the canal
description:
Beautiful and spacious apartment by the canal with roof terrace overlooking the city.
The old West neighborhood of Amsterdam is currently the most attractive, happening area of the city. Cosy cafe's, a great variety of restaurants, The food Hallen are all situated a stone's throw away. Walking distance from the Jordaan, city center, Van Gogh-, Rijks- and Stedelijk Museum, Vondelpark, DeLaMar Theatre, PC Hooftstraat, Leidseplein etc etc.

name: Luxury Houseboat Prince-William
description:
Short stay!

This beautifully decorated houseboat is in a prime location near the Jordaan district, just minutes from the city center and "Noordermarkt."

The houseboat features 2 bedrooms, a living room with a sofa, flat-screen TV with cable, and free Wi-Fi. The bathroom has a bathtub/shower, with a separate toilet. The dining table offers canal views, and the kitchen includes a dishwasher, stove, microwave, oven, and fridge. A child cradle is available on request.

Suitable for up to 4 guest

name: Spacious apartment w/ garden close to Vondelpark
description:
Welcome to our lovely apartment (95m2 / 1022 sq.ft.) in De Baarsjes, one of Amsterdam's most hip, popular and upcoming neighbourhoods. By bike we are...

5 minutes to the Vondelpark & Rembrandtpark
5 minutes to 'de Hallen'
10 minutes to the canal district
10 minutes to the Museum square
(bike rental is 5 minutes walk)

Good to know: this is our home, in which we are very happy to live. It's not for rental only.

name: Room in the most hip & trendy area of Amsterdam
description:
Private single room with single/doble bed in the most hip and trendy neighborhood of Amsterdam. The apartment is located in the always bustling Amsterdam Pijp.

The neighborhood is well-know by the many restaurants, the numerous (food) cafes, a wide variety of (boutique) shops, lively nightlife and of course de Albert Cuyp market, where you go for fresh specialities. The famous river 'De Amstel' and also Sarphatipark are just a stone's throw away.

Tram, Metro and Train (Amstel Station).

name: Luxurious waterfront family apt with balcony &view
description: This brand new apartment (4th floor) overlooking the IJ is situated in the up and coming neighborhood the Houthavens. It's about 150 m2 and it has 3 bedrooms and a balcony with a stunning view. You can easily walk to the Westerpark (10 min) or the cosy area 'the Jordaan' which takes you about 10/15 min. You will be staying in a quiet neighborhood close to nice restaurants and supermarkets. Looking forward to welcoming you!

name: Apartment with canal view
description:
Modern apartment with canal view. 1 bedroom with double bed (1m40x2m10). Bathroom with shower and washing machine/dryer. Seperate toilet.
Modern kitchen. Balconies at the backside of the apartment (garden view)

name: Peaceful + spacious for plant lovers
description: Our home is located two metro stops (4 minutes) from central station and in one of the quietest parts of the hip Noord district. It is a spacious apartment with lots of natural light and a fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for young families, business travelers, couples who want a bit more peace & space. Lots of parks and shopping nearby, good food, independent cinema, etc.

name: beautiful ground floor apartment with garden.
description: If you love the historical roots of Amsterdam this is the ultimate destination to stay downtown. This  lovely spacious 120 square meters apartment is on the ground floor with a nice, large garden 130 square meters. Unique in Amsterdam. Located on the historical Realen Island, near by the cool streets of the Haarlemmerdijk, Jordaan and Westerpark. With nice restaurants, shops and bars on walking distance.

name: Ruim en licht appartement Amsterdam Zuid.
description: In this centrally located accommodation, everything for your family is within reach. Close to train station (Amsterdam Zuid) and tram stop Gerrit van der Veen. Comfortable and stylish home with unique roof terrace (all day sun) and two balconies.

name: The Classic Canal house Loft
description: Your window situated right on the Canal. Located in the very centre of classic canal district, 9 streets and Dam Square, designed with eye for detail, we offer a relaxing haven in the midst of the city centre. Sleek concrete floor, high ceilings, hotel bedding, sophisticated wine fridge, coffee maker and hotel soaps and linnen. 24/7 assistance. We are a quiet location in the heart of the city with respect for neighbours.

name: Appartment  in a canalhouse in central Amsterdam!
description: In the bright basement (with windows) of our unique canal house with façade-garden, on the corner of a canal and a square with large oak-trees you find this b&b wih lots of privacy, nice rooms and close to everywhere you would like to go! You enter the spacious entrance hall with table and coffee / tea supplies; with a private bathroom, separate toilet and a cozy bedroom / living room. Renovated with natural stone and wood. This house and this area are very photogenic.

name: Authentic Suite with Canal View in Heart of City
description:
Perfectly located along the UNESCO World Heritage Herengracht canal in Amsterdam’s City Center. The Historic Canal Suites will have you surrounded by the most iconic Amsterdam sights when you’re out and about in the neighborhood, and steeped in rich Dutch culture when you’re relaxing in this two-suite bed and breakfast built for luxury.
The building housing the Historic Canal Suites is an authentic piece of Dutch history, built in 1637 and painstakingly maintained.

name: Bed & Breakfast Zunderdorp, Studio 1
description: B&B Zunderdorp is a traditional Dutch Stolp farmhouse with 5 fully equipped studio's, each with a private kitchen and bathroom. Located on a working farm, surrounded by animals and peaceful meadows, yet within easy cycling distance of Amsterdam city centre. Your stay includes a complimentary breakfast, with the unique experience of collecting your own eggs from the chicken coop. Free on-site parking (rare around Amsterdam) and bicycle storage available. Ideal for families or a romantic getaway.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Cozy apartment with garden in East!
description: The apartment is located in one of the trendiest neighborhoods in Amsterdam. Within 1 minute walk of public transport and 5 minutes walk from all restaurants, bars, coffee shops and boutiques on the Javastraat. Amsterdam East has many parks, museums, the IJ brewery, the Dappermarkt and other sights such as Artis. This apartment is perfect for a romantic get away, in a quiet neighborhood where you can relax after a long day of sightseeing.

name: great big, beautiful apartment with roof terrace
description:
Our apartment is 100m2 and has 2 bedrooms, a big kitchen with a big dinner table and adjoining our living room with a great couch to relax and watch Netflix :). We have two balconies but best of all a great roof terrace where you can barbecue and enjoy the view of (a piece) of Amsterdam and enjoy your wine or eat your breakfast.
We live on the second floor and on the third floor live my son and daughter who can always help you with any questions you have

name: Home at the Park
description: This B&B is located on the ground floor of a characteristic and solid mansion built around 1900. It's located right at the Oosterpark with easy access to all Amsterdam has to offer. This family friendly B&B with rear yard has two floors with the private area containing 2 bedrooms, bathroom and separate toilet. Guests can use the game room with pool and football table and garden room with many boardgames. There is also a private outside seating area which is rare for Amsterdam.

name: Modern & Cozy ‘Hotel Style’ Studio
description:
Value for money, this place is among the best value for money places in the city!

- Great location; safe area and only 8 minutes by fast-tram to Central Station
- Attractive studio, fully furbished, includes all amenities
- Fully equipped kitchen, no need to go out for dinner
- Floor to ceiling windows for a bright & pleasant interior
- Fabulous views of the Amsterdam Skyline from your French Balcony
- Super clean and neat place
- Low cleaning fees

name: COSY HOME in Center of Amsterdam - Special Offer!
description:
Special offer for 6-12+ months stay!

Safe, quiet and private home. Large supermarkets, shops and restaurants next door.

Recently renovated!

name: Prinsengracht familyhouse with green garden
description: Staying in this stylish and cosy family house on the Prinsengracht will make sure you and your kids have a true experience of living in Amsterdam! The house is recently refurbished with original 17th century elements and is perfectly suitable for a couple with kids or families. It has a beautiful lush garden to relax and where the kids can play. The house has all facilities needed, including toys for the kids. Nice restaurants, playgrounds, coffee places and sightseeings are within 5min walk.

name: What a view! Beautiful Apartment with 2 bedroom
description:
+80m2 apartment - Recently renovated / amazing view.
2 comfortable double beds sleep 4 ppl.
15min from center (pt 5 minutes walking away)
15min from Schiphol (By taxi or train)
Street parking available for €20 a day
Metro, tram and train nearby
Fully equipped kitchen. (Dishwasher, oven, Nespresso, kettle etc.)
Fully equiped bathroom
Fast Wifi
Dedicated workspace
Large TV with Netflix
Balcony with two seats

Permit: Z/26/3100117

name: Historical sailing ship near city centre
description:
Sleep on a historical sailing ship! The interior is cozy and is perfect for couples and families.

The ship is located only 5 minutes from the Jordaan. The Jordaan is one of the oldest area's of the city which is lively and beautifull. Shops and restaurants are also within 3 minutes walk.

On board of the ship (the roof) you have plenty of space to sit in the sun and watch boats passing by.

Inside of the ship you have everything you need to have an amazing holiday!

name: Beautiful house in popular 'De Pijp' area
description:
Warm, family friendly home on a quiet street in De Pijp, close to Sarphatipark and the Albert Cuyp Market. The area is lively yet calm and great for families.

Bright living and dining room with open kitchen and fireplace, opening onto a private garden. Two living areas and desks give space for kids to play and parents to relax.

The house has three bedrooms, a separate playroom, a stylish bathroom and an extra half bath. Ideal for families seeking comfort, space and a true local stay.

name: Lovely cozy family home with garden
description:
We welcome families and couples to our comfortable home in Amsterdam Noord, set in a quiet green area near NDSM Wharf and Twiske nature reserve. The city center is just 15 minutes by bus or bike.

Bright living room and sunny south-facing garden. Upstairs are three bedrooms and a bathroom with bathtub.

NDSM’s restaurants and cultural hotspots are 10 minutes away. A free ferry connects you directly to Amsterdam Central Station. Buses run every 10 minutes, 300 metres from the house.

name: Jordaan apartment with roof terrace!
description: Enjoy a stay in our 3 bedroom Jordaan apt in the center of Amsterdam. Our luxery, yet authenic home comes with a roof terrace, city views and is ideal for young families or couples and located 2 minutes from Anne Frank House.

name: 5* Apartment including D.I.Y. breakfast
description:
The flat is located in the Bos & Lommer Area, close to the city center of Amsterdam on the top floor of a recently finished (2016) apartment block. Easy to reach by PT or car. It’s very spacious (70m2) and bright due to its high ceiling and huge windows in the bed- and living room. The Sloterplas is a walking distance and has a nice city beach for hot summer days.
I will provide welcome drinks and a do-it-yourself breakfast. Let me know your preferences after confirmation!

name: SWEETS hotel Kortjewantsbrug
description:
Eye-catching bridge tower with a mind-blowing 360-degree view of Amsterdam’s city centre and waterways. Just like the outside of the tower, the interior is round – even the bed! From this unique hotel room in Amsterdam Centre, perched high above the water, you can see how centuries of development made this city into the miraculous place it is now.

SWEETS hotel Kortjewantsbrug is an independent hotel room with double bed, bathroom, pantry and daily service. The city is your hotel lobby!

name: SWEETS hotel Hortusbrug
description: Stay in a three-dimensional Mondriaan painting on top of a canal! A true icon in the middle of Amsterdam Centre, perfect for lovers of architecture and design, located in between quaint 17th-century canal houses and Amsterdam’s historic botanical garden ‘Hortus Botanicus’. The white cubical structure with its black, blue and yellow details reminisces of De Stijl and the famous Dutch architect and designer Gerrit Rietveld. Free entrance to Hortus Botanicus included!

name: Spacious Room w Organic Bed (COCO-MAT) & Den
description: Bright private room on the third floor of a townhouse, with an organic Coco-Mat queen size bed (160cm x 200cm), a closet with mirror doors and air conditioning. In this room is also a small alcove with a desk, a chair and a book shelf. Guests have access to a shared bathroom with other airbnb guests (max 2) and to the laundry room/kitchenette with basic cooking appliances.

name: Garden view Studio in family home
description: This beautiful studio with garden view in a family home is a peaceful place just 15 minutes away from the busy city center. The entrance to the house is communal, we live on the top floors, but the studio has its own entrance from the hallway and has private access to the garden with view on and entrance to a canal. The studio has a kitchen with basic cooking equipment (microwave, hot plates, pans, coffeemaker etc), shower, toilet and seating area to make your stay as convenient as possible.

name: Loft Jordaan 1620, with private entry
description:
Amazing loft in the heart of Amsterdam. 17th century townhouse, with private entry to the attic where you stay in a spacious room with double bed, sitting area and bathroom en-suite.
You will be in the heart of the Jordaan, walking distance to Anne Frank House, Dam Square, the nine streets, many canals and much more.
Discover some hidden gems in the Jordaan (hofjes) and enjoy the markets on Saturday and Monday.
Please think when packing, it's a historic building with traditional steep stairs!

name: Spacious, luxury house  in The Old West area.
description:
Beautiful and spacious apartment by the canal with roof terrace overlooking the city.
The old West neighborhood of Amsterdam is currently the most attractive, happening area of the city. Cosy cafe's, a great variety of restaurants, The food Hallen are all situated a stone's throw away. Walking distance from the Jordaan, city center, Van Gogh-, Rijks- and Stedelijk Museum, DeLaMar Theatre, PC Hooftstraat, Leidseplein etc etc.

name: Cosy apartment in Amstedam Noord
description: This lovely apartment in amstedam noord is completely new. It has one bedroom with queen bed, one big bathroom and a really bright open space with living room and kitchen. The best is the balcony facing south, so you can be sure to enjoy the evening sun.

name: Room in a very peaceful part of Amsterdam.
description:
Please take in account this is a residential neighbourhood, so I would like to ask not to make too much noise after 22.00-22.30.

Only access to room and shared Toilet and badroom.

Cooking not allowed by Amsterdam municipalty rules for BnB/B&B. Microwafe available.

name: Cozy two-room apartment in quiet, green area
description: Nice cozy apartment in green, quiet area. Ideal when traveling alone or in  a couple.

name: Great view at the Amstel
description:
Places to eat or drink:
Next to the house on the right side is Cafe Vrijdag for drinks, breakfast to dinner
Across the street at weesperzijde there are many bars and restaurants. Riva (French) Dauphine (French with jazz night every Friday), Girasol (Portuguese lunch, dinner or drinks) Hesp (drinks and bar food)
In the wibautstraat there are many options, underdog or volkshotel (with rooftop), bagel&beans and volkoren are cool places
Supermarket and bakery are very nearby.

name: Cozy appartement Amsterdam Sloterdijk
description: Nice, cozy and clean appartement in Amsterdam West. Close To public transport. You can be in the city centre in less than half an hour. Supermarket (Lidl) is very closeby and the people in the neighborhood are friendly. There is also a shoppingmall about 10 minutes walking from the appartement. The tram to the museum square is also closeby

name: Luxe huis met grote tuin in het centrum
description:
LUXURY APARTMENT WITH SPACIOUS ROOM | 2 BEDROOMS | COMPLETELY RENOVATED | TURNKEY FURNISHED | AMSTERDAM WEST

Equipped with designer furniture, a great garden with sun and 2 large bedrooms. The architect has chosen a bohemian & Mediterranean style.

name: RoomWest Cosy with ensuite bathroom
description:
Compact double bedroom with ensuite bathroom, mini-fridge, television and desk in Amsterdam Oud-West.

Looking for a bigger room? check our second room: RoomWest Double

name: Apartment near Westerpark, Smokers Friendly
description:
You can enjoy all kinds of activities from this ideally located accommodation. Westerpark is a huge park with many fun things to do, such as a walk to a cinema, good food and going out is also all possible.
In a fairly quiet neighborhood you are fully equipped, several supermarkets and eateries are nearby.

name: RoomWest Double with ensuite bathroom
description:
Bedroom with ensuite bathroom, mini-fridge, television and desk in Amsterdam Oud-West.

Looking for a more budget friendly option? check our second room: RoomWest Cosy

name: Spacious appartment in popular east
description: Nice, clean and cozy appartment (spacious livingroom, kitchen, balcony, bedroom) in the popular east of Amsterdam. 10 minutes walk to the local market at Dapperstraat. Public transportation options nearby. Bike rental around the corner. 15 minutes by bike to Dame Square, city centre, central station. Everything you need in walking distance. This appartment is only for a maximum of 3 persons. There is a double bed in the bedroom. There is an option to unfold a 3rd bed in the living room.

name: Kindvriendelijk huis met privé tuin
description:
Lovely spacious house with a green garden! The house offers both indoors and outdoors THE perfect place to visit Amsterdam and still be close to nature. The house is located in a quiet, child-friendly neighborhood.

It is ideally suited for a family or 2 couples who want the space and do not want to sleep in the hustle and bustle of the city. Within 15 minutes of cycling, you are at Amsterdam CS, and within 5 minutes you are in nature.

Private parking space, ideal if you come by car.

name: City Centre Apt | Modernised | Family Friendly!
description:
We rent out a private apartment with your own entrance, situated in the souterrain (-1) of our building. Main guest booking must be age 21 +. Location is very close to the Vondelpark which is ideal for families or if you want to take a morning walk/run.
Main Features:
* City centre location just 5 minutes walk from the museum district
* Fully equipped kitchen & modern bathroom
* Two SwissSense beds can be setup in doubles or singles.
* WIFI, cable connection & SMART tv.

name: Stylish ‘North’ house with garden, free P (+cat)
Cozy 2 bedroom family home (children friendly)
description: Relax  with the whole family at this stylish place in Amsterdam.  The home is new and if fully equipped with everything you could possibly need for a fantastic vacation. This home is three stories, heated floors, a beautiful garden and airconditioned bedrooms. The free standing bathtub has views of the lake. The house is 100 meters walking distance from a city beach perfect for swimming in the summer.  You will have glass fiber WIFI. We will make your stay one to remember.

name: Familyhouse Amsterdam near centre with lakeview
description:
You can find our very nice familyhome in one of the most beautiful areas of Amsterdam. In front of our house you will find a beautiful city lake, park and a little beach which is absolutely great in summer! The tram stops around the corner and takes you to the city centre within only 15 minutes. We live in a child friendly neighbourhood with a lots of activities you can undertake.

Haarlem and Zandvoort are very close and easily reachable with public transport.

name: 2BR Cosy Family apartment + Private Garden
description:
Feel at home in this cosy and stylishly decorated apartment in a quiet, trendy neighbourhood, 20 minutes by tram from the center of Amsterdam.

Great restaurants, three nice parks and plenty of shops just around the corner.

Two bedrooms, fully equipped kitchen, dining area, lounge, a piano, a garden.... This house will be your perfect base to start exploring Amsterdam.

All amenities are included. All you need to bring is your suitcase!

The apartment is suited for families with 12+ kids.

name: Spacious apartment with private garden
description: Very spacious apartment in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid with private garden, facing south-west.

name: Popular 2 bedroom accommodation on great location
description: Great 2 bedroom accommodation on quiet Cornelis Drebbelstraat is located right in the most beautiful neighborhood called the Watergraafsmeer, where many city hotspots can be found within walking distance and/or public transport! This accommodation is specially fitted for 2 people that like space and privacy. Next to the bedrooms there is 1 bathroom & separate toilet. There are no cooking facilities. A Nespresso coffee machine, tea facilities and refrigerator are at your disposal.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Scandinivian design house across Amsterdam Canal
description: Charming house on the canal in Amsterdam. Close to the Anne Frank House, one of the most famous cultural institutions and next to the organic food market. Nearby are countless small restaurants and shops. Nevertheless, the house is quiet and easy to reach.

name: 1-Bedroom Apartment | The July - Boat & Co
description: Whether dipping into Amsterdam for 24 hours or relocating for a month or longer, at The July - Boat & Co we seamlessly blend short and long stays. We’re a calm city hideout, with a view of the water and the city center just a pedal away.

name: Miriam's Suite Amsterdam - private rooftop studio
description: Completely private rooftop suite, with a private entrance on the 4th floor of a typical old Amsterdam building. 28 M2 studio after a complete renovation. As you can see in the photos, you will have a nice and spacious modern space with a double bed, sitting area including sofa which can be opened to a bed, bathroom + WC. Cooking is not possible (no stove) but there is a nice mini-kitchen with a coffee machine, a fridge and other facilities. AC and heating available.

name: Exclusive Diamond Watervilla Opposite Hotel Amrâth
description:
An exclusive private stay on an luxurious houseboat in the top center of Amsterdam, offering a refined sense of calm and space that is rarely found in central locations.

Diamond 2-floor watervilla is designed for comfort and atmosphere, with a generous layout with a stylish living area, a fully equipped kitchen, 2 separate sleeping spaces, a high end bathroom and uninterrupted views. Natural light, openness and thoughtful details create a setting that feels both luxurious and relaxed.

name: Beautiful canal apartment in Amsterdam East
description: This is a cozy above ground floor apartment next to the Amsterdam zoo, in a very green area. My apartment is located in front of a canal and has minimal traffic noise. It is walking distance to the city centre and has numerous places close by to visit and have great food and drinks!

name: The ultimate suite at Prinsenboat.
description:
We offer a suite on board a house boat in the central canal district In Amsterdam. The suite is 45 square meters in a newly build boat; completely safe. No gas on board. Every attraction is within walkable distance. The most stunning view of the canal. Boats will pass by. You will be the queen and king of Amsterdam.
The suite is designed for a couple or a small family. Max 4 adults.

The houseboat studio is very nice and the location is super. It is the ultimate way to enjoy the best of Amsterdam on the water.

name: Amazing and modern city centre apartment
description: Very Stylish 2 bedroom apartment two tram stops away from Amsterdam Central station in the amazing area of Amsterdam Docklands - Cafe's and restaurants around the corner! This area has it all - only three stops by tram to central station and six stops to the center of Amsterdam yet a very quiet modern apartment that allows you to get the best out of your Amsterdam trip.

name: Studio in City Centre w priv. bathroom  ♥
description:
Private room with priv. bathroom

Located in the beautiful city centre of Amsterdam in an historic building, right in between the canals.

This is a room with an entrance to the street (Completely privacy), located perfectly between the touristic sight and nice neighbourhoods.

Moreover, the North-South subway line is a 2min walk which brings you to the north part (newest spots) or south part of Amsterdam (Bus. district).

City Centre 0 min
De Pijp 5min
Jordaan 10min

No kitchen/cooking

name: Morpheus b&b - Room: Mirror
description:
Located 6.1 km from Vondelpark, Morpheus offers a garden, and air-conditioned accommodation with a balcony and free WiFi. The property features garden and inner courtyard views, and is 6.9 km from Van Gogh Museum. Featuring a private entrance, the bed and breakfast allows guests to maintain their privacy.

Schiphol Airport is 3 km from the property.

Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.1 for a two-person trip.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Luxurious 78m² apartment with large terras
description:
Luxurious living area with plenty of windows looking out over the square. Livingroom includes a large corner sofa, electric fireplace, chesterfield desk, ambilight Smart TV with Netflix (Smart TV also in bedroom), wifi connected soundbar and a telescope to spy on the neighbors ;).

Next to the living room is a large 10m² terras.

Very close to the bus and trams (300 meter walk) that take you straight to the center in 15 mins. Also 10 min walk to the train station. 5 minute walk to park.

name: 2HouseboatSuites | Floating Boutique Prinsengracht
description:
Stop searching, you’ve found one of Amsterdam’s most unique stays. Enjoy your own private suite on a newly built houseboat, floating on the iconic Prinsengracht in the heart of the Jordaan.
Each suite has its own private entrance, en-suite bathroom and everything needed for a peaceful stay. The only shared area is the hallway, all other spaces are completely private.
Wake up on the canals, watch boats drift by your window, experience Amsterdam from the water in a way you’ll never forget.

name: City Centre Amsterdam Queen Apartment > 70m3
description: The rooms are very modern and beautifully decorated.

name: City Center Amsterdam Luxe King Apartment > 80 m3
description: Modern, bright apartment with kitchen, living room and 2 bedrooms in the heart of Amsterdam

name: 2 Bedroom Guestsuite in Amsterdam City Centre
description:
Great for families, couples & friends, this comfortable 2 bedroom accommodation with private entrance is perfect to explore Amsterdam's centre by foot.

Enjoy 2 light bedrooms with comfortable beds and a clean bathroom with fresh towels, a fully equipped kitchen with snacks, coffee & tea and everything else you need for a comfy stay!

Within walking distance (10-20 mins) from tourist sites such as the Canals, Anne Frank House, the famous '9 straatjes', Dam, Leidseplein and the Museum District.

name: Quiet room in a clean and cosy apartment
description:
Private room in a beautiful shared apartment The apartment has all necessities and located in a calm residential area. Vondelpark is just a few minutes walk away and close by you have multiple restaurants, cafes, and grocery stores. Take the tram to and from the apartment which takes around 10 minutes to popular areas as museum-plein. Note that the kitchen and bathroom are shared with the host.

Weed not allowed in/around the property!

Looking forward to hosting you!

name: True Unique Amsterdam Appartement - City Centre
description: Unique and true "Amsterdam" appartement in which I usually live myself, but I'll be on holidays. Super cosy atmosphere and right in the very centre, 5 minute walk from the Central Station.

name: Spazio Arte 2 Rooms max. 4 persons
description: The 2 rooms are on the same floor of the apartment, accessible by stairs, where the bathroom and toilet are. These are only used by you. No other guests will be booked in the apartment during your stay. So the entire floor is yours. Both rooms can be locked and guests receive 2 pairs of keys. We are about 25 min. away from the Amsterdam city centre, and the apartment is easy to achieve by Underground (10 min 2 stops) from the central station. The Underground is on 5 min walking from the house.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: B&B Houseboat Amsterdam | Privé Sauna & small boat
description:
The perfect romantic getaway for two, relax & enjoy the private sauna and home cinema. Options for Champagnes, rose leaves, chocolate and bites.

Some call it 'the loveboat'

(some go for the ultimate relaxation with their best friend)

You'll stay on a recently renovated former cargovessel with a private mooring at the IJmeer of Amsterdam! Wanna go out? It's less than 15 minutes to central station by tram, it runs every six minutes and goes till 00.30

A breakfast package included

name: Cozy design house at ground floor with garden
description:
Welcome in my tiny house! 40m2 but all the space you need for a pleasant stay in beautiful Amsterdam. In 2018 I (@roossneek) bought this house and renovated it together with my father. With a lot of love and joy I was able to make it the way I want it to be. I have even been featured in a magazine.
With a bathroom en-suite and a spacious living room with kitchen it has all the luxury you need. Bus and tram stop are in front of the door and take you to the city centre within 10min — A la Roos

name: Sophisticated apartment in the heart of Amsterdam!
description: Welcome to this cozy, spacious apartment filled with natural light, offering a clean, organized, and comfortable stay—ideal for families and friends. Located in the heart of Amsterdam, it’s just a short walk to top attractions like the Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, Dam Square, and Vondelpark. Bars, restaurants, and nightlife are also nearby. Whether you’re here to explore or relax, this apartment is your perfect base for enjoying Amsterdam.

name: Family house 150m2, right at the park in de Pijp
description:
Beautiful, recently fully renovated family house of 150m2 at the park. High ceilings, wooden floors, a fire place next to the dining table, and a spacious garden- all in the bustling area of the Pijp.

A very light two story house with a large livingroom and well equipped kitchen. In the souterrain (with high ceilings:)) we have three bedrooms and a nicely sized bathroom (with shower and bath).

name: Compfy tiny house apartment
description: Cozy little apartment in a quiet& vibrant neighbourhood. We are renting longterm to ideally one person. The studio has a comfortable double bed. Private bathroom and toilet. The place is fully equipped. There is a washing machine, stove, hood, microwave and oven in one. A big supermarket, night shop, restaurants, lunchrooms, bike rentals, bus and tramstops etc are just around the corner one minute walk from us. You walk in 30 min to the hart of the city centre; 15 min walk to the central canals.

name: City Center Amsterdam Maxima Penthouse  >110 m3
description: nice brightly decorated apartment

name: Spacious apartment with private garden
description:
The apartment is beautiful, spacious (100m2) and very light. It is situated on the groundfloor with a big living room and a bed- and bathroom on the first floor. Furthermore, it has a private garden facing south and all is recently renovated.

It is located in a very quiet street in a very popular neigbhourhood (de Pijp)!

Should you want to bring your baby, please let us know so we can arrange for a baby bed

name: New studio near Vondelpark, private entrance
description: In the popular Old-West area, close to the famous Vondelpark and Leidse square, is our beautiful and cozy studio situated. It's newly renovated, with a beautiful bathroom with rain shower, kitchenette with Nespresso machine and dishwasher, a comfortable double bed with luxurious linnen and your own private entrance. Perfect for a getaway to Amsterdam! We became superhosts with our other studio, with almost 200 5 star reviews. We used all our hosting experience for renovating this new space.

name: NEW! LUXURIOUS APPARTMENT 4 p. + ROOFTERRACE
description:
Modern, luxurious newly renovated appartment with balcony and roofterrace. Located in the Rivierenbuurt (10 minutes walk from the Amstel station) for 4 persons! We are two Dutch sisters that love to give you a warm and welcome stay. Any questions or remarks are more than welcome.

We welcome every one around the world: any gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, culture, ordinary people, extraordinary people, and everyone in between.

name: Studio Ultra1 (smoker friendly) in heart of center
description: Smoker friendly (but you won't smell smoke from the previous guests due to crossing windows). Loft (29m2): living, bedroom (send us your choice: double or twin beds), bathroom, kitchenette with basic amenities, fridge, toaster, coffeemaker, kettle (no stove/micro). Lots of young art, 1st floor by steep stairs, lively noisy street. Historic monument in the middle of the center, all attractions around. For 2 persons only (no other guests allowed!). Not suitable for nit-pickers. Do not make noise!

name: Big 3 floor family home, close to the city center
description: Big and comfortable 3 floor family home in a quiet and kids friendly neighborhood in Amsterdam Noord. Spacious, quiet and luxurious house compared to city apartments, with free parking and a cosy garden.  Only 15 minutes travel to the city center by public transport, and a 15 minute walk to the famous NDSM wharf, with free ferries to the city center. We only rent to families, with a max of 2 adults and 2 kids. We have 1 queen size double bed (2 adults) 1 bed 80x160, 1 couch sofa (for kids)

name: Beautiful bright modern flat close to Rai centre
description: Modern bright spacious apartment , at 7th floor with view , very spacious living room and nice balcony with view to Canal , 2 big bed room and very close 7 min walk to Amsterdam zuid station , train , tram metro to center (12 min) and other cities , direct train to airport and nice restaurants , super market , gyms in neighbor hood

name: 45m2 apartment in historic citycenter (free bikes)
description: Stay in a unique 45m² lower ground studio apartment in a historic canal house. Located in a quiet, charming area in the heart of Amsterdam, just a 15-minute walk from Dam Square. A short stroll takes you to the lively Jordaan, full of local character, boutique shops, and top-quality cafés, bars, and restaurants. Hop on our free bikes to explore the city further. Central yet peaceful – the ideal base for your Amsterdam stay. Book now!

name: Old cargo vessel reborn into a modern light studio
description: Solitude in the centre of Amsterdam! Water and nature, sun and waves. A stilled spot only 15 minutes from the  the centre of Amsterdam by tram! A place to contemplate and bring your mind at peace with the rocking of the boat, subject to the ever changing seasons! In the summer a perfect place swim, in the winter to stare over the water and watch the birds fishing. Thinking how to spend a beautiful time in Amsterdam!

name: Apartment with terrace near The Foodhallen
description: This is an authentic lived-in Amsterdam home. A 3rd/4th floor apartment located half a block from the Foodhallen and its popular street market. It’s very central yet very quiet (The street is a dead-end for traffic). Public transport and all sorts of handy shops are 2 min away. The neighborhood has dozens of bars/cafes, restaurants, design shops, coffee spots, etc. You can walk to the canal ring (10min), to Vondelpark (12min). Follow me @amsterdam_homestay for more neighborhood tips.

name: Westerpark home
description:
The Westerpark - Amsterdam Apartement

Enjoy Amsterdam in this great city centre apartment! When you are looking for a spot close to the centre of Amsterdam and next to the Westerpark, than do not look any further! Bus 22 from CS brings you to our street incl. restaurants and bars! Additionally, there is a cinema in the park and there are great bar-restaurant. The apartment offers you a spacious place with a modern bathroom, 1 bedroom and living area with open kitchen. You'll have a great stay!

name: Amsterdam North apartment near durgerdam
description:
Welcome to our bright and spacious apartment in Amsterdam North! Located on the 2nd and 3rd floor, with a beautiful roof terrace with a corner sofa and picnic table, this is the perfect place for your next stay in Amsterdam.

The neighborhood in which our apartment is located is modern, yet there are picturesque streets and areas within walking distance, such as Durgerdam and Schellingwoude. It's the perfect starting point to explore Amsterdam while enjoying a peaceful environment.

name: ★COSY STUDIO FOR 2 IN THE JORDAAN ★ CANALS ★ VIEW★
description:
This small & Cosy studio offers all amenities you need for a great stay in Amsterdam! It's located in the heart of the famous Jordaan district, in the old city center and within the most beautiful area of the canal belt. A great pleace for everyone who loves to experience the local vibes.

Close to several outside markets, grocery stores, great restaurants & bars.

Located within walking distance of all major sights in Amsterdam. Honestly the best location possible for discovering Amsterdam!

name: Modern Downtown Two-Story Appartment
description: Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space.

name: B&B Mondriaan
description: This charming accommodation has a stylish decor. New building, it looks more like a studio than a room
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Gorgeous and stylish place for two in hip west!
description:
**SMOKING IS NOT ALLOWED**

When you are looking for a great place to stay in a great neighborhood, do not look any further!
Sleeping up to 2 guests in stylish surroundings, this fantastic holiday home makes the perfect choice for your stay in Amsterdam!

name: “ Oak Room” Canal View - Straight Tree Residence
description:
Welcome to my gorgeous getaway, a haven of peace within the vibrating heart of the city centre of Amsterdam!

Feel at home in this cosy and beautiful getaway with canal view, including queen size bed, mini fridge and brand new bathroom. The entire house has been newly renovated.

After a long day of walking, watch some Netflix on the Smart TV, or enjoy a drink surrounded by the beautiful canal houses from the bench in front outside of the house.

Looking forward to welcome you!

name: Cute apartment near city center
description: This special place is located in a lively neighborhood with nice bars and restaurants, it’s close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit. This is a 25sqm one-bedroom apartment of my own, my belongings will be there.

name: "Bamboo Room" - Straight Tree Residence
description:

After a long day of walking, watch some Netflix on the Smart TV, or enjoy a drink surrounded by the beautiful canal houses from the bench in front outside of the house.

Looking forward to welcome you!

name: Bright stylish home in city centre - 160m2
description:
The apartment consists of three levels. Your enter through a charming private hallway.

The ground floor has two spacious bedrooms, a babyroom, a bathroom and a seperate toilet. One of the bedrooms has a kingsize double bed and the other bedroom has a bunkbed for two adults or three children.

The living room, kitchen and balcony are on the first floor, which also has a toilet. The basement includes a bathroom with a shower and toilet and good washing and drying machine .

name: Stylish & Cozy Central Appartm.
description:
Experience comfort in this quiet, centrally located apartment in Amsterdam. The bright, cozy space is perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring.

The city center is a 15-minute walk, and all necessities (supermarket, public transport, restaurants, bars, park) are within 5 minutes.

Features:
5 min. walk from the Jordaan
20-minute walk from Vondelpark or Westerpark
Kitchen including dishwasher and oven/microwave
Washer/dryer
Nespresso machine
Fast Wi-Fi
Smart TV with Chromecast
Separate workspace

name: Spacious family house - high ceilings - lake view
description: Modern and luxurious family house (150 m2), 3 floors, small garden and stunning roof terras (30 m2) - 3 bedrooms, modern bathroom and parking garage included. The house is spacious with plenty of natural light and spectacular views of the lake. Children can play in the attached jointly garden. The house is surrounded by  a parc and water with outdoor swimming in front of the house! It's very well located, the shopping center is 2 min walking distance and also the tram to city center (15 min).

name: Master bedroom in new designer duplex luxury loft
description: Private master bedroom in new luxurious loft/duplex apartment with huge vide and amazing views over the skyline of Amsterdam. Your bed will be very comfy and is made by top brand Auping. In your bedroom you will find a bottle of water and amenities upon arrival. A Philips HD 47 inch flatscreen is there to indulge you with some Netflix or other entertainment. Fresh linnen and lovely pillows to dream away after a lovely day and night on the town.

name: Historic garage loft with private garden
description: In the heart of The Pijp district and only 5 minutes from museum square. The entire apartment of 92 square meter is completely renovated and has a modern and stylish interior and nice cosy garden for a drink. The apartment is located in a quiet street with the bedroom in the back of the apartment for a good night sleep. Further more a a separate tv room and office are to relax or work. Feel free to reach out for any questions.

name: Private Vacation Apartment #8 in ArtHotel by metro
description: Conveniently located 50m away from the metro, our colorful ApartmentHotel is set in a thriving creative community just on the outskirts of the city. Within biking distance to several beautiful parks and a quick metro ride into the downtown area, our location makes it easy to take advantage of all the cool things our vibrant city has to offer, whether it's art, nature, history, or nightlife!

name: Waterfront villa · 4BR · private garden · parking
description:
Four bedrooms, a fireplace and a private dock on the IJmeer: detached villa in Amsterdam IJburg with park view and beach 5 min away.

Ground floor: open kitchen with island and wine fridge, dining and lounge area with fireplace and water view.

1st floor: master bedroom with en-suite bathroom (bath + shower), separate toilet and laundry room.

2nd floor: three bedrooms each with 2 beds, second bathroom and separate toilet.

Max 8 guests. Private parking with EV charging; city centre 15 min away.

name: Apartment w/ garden & duo-bath
description: Kick back and relax in this calm and stylish apartment space. Completely renovated in 2019, with new bathroom, kitchen and floor heating. Making it cozy but spacious. Situated in a quiet street just outside of the city center. 5 minutes walk from Westerpark,  Haarlemmerplein and the Jordaan.

name: Houseboat on the AmstelRiver
description: I'm excited to tell you about my boat, Maria! She's a beautiful transport boat from 1911 that's now docked on the east side of the Amstel River. The houseboat is 164 m² in total, with 47 m² set aside just for you. Living on a houseboat is such a unique and exciting experience, giving you the chance to live like a local and truly immerse yourself in the city. I highly recommend giving it a try!

name: Family friendly apartment in nice & green area
description:
Only suitable for a couple or a family!

Beautiful modern comfortable family apartment with garden in Watergraafsmeer/ East Amsterdam; a very nice residential neighborhood. The house is light, 80m2, modern design (fully refurbished in 2019) and is fully equipped for a familiy with 2/3 children or a couple.

We love to live in this (green) and quite part of Amsterdam; you'll find restaurants, bakeries, a supermarket, flower stall etc. around the corner.

Free and fast Wifi

name: ★ NEW ★ LUXURIOUS ★ GROUND FLOOR ★ CITY CENTER ★
description:
My open-planned apartment is an oasis of calmth in the busy city center of Amsterdam. The huge open space provides everything you need on a daily basis.

There is a cozy and stylish sitting-area where you can relax. A very big dining table, A modern and new fully equipped open kitchen/ cooking-island.

The sleeping area has a super comfortable big 2-persons King bed.

You 'll certainly have an amazing stay in this apartment & wonderfull neighborhood....

name: Leidse Square 5 star Luxury-apartment
description: Our lovely monumental 5 stories house originates from 1887 and is situated in the middle of the centre of Amsterdam, near Leidsesquare. Luxury Apartment has just been renovated, you will experience excellent quality, love and eye for detail. The apartment is very suitable for families with children or business guests, as it's spacious with a lot of privacy.

name: Comfortable apartment in Amsterdam West
description: Comfortable apartment in a lively neighborhood close to the center. The apartment is located in a quiet street close to public transport. It has all you need for a wonderful stay.

name: Beautiful appartment next to Vondelpark
description:
Warm, spacious, cozy, freshly renovated appartment. There are two bedrooms and the kitchen and livingroom is one open space.

The location is ideal. On every corner there is a restaurant or bar and the appartment is on walking distance from Vondelpark. You can walk to the center, but it is still in a quiet area. The appartment has a view over a big canal.

name: Townhouse close to citycenter
description: My home suits only couples

name: Cosy appartment, in quiet Amsterdam neighborhood
description: The "Baarsjes" area is the place to be! Upcoming, hip with lots of great restaurants & bars. Will leave enough tips for the perfect visit to Amsterdam

name: The Blom
description: Guest accommodation in a monumental building on a quiet canal in the heart of Amsterdam (Jordaan), just around the corner from Anne Frank's Secret Annex and the Westerkerk, overlooking the Bloemgracht. Everything is nearby to enjoy!
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: SWEETS hotel Willemsbrug
description:
A charming former bridge house from 1928 with a panoramic view, located in between Amsterdam's city centre, the Jordaan area and the culture-friendly Westerpark. Stay in your own little house in Amsterdam and feel like being a part of the city!

Bridge house Willemsbrug is located at just a stone's throw away from many of Amsterdam's must-sees. Central Station is only 9 minutes by bus and 20 minutes on foot.

name: Bed&Bloom 99
description: Guest accommodation in a monumental building on a quiet canal in the heart of Amsterdam (Jordaan), just around the corner from Anne Frank's Secret Annex and the Westerkerk, overlooking the Bloemgracht. Everything is nearby to enjoy.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Entire Private Apartment Amsterdam
description: Hassle free on a holiday :-) We made your stay like you were at home. We have thought of everything. If you miss something while your stay we take action at once to make your stay even greater it already is :-) Friendly, very neat and clean, and wants to make our guest feel both at home and on vacation. Everything you need will be here! Excessive quality guarantees!-Excellent quality beds (also separate beds on request).

name: Luxury family house with garden next to Vondelpark
description:
This family-friendly house is located next to Vondelpark and close to the city center of Amsterdam. Many museums, bars and restaurants are nearby. The center is easily accessible via public transport (tram 1, 2, 17, bus 15). There is a playground right next to the house.
As this is our cherished family home, we love sharing it with guests a few times a year. We hope you enjoy it as much as we do!

name: Cozy room in De Pijp
description: Cozy room in De Pijp, in a ground floor. The apartment is shared with another person. Please note; we don't charge clean fee because we expect that you keep it clean and tidy. There is a dishwasher machine and also you can clean the dishes manually, so please don't accumulated them.

name: Sweets hotel - IJdoornlaanbrug
description: A comfortable former bridge house from 1975 with a panoramic view of an old Dutch windmill along a canal, located perfectly between the historic towns of North Holland and the lively city centre of Amsterdam. Nearby, in IJdoornlaanbrug's neighbourhood of Amsterdam Noord, you'll find the most popular alternative hotspots loved by locals. Bridge house IJdoornlaanbrug is only a few minutes by foot from metro station 'Noord', from where you'll be at Amsterdam Central Station in only 8 minutes.

name: Amsterdam Blossom Houseboat
description: Docked only a few minutes from Amsterdam Central Station, newly renovated and designed under architecture: that's the Amsterdam Blossom. You will be sleeping in the hull of a historical freight ship, in a bed that is basically a throne. The houseboat studio offers lots of space and light getting in via the many stylish portholes. And the location could not be better: close to the buzzing city centre, yet you are assured to enjoy a good night rest since our harbor is peaceful.

name: Peaceful home in a central Amsterdam neighborhood
description: One metro station [10 min bike ride] to the center of Amsterdam, three stations to the Museumplein while enjoying a very quiet peaceful piece of the city. NoorderPark, cafe de Ceuvel, top restaurants Cafe Modern, Pompet, local brewery Oedipus and the city forest Vliegenbos, all walking distance. The nature reserve Landsmeer with a bike 18minutes. Perfect for young families, couples, business travelers.

name: Beautiful home for design lovers
description:
This beautiful large dike house is located in a unique location on the Wilmkebreekpolder in Amsterdam. A special piece of nature in the city. You can enjoy the peace and space here, but you can also go to bustling Amsterdam, as the city center is just around the corner.

In 20 minutes, you can reach Central Station by bus and metro. NDSM is only 10 minutes away by bicycle. There are also many nice festivals, restaurants, etc. From NDSM, there is a free ferry to Central Station and the Houthavens.

name: Modern home in Amsterdam East
description: Welcome to our spacious, light-filled apartment on Eerste Atjehstraat in Amsterdam! Recently renovated, it offers modern comfort with classic charm. Enjoy the open-plan living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a serene private garden—a rare find in the city. Located in a vibrant neighborhood, you're close to cafes, shops, and easy transport links. Perfect for a relaxing stay, whether you're here for business or leisure.

name: Living the dream at houseboat Lazy Luscious
description: Welcome to houseboat Lazy Luscious, or in Dutch, "Luilekkerland", named after the old fairy tale. This barge, built in 1912, once used for transportation of goods, is now a place to live, love and create. Located very central yet in a quiet and non-touristy area, you get the best of both worlds; the vibrant city life as well as a place to give you peace of mind while having many luxuries at hand. With this vision we renovated the boat in 2019 and we are honored to share it with you!

name: Modern family home in Amsterdam NDSM
description: Family home with spacious garden near NDSM (cafes and restaurants), ferries, subway and busses. Quiet residential area with families, neighbourhood full of playgrounds and a big supermarket around the corner. 5 minute busride to subway to city centre, 10 min walk to ferry to take you to central station and westerpark. Nearby Twiske, nature recreational park where you can bike, swim and sail.  We only rent out to families or couples.

name: Renovated luxurious 200 SQM loft in city center
description: Experience unmatched elegance in this 200 m² double ground-floor gem along Amsterdam’s iconic ‘Singel.’ After a complete renovation, this luxury apartment combines high-end living with the charm of its prestigious canal-side location. Within walking distance of landmarks like the Anne Frank House, Dam Square, and the Jordaan, it offers the perfect mix of cultural immersion and luxury. A true testament to modern elegance set within Amsterdam’s rich historical landscape.

name: Modern apartment ✪  1 to 4 guests, ♕King Size Beds
description:
Modern rooms with ✔King size beds
✔Spacious balcony overlooking ArenA stadium
✔Jacuzzi ✔ Rain shower ✔Free netflix ✔Free WiFi ✔ Nearby lot of hotspots. ✔Free private parking spot for 1 car

We are near Ajax ArenA, Heineken Music Hall , Ziggo Dome,

Affordable stay for couples, small group and business travelers looking for a convenient place. For 1 or 4 people.

Distances from my house to:
METRO/TRAIN: 11 min walk (bus 4 min )
CITY CENTER: 21 min (metro)
AIRPORT: 21 min (train)

name: NEW! Private and stylish apartment - Casa Blake
description: Luxury, light, boutique hotelroom with private entrance. Wake up in a cozy, beautiful room right in the middle of the most popular area, the Pijp. Enjoy all the best of the city being perfectly central to experience a real local lifestyle, just one street behind the famous dutch Albert Cuyp Market. We are there for you to make your stay the very best possible, so please don’t hesitate to contact us for any information.

name: Empire suites garden view
description: Luxury, comfy private attic canal appartement down town Amsterdam with much light, a separate bathroom and toilet including beautiful classic garden view.

name: Unique floating house in Schoonship project!
description: Experience staying in Europe's most sustainable floating neighbourhood, Schoonschip in the heart of Amsterdam. Just google 'Schoonschip Amsterdam' and you can read all about this amazing project. We offer our home to couples with or without children who want to experience this unique neighbourhood in one of Europe's most beautiful cities. The 3 level house is surrounded by water. You can have a swim or if you don't want to get wet, you can take one of our two canoes. A stay you won't forget!

name: Modern luxurious room in central-west Amsterdam!
description: A beautifully renovated apartment located outside Amsterdam’s crowded tourist center - close enough to reach the heart of the city easily by foot or public transport, yet far enough to enjoy peace and comfort. The interiors have been thoughtfully updated with a modern, stylish touch, complete with Philips Hue lighting everywhere that lets you set the perfect mood, from bright to soft and cozy. Lush green plants throughout the space add warmth and a welcoming, homely atmosphere.

name: Motor Yacht Almaz close to the centre of Amsterdam
description: Make your visit to Amsterdam even more special, stay on your own private motor yacht 'Almaz'. The yacht offers all facilities and comfort and will make your stay unforgettable. A stay aboard the Almaz is a wonderful way to experience Amsterdam. This beautiful ship is no less than 12.00 meters long and offers a lot of charm and cosiness. We can accommodate up to 4 guests. Of course you have the whole ship to yourself. If not available, look at the yachts Amstelle, Amazone, Flint or At Ease.

name: Comfortable room for 2 near RAI and city center
description: You will love staying in this comfortable room. The room has a king size bed. Clean sheets and towels are included in the price. The accommodation is located 10 mins walking to the RAI convention center and the METRO station Europaplein (to reach the city centre in few minutes).
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: ★ UNIQUE & COMFORTABLE APT | CENTER OF AMSTERDAM ★
description:
Fully private, 1 two-persons bed, ground floor Unique & Comfortable apartment in the center of Amsterdam.

This hidden gem is right next to the Vondelpark, the Vondelstraat is arguably the prettiest street of Amsterdam.

Close to everything -5 minute walk to the Museum Quarter, 10 minute walk to the canals. This beautiful sunkissed studio apartment looks out at a beautiful garden.

Come to rest after a day of exploring the city, this artist's home is a beautiful place to spend some time!

name: Stylish private garden studio
description:

We hope to welcome you on board soon on our houseboat in the Amsterdam canals.

The Amsterdam canals are also magical in the winter months. We still have spots available.

I hope you'll have a wonderful stay!
