name: Canals & Cocktails: Courtyard view
description:
Welcome to Rosalia’s Menagerie, this modernized 17th-century canal house features a cocktail bar and six personally styled hotel rooms upstairs. Each a unique mix of style, charm and practicality.

Our cozier, quieter and cooler Garden View rooms (18m2) at the back of the building have king-sized bed and a view into a small and infamous Amsterdam inner courtyard area. They have bathrooms with rain showers and natural daylight. These rooms are equipped with fans and have windows on two sides.

On the principal floor you will find our cozy little cocktail bar inspired by Dutch heritage with its rich history in the trade, distilling, and innovation. We look forward to sharing our passion for Jenever and great locally-made spirits with you, as well as, showcase extraordinary products from abroad.

Upstairs you will find “Rosalia’s Inn Upstairs”, our lovely little hideaway. With six lovely rooms overlooking either the canal or a fetching Amsterdam secret

name: Picturesque cottage, For small groups up to 5 pp
description:
For small groups: An artistic, quirky yet cozy cottage. Filled to the brim with eclectic artefacts. It's an actual private home. With sunny garden.
Wharfs just 5 minutes away. From docks the ferries will bring you in 10 min to the centre. Easy parking for the lowest rate in town.
There are three queen size double beds. Kitchen well equipped. WiFi connection speedy. Washer and dryer you can use. The cat Beertje is the true mistress our house. She loves to be spoiled by you! :)

name: City Center Amsterdam Alexander Penthouse >110 m3
description:
The Alexander Penthouse is one of the best Amsterdam short stay apartment in town when it comes to daring, spacious design and luxurious extra’s. Our Alexander Penthouse offers a truly unforgettable stay in Amsterdam. This apartment breathe uniqueness and style. It has comfort and everything else you couldn’t even imagine.

Unforgettable stay
A new shimmering penthouse downtown. One that’s genuinely welcoming, warmly livable, highly enviable, and begging to be discovered.

With space for everyone to spread out, Alexander Penthouse is a great base for families. It has no fewer than 2 bedrooms, each with a separate bathroom. under which rain shower will you stand?

With the spacious dining area there is room for the entire clan.
With its glossy kitchen and modern seating area, Alexander's Penthouse open-plan living room feels very smart.

name: Cozy home in a historic Amsterdam building
description: We are renting out our own home while we are traveling. We will accept only the guests who need a temporary stay for several days in Amsterdam and would take care of our space as their own home. It is perfect as home office. Not suitable for large group (more than 2 guests) of individuals sharing. Parties are strickly restricted. While sending booking request,  please introduce yourself, and who you are coming with, the purpose of your trip and confirmation of the house rules.

name: Rooftop apartment in the heart of Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to my home!

This apartment is in between the Jordaan and Westerpark neighbourhood's. About 15 min from the train station (Amsterdam Centraal) by public transport and 12 min walk to the nearest park (Westerpark).

Whats so unique about this place is you get to be in the city centre (near the Anne Frank house, emblematic canals) without the hassle and noise that comes with it.

Ideal for solo/duo travellers, couples or remote worker(s)

name: Canal Suites in center + sauna + bicycles
description: The two stand alone bedrooms (not an apartment) with each their own bathroom on the first floor of this canal house are located in the center at the picturesque Prinsengracht, facing the famous nine little streets.  Anne Frank House, Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh museum and Vondelpark  are a 15-minute walk. Four bicycles are free to use.  One out of two  bathrooms includes a whirlpool bath and sauna. No breakfast provided, but restaurants and supermarket around the corner. Host lives the floor above.

name: Spui's the Limit
description:
Cozy studio in a typical Amsterdam building, located very centrally near Dam Square and the famous 9 streets district.
You will have your own studio with bathroom en toilet. The bathroom and the studio are separated by a shared hallway with me :). But I will respect your privacy and only use the hallway when I come home or leave.

name: Rembrandt Studio Two
description:
This awesomely cosy studio is located in the heart of Amsterdam, you can walk to museums, bars, the park, canals, restaurants, etc. Situated next to Rembrandtplein makes sure that you are in the centre the minute you walk outside the door.

The studio has a comfortable two-person bed and a spacious bathroom, also there is a small lounge area with two nice chairs.
Check out the pictures and imagine yourself staying in this cozy place!

name: Hotel Not Hotel Ams: The Blue House Downstairs
description: This room is the permanently temporary result of different stages of evolution, inspired by the ever-changing nature of the hotel. Several houses have been altered or reconstructed over the last years, The Blue Room being one of them.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Hotel Not Hotel Amsterdam: The Sun Room
description:
This room is one of the hotel’s latest creations.
This time, we wanted to let our guests be part of the creative process, and come up with some fresh new ideas for this empty space.

Stay in this room and let the ideas flow onto the black canvas. There are no boundaries to what imagination can bring. Creativity lies within us all.
Feeling inspired? Please leave your ideas in the mailbox next to the reception after you have stayed in this room.


Room features: Shared Bathroom
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Hotel Not Hotel Ams: The Invisible Tower
description:
Now you see me, now you don’t. The Invisible Room is nothing and everything at the same time. It’s constantly reflecting all of the hotel’s light and colour, making it both full of life and practically invisible.

The Invisible Room was created by the infamous HNH Concept Factory, a group of philosophers, scientists, and visual artists. Be careful not to bump into it on your way into or out of the hotel.

name: ★★★★ CANAL APARTMENT | AMSTERDAM CENTRAL | 4P ★★★★
description:
This type of extraordinary accomodation, in this amazing neighborhood, is rarely available! A nicely designed 7 stylish apartment.

Warm & cosy with a chique look.

Experience the joy of the center of Amsterdam and the liveliness of this famous historic neighborhood, while enjoying the tranquility of living in a historic apartment which recently has been fully renovated to a beautiful and luxurious short-stay.

All amenities are included, so all you need to do is bring your suitcase!

name: Cozy-arty apartment with king size bedroom+office
description:
Arty and very cozy apartment, with lots of daylight, on a quite street of Amsterdam's hip West.

Extra office room with standing desk for comfort of working professionals.

Ideal space for couples.

Within walking distance from Westerpark. 10-12 mins biking from Jordaan (the historic center with beautiful canals).

name: Cityden | 1-Bedroom Apartment | Aparthotel
description: Ideal for longer stays or those who appreciate extra space. Open floor plan bedroom with queen bed and sofa bed in living area, and fully equipped kitchen with fridge, stovetop, microwave/oven, dishwasher and Nespresso machine. Flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi, and workspace included. Modern bathroom with shower, hairdryer, and toiletries. The appartment has a climate control system.

name: Cozy 105 sqm residence with a home cinema & garden
description: Welcome to our home! Our cozy 105m2 ground-floor apartment invites 3-4 guests and is located in the area to be! The place was fully remodelled (new kitchen and bathroom) in 2018 and has had some updates since then. City-centre West: where you can find all the Fine Arts, Culture, Restaurants, Clubs & Bars with a true local feeling and away from tourists traps. We have a great sunny BBQ garden, a cinema projector with Netflix, and lot's of plants to enjoy!

name: In center, private with great view on the canal !
description: This charming apartment is situated within a typical Dutch house on one of Amsterdam's canals in the oldest part of the city center. The characteristic construction style of a house at the canal features multiple floors. The apartment is situated on the second floor. Here you'll find your bedroom and your private bathroom. Above the bedroom there is an attic, a room with a couch.

name: Eco-friendly Double Room next to Vondelpark
Eco-friendly Twin Room next to Vondelpark
Cityden | Studio | Aparthotel
description: Small but efficient, this studio is ideal for solo travellers or couples. Queen bed, living area, and fully equipped kitchen with fridge, stovetop, microwave/oven and Nespresso machine. Flat-screen TV, free high-speed Wi-Fi, and workspace included. Modern bathroom with shower, hairdryer, and toiletries. This studio has a climate control system.

name: Cityden | Studio XL | Aparthotel
description: Studio designed for those who appreciate extra space. Queen bed and sofa bed comfortably sleeps up to four guests. Fully equipped kitchen with fridge, stovetop, microwave/oven, dishwasher and Nespresso machine. Living/dining area with sofa, TV, free Wi-Fi, and workspace. Modern bathroom with shower, hairdryer, and toiletries. This studio has a climate control system.

name: Cityden | 1-Bedroom Loft with Patio | Aparthotel
description: Live the Amsterdam lifestyle in this split-level open floor plan loft. Bedroom and living area downstairs, kitchen on the upper loft. Private patio for outdoor relaxation. Queen bed and sofa bed, fully equipped kitchen with Nespresso machine, fridge, stovetop and microwave/oven. Living/dining area with sofa, TV, Wi-Fi, and workspace. Modern bathroom with shower, hairdryer, and toiletries. The appartment has a climate control system.

name: Cityden | 2-Bedroom Apartment | Aparthotel
description: Open floor plan with two bedrooms and sofa bed comfortably sleep up to six. Fully equipped kitchen with fridge, stovetop, microwave/oven, dishwasher and Nespresso machine. Living/dining area with sofa, TV, Wi-Fi, and workspace. Modern bathroom with shower, hairdryer, and toiletries. The appartment has a climate control system.

name: Cityden | 2Bed & 2Bathroom Apartment | Aparthotel
description: Ideal for groups or families. Open floor plan apartment with two bedrooms and sofa bed accommodate up to six guests. Two bathrooms for smooth sharing. Fully equipped kitchen with fridge, stovetop, microwave/oven, dishwasher and Nespresso machine. Living/dining area with sofa, TV, Wi-Fi, and workspace. The appartment has a climate control system.

name: Cityden | 3-Bedroom Apartment | Aparthotel
description: Spacious apartment for larger families or friends. Three bedrooms in an open floor plan and sofa bed sleep up to eight guests. Fully equipped kitchen with fridge, stovetop, microwave/oven, dishwasher and Nespresso machine. Living/dining area with sofa, TV, Wi-Fi, and workspace. Modern bathrooms with shower, hairdryer, and toiletries. The appartment has a climate control system.

name: Cityden | Penthouse + Roof Terrace | Aparthotel
description: Premium open floor plan penthouse with private rooftop terrace or patio. Two bedrooms and sofa beds sleep up to six guests. Fully equipped kitchen with fridge, stovetop, microwave/oven, dishwasher and Nespresso machine. Living/dining area with sofa, TV, Wi-Fi, and workspace. Modern bathroom(s) with shower or bathtub, hairdryer, and toiletries. The appartment has a climate control system.

name: Cityden | Penthouse XL + Roof Terrace | Aparthotel
description: BoLo’s largest and most spectacular open floor plan penthouse. Sleeps up to eight guests with three bedrooms with queen and sofa beds. Private rooftop terrace with panoramic city views. Fully equipped kitchen with fridge, stovetop, microwave/oven, dishwasher and Nespresso machine. Spacious living/dining area with sofa, TV, Wi-Fi, and workspace. Modern bathrooms with shower or bathtub, hairdryer, and toiletries. The appartment has a climate control system.

name: Bright 4th floor studio near the Foodhallen
description:
This studio is located half a block away from the hip Foodhallen. It’s a 4th floor studio, very central yet extremely quiet (the window overlooks the internal gardens). A popular street market is only 1 min walk. Public transport and all sorts of handy shops are 3 min away.
The area has dozens of bars/cafes, restaurants, shops, etc. And you can be in 7 min walk at the canal ring. For more recommendations about the area check out IG: @amsterdam_homestay

name: Charming Waterfront Stay Near the Jordaan
description: Enjoy Amsterdam like a local in this bright and fully furnished 60 m² apartment, located by the water near Hugo de Grootplein and the Jordaan. The apartment features a private south-facing garden, a comfortable living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and fast Wi-Fi. Surrounded by great cafés, restaurants and local shops, with the city centre within easy reach by foot or bike. Perfect for a relaxing city stay or remote working in Amsterdam.

name: Geweldig familie appartement
description:
Bring the family to this great place with lots of room for fun. The living room is a nice, spacious area with an open kitchen, where you can comfortably cook, eat, and enjoy drinks. One bedroom has a double bed. The children's bedroom has one large single bed and a toddler bed (if desired, a baby bed or a second single bed).

Nearby are nice pubs, restaurants, and the Vondelpark and Rembrandtpark are both 1 km away.
- Tram 200 m, Metro/Train 500 m
- 10 min bikes to the canals

name: Single Room
description:
A comfortable and stylish boutique hotel located in the vibrant Amsterdam Oud-West district. Our spacious rooms are suitable for up to two guests and offer everything you need for a relaxed stay in the city.

Each room is modernly furnished and features comfortable beds, free high-speed Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, a safety deposit box, and a private bathroom with shower and toilet. Large windows provide plenty of natural light and views of the characteristic Amsterdam streets.

name: Cozy modern "Loft XL" apartment in canal district
description:
Discover a new kind of business hotel in the heart of the canal district.

Just 1 mile from Central Station, Zoku Amsterdam blends the comfort of a design-led, sustainable apartment with the services of a hotel: made for professionals, business travelers, and remote workers. Settle into your private Loft, then connect or unwind in our 24/7 rooftop Social Spaces.

Stay 14 nights or longer and get extra perks, like a free community dinner and 15% off the restaurant and bar.

name: Loft with private bathroom in centre Adam West
description:
Enjoy our spacious bright Bed and Breakfast with luxurious private bathroom near beautiful park in Amsterdam.

Tram/Metro: 8 min walk
Supermarket: 6 min
Park: 2 min

Bed consists of 2 matrasses and separate bedlinen.

Top floor. Shared stairs.

WHEN BOOKING IN AUGUST: LOW PRICE COMES WITH CARE FOR OUR CAT (cat lovers only :)) minimum stay: 5/6 nights

Plse let us know if you would like to use our breakfast service. (not available in august)
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Amsterdam Woonboot Kortbij Vondelpark, 15mins walk
description: Have the most authentic Dutch experience by staying on our cosy House Boat. You are floating on the Kade, a canal famous for its safe swimming location nestled among nature reserves. You can dive straight off the boat to enjoy a refreshing dip on hot summer days. The houseboat is located 15 minute walk from Vondelpark, Amsterdam's central park.  You are also well connected here. You can be anywhere in the city within 20 minutes on the Tram 2 or Tram 1. Hoofddorpplein is family friendly and cozy.

name: Modern family home for family with children
description:
*Not for groups of friends, no more than 4 people (excluding babies)*

Tastefully furnished city house within the Amsterdam ring road, near the start of the North/South metro line. Also included: split-level living room and kitchen/diner (total 80m²), 4 bedrooms (1 for kids, 1 baby room), 2 bathrooms, a large garden (140m²) with a terrace, lounge sofa and 3 friendly rabbits. Perfect for families with children or couples who want luxury and space but still want the option of exploring the city.

name: Stylish Apartment in Vibrant Oud-West with terrace
description:
Cozy, newly renovated apartment in Amsterdam’s charming Old West.

Just a 3-minute walk from Vondelpark and steps away from local shops, supermarkets, cafés, excellent restaurants, a fresh market, and the Foodhallen. The city centre is only a 10-minute walk.

Excellent public transport connections nearby, and if you’re arriving by car we can register your vehicle for visitor parking, to help you avoid high street parking fees.

name: Apartment next to Westerpark
description:
We're located next to the Westerpark, known for all the nice restaurants, wine bars and weekend markets (definitely a must go).

Our apartment has everything you need during your stay here. Planning to have dinner at home? You're at the right place! We have a great kitchen and if the sun's out, you can sit outside in our garden en make use of the BBQ.

Furthermore we have: TV/Netflix, Vinyl player+Marshall sound-bar, a lovely rain shower, Sage Barista Express (the best coffee). And more!

name: Superior Suite with private bath room
description: Luxurious Suite with a beautiful view on the canal. With private bath room (Airbnb says it is shared but it is NOT!!!) With a huge romantic marble bath tub in the room (for extra costs). Luxury and wellness guaranteed in the heart of the city centre. All interesting sites are on walking distance. Our B&B is situated in between the famous 9 streets where you shop till late in the evening. A chance to stay in a 17th century canal house and experience how the Dutch live.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Historical ship on an astonishing spot
description:
This houseboat is located in an historical quarter. Your luxurious private room with original details is very modern and well maintained. This mix of a modern and traditional decor makes the houseboat unique.

Enjoy your beautiful room, make a cup of tea or coffee and enjoy sitting on the deck terrace. You will be surprised by the fantastic view and beautiful environment. Afterwards, discover the beautiful city.

name: Light and quiet 2-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam
description: Light and spacious (75m2 divided over 2 floors) 2-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam Noord for rent. The place is situated right next to a lovely park and small forrest. The subway is about a 6 minute walk, which will take you right into the city centre (central station is one stop further). Also the ferry to Central Station is about a 7 minute cycle, the ferry goes every 3 minutes and takes you right into the centre. The place itself is situated on a quiet street in a very peaceful neighbourhood.

name: Art-Filled Designer Flat w/ Private Patio
description:
We would love to welcome to you to our stylish and unique art & design ground floor garden home in Central Amsterdam, close to Westerpark & Jordaan.

As art collectors our apartment has an ever changing art and furniture collection, featuring vintage art and furniture by some of the newest Dutch designers.

We have created a green oasis in our courtyard garden. Bustling Westerpark is 1 min walk, Jordaan is 5 min walk and biking distance from major tourist attractions

name: Romantic Loft apartment with canal view
description: Beautiful attic apartment in the city centre. With its beautiful canal view this apartment of 65m2 surface has an enormous light and open character. The luxurious and cosy refurbishment makes you feel at home immediately. With its queen size bed, a cosy living room with a huge sofa, TV and dining table this apartment is really a gem. It contains all kitchen utensils and also a fridge, microwave, coffee and tea maker. Outside the room you will find the private bathroom with bath tub and toilet.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: ALDO (Room Not for parties)
description:
We are offering one bedroom only (about 10 square meters) in a centrally located, bright and airy second floor apartment (no elevator).

The room is strictly for a maximum of two guests.

You can choose between two single beds (80x200cm) or a double bed (160x200cm).

The bathroom is shared with the host.

Self service check-in with a secure Masterlock box

Note that breakfast is not provided.

No parties. No infants. No pets.

Check-in between 15.00 and 23.00. Check-out no later than 10am.

name: Charming canal apartment in Amsterdam
description:
Charming mini appartment on the ground floor of a canal house in the Jordaan, Amsterdam. Situated on a quiet and beautiful canal, the appartment is close to a variety of restaurants, bars and boutique shops.
It has a comfortable Swiss Sense bed (Kingsize), a cosy sitting area with canalview, a kitchen corner with dinner table and a pleasant bathroom.

name: Comfortabel gezinshuis aan Vondelpark
description: Spacious and bright family home on the Vondelpark with garden and parking next to the house. In addition to the four bedrooms, there is a playroom/TV room with direct access to the garden. Easily accessible by car and public transport, close to museums, theaters and shops.

name: Amsterdam Sleeping under Stars- Free Parking!
description: Sleeping under Stars & Free Parking! Loft, tiny apartment in restored dike house from 1903 on the Schellingwouderdijk in Amsterdam. The beautiful surroundings are a perfect combination for those who love both the City Center and Rural Life. The characteristic Family House offers views on the Amsterdam IJ and meadow for children to play, with tables from where to enjoy the panoramic sight of horses and ships sailing by. In summer swim in front skate in winter! Registered under 97188. Z/20/1761348

name: Cosy, sunny apartment in quiet street in Amsterdam
description:
This is my personal flat that I rent out when I'm out of town. It is fit for 2 people (1 bedroom with double bed). The upper floor apartment is in a quiet residential quiet street with families and only a 10 minutes bike ride to the heart of Amsterdam. Located next to Rembrandtpark. It's the perfect place to peacefully come home after a day of strolling in town.
If possible I like to welcome my guests personally. Check-in time is between 2 p.m. and 8 p.m. (sometimes earlier, upon request).

name: 2floor apartment (115 m2) with garden in Amsterdam
description: Spacious 2-floor apartment with two guest bedrooms and sunny backyard in the upcoming Amsterdam West), at walking distance from the Vondelpark, supermarkets, shops and public transport.

name: Spacious Family Home + Free Parking. Near center!
description: Welcome on the west side of Amsterdam. With a direct tram to the city centre (20 min.) and only 10 minutes away from the lively shopping and restaurant area De Baarsjes. The house is adjacent to the impressive lake Sloterplas with the city beach within 3 minutes walking distance. It is a very specious house with 3 floors, a great house for a family.

name: Authentic Farmhouse The Vergulden Eenhoorn 2
description:
There is great history behind the hotel. The Vergulden Eenhoorn was established in 1702 as a city farm and used to be one of very few farmhouses the city of Amsterdam has.

Together with the city of Amsterdam the farmhouse was fully renovated to modern standards, while maintaining the historic value and its features.

The space is fully equipped with all necessities to make your stay as comfortable as possible!

name: Large private room + direct tram to center
description:
Enjoy a spacious room with a comfortable European King-size bed (US Queen) in our home. Unwind with a TV equipped with Chromecast, Netflix and standard channels- for relaxing evenings after a day of exploring Amsterdam.

Our home is nestled in a family-friendly neighborhood, surrounded by a variety of shops, restaurants, and cafés right on our street and around the corner.
Located just 700 meters from the tram stop which brings you directly to the city center and all its attractions.

name: Cozy apartment with big sunny terrace in Ams' East
description:
Lovely apartment in the East of Amsterdam directly located on the buzzing Javastraat. Big terrace in the back to enjoy summer days & nights, and cozy inside for winter days. Check-in and check-out can be discussed, I am generally super flexible as I travel myself :)
Btw, my cats are currently not around as they are vacationing long term in France!

Z/23/2148647

name: Luxury & cozy apartment in the middle of Amsterdam
Adam's Suite
description: Located in the heart of Amsterdam and just around the corner from the famous Prinsengracht Canal, you will find a lovely B&B called Adam's Suite.

name: Adam's Loft
description: Located in the heart of Amsterdam and just around the corner from the famous Prinsengracht Canal, you will find a lovely B&B called Adam's Place. My name is Adam and this is my place.

name: Stylish Canal House B
description:
Stylish Canal House in Amsterdam offers accommodation with free WiFi, less than 1 km from the Anne Frank House, a 13-minute walk from the Basilica of Saint Nicholas and 1.5 km from the Flower Market. The property is 2.9 km from the Rembrandt House and 4.4 km from Museum Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder.

The apartment features 2 bedrooms, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, an equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and a microwave, a washing machine, and 1 bathroom with a shower.

name: Near city centre, beautiful & private, gardenside
description: Charming, peacefull and private stay of 60 m2 in lovely dike house situated in a pitoresque street, right at a lovely park. Consists 1 master bedroom with box spring bed, large living area with pull out sofa bed,  modern bathroom, south facing terrace in spacious garden. Only one metro stop (2-3) min. away from  city centre, ten minute walk to metro. Within walking distance free parking. Nice big park with tennis court and natural swim facillty. Also nearby you can hire bikes.

name: Beautiful studio in Museumkwartier(long term only)
description: Beautiful, recently renovated furnished studio in one of the best neighborhoods of Amsterdam, Museumkwartier. Famous museums, restaurants, gyms, grocery stores are all within a walking distance. The studio is equipped with everything you need for your stay: modern kitchen with high end electrical and cooking appliances, smart TV, internet, washing machine. Enjoy your stay with a beautiful view of Amsterdam canals! This rental is Long term only : 6+ months

name: Brightroom II - Forest View Rembrandtpark
description:
This apartment is a wonderful place to stay. It's bright white, modern, and fresh, with supermarkets and the metro within walking distance. It's located near Rembrandtpark, within the Amsterdam ring road.

There are two rooms available on Airbnb.

The apartment is nice and bright with a lock on the door. It has a balcony (smoking allowed) with a beautiful view of Rembrandtpark.
We always ensure the apartment is kept clean, including fresh towels, bed linens, and internet.

name: Brightroom I -  City ParkView Rembrandtpark
description:
It is very pleasant to stay in this apartment. Bright white, modern, and fresh, with supermarkets and the metro within walking distance. Located on Rembrandt Park within the Amsterdam ring road.

There are 2 rooms available on AirBNB, of which this room is suitable for 1 guest.

The apartment is nice and bright with a lock on the door. Balcony (smoking allowed) with a beautiful view over Rembrandt Park.

We always ensure that the apartment remains clean. Clean towels, bed linen, and internet.

name: Garden View Suite
description:
Be aware! Steep stairs! (typical for Amsterdam)
Very light spacious room with private bathroom and bathtub. The toilet is not located in the bathroom but is in the hallway and shared with me and other guests!

name: Spacious house with great views near the city!
description: Our beautiful spacious and bright corner house is located in the green and tranquility rural area of Amsterdam-North, in the picturesque village of Ransdorp.. An ideal base for visiting Amsterdam and for cycling or walking in the beautiful Dutch countryside. In about 15 minutes by car you are in the center of the city, and in 10 minutes there is the shopping center Buikslotermeerplein, and metro station Noord. Volendam, Edam and Marken are easily accessible. We only rent to family’s.

name: Amstel River Citycenter View
description:
The large wooden windows on the first floor have a wide view of the Hermitage, the Magere Brug and on the right side Theater Carre. The two floors are small but nice and completely renovated last year. So small kitchen, small bathroom but new.
Our house has been restored to its original state (18th century), which means that there are many beautiful details from the moment you enter. Rotating wooden stairs, wooden beams, panes in the windows, ornaments on the doors.

name: Prinsengracht 969, your home to explore Amsterdam
description: Our house, built in 1680, is on the Prinsengracht. The apartment is in the basement of the house with its own front door. With a love for antique details, we made it a comfortable place to stay. Situated in the centre of the city of Amsterdam you can reach the musea and restaurants within a ten-minute walk.

name: Sunny garden flat, 15 mins. to Amsterdam central!
description:
Our 2 bedroom apartment has a great location just 1 min. walk from the metro. In 15 mins. direct, you are in central Amsterdam! We are also near the regional (NS) train stations, from there you can quickly get to Schiphol airport or onwards to discover more of the Netherlands.

Per Amsterdam regulations, only guests booked in reservation (max 4) are allowed in the property during your stay. No visitors, events or parties or other activities that would be disruptive to neighbors

name: Comfortable B&B near Centre with private bathroom
description:
Our brand-new Bed&breakfast is waiting for you. It's at an AAA-location; near the center. Fast internet. Streetmarket, Heineken, big museums, all on walking distance. And many fine and cozy restaurants and shops.

The room and bathroom are in the basement-floor with a light-window facing our garden. Quiet place, floorheathing, luxury bathroom, a little fridge and all the equipment to prepare breakfast at any time you want.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: The Wikkel | Iconisch Field Cabin
description: The most famous tiny house in the Netherlands. Spacious at 45 m², cozy, and unmistakable with its sloping roof and wooden interior. In this cabin, you can fully enjoy the sun with friends and family. In addition to a queen-size bed in the master bedroom or a sofa bed in the living room. If you prefer a bunk bed, you can request this based on availability.

name: Family house with garden
description:
Our family house is close to the Vondelpark (a 15 minute walk), the start of the city centre. Tram 2 stops just around the corner and takes you to all the nice musea and neigbourhouds, straight through the centre to Central Station. National Geographic says tram 2 to be one of the best tram-rides in the world. By bike is actually the best way to visit Amsterdam, so you are free to use ours, including child seats :)

Our house hosts a maximum of 4 adults and 2 kids. We only host families.

name: Boardwalk Suite
description:
The 30m² Boardwalk Suite is perfect for two people. Relax in a luxurious queen-size bed, located in a separate bedroom.

The bathroom has a rain shower and wonderful spa products. The room has air conditioning and free super-fast Wi-Fi. Some suites are now also equipped with induction and have cooking facilities!

name: The Barn | Private Field cabin with wood stove
description: Inspired by the traditional Dutch rural barns. This two story cabin (60m2)  has two master bedrooms with queen size beds, a stylish unique interior and a bathroom on the first floor. On the ground floor is the kitchen and a lounge with a wood-burning stove where you have plenty of space to relax. Large sliding glass doors give access to the private deck in the garden with lounge chairs. The Barn is the ideal place to enjoy together.

Walk, bike or take public transportation in or out of the city. name: Great apartment with bath near Vondelpark
description:
You will find the apartment in a really great neighbourhood of Amsterdam. It's in the hip area of Oud West with its boutique shops and abundance of bars and restaurants. It's just a few steps from the lovely Vondelpark and close to city center.

It is a arty, spacious and modern apartment. Modern kitchen with everything you need. Bathroom with washing machine and bath tub! The bedroom has a double bed and garden view. So quiet sleeping.

name: Private studio in Jordaan area  for 1-3 persons
description: This studio is located on the ground floor of a characteristic cornerhouse in Amsterdam city center Jordaan. You'll have your own private kitchen, shower and toilet, just 3 minutes away from Anne Frank House and other major sights.

name: Cozy home with workstation 5' from canals/Jordaan
description:
Cozy-up like a local in this warm Amsterdam apartment.

It provides an ideal base to explore the city: right next to the biggest park, 10’ walk from the historic Jordaan neighborhood and 15’ by tram from most cultural attractions and the central station. Or just grab my bike and explore the Dutch way :)

Intended for short and long stays, the apartment comes with top-notch WFH equipment, including a large computer screen and ergonomic desk chair.

Perfect for one person or a couple. Enjoy!

name: Fijn appartement in Amsterdam-West
description: This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated. The apartment features a spacious living room with dining area and sitting area. There is 1 bedroom, and an office space. The two balconies and the number of windows provide the apartment with enough sunlight all day long. The location is centrally located and within (10 min.) cycling distance of the city center. In addition, there is a park within walking distance.

description:
The house is located in a quiet residential area, a few minutes from green areas and a parking area.

name: Eco-friendly Double Room in an unique location
Cozy apartment in lovely street next to Vondelpark
description:
Lovely 1-bedroom apartment next to Vondelpark and Rembrandtpark, both 5 minutes away on foot.

Recently fully renovated, it features modern, stylish interiors ideal for both leisure and work stays.

The main bedroom opens onto a private balcony with morning sun, perfect for coffee or breakfast.

A separate room serves as a dedicated workspace with a desk, ideal for remote work. Located 15 minutes by bike from the RAI Convention Centre, close to city life and parks.

name: High-end, spacious apartment with roof terrace
description: This spacious and luxurious apartment has been entirely renovated in 2025. On the 3th floor is the living room, fully equipped kitchen, dedicated workspace, separate toilet and balcony on the sunny south. The 4th floor features a master bedroom with a balcony,  bathroom with a bathtub and two showers. The top floor offers a private rooftop terrace with lounge area and view.  Located in a quiet street in Amsterdam West, just 5 minutes from Vondelpark. And public transport around the corner.

name: sunny and spacious apartment in central Amsterdam
description: A bright, homely apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. Just a 10-minute bike ride to Leidseplein and Oud-West, and walking distance to the Vondelpark, with plenty of cafés and restaurants nearby. The home has a spacious living area, two bedrooms, a modern kitchen, a small bathroom, and a rooftop terrace. It’s in a quiet family neighbourhood, so not suitable for parties or disturbances. Bikes available on request. Also close to a main tram line with quick connections to the city centre.

name: Midtown Twin Studio
description:
Cosy and bright apartment. This luxurious room provides two relaxing single beds, a kitchenette and a dining area/ work space. Perfect for a couple or business traveller!

Midtown Hotel is situated at the edge of the center in one of the most popular areas in Amsterdam. Only 5 minutes from Leidseplein, Vondelpark, Museum district and the “9 straatjes” popular for its cozy restaurants and boutique shops.

name: Canal View 2-bedroom apartment
description:
Enjoy the real laid back Amsterdam lifestyle from this canal view apartment. Perfectly located in the center, you would be able to discover the beautiful Jordaan, wander in the picturesque Prinseneiland, relax in WesterPark, get a coffee in Haarlemmerdijk... Best spots are only 5 minutes away by walk!
It is well connected (bus 48/18/22, tram 5, Ferry F7), central station is 10 minutes away by bus/bike.
We renovated our 60m2 apartment & hope you will enjoy & take care of it as much as we do!

name: NEW! Studio apartment Eelhouse @Jordaan
description:
Charming and quaint B&B in the historic heart of the 'Jordaan' in Amsterdam's city centre.

Our historic building dates from 1619 and is of typical Amsterdam authentic style with stepped gables.

name: Large modern inner city apartment
description:
Entrepotdok is an amazing street with beautiful houses along a big canal. Our apartment is slightly off the canal with a view into a peaceful garden, so you have complete privacy.
There are many great bars, restaurants, museums & parks nearby.

For longer stays feel free to send me a message.

★ Quiet location on a canal close to City Centre & other cool places
★ King bed
★ Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher
★ Washing machine & dryer
★ Smart TV
★ Fast Wi-Fi
★ Separate office/working space

name: Waterwoning met sauna 20 min van centrum
description: Spacious water house in the greenest canal of Amsterdam. Large dining kitchen (50m2) with lots of equipment, even a lava grill in case you can't use the outdoor kitchen in bad weather. Relax on the floating terrace or in the sauna in the garden. You can cool off and/or swim directly from your own garden in the canal.

name: Complete woning in Amsterdam Zuidoost
description:
Entire family home on the outskirts of town.
The metro is a 10-minute walk away, and in 20 minutes you will be at the central station.
You can park for free in front of the door.
I live there myself and only rent when I am traveling, so I am looking for guests who respect the space.

name: Bb 1971 Hazenstraat shared bathroom
description: This cozy private room with shared bathroom situated right in the city centre of Amsterdam

description: Tiny house in the heart of the “Jordaan”, city center of Amsterdam

name: Spacious, stylish apartment with big balcony
description:
Spacious, stylish and comfortable apartment in the new West area of Amsterdam (Mercatorplein area). The apartment has a big, open floor kitchen + dining + living area. The big balcony is connected via doors from both the living area and the bedroom. From the living area and balcony, you'll have great views overlooking trees, parks, and water.

This is a new listing on Airbnb as I am looking to rent this out during my travels. If needed, I have 1 bike for you to use.

name: Maria's city center classis loft/condo vondelpark
description:
VONDELSTRAAT LOFT AMSTERDAM CITY at the Vondelpark in the middle of the city center. Modern, lightly finished city apartment.
Provides a home base for vacationers and business travelers who want to stay a few days in the middle of the luxury part of the city. You can walk into the Vondelpark and PC main street, the luxury shopping state of Amsterdam. 5 stars for the location

name: Amsterdam apartment,canal view,near Vondelpark
description:
Welcome to my home. I’ d like to share my trendy apartment with you, with a large garden, just a heartbeat away from the main attractions of Amsterdam like the Vondelpark

My house is situated in quiet street with a view on an Amsterdam Canal, trendy renovated apartment with very comfortable facilities.

At the end of the street you can rent a bike for 10 euro a day.

From the garden patio you can enjoy a morning coffee in the sun. In the afternoon you can swim in the Canal with good wheather

name: Luxurious Residence in Vondelpark/Museum District
description:
**Important information** I only accept guests above the age of 25+.

A beautiful stay in the Museum Quarter of 'Amsterdam Zuid'. The accommodation is located next to the Vondel Park and within walking distance to museums, restaurants, and shops making it the perfect spot to discover Amsterdam.

★ Airconditioning

★ High Speed Wi-Fi
★ 46 Inch Flatscreen

name: Cozy Apartment in Amsterdam West
description: Cozy 1bedroom apartment in the West side of Amsterdam, 15min walking to the city center. Located on the first floor of a lively street during day time, full of  shops, market, and everything you might need. But quiet and cozy at night. Furnished with a comfy bed and a small desk facing the backside of the building which makes it very quiet, a big couch and tv, spacious kitchen fully supplied, bathroom with a bath-tub and a small balcony.

name: Studio with private bathroom, kitchen and terrace
Amazing familyhome in green area near centre
description:
This amazing house with beautiful scenery will make you love Amsterdam even more. It is 15 minutes away from city centre but in a very green area, where kids can play outside on the grass, while you enjoy the sun.
The house is 4-floors including a garden attached to the kitchen. 3 bedrooms, one bathrooms with bath and seperate shower, 2 toilets and a fire place.

name: Sunlit Amsterdam Loft • Views, Piano & Comfort
description: Wake up in the heart of Amsterdam in this bright, modern 2-bedroom duplex with floor-to-ceiling windows, a designer staircase, and a Clavinova piano. Perfect for couples, friends, or remote workers looking for both style and comfort — all just steps away from the city’s most vibrant cafes, restaurants and canals.

name: Amsterdam city garden
description:
Lovely groundfloor apartment for plant lovers in Amsterdam west. Close to center, foodhallen, tram, supermarkets, restaurants, shops and beautiful parks.
If you like plants, you will love this place.

name: Family house in the middle of Amsterdam and nature
description: Family friendly house in the middle of Amsterdam Noord, the hippest part of the city. The house is located in a quiet park 10 minutes by bike from the old city center and less than 5 minutes by bike from NDSM and all that it has to offer. So you get all of the peace, quiet and room of being far out of the city while still being right in it! The house is 3 floors, with the living on the ground floor, bedrooms and bathroom on the middle floor and TV, working space and guest room on the top floor.

name: Ruim en licht appartement met royaal dakterras
description: This centrally located home in Amsterdam West is tastefully decorated. It is located next to the beautiful Westerpark and is the ideal base for visiting Amsterdam. The house is spacious, bright and equipped with every comfort. With a new and modern bathroom and a spacious and sunny roof terrace from where the sunset can be seen beautifully. Within walking distance of nice coffee shops and the city center just 15 minutes away, this home makes your stay in Amsterdam an ultimate experience.

name: Bright flat, fabulous area - RAI
description:
Experience staying in a quiet, authentic Dutch residential neighbourhood very close to the centre of Amsterdam.
Enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located flat. It is walking distance to public transport, shops, restaurants and the RAI convention centre. It’s a 15 min drive or short train ride to Schiphol airport.

name: Canal  Duplex with Garden next to City Center
description: Want that cozy feeling of staying in a typical Amsterdam apartment with view to canal, quiet and private? You are welcome in our family home - ground floor and first floor house –in a building from 19th Century with original ceiling decorations and details. The apartment is located near the center close to all the treats Amsterdam has to offer. Our home is 100sqm with private entrance: generous living room, 2 spacious bedrooms, separate toilet, bathroom, fully equipped kitchen and private garden

name: Delightful Modern Houseboat with  sunny patio
description: You'll love this unique and romantic escape. This enviromentaly friendly Houseboat is a new build with triple glazed windows, underfloor heating, heat pump and solar panels. It is wonderfully relaxing to sleep on the water, with swans and ducks passing by. The boat is south facing so you can enjoy sunshine on the terrace with eating area, bbq and sun loungers.

name: Stijlvolle kamer aan straat in centrum met privacy
description: 23 SouS is centrally located in the old part of the city center. Our 18th-century house offers two comfortable double rooms, each with its own private entrance and private bathroom. These can be booked separately or together as a family stay. 23 SouS is ideally located for discovering the city on foot and by bike. 23 SouS is also suitable for a family with children and business travelers. For business travelers, conference venues are easily accessible from 23 SouS.

name: Stijlvolle kamer aan tuin in centrum met privacy

name: Stylish Amsterdam Pad - whole apt to yourself!
description:
Guests (max 4 people) will have full and exclusive use of the whole apartment, owners will not be present.

Built in the early 19th Century, the apartment is centrally located in the famous 9 Streets neighbourhood of Amsterdam, just a few minutes walk from Dam Square and the Royal Palace and situated amongst the beautiful central canals of Herengracht and Keizersgracht.

name: Appartement Amsterdam oost
description:
This apartment is perfectly located in the Javastraat (10 min from centre) in the cosiest neighbourhood of Amsterdam: The Indische Buurt, which has everything you need. You'll find your local fruit store, bars, pubs, the best falafel in town, boutiques, bike rentals, coffee houses and the supermarket around the corner.

The apartment is a recently renovated and modernly furnished. It offers two bedrooms, a kitchen, a nice living room, bathroom (with rain shower) and south-facing balcony!

name: Verblijf met privé ingang en badkamers in kamers
description: Two Double Rooms, 2 Private Bathrooms with walk-in shower, 1 double bed (King size), 2 Separate Beds.  The family accommodation consists of a Private Entrance with a hall that gives access to the Canal Room and the Garden Room.  Each with its own bathroom.                                                                               For more information about both rooms, the Canal Room and the Garden Room, you can view the information for each of these rooms on our website.

name: Houseboat • Private Terrace • Free Ferry to CS
description: The apartment in the houseboat has its own toilet, shower and floating terrace with lounge sofa with beautiful views over the water. It is an oasis of peace, while within a 15-minute walk you will find the bars and restaurants of the trendy NDSM. Take the free ferry there to Amsterdam Central or the nice neighborhoods in Amsterdam West. From the terrace you can swim or SUP (free). In the communal garden is a covered outdoor kitchen, a big hammock and fire pit. Breakfast not included.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: The Village Hideaway
description: The Village, located just 700 meters from the resort, consists of compact wooden villas that float above the landscape, spaced safely apart in the wild polder landscape. There are only seven freelodges, so don’t worry about crowds. Stay in the heart of nature, relax, and enjoy the peace. All guests of The Village can make use of the resort’s facilities at any time.

name: Gezellig huisje op het erf van een bio boerderij.
description: You will stay in a converted haystack in the middle of our yard of our organic farm. In the stables, cows are still being milked, the sheep are walking in the meadow, and the horses and pigs are looking over the fence. And yet you can reach the heart of Amsterdam within half an hour by public transport!

name: Cosy & sunny apartment. Perfect location!
description: This cosy & sunny apartment is in the best area of Amsterdam,  in 'Oud West' . Which is the perfect location in Amsterdam if you want to be close to the center  (5 minutes by bike / 15 minutes walking )  but have your privacy, chilled strolls trough the city and quiet sleeps. Strolling around in the lovely neighborhood is my favorite thing with so many great coffee places, shops and restaurants. Also only 5 minute walk from the beautiful Vondelpark <3

name: Unieke waterwoning met uitzicht (Amsterdam-Noord)
description:
Unique water house in a sustainable floating neighborhood (Amsterdam-Noord)

- 2 bedrooms: double beds
- 1 bathroom: shower, bath
- 1 living room and kitchen
- 1 TV/lounge room
- 1 work/reading room
- 1 roof terrace
- 1 balcony (shared with neighbors)
- 2 toilets

We designed, built and furnished our home ourselves. In doing so, we have made use of natural materials as much as possible.

The house is part of a sustainable floating residential area, Schoonschip, developed and built by 46 households.

name: Nice apartment with Canal view
description:
This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated and has its own entrance.
The apartment features 1 bedroom with a double bed and possibly an inflatable mattress.
The house has an open kitchen with a spacious dining table that overlooks the canal.
Two years ago, the house was completely renovated and has a luxurious bathroom with walk-in shower and separate toilet.

registration number: 0363 EDE7 F93D F7C1 1C93

name: Bright and modern apartment in the Old West
description: Enjoy this spacious one bedroom apartment, located in one of Amsterdam's liveliest districts. On the fourth floor, the studio benefits from amazing lighting and unique views. Tastefully decorated, the space is designed to provide functionality and comfort.

name: Privé kamer in woonschip vlakbij Artis (centrum)
description:
The houseboat is located on a quiet canal in the city center of Amsterdam, behind the Amsterdam Artis Zoo.

There are beautiful warehouses along the canal. At the front of the boat, you can enjoy boats sailing through the canal. Museums and Waterlooplein are within cycling distance. Bicycles are available for rent in the area, bars and restaurants are within walking distance.

It is a cozy room that can be well heated with central heating.

About a 15-minute walk from Central Station.

name: Lux Penthouse, rooftop & skylights (Center AMS)
description:
Designed and recently renovated luxurious sunny penthouse. Since the apt has 3 open sides and many windows/skylights it is very sunny and light.

The Apt is fully furnished with one master bedroom and a smaller room (functions as a working space), rooftop to enjoy sunny days and relax, in addition a balcony in the main level.

name: Bright City Apartment with Private Rooftop
description: Spacious and light apartment on one of the most dynamic streets in Amsterdam. Within a three-minute walk, you can either reach the lively Javaplein by turning left from my place, or the beautiful Flevopark by turning right. In this neighbourhood you experience another side of Amsterdam life, away from the tourist crowds, while the city centre is only 10 minutes away.

name: Modern appartement in het centrum van Amsterdam
description: This stylish apartment has an excellent location. Within 5 minutes' walking distance, you will find the Jordaan with all kinds of cozy restaurants and a market. The apartment is clean and has recently been completely renovated. The apartment is located in a quiet street and has a nice square in front with a playground for children or where you can enjoy exercising yourself. The apartment is on the 3rd floor. There is no elevator available!

name: Wildervanck Bed&Breakfast
description:
Wildervanck Bed&Breakfast is located in a charming 17th century canal house on the Keizersgracht. Our comfortable room has a private bathroom with washcloths and towels.
Due to its central location, it is very easy to reach.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: DESIGN apartment in Amsterdam RAI
description:
Design Flat in Amsterdam – Everything in the apartment is brand new after a full renovation.

It's in the charming Rivierenbuurt neighborhood, a short walk from the RAI Convention Center and less than 10 minutes from trendy De Pijp. Centrally located, it's surrounded by great restaurants, the Albert Cuyp Market, the Rijksmuseum, Carré Theatre, and has excellent public transport to Central Station and beyond.

The apartment also includes amenities to make traveling with kids easier.

name: Unieke duurzame drijvende volledige woning
description:
Part of Europe's most sustainable floating residential area, our home is located in the middle of the particularly attractive Amsterdam-Noord. 15 minutes from the Dam, 5 minutes from the NDSM neighborhood and with shops and a market within walking distance, the location is nothing short of ideal.
We are in the middle of the residential community SchoonSchip.
Our floating home is full of comforts and is child-friendly. Families are welcome. We live here and wish to have a respectful relationship with our habitat and neighbors.

name: Spacious, sunny and luxury apartment in Amsterdam
description: Luxury, sunny and spacious (>80m2) apartment in Amsterdam Old-South, close to the Vondelpark and Museumplein. Perfect for a couple to discover Amsterdam! Very recently renovated (April 2022) and it has a brand new kitchen and bathroom that is fully equipped. The apartment is less than 100 meters from the canal (Westlandgracht). Everything you need is less than 3 minutes walk: supermarkets, cafes, restaurants, coffee houses, stores and public transport.

name: Suite 7 - Big sunny studio in 'de Pijp', Amsterdam
description:
This spacious and sunny studio with private access is located on the 4th floor (no elevator) of our 19th century building in trendy and lively neighborhood de Pijp. Walking distance to the city center and the famous Van Gogh and Rijks museum. The lovely Sarphatipark, the coziest bars and restaurants of Amsterdam, public transport or rent-a-bike, just around the corner.
High-speed wifi, central heating, a kitchen dresser with fridge and Nespresso machine and private bathroom all for you!
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Amazing bedroom in an a lovely apartment
description: A great bedroom is available in a bright and large apartment with private access to the balcony. There’s a living room with a smart TV and super comfy sofa and a dining area. The kitchen includes various built-in appliances and access to the second balcony. The bathroom is gorgeous and has floor heating. The flat is located in Bos en Lommer, close to Westerpark and bars & restaurant. Look forward to hosting you in this beautiful home.

name: Prachtige woning in de stolp van de boerderij.
Spacious Canal View Apartment next to City Center
description: This 2025 refurbished apartment is situated in "De Pijp" - the most lively neighborhood in Amsterdam. It is a light and stylish first floor apartment, surrounded by many authentic small restaurants, bars & shops. Close to the city center, museums and public transport. Queen-size double bed with a lovely ensuite bathroom. Spacious living room with canal view. We would love to be the ones to host you during your trip and provide you with an unforgettable experience.

name: Galeforce One - Jordaan houseboat studio
description:
Galeforce One is a charming houseboat studio with gorgeous canal views.

It has a bedroom, private bathroom with walk-in shower, toilet and vanity with hairdryer.

There is a fridge with a bottle of welcome wine to welcome you, a microwave, coffee machine and water kettle, coffee and tea is provided.

Step onto the little terrace to watch boats drift by and feel like a true Amsterdammer enjoying life on the water.

Please note: you are renting part of the houseboat, NOT the whole houseboat.

name: Cosy and luxurious room with canal view
description: In the heart of the centre and situated at one of the most beautiful canals this accommodation offers a luxurious and comfortable stay.  All interesting venues and attractions are on walking distance.  The room is part of our B&B and is 25m2 big with a large bathroom in marble.  The view on the canal is stunning. The room has 2 single beds, TV, table and chairs and a cupboard. Ideal for a short or long stay.

home in Amsterdam! It has everything you need to enjoy the city to the fullest.

The apartment is just a 20 min Uber ride from the airport, or easily accessible by subway (5 min walk from the station).

name: Loft in Amsterdam
description:
Stylish loft in Amsterdam. Lots of space, nice double bed, large bathroom with bathtub, wake up with a living room/kitchen full of sunlight! Always a parking space to be found and in one of the nicest neighborhoods of Amsterdam, the Pijp.

Stylish loft in Amsterdam. Lots of space, nice double bed, large bathroom with bath, wake up with a living room/kitchen full of sunlight! You will always find a parking space, and in one of the nicest neighborhoods in Amsterdam, the Pijpijp.

Located in a nice neighborhood with supermarket nearby and a good bus connection to the rest of the city. The house has just been renovated and furnished with new furniture and kitchen. In the garden is a wonderful place for children to play safely or to light the BBQ.

description:

Walking distance to the city center, the famous Van Gogh and Rijks museum. The lovely Sarphatipark, the coziest bars and restaurants of Amsterdam, public transport or rent-a-bike just around the corner.
High-speed WiFi internet, a kitchen counter, toaster, fridge, Nespresso machine, central heating, and a bathroom all for you!

Everything is totally private and you don't have to share anything with someone else. The apartment has 2 bedrooms with both kingsize comfortable beds. Both a tv with Netflix and the best working WIFI you can get. This stylish apartment offers a renovated bathroom with a bathtub and a walk in shower. Separate toilet as well. You will get all the privacy and comfort

Bedroom with king-size bed and separate office/guest room with sofa bed. Modern bathroom, separate toilet, and two separate sleeping areas. Quiet street in vibrant Amsterdam.

name: Spacious apartment in Centre, near Amstel river
description: Newly renovated Amsterdam apartment, with Sicilian touch. Two bedrooms and spacious living, with balconies front and back. Next to the Amstel river <5 minutes walking distance from the Skinny bridge, various museums and restaurants. Ideal for a families, couples as well as solo traveller looking for a quite and well-maintained apartment on the eastern side of Amsterdam Centre.

name: 2 Bedrooms, Terrace, BBQ, 2 floors 120m2

Welcome to our 120m2, 2-floor apartment in Valeriusstraat.

We rent out the whole apartment, or our guest room separately. Here you can book the whole apartment.

The whole apartment consists of 2 bedrooms, a big living/dining room and a roof terrace. It is located on the 3rd and 4th floor in lovely, local Oud-Zuid, Amsterdam in close proximity to Vondelpark and Museumsplein.

name: Huis met tuin in Amsterdam West
description:
This beautiful house is centrally located in the hip Amsterdam West. This home, ideal for a couple, combines luxury with the comfort of a quiet living environment. The open kitchen, equipped with high-quality equipment, offers a perfect setting for cozy dinners.
The house has a spacious, sunny garden that invites you to relax in peace. The location offers both privacy and proximity to the city center, with trendy cafes, shops and parks within walking distance.

Our house and the studio is located in the center of Amsterdam (east side) and all highlights (as well as restaurants, bars and clubs) are super close just like the public transport.

Bright and welcoming canal-side apartment in the charming Oud West area, one of Amsterdam’s most vibrant neighbourhoods.
The loft is accessed through a private door, it has a balcony with canal views, spacious living room, kitchenette, cosy bedroom facing a beautiful garden, and en-suite bathroom. Perfectly located near Vondelpark, museums, markets and cafés, with excellent public transport links.

The living room offers a beautiful view on the park. Guests often say: "It's so peaceful and quiet, yet zo close to everything!" Hope to welcome you soon, warm regards, @hugofeenstra

The apartment has a nice sun terrace attached to the bedroom.

name: Sunny 2BR Apt w/ Terrace & Tram-Bus access
description:
Welcome to our comfortable home.
This bright, well-equipped 2BR Apt is perfect for couples, friends, or a young family. The space is warm, practical, and relaxing, an ideal base for exploring the city.

The living area is cozy and inviting, great for unwinding after a day out. The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need.

The terrace is a lovely spot to enjoy a coffee or glass of wine.
Located in vibrant Amsterdam-Oost with great cafés, parks, and easy public transport connections nearby

name: Cosy apartment in Amsterdam

At the edge of Amsterdam you'll find this cosy apartment. A perfect place for a solo traveler, couples or friends that are on a fun adventure together.

The apartment has everything you need for a relaxed getaway.

It is paid parking untill 19.00

Nice, quiet street in trendy, charming area inc. some o/t best bars, restaurants and parks of the city- all a few mins walking distance. Superb transport links: train station, tram & bus all only 2 mins walk, all with connections to Schipol airport & Central Station.
The apartment is on the 1st floor, with 2 bedrooms, a bathroom, a toilet, a balcony. There is no living room nor kitchen

name: Cozy house with garden close to NDSM

The house is located conveniently 2 minutes walking from a café, bakery, and shops, 2 minutes to the closest bus stop with which you are in the city in 20 minutes, 15-20 minutes walking to the NDSM ferry which will take you directly to the Amsterdam Central station while enjoying the views of the harbor. Groceries and all other amenities are close by.

Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located 3 bedroom designer townhouse directly next to the vondelpark and to all the attractions and nightlife that Amsterdam has to offer, a short walk from the luxury Conservatorium Hotel and Museum Square. The house has 3 floors of living space, plus two terraces a garden and a balcony.
There are two living areas, one equipped with a cinema projector, the garden was recently upgraded but we haven't taken pictures of that yet

name: Beautiful city apartment next to Vondelpark
description:
This newly renovated city apartment is situated in the beautiful Old-West area. Adjacent to Vondelpark and 5 minutes from the canals, the apartment is located in a quiet area close to all the places to be in Amsterdam. A stroll through the beautiful Vondelpark will lead you to the city center; a perfect start of the day.

The apartment has 2 bedrooms with 2 double beds and a large living room with a fully equipped kitchen in the middle.

name: Room Michelle in family apartment no party
description:
A simple (10 square meters) bedroom in my apartment located in the 'Leidseplein' area.
The museums are at walking distance and my house is located right next to the canals.
The bathroom is shared, there is no kitchen available and pets are not allowed.
Please note that i live in the apartment too, and there is also another room rented to customers, so is very important that you are mindful and respectful of others.
No party allowed, please if you wanna have a house party, this is not the place.

name: Lovely loft in Oud West (ground floor)
description: Charming Amsterdam West loft near Foodhallen and Ten Kate Market. Ground floor in a gated street for security and tranquility. Close to Vondelpark. Well-equipped for a comfortable stay, with optional baby amenities like a cot and co-sleeper. Baby-proofed for worry-free family travel. Enjoy a peaceful retreat in the heart of Amsterdam.

*Unique canal view & Perfect location!*

Make your stay in Amsterdam complete by staying in this centrally located two bedroom guest suite.

description: Beautiful ground floor apartment in a quiet area of Amsterdam, 10 minutes by bike from the city center. Stylish, bright, family friendly and spacious apartment.

Super well-connected one-bedroom, in the heart of a family neighbourhood with lots of great coffee places, youga studios, bars and restaurants in walking distance.

It has fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, heating, a small working space and a ton of light.

The apartment is perfect for 1 person or a couple, bus line from Amsterdam Central Station stops at the door, Westepark is 400 meters away, de Joordaan and Anne Frank house is within 15 minutes walking.

It is a home!

name: Nieuw en licht appartement (baby-friendly)
description: Beautifully renovated apartment. A unique, bright and stylish apartment with two floors and a sunny terrace until the sun goes down. Located in a prime location. The Vondelpark is a 5-minute walk away, supermarket in the street, public transport around the corner and close to popular neighborhoods such as the Pijp, the Hallen, Ten Kate market and Nine streets. Furthermore, the apartment has a modern bathroom with a rain shower. Ideal apartment for a couple with a baby. An unforgettable experience!

name: Small studio in a popular area in Amsterdam.
description:
From this ideally located accommodation you can do all kinds of activities. The studio is located in a nice shopping street with bars and restaurants. The canals are a 15-minute walk away, but tram 13 towards Central Station and tram 19, which goes east via Leidseplein and De Pijp, stop around the corner.

The studio is 30m2 and has its own kitchen (extendable dining table), bathroom, sitting area with TV and a box bed.

name: Private room in Amsterdam near Metro
description:
Fully furnished room with a double bed, and a TV for your own streaming.
Fast wifi throughout the whole house, quiet and peaceful place for working from home.

Bus and metro stations are close by, with direct connections to the centre of Amsterdam, Bijlmer Arena, Gaasperplas, and Schiphol airport.

You will find all amenities to have the best comfortable stay!

You should expect to share the common areas of the house with other guests, and we expect you to respect our quiet and nice home.

Elegant Private Room and bathroom in Amsterdam

Located in a peaceful neighborhood, just minutes from top attractions, charming canals, and vibrant cafés. Perfect for a romantic weekend, solo adventure, or work trip. Experience comfort, style, and privacy in a welcoming home that offers the ideal balance between relaxation and convenience.

name: Quiet apartment in the center - with cute cat

Bright and stylish apartment in the heart of Amsterdam but away from the tourist-buzz.

**I have a cute cat and he’ll be staying with you! You don’t need to feed him, but he likes to get some love. 😻For bookings confirmed after 1-4-22**

Stay at a private large, luxurious, cozy apartment at the Museum district.

5 minutes from the van Gogh , Rijks and Stedelijk Museum.

Bathroom, bedroom, toilet, balcony and lobby are all your private space.

The accommodation has a energy label A+

Departure in front of the flight terminal every 10 minutes on regular days.

description: The apartment is located on the Beukenplein. This is a bustling square with many different hospitality venues and something for everyone. name: Lovely 2-bedroom apartment @Amstel River + garden
description: *Enjoy Amsterdam and stay in this beautiful Scandinavian style apartment only 50m from the Amstel River. The apartment is recently extended and renovated  with a lovely little garden. name: 10 Mins to Amsterdam Central
description:
NOTE: If this listing is unavailable, check my other listings on my profile!

Welcome to our cozy room in Amsterdam, just a 1-minute walk from Venserpolder metro station, offering direct access to Amsterdam City Centre in 15 minutes.

Duivendrecht train station, an 8-minute walk away, connects you to Schiphol Airport in 15 minutes.

The colouring hints a latin feel - as well as the music collection that is available. You will definitely enjoy the sun, the birds in the garden. You can retreat for a nap, for work, quiet reading or yoga in the garden room, have breakfast on the terrace. The city centre is in walking distance of our village-esque neighbourhood.

name: 2br 1.5ba Apartment With Office
description:
Spacious 89m2 two-story apartment on the top floor with two bedrooms, an office, full kitchen, balcony facing west, and 1.5 bathrooms.

It is located close to Oosterpark, and only a couple minutes walk from the tram, metro, bus and the Amstel river. In a fun area with lots of restaurants and bars right outside the door.

The apartment has super fast wifi throughout with an additional router in the office, perfect for working remotely, video calls, gaming, etc.

name: A book lover's hideaway in the the Jordaan
description:
Sleep, read, and wake up to canal views in this warm, eclectic one-bedroom apartment on Marnixstraat, one of Amsterdam's most beloved streets, steps from the Jordaan's best cafés, galleries, and markets.

The apartment is filled with books and art, and designed for guests who appreciate beauty and quiet comfort. Everything is thoughtfully arranged: a fully equipped kitchen, fast WiFi, fresh flowers, towels, and a small welcoming gift waiting for you on arrival.

name: Cozy apartment next to Rembrandt Park, with patio.
description:
Welcome to my home!
My super cozy apartment is located right next to Rembrandt Park, in De baarsjes, a trendy & up-and-coming neighborhood, still central in Amsterdam but away from the annoying tourists places. This is the real Amsterdam.

The apartment is located just a few seconds walk from the beautiful Rembrandt Park.
It is still short distance from most of the city.
8 minutes to Jordaan and city centre.
5 minutes to Oud west.

A bike rental is located right across the street.

name: Canal view design apartment, booming neighbourhood
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place close to the Foodhallen, Jordaan area and 9 streets district with a lovely view over the water. Listen to your favorite music with our LP-player or watch a movie using the beamer. The apartment has a spacious bedroom with a balcony at the back and you can enjoy your morning coffee at our balcony on the front. Including bathroom with bathtub. Airco in the bedroom.

name: Cosy appartment in de Pijp, Amsterdam
description:
This charming appartment is your perfect place to visit Amsterdam. It is located in the center of "De Pijp", the most vibrant neighborhood of the city. Step out of the door and you will find supermarkets, bars, restaurants, and everything you need. The tram that brings you to the center (in 5 min) is a 1 min walk from the door.

The apartment has a sunny balcony, a living room with a renovated kitchen, a toilet, bathroom, and a separate spacious bedroom. It's the perfect place for your visit!

name: New and Modern appartement Amsterdam De Pijp
Cosy apartment with spacious roof terrace
description: Are you looking for a home away from home? This might be it! I'm traveling to Ibiza in June so it's free for you to stay in. My best friend lives around the corner and will take care of your needs. My roof terrace on the first floor is the coolest hiding place in town this summer. My home is welcoming. People say it feels 'like it's embracing you'. It's got everything you need and more. My apartment overlooks the always lively Jan Evertsenstraat. Never a dull moment.

name: Great apartment in central location in Amsterdam.
description: Our apartment lies in a quiet neighbourhood, though very close to the city center. That makes it a great getaway for people who want to be in the city but prefer to sleep quietly during the night. Our house is 85 m2 and is suitable for couples or a family with two small children.

name: Charming canal house in the heart of Amsterdam
description: A cozy 1 bedroom apartment of ~50m2 located in the centre of Amsterdam. The B&B is located in one of the famous ‘canal’ houses at the Brouwersgracht, which has once been voted as one of the most beautiful canals in Amsterdam. The space is on the first floor and offers an excellent view on the canal.  You have access to the whole apartment with private bedroom, bathroom and living room.

name: 2 Private Bedrooms In Amsterdam -1 min walk Metro
description:
Our shared apartment in peaceful Amsterdam offers easy access to food and drinks at Amsterdamse Poort and World of Food.

The metro station Venserpolder is just a two-minute walk away and can take you to most locations in the city. Train station Duivendrecht is a 10-minute walk away, providing access to main Dutch cities and the airport.

Our apartment offers a cozy, comfortable environment with private rooms, shared living spaces, and high-speed internet. Enjoy your stay in Amsterdam with us!

name: Knusse woonboot met parking in centrum Amsterdam
Appartement in city center of Amsterdam
description: This is centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated, with a beautiful outdoor location. Plenty of room to eat outside or relax on the lounge sofa, all for private. Inside it is also a very light appartement on the first floor.

description:
The Fabulous Suite is a luxury guest room with bathroom on the 1st floor and is completely private.

This room will surprise you, I promise!!

YOU CAN DROP OFF YOUR BAGS FROM 11:30 AM

Museumplein,Van Gogh museum,Rijksmuseum 4 min by foot

Very easily accessible with public transportation.
Central station 3 stops and Rai congress center 1 stop by metro
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

description:
A one-of-a-kind three-story houseboat in Amsterdam-Noord, on the outskirts of Amsterdam-Oost, overlooking Durgerdam, an old Dutch authentic fishing village.
The boat has three different outdoor decks with tables, seats and a hot tub.
We are renovating the entire boat, everything is being tackled one by one, and that means it is partly finished (the spacious salon with bar, toilet shower) and partly in full development, such as the wheelhouse upstairs and the bedrooms.

description:
Our 8-person private room with private shower comes with 4 bunk beds. Toilets are shared and are located on every floor.
Room comes with mobile AC unit that is installed only during the summer period.
All of our rooms are smoke-free but we have a smoking room next to the reception. We are located in the Leidseplein area at walking distance from all the great landmarks. Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

name: Cosy & colorful apartment with rooftop terrace
description: Living like a local in an authentic and quiet part of Amsterdam. The apartment 29m2 is cosy & practical.  Rooftop 18m2 offers 360 degrees view over the city. Within 500 meters you'll find the best breakfast at The Cottage, Massimo's famous ice cream or go for a pizza at Pazzi. If you feel like Coffee, Rum Baba and Bru are there to help or you can shop all your delicacies at Erik’s. The house is located between 3 parks and the Amstel River on walking distance, and a supermarket around the corner.

name: Luxe Bed&Breakfast midden in de Jordaan, Amsterdam
description: In the middle of Amsterdam ( De Jordaan) you find Maison Rose. A brand new renovate private appartment with all you want. 60 m2 for yourself. A big sleeping room with airco, a balcony, a pantry (no kitchen) with coffee and hot water and a little fridge. A little living room with a gas fireplace and a view at the canal. A big bathroom with bath and rain shower. Also a private toilet. Excluded breakfast.

description:
This is an active ship to cruise the bigger waters in and around Amsterdam with possibilities for sleep overs on open water on board.

Docked only a few minutes walking from Amsterdam Central Station with renovated living space. The boat has all facilities a normal house also has, from the quality you expect from a house. The location couldn't be better: inside the buzzing city center, yet on a quiet and peaceful dock.

description:
Welcome to 'Polin Canal & Garden House'!

Sunny and light ground-floor apartment (85 m²) in the heart of Amsterdam, featuring three bedrooms, a private courtyard garden (45 m²), and a view of one of the city’s most beautiful canals. Amsterdam at its best!

Located just behind the Royal Theatre Carré — one of Amsterdam’s most iconic buildings — and the famous Skinny Bridge. The canal view completes your authentic Amsterdam experience.

The whole apartment and the garden are non-smoking.

Bright and cozy apartment with 2 bedrooms and a large balcony, making it perfect for families.

description: We would like to welcome you on board for a unique stay in the captain's cabin of our ship De Hoop. You’ll wake up with the serenity of the water, whilst also being a 15 min tram ride to Amsterdam city centre.

name: Amsterdam Vondelpark family apartment in Oud-West
description:
Enjoy beautiful views over the Vondelpark from this bright and spacious family apartment in the heart of Amsterdam’s most popular Oud-West district.
Located in a quiet, car-free street right at the park’s entrance, just a 10-minute walk from the city’s famous museums and the lively Leidseplein.
For families, the Vondelpark offers plenty of fun for children, including a paddling pool and several playgrounds.
