description: Unique and spacious city villa of 250 m2 built under architecture; located in a very green area, near the Sloterstrand and the Sloterplas and only 10 minutes by bike from the center of Amsterdam.

name: 1-bedroom apt in Amsterdam
description: This stylish place to stay is perfect for visitors who want to see the beauty of the city while enjoying the local vibe. 20-25 mins walking to the center or 10 mins by bike with public transportation available all the time. In frony of the famous Vondelpark. You can find all grocery stores, bakeries, cafes and nice local bars and restaurants as you leave the apartment

name: Houseboat Amsterdam, free bikes, boat and parking
description:
This houseboat is 180m2 and situated in a magical spot.
You stay in a green area, but still conveniently located when you want to see the main Amsterdam attractions.
Being moored south of the central part of the city, you reach within 10 minutes by bike the busy streets of A'dam with all its facilities. Nearest public transport is a 18 min. walk.
To reach the houseboat you first have a short path through the woods leading to its garden in front of the houseboat. it is our own boat where we live.

name: Private room in Amsterdam near Metro
description:
Fully furnished room with a double bed, and a TV for your own streaming.
Fast wifi throughout the whole house, quiet and peaceful place for working from home.

Bus and metro stations are close by, with direct connections to the centre of Amsterdam, Bijlmer Arena, Gaasperplas, and Schiphol airport.

You will find all amenities to have the best comfortable stay!

You should expect to share the common areas of the house with other guests, and we expect you to respect our quiet and nice home.

name: JUNGLE THEME APARTMENT citycentre & bubble bath!
description: Just renovated apartment in city centre! New furniture, bedrooms with kingsize beds, bubblebath,walk in shower, balcony&dish washer! Our apartment is a 'jungle themed-heaven' for those who like a unique and comfortable stay! It is located in the city centre of Amsterdam. Directly on the monumental famous market: The Albert Cuyp market. Dont worry. The bedrooms are in the back of the apartment, therefor the buzz from the market will never wake you up, but will make your stay very pleasant!

name: Luxurious & spacious family home with sunny garden
description:
Spacious, luxurious (171sqm) and centrally located apartment at Amstel River. In “de Pijp”, Old South neighbourhood, close to the best bars, restaurants and Albert Cuyp market.

Our home, built in 1923, and has a monumental status. It was fully refurbished in 2020.

It's our family home, we only rent it out when we are on holiday ourselves. Please try to contact me directly. I'm the founder of touristdoc. I have a business profile on social media.

We prefer a couple or family with children

name: Enchanting parkview penthouse w/fireplace&terrace!
description: Exquisitely designed, light and spacious apartment with a delightful rooftop terrace in elegant historical Old East area near A’dam Center, overlooking a beautiful park with plenty of characteristic cafes! Enjoy observatory park views from a living room with a wood-burning fireplace or get enchanted by intimate cosiness of our bedroom upstairs, fusing Art Deco and Marrakech riad inspirations. Indulge in spa bathroom with mother-in-pearl mosaic or lounge on a magnificent royal bed with a view!

name: Flow: double room
description: The FLOW is a peaceful oasis in the center of Amsterdam. We are looking for guests who enjoy a unique stay on a boat and will not be partying as this does not fit with our other guests. This hostel offers adult accommodation with a shared lounge and a terrace. The shared bathroom includes a shower, and all rooms at the hostel are fitted with bed linen and towels.  The beds can comfortably fit up to 185 cm in length.

description:
Unique spacious warehouse style apartment with high ceilings, beautiful natural light, and a spectacular view over the canals. Wonderful space for families, with a master bedroom and two childrens bedrooms.

The apartment stretches the full length of the building, with light coming in from both sides.

name: IRU (Room not for parties)
description:
We offer 1 bedroom only with your own private bathroom (11,7 square meters) in a centrally located apartment. The room is for a maximum of 2 guests and has a double bed.
No access to the Kitchen and Living room (as local authority requests).
Breakfast is not provided.
No parties. No pets. No infants.
Self service check-in with a secure Masterlock box.
Check-in from 15.00 (3pm). Check-out no later than 10am.

name: Best spot in town
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

name: Designer Flat with Sunny Balcony in Trendy West
description:
You WON'T want to leave!

We put A LOT of love and thought into curating our house into a home that feels comfortable and full of life.

Because we both work from home, we went out of our way to equip it with the best amenities - air conditioning, high-speed mesh WiFi, 2x 4K OLED TVs (bedroom and living room), a beautiful wooden herringbone floor, fully equipped dynamic lighting and central heating.

Fully renovated 3 years ago. Quiet and well insulated, perfect for a weekend or a longer stay.

name: Room with bathroom in City villa, close centre.
description: Your private room with private bathroom and private entrance, is part of a new city villa in Amsterdam. The room has a great view on the water. Public transport is close and tramline 2 brings you in 15 minutes to centre of Amsterdam. Tramline 2 is going directly to Vondelpark, Museum Square (Van Gogh, Rijks Museum), Leidsche Square, Dam Square (Anne Frank House, Red Light District). We have free private parking. It is 25 minutes drive to North Sea beaches, Zandvoort, Scheveningen or Keukenhof.

name: Huis met privé tuin in Amsterdam West!
Unique apartment in Amsterdam's Jordaan district
description: This chic apartment is located in one of Amsterdam’s most trendy and historically rich neighborhoods. Live like a local; with local neighborhood markets around the corner,  many good restaurants, cafes and shops at a walking distance, but close to the buzzing city, museums and other tourist attractions.

name: Summer town house with country view!
description: Our amazing house combines the peace of a green oasis with the buzz of Amsterdam. The large private garden overlooks the Wilmkebreekpolder, a nature reserve with birds, cows, and sheep. Enjoy a quiet countryside breakfast surrounded by nature, while the vibrant city center—full of culture, cafés, and restaurants—is just a short bike ride away.

name: Enjoy ShipStays in Amsterdam!
description:
Make your trip unforgettable! Stay on board this authentic docked sailing ship.

This beautiful ship features comfortable cabins with private bathrooms & showers to make guests immediately feel at home.

The spacious lounge with it’s maritime feel is great for parties & get togethers.

With plenty of room to sleep 22 and a huge deck to relax and enjoy watching the sun set.

Welcome Aboard :)

name: Private Guest Suite Near Schiphol & Amsterdam
description:
Your own peaceful guest suite in Amsterdam and near schiphol✨
Private entrance, comfortable bedroom, hallway and private bathroom — all fully yours.
There is an interior door to the main house that stays closed and locked, ensuring complete privacy.
Enjoy fast WiFi, Apple TV, and a quiet area with parks, shops and a gym nearby.

name: Cosy Apartment next to the Vondelpark
description:
Cozy apartment in the heart of Amsterdam, just steps from Vondelpark and the city center. Filled with natural light, it has a private balcony.

Ideal for 1 or a couple, the kitchen opens onto the balcony. The bathroom has a spacious shower and a separate toilet. The bedroom has a comfortable double bed.

Some closets are locked as I live here, but there is still enough storage. Enjoy nearby amenities while relaxing in a peaceful, comfortable space.
I hope to welcome you in Amsterdam!

name: One-Bedroom Apartment in Amsterdam
description:
Stay in this bright apartment at the Catalonia Vondel Amsterdam hotel, excellently located just 300 meters from Vondelpark and Leidseplein. The apartment features a spacious living room with Smart TV, and Chromecast, a kitchen, and a bathroom with a washing machine. Additionally, you’ll enjoy all the conveniences of a hotel, including daily housekeeping, 24-hour reception, and an optional buffet breakfast.

IMPORTANT: Access to the apartment on the first floor is only available via stairs.

name: Canal-view 1-bed flat in the Pijp | 2P

name: Authentic, cosy, centrally located apartment
description: This light and cozy appartement (65 sq) has a spacious living room with side room (as a working space) and a spacious bedroom with king-size bed and balcony facing south. A stained glass door separates the bedroom from the rest of the apartment to allow sight and sunlight from both directions. The living room includes a cozy dining table suitable for 4 people and a sitting area. The kitchen is equipped with modern appliances and washing machine and dishwasher.

name: Centraal gelegen ruim appartement in Amsterdam
description: Beautiful spacious apartment with terrace and garden located against the Jordaan in Amsterdam. This stylish accommodation is perfect for people who appreciate luxury and space.

name: Cozy apartment in Oud-West, Amsterdam
description: Peaceful and fully renovated apartment located in the beautiful neighborhood of Oud-West, 10 minutes by bike to Amsterdam center and just 5 minutes walk to Vondelpark. Tram & bus within walking distance. It is a modern young area with many bars, restaurants and supermarkets.

name: New modern Apartment Amsterdam Zuid
description:
The apartment is less than a year in use. It is a bright apartment, very clean, modern, quiet because the apartment is located at the rear and not on the street side. The apartment is 2 minutes away from the Vondelpark and 5 minutes centrum.

it has an amazing double bed, a bathroom, and kitchen with bar, a dining table, a lovely sofa with TV.

no music, smoking or party's allowed!!! My house is in perfect condition and i want te keep it that way! Also because of the neighbors no music!

name: Charming Amsterdam Loft Canal View & Sunny Terrace
description:
Welcome to our charming apartment in the heart of Amsterdam! We are thrilled to offer you a comfortable and unique space that is just steps away from all the must-see museums and the picturesque Jordaan neighbourhood.

Our apartment boasts an incredible view over the canals, and you will have your own balcony to take it all in. With plenty of natural light streaming in from the windows reflecting on the high ceilings, you will feel right at home in this bright space.

name: Lovely bright 1- bedroom apartment in Amsterdam
description:
A bright and well-designed 68m2, 2 bedroom home with an open kitchen/dining room. 1 bedroom for a single or couple and 1 bedroom for a baby/toddler.

The apartment is located in Watersgraafsmeer & in walking distance to Oostpoort (10mins), & very close to all public transport.

The apartment is on the highest level (2nd floor), and located across from a small park with a nice green view. The apartment has a large balcony (afternoon sun facing) and recently renovated bathroom and kitchen.

name: Standard Small Double Room with small double bed
description:
The Euphemia was formerly a monastery built at the turn of the century.
The hotel is close to all the main tourist attractions within the city centre: Heineken Brewery, Leidseplein, nightlife area and the museums.
Due to its location on a quiet side street, one is able to escape the hustle of the city.
Stay with us, and you will be able to enjoy a great experience with comfortable accommodation and friendly service.
Accommodation to suit your budget!

name: Lovely Amsterdam center apartment with balcony
description:
Experience the best of Amsterdam in this lovely modern city studio.
All of Amsterdam highlights reachable in 10 minutes.
The apartment has a wide balcony with sun from midday till the evening.

name: Beautiful double floor apt on the Amsterdam Canals
Charmant appartement aan park
description:
A bright and sunny apartment overlooking the Erasmus Park and the Erasmusgracht in a quiet and green neighborhood of Amsterdam. It is about 10 minutes by bike or tram to the Jordaan (30 min. walking distance).

My house can be found on the top floor of a building from the 1930s, directly on the park. It has two spacious balconies on both sides, so you can enjoy the sun all day and evening.

A homey place from which you can discover the city:)

name: Lovely 1 bedroom apartment in Amsterdam
description:
This apartment is perfect for your stay in Amsterdam. It's large, bright, and has a really nice balcony that has morning/afternoon sun where you can sit and relax. It has a very spacious living room dining area, and a large bedroom.

It's very well connected to central Amsterdam via the metro and trains from the nearby Bijlmer station. You can also rent bikes from local shops to make your way around.

The apartment is situated right next to the Amsterdamse Poort with plenty of shops nearby.

name: Hip apartment with balcony near Vondelpark
description:
You will find this apartment in a beautiful and quiet neighborhood of Amsterdam South on the 2nd floor. (no elevator) It's just a 10 minute walk to the Vondelpark.
It’s perfect for them who wants to enjoy being in Amsterdam without being in the chaotic part of the city.

The living room is spacious and very comfortable with a great atmosphere. Sit down and relax while watching some television. The kitchen is fully equipped and a great place to cook & enjoy delicious meals.

name: Spacious apartment for 2 couples or a family
description:
Spacious & stylish two-story apartment on the first and second floor.

Perfectly suitable for a family and many public transport opportunities; within 15 min, you're standing at the Dam square right in the centre of Amsterdam.

The apartment is located in a quiet and safe residential area, close to the Vondelpark and Rembrandtpark.

One bedroom with a queen sized (160 x 200) bed and a 2nd bedroom with comfortable sleeping couch for 2.
Separate bathroom, kitchen and a nice large living room.

description: This is my lovely little pearl that I let a few days a year for the ones that want to feel real Amsterdam , located in the finest central spot in Amsterdam, 5 min to rverything, romantic street and building, unique canal living feel. the street is peaceful with relaxing sound and shimmer of water, in a old historical Amsterdam building with an wonderful  view over the canal.

name: Bright spacious family apartment
description:
Bright family home in peaceful Watergraafsmeer, Amsterdam East. Faces a playground and near parks, cafés, shops, and bars. Everything is walk-able or bike-able. Close to Amstel and Science Park train station.
3 floors: full kitchen, living room and terrace, 2 teenager bedrooms, 1 adult, 2 bathrooms, roof terrace. Ideal for families with kids and a great base to explore Amsterdam and beyond. Not suitable for more than 2 adults and 2 children. In Amsterdam a maximum of 4 people is allowed.

name: Amazing apartment with roof terrace in Amsterdam.
description:
Beautiful and cozy apartment located in the heart of Amsterdam, just a few meters away from the beautifull Vondelpark.
The apartment has 58 m2 + 24 m2 roof terrace with your own bbq to enjoy beautiful evenings and sunsets.
The apartment has one room and one sofa bed in the living. Is located 20 min away from Schipol airport and 3 minutes from Canals in public transport.
The area is ideal to enjoy the quiteness of Vondelpark and still be close enough from all the touristic spots from Amsterdam.

description: Our bright and spacious house has 3 floors and a roof terrace. Ideal for a family or for two couples. The house is in a quiet street, but the city center and also the most important museums are close by. The ideal base for an inspiring stay in Amsterdam.

name: Mooi, nieuw, luxe appartement in hartje Amsterdam
description: Unique, cozy and stylish apartment with a bedroom and connected balcony terrace. Beautifully renovated with open kitchen, living room and home office. Located in a prime location with cozy terraces, shops and restaurants, 5 min walk to the Vondelpark, and close to popular neighborhoods such as De Pijp, Museum square, Zuid, Central Amsterdam. The street is very peaceful, for a good night's sleep. Enough parking spots, or spots to lock your bike. A great Amsterdam experience.

name: Cozy home in the old west of Amsterdam
description: Welcome to my cozy, newly renovated apartment in Amsterdam West! Located just 5 mins from Rembrandt and a 15 min walk to famous Vondelpark. With a fully equipped kitchen and spacious balcony, your stay will be enjoyable. Bus 18 is a 2-min walk away, providing easy access to the city center. It is my personal apartment, I also live in. Only airbnb while I am travelling.

name: Cosy home in De Pijp
description: I invite you to my home, which I rent out for period when I am away, so you can have full 'Home away from Home' experience. On a very peaceful typical Amsterdam street of De Pijp, around the corner from the coolest cafes, wine bars, restaurants and boutiques and literally 5 min bike ride (15min walk) from the Amsterdam City Center.

name: Gaaf appartement naast het park
description:
Welcome in my cool apartment, around the corner of the Jordaan and the Westerpark. 40m2 on the first floor of a building from 1885! It has been fully renovated in 2009 so its well-maintained. In this place you are sleeping on a Auping matras, a very comfortable dutch bed. Next to that the TV has a chromecast. Enjoy your stay!

At this moment I am only accepting people with reviews. Thanks.

name: Spacious apartment with garden, close to centre
description:
Spacious, luxurious apartment with garden facing south. The apartment is located only a 10 minute bike-ride from the city centre, museumsquare and 5 minutes from the Vondelpark, plus there is a park only 1 minute walk from here . The tram and bus stops in front of the house, so reaching all interesting locations using public transport is also very easy.
There is a separate room if you need to do some work and you can relax in the garden when you need a break.

name: Lovely apartment in Calm street in A'dam
description:
Want to stay in a quiet neighbourhood, that is easy to reach from the Amsterdam city-centre? Then I would be more than happy to welcome you to my cosy 1-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam Zuid-Oost. You will have your own kitchen, bathroom and living room, with a sofa bed to relax.

The apartment is affordable with various public transportation options. Hot spots nearby are the Nelson Mandela park, the Amsterdamse Poort shopping centre, Pathe City, and the stadium.

name: Peaceful Getaway on Historic Amsterdam Dike
description: Recently fully renovated dike house on the beloved Nieuwendammerdijk – one of Amsterdam’s most charming spots. Just steps from the Vliegenbos forest, local cafés and nature, yet only 15 min. from the city center. The perfect mix of peace, space and village charm with the energy of the city. Includes king-size bed, sofa bed, French-door-balcony, garden and modern comforts. Baby cot available on request. Perfect for families.

name: Lovely apartment Amsterdam
description: Cozy studio apartment 40sq meters, close to the city center. Nearby Vondelpark, 12 min walk to Leidseplein. Located on the perfect location with bars, restaurants and where locals go. Supermarket 1 min way. Please no parties! The walls are very very thin and neighbours complaining about any music or hard talk - also please please walk the staircase quietly especially at night.

name: High class room Pijp- approved for Airbnb
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located room with a private entrance.
The Pijp is the most exciting neighbourhood in Amsterdam and is situated only a 2 min walk from the world famous Albert Cuyp market and the fabulous Sarphatipark.
Tram 4 will take you to the Center of town in less then 9 min and even less by bicycle.
The best location in town with loads of Bars, restaurants and many attractions.

name: Modern guesthouse at canal near center
description:
This centrally located place is modernly designed and has all things you need for a short trip.
For summers: naturally cooled, since its partly underground.
In Winters: cozy warm due to floor heating.

name: Cozy centrally located apartment in 'de Pijp'
description:
This apartment is located in the nicest area of Amsterdam: 'de Pijp'. It is surrounded by cozy restaurants and cafes perfect for a night out.

The apartment is close to these famous hotspots in Amsterdam:
- The Albert Cuyp market is around the corner
- Rijksmuseum and Museumplein is a 14-minute walk away
- Leidseplein is a 5-minute bike ride
- Rembrandtplein is a 16-minute walk away
- Dam Square is 8 minutes by bike
- The Anne Frank House is 12 minutes by bike

name: Appartement in Amsterdam-west met groot dakterras
description: This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated. The apartment is in a quiet street in “de Baarsjes”. In the street there are nice restaurants and the Rembrandtpark, Erasmuspark and Westerpark are just steps away. The apartment is within walking distance of the Jordaan and has tram and bus options around the corner. Within 10-15 minutes by tram in the middle of the city center of Amsterdam.

name: Room in stylish cozy apartment, big sunny balcony
description: A lovely ROOM (apt shared with me) Amsterdam West first floor apartment that can easily reached by public transport (direct connection from Central station or station Sloterdijk). The apartment is very clean, spacious, and nicely decorated. The big balcony faces the South-West, so catches the sun until late. The kitchen is very well-equipped with a Nespresso machine, a Quooker (instant boiling water), Smeg oven, dishwasher and everything else you would expect. Bathroom and toilet are separate.

name: Eclectic Two-Bedroom Apartment with Sunny Rooftop
description: You found an Amsterdam gem! This comfortable and charming two-bedroom apartment in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam Zuid, combines all modern amenities with funky decorative elements. The apartment is bright and spacious, and has a sunny rooftop terrace. It's just a five minute walk to de Pijp, the go-to area for eating and going out and only a ten minute walk to the Museumplein for your daily dose of Dutch art and culture. Everything you need for your perfect stay in the city!

name: Lovely 2 bedroom (close to metro & cheap parking)
description:
If you want a quiet and relaxed base to explore Amsterdam, you've come to the right place!
Located in Amsterdam Noord, 5 mins walk from the Noord/Zuidlijn metro you can be in the city center in no-time. If you come by car, I got you covered because parking is super cheap here

The apartment has a large and sunny balcony to relax a fully equipped kitchen a large living room and 2 spacious bedrooms.
Bedroom 1 has a 180x200 bed Bedroom 2 has a sleeping couch that easily hosts 2 people.

name: Spacious 2BR by Vondelpark, great value
description: This lovely family home combines classic charm with modern amenities. Located in the heart of the city, it’s nestled in a quiet residential area, offering both excitement and peace. Nearby, you’ll find trendy restaurants and bars, and top attractions like museums and Vondelpark are just a short walk away. With two bedrooms, it’s perfect for couples, families, or a group of friends.

name: Modern Apartment in the heart of Amsterdam
description:
Enjoy a classy experience in the heart of Amsterdam at this strategically situated establishment. The house has two bedrooms, a patio, a wine cooler, and a modern design. The patio has two heaters as well as a Sonos soundbox. The flat comes with a complete Sonos kit. Sonos is also used in the toilet and shower.

A strong restriction on No Party is in place. In addition, the patio is a no-smoking zone.

name: Luxurious apartment on central & quiet location
description:
Explore Amsterdam from our luxurious, light-filled apartment that’s in a central but very quiet location. Our apartment is suitable for 4 adults plus one baby / child. As the neighborhood is nice and quiet we would like you to respect that and prefer families and couples to stay in our home.

We have three bedrooms, one master bedroom, one smaller bedroom (also study) and one baby room. The second bedroom has a good quality sleeping couch (a bit smaller).

name: Design apartment with canal view
description:
We are thrilled to share our brand new apartment in the centre of Amsterdam. In 2022 we moved in after an extensive renovation of our monumental building.

If you're into Scandinavian design and don't mind waking up with an incredible view this is your place. Giving you a front row seat at the famous seven bridges.

The magical canal view is something we enjoy everyday. We will be away for a few days giving you a chance to experience this for yourself.

name: Beautiful large 1920s city home
description:
*** This property allows maximum 4 persons due to new law in The Netherlands ***

Nestled on the picturesque, tree-lined Prins Hendriklaan, one of Amsterdam’s most desirable residential streets, this elegant 1923-built 413 m² townhome offers an exceptional blend of space, style, and modern comfort. With five floors, four well-appointed bedrooms (1 King, 3 Queen), and 2 bathrooms with 2 half baths, the home is ideal for family gatherings or refined group stays.

name: Beautiful City Center Condo w/360° rooftop terrace
description:
Our spacious (100m2) and recently renovated (2023) appartement with 360° Amsterdam view rooftop terrace (20m2) and balcony, is located in a beautiful alley in the Jordaan, next to one of Amsterdam’s most prestigious canals ‘Prinsengracht’. The famous ‘Noordermarkt’, with one its finest street markets on Saturday, is -literally- just around the corner.

In 5-10 minutes walking distance you are at Central Station, can visit the Anne Frank House or the Nine Streets with its famous boutique shops.

Bright apartment located in the east of Amsterdam 5 minutes from Muideport station. (One train station from the central station, very convenient) and tram, 1, 3, 14 at 3-4 minutes.
2nd floors accessible by stairs only. the apartment is quiet, bright with a very relaxing living room - dining room with a comfortable bed (queen size),
1 bedroom with a comfortable bed (king size), 1 toilet/bathroom, kitchen, and a large balcony with sun all afternoon ☀️

The city center can be reached in 10 minutes by bike or public transport and there are several bars, supermarkets, restaurants and parks (Oosterpark, Frankendaelpark) within walking distance!

- 1 bunk bed with 2 adult size single beds

Bens The Walton features free Wi-Fi. The apartments are split over two floors with modern decoration and a natural colour interior.

name: ★ PENTHOUSE SUITE ★ VONDELPARK VIEW ★ BALCONY ★
description:
Beautiful sun kissed penthouse overlooking the Vondelpark with a lofty feeling master bedroom with balcony.

Spacious living room, with open kitchen, dining area and comfortable lounge area.

Very quiet area, guarantees a great sleep at night, but also very central within easy walking distance of the museums and old city center.

This hidden gem is where you want to be. Right next to the Vondelpark, the Vondelstraat is arguably the prettiest street of Amsterdam.

Plus a lovely cat Boris.

name: Great appartement in Amsterdam,perfect for family
description:
This light apartment is located in one of Amsterdam best neighborhoods! Close to the city center, 3 minute walk from train station, and a very green and quiet neighborhood. A lot of playgrounds close by.

The apartment is perfect for families with 1,2 or 3 kids. There are 3 bedrooms, 1 with a double bed, 1 with a bunkbed for 2 kids (max 1.40m, and 1 with a baby bed.

Only for families!

Wonderful place from which to discover our beautiful city. We are looking forward to welcoming you!

name: Bright and spacious apartment right in the center
description:
Enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place, while at the same time very relaxing and authentic (where actual locals live!). Walking distance to Vondelpark, and less than 20 min to all main touristic areas by public transport.

Has shower, bathtub and two balconies.

name: Bright and spacious apartment on the canal
description:
Bright and spacious 1 bedroom apartment in one of nicest neighbourhoods of Amsterdam (west).

A true gem located in a quiet street close to multiple parks, while at the same time walking/cycling distance from the canals and city centre. The apartment is spacious, bathes in natural light, is tastefully decorated, well maintained and clean.

name: 5-star apartment in Amsterdam centre (with garden)
description:
Luxury and renovated city apartment of 75 m² in the heart of Amsterdam, within walking distance of all hotspots including the popular Bosboom Toussaintstraat (2 min) and Vondelpark (5 min).

The apartment – located on the ground floor – is wonderfully decorated and offers a unique view of the canals. At the back of the house, you can enjoy the large garden, fully equipped with all comforts. Enjoy this wonderful apartment and experience everything Amsterdam has to offer!

name: Spacious, family friendly home right on the canal
description:
Spacious, bright and family friendly home in the heart of Amsterdam on one of the most peaceful and quiet canals. High ceilings, with a large living room overlooking the canal and separate kitchen/dining area.
Two large bedrooms with queen size beds overlooking a garden. Both bedrooms have their own bathrooms. (Baby bed + crib available upon request)
The home is located on the second floor, with easy elevator access. Restaurants, shops and public transport right around the corner.

name: Familiehuis met ruime tuin en eigen parkeerplaats
description:
This spacious house is extremely suitable for families. The house features a spacious south-facing garden with a trampoline. The house is in the quiet neighborhood of Elzenhagen in Amsterdam-Noord. Within 5 minutes' walking distance, you will find the Noord/Zuid metro line, which will take you to Amsterdam city center within 5 minutes. Furthermore, the house is close to the A10 highway, so it is also easily accessible by car. The house has its own parking space.
Registration number: Z/22/2035779

name: Top-notch apartment in central Amsterdam
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located spacious apartment. The 100m2 luxurious apartment has 1 large bedroom with 1 king sized bed, 1 large bathroom and a balcony. It is fully equipped with all necessities and more to make you feel at home.

Convenient for couples and sleeps a maximum of 3 adults (1 large bed + 1 sofa bed). No parties allowed and strictly non smoking.

Located in the beautiful neighborhood of Jordaan in the center of Amsterdam.

name: Beautiful 3BR family house near Vondel Park +RoofT
description:
This amazing two floor house has everything you and your family needs, luxury, comfort and great surroundings.

This familyproof 5 room appt is easy to get to by public (metro, tram and bus stops are 5 min away). Easy by car as well (10 min drive from Schiphol). The famous Vondelpark is a 10 minute walk away!. There are plenty playgrounds for kids close by, theres plenty of fun for all ages with many nice bars and restaurants close by as well as the sunny canal on the intersection.

name: Cozy corner flat in the front of Westerpark
description:
Enjoy Amsterdam in this peaceful and centrally-located place, with the most beautiful city park at your feet - Westerpark! 15 min bus ride from AMS Centraal, full of shops and nice restaurants around the corner.

Please note the flat is on the 4th floor in a traditional Amsterdam building with no elevator.

name: Stylish & Cosy 2-bedroom apartment | 94m2
description:
This centrally located apartment is ideal for your stay in Amsterdam. Located in the quiet Frederik Hendrikbuurt, yet close to many sights. The Jordaan, Oud-West and Westerpark are within walking distance of the apartment. The canals and, for example, the Anne Frank House are also around the corner.

Several trams and buses stop one street away.

There is a park on one side of the street and a canal on the other.

name: Arty House with garden in oud west
description: We have a beautiful ground floor apartment in the cosy Oud-West  borough of Amsterdam. The bedroom is located at the front of the house, while at the back we have a spacious, gallery-like living room with doors that open up to a 70 square meter garden. The living room has a seating area, dining table and an open kitchen in a single connected area. As you can see from the photographs, we take pleasure in filling our apartment with books, plants, unique art objects and weird thrift store finds.

name: Raam Studio 2
description:
Great studio to get away for a few days. Very centrally located in Amsterdam, near Leidseplein and the famous canals. Also the museum district is on 10 minutes walking. If you would like to go further, the public transport is also around the corner.
The studio itself is very practical and light and has everything you will need.
Hope to see you here!

name: Bright and Cosy Apartment - Great Location!
description:
Comfortable 1-bedroom apartment in the top neighbourhood in Amsterdam.

The location is great to explore the city center while having your own privacy.

Around the corner you'll find a main street with variety of local shops, coffee shops, supermarkets, restaurants, bars and fresh-market.
- 10 minutes walk to city center
- 5 minute walk to the Vondelpark.
- 2 minutes walk to public transport

Apartment has unlimited 100mbps high speed wifi for people who prefer remote work & travelling.

name: 3-Floor Luxury Apt in Cozy Street in Center of AMS
description:
Luxurious, authentic 3 floor apt. 5min walking from the canals. Located 1km from central station/100m from entrance of Westerpark/5min walking from the Jordaan and canals.

The apt. is spacious (193m2), decorated with high-end furniture and is comfortable (fully equipped open kitchen, cooking island w. bar seats, sunny rooftop terrace w. BBQ, walk-in shower and bath tub).

2 bedrooms+1 separate office. Large living room. Lovely street w. all amenities needed. Fast wifi everywhere, incl. rooftop.

name: Villa in Amsterdam met grote tuin
description:
We rent out our stylish house located in one of the historic neighborhoods in the Amsterdam-Noord district. The house combines the dynamic Amsterdam atmosphere with a picturesque village feel. Ideal for a couple or family of four. Parking is free.

The house is spacious, bright and welcoming with four bedrooms and two bathrooms. The large backyard is sunny and green. In the backyard or on the terrace there is plenty of space to eat outside and for children to play.

name: Enjoy ShipStays in Amsterdam!
description:
Make your trip unforgettable with Ship Stays!

Whether you enjoy the sun on the back deck, pass the time on the middle deck with parlor games, or dare to climb onto the mast with a safety belt and enjoy the unique view from the top, there really is something for everyone here!

Welcome Aboard! :)

name: Ruim, licht appartement met perfecte ligging
description:
Spacious and bright apartment. A perfect base;
In a quiet neighborhood within walking distance of Lelylaan train station, 6 minutes from Schiphol airport, 11 minutes from central Amsterdam. Walking distance to tram and metro and a 5-minute bike ride from Vondelpark.

With balconies on east, south, and west side, you always start and end the day in the sun. The spacious living room, nicely furnished bedroom, well-equipped kitchen and separate study make this the perfect place to discover the city and its surroundings.

name: Monument in the heart of historical centre
description: Our monumental home was built in 1638 and is located in a car-free alley in the heart of Amsterdam. You'll be in walking distance from the canals (2 min), Dam square (5 min), central station (8 min or 1 tram stop) and a huge variety of shops, restaurants & bars. Having all the benefits from Amsterdam city life combined with a stunning view on a secluded garden (sadly the garden can’t be used by guests).

name: Luxury 97m2 Penthouse Amsterdam City Center
description:
Our home is the place where we escape from the city buzz. The beautiful building was built under architecture in 1994 and that is reflected in the use of industrial materials such as a steel floor and frames and the large windows. Big highlights are the two central roof windows and a balcony which spans over the entire width of the house.

Note: We have recently upgraded both the Air Conditioning of the top floor and the master bedroom. As well as the floors of both bedrooms incl. new cupboard.

name: Lovely bedroom with nice balcony & green view!
description:
A bedroom with a nice balcony and wonderful green view in a cozy apartment. The tram station where tram number 1 & 17 passes are 3 minutes walk from the apartment, and in 15 minutes you are in the center of Amsterdam.
very close to Lelylaan station & schiphol airport.
**Blacony can be used for smoking but only normal cigarettes and not anything else**
If the booking is done for 3/4 guests, a single bed and a sofa bed (for 4th guest) in the bedroom shown in the last photo will be provided.

name: City Center Canal area apartment
description: This bright apartment is one of the most centered places in the City. Only 8mins walk from the famous Rijksmuseum & Van Gogh Museum. Only 8 mins walking from the Rembrandtplein or Leidseplein district for restaurants, bars & clubs. Only 5 mins walking from the Heineken Museum & trendy 'Pijp' district. Less than 300m from the all-new Metro Line which connects all parts of the city. All in all, this place is good for couples, business travelers, and families

name: Woonark De Appeltuyn
description:
On our recently built houseboat, De Appeltuyn, you will enjoy staying among the ducks, swans and passing boats! Our houseboat has a separate area to stay in with a kitchen, bathroom, separate toilet and two double rooms. We are easily accessible by public transportation. The NDSM ferry, which takes you to and from Amsterdam Central Station, is 7 minutes' cycling distance from us.

We look forward to welcoming you for an unforgettable stay!

name: Canal view apartment
description:
Central and newly renovated apartment near Museumplein and in the trendy de Pijp area of Amsterdam.

Street and Building renovation is complete and there is no disruption or scaffoldings in place.

name: Bright Modern Apartment Near Vondelpark
description: Explore the hart of Amsterdam from our modern Oud-West apartment, steps from the Rijksmuseum. Enjoy a bright space, a well-equipped kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, and nearby parks. Foodhallen's culinary delights await. Ideal for city and cultural adventures.

name: Spacious home, between city centre & country side
description: Large house & garden in a quiet area, ideal for families with small children. Our newly built home provides all modern day conveniences while the neighbourhood is designed according to local Dutch tradition. You can use 2 bikes that come with child seats, so ideal if you want to explore Amsterdam and surroundings. City centre is a 10 min bike and 10 min ferry ride away. A similar trip gets you to Twiske national park or one of the many countryside villages that surround the north of Amsterdam

name: Charming Amsterdam houseboat
description:
These two unique and romantic studios are sure to please. With a rustic Scandinavian design and the swans swimming by you can completely relax, while you are right in the heart of the city!
I have many tips to make the best of Amsterdam, and enjoy a true Dutch experience!

name: A B&B in the historical centre with sauna.
description: In this unique accommodation you are right where it all happens. It is almost impossible to get more central than this room in the center of Amsterdam. The room is located at the back, the building can be a quiet place for city center concepts. In the room you will find the sauna, adjacent to the room is the bathroom, which is equipped with a sink, a shower and a shower.

name: Grand 4 Bedroom Townhouse with a Roof Terrace
description:
This stand-alone, five-story 17th-century canal house is located in one of the most charming parts of Amsterdam’s historic center — right in the heart of the famous ‘Nine Streets’ district. Just steps away, you’ll find an abundance of boutiques, restaurants, theaters, and bars.

The house features four bedrooms and four bathrooms, a spacious kitchen and dining room, a comfortable living room with a separate TV area, and a private roof terrace.

name: Adult Only | Luxury Apartment | Museum District
description:
Luxurious fully furnished 2-bedroom
apartment in a triple-A location on the most prestigious shopping street, a 2-minute walk from the Van Gogh Museum and Rijksmuseum. Private apartment entrance within the building, no elevator. Two floors, full kitchen & living area, 1 full and 2 half bathrooms, 2 king beds, AC, balcony and sunscreens. Total 102 m² / 1,098 sq ft. €5,500 per month incl. utilities and Wi-Fi, excl Airbnb fees/taxes.

name: Large penthouse with roof terrace near Vondelpark
description:
This stunning 130m² penthouse features three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a spacious 60m² roof terrace. The newly renovated upper level includes two bedrooms and a full bathroom.

Fully furnished for a "home away from home" experience, it accommodates up to four adults. No parties or smoking allowed.

Ideally located near Vondelpark, the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, and Stedelijk Museum, with shops, restaurants, and bars within walking distance.

name: Funky 1 bedroom apartment in trendy De Pijp
description:
Cozy 1 bedroom apartment filled with plants and art. It features a spacious living area, king size bed, and newly renovated bathroom & kitchen. Perfect for working from home as it has a dedicated office corner with desk, ergonomic chair and monitor.

You’ll be staying in the heart of De Pijp neighborhood, 15 min walk from the city center, as well as a few minutes away from the Amstel river, the famous Albert Cuyp market, and some of Amsterdam’s best restaurants, bars and cafes.

name: 200 m2 houseboat on a lake in Amsterdam
description: We live in a unique three-stories housebout on the 'buiten-IJ' lake in the North of amsterdam. You can overlook the green pastures and the pastoral Durgerdam, an old fisherman village.

name: Private Apartment. Living, bed and bathroom.
description: Top location in the canal belt. This is a convenient one bedroom ground floor apartment on a canal in the heart of a vibrant neighborhood in Central Amsterdam. The apartment is comfortably furnished with a private living room, bathroom, and bedroom with king size bed. The location is within easy walking distance to local cafes and shops and a  short walk to museums. You can also rent bicycles nearby to explore the city like a local. In the apartment is a kitchen however no cooking possible.

name: Room in canal house. Private shower and toilet.
description: Top location in the canal belt. This is a convenient bedroom in a house  on a canal in the heart of a vibrant neighborhood in Central Amsterdam. The room is with a private shower, sink and toilet. The location is within easy walking distance to local cafes and shops and a  short walk to museums. You can also rent bicycles nearby to explore the city like a local.

name: Lovely new room
description:
Stylish apartment in a quiet street. Not far from the centre, and there's enough entertainment around. The place is very comfortable with a lovely Auping bed, own entrance, Nespresso and good shower.

WIFI, Nespresso, shower, no cooking facilities.

Bos en Lommer is a great neighborhood, with many restaurants and shops.

name: Cozy swimming paradise houseboat with garden
description: Our house feels like it's holiday everyday. The houseboat is open and spacious, inside and outside spaces become one with good weather. Ideal place for a couple or a family up to 2 kids. There is a big waterside terrace with childproof fences, a slide and trampoline on the water for the kids. And a small garden as well, where we have chicken, a playhouse and a climbing wall. On top of that we are only 10 bike minutes from the ferry to Amsterdam Central station.

name: Fijne gezinswoning vlakbij Amsterdam-Centrum
description: Cozy, spacious family home including parking space, 20 minutes from Amsterdam city center, 10-minute walk to Blijburg city beach. 5-minute drive to Amsterdam Castle. 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, garden, and balcony. Our home is very suitable for families; that is our preference. IJburg is a quiet residential area with nice shops, supermarkets, restaurants, a swimming area, a harbor, and a direct tram line to Centraal Station.

name: Chique- private appartement- center pijp
description:
This centrally located town house is tasteful, bright, homey and chic. You have a bathroom, 2 bedrooms (1 double bed and 1 foldable bed), dining area, open kitchen and south-facing balcony. In the middle of the Pijp, 1 step outside the door and you are sitting on nice hip terraces and surrounded by local Amsterdam. Public transport around the corner. Close to - Albert Cuyp market - Heineken experience - Sarphati park - Boarding canal cruise boat - Museum Quarter - Leidseplein
Everything is within walking distance!

name: Bright apartment (+hottub) centrally in Amsterdam
description:
Centrally located in a neighborhood called "De Pijp", which is famous for its many bars, restaurants, the Sarphatipark and the Albert Cuyp market.
Due to its central location within minutes you'll be around the city.
Public transport around the corner.

It's a bright apartment on the second floor.
There's one bedroom, a bathroom with a hot tub including a TV and a separate toilet. Each room has a TV with a chromecast. The living room has a large sofa, an open kitchen and dining table.

Enjoy!

name: Design Canal Apartment
description:
Have you ever imagined staying right at the canals of Amsterdam?

Wake up to the view of the swans in the canal, have breakfast by the waterside, BBQ at the private garden and enjoy 3 parks within walking distance: Rembrandtpark (5min), Vondelpark (10min) and Erasmus park (10min)

Stay in the hip area of Amsterdam West, away from the touristic chaos of the city center, within easy reach to main tourist attractions and coolest restaurant and bars.

Search @casa.admiral on insta for a full tour

name: Spacious apartment with allday sun rooftop terrace
description: This spacious apartment is the perfect hide away in the city, this sunny and bright apartment has a big rooftop terrace.

name: Large flat in green area of Amsterdam West
description:
Flat of 95m2 a few steps away from Plein 40-45, located in trendy New-West. In the middle of greenery with a large and private balcony directed to the South-West.

We have two sleeping rooms, and a sofa bed in the living room.

The flat comes with a free parking and an elevator.

The neighborhood is not touristic and quite: you can reach the center in less than 30 minutes by tram 7, bus 21/80 or bike. And located close to Sloterdijk (Bus 369).

Optimal for a family with one or two children.

name: Recently renovated appartement in Amsterdam
description:
The appartement is in the hippest neigborhood 'de Pijp' in Amsterdam. Thus appartement is within walking distance to a lot of bars, restaurants and city highlights.

The appartement is renovated in february with a new kitchen, paintjob and floor.

You will have everything you need, from TV to dishwasher.

name: Nice apartment in Amsterdam close by city
description:
Relax and unwind in this peaceful, stylish space. Entirely private apartment of 60m2. Wake up in the morning with a coffee on the back balcony, laze around all afternoon in the hanging chairs on the front balcony.
Within walking distance of the Bos en Lommerplein shopping center.
Get on your bike and you'll be in the city center within 15 minutes!
There is 1 bedroom with 1 double bed. If you want to come with more people (Max 4 in total), I can put a double mattress in the living room.

name: Modern apartment in Amsterdam West
description: Welcome to this modern and bright apartment in the trendy Amsterdam West. Upon entering the beautifully renovated apartment you directly notice how much space to live, eat and chill it has to offer.

name: Museum district, beautiful renovated house
description:
Nice renovated appartement.

In the middle of the museum district.
Next to Amsterdams most famous street market, the Albert Cuyp.

Close to city center.

Roof terrace available with sun way beyond any street terrace.

In De Pijp, most vibrant neighborhood of Amsterdam.

Hosts 3 people, with 1 person sleeping on the couch.

Washing machine available
Dishwasher available


50meters from the subway entrance
250meters from vibrant pub-area
10 minute walk from Leidse, main center city square

name: Amazing apartment canal view and private terrace!
description: Great place to stay in the middle of the city centre. Close to the Ann Frank house and with a view on the canals. Super luxury apartment with a private brand-new sunny terrace!

name: Charming apartment with garden in Amsterdam South
description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place in the heart of Amsterdam South. Spacious living/dining setup with access to beautiful veranda and garden. Super close to RAI convention center; with easy walking distance to public transportation. Perfect place for (two) couples, families and business travelers.

name: Ruim familiehuis A'dam met gratis parkeerplek
description:
Spacious and bright family home in Amsterdam with a nice garden near the water. Located in the quiet neighborhood of IJburg. And within 15 minutes by public transportation to Amsterdam Central to discover bustling Amsterdam.

The space
Spacious house of 145 m2, spread over 3 floors, with a 3.2 m high ceiling in open kitchen and living room. 3 bedrooms with 1 king bed and 2 double beds. 2 toilets and 1 bathroom with bath and shower.

Registration number
0363 6E45 3F5A 630F 8F4C

name: Epic apartment with garden close to Vondelpark
description:
Beautiful ground floor apartment located by a canal and on a quiet cul de sac in the nicest area of ​​Amsterdam.

The apartment has a playful layout:
-dining and sitting area
-stair cupboard
-toilet with sink
-sleeping area with a large double bed (2.2x1.8m) of top quality
-living area
-built-in closet with washing machine and dryer
-kitchen with dishwasher, combination microwave/oven and a delicious coffee machine
-bathroom with a large bathtub and a separate shower

name: High-end boutique apartment near city center!
description:
Our property is situated in an old historical building located in the West part of Amsterdam, only a stroll away from the Rembrandt Park. The airport is only 7 minutes away by train. Bens The Walton features free Wi-Fi. Furthermore bicycles are available for rent. The apartments are split over two floors with modern decoration and a natural colour interior.

We offer free coffee, tea and chocolate milk for our guests in the lobby, next to the workbar as we love given back to our guests.

name: High-end boutique apartment near city center!
description:

name: Charming 2 bedroom apartment in vibrant Jordaan
description:
Lovely 4 person apartment in the middle of the Jordaan with two bedrooms. The location of the apartment is a 1 minute walk from the world famous Amsterdam canals and right next to the lovely 9 streets. In the apartment you can find fast internet and a smart TV where you can watch Netflix and HBO. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you would need to prepare a Michelin star caliber meal.

Additionally, with 70m2 the apartment is very spacious.

Energy Label C

name: Romantic ‘Aft Cabin’ on Board of an Icebreaker
description: Please be welcome on our unique houseboat, a former East-German icebreaker, tug, pusher and fire boat built in 1954. We ourselves live in the front part, the aft cabin – the former crew bunks - we converted into a cozy little studio with a vintage feel. The wooden interior gives a warm ambience, and the acoustics are great. A beautiful, clean place to work or to rest, to relax or to make music in.

name: Comfortabele gezinswoning in Amsterdam-Noord
description: A nice house for a family with young children. A 10-minute bike ride from the city center of Amsterdam and a bus stop around the corner. Close to a park, a forest, lots of restaurants. But also not far from waterland, one of the most beautiful nature reserves in the Netherlands. A nice neighborhood in Amsterdam, in a house that is equipped with all comforts.

name: Spacious apartment w. big balcony, center 20 mins
description: This stylish place with two bedrooms (one double, one single) is perfect for couples or a company of three and is located in a quiet residential neighborhood 20 MINUTES AWAY FROM THE CENTER. A perfect crash pad for touristing in Amsterdam! The beautifully decorated apartment also features 2 working stations if a remote work-friendly environment is what you are after. Cheap parking (for Amsterdam standards) on the street, and Sunday is free.

name: Super cosy apartment with garden!
description: This apartment is a real pearl for people that like Amsterdam but also like to stay in a quiet green area. The apartment got totally renovated 5 years ago into a sweet vintage jazzy crib :) You can play vinyls or listen to the birds in the nice private garden. The apartment is located in Amsterdam North. 15 min by bike or 20 min by public transport from Amsterdam Central Station. Supermarkets around the corner and surrounded by beautifull nature.

description:
Feel at home in this spacious, light and cozy appartement in a peaceful neighborhood close to the Vondelpark and the Amsterdam city center. Use all facilities that normally make this a great place to live for me. Feel free to share your request for an unforgettable stay!

The apartment is a 10-minute walk to Vondelpark and Rembrandtpark, and just a 3 minute walk to the tram and bus stops. In 10 minutes, you can reach Leidseplein, and in 15 minutes, Dam Square, by direct tram.

name: Light and spacious apartment in the cosy Baarsjes
description:
Very light and spacious apartment 64m2 in the popular city area de Baarsjes in Amsterdam. Experience Amsterdam from this trendy area with nice bars and in 10 minutes you’re on Dam square, the Jordaan area or in the Pijp.

The apartment itself has a fully newly renovated bathroom and is very cosy to chill at night but also to have a nice drink if you want!

Ask me any questions you might have :)

name: ★★★ NEW: FAMILY-FRIENDLY APARTMENT + GARDEN ★★★
description:
Make your stay in Amsterdam memorable by staying in this brand new apartment with a (shared) garden.

The two bedrooms, bathroom, toilet, dining and lounging area (sofa which can also transform into a bed) are fully private. The garden is shared with our family.

You will enter the apartment through a separate (own) entrance through the garden.

Located in upscale and safe neighborhood Amsterdam Old-South, next to Amsterdam forest - with easy and direct public transport into the city center.

name: Modern 1 bedroom apartment with balcony
description: Recently refurbished, modern and well equipped 1-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam West, De Baarsjes. Equipped with all the needed creature comforts. This is my personal apartment and has character, I only list it when I travel on long trips.

name: Appartement in Stadsdeel West
description: Central located Apartment in Amsterdam West

name: Monumental apartment next to Westerpark
description:
Monumental apartment next to Westerpark including a garden with iconic view!

Build in 1920, next to museum 'Het Schip'. Famous of its 'Amsterdamse School' architecture.

The apartment is next to the wester park witch offers a combination of green environment and nice bars and restaurants.

Only 5 min walk from the apartment is the famous old neighbourhood the 'Jordaan'

description:

Experience the authentic local vibe by staying in the heart of Amsterdam, within walking distance to all the must-see sights.
