Treat yourself to the culinary delights of Amsterdam's finest restaurants, cafes, and bars, all conveniently located just a stone's throw away.

Enjoy exploring this vibrant city like a true local.

name: Beautiful canal house in the centre of Amsterdam
description:
Beautiful and recently fully renovated apartment with balcony, located in one of the most beautiful neighbourhoods of Amsterdam. Around the corner of the Roeterstraat, Theater Carré, Artis, museum Hermitage & the Stopera. The apartment consist of a large bedroom, office room, separate toilet and bedroom and spacious living room including open kitchen. Feel welcome!

On the pictures you see a room with a second bed. This has been replaced by a working place (office)

name: Stylish and cosy apartment@Museum quarter
description: This centrally located 90M2 accommodation is tastefully decorated. Within walking distance is the Museumplein, many nice restaurants and cafes. The tram takes you to Central Station or South Station in ten minutes. The Vondelpark and the Albert Cuypmarkt are also within walking distance. It has two bedrooms, one of which is a children's room but can be placed an arrowbed or single bed. It is suitable for a couple, even with a child or two friends. The master bedroom has a double bed.

name: Spacious apartment + garden in popular ‘de Pijp’
description:
We have a two story apartment in one of the nicest areas of Amsterdam, the vibrant 'Pijp" area!
Perfect for families who are looking for a home away from home with a lush, green urban jungle! The street is very quiet, but busy city life is around the corner.

Everything is within walking distance (nice restaurants, markets, bars, supermarkets and public transport).

name: Bright and spacious modern apartment in Amsterdam
description: This recently renovated (mid 2022) spacious modern apartment is located in Amsterdam West, just outside the city center. The large windows located at the Southwest side give way to a bright and possibly sunny apartment. The apartment is equipped with any kind of luxury you'll need and includes new and comfortable furniture. In the area you'll find many bars and restaurants, easy access to public transport and 2 large green parks. Rent a bike and within 15 minutes you are in the city center!

name: Ruim huis in Amsterdam Noord
description:
A spacious house in Amsterdam Noord, very suitable for a family with children. The house has a large garden with outdoor dining, a hammock and a fire bowl. Parking is free in front of the door. The bus stop, a 2-minute walk away, takes you to Sloterdijk Station in 10 minutes, and to Metro Noord in 17 minutes.

A 12-minute walk through the park will take you to a supermarket, butcher, bakery and drugstore. The neighborhood is very child-friendly, with many playgrounds. The trendy NDSM terrain is nearby.

name: Midtown Royal
description:
The 45m2 Royal studio features a modern living area, 4 single beds with comfortable mattresses, a fully equipped kitchen and a brand new spacious bathroom.

Midtown Hotel is situated at the edge of the center in one of the most popular areas in Amsterdam. Only 5 minutes from Leidseplein, Vondelpark, Museum district and the “9 straatjes” popular for its cozy restaurants and boutique shops.

name: Midtown Triple Room
description:
Cosy and bright apartment with three single beds with quality mattresses, a kitchenette with a comfort dining area. Perfect for a couple or a group of three!

Midtown Hotel is situated at the edge of the center in one of the most popular areas in Amsterdam. Only 5 minutes from Leidseplein, Vondelpark, Museum district and the “9 straatjes” popular for its cozy restaurants and boutique shops.

name: Canal View rooftop jacuzzi & garden
description: Canal and sunset views, jacuzzi on rooftop with garden. Lots of indoor/outdoor space (2100 sqft).  Vibrant neighbourhood close to Van Gogh Museum. Lots of local cafes and top restaurants. Walking distance to Leidseplein.

name: Artist apartment - city centre
description: Artist apartment in the city centre of Amsterdam, located on the Brouwersgracht - voted as the most beautiful canal in Amsterdam. 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, open living space with view on the canals. Wifi, television in the livingroom and bedroom, washing machine, fully equipped kitchen. Walking distance from all must-sees of Amsterdam, apartment located in the neighbourhood called De Jordaan, full of nice restaurants and shops.

name: Modern, spacious 2 bedroom apartment incl. parking
description:
Kick back and relax after a full day of sight seeing, at this idyllic property located in the iconic East of Amsterdam.

It is surrounded by water and close to many hip bars and restaurants favourited by the locals.

The property has an outdoor balcony overlooking the stunning Rijn canal where one can often see large ships traversing across Europe.

Situated about 10 minutes by car from central, the property is well connected and a brisk 10 minute walk from the nearest public transport.

name: Woonboot-watervilla Amsterdam, free parking
description:
Floating house with two bedrooms, swimming possible direct out of the window. Topfloor: balcony, kitchenette and living room.
Ground floor: entry, kitchen, toilet, washing machine and dryer, and diningroom.
Underwaterfoor: 2 bedrooms and one huge bathroom, with bath and separate shower.

name: Canal Room
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.We are located on the Passeerdersgracht in the heart of historic Amsterdam. Touristic hotspots like the Anne Frank House, Dam Square, Leidse Square and the Rijksmuseum are within walking distance. Enjoy the view from your room on the peaceful gardens.

*maximum for two guests, not suitable for infant or children.

name: The Garden Room
description: Room in a bed and breakfast hosted by Carlos & Rob

name: Cozy apartment in Amsterdam West!
description:
Cozy apartment in Amsterdam West- de Baarsjes. Walking distance to restaurants, cafe’s and nice shops. The famous ten Katemarkt and Foodhallen are close by! Walk a little bit further and you arrive in the historic Jordaan.

The apartment is just renovated and has a new kitchen and bathroom.

Just 10 minutes by bike to the city centre. Next to the apartment are two nice parks: Erasmuspark and Rembrandtpark. If you walk all the way threw Rembrandtpark you arrive at the famous Vondelpark!

name: 1 Bedroom Apartment - Centre of Jordaan
description: Great 1 bedroom apartment within central Jordaan, stones throw away from Anne Frank's, great public transport throughout Amsterdam.

name: Bright Apartment by Vondelpark | Quiet & Central
description:
Light and cozy apartment in a classic Amsterdam red-brick building, located just 2 minutes’ walk from Vondelpark.

The apartment features a spacious living room with large windows overlooking a green square, a fully equipped kitchen, and a large bedroom with a comfortable queen-size bed.

Situated in a quiet, green neighborhood with cafés and restaurants nearby, ideal for guests looking for a calm stay in central Amsterdam.

2nd floor (stairs only, no lift)
Minimum stay: 5 nights

name: Mooi appartement in Amsterdam Oost
description: Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space.

name: Spacious double appartement in Amsterdam-east
description:
Spacious double appartement in middle of hotspot Javastraat in Amsterdam East for four guests. All facilities, restaurants, shops, bars, market an public transport close-by.
A tranquil place in the middle of a burstling neighbourhood.
The bed rooms are equiped with excellent boxspring beds.
The bathroom has a shower and separate bathtub.
To complete your relaxed stay, a sauna included aswell.

name: NEW: private room Canal Amsterdam Centre/Jordaan
description: Charming room with private entrance in the city center of Amsterdam in a super location on the edge of De Jordaan. Close to shops, restaurants and museums.

name: LIEV.amsterdam Cozy boutique suite in The Pijp
description:
This newly renovated Boutique Suite, including Private Bathroom, is situated in the bustling district "The Pipe/de Pijp". Just a small walk to the Albert Cuypmarket, Heineken Experience and the Van Gogh or Rijksmuseum. Located in one of the most beautiful streets of Amsterdam; The Frans Halsstraat.

Metro station: 1 minute walk
Central station: 5 minutes (Metro)
Dam square/city center: 3 minutes (Metro)
RAI Amsterdam (bus to Keukenhof): 2 minutes (Metro)
Van Gogh and Rijksmuseum: 9 minutes walk

name: Spacious & Light Balcony Loft in Centre Amsterdam
description:
This apartment is located on the most cozy and central street in Amsterdam. It is surrounded with many nice restaurants and bars.

It is only a 5 minute walk to the Vondelpark, 5 minutes walk to the canals and a 5 minute walk to two of Amsterdam's most famous squares, Leidseplein and Museumplein.

The apartment itself is very quiet and has a wonderful balcony. The perfect stay for people who would like to discover the beauty of Amsterdam.

name: licht en ruim appartement in Amsterdam
description:
Experience the ultimate convenience in this centrally located apartment, just steps away from the beautiful Vondelpark. Everything you need is within easy reach. The space boasts a fully-equipped kitchen, perfect for preparing your favorite meals, a spacious and modern bathroom, and a private balcony where you can unwind.

With the tram, you'll be just 10 minutes away from the vibrant Jordaan district and the lively Leidseplein, making this the perfect base for exploring the city.

name: Begane grond woning Amsterdam
description: This ground floor house, with garden, has recently been completely renovated. The Spaarndammerbuurt, where the house is located, is a quiet, centrally located neighbourhood in the heart of Amsterdam. The property is perfect for individuals or couples looking for a comfortable, stylized and centrally located point from which to explore the city. The house has all the facilities needed for a comfortable stay (fast Wi-Fi, rain shower, garden, oven, dishwasher, underfloor heating and a garden).

name: Great appartement - free parking
description:
This great accommodation guarantees fun with the family. The living room is a nice spacious place with an open kitchen. You can cook, eat and drink together here. There is one bedroom with a double bed. The other bedroom is divided into two: one double bed and an adjoining nursery.
Close by are nice pubs, good restaurants and the Vondelpark (1km).
- Private parking space under the house
- Metro 150 m, Tram 200 m, Train 850 m
- 10 min. cycling to the canals

name: Lovely 1-bedroom with a rooftop terrace
description: You will feel like you are visiting your friend's place in this cozy apartment in Amsterdam Old West. There are plenty of bars, restaurants and coffeeshops nearby. The canals are a short walk away. Very centrally located without all the noise of being in the center. We live in this apartment so please expect it to look like that! We are on the 4th floor so that means climbing 4 flights  of steep narrow of stairs.

name: Clean and private Amsterdam Zuid apartment
description:
Stunning double upper house. Completely private and spacious.

It has one bedroom, a bathroom, two toilets, a nice balcony, a big living room and open kitchen with a plenty of light. The spacious house has multiple places perfect for working or relaxing.

Leimuidenstraat is a quiet, charming street, located in the in the Oud Zuid district. There are multiple public transportation options, grocery stores, shops and the Vondelpark within walking distance. The street has minimal traffic.

name: Bright Boho Apartment Amsterdam
description:
This apartment will allow you to have a very relaxed stay in Amsterdam.
I am always on hand for any questions.
There is a pull out sofa, a work desk and a lovely balcony.

You can reach the flat from the central station by taking the metro M51 to Postjesweg station which is at 3 minutes walking from the flat, or the bus 18 which stops right outside the flat.
Further the flat can be reached from the airport by taking a direct train to station Lelylaan and walking for 9 minutes.

name: Sustainable Hideaway; eco-luxe (70m2)
description: Noorderbed is a family-friendly B&B where you can unwind after a busy day in Amsterdam. Delightful beds, a well-equipped bathroom and a pantry with a fine coffee machine make your stay extra comfortable. In the lounge you will find books and games. The kitchen table is also a great place to work. Public transport brings you quickly to the centre, but Amsterdam North also has a lot to offer - think Eye, NDSM and many restaurants in all sorts and price ranges.

name: Lovely family house in Amsterdam close to centre.
description: The house has lots of windows and is therefore light and sunny. Very child-friendly, toys available.

name: Sfeervol appartement met balkon in Amsterdam-Oost
description: Cozy apartment (40m²) in bustling Amsterdam East, perfect for couples. Enjoy the spacious, sunny balcony (10m²) and a warm, personal atmosphere, this is my own home. Walking distance to Oosterpark, the Dappermarkt and fun spots like Bar Bukowski and Louie Louie. Easily accessible by public transport, Muiderpoort station around the corner.

name: luxury apartment on the ground floor!
description:
Enjoy this classic Amsterdam apartment with many luxury elements that make your stay easier: Just renovated apartment, bath and shower, Sonos speakers, fast wifi, washer-dryer combination, 4k TVs.

Located in a quiet neighbourhood yet close to major attractions. Nice cafes a short distance away, the Oosterpark 4min walk, supermarket 1m, and 5m walk from the Wibautstraat metro station connected to Schiphol Airport or Central Station Amsterdam.

name: H3, Cozy B&B near Amsterdam - Free parking & Bikes
description:
Our stylish and charming guesthouse offers stylish, fully private rooms with a private entrance, bathroom and toilet. A lovely place to unwind, just outside the city.

R&M Boutique is the ideal base for exploring Amsterdam, Haarlem and the coast, while staying in a peaceful setting.

It is also well suited for business travelers, offering a comfortable workspace with garden views.

Located near Amsterdam, Schiphol Airport, Haarlem and Zandvoort.

~Your home away from home~

name: Boutique-style loft, 160m2, in Amsterdam West
description:
Two floor apartment in boutique hotel style:
Ground floor: living room with fireplace, open kitchen and additional tv room. As extension of the living room there is a large garden patio / terrace overseeing the 120m2 backyard, on the south west side.
Basement: two bedrooms with double beds and two bathrooms. Main bathroom has a jacuzzi.

name: Gezellige familiewoning met tuin en dakterras.
description:
Feel welcome to this stylish home. Our house is suitable for guests who want to stay in a quiet residential area and parties beyond.
The house has a roof terrace and garden near the Sloterplas and beach. A very nice green area and only 10 minutes by bike from the old town of Amsterdam!
Public transportation is within walking distance and a nice shopping center is also within walking distance.
As mentioned, a family house. We rent out 2 bedrooms with two double beds.

name: Lovely 5-bedroom loft with plunge pool
description:
Stylish place in middle of center of Amsterdam. Family friendly, with 3 kids bedrooms, master bedroom and guest bedroom. Has master bathroom and separate bathroom for guests and/or kids.

Located in walking distance of Westerpark, Jordaan and Haarlemmerdijk.

Only available for families, no availability for groups and commercial shoots.

name: Cute 1-bedroom rental unit in central Amsterdam.
description:
Bright and cosy apartment located in Amsterdam Oud-West, between the Vondelpark & Jordaan.

Perfect place to stay; located just a few minute's walk to all the fun activities around; Foodhallen, bars, cafes, museums, parks, nightclubs, etc.

Few days only: during my holiday I am opening my cozy home in the very center of Amsterdam. There will be my personnal belongings and I am asking guests to leave the place as clean as they have found it.


0363 A4C2 0DCE 951B D1FE

name: Spacious Gem in friendly Amsterdam North
description:
Accomodates 4 adults, a toddler and a baby.

Well decorated three story house with a big garden at the back which opens up to a common gated playground. Natural materials define our style of decoration, combined with a jungle of plants and many spots to chill out comfortably. You will feel straight at home. Two bikes are included and you are very welcome to have a nice bath after a long day of exploring this great part of Amsterdam and all the rest of our beautiful city.

name: Modern en licht appartement in gezellige buurt
description: Our beautiful little house in Bos en Lommer is a gem in the neighborhood. Within fifteen minutes in the heart of Amsterdam by train, bus, tram and metro within walking distance. Washing machine, internet, dishwasher and television are provided. Includes a west-facing balcony. Equipped with two built-in air conditioners for both cooling and heating.

name: Canal Boat Home Experience | Amsterdam Centre
description:
Please join me in sharing my 1st canal boat experience, moved in Aug 2022.

I'd like to share the experience, typically while traveling. Listing covers future investments into the boat's maintenance.

NOTE: This is boat is owned by me and primary residence, available when traveling for work or personal reasons.

Effectively this means; you will notice used personal stuff as-is.

Great for travellers that like a Local Experience near the waterfront, this is NOT a hotel for Business Travellers.

name: Spacious home in the heart of Amsterdam, 2-BDRS
description: Super spacious [120 sqm] home in the heart of charming Amsterdam with 2 bedrooms, a large rooftop terrace, and extremely close proximity to canal and shopping area. Rooftop is an oasis with plants and trees, including big BBQ Green Egg and view over the city. i’ll be away working remotely so my home is looking for a new owner. I prefer someone who stays a month or so, feel free to send me a message for further info - 3rd and 4th Floor no elevator!

name: Amazing 2-bedroom flat with rooftop - De Pijp
description: If you are looking for a spacious place in the heart of the De Pijp, this flat is for you! Perfect for an authentic Amsterdam experience, you will feel home from the first minute. Just 10 minutes from Central Station by metro. Only 10minutes from RAI too.

name: Modern apartment  close to city centre
description:
A stylish apartment located only 5 minutes away from the heart of Amsterdam. Situated in a quiet area, but plenty of bars, supermarkets and public transportation in the area. Perfect place to stay during your trip to Amsterdam.

If you come to Amsterdam only for party or smoking weed please don't book with us.

name: Beautiful 4-bedroom house (250m2) with garden
description:
For a chic and ultra luxurious stay in Amsterdam, this ultimate downstairs house (250m2) with a beautiful garden is the perfect base. It is located in the heart of Oud-Zuid next to the Vondelpark and within walking distance of the PC Hooftstraat, the Museumplein and the Concertgebouw.

The recently stylishly renovated downstairs house has 4 bedrooms with double beds (1x doubter). Furthermore, the house has 3 bathrooms with 2 baths, 4 toilets, a games room and a cooking island.

name: Luxury house with garden in popular Amsterdam area
description: Beautifully renovated luxurious home with beautiful  park views nestled in a prime location in Amsterdam’s popular East. Short walk to the famous ‘De Kas’ dining experience, Artis zoo, 1900 restaurant, De Plantage restaurant and charming ‘Merkelbach' with both a beautiful terrace. Easy access to public transport, delicious coffee, excellent restaurants, supermarket, bakery, bars and cozy lunch spots all just around the corner. We live in a perfect blend of city life and serene living.

name: Stylish home with garden in beautiful neighborhood
description:
Modern, stylish family home (130m2) on the ground floor with private garden, located in the beautiful, quiet neighborhood Old-West. Walking distance to the Vondelpark and lots of restaurants. Easily connected to airport and city!

The ground floor has a large, fully equipped kitchen (2021), large living room, toilet, and garden. The main bedroom with ensuite bathroom, kids bedroom and separate bathroom and toilet are downstairs, in a typical Amsterdam 'souterrain'. Nice and cool in the summer!

name: Mooi appartement gelegen aan een gracht
description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

name: Double Room
description: Enjoy a pleasant stay in our air-conditioned Double Room. This room features a Smart TV for your entertainment, a refrigerator for your refreshments, and a laptop-size safe for your valuables. Refresh yourself in the private bathroom, which includes a shower. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, this room offers comfort and convenience.

name: Luxury Double Room
description: Relax in our spacious Luxury Double Room, designed for comfort and ease. The air-conditioned room includes a Smart TV, refrigerator, and a laptop-size safe for your convenience. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower. Some rooms also offer access to a shared terrace, providing extra space to unwind. Perfect for both short and extended stays, this room ensures a comfortable retreat.

name: Duplex Studio
description: Experience a unique stay in our air-conditioned Duplex Studio, which spans two floors. This spacious studio features a Smart TV for your entertainment, a refrigerator for your refreshments, and a laptop-size safe for your valuables. Enjoy the convenience of a private bathroom with a shower. Perfect for longer stays, this studio offers a comfortable and flexible living space across two levels.

name: Quadruple Room
description: Enjoy the versatility of our Quadruple Room, perfect for families or groups. Some offer two inter-leading spaces, one with an en-suite bathroom and shared terrace access. Others have a single large area with four beds, a private bathroom, and terrace access. All include a Smart TV, Nespresso machine, safe, air conditioning, clothes rack, and a telephone for incoming calls, ensuring a comfortable stay for multiple guests.

name: Small Double Room
description: Stay comfortably in our cozy Small Double Room, located in the basement. This air-conditioned room includes a Smart TV for your entertainment, a refrigerator for your convenience, and a laptop-size safe. The private bathroom features a shower. Despite its basement location, this room offers a snug and pleasant environment for your stay.

name: Loft - Triple Room
description: Experience a comfortable stay in our Loft Triple Room. This air-conditioned room includes a Smart TV, refrigerator, and a laptop-size safe. The private bathroom comes with a shower. Perfect for small groups or families, this room offers ample space and modern amenities for a relaxing visit.

name: Gezellig huis dichtbij Amsterdam Centrum
description: In this centrally located home, everything is within reach for your family. There are 4 bedrooms. A washing machine and dryer are provided. You can relax in the garden. Within walking distance are two shopping centers with a supermarket and places to eat. With a bus stop at the door and the metro within walking distance, you can reach the Amsterdam Arena and the cinema within 15 minutes or the center of Amsterdam in 20 minutes. Bicycle and car rental are possible.

name: JONI (Room not for parties)
description:
We offer 1 bedroom only with your own private bathroom (11,4 square meters) in a centrally located apartment. The room is for a maximum of 2 guests. You can choose between 2 singles beds (80x200cm) or a double bed (160x200cm).

No access to the Kitchen and Living room (as local authority requests).
Breakfast is not provided.

No parties. No pets. No infants.

Self service check-in with a secure Masterlock box.
Check-in from 15.00 (3pm). Check-out no later than 10am.

name: 2 bedroom apartment with garden and office space
description: Very quiet and trendy neighbourhood in Amsterdam, centrally located, great for a weekend away or a longer period working from home with a separate office space and 2nd bedroom in the garden house. Fully equipped kitchen with spacious living room. Perfect for a couple, two couples or a family. The apartment is close to the train station and metro station. 5 minutes walk to Vondelpark or Rembrandtpark. Nice and trendy cafes and restaurants nearby!

name: Amsterdam loft apartment
description: Amsterdam loft apartment

name: Gezellig familiehuis met tuin dichtbij Vondelpark.
description: This unique, cozy house, ideal for couples or families, is located in a quiet street in Amsterdam-Zuid. The ground floor is spacious and bright, with a large kitchen and more than enough space to play and relax.  In the garden, you can eat outside or have a BBQ, and children will love the large trampoline and soccer goals.

name: Mooi en knus huis met zonnige tuin, vlakbij metro
description:
Extra baby room available on request!

Light, renovated house of 100m2 with open kitchen, new garden, double rain shower and two bedrooms. The garden has sun all day!

The metro and bike rental are within walking distance. This way you can be in nice neighborhoods such as the Baarsjes, Oud West, Vondelpark and the canals within minutes.

The house is in a quiet neighborhood. It can therefore not be used for parties and/or guests who would like to make noise in and around the house after 10 p.m.

name: Studio 28A5 with free parking
description:
Studio 28A5 is located in Amsterdam Noord, 3.8 km from A'DAM Lookout and 4 km from Dam Square in the heart of the city center.

Amsterdam Noord is still unknown outside Amsterdam, but for the citiznes of Amsterdammer it has become a popular and hip district and the place to be for the creatives.
Near the location are many restaurants, a brewery and even a real wine chateau.

The metro stop to the city center is a 15-minute walk away.

name: Historic city center studio: canal side apartment
description: I hereby rent out my unique, recently renovated and climate-friendly studio apartment. I have been living in this special place for over 10 years now, right in the middle of Amsterdam's historic center and on one of the city's most beautiful canals. Central Station is within walking distance and therefore my apartment is easily accessible from your arrival in Amsterdam.

name: East-Central 1-bedroom flat
description:
Hi 👋 Welcome to our cozy flat! It’s perfect for a single traveller or a couple. Situated in a popular & lively part of town, the house itself is in a quiet residential street. The area is tourist-free and perfect for someone who's looking to get a piece of authentic Amsterdam life.

- 1 min to restaurant / bars
- 2 min walk to Oosterpark
- 1 min walk to farmer's market
- 1 min walk to the nearest tram stop
- 10 min walk to Amsterdam Zoo (Artis)
- 10min cycling to Amsterdam Centraal

name: Staysome Amsterdam Hemonyst. | Economy Queen Room
description:
Welcome! Stay in lovingly furnished apartments – a personal alternative to impersonal hotel rooms or unfamiliar private rentals. Our suites combine the quality standards of a hotel with the coziness and comfort of your own apartment.
Thanks to our electronic access system, you can check in at any time after 3:00 PM – no need for a reception desk or prior arrangements. You'll receive your access codes by email on the day of arrival.

description:
Step into the holiday spirit at our cozy and charming loft in the heart of Amsterdam, beautifully set up to make your Amsterdam time off unforgettable! Minutes from the bustling city center.

✨ Your Home Away From Home ✨

name: Ruim appartement met tuin en BBQ in Amsterdam
description: From our spacious and sunny apartment, you can perfectly explore Amsterdam as a couple or with friends. The house has everything you need for a relaxing stay.  The Oosterpark and many cozy bars and restaurants are literally around the corner (ask us for tips!). Many famous museums are within walking distance. The apartment is in a quiet street in bustling Amsterdam East. A bicycle rental is around the corner, so you can experience Amsterdam from this home like a local!

name: Trendy and cozy apartment with garden
description: A bright, attractive, and classic apartment in sought-after Amsterdam Oud-West, completely renovated in 2020. Located next to the Vondelpark and 15 minute walk from the typical Amsterdam canals, the Museumplein (with Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum), and the Foodhallen. One of the most sought-after streets of Amsterdam (Jan Pieter Heijestraat) is literally around the corner, full of trendy restaurants, bakeries, and other hotspots.

name: Centraal gelegen, nette/mooi woning in Amsterdam.
description: Just get away from it all in this soothing, centrally located accommodation. close to the center,  but also to Dapper and albertK market. quiet residential area. lots of space. ideal for couples.

name: Luxe appartement aan de gracht
description:
Wonderfully bright apartment located in the middle of the Jordaan around the corner of the Prinsengracht. The apartment has a large bedroom, with air conditioning and adjoining terrace and a luxurious living room with open kitchen.

In short, a lovely apartment in a fantastic location in the middle of the canal belt of Amsterdam.

name: Spacious Suite at Park and Museum
description:
Spacious and stylish suite to relax after a day of sightseeing, or for that matter in the middle of it. Nothing is ever far away from this spot.

Its perfect spot for a family get-away, we can host only 2 adults but up to 2 children (up to 16 years) are welcome to join free of charge. The sofa is a double bed pull out.

It is located next to Vondelpark and Museum square, 3-4 minutes from Canal belt and Jordaan. De Pijp is only a 10 minute walk away.

name: Sweets hotel - Walter Süskindbrug
description: This bridge keeper's house has amazing views over the Amstel river. This unique and romantic accommodation is undoubtedly appealing.

name: Luxury  apartment Museum Quarter, 2 bedrooms
description: Beautiful apartment equipped with all comforts and luxuries in a beautiful quiet residential neighborhood just minutes from the Museum Quarter and the Old South shopping streets, such as the Cornelis Schuyt and the P.C. Hooft str. The Mondaine Oud Zuid offers trendy restaurants, unique boutiques, all museums and the Vondelpark. The property is built in the Amsterdam School style, designed by the famous Warners family. The house, right on the water, offers a great base in warm, luxurious and classic style.

name: Nice and cosy studio in Amsterdam
description:
Nice and functional studio only 15 minutes cycling or with an uber/ public transport about 20 min from Amsterdam City Center. The studio has a modern bathroom which is fully renovated 2 months a go. The bed is 160x 200 cm. There is a TV and WIFI connection.

The studio is on the ground floor in a family friendly street. Pets are not allowed and also smoking is prohibited. Because it is a very family friendly area, partying is not allowed.

name: 4B - Congress Centre Apartments - French balcony
description:
Looking for a 6 months rental in the popular RIVERSIDE-area? Ideal for a couple of students, employees for a project, etc.... Interested? Send us a message for a (FaceTime) viewing. Rent €2500/month. Fully furnished.

REGISTRATION FOR 2 PEOPLE IS allowed.

name: Luxe 150 m2 appartement in Watergraafsmeer
description: Perfect location for couples and families who love peace and atmosphere. Located in the leafy Watergraafmeer, within walking distance of cozy cafes and (top) restaurants

name: Stylish 3-floor family apartment Amsterdam center
description: A gorgeous 3-story apartment in the heart of Amsterdam with private garden, dedicated kids rooms and beautiful modern interiors. Sleeps up to 4 adults and 4 children yet city of Amsterdam limits bookings to 4 people. Well-set up for a family stay (fully-equipped kitchen, family-sized dining area) with the charm of a historical building, the residence has a back garden, and a private bench on the street side (ideal for sunny mornings) and balconies on both sides on the upper floors.

name: Privékamer in Amsterdam West
description: Cozy Boho chic room in the area Bos en Lommer. The room is located on the third floor and has a private bedroom and bathroom. Extra facilities such as coffee maker, kettle and mini fridge are present. I have been working in the hospitality industry for many years and I am looking forward to welcome you as my guest!

name: Gezellig 2 kamer appartement aan het water
description:
Beautiful accommodation of about 55 m2 located on the Kostverlorenvaart. The house is within walking distance of the Vondelpark and the major museums on Museumplein. In the immediate vicinity you will find many nice restaurants and trendy shops.
It concerns 2 rooms (a bedroom and a living room with pantry) with its own entrance. The Airbnb is adjacent to our own home.

name: Amazing family home AMS (more pics coming soon)
description: Spacious 240m² family home in Amsterdam South with 5 bedrooms and lush gardens on both sides. The ground floor offers a large open space, huge kitchen, and 10-seater dining table. Upstairs you’ll find a master suite with walk-in closet and royal bathroom, plus 2 bright bedrooms with their own bath. The basement has laundry, and the garden house is a fully equipped studio with kitchenette, shower, and bathroom. More pictures upon request

name: Beautiful apartment in the heart of Amsterdam West
description:
In a monumental protected building, near to beautiful canals and green areas, the apartment is light and cosy with design furniture, little vintage gems, and my own plant collection that makes it very charming.

Located in one of the most hip and up and coming neighbourhoods in Amsterdam, you will be surrounded by many trendy bars, amazing restaurants and bakeries, design stores and some of the best conceptual coffee places in the city!

name: Lovely bedroom with balcony very spacious
description: you will get a private room in a shared apartment.

name: Loft apartment in Amsterdam
description: Relax and unwind in this peaceful, stylish space. The loft is situated in an old warehouse and exudes zen. The thick walls ensure pleasant coolness in the summer and little radiation. The house is fully equipped. And designed by myself. The environment is very idyllic and so close to the city, with lots of nice cafes and restaurants. Close to the warehouse there is a place where you can swim in the summer. Best combination of city and nature in Amsterdam!

name: Centrally located trendy loft w/ jacuzzi + rooftop
description: Centrally located, light, spacious and recently renovated one bedroom apartment next to food court De Hallen and with a daily local market at your doorstep. The apartment is furthermore within walking distance from the Canals, Vondelpark, Jordaan, the Van Gogh/Rijksmuseum, Anne Frank House and Leidseplein. Tired after a busy day exploring the city? No problem, you can fully reload on the private roof terrace or in the jacuzzi.

name: Artistic appartement in Amsterdam West
description: Welcome to our dream apartment in Amsterdam! This cozy space is perfect to experience the city like a local. Restaurants and bike rental are close. Erasmuspark is 100m away. Public transport stops in front of the apartment. The beautiful design furniture and creative interior will inspire you, and the premium bed with a topper promises a good night's sleep. We offer cleaning during your stay. Feel free to contact me. Tourist registration number: 0363 468B 581C 65D6 946A

name: Cozy and Modern Apartment in Central Amsterdam
description:
Bright and spacious 2-bedroom apartment, perfect for families or small groups!

Enjoy two sunny balconies (east and south-facing) for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Just 10 min by bike to the city center, with trams and buses at your doorstep (15 min to Central Station). Nearby, you’ll find parks, trendy restaurants, bars, and grocery stores. Unwind with a home cinema and 3D sound system - perfect for movie nights after a day of exploring.

Book now for a comfortable and convenient stay!

name: Sunny 2 bed apt de Pijp, child friendly
description:
Welcome to our beautiful apartment located in the heart of De Pijp. With a size of 75m2, two bedrooms, a sunny garden, and a south-facing balcony, this is the ideal place for your stay. Our place is suitable for max. 2 adults and 2 kids (max 130cm, due to beds).

We have 2 children ourselves, aged 4 & 6, which makes the apartment child-friendly and equipped with all the necessities for children. Without kids, you are also welcome, as the children's room also has a desk where you can work.

name: Hidden Gem Amsterdam | a natural oasis of peace
description: This charming (child friendly) retreat offers the best of both worlds: the tranquility of a green oasis and the vibrancy of the city center. The private 1,600 m² garden, complete with its own orchard, borders the Wilmkebreekpolder – a stunning nature reserve where meadow birds, cows, and sheep dot the landscape. Here, you can unwind in peace and enjoy breathtaking sunsets. At the same time, the bustling heart of Amsterdam, with its rich culture, restaurants, and cafés, is just minutes away.

name: Brand new bright studio with balcony at a canal
description:
The brand new large room with ensuite bathroom is spacious, bright and decorated by an interior designer. It has a lounge corner with a nespresso machine and tea, mini-fridge, and balcony. The bathroom has a large shower and big wash-basin, a toilet with little sink.
The room is close to the centre of Amsterdam, in a quiet street so you can get a good night's sleep if you want, and in the area (5 min walk) you'll find lots of restaurants (also vegan), shops, parks, and a place to rent bikes.

name: Cozy & spacious studio near city center Amsterdam
description:
The brand new large room with ensuite bathroom is spacious, bright and decorated by an interior designer. It has a lounge corner with nespresso machine and tea, a mini-fridge, and a (small) desk. Your bathroom has a large shower, big wash-basin, and toilet.
The room is close to the centre of Amsterdam, in a quiet street so you can get a good night's sleep if you want, and in the area (5 min walk) you'll find lots of restaurants (also vegan), shops, parks, and a place to rent bikes.

name: Appartement in de Pijp
description:
Beautiful, spacious and ideally located apartment in de Pijp. This area is a popular area and has lots of nice restaurants, bars and shops. The famous “Albert Cuyp” market is only a few minutes walking.

The apartment (65m2) is fully furnished with 1 bedroom with a king size bed and a spacious living room with an open kitchen. Fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and everything you need.

The perfect apartment for couples or business travelers.

Vergunningnummer: Z/25/2904696

name: Beautiful 2 Story Home in 'De Pijp'
description:
Beautiful family home of 200 M2 on the ground and first floor with huge garden of approx. 143 m2!

The house is divided over two floors, the ground floor and first floor, and has 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 1 office, a terrace and garden facing south. The living area and living kitchen are on the first floor, with a beautiful view over the canal at the front and an oasis of green tranquility at the rear. The atmosphere of the house is fantastic and the whole has been styled in a very tasteful way.

name: Stijlvol appartement op gunstige locatie
description: This stylish apartment is located in the city center of Amsterdam. From the apartment, it is a 2-minute walk to the Magere Bridge, a 5-minute walk to the zoo (Artis), and a 10-minute bike ride to the Rijksmuseum. Furthermore, the house can be reached easily by both car and public transportation. The apartment is equipped with every comfort, so you don't have to worry about anything during your stay. The apartment features a garden where you can quietly retreat.

name: Apartment next to Vondelpark
description:
🌟 Uncover the beauty of Amsterdam from your extraordinary 2-floor, 130m² apartment nestled beside the stunning Vondel Park.

Just a 5-minute walk from Museum Square and the picturesque canals. This remarkable rental features 2 spacious bedrooms, each with its own sleek bathroom, a beautifully styled living room, dining area, and a fully-equipped kitchen!

Enjoy a generous terrace and a lush garden – your own oasis in the heart of the city. Your Amsterdam adventure begins here! 🏡

name: Prachtig begane grond appartement met tuin op zuid
description: This unique accommodation has its own style. Beautifully renovated ground floor house of 53m2 with a cozy, sunny city garden on the south west (afternoon and evening sun). This apartment with its own entrance has a particularly practical layout, with beautiful views over the Schinkel, with luxury bathroom + kitchen, spacious living room and cozy bedroom, it is comfortable living. Located between a supermarket and bakery, located in Oud Zuid, near the Vondelpark and Hoofddorpplein.

name: Large  and modern family apartment with garden
3BDR with stunning terrace and free parking
description:
Brand new, bright and spacious 3 bedroom apartment. Featuring an open kitchen and a stunning huge terrace.

3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms including a walk in shower and a bathtub.

Washing machine and dryer.

Child and baby safe and friendly.

name: Clean & bright home in quite, green environment
description:
Our house has everything for a comfortable holiday. Ideal for families. Our king size master bed is of excellent quality, 2 kids bedrooms. A fully equipped modern kitchen with a Cooker, waterfilter. House is renovated with only natural materials.2 bathrooms. Private green patio.
The quiet, car free street, playgrounds and parks offer plenty space to enjoy outside.
The house is located in A.dam Noord, close to NDSM, next to a bus station, right next to a bus station, 15 minutes to the center.

name: Beautiful apartment in the heart of Amsterdam
description: Enjoy an amazing stay at a ground floor apt while exploring the city. The studio has a double bed and a sleeping couch fitted for 1, 2, 3, or 4 travellers. You have a fully equipped kitchen to prepare your breakfast or cook a meal. The studio is in the best neighbourhood of Amsterdam, De Pijp, with many trendy shops, cosy cafes, and excellent wine bars.  You are only a 5’ walk to the museum district and the most popular market, Albert Cuyp, and a 15' walk to Leidseplein.

name: Bed in unisex dorm.
description: Our lovely hostel is located in a wonderful quiet neighbourhood Plantage, within walking distance to the centre. Nearby you can find plenty of restaurants to dine in and some cafes, pizzerias, public transport is well located (1 min to catch a tram #14 to the Central Station). 10 min walk to the metro at Weesperplein. Our neighbours are the Botanical Garden and the popular Zoo Artis.

name: Spacious apartment in the center
description:
First of all welcome to every: gender, sexuality, ethnicity and culture!

This centrally located apartment offers everything one might need when visiting Amsterdam as a tourist or for a work visit.

The location is perfect: 15 minutes from Amsterdam Central Station, tram and subway around the corner, one street away from the famous Albert Cuyp market and restaurants and bars on everywhere.

The space itself offers all comforts one might wish for.

Registration number: 0363 2BC1 E393 2CF5 6944

name: Luxurious family home near Vondelpark in Amsterdam
description:
Our nice, spacious house offers everything for a great stay in Amsterdam. It is centrally located in the city, in a quiet and green neighborhood but close to many hotspots. The museum square, Vondelpark are just around the corner, as are the many nice cafes, restaurants & shops.

The house is very spacious and completely renovated in 2021. There are 3 floors, 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, one with sauna & rain shower and a bathroom with an XL bath and separate shower. There is also a private garden.

name: Bed in Women Dorm
description: Our lovely hostel is located in a wonderful quiet neighbourhood Plantage, within walking distance to the centre. Nearby you can find plenty of restaurants to dine in and some cafes, pizzerias, public transport is well located (1 min to catch a tram #14 to the Central Station). 10 min walk to the metro at Weesperplein. Our neighbours are the Botanical Garden and the popular Zoo Artis.

name: Unique spacious (private) boat in Amsterdam.
description:
"Sailing barge Titaan” is a relatively new ship in the Dutch fleet. She is build in 2001 and has been used mostly for romantic sailing trips and weddings.

Nowadays she has been refitted to accommodate groups of passengers (up to 12 people). The traditional white sailing barge in combination with a more modern and luxury interior gives the whole ship an interesting twist and a perfect place to unwind and relax.

name: Modern 2BR duplex
description: This place has a unique style all on its own. It has a fresh, urban vibe with some cosy nooks and crannies. Stay here and enjoy all the comforts of your own home.

name: Spacious, stylish apartment in central lively area
description: The apartment is well located in a central, vibrant neighbourhood, just a 15 minute tram or 10 minute bike ride from Amsterdam Centraal Station. Surrounded by great cafes, local bars, restaurants and parks. The spacious, light and comfortable apartment is perfect for a couple or friends who are looking for a great way to experience Amsterdam.

name: Four bed family home, River view centrally located
description:
Amstelview is a large traditional brick house from 1900, it has 2 floors. You stay at the first floor: living room+office, 3 bedrooms, private bathroom. I live on the ground floor, the front door is shared with me. In the hallway, an extra door separates my private apartment from the AirBnb.
The Weesperzijde street is Amsterdam's best kept secret! Green+wide riverfront, bikes and pedestrians. Lined with houseboats+sidewalk restaurants towards the historical centre in 15 min.

name: Lovely 1-bedroom condo in the heart of Amsterdam
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.
The apartment is in one of the coolest and hippest districts in Amsterdam.
There are local cafes and restaurants around.
There is a lovely little terrace.

name: Appartement city centre
description: Renovated own apartment with balcony and comfortable large bed. Best possible location: in the middle of the city centre near the rijksmuseum (350 meters) 90 meters from the metro (20-25 minutes to the airport, 5 min to Amsterdam Rai, 5 minutes to Amsterdam central station) in one of the most beautiful neighborhoods of Amsterdam.

name: Prachtige gezinswoning in Amsterdam
description:
Our beautiful family home is available for you (and your family). The house has a master bedroom, a guest bedroom, baby bedroom, 2 bathrooms, large living area, and a kitchen with everything you need. There are 2 terraces, a smaller one on the lower level and a large sunny one on the upper level.

The house is located near the "Amsterdamse bos", a really nice park to go for a run or just a walk. There are plenty of restaurants/cafes in the area and the Amsterdam city center is about 20m away.

name: Spacious, luxury home with garden
description: Perfectly located, spacious 76m2 apartment in Amsterdam West between Vondelpark and Rembrandtpark.  New, fully equipped, kitchen and bathroom with separate bath and rain shower, large double bed and great garden with BBQ. You have the option to choose whether you would prefer to use the separate office space or the children’s room. One of the two will be closed for storage of personal belongings during your stay.

name: Luxurious apartment with garden in Amsterdam!
description: This spacious ground floor apartment with garden is located in a populair area in Amsterdam West. The apartment is based in a child-friendly neighborhood between two city parks. Moreover, public transport is around the corner with only 10 minutes away from the city centre. In the neighbourhood facilitates ample of populair restaurants and cafe's or supermarkets. In addition, a babybed can be prepared at request for young families.

name: Cozy stylish apartment Amsterdam
description:
This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated. With my interior consultant training, I have put a lot of love into my cozy apartment. So cozy that I'd love to share this experience with you. The apartment is in Amsterdam Oud West and is 5 minutes from Leidseplein. The tram is at the end of the street. Supermarket and cafes, everything is nearby.
I have 2 cats that will stay home to welcome you. And will keep you company.

name: Renovated apartment Rivierenbuurt, near Pijp/ RAI
description: Quietly located corner apartment in a nice, safe neighborhood. Supermarkets within walking distance, as well as several restaurants. Within a few minutes you will find yourself in De Pijp, a vibrant district in Amsterdam with many bars and restaurants. There is a tram/bus stop 2 minutes away or go for the local experience and rent a bike at a bike shop nearby.

name: Floating eco design home in heart of Amsterdam
description: Our floating eco design house is ideal as a short stay for one or two people, to relax and as a base to explore Amsterdam. Equipped with designer furniture, a large kitchen with modern sustainable appliances, a grand piano, a TV lounge room, convenient workplace, king size bed and bathroom with bathtub. In the unique floating village of Schoonschip.  Very close to the city center - within walking/biking distance to the ferry to Amsterdam city center, with public transport around the corner.

name: Modern appartement dichtbij Amsterdam Centraal
description:
Fun with the whole family in this stylish space. Perfect for 2 adults (with or without children) or for 4 adults.

We kindly ask you to look after our cat during your stay.

name: Small studio on an original Amsterdam houseboat.
description: This is a lovely small studio on a houseboat with a private entrance. It consists of a room, bathroom and kitchenette. The atmosphere is cozy and private. The location is excellent. Just 15 min walk from Centraal or the Dam. Feel your love and lover in a totally wonderful setting encircled in the passion of Amsterdam. Now, you have a chance to enjoy the water, to share with your partner, to entwine yourselves in the history, love, and romance of this lovely houseboat on the Korte Prinsengracht

name: Nice accomadation for youngs and travelers
description: One room for travelers passing by Amsterdam. Room has a double sized bed. Suitable for couples or singles. We will be sharing common areas like kitchen, bathroom and living room. There are washing machine, dryer, microwave oven and other common furnitures. Reach me online: ademgunesen

name: Very spacious dreamhouse with sunny garden!
description: In our modern and very tastefully furnished home, it is a wonderful life for you and your children OR for 1-2 couples. Our house has all the comforts. This is a real home, not a home that is furnished only to rent. The advantage of this is that everything is there and you can use everything, such as children's bicycles, skateboard, toys, guitar and a stocked kitchen. The garden faces south. The glass sliding doors provide light and space in the greenest neighborhood of Amsterdam!

name: Very Unique City Center Family Home - Museumsquare
description: Our beautiful house is located only one feet away from Museumsquare, the heart of Amsterdam city centre with its most famous musea next door and great variety of restaurants and bars. The apartment is suitable for couple/families and has a very spacious living room, a full equipped kitchen and sunny front and back garden. It’s a 2 floor house that leads directly to the canal where a friendly family of ducks will visit you every morning. This home will make your stay an unforgettable experience!

name: A'dam (1) Twiske  prive kamer- (incl 2 fietsen)
description:
This private room has the most beautifull view in Amsterdam. Very relaxing and you will think your in the middle of the wouds.
IN the moring you'll wake-up and will hear the birds sing.

name: Luxury, designer loft penthouse in Canal District
description: 1760 built, UNESCO heritage listed, fully renovated by famous designer, 140sqm (1,500 sq ft), 2-floor, luxury, designer loft penthouse by historic Herengracht canal with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (including 1 hammam with canal view), at the centre of Amsterdam Canal District. 7m walk from Anne Frank, 5m from Dam Square, 5sec from 9 Streets boutique shopping. NO LIFTS, ONLY STAIRS. NO PETS ALLOWED. NO BABIES. I decline 9 out of 10 incoming requests! ONLY CLASSY GUESTS. NO NEGOTIATIONS.

name: Private bedroom in Cozy apartment in Amsterdam!
description:
We are renting a big bedroom with shared WC and shared bathroom our cozy apartment in Amsterdam!
In this apartment, you'll immediately feel at home in the warm and inviting atmosphere.

The interior design and decor can greatly influence your experience as guest.
When you're ready to venture out, the city centre is a 20 min distance away.

You can hop on the Tram 2 or take a leisurely bike ride into the heart of Amsterdam.

name: Perfect 1-bedroom apartment with hot tub.
description:
Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space located in the heart of Amsterdam Zuid (Zuidas).

You’ll be 3 minute walking distance away from train and metro station and 1 metro away from city center. Perfect for some nice and peaceful holidays at Amsterdam.

name: CCentre Light gf. apt. | 150m² | garden + view
description:
Welcome to our place.

Our apartment is situated at the lower two floors of at 19th century building with a lot of interesting Dutch Architecture.

And lies opposite of the Park, within 5 minutes you are in the heart of City Center. In the street you find several restaurants and bars and the Tropen Museum. Wihtin 500m from our home you have high-end Hotels like Hyat, Pillows and Arena.

PUBLIC TRANSPORT (door to door):
- JohanCruijff Arena: 20m
- Rai: 20m
- Museumsquare: 19m
- Damsquare: 18m

name: Family house with garden near subway
description: We keep a 5 nights minimum! Big house with garden facing South, so very bright. Close to lake, 10 minutes walk from train/subway and bikeride distance to BijlmerArenA train station, Ziggo Dome etc. , 30 min from airport,

name: Appartement in Stadsdeel Zuid — Pijp
description: Our spacious apartment is located in the bustling district of De Pijp and has all the comforts. The cozy apartment is warm and modernly decorated, making it feel like home right away. You are only 50 meters from a direct metro connection to Amsterdam Centraal & Amsterdam Zuid. De Pijp is a characteristic neighborhood full of restaurants and cultural venues. The Museum Quarter is a walk of only 5 minutes.

name: Gezellige woning aan het park
description: A house at the park and near a forest! It’s a family friendly home with a petting zoo within walking distance. It’s a spacious house in Amsterdam with a lot of nature and birds around you. There is a fireplace and possibilities for a campfire on the patio. There is free parking in this neighborhood and also great access to Amsterdam city center by metro (10 min walking).

name: Houseboat-Amsterdam-classic
description:
No smoking
Normal central heating

Proud to present beautiful classic Houseboat center of Amsterdam near Central Station! Amazing views you will definitely appreciate the warm look of the place with all its wooden finishes. Central heating, shower, toilet, everything is modernized and works just like it would in an apartment. TV, Wi-Fi, Nespresso coffee, steamer, hairdryer, and a water cooker are provided No other cooking facilities. Walking distance Dam Square, Nemo Museum, Public library

name: Luxury and spacious Loft by the Park w/ Rooftop
description: Relax in this spacious 90m² apartment on a quiet street next to a park, just 15 minutes from the city center. And public transport at a 2 min walk. Enjoy a luxury kitchen with island, combi oven, Nespresso, and Quooker. Walk to nearby restaurants and cafés. Unwind in the stylish living room in the bathtub or at the couch with Netflix, or sip free coffee on the large and sunny rooftop terrace with skyline views or on the balcony. Zandvoort beach is close by. Enjoy your stay!

name: Lively street in trendy East
description:
Cozy, stylish apartment (47m2) in lively Amsterdam East, a 5 minute train ride from Amsterdam Central station. Conveniently located close to the train station, bus and tram stations. On my street: supermarkets, restaurants, gyms, shops, etc.

When not traveling myself, I normally live in the apartment, so I’m looking for guests who respect the space. I am happy to share my favourite spots and restaurants in the city and neighborhood and always available via text for tips.

name: 2BR + Balcony Stylish apartment | 4P | Canal views
description:
Ce logement est proche de tous les sites et commodités.
Please take into consideration that we are only allowed to host adults (and children above 12 years).

name: Jordaan Loft on Canal
description:
The loft is a 93m2 one-bedroom apt. located in the heart of the Jordaan with a cozy French balcony overviewing the canal.
The neighborhood is central, close to public transport & museums with great restaurants & bars around and all within walking distance.
The mix of modern design furniture combinates with art and plants gives it a coyz living - the living room is spacious with 3.3m high ceilings, a kitchen island and a comfortable sitting lounge. The bedroom has a large kingsize bed.

name: Cosy Trendy Design Apartment in Amsterdam Center
description:
A beautiful, cosy and trendy apartment in the center of Amsterdam. With 10 minutes you can find yourself on the canals and dam square. You will be at Schiphol Airport within 15 minutes.

The apartment is located in a quiet street and is surrounded by a lot of trendy coffee cafes and wine bars. There is a big park nearby for some romantic walks. The neighborhood is very save and friendly.

In 10 minute by tram you will be at the canals, the Rijksmuseum, Anne Frank Museum and Van Gogh Museum.

name: Prachtig appartement in de Pijp
description:
This centrally located apartment (85 m2) offers everything you need for a great stay.

For a cozy and lively neighborhood, you have to be in De Pijp.
In the streets around the colorful Albert Cuyp market, you will find numerous trendy shops, bars, museums and restaurants.

The space
The apartment is on the 3rd and 4th floor, facing south.
Guests can use the entire apartment: bathroom, kitchen, living room, bedroom, terrace and roof terrace.

name: Modern Apartment with Rooftop Terrace in AdamWest
description: Discover a bright, modern apartment in Bos en Lommer. Enjoy a cozy balcony for morning coffee and a spacious private rooftop terrace for sunset views. Surrounded by local cafés, green parks, and easy tram access, this stylish two-storey apartment offers the perfect blend of comfort and Amsterdam West charm. A relaxing home base to explore the city like a local.

name: Modern apartment with parkview
description:
This beautiful, modern apartment with plenty of light & space offers everything for a lovely stay for 2-3 pers. It's bright with a sitting area in the window to enjoy the view of the beautiful and quiet park. There is a fully equipped open kitchen and many plants! Enjoy the walk-in shower or relax at the balcony that's connected to the bedroom. Buses and trams (2 min walk) run to all train-stations and city parts.
We absolutely love our house & area, so we'll have plenty of recommendations!

name: Cozy courtyard room in the old center
description: Dormer bedroom with a queen-size double bed and shared bathroom. At the quiet side of the guest wing. The apartment is located next to the lively Leidseplein (City Centre), with the scenic and world-famous Canals of Amsterdam just around the corner.

name: Cozy dormer room in the old center
description: Dormer bedroom with a queen-size double bed and shared bathroom - in the guest wing of the apartment. Located next to the lively Leidseplein (City Centre), with the scenic and world-famous Canals of Amsterdam just around the corner.

name: Cosy Studio Apartment
description: Are you looking for a cosy, well-located place to stay in Amsterdam? Then this might be your place! My studio apartment is well located in Bos en Lommer (Amsterdam West). There is a direct connection with bus 15 to Sloterdijk Station and Amsterdam Zuid Station, and with bus 21 you are at central station in 15 minutes. The apartment also has an elevator. Ideal for a short stay if you are looking for explore the city.

name: Uniek Amsterdams dijkhuis
description: Unique and entire dike house on the most beautiful street in Amsterdam, De Nieuwendammerdijk. With 4 bedrooms and 6 sleeping accommodations. The historic Nieuwendammerdijk is a protected city area with many monumental buildings. This is the perfect combination of a relaxed village atmosphere with wide views and the city center of Amsterdam just a stone's throw away. The ideal base during a wonderful stay in Amsterdam in this unique, family-friendly accommodation.

name: Child-friendly 2 bed garden flat in great location
description:
A stylish, child-friendly, recently refurbished, ground floor, 2 bedroom apartment with garden, located in one of the best neighbourhoods in Amsterdam, near to the wonderful Vondelpark as well as close to the city centre via tram, bike or walking.
Local neighbourhood comprises of numerous great cafes, bakeries, bars and restaurants.
We are less than 20m from the nearest supermarket.
An extra high quality mattress is available for the kids' bedroom giving space for two kids to stay.

name: Lovely Two Bedroom Apartment with Roof Terrace
description:
The perfect place for enjoying Amsterdam. Cosy top floor apartment located on a peaceful street in the Oost just a minute's walk from vibey Javastraat.

Studio Bike rental is across the street and great for hiring bikes. There is also a tram route outside the apartment that can take you around the city. Alternately Muiderpoort Station is close by and handy for traveling to Schipol. The beautiful Flevopark and Oosterpark are also within walking distance.

name: Cosy, central located apartment
description: Just get away from it all in this centrally located but quiet accommodation. Our house has all the amenities and is well suited as a starting point for discovering Amsterdam. A cozy place and in our own personal style in the middle of Amsterdam.

name: Beautiful Luxury Apartment
description:
Welcome to my home, a beautiful design luxury apartment decorated with high-quality design furniture. I live here, and I rent the apartment only while traveling.
The apartment provides all the accessories needed for a pleasurable experience in Amsterdam. The apartment is easily accessible from both Schipol Airport and Amsterdam Central Station.

name: Cozy two bedroom guest wing in the old center
description: Dormer bedroom and courtyard bedroom both with a queen-size double bed, private bathroom all on your private floor (the guest wing). Located next to the lively Leidseplein (City Centre), with the scenic and world-famous Canals of Amsterdam just around the corner.

name: Appartement with river view
description: Our spacious, modern and colorful apartment is within walking distance of the bustling NDSM area, amidst all the culinary hotspots and a 15-minute walk from the pond that takes you to the city center. A luxury kitchen with Cooker and sparkling water from the tap give you a feeling of luxury, and both sides of the apartment have a large balcony where you can enjoy sun, views of the IJ and spectacular sunsets from morning to evening.

name: Spacious 2-bedroom appartement with free parking
description:
Explore Amsterdam from this spacious 2-bedroom apartment with private parking. Quiet area while walking distance to Vondelpark. Also well connected via train/metro/tram/bus, all within a 5-min walk, and only 7-min train ride to the airport.

Living room with brand new kitchen, a cozy corner sofa, and smart TV. One bedroom offers a kingsize bed, and the other is furnished with a sofa bed, an adjustable desk and comfy office chair. Newly renovated bathroom.

For a perfect stay in Amsterdam!

name: Comfort Room, ontbijt is inbegrepen.
description:
From this charming accommodation located in the 'Rosse buurt', you can easily reach popular shops, restaurants and bars. Just an 8-minute walk from the Central Station. Paid parking garage is 10 minutes away.
We are happy to help our guests with their plans and provide them with all the information for a pleasant stay in our beautiful city.

Breakfast included.

name: Spacious House with bikes
description:
This house in the quiet neighborhood of Aker has all the comforts. A double room, and a guest room with a bed that can be made into a double bed, a very nice and bright workspace in the attic + a workspace in the guest room and a south-facing garden! Riverbridge Suite offers all the comforts of home for a perfect short or long stay in Amsterdam.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam with garden
description: This cosy but comfortable appartement is on ground level and has a small outside area to its own. It has a spacious bedroom with a luxurious bed, and a stylish living room. The house is located on the border between De Jordaan area and Amsterdam West which is an almost perfect location for any trip to Amsterdam with everything you could want nearby.

name: Hotelkamer op de gracht
description:
This centrally located and tastefully decorated hotel room is located in a monumental canal house in the Jordaan. The accommodation is around the corner from the Prinsengracht, Anne Frank House, Westerkerk and the 9 streets. Ideally located to discover the old city!

The room has its own front door and can be entered directly from the street. The room also has a nice view of the water, a private bathroom and a nice king size bed. Flexible check-in is possible with the help of a key locker!

name: Contemporary and secluded gem in Amsterdam
description:
It's located just a short tram ride away from the city center, and it's surrounded by lush green surroundings.
This 3-story contemporary home is the perfect place to relax and unwind after a day of exploring the city.

The house has been recently renovated, and it's decorated with stylish design furniture and artworks. The living room and kitchen are light and open spaces. There is a sunny terrace with a table, benches, and chairs, as well as a hammock where you can relax.

name: Great apt. in Amsterdam zuid
description:
Very nice and brand new apartment located in one of the nicest areas in Amsterdam where you'll find lots of nice restaurants, bars and parks (Vondelpark and Rembrandtparkt). The area is very clean, tourist friendly and very safe.

The tram and bus stop right in front of the apartment which will bring you to the city centre within 7 minutes. Schiphol Airport and Amsterdam Central Station are only 20 minutes away by public transport.

The apartment is big, cosy, clean and brand new.

name: Cozy Jordaan house with lush garden
description: Beautiful cosy house with trendy and fully equiped kitchen and spacious living room. Enjoy peace and quiet in the unique garden after enjoying all the highlights closeby. Walk into the Jordaan or Westerpark, take the tram that stops around the corner and discover all of Amsterdam!

name: Authentic renovated apartment Amsterdam
description: This trendy renovated apartment is located in the Southern part of the city (Amsterdam Oud-Zuid). The typical Amsterdam neighbourhood is very quiet but close to shops and supermarkets. Ideal to stay for a couple or two friends. It is located on the Van Tuyll van Serooskerken Square, which leads to the historical Olympic Stadium of Amsterdam. The bus and tram stop is around the corner and takes you to other places in Amsterdam in minutes. A unique and comfortable apartment with a great location!

name: Penthouse on the Amstel
description: This unique penthouse on the Amstel is the perfect place to visit Amsterdam. You will have a spacious apartment. With 2 big bedrooms and 2 bathrooms and your own elevator that brings you right in the livingroom. The location is perfect as it is right next to Amstelstation and metrostation Spaklerweg and beautifully located on the amstel  and near the centre. In the area are some amazing restaurants and bars that I would love to recommend to you.

name: Gezellig appartement
description: It's a great place that's perfect for a group of friends or 2 couples. Also as a family, this apartment is perfect to use. It is next to a number of trendy restaurants and fun nightlife venues

name: Spacious modern house with cat.
description:
Our spacious, stylishly decorated house is fully furnished. With a south-facing garden, a brand new kitchen, a bubble bath and a fully equipped study you will enjoy Amsterdam to the fullest. Staying here is a perfect mix of nature and hustle and bustle, with the NDSM (industrial art-district) just steps away and nature reserve Twiske around the corner.

Our house is a real residence, so not just for rental. That means that our super sweet, cuddly cat Jip also likes to be fed and taken care of!

name: Historic Canal View Apartment [Unesco]
description:
Located on the picturesque Keizersgracht canal, just around the corner from the iconic Westerkerk and Anne Frank House, this apartment is a great base for spending time in Amsterdam.

The 9 straatjes and Jordaan are within walking distance. The Van Gogh Museum, Dam Square and about a zillion other must-sees are all within minutes walking distance.

The apartment is situated on the first floor and offers unique views of the canal through three large front-facing windows.

description:
Brand new one bedroom apartment in Amsterdam.
This apartment is situated in a very nice and quiet area of Amsterdam. There is a bar and restaurant at the end of the street. Within 20 mins walk you'll be at the Javastraat, a very nice area with bars and restaurants. The apartment is very comfortable, with floor heating and cooling. It's small but it has everything you need. Amsterdam Centraal Station is not too far, so you will have easy acces with the center.

name: Lovely appartment old west
description: Renovated ground floor apartment near Vondelpark. Spacious living room with sunny garden. Open-plan kitchen with island, modern furniture such as 5-p stove, oven, Quooker and Coffee Roaster. Netflix, sonos sound system, WiFi. Two bedrooms (one kingsize and two single beds) and a third room (f.i. bedroom a/o study room). Luxurious bathroom (shower/separate bath), and separate toilet. Garden house can serve as working/fitness space.

name: Newly designed apartment
description:
Experience Amsterdam in peaceful and centrally-located place. My apartment is newly renovated and designed. It is in a residential neighborhood which is quiet and clean.
I have a fully equipped kitchen will all you need to cook your fav meal if you want or enjoy a cup of coffee/tea to kick off your day or relax.
My apartment comes with floor heating to keep you warm in colder days.
Toilet is separate from bathroom which comes practical when needed.
Enjoy your stay :)

name: Cozy apartment in Amsterdam West
description:
This light and cozy apartment is located in Amsterdam West - a trendy neighborhood filled with (actual!) coffee shops, cafes, bars, restaurants and one of the city's best bakeries - Fort Negen - just 2 minutes' walk away. You are just 15 mins from Amsterdam Centraal on a tram or bike.

The apartment has a double bedroom which opens out onto a balcony. The kitchen is fully equipped, the bathroom is newly renovated, and the living and dining area are spacious and stylish.

name: Bright Rooftop Apartment
description:
This bright and cozy apartment is located on the top floor. With 2 roof terraces, you can enjoy the view and the sun. With a modern and cozy decor, it feels like a cozy cottage.

With a fresh market (dappermarkt) around the corner, you have fresh products and delicious snacks 6 days a week. Nearby you will find many good eateries of different types of cuisines: Asian to Yemeni.

A place you will enjoy!

name: Queen Wilhelmina naast Vondelpark
description:
This stylish, just renovated Queen Wilhelmina, with own entry door, private luxurious bathroom, and a pantry with a fridge, "Nespresso" coffee maker , kettle for tea, is situated at a quiet street in the center of Amsterdam.

The nice Vondelpark is a 3 minute walk and Museumplein and Leidseplein are a 19 minute walk.

Around the corner on Jan Pieter Heijestraat there are several boutiques and nice places for coffee, lunch and dinner.

This unique corner apartment has a view at the canals and is located in a prime location in the centre. Located in a green area with lots water, also called "The garden of Amsterdam".

Our apartment is 3 minutes walk from the tram station called Alexanderplein. This station takes you within 5 minutes to the metro line or you can take the tram for 10 minutes to the city center. Lastly, we have a bike shop around the corner so you can have the full Dutch experience during your stay!

In the trendy Indische Buurt, close to top tourist spots, shops, bars and restaurants. Walk or tram ride to Artis , Rembrandtplein, Dam Square, Centraal Station. A few minutes walking from the Dappermarkt, Eastern park, Tropen museum and the zoo Artis ✨

Supermarkets, stores, gym, park and public transportion are all within a few minutes walking distance.

The apartment is centrally located: 7 mins walk from albert cuyp, a 5 minute walk from Museum plein, a 10 min walk from Vondelpark and 20 mins walk from the city center (public transportation is right outside)

Spacious (125m2) light canal house in the center of Amsterdam. Beautiful view on the Tropenmuseum and just behind Artis Zoo and Oosterpark.

You are a 5 minute walk away from a street full of bars, restaurants and coffee places.

The appartment is equipped with everything you need! Vinyl player, TV, 2 bathrooms, 2 bedrooms and a spacious homeoffice with sofa bed.

Downstairs is a spacious sitting room with a view of the water and an open kitchen with all the equipment you need

Apple TVs with Netflix, Prime, Disney+, HBO Max, Viaplay, Plex, Discovery+, Apple Music, Spotify

Enjoy a nice lunch or a tasty diner in- or outside one of the modern cafes and restaurants. Visit all the famous places or just stroll around. You'll love it!

Enjoy Amsterdam while recharging in this apartment, including free bikes and a cleaning service during your stay. Available for long-term rentals.

name: Cosy, colorful appartment (pijp)
description:
A cosy two-floor appartement in the heart of Amsterdam. It is a sunny, bright, colourful appartement with a spacious livingroom and a cosy balcony (with sun most of the day!). The location is super central, so a perfect homebase to explore the city!
I have a spacious living room, a bedroom with a balcony, a kitchen, a toilet and a bathroom. The appartment will be an ideal place for a single or couple. Warning: steep stairs!

name: 4F - Congress Centre Apartments - roof terrace
description:
Looking for a full-furnished 4p apartment + huge terrace in the heart of Amsterdam's vibrant De Pijp area?

This spacious gem is ideal for anyone looking for a cozy, welcoming home in the city’s most popular neighborhood. Rent is €3250,-/month.
The apartment is bigger than the photos suggest, offers a warm, inviting atmosphere. With fast WiFi, you’ll stay connected with ease. Plus, with supermarkets just around the corner, everything you need is right at your doorstep. Registration allowed!

name: Stylish two floor apartement with private garden
description: Our lovely 2 floor apartment is suitable for 4 people and has a very green city garden with terrace on the south. The house is located  in the Oud-West district, directly at the entrance of the famous Vondelpark and within walking distance of the most important museums and the center of Amsterdam. A tram stop is opposite the street and connects the location with Central Station. The immediate area is certainly worth a visit because of the many museums, cafes, restaurants and shops in the area.

name: Spacious & warm (family) house in a quiet area
description:
Attractive family home (102m2) with garden, lounge sofa and trampoline in a beautiful old neighborhood with lots of green and playgrounds.

Enjoy the sun in the backyard and sidewalk. Swim or SUP in the canal or the Amstel. Or enjoy special places nearby for good food and drinks.

Welcome to our beautiful penthouse located in the heart of Amsterdam's charming Jordaan neighborhood! This spacious and modern apartment boasts a private rooftop garden terrace in the middle of the city center.

The apartment features high ceilings and large windows that let in plenty of natural light, making it the perfect space for relaxing and entertaining.

We are ONLY allowed to host families or couples. No groups of friends.

Located in a quiet residential neighborhood close to cafés, shops, and public transport. Perfect for couples, solo travelers, or business guests seeking comfort, charm, and an authentic local experience.

The apartment is located on the top floor, which means lots of natural light throughout the day in the house and on both balconies. You’ll find that the apartment offers a brand new kitchen, bathroom and comfortable bed.

Light, attractive, well maintained split-level apartment located in the highly desirable Jordaan neighbourhood.

This unique apartment is spacious and has all modern features and appliances to meet your needs.

You will for sure experience Amsterdam and it's beauty to the fullest when staying in this lovely apartment in the Jordaan area.

Cozy, newly renovated, attractive 2-story apartment 80m2 with balcony. The apartment is located in a quiet oasis in the middle of the bustling neighborhood "de Pijp."
De Pijp is known for its many cozy restaurants, nice bars and the famous Albert Cuyp market. In addition, many museums such as the Rijksmuseum, the Van Gogh museum and the Heineken Experience are within walking distance. The metro station can also be reached within 5 minutes.

name: Beautiful well located apartment

Beautiful apartment located in Amsterdam-East.
You will stay in a quiet apartment all for yourself (please: no parties!). There are many nice bars and restaurant just around the corner, and of course we are more than happy to give you some tips. If however this is not enough for you, all public transport is around the corner and takes you in <15 minutes to the center (6 min. to central station). Or even better: 20 min by bike :-)
