Everything you need is within walking distance. There are several supermarkets and specialty shops for your daily shopping and my (your) favorite restaurants, bars and cafes are around the corner. And even better, within one minute you are at the Albert Cuyp Market!

name: Spacious waterfront apartment (canal view)
description:
In a quiet part of De Baarsjes. Near the buzzing 'Golden Triangle' of Oud-West, De Baarsjes and Vondelpark, this spacious and well-arranged 3-room, 2-bedroom apartment of 75 m² is now available for rent. It has been renovated three years ago so it is as good as new.

The spacious living room at the front has a beautiful unobstructed view over the water and the (defunct! so no noise) mosque.

name: Groot appartement met dakterras.

I would love to welcome you to my beautiful and spacious 140m² apartment located in the heart of Amsterdam! The two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment offers the perfect combination of modern comfort and authentic charm. The seperate office and dining area, as well as the open kitchen, provide ample space for you to relax and enjoy your stay.

One of the highlights of our apartment is the stunning roof terrace, which offers breathtaking views of the city (photo's are missing because of renovation).

Last but not least enjoy working at the home office space also overlooking waterfronts views, with a brand new en-suite bathroom where you can relax and wash the day off

Enjoy your own accommodation, your own living room, bedroom and bathroom, on your own floor. You will have complete privacy.

Several times elected the most beautiful canal of Amsterdam, it's central to everything you want to visit, yet so lovely and calm.

The apartment has one bedroom and one study room. There is wifi available so you can easily work from the apartment. Alternatively we can put an air bed in the study room, so you can stay here with up to 4 people.

It is a nice neighborhood, where there is a lot of living, working, shopping, with restaurants and cafes and a daily market around the corner. Almost everything is within walking distance, but also well connected by public transportation.

name: Sunny Amsterdam Groundfloor Home with Garden

The apartment is located in a quiet street in the heart of the bubbly Amsterdam Oost. The Oosterpark many restaurants & bars and famous museums are around the corner.  Enjoy the peaceful garden with bbq and soak up the sun on the small bench in front of the house. The bedroom is super quiet, with a large and comfortable bed (1.80m wide).

description:

Recently voted among the 15 best AirBnb locations by Time Out magazine. There is air conditioning in the bedroom and a lovely gas fireplace in the lounge area. In the summer, you can enjoy swimming from the terrace or spend an afternoon relaxing in the sun.
Also take a look at https://www.airbnb.nl/rooms/1593551908037238762, my new project.

name: Wake up with the View
description: This unique place has its own style. Located in a typical Amsterdam house on one of the central but quiet streets: Nes. You will live "on the roof" of Amsterdam overlooking other buildings. You will be awakened by the melodies of the chimes from the historic church towers. If the weather is good, you can have breakfast on a small terrace, enjoying this freedom in the middle of the bustling tourist life of the capital. The apartment is bright during the day, atmospheric at night. It also has a rooftop exit overlooking the stars.

Our place is the really best place you can pick. Why?

Old Dutch house totally renovated with modern look and a boho/vintage touch situated next to a canal. Lively by day and peaceful at night.

Best, best, best location to move anywhere you want (no kidding):
100 meters from our door you have the 52-metro that takes you North to South and Tram that takes you West to East. Rijksmuseum, De Pijp, Dam Square, LGBT street all in less 15mins walk distance!

Very Dutch, very modern & very easy!

name: Greenspot
description:
Friends and family home. Relax and come to rest in a green and quiet neighbourhood, alongside a park, close to the lake and not far from the city.

You will have a whole house for yourself, with equipped kitchen, comfortable coaches, movie projector, bathroom with bath and shower, garden and parking place in front (dayticket 17 euro).

Enjoy a 6 km walk or run around the lake, go for a swim in summer.

Airport is 10 minutes by train, and public transportation is nearby. City centre is 15-20

name: Oasis in trendy Amsterdam East
description: Design apartment with nice garden, in one of the nicest neighborhoods in Amsterdam. The space is stylish, but very cozy in the evening. There are two nice bedrooms with double beds, a sitting area and a kitchen with everything you need. The quiet garden is exceptional in densely populated Amsterdam. The house is within walking distance of supermarket, metro and train station and the romantic Amstel river. It is a 10-minute bike ride to the city center. In short, the perfect place to explore Amsterdam!

name: Penthouse Loft with a View
description: Beautiful 2 bedroom 1 bathroom top floor apartment.  It's 1 minute walk from the metro, and 1 stop from Centraal Station.  Super convenient from the airport or driving by car.  The apartment is totally furnished, and kitchen has all the amenities you could need.  There's a small, 2-person Finnish sauna you are free to use.  I personally live in the apartment and rent it out when I'm traveling.  It's a peaceful, comfortable refuge with easy access to everything in Amsterdam.

name: One of a kind, a Piece of art
description:
This unique accommodation has its own style.

The Wenslauerhuis was completely renovated by an architect in 2015. You imagine yourself in a house that looks a bit like a Scandinavian interior.
The beautifully finished rooms, the sturdy concrete look, the wooden ceilings, the kitchen that invites you to cook, the hanging fireplace where you can sit for whole evenings and roast a marshmallow yourself. There are 2 bathrooms, 1 of which has a bathtub. Large TV room for wonderful relaxation.

name: Spacious Amsterdam flat with sunny outdoor spaces
description:
The perfect blend of comfort and style at my apartment, centrally located in Amsterdam. Walking distance to great parks & restaurants, and the airport & city centre are within 15 min. by public transport.

With beautiful natural light, this apartment offers comfort and privacy after a day of exploring the city.

The apartment has everything: from a very comfortable bedroom, a great bathroom, a fully-equipped kitchen and living room, to a home office, balcony and a roof terrace with sun all day.

name: Luxury canal view suite big and central
description:
This big and compleet appartment is on the best and most central spot you can imagine. Only 10 minutes walk from central station. In a great viral neighborhood.
With lots off restaurants, bars Museums,shops and the Royal palace and shopping walhalla just around the corner.
Beautiful view right on the canal.
Steps outside for a drink watching people .
With the bedroom in the bag for a quiet sleep. Beautiful decorated.
Also available for long stay. Children and more guests possible on request.

name: Large entire traditional Dutch house with garden
description: Maak nieuwe herinneringen in deze unieke, gezinsvriendelijke accommodatie.

name: Canal house in the centre of Amsterdam
description: This room is placed in a cozy canal house, located in the middle of Amsterdam Jordaan. And just 1 minute from Anne Frank House.

name: Cosy apartment in the Pijp
description: In this centrally located accommodation, everything for your family is within reach. A bunk bed and a baby cot for children are provided. And there is a large playground in the street. Due to its central location, you can easily walk or bike to another nice neighborhood. And by metro and train, you can reach Schiphol Airport in 30 minutes.

name: Cute authentic houseboat in city centre!
description:
Welcome to my, cute, traditional blue houseboat in the city center of Amsterdam! Docked on the Prinsengracht, next to the Amstel, right on the historical Chanels of Amsterdam. Enjoy this super unique, bohemian experience that no hotel can provide.

Follow IG @ lekt_niet for more pictures!

name: Two person apartment
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.
It is a 15-minute walk from Amsterdam Dam.
You can sleep there with two people, and it has a bathroom, 2-person bed and kitchen.
Washing machine is available, and you can park your car in the street for a fee.

name: Luxurious Family Apartment | 4BR | 2BATH | Garden
description:
These types of homes are rarely available!

Experience the joys of The Pijp area and the liveliness of this famous & historic neighborhood, while enjoying the tranquility of living in a historic monumental fully renovated house with a private garden. All utilities and amenities are included, so all you need to do is bring your suitcase!

This home is new on airbnb and very rarely and limited available.

Check-out the reviews of our Super-co-hosts. They will make sure you have a memorable stay!

name: Comfortable family home; free parking
description:
Welcome to our house for a relaxing holiday. Our house has everything you could wish for a holiday with your family. Enjoy the large park with a city beach within a 3-minute walk or take the tram and be in the center of Amsterdam within 20 minutes. While the children play with everything the house has to offer, you can relax in the sun-drenched garden.
Parking is expensive in Amsterdam, but we offer free private parking!
Attractive discount when you stay with us for a week or longer.

name: 5 stars Beautiful Sunny & new Renovated apartment
description: This elegant apartment is ideal for a couple. Recently refurbished with premium materials, it offers a relaxed and contemporary stay. The flat is set on an upscale shopping street next to a park. All parts of the city are easily reached by public transport, with a stop directly outside the building. In summer, the whole apartment is filled with light, and the spacious balcony enjoys sunshine all day. All other amenities, including supermarkets, cafés, restaurants are within a five-minute walk.

name: Spacious apartment (100m2) in trendy neighbourhood
description:
Enjoy a spacious and stylish stay in our home, while we’re away, in the heart of De Baarsjes (Amsterdam-West).

Our home is perfect for families and offers all the comfort you need for a relaxing stay.

The location is ideal: in a lively and trendy neighborhood filled with cozy cafés, great restaurants, and charming shops — all within walking distance. Within just 10 minutes by bike or public transport, you can reach the city center and all major attractions.

name: Stijlvol familiehuis met tuin
description: Fun with the whole family in this stylish space on the ground floor. A beautiful garden and large courtyard garden where you can play. Our house is suitable for families. Maximum of two adults and three children. Our house is spacious (180m2), with high ceilings and lots of light. The Vondelpark is within walking distance, as is the lively Hoofddorpplein with special shops, nice restaurants and cozy bars. The tram near the house will take you to the city center of Amsterdam in 15 minutes.

name: City Centre Gem
description:
Tucked away between Leidsegracht, one of the prettiest and quietest canals of the city, and the bustling Leidseplein Theatre quarter, you could hardly be more centrally located.
Many buildings in the vicinity date back to the 1600’s.
The Museum quarter and Vondelpark are a stone’s throw away as well as hundreds of bars and restaurants.
Excellent public transport connections to railway stations (Central Station 20 minutes) and airport (Schiphol Airport 35 minutes). Do not bring a car. Queries? DM

name: Beautiful City Apartment Amsterdam 90m2
description:
Lovely 3rd floor 90m2 apartment with a sunny patio and balcony, next to the Amstel and in the city center. Nice lively neighbourhood with lots of cool restaurants/bars and several beautiful parks with walking distance. The street itself is quiet with the city life just around the corner.

IMPORTANT: we respect our neighbours, so NO PARTIES are allowed in this apartment. Also, we value our stuff so please handle them as if they were your own.

name: Modern & light appartment Amsterdam City
description:
This appartment is located in central part of Amsterdam city, but silent at night. The rooms are light, spacious and stylishly furnished. On the first floor there’s a balcony and on the second floor there’s a small rooftop terrace with sunlight all day!

The house is fully equipped, which makes the appartment a comfortable place.

The biggest park of Amsterdam is around the corner and other beautiful famous areas, like the Jordaan, city center or canals, are only on a 10 min bike ride distance.

name: Premium apartment, wifi, roof terrace & near park
description: This 2-floor luxurious apartment is located near the RAI Amsterdam convencion centre. Public transport is on a short walking distance. This apartment is fully renovated and very spacious. As a host we always provide our guests with all information needed to have a great stay and enjoy your time in Amsterdam. On top of the apartment there is a great roof terrance including a barbeque. On the top floor we have an office with high-speed wifi. The apartment starts at the third floor.

name: Cozy apartment in Amsterdam
description: Live like an Amsterdam local in our apartment while we are away. With beautiful light, the apartment offers comfort and privacy after a day of exploring the city. It has everything you need: a full kitchen, spacious living room, balcony, and two comfortable 140x200 cm beds (one with a double duvet, one with two single duvets). Towels are provided and baby essentials are available on request. As this is our private home, some closets and fridge/freezer space contain our belongings.

name: Ideal for a family with children I  Cat co-hosting
description: Serenity by the Water: Unforgettable Amsterdam Flat with Breathtaking Views and kind Cat co-hosting !

name: Modern downtown apartment
description:
The space has been thoughtfully decorated with a modern touch, creating a sleek and inviting atmosphere.

One of the major highlights of this apartment is its unbeatable location. Situated in the center, you'll find yourself within walking distance of Leidseplein, one of Amsterdam's most popular squares. Immerse yourself in the bustling energy of the city, with an array of restaurants, bars, and entertainment options at your fingertips.

name: Cosy apartment in De Pijp
description:
Cosy 1-bedroom apartment in the heart of De Pijp. Located in the very center of De Pijp, only 2 min away from Metro station and trams. Situated on a quiet side street, the apartment is surrounded by small concept stores, cafes & wine bars, supermarkets and food stores.
10 min walking distance from Van Gogh & Rijksmuseum.

name: Motor Yacht Amazone close to centre of Amsterdam
description: Make your visit to Amsterdam even more special, stay on your own private motor yacht 'Amazone'. The yacht offers all facilities and comfort and will make your stay unforgettable. Staying aboard the Amazone is a wonderful way to experience Amsterdam. This beautiful ship is no less than 11.00 meters long and offers lots of charm and cosiness. We can accommodate up to 4 guests. You have the whole ship to yourself. If not available, check out our other yachts: At Ease, Almaz, Amstelle or Flint.

name: Cozy apartment in trendy ‘de Pijp’
description:
Just get away from it all in this soothing, centrally located accommodation. We live here and rent it to people we trust to take good care of it.

Our house is a quiet and cozy house located in the popular neighborhood "De Pijp". The house is located on a quiet street, but the bustling part of the city is within walking distance.

The house is equipped with everything to make your stay as easy and comfortable as possible.

name: Modern and bright apartment for two
description:
Be welcome in our nice, newly renovated home. The living room, furnished to Scandinavian design, is equipped with dining table, sofa, stove and TV, and the adjoining kitchen has modern appliances (e.g. Jura coffee maker).

The spacious bedroom has a work desk and connects to the dressing room with fitted wardrobes. From there you walk into the modern bathroom.

Our house is 10 minutes by bike from the Jordaan, making it easy to enjoy the charm of Amsterdam.

name: Double Room in our Cosy Canal Apartment
description:
Enjoy a stylish and welcoming experience sharing with us, at our canal apartment, on the Singelgracht Canal in AMS West.

We offer you our cosy, compact, bright double room.

Only a 10min walk to the heart of Jordaan, full of eclectic restaurants, cafes and vintage shopping + The 9 Streets (De 9 Straatjes) for more designer boutiques.

Easily accessible by bus from Centraal Station and trams close too.

We love our food, so for your first night there's a breakfast basket included too!

name: Amsterdam centrum/oost
description:
Well furnished apartment, centrally located (east side) in Amsterdam. Third floor, no elevator available (6 short but wide stairs).

Open kitchen and living room, separate bedroom (bed 1.40x2m) and bathroom. Large balcony/patio at the back with lounge set and evening sun.

Located near Artis, the Dappermarkt, Oosterpark, and many great cafes and restaurants. Easily accessible by public transport. Muiderpoort station is within walking distance.

name: Whole apartment in the old centre of Amsterdam
description:
In the middle of the old part of Amsterdam. At a children's playground and around the corner from Haarlemmerstraat and the canals. Restaurants and boutique shops are just a stone's throw away. An oasis of peace, amidst the hustle and bustle of the city center. In front of the apartment, you can sit outside at your own garden table, while you can see the children play. You can grab the bike from the house and go into the city!

Price is for up to 4 people.
A maximum of 6 people can stay.

name: Private Canal Apt in city centre
description:
A high-quality and luxuriously renovated 2-room upper apartment located on the Singel, near Blauwburgwal and the quaint streets of the Jordaan district.
This pleasantly designed apartment with spacious balcony has approximately 75 m2 of living space and is located on the second floor of a Monumental building (built in 1906) with stately entrance.

name: Planta casa Reus
description: A wonderful place to retreat and unwind. Ideal for a couple who love natural surroundings. Jump on the bike towards the Twiske nature reserve or cycle the other way and you will be in the heart of Amsterdam in 15 minutes.

name: Spacious home 20 min to centre (Free parking)
description: Discover a spacious, beautiful home in Amsterdam Noord, perfect for couples, friends, or families. Just an 8-minute bike ride to the vibrant NDSM area, where the action happens. Hop on the free ferry to Central Station, the city center, and the charming Jordaan neighborhood. Departures every 15-20 minutes. Plus, enjoy free parking! Rent a bike and explore!

name: Luxury apartment Amsterdam
description:
If you're looking for the perfect apartment in the heart of Amsterdam, look no further! This luxurious apartment has everything you need for a comfortable and romantic stay in the city.

The apartment is just steps away from all the best shopping, dining, and entertainment options that Amsterdam has to offer.

name: Luxurious and Modern apartment|Fully private
description: Located in the vibrant Old-East district of Amsterdam! This newly renovated studio includes a bedroom with comfy queen-size bed,  en-suite bathroom, a smart tv and  a small kitchenette that includes a fridge, kettle and coffee machine equipped with high quality coffee and tea options. If you are looking to stay in a luxurious apartment, located in a quiet yet lively neighborhood with perfect connection into the city center, then this is the place for you! Ideal for couples and solo travelers.

name: trendy gezins woning
description:
Stay in our beautiful house in the middle of the hip Watergraafsmeer (Amsterdam East). The house is very suitable for families and is a short distance (10 minutes by bike or public transport) from the center of Amsterdam and all the main attractions. In addition, you will find a huge number of cozy cafes, restaurants & shops in the immediate vicinity within walking distance.

It is also possible to use the enclosed private parking space 50 meters from the house for a small additional fee

name: City centre renovated apartment
description:
Cozy renovated place in the heart of the City Center.

- 1 minute walking distance to the Jordaan / Amsterdam Canals - 1 minute walking distance to the Anne Frank house
- 5 minutes walking distance to Dam Square
- 12 minutes walking distance to the Vondelpark
- 12 minutes walking distance to Central Station
- 15 minutes walking distance to Museum District
- 15 minute walking distance to Heineken Brewery
- 15 minutes walking distance to Amsterdam de Pijp

name: Sunny apartment
description: Welcome to our 70m2 apartment located in the heart of Amsterdam, near the Muiderpoort Station! Featuring a sunny balcony. This apartment provides the perfect base for exploring the city. With its central location near the Muiderpoort Station, summary, this apartment is the ideal base to enjoy everything Amsterdam has to offer!

name: Luxurious Amsterdam Loft with Amazing Rooftop
description: Beautiful recently renovated loft in the central and historic Old-West neighbourhood in Amsterdam (best part of town!). Comes with what we think is the best rooftop terrace we have ever seen in the city. With all day sun, barbecue and firepit included. The best bars, restaurants, cinema and must-see foodhallen are only a couple of steps away. And the Ten Kate Street market is literally there when you step out of the front door.

name: Spacious luxury 2 floors 104m2 appartment
description: Experience the luxury of everything double! The two apartments are located on 2 floors and are connected by an internal staircase. Modern stylishly decorated, lots of daylight and a beautiful view of the towers of Amstel station and a luxurious interior on the third floor with balconies on both sides and a new luxurious dining kitchen with every comfort. Luxury sofa, home cinema and a bath to relax and the possibility to withdraw in privacy whenever you want.

name: Sunny top-floor stay | roof terrace + balcony
description:
Wake up with sunlight flooding the apartment, step onto your private rooftop terrace with coffee, and enjoy a peaceful escape just minutes from the buzz of Amsterdam.

Light-filled top-floor stay with balcony, rooftop terrace and a comfy king-size bed. Quiet but central, near Jordaan, Westerpark and great local spots. Central Station is also easily reachable, making it a perfect base to explore the city.

Perfect for couples of friends looking for a peaceful, stylish stay with a local feel.

name: Pretty apartment near Vondelpark
description:
Stylish and cozy apartment next to Vondelpark.

All amenities are included, the only thing you need to bring along is your suitcase!

name: Luxurious 4 bedroom house in Amsterdam w garden
description:
Fully renovated 200 square meter family house close to Amsterdam City center.

4 bedrooms, 2 bath rooms

Very well equipped for families.

Separate dining room

Sunny garden with BBQ facilities

Separate TV room

Many original details

Office space with high speed LAN, perfect WIFI on every floor

Located in quite area of Amsterdam (Amsterdam Oost / East / Watergraafsmeer). Easy (paid) parking, public transport at your doorstep.

ONLY FAMILIES / NO PARTIES / MAX 4 PEOPLE / NO DRUGS

name: Lovely modern apartment in Amsterdam with garden
description:
Our lovely apartment in Amsterdam Oud-West (de Baarsjes) is located on a perfect spot to explore Amsterdam. There are many restaurants, shops, market and public transport near by.

The Apartment has been renovated some years ago. It is modern and has all appliances to have a good stay in Amsterdam.
In about 10 minutes you arrive by tram at the famous canals and in approximately 20 minutes you reach Amsterdam Airport (Schiphol) by taxi.

name: Spacious De Pijp gem
description: Welcome to our stunning two-bedroom house in the heart of De Pijp, one of Amsterdam's most vibrant neighborhoods. The house features two spacious en-suite bedrooms, a large roof terrace with beautiful city views, and is just steps away from restaurants, parks, and the famous Amstel Canal. Enjoy the bright and airy open-plan living and dining area, with central sound system, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Whether you're in Amsterdam for business or pleasure, our house is the perfect home away from home.

name: Luxe 90m2 appartement in De Pijp
description:
Luxurious and completely renovated city apartment of 90 m2 in the middle of the hip neighborhood De Pijp. Completely new and very tastefully designed, sunny apartment located on the 2nd and 3rd floor with spacious terrace by the living room. Enjoy a delicious homemade BBQ on the terrace or experience everything De Pijp has to offer from a very central location.

Ideal for couples, friends and families with children.

Check in: from 3 p.m.
Check out: before 11 a.m.

Registration number: 0363 C979 91B5 B67D 05BC

name: “Hidden Gem” @Jordaan studio (ground floor)
description: Welcome to our studio "Hidden Gem" in Amsterdam's Jordaan district. Perfect for solo travellers or couples, our studio features a comfortable kingsize bed, private small bathroom, kitchenette, outside patio and table/ workspace , within 5 minutes of all hotspots, the famous canals and museums. Our house is located in a quiet street , where you can sleep peacefully and all is for private use, we only share the main front door. Our studio is the perfect home base for your stay in the city.

name: Romantic studio in the old city - City Centre
description: Situated in an authentic Dutch canal house, our quaint private room with view over Amsterdam's famous "Koepelkerk" is the perfect getaway for two in the heart of Amsterdam's old city centre. Conveniently located a five minute walk from Amsterdam Central Station and within walking distance of famous sights such as Dam square, the Anne Frank house and the vibrant Jordaan district, you will be able to enjoy Amsterdam as we do ourselves on a daily basis. We hope to welcome you to our city soon!

name: Quiet apartment near the Zoo
description:
Stay in the heart of Amsterdam’s green and peaceful Plantage District! Our 2-bedroom apartment takes up the entire lower level of a 19th-century townhouse and is perfect for 4 guests. Each bedroom has its own shower and sink, plus there’s one separate toilet.

Relax in the spacious living, designed with a modern touch. Step outside and explore our charming neighborhood, just a short walk or tramride from the city’s main attractions.

Please note that this is a non-smoking apartment

name: Appartement in stadsdeel Noord met zonnig balkon
description: Spacious apartment with south-facing balcony, where you can relax after a (busy) day in Amsterdam.

name: Lovely family house in the populair Pijp area!
description: Welcome to our lovely and spacious family house in the heart of the artistic area ‘de Pijp’. We are centrally located within walking distance to all the famous museums (Museum square), the beautiful concert building and other highlights in de Pijp, one of the hippest neighborhoods in Amsterdam. Feel like a local and have a seat on one of the many terrasses in the cosy neighborhood. The famous Albert Cuijp market is just around the corner. Feel home away from home!

name: Riverside roofterrace appartment
description:
A lovely spacious 2 story apartment with a large roofterrace and balcony.. Located in an peaceful area, 5 min from the center.
Guests can enjoy the home made tiramisu.

name: Green garden appartment
description:
Amsterdams tourist area just 20 minutes away. Restful apartment with decorated green garden. Very safe environment.

Relaxing garden.
Small bathtub.
Comfortable relaxed atmosphere.

Mi casa es su casa. Enjoy!!!

I am easygoing and communicate quick and clear.

name: Charming Loft Apartment in the Heart of Amsterdam
description: Bordering the centre of the city, Oud-West is a special corner of Amsterdam; a popular, dynamic neighbourhood dotted by trendy design stores, cool cafe bars and some of the best restaurants in the city. Right in the middle of this lovely neighbourhood is my home - a loft style appartment covering the top two floors. It is within walking distance of all major attractions, museums, restaurants and bars and will make you feel right at home.

name: Central Historic Gem Apt
description:
✔ Newly renovated, stylish & comfortable
📍 Prime Location - walking distance to everything!
👥 Perfect for couples or two guests looking for a relaxing stay
💬 Instant responses - message me anytime!

name: Stylish Rooftop Retreat
description:
Welcome to our stylish rooftop retreat! Centrally placed in Old West, steps from the Vondelpark, great restaurants, and cozy bars.

The appartement is located on the fourth floor, was recently renovated and has all the commodities you need:

- Fully equipped kitchen
- Laundry & dryer facilities
- Comfortable bed
- Stylish bathroom
- Perfect dining area

And a rooftop terrace to top it all off! Enjoy the stunning city views, a perfect perch to savor the charm of this iconic area.

name: Verborgen parel in Tuindorp Oostzaan
description: Stylish and cozy house in Tuindorp Oostzaan, between the creative NDSM and the green Twiske. Ideal for city trippers, peace seekers and young families. With a characterful interior, lots of light, a child-friendly neighborhood and good connections to Amsterdam and Zaanstad. A surprising, versatile place to come home to.

name: Great family home with garden & free parking
description: A nice spacious house with 2 large bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. And spacious living room, fully equipped kitchen, garden and parking space on the premises. A 5-minute walk from the NSDM shipyard and 5 minutes from the highway.

name: Modern apartment near Jordaan
description:
Looking for the perfect place to stay in Amsterdam? Our cozy, family-friendly house near the charming Jordaan neighborhood is ready to welcome you. With space for 3 adults, 1 kid and a baby, our home provides comfort and convenience for all.

We can't wait to host you in our lovely home and help you create unforgettable memories in Amsterdam. Whether you're here for a romantic getaway, family vacation, or solo adventure, our house is your perfect base.

name: Great private apartment 80m2, bedding & towels inc
description:
Beautiful new 80 m2 recently renovated apartment in south Amsterdam: 2 bright spacious bedrooms, perfect for family.
Spacious sunny living- and dining room. A lot of light. Rain shower & bath. Fast wifi and cable tv.
Free parking on Sundays!

Surroundings
At 25 meters is a sushi restaurant, pizzeria & small supermarket.
At 200 meters there is a large supermarket & tram(stop), which takes you to the center of Amsterdam in 15 minutes.
At 800 the beautiful Amsterdam Forest with water.

name: Charming Loft 57, next to a beautiful canal.
description:
A warm welcome to our lovely Loft 57 next to a canal in the Schinkel neighbourhood in Amsterdam.
Nearby to the city-centre we offer a private loft/studio. (70 m2).
Situated in a green en quiet neighbourhood with a variety of nice bars and restaurants. The Vondelpark at a minutes walk across the bridge and very near to the museums and city-center (direct tram 17, 1 or 2)

name: Spacious and perfect located apartment
description: Welcome to our charming apartment near the bustling Pijp in Amsterdam. Here you will find the perfect combination of city liveliness and serene tranquility. Enjoy the cozy cafes, lively markets and trendy shops within walking distance, but also return to an oasis of calm in our quiet retreat. Discover Amsterdam and then come home to relax in peace. Welcome to your ideal stay!

name: Ground floor apt w/ hot tub near Vondelpark
description: This charming ground floor apartment is only a short walk away from the southern entrance of the popular Vondelpark. The apartment has its own private garden and hot tub. Additionally, it is equipped with a 55 inch TV, front loading washer and dryer, and a home office station.

name: Spacious Amsterdam Apartment near the Lake
description:
Welcome to this spacious, renovated 89m² apartment in peaceful Amsterdam West! Enjoy a quiet balcony retreat just a 15-min bike ride, tram, or train to the vibrant city center. It's the perfect base to explore Amsterdam or take a spring trip to the tulips. Ideal for remote work with fast Ethernet & an espresso machine! Unwind in the large bathroom (tub & shower). Fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer & elevator included.

Are you ready for your beautiful stay in Amsterdam? :)

name: Spacious apartment Amsterdam
description: Luxurious and spacious 100m² apartment in Amsterdam-West. Bright home with large windows, front and back garden and design furniture. Great location near the Foodhallen and bars and restaurants. One large bedroom with a kingsize bed and AC and a second smaller bedroom for a child or a queensize bed. XXL sofa, smart TV and Sonos. Front garden on a quiet pedestrian street.

name: Beautiful apartment near Vondel!
description:
This beautiful light and stylish apartment is located in a quiet street in the neighbourhood Old-West and is just a 5 minute walk from the Vondelpark. Just a two minute walk from the apartment is a tram station that goes to the central station. Around the corner you have the famous Ten Katemarkt and the Foodhallen. There are a lot of shops, cafés, restaurants and bars in very close proximity.

No parties!

name: Canal House de Schans
description: Welcome to Canal House de Schans, this beautiful apartment is located in the heart of Amsterdam, near the Rijksmuseum. Whether you want a weekend away with friends, are planning a romantic holiday or simply want to spend some quality time with your family, this apartment is the perfect base from which to explore all that Amsterdam has to offer. It is a large apartment of 120m2 on two floors.

name: City Center Charm in Amsterdam (130m2).
description:
A beautiful, 2-floor stylish apartment of 130 square meters in a quiet street in the center of Amsterdam. From this centrally located space on the third and fourth floor, everything for the whole group is at your fingertips. Great for couples, families with children, or travelers looking for a good location for remote work.

Most unique: it is a few steps away from the Amstel River, the vibrant heart of the city throughout the year.

name: Lovely Appartment near Vondelpark
description: Welcome to your charming Amsterdam retreat! This cozy appartment in Oud-West offers 2 spacious bedrooms filled with natural daylight. Immerse yourself in the vibrant neighborhood, just minutes away from Vondelpark and a short walk to Museumplein and Leidseplein. Book now and experience the best of Amsterdam from the comfort of this inviting apartment in the heart of the city!

name: Mooi appartement Amsterdam west met dakterras
description: This great accommodation is perfect for the whole family. With 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, there is plenty of room. In addition, the open kitchen with living room offers the opportunity for cozy cooking. When the weather permits in Amsterdam, you can sit in the sun on 2 balconies or even eat on the roof terrace. Of course, the new barbecue can also be used!

name: Ruim en gezellig appartement met zonnig dakterras
description: Discover this bright, spacious and stylish apartment of 70m2 is located in the lively neighborhood "De Baarsjes" in the Amsterdam West district. After a day exploring the beautiful city of Amsterdam, this is a wonderful place to return to. A spacious open kitchen, living room, elegant bedroom, fully renovated bathroom and sunny roof terrace make your stay in this apartment extra special.

name: 3 Bedroom -130m2 Cozy Family Apartment Amsterdam
description: Your family or group of friends (maximum 4) will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place. The house is located in the cozy neighborhood of Baarsjes, a 15-minute walk from the center of Amsterdam. Tram and bus stop are just around the corner.  There are a lot of cozy restaurants, cafes and shops within walking distance. Vondelpark, Rembrandtpark and Erasmus park are also all close by. You will not be lacking anything in this cozy Amsterdam house during your stay.

name: Exclusive Diamond Houseboat: Luxury, Space & Quiet
description:
Diamond houseboat is a luxurious watervilla on a hotspot in town near Dam, Nemo, NieuwMarkt, Central Station, WaterlooPlein. In the heart of the city, but still in an oasis of quietness and privacy. You can swim in the waters in front of the door, sun bathe on deck or enjoy the luxury in doors.
Ideal for a couple, but there is a large room with a double bed for 2 extra guests as well.

name: Design loft w/ canal & mill view
description:
Spacious penthouse with spectacular canal view, directly opposite Amsterdam's oldest mill. Large outdoor balcony (28 m2) facing west to enjoy romantic sunsets.
Completely renovated in 2023 with floor heating, designer kitchen, contemporary furniture, fire place, the most comfortable Hästens bed (180 x 210 cm), and bath tub in spacious bathroom.

name: Family apartment, large terrace & free parking
description:
Only suitable for 1 couple or a family with 2 kids.

We love food so the kitchen is well-equipped. The kids can play on the large terrace that is connected to a gated square.. There is a parking garage underneath the house where you can park your car. Within 20 min you are in the Jordaan/Centre (bike or public transport) but there are also several nice parks and restaurants around the corner.

Next to the A10 ring road which makes it very convenient to visit places outside of Amsterdam.

name: Centrally located apartment
description:
Just take a break in this soothing, centrally located accommodation. The house is very bright and has all the comforts to enjoy Amsterdam.

Because it is centrally located, you are close to everything: Amsterdam city center, canal belt, museums, Vondelpark, Westerpark, Museumplein, Leidseplein and Rembrandtplein.

name: Mooi Apartment in Amsterdam Oost!
description:
A bright and cosy apartment (60m2) located in Amsterdam East (Oost). Situated between Oosterpark and the Dappermarkt, with plenty of bars and restaurants nearby.

The central station is only a 15 minute cycle, 5 minute train ride (from Amsterdam Muiderport), or there are plenty of trams from just outside the door.

name: Amsterdam townhouse with garden in city center
description:
Welcome to our beautiful home in the heart of Amsterdam! Located in the charming and vibrant Staatsliedenbuurt neighborhood close to the Jordaan.
As you step inside our home, you'll be immediately struck by the warm and welcoming atmosphere. The house is full of light and features an open-plan layout, sunny garden, kitchen and 3 bedrooms. All in all, our home is the perfect choice for anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient base while exploring Amsterdam. We can't wait to welcome you!

name: Fijn appartement in Amsterdam
description: A nice, bright, spacious and recently renovated apartment in a quiet street in Bos & Lommer! A hip and lively neighborhood with lots to offer: coffee bars, parks, restaurants and cafes, and the supermarket is within walking distance. About 15 minutes to the Jordaan or the city center by bike or public transport (tram, bus). Many options for public transportation close to the apartment (near tram and bus stop, 10 minutes from Sloterdijk train station, good connection to the airport).

name: Tiny cozy apartment with private kitchen/bathroom
description:
Small but cozy studio (17m2) in Amsterdam Bos en Lommer (West) for 1 or 2 persons. Includes a modern kitchen and bathroom. The bed suits 1 or 2 people (140 x 200cm). Great place to work with proper WiFi and a (electric stand-up) desk and office chair.

Next to Westerpark, 5min from Sloterdijk Station & only 15min from Central station.

Surrounded by many trendy food-, coffee- and bakery hotspots & a supermarket only 1-minute away

name: A family home in east Amsterdam
description:
A simple but cozy family home with a garden located on the ground floor in a quiet, child-friendly area, but very close to the Indische buurt neighbourhood
with lots of restaurants and bars nearby (10 min walk). Located just east of the centre of Amsterdam, easily reachable with public transport (20 mins).

We love living here with our 2-yr-old son and rent out our home when we are away to enable others to enjoy the experience of living in a quiet neighbourhood of Amsterdam near the city.

name: BedonBoard #2
description: To wake up in the morning with the reflection of the sunlight on the surface of the water and hear the water birds singing is a unique way to live within the city. Good to know that we have BedonBoard #1  &  BedonBoard #2  The rooms have a comfortable Queen-size bed (1.60 x 2.00), a modern bathroom with private toilet, shower. The BedonBoard #2 is located on the ground floor of our houseboat.

name: Family Home Center Amsterdam
description:
In this centrally located accommodation, everything for your family is at your fingertips. With plenty of space over three floors, you can enjoy a lovely family house in beautiful Amsterdam. With private parking.
Our house is in a prime location surrounded by the lively energy of the city centre. From famous landmarks to local hidden gems, everything is right at your fingertips. Step outside and discover all that Amsterdam has to offer.

name: Luxe 5* - incl elevator & aircon - Museum Square
description:
Including elevator to bring you upstairs!
The airconditioned apartment is stylish, spacious, high quality, fully equipped to meet all your needs. The apartment consists of living area, dining area and open kitchen. A separate bathroom with windows and a spacious bedroom with beautiful windows. A refreshing apartment on 1 min walk from Museum Square and Concertgebouw. In the kitchen a refrigerator, freezer, Gaggenau oven, dishwasher, coffee machine (nespresso) , pans, plates and glasses :)

name: Luxurious Canal View Loft
description:
Welcome to my newly renovated canal-view loft in the heart of Amsterdam! This stylishly furnished one-bedroom loft combines modern comfort with breathtaking canal views. Nestled in the vibrant and central Oud-West district, you'll be just steps from top attractions, trendy restaurants, and cozy cafes. Book your stay today to experience Amsterdam's charm and convenience in style!

Within 300 meters, you'll have access to bike rentals, excellent dining options, and a well-stocked supermarket.

name: Apartment in boujee neighborhood: stayinthepijp
description:
Message for a long stay discount!
stayinthepijp for more (videos, discounts etc)

Experience Amsterdam like a local in this stunning modern apartment in the boujee Pijp area. Savor local cuisine at nearby restaurants, discover hot bars and boutiques, and immerse yourself in local culture at the Albert Cuyp Market.

Explore the city's top attractions with a short walk to Leidseplein, Museumplein, and RAI Congress Center, or take the newly-built metro to Central Station in 5 minutes.

name: Canal View Apartment w/ Rooftop
description:
Welcome to your Amsterdam oasis!
Step into this stylish apartment and be captivated by its enchanting features.
Immerse yourself in the vibrant Pijp area, known for trendy cafes and picturesque parks.
Enjoy the captivating canal view and unwind on the delightful private rooftop terrace.
Play the piano, sip cocktails at the fully equipped bar, and sleep soundly in the cozy loft bed.
Discover comfort, style, and the vibrant atmosphere of Amsterdam at your doorstep!

name: Sunny apartment in De Pijp
description: One bedroom apartment located on the first floor in the trendy neighbourhood ‘De Pijp’.

name: Luxury Canal House Center
description:
Enjoy your Stay with family in Amsterdam in this Stylish Luxury Canal House on the Best Location of Amsterdam 200 meter from Local Transportation. The Amazing view over the Canals on the 3rd floor.

The large and luxury canal house has:
• Luxury Livingroom
• Fully equipment kitchen
• AC + Floorheating
• SmartTV + High Speed WiFi
• Washing Machine
• 3 sleeping rooms:
• 1x Box spring bed 160x200
• 1x Sofa bed 140x200
• 1x Baby bed
• Walk-in shower + Bath
• Keyless entrance
• Fin Sauna + Shower

name: Private LOFT 65m2 - Ground Floor
description:
Enjoy your Stay in Amsterdam in this PRIVATE LOFT 60M2 Renovated Appartment on the Best Location of Amsterdam 200 meter from Local Transportation. Very cozy and quit neighborhood.

The large and luxury appartment has:
• Livingroom
• AC and Floorheating
• SmartTV + Netflix
• High Speed WiFi
• Comfort sofa
• Refridgerator
• Microwave
• Kitchenette
• Washing Machine
• Nespresso coffee
• Box spring bed
• Walk-in shower
• Keyless entrance
• Cleaning towels

name: Sfeervol appartement in Amsterdam | Stadscentrum.
description:
My private apartment is located in a quiet area and is very close to the city center. It's a 15-minute walk to the famous Jordaan and is the perfect place to explore Amsterdam. You will find plenty of breakfast and brunch spots and restaurants.

The apartment has a great atmosphere with lots of day light. It features a comfortable bedroom, a separate toilet and shower, a kitchen with a Nespresso coffee maker and milk frother.

name: Knus huisje met tuin, vlakbij centrum.
description:
Take a break from city life in this soothing, centrally located accommodation. From the living room, you can see the Adam Tower. You can walk in 10 minutes to the ferry that takes you to Central Station.
Garden on three sides of the house, enjoy both sun and shade on the garden bench.
Shopping center and market within walking distance. Cozy restaurants in the vicinity.

name: Unique Double Canal House with garden
description:
Experience this 225m2 unique double canal house located in the greenest City part of Amsterdam. From here you can reach everything by foot, bike, Tram or Metro and still enjoy the neighbourhood’s quietness. Perfect for families that want to escape the vibrant City life now and then.

The house has been completely renovated over the years and is equipped with every luxury. In Summer you can sit in the large backyard including an outdoor kitchen and in Winter you can sit by the fireplace.

name: Spacious apartment | Balcony 2 bedrooms | Center
description:
We recently moved into this new apartment, hence only few reviews. Feel free to check my profile to see the comments of our previous apartment to be more confident to book.

Light and spacious apartment with a balcony in the south and 2 bedrooms. In a nice neighbourhood with restaurants/shops around, park within 2min walk, well connected with the bike/tram to visit the city in 10min. A perfect location for your stay.

name: Unique sustainable water home
description:
Come and experience this peaceful, relaxing most sustainable, floating residential area in Europe. Thirty water homes with 46 households form a revolutionary new neighborhood that generates its own energy. The fantastic apartment of 103 square meters on the water also floats here.
The house has three bedrooms, two bathrooms, two toilets and a spacious living room on the third floor, with a bed sofa, in split-level with an open kitchen. A spacious terrace on the water and a floating garden.

name: Lovely light apt with balcony
description:
Lovely light apt with a big balcony in the vibrant Bos & Lommer area, Amsterdam west. Great location, within 10 minutes you can be in the Jordaan or city center. The direct neighbourhood also offers plenty shops, restaurants, bars and parks.

Enjoy plenty of privacy as you'll have the entire place to yourself. The place is cozy and light and you can enjoy the sun all day long.

We're always happy to help with any questions or recommendations you may need during your stay!

Love, Anke & Zjanna

name: Private Ground House w/ Sunny Garden in Amsterdam
description:
Located in Amsterdam North and 10 minutes walk from the bustling NDSM-Werf.
Perfect for a couple wanting to explore Amsterdam from a quieter base.
A separate bedroom holds a large bed & wardrobe space. Next to it you'll find a comfortable living room and a kitchen that opens up to a sunny garden equipped with a lounge set and chill out area.
Amsterdam's central station is a 15 minutes bike ride or 10 min ride on the free ferry from NDSM.

name: City Centre Modern Vondelhouse
description: Leidse square is walking distance (2 min). Also all the needed stores such as supermarket and cafetaria’s are really close. You could get the best coffee of Amsterdam on 1 min walking (usually a long queue, but goes quick!). Also the house contains a luxury environment.

name: Family home on the canal
description:
This characterful, newly renovated and sunny family home is on the first and top floor of a 19th century canal house. Located on a beautiful and quiet canal in the East of Amsterdam it's perfect for a family getaway.

Located between 2 parks and close to the zoo, with lots of supermarkets within a short walk, it offers all you need for a relaxing Amsterdam stay with kids.

1 double bedroom + 1 kids room with 1 single bed and a cot.

name: Modern, stylish with great views (100m2)
description: Built under architecture, this stylish waterfront apartment of a hundred square meters and surrounding balcony of another sixty offers spectacular views onto the Adam Tower and Pontsteiger. Situated on the third floor of this modern building you will enjoy space whilst having easy access to the city. It is furnished with design classics, vintage and international art. Noguchi, Eames, Martin Visser, Fritz Hansen, Gijs Bakker, Bolia and more.

name: Unique luxe house in Amsterdam
description: The house is very centrally located on Museumplein. The house is 250m2 with two outdoor spaces. It consists of three floors with two kitchens; on the first floor is the living/dining/kitchen area. The second floor has a spacious bathroom and 2 beautiful bedrooms. One of the bedrooms also has a roof terrace. The third floor has a gigantic high ceiling of no less than 4.5m high with lots of light. Here is a projector to organize the ideal movie night.

name: Ruim en licht hoekappartement in Amsterdam-Oost
description:
Welcome to our own spacious and typical Amsterdam house (1930's) with comfort (full equiped kitchen, large bath & rain shower head), space (60 sqm) and a unique location.

- Perfect location in Amsterdam close to Oosterpark, Pijp and City Center (straight centrum connection with public transport)
- Bright ground floor corner apartment
- Near popular multicultiral "Javastraat" with dozens of delicious and hip places to eat and drink
- Close to public transport (100 meters) directly to the center

name: Private Spacious Apartment With Urban Garden
description: This ground floor apartment has been newly renovated and includes a bedroom with comfortable queen-size bed, smart-tv, lounge, a spacious dining area and lovely urban garden! It is located on a quiet street in the trendy and authentic pijp area, close to nice restaurants, local bars and the wonderful Sarphatipark just around the corner. If you are looking for a spacious and comfortable apartment where you can experience Amsterdam as a true local is your place! Ideal for couples!

name: Feel at home
description:
Relax and unwind in this peaceful, stylish space. Pleasant open kitchen that is attached to the living room. From the kitchen, two French doors to the garden.

Super jurra coffee machine
Quooker
All the comforts you need

name: Stylish appartement in Amsterdam
description: This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated. The apartment is on the ground floor and first floor in Amsterdam East, 10 minutes from downtown Amsterdam. There is plenty of public transportation nearby and a bicycle rental nearby. Two blocks away is a large shopping street with several supermarkets, cafes and restaurants.

name: Modern Amsterdams herenhuis
description: A modern canal house near downtown Amsterdam overlooking the Ringvaart. The house has a living room with adjoining garden with lots of sun on the ground floor, a kitchen on the 1st floor, a bedroom with double bed and bathroom and a laundry room on the 2nd floor and in the attic 2 bedrooms (children's rooms) and an extra bathroom. There are 2 bicycles available and the car can be parked for free behind the house.

name: Family home in North-Amsterdam!
description: A beautiful family house located in the fantastic neighborhood of Amsterdam-Noord. The perfect base for exploring Amsterdam. The house is situated in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood, with trendy restaurants, museums, a park and shops close by. The house features three spacious and bright bedrooms, as well as a backyard where you can enjoy breakfast in the sun. We have decorated the house with a lot of love and care, and we hope our visitors will treat it with the same level of respect.

name: Houseboat on canal in citycentre
description: Always wondered how it is to sleep on the water? This is your chance to sleep right in the middle of the centre of Amsterdam surrounded by canal houses. The interior is recently refurbished and has all the amenities you need. With a nice sunny terrace on the deck. It's a truly unique way to experience Amsterdam and the life on the historic Amsterdam canals. While at the same time very easy to reach as it's just a few minutes walk to central station where there are many trains, metro and busses.

name: Monumental artistic warehouse on the canals 80m2
description: On the picturesque Prinsengracht canal, this charming apartment is a gateway to the heart of Amsterdam. Entering the space you’ll be greeted by a stylish and inviting atmosphere, where historical touches blend seamlessly with modern amenities. The big living room features comfortable seating, and a designer kitchen perfect for relaxing after a long day of exploring the city. The location is unbeatable, with some of Amsterdams best restaurants, cafes, and attractions just a short stroll away.

name: Modern comfortable apartment
description: This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated. The apartment is in a quiet residential area around the corner from Europaplein metro station (RAI Amsterdam) and RAI train station. It is a boutique hotel inspired space that was completely renovated last year and equipped with every comfort.

name: The 19th Hole
description:
Take it easy at this unique and calming flat in the heart of Amsterdam Oost.

With parks like Oosterpark, Frankdael & Flevopark all within a 10 minute cycle, you are able to fully immerse yourself in Amsterdam's green spaces.

You are close to the jaw dropping Amstel river, where you can swim, stroll or experience some of the best bars & restaurants in Ams.

Want a night in? The flat is light, spacious with both a cosy & modern feel where you can easily make the out of indoor/outdoor living.

name: Private attic next to AMS
description:
Cozy and comfortable room with en suite bathroom on the 3rd floor of our house. The room features a large bed (180x200), a desk and space for your clothes.

Free parking on the street.

Great location to visit Amsterdam and to attend events in Amsterdam Arena and Ziggo Dome. Multiple public transport options are available. Metro into the city centre, train to/from Schiphol in 15 minutes and bus stop 1m away.

name: Luxery appartment in the heart of Jordaan
description:
This newly renovated luxery appertement in the centre of the populair neighboordhood de Jordaan is the best location for a citytrip.

The appartement is equiped with a comortable 1.80 m bed and a large bathroom. Complete kitchen with a dining table and a comfortable sofa.

The appartment provides an oasis of peace in the busy city centre. Based on the 3rd floor with an elevator. Everything is on walking distance. One minute walk to the populair “negen straatjes” shopping neighborhood.

name: Cozy apartment in De Pijp
description:
The apartment is located in a quite street of the centre of De Pijp, behind the Heineken brewery. The main attractions like Dam Square, the Rijkmuseum, Museumplein and the centre are at a walking distance.
The apartment is at the first floor and it has a bedroom, a kitchen, a big bathroom and a typical Dutch living room with Van Gogh vibes.
The apartment is good for couples, limited group of friends or a family.

name: Clean, cozy and beautiful home in Amsterdam!
description:
Hello! Welcome to my apartment located in the east side of Amsterdam :) It's in a quiet residential area, but within reach of tons of restaurants, bars and coffee places. Only 15/20 minute bike ride to the city center. Or, 10 minutes by train to Amsterdam Central station.

The apartment is clean, cozy and beautiful. It has everything you need to relax, rest and have a good time to explore Amsterdam city. Please read full advertisement before booking :)

name: Woonhuis (2-floors 115m2) Amsterdam Vondelpark
description:
This stylish home is perfect for a wonderful city trip, a vacation with your family or when you are in Amsterdam (area) for business.

The accommodation is very easily accessible by both car (15 min drive from Schiphol) and public transport. Nearby metro and train station (15 min walk) and tram bus stops (2 min).

Ideal for this spacious home including garden: quietly located, but within 2 minutes you will feel the hustle and bustle of the city. Close to the Vondel and Rembrandt Park.

name: Modern & industrial home in city centre/east
description: We are renting out our beloved home in Amsterdam while we're traveling. Great for couples in the centre of Amsterdam! It's locate in district Amsterdam-Centrum but at the east side of town, overlooking a canal and the Oostenburgerpark. During the day you can enjoy the sun through our 10 meter long sliding windows from sunrise until around 3 or explore amazing Amsterdam.

name: The Isac, a luxurious getaway!
description:
Stay in a luxurious suite with private bathroom, part of a charming canal house located in a quiet area right in the middle of the heart of Amsterdam.

You’ll have a private entrance and hallway that lead you to your stylish, relaxing bedroom and bathroom!
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Canal view Keizersgracht - 17th century town house
description:
We welcome you in our stunning and luxury two floor family apartment in the monumental 17th century house on the Keizersgracht in Amsterdam.
Fully furnished, beautifully decorated. Well equipped new kitchen, fitted appliances. Amazing views over the water. Safe and quiet residential neighborhood, two minutes from the Amsterdam Walldorf Astoria Hotel. Within walking minutes of all sites.

Longer stays upon request.

Special catered lunch or dinner services upon request. Fees apply

name: Private appartment in ‘De Pijp’
description: Private double bed appartment in the lively area ‘de Pijp’ in Amsterdam South. 5 minute walking distance from the nice café’s and shops but the street itself is nice and calm. Large kitchen and cosy living room with a balcony to enjoy a breakfast in the sun. Dishwasher, washing machine, tumble dryer, etc, and a sufficient bathroom and a double bed (not shown on the picture as I ordered a new one ;-)).

name: Cosy apartment in trendy area!
description:
This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated.
The cozy apartment was completely renovated in 2019 and equipped with every comfort.
In addition, it is located in the lively neighborhood "de Pijp" although in a quiet street with the Sarphatipark around the corner.
You will also find many restaurants around the corner as well as the open-air market "Albert Cuyp" and all major museums within walking distance.

name: Charmant en zonnig huis in de Amsterdamse Pijp
description:
Spacious and modern apartment, located on the first floor with a sunny south-facing balcony.

It is the perfect base for a vacation in Amsterdam.
The house is located in a quiet street and just a few minutes' walk from the heart of the Pijp, near the Albert Cuyp market and the Amstel.

The house has all the comforts such as a modern kitchen with various appliances with adjoining balcony, spacious bathroom, bedroom, two dining tables and a luxurious living room.

name: Apartment with canal view close to Vondelpark
description: This charming 1930s apartment is located on the 1st floor. The apartment has its own entrance, 1 bedroom with a king-size bed, a bathroom with walk-in shower, a fully equipped kitchenette, spacious living/dining area and a balcony. The location is in the middle of  Hoofddorppleinbuurt, in a green and quiet street. Whitin walking distance you can find various shops, supermarkets, cafes and restaurants. Within minutes you are in the Vondelpark and have good connection for public transport.

name: Bright & Cozy Guest Studio in Center
description:
Located near the Amstel Hotel and Carré Theatre, this bright and cozy guest studio with tall windows offers a private bedroom, living area with Murphy bed, and big bathroom with tub.

The space is located on the second floor of the building, accessible by stairs. The entrance hall is shared with the hosts, who live on the upper floor of the appartment.

Start your day with coffee and croissants from the bakery next door, metro and tram are steps away.

name: Unique modern design apartment in citycenter
description:
This light and airy two story apartment is truly a rare find. Fully furnished with great midcentury modern design, and all the luxurious amenities that will make your stay the finest and authentic you can imagine.

Located just a ten minute walk from central station you will find yourself in the heart of Amsterdam. The interiour is minimal yet intimate with unique art, books and plants. Despite the central location, the apartment is very quiet, situated in a calm street, next to the park.

name: Cozy bright apartment
description: Welcome to our cosy home, perfect for a winter getaway! The space is bright, warm, and ideal for relaxing after a day of exploring, with a fully-equipped kitchen, a big dining table, and a spacious comfy couch, a Bastard BBQ on our roof-terrace and a Christmas tree to brighten the season (presents not included 😉)

name: Charming Family House in the Heart of Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our beautiful family home in the heart of Amsterdam, the Jordaan district! Located around the corner of the famous Noordermarkt and amidst vibrant bars and restaurants, yet unbelievably peaceful, this is the perfect getaway. This spacious home boasts a huge, beautifully decorated kitchen, a large living room, and three cozy bedrooms.

name: Familyhouse with 2 cats + garden
description: Spacious family house with 2 cats that you will need to feed and garden.  Our house is situated near station Sloterdijk. 5 mins by train to central station or 15 mins by bike or tram to the city centres museums. The house has a big open living room and kitchen,  4 bedrooms, two office spaces a bathroom on the first floor with toilet and a toilet on the ground floor. The garden has a trampoline a a big picnic table to eat in the sun. I will upload more pictures this week.

name: Houseboat Paradise | Great Views | City Center
description:
These types of accomodations are very rarely available!

Experience the joys of living on the water in a luxurious style and the liveliness of this famous historic neighborhood, while enjoying the tranquility of living in a boat.

All utilities and amenities are included, so all you need to do is bring your suitcase!

name: Cozy Apartment in Oud-West
description: Welcome to our charming shared apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. Nestled in the vibrant Oud-West neighbourhood, our cozy and inviting space is the perfect base for exploring all that this beautiful city has to offer.

name: Cozy studio apartment near city center
description:
My apartment is on the third floor on the back side of the building and facing the south, so you’ll have a lot of sun and little noise from the street. It also has a shared roof terrace and gym.

My place is easy to reach from Central station and Sloterdijk station by bus 22, which stops in front of the house.

There are plenty of supermarkets, bars, restaurants and the beautiful Westerpark in the area all at walking distance. You will reach the start of the city center in 10 minutes by foot.

name: Heerlijk ruim appartement met tuin! Begane grond
description:
Discover Amsterdam from this stylish apartment! Completely renovated in 2023 and equipped with every comfort. It is on the ground floor with its own entrance and has a garden with terrace. Supermarkets, cafes, restaurants and shops within walking distance and within 15 minutes in the center of Amsterdam!

We are Christiaan & Eva. We love traveling and staying abroad regularly in Airbnbs. That's why we like to share our nice house in Amsterdam with people who also love to travel!

name: Great downtown aprtmnt w/ yard!
description:
Fantastic 1 bed (+ pull-out sofa) / 1 bath. ground floor apartment. Downtown Amsterdam - about 10 min. walk from Anne Frank house. About 20 min. to Dam square, Vondelpark, Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh museum. Quiet street (but close to all the action - supermarket, restaurants and coffee at walking distance) Family friendly. New bathroom and kitchen with washer. Pull-out sofa w/ queen size mattress for extra guests. Tastefully furnished plus full excess to the private yard!

Permit #: Z/26/3094466

name: Nieuw! Tiny house in Amsterdam aan het water.
description: A super nice Tiny house in Amsterdam that has just been built with all amenities. The tiny house is in the garden and this garden is located on the water. The house is located on one of the most beautiful streets in Amsterdam,  a dike with a view of the IJ. It is a very green area and yet a short bike ride to the center of Amsterdam. Public transportation is 10 min walk.

name: Stylish & Sunny apt. - big balcony - crib and bath
description:
Lovely apartment well-located in buzzing area 'the Baarschjes' around a lot of restaurants and shops. The apartment is very clean, spacious, nicely decorated and has two very comfy beds (one double, one single). There is a baby crib available too (other baby necessities on request).

The apartment is bright and has a big sun facing balcony, perfect for a drink/dinner outdoors and some relaxation.

My guests tell me (please the see reviews) that it's the perfect base for discovering Amsterdam!

name: Stylish two floor apartment in de Pijp
description: This stylish, spacious and bright two-floor apartment is located in the de Pijp neighbourhood in central Amsterdam, one of the city's trendiest areas. The house is a typical two-storied Amsterdam home. On the main floor, you will find a bright living room with an open kitchen that is fully equipped for cooking. The flat has a balcony that overlooks a green courtyard.The spacious bedroom is located on the second floor together with a modern shower with a bath. Available for longer stays

name: Beautiful spacious appartment in de Pijp (140M2)
description: This stylish accommodation is the perfect getaway home  for 4 people looking to stay in the beautiful district de Pijp. De Pijp is located south-west of the City Centre and is a quiet village-like district in the big city of Amsterdam.  With a 140 squared meters this is  an exceptionally large appartement  for Amsterdam standards.  Since the Pijp is located near the city centre the area is more quiet and has a village-like aura. All the local hotspots are within a 5 minute walk.

name: Generator - Single Pod
description: Book a private pod in our brand new space at Generator Amsterdam, designed for a unique and comfortable stay. Each pod features a central control panel, light, cosmetic mirror, coat hook, USB charging station, and fresh air ventilation. Secure your belongings in lockers with an anti-theft lock and smart card access. Enjoy a slow rebound memory foam mattress, with pillow, duvet, and linen supplied. Shared bathroom. For guests aged 18 and over only.

name: Appartement in de pijp
description: This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated.

name: Cabinhouse, free bikes and parking
description:
Nice cabinhouse in a quite and green area, but still close to the center.
There are 2 single beds and 1 foldable bed. In the kitchen you can find all you need to prepare a meal or a coffee/tea. There is a fridge and a microwave, dishwasher, coffee and teamaker etc. We have also bikes available if you like and there is free parking on the street.
The cabinhouse has airco and als a terrace with a picnictable.

name: Former Canal House - Jordaan - Center of Amsterdam
description:
We would like to warmly welcome you to our canal house in the center of Amsterdam!

Almost everything you want to see in Amsterdam is within walking distance. Located in the heart of the Jordaan, the most charming part of the city! Enjoy leisurely strolls through the 9 streets, Noordermarkt, or Haarlemmerstraat with its cozy shops.

The house has 4 bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, and a large terrace. The entire property is private for you!

We hope to see you soon!

name: Manu & Jilly
description: Beautiful corner house, very close to the subway, perfectly close to downtown Amsterdam.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Your Amsterdam Getaway
description: Light and spacious apt. in the hip and lively neighborhood of Amsterdam Oost. With a spacious kitchen and a comfortable master bedroom with a queen bed, this is a perfect apt. for couples or families with a spacious balcony with beautiful views. Oost is within biking distance of the center of Amsterdam but is characterized by the many restaurants and bars where the locals like to come and close to Artis Zoo. The city center is easily accessible by train, tram or bus

name: Most central amsterdam chic home
description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

name: Design chic loft flat in centre
description: Kick back and relax in this chic, calm, stylish space in the midst of the centre right next to the vondelpark restaurants public transport and supermarkets all within 30 seconds walk

name: Apartment in west
description: Welcome to our cozy and spacious Amsterdam apartment! Enjoy 137 m2 on the third floor of charm with 3 outdoor spaces. Fully equipped kitchen, dining area, 3 bedrooms (2 double, 1 single), and an office space. Super central location near Vondelpark. Experience the best of Amsterdam from our charming Airbnb.

name: Mooi gezinsappartement Amsterdam
description: Spacious, bright apartment in the beautiful, quiet Gaasperdam neighborhood in Amsterdam. Perfect for families. Enjoy the sun-drenched garden and the relaxed atmosphere, yet a stone's throw away from Amsterdam city center. Metro within walking distance.

name: Knus appartement met groot dakterras
description: Relax and unwind in this stylish cozy upstairs apartment in a quiet but cozy and green neighborhood with large roof terrace! Many nice restaurants, by the water, Oostpoort shopping center and the city center are easy to reach by bike or public transport. Perfect for single or couples.

name: Sunny little gem: 2 bedroom & big balcony
description:
🏡 Meet my cozy little gem: a newly furnished 2 bedroom apartment with a big sunny balcony on the 1st floor in the popular area the Baarsjes, Amsterdam-West

🌳 Right next to the famous Rembrandtpark. It comes with great bars and coffee ☕️ places too. I have already made a Amsterdam wish list, if needed :)

🚃 Tram 17, around the corner, brings you to the city centre in less than 10 minutes

📺
Netflix, Sky Sports, TNT & IPTV

🖥️ A Droptop desk with 2 built in 24” monitors, wireless keyboard and mouse

name: Groot familiehuis met souterrain en tuin!
description: In this centrally located accommodation, everything for your family is within reach. The house (145m2) and the garden (120m2) are an oasis of peace and at the same time there are good restaurants and amenities such as supermarkets and shopping streets nearby. The city center is also a 15-minute walk away. The tram to the city center, 3 stops, is a 2-minute walk away. The house has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 toilets and a loft-like living room. Both the house and the neighborhood are great.

name: Large & Sunny Canal Apartment
description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place. A stunning canal view, full of light, where you can watch the boats go by. Big windows, a terrace and three bedrooms (2 x single beds 1 x double) available.

name: Stijlvol, ruim twee kamer appartement
description: Newly renovated spacious apartment/B&B on Steigereiland. 40 meters. Offers a panoramic view over IJmeer and Diemerpark. Sunny balcony where you can have breakfast or enjoy a drink. Quietly located, private entrance via the stairs on the garden side next to the house. You can swim from your own jetty. Inside, you will find a large soft sofa, TV, a sitting area and a pantry where you can make coffee and tea.  Separate bedroom with a 160-centimeter bed. No cooking facility, but there is a microwave. Small fridge.

name: Spacious family home in North
description:
Three story family home in vibey Amsterdam North. Located in a quiet and rustique residential area. Ferry to city center 7 minutes away.

1 doublebed (2p) + 2 single adult beds + 2 children's beds available.

Well suited for a family with small children with a separate childrens bedroom available. Open kitchen with modern equipment. Free parking space, supermarket and busstop to North/South line within 2 minutes walking distance.

name: Creative Apartment in West
description:
Drenched in sunlight in a quiet spot right next to Westerpark our design led home is just a 10 minute cycle from the city centre. Our top floor flat looks out over a tree filled garden and you can hear the church bells on a Sunday. Relax in the roll topped bath or sit on the balcony in the morning sun sipping coffee.

Nearby is an amazing natural wine shop, Fuku Coffee, and many fantastic restaurants. For the sporty are yoga studios, a huge bouldering hall, and paddel and tennis courts.

name: Lovely apartment in the Pijp! Great location!
description:
Large apartment, 55m2, stylishly decorated, great location. Walking distance to major museums and city center. Albert Cuyp market is one block to the north, beautiful Sarphati Park one block to south. Lots of wonderful cafes and restaurants close by.

The registration number for the apartment is 0363 EDD6 1885 DF0C 641A.

We only rent out to guests with positive reviews. And we do not rent out to groups of friends, families only.

name: Stylish family home with garden near Vondelpark
description:
Stylish family home with all-day sun garden in Oud West — 10 mins by tram or bike from the centre and 3 mins walk from Vondelpark.

Thoughtfully set up for young families, the property sleeps 2 adults and up to two kids (baby/toddler and an older child) across two floors, with generous natural light and a large open-plan living space.

With a fully equipped kitchen, cosy living area and outdoor dining with a gas BBQ, it's the perfect base to relax and enjoy Amsterdam like a local.

name: Family apartment next to Vondelpark
description:
Located on a quiet cul-de-sac just 50m from Vondelpark, our newly renovated 85m² duplex is the perfect retreat for families. The modern interior features a master suite with a queen bed, two dedicated kids' rooms (200x80 cm beds), and a full bathroom with a separate guest toilet.
We provide everything you need for a stay with young children.

House Rules:
Capacity: Max 4 adults and 1 baby.
Strictly Families Only: This is a peaceful family residence. We kindly ask party-seekers to book elsewhere.

name: Beautiful 2 Bed w/ sunny garden
description: Stay in our beautiful two bedroom house in the middle of the hip Amsterdam East, with a sunny garden that has sun the whole day. The house is very suitable for families or two couples and is located a short distance (10 min bike or by public transport) from the city center of Amsterdam and all the main attractions. In addition, you will find a lot of cozy cafes, restaurants & shops, in the immediate vicinity within walking distance.

name: Apartment close to city centre
description: Our apartment is close to the city centre. Anne Frank House, Jordaan, famous canals and Westerpark are within walking distance. It is a nice family house in a quiet neighbourhood. The apartment is on the third floor and there is no elevator, only steep typical Amsterdam stairs. Our apartment has 3 bedrooms. A master bedroom with a queen size bed,  a teenage bedroom with a bed (1,80 meter). The fourth bedroom has a two-person bunkbed.

name: De Stijlkamer
description: Welcome to the Stijlkamer, a beautiful room with original details in the heart of the bustling Pijp with its own front door, hallway and bathroom. There is no kitchen.

name: Fijne gezinswoning!
description: Have fun with the whole family in this stylish space. Nice spacious living space with three bedrooms. A lovely playroom next to a sitting area where you can chill and read undisturbed. A good base to explore the city from here, but also to discover the nature and the sea next to the city. The house is in a quiet neighborhood with good amenities.

name: Cozy & Bright Jordaan 2-Story+Terrace | Anne Frank
description:
Just a stone’s throw from the Anne Frank House, this cozy 2-bedroom apartment invites you to experience Amsterdam like a local — right in the heart of the charming Jordaan district.

Enjoy local favorites like fresh pastries from nearby bakeries, stroll through vibrant markets, or simply relax by the canal with a good book. Our home is quiet and private, yet just minutes away from the city’s best attractions.

We look forward to hosting you and helping you experience Amsterdam like a local.

name: Woonhuis met Tiny house
description: Relax in rural Noord, within 15 minutes of Amsterdam City Center

name: Amsterdam Riverside Retreat
description:
This property boasts an excellent location, riverside detached, with beautiful scenery, suitable for 2-4 people.

Approximately 20 minutes walk to the central station
Approximately 15 minutes walk to Noorderpark metro station(M52).
Approximately 10 minutes walk to the supermarket

name: Stylish apartment near the Jordaan
description:
A peaceful, newly renovated ground-floor apartment in the heart of Amsterdam West, with public transport taking you to the city centre in just 10 min.

Enjoy a quiet neighborhood with great coffee spots, bakeries, restaurants, and beautiful parks within walking distance.

The bright living area offers plenty of natural light and opens onto a spacious private garden (35 m²), perfect for relaxing after a day in the city.

A garden house provides an extra bedroom (bed 140cm wide) and toilet.

name: Sweet little house in Amsterdam
