description: Our sweet little house is in the green and quiet area of North Amsterdam. It has a small front and back garden, and two floors of 70 m2 together. There is a two-person bedroom and a baby room. You can also use our garden office, everything with wifi. From the house you can make beautiful walks and cycling tours. The house is nearby cultural hub NDSM terrain, from where the free ferry to Central Station in ten minutes. You will be staying here with our cat Kirí.

name: Amsterdam apartment (ground floor) with garden
description: Centrally located, modern Amsterdam apartment in a 19th century building (ground floor). The apartment is situated in the charming 'Dapperbuurt' (Amsterdam-Oost). Close to the Amsterdam city center (a short walk to Artis Zoo, Wereldmuseum Amsterdam and Dapper market). Special features include a garden with seating area, a working space and two bedrooms (note: one bedroom is attached to the kitchen and does not have a door and therefore limited privacy).

name: Great location in Amsterdam, pretty and quiet room
description: The house is located in a quiet neighbourhood and has easy access to the city center (15 minutes by bike and 20 minutes by public transport). A shopping center is within a 5 minute walk and provides all the necessary amenities.  If you would like to explore the NDSM wharf and the sites of cool Amsterdam-Noord, these are also all within walking distance. Once you arrive, my brother and I would be happy to offer tips on unique sites in the city for you to explore.

name: Fantastic Family City Home
description: In this centrally located accommodation, everything for your family is within reach. The great Vondelpark is just around the corner. A nice playground in front of the door. Various restaurants, cafes, coffee and lunch bars, supermarkets and shops around the corner, as well as museums such as the Rijks and Van Gogh. A lively neighborhood.

name: Ideal Location Studio for Two
description:
Discover the best of Amsterdam from this charming, elegant, and ideally located studio in the historic Jordaan district. A place where traditional Dutch aesthetics blend seamlessly with modern convenience and comfort, this apartment is perfect for couples seeking a serene yet central vacation getaway.
15 min from RijkMuseum
10 min from VondelPark

Close to public transportation and to grocery stores.

name: Beautiful loft in Westerpark (90m²)
description:
We offer our beautiful apartment (90m²) with spacious allure in a characteristic former factory building "Magister" in the Westerpark district.
The house is located on the (slightly) raised ground floor of a robust and well isulated former factory building from 1921 with a unique industrial character, located along the water of the Kostverlorenvaart. The house has large windows, high ceilings, arched hallways and is very light due to the corner location.

name: An architect’s family home
description:
Have fun with the whole family at this stylish place. In our spacious home there is enough space to relax, cook, enjoy the garden and a perfect fall out to the city and surroundings.

Note; since this is our family home, we only rent out to families

name: Modern ground floor apartment with sunny garden
description:
Light modern 1-bedroom groundfloor apartment with a sunny spacious garden in a quiet street in the heart of Amsterdam.

Great central location (Frederik Hendrikbuurt). Short walking distance from Jordaan area and city centre incl. the UNESCO historic canals, Anne Frank house, Westerchurch, Dam square, shoppings districts, etc.

Public transport within short walking distance (bus, tram).

Around 20 minutes to Schiphol Airport by taxi.
Around 12 minutes to Central Station by bus/tram.

name: The Blue Door
description:
Indulge in the allure of Amsterdam's old center with our rental room in a historic house, dating back to 1492. Nestled amidst the captivating streets, this cozy space offers a tranquil retreat while being within walking distance of the renowned red-light district. Immerse yourself in the city's vibrant energy and have it quiet when you want to sleep.

Location is everything, and you'll find yourself in the heart of it all, next to Dam Square, the Red-Light District, and the Rembrandt Museum.

name: Cozy 2-BR/2-Double Bed Flat near Westerpark
description:
Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish lived-in home where you’ll feel like a local. This is my personal space, so my belongings will be present.

Close to Westerpark, known for summer events and green areas.

15 minutes by bike or 30 minutes walking to the city center, with metro, tram, and bus stops next to the house connecting you across Amsterdam.

Amsterdam Airport Schiphol is about 30 minutes door-to-door, with easy access to Eindhoven.

Residential area, quiet at night.

name: Apartment in the lovely Pijp area
description:
Location, location, location!
This lovely apartment with a balcony is the perfect base for your stay in Amsterdam.

Located in the heart of De Pijp, one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods.
Just around the corner from Museumplein, and within walking distance of the city center.

Public transport is nearby, with easy access to the RAI Amsterdam.

Surrounded by great restaurants, coffee spots, and concept stores.
The famous Albert Cuyp Market is just around the corner.

name: Stylish River view apartment @ Amsterdam The Pijp
description: Step into this delightful 84 m2 apartment boasting mesmerizing views overlooking the tranquil Amstel river.

name: Serenity in the City - Luxe Living, Prime Location
description: This beautiful modern, bright and stylish apartment is located on the edge of the neighborhoods: Jordaan and Amsterdam West. Due to the convenient location of the apartment, it is the excellent place where you will optimally relax, and at the same time you are within walking distance of the city center and all Amsterdam hotspots! The apartment is easily accessible by car, train, and from Schiphol Airport. Public transportation is also within walking distance of the apartment.

name: B&B House of Straw Amsterdam - The Budget Room
description: Our House of Straw is a unique B&B built of wood, straw, hemp and loam. Because of its location you can enjoy the city, but also enjoy the rurality of North Holland, which is just around the corner.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Beautiful apartment with garden next to Vondelpark
description:
Feel like in a oasis in a vibrant capital city:

- next door to the Vondelpark (100 meters): ideal for running along the city most beautiful houses, with nice restaurants and bars nearby

- vertically below the city heart: ideal triangle to explore the Canals (Rijksmuseum is 7' by bike), West (Jordaan is 10' by bike) and East (De Pijp in 10' by bike)

name: Lovely house for families
description:
Modern, family friendly house in Amsterdam Noord, the hippest part of the city. Only ten minutes bike ride from the old city center.

Enjoy our 150m² house, beautifully designed and fully suitable for families. The house has three bedrooms, a spacious living room, a fully-equipped and modern kitchen, bathroom with bath and shower, and a lovely garden to unwind after a long day.

The house is situated in a car-free area, where kids can play and youth/adults can relax at the waterfront.

name: Child-friendly | Vondelpark 2 Min Centre 10 Min
description: This child-friendly Amsterdam house is located in the Wilhelminastraat in Amsterdam Oud-West, a 2-minute walk from the Vondelpark. This is one of Amsterdam's most popular neighbourhoods and this area is also known as Helmersbuurt . Many locals consider the Wilhelminastraat the most beautiful street in the city, look at the pictures and you will understand why. The house contains 4 bedrooms, 1 kitchen, 2 toilets, bathroom with shower and bathtub, living room and a private garden with lounge sofa.

name: Corner Apartment with Vondelpark Entrance
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place. Located at the entrance of Vondelpark and in the middle of the popular and vibrant Oud-West area, this spacious apartment offers room for 4 people. The perfect place to spend a week(end) in Amsterdam. Walking distance from the Museum Quarter, Leidseplein and Oud-Zuid, this park-situated apartment has something for everybody.

name: Design studio in trendy Noord
description:
Experience style and tranquility at our parkside B&B studio in Amsterdam's Noord.

Enjoy picturesque park views, serene ambiance, and lush greenery. Wake up to the sounds of nature and savour freshly brewed coffee in front of our house.

Conveniently close to vibrant centre of Noord with museums, cafes, restaurants, and nightlife nearby. Short stroll to metro for easy access to the entire city and all its main attractions.

name: Family friendly, ground-floor near Amstel & Artis
description: Our 140 m2, loft-style apartment combines convenience and tranquillity in an ideal location between the bustling city centre and the peaceful Plantage neighbourhood. With a modern and effortless interior, our apartment features three spacious bedrooms and open-plan living. The perfect place to relax and unwind when exploring Amsterdam.

name: Stylish apartment in Amsterdam Oost
description:
Welcome to our ground floor apartment in Amsterdam East! With its cozy private garden, modern bathroom, and fully equipped kitchen, this is the perfect place to enjoy Amsterdam.

Located in the relaxed and green neighborhood of Amsterdam East, you'll be surrounded by trendy cafes, bars, restaurants, and parks. Explore the charming streets and soak in the city's unique ambiance.

Upon arrival you will find a guide including information on our favorite places in the neighbourhood and city.

name: Cosy family home in Ams North / NDSM
description: Relax with the family or your loved one at this peaceful place to stay in the North of Amsterdam. 10min walk to NDSM (museum and ferry) and 5min drive to highway.

name: Renovated Modern 2BR Apartment in Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our Tranquil Haven near Amsterdam Canals! This cozy 2-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam East offers a peaceful retreat, easily accessible by public transport. Close to shopping areas and just moments from the enchanting canals and vibrant Harbour Club. Discover the serene living room, two comfortable bedrooms, fully equipped kitchen, and essential amenities. Escape the city's hustle and bustle while enjoying easy access to all that Amsterdam has to offer.

name: Sunny apartment with garden near de Jordaan
description:
If you are looking for a quiet neighborhood to stay, but still within walking distance from Vondelpark, the nine streets and the foodhallen, this apartment is the best choice!

A sunny apartment with all the necessities you need for a comfortable, fun stay in Amsterdam. With a large garden where you can chill and drink a coffee before you start the day. Or not, because there are soooo many nice coffee spots, bars and restaurants nearby :)

Enjoy!

name: Beautiful Apartment at the Park
description:
Slow down in this unique, soothing accommodation.
With a lovely view over the cozy Erasmus Park, you can relax after all the beautiful adventures in the city.
Public transportation is within walking distance and easily takes you from A to B. If you like cycling, then you are also in the right place here.
We offer 2 bedrooms both with double bed and a fold-out bed. Both beds are 160x200.
Spacious living room overlooking the park.
And at the rear, we offer a balcony.

name: Gem of De Wetering
description: Welcome to this beautiful Amsterdam corner apartment with lots of natural light and modern amenities, including a 6-burner gas stove, hood, dishwasher and fridge. On the second floor, there are two luxurious bedrooms with private bathrooms and custom-made fitted wardrobes. Enjoy historic charm and modern comfort in the quiet Weteringbuurt, within walking distance of Vijzelstraat metro station and various museums, as well as the bustling Leidseplein and Museumplein.

name: Luxurious & modern apartment in Amsterdam centre
description:
This stunning, stylish and modern apartment is situated in one of the most beautiful and authentic neighborhoods of Amsterdam called 'de Jordaan'. The 'split-level' architecture together with its big windows gives the apartment its spacious feeling.

Located in a quiet street, it is still very close to everything. The Anne Frank house, the beautiful canals, Nine Street shopping area, and many restaurants are within walking distance.

All things considered, a truly unique accommodation!

name: Monumental 100m2 apartment heart of city center
description:
situated in a prime location right in the heart of the city center, near the iconic Dam Square, the Kalverstraat with trendy stores, several supermarkets, restaurants and optimal public transport within walking distance.

This beautiful apartment with a monumental facade is located on the first floor of the old printing office of the financial newspaper.

No parties, drugs allowed!

name: Private mews studio near Vondelpark & museums
description:
Situated in a private mews, our studio offers a comfortable home within walking distance of the Museum Quarter (Rijks, Van Gogh and Stedelijk Museums), Vondelpark & Leidseplein

Sleeping up to two guests, the studio is ideal for your leisure or business stay in the centre of Amsterdam

We are a Lhbtiq+ friendly household

name: Happy peaceful stay in Amsterdam
description:
You won’t want to leave this charming, one-of-a-kind place.
Located just a 10 minute walk from the metro station, our Airbnb offers a convenient 25-minute ride to the city center.
Your cozy room awaits on the first floor, accessible through a hallway. You'll enjoy complete privacy as we only share the front door and the bathroom.
The room features a comfortable double bed and a fast wifi and a mini bar ☺️

name: 73m2 Apartment near Jordaan
description: Welcome to the newly renovated luxury apartment on the outskirts of the canal belt. Enjoy 73 square meters of comfort and light in the center of the city, bordering the historic Jordaan neighborhood. The apartment on the second floor has a lot of sunlight all day and has a nice small balcony facing the water. Sleeping is on the quiet back side, which also adjoins the bathroom.

name: Apartment Amsterdam Zuid-Oost
description:
A pleasant apartment in a suburb of Amsterdam. A place where you can relax after a busy day in the city. The apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood +-20 minutes from the city by public transport and +-30 minutes by bike. There is a quiet workplace with a large monitor. In the kitchen, everything can be used, and the living room is a great place to hang out on the sofa with a good movie after a long day in the city.
Be welcome and feel at home in my home :)

name: Vibrant 2P Apartment Amsterdam Westerpark
description:
This apartment is the perfect getaway and and ideal base for spending a memorable time in- and exploring Amsterdam!

All utilities and amenities are included, so all you need to do is bring your suitcase!

name: Appartement aan het park
description: Beautiful apartment in Amsterdam (Baarsjes). An ideal base for a city trip, the apartment is within walking distance of the Erasmus Park and all kinds of cozy streets and cafes. Suitable for a couple or family with up to 4 people

name: Quiet Room in Amsterdam West | WiFi | Cinema
description:
Your own private room in a modern Amsterdam West apartment. Bright spaces, sun terrace, and quiet garden setting — perfect for solo travellers or couples.

Shared living room, full kitchen, and outdoor seating. Stream Netflix, play PS4, or enjoy coffee overlooking the garden. Free WiFi rated 10/10.

Supermarket 50m away. Bus stop 2 min walk — direct to Centraal in 30 min. Pets welcome.

name: Appartement Amsterdam in het groen voor stel/gezin
description:
Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place in Amsterdam West/Oud Zuid

The house already feels a small wellness. Overlooking the Rembrandtpark, bird sounds in the garden, bath in the bedroom and a separate bathroom! In addition, the house is characteristically furnished in the 1930s style.
In addition to the Rembrandtpark, the Vondelpark can also be found within walking distance. And you are in the Jordaan in 7 minutes by bike or you are on Leidseplein!

Suitable for couple/family 2 kids

name: Family home in vibrant East side
description: Welcome to our stunning apartment nestled in the heart of Amsterdam's vibrant Indische buurt neighborhood! This carefully curated apartment offers a perfect blend of modern sophistication and family-friendly comfort, ensuring an unforgettable stay for guests of all ages.

name: Room at the heart of Amsterdam
description:
Situated conveniently upon the esteemed Spuistraat located in the very center of Amsterdam, this room offers the opportunity to stay immersed in the hustle and bustle of the city. Everything is within walking distance and public transportation is readily available. If you are searching for a place to stay that remains connected to all aspects of Amsterdam, there are few options as superb as this one.

(Note: Host is present in the listing due to local restrictions)

description:
A prime location. Charming canal house in the heart of Amsterdam. Many attractions, restaurants and shops are within walking distance.

The accommodation is 5 minutes from Central Station, Rembrandt House, the Old Church, Red light district, in 10 minutes you can be on the Dam.
Within 20 minutes, you can walk to a place where you can swim.

The Nieuwmarkt is only 5 minutes' walk away with lots of restaurants and terraces.
By train, you can reach Schiphol Airport in 15 minutes.

description: Welcome to our charming, recently fully redecorated apartment nestled in the centre of vibrant Amsterdam! Located on a quiet residential street, our cosy retreat offers a tranquil oasis amidst the bustling city. Embrace the best of both worlds as you enjoy the serenity of your own space while being steps away from the excitement. Take a leisurely stroll along the nearby canals or visit popular attractions such as the Anne Frank House, Dam Square or the Museum Quarters at walking distance.

name: Stunning Canalside Apartment
description:
With picturesque canal views, our apartment offers a unique stay. Enjoy a cozy open-plan layout, fully equipped kitchen, and comfortable beds. Walk along the famous canals and explore the vibrant Jordaan district or De Pijp, just a stone's throw away.

You'll have the opportunity to witness the daily rhythm of life on the water. Gaze out of the windows and see boats passing by, or simply relax on our private terrace, taking in the enchanting ambiance of Amsterdam.
