description: The house is well insulated and equipped with every comfort, there is also a lot of light and plants. There is also a lunchroom / co-working space in the complex The Villy also for a delicious breakfast and lunch. The place is central and within a few minutes walk there is access to public transportation to the city center. Surrounding various parks, supermarkets and sports clubs.

name: Trendy spacious, canal apartment + sunny terrace
description: Luxurious and spacious 2nd floor apartment (104 sq m) with canal views, centrally located in Amsterdam. The apartment is a 10 min walk from the Jordaan and the famous “Dutch Canals”. There is a sunny (3pm-9pm) private terrace (20 sqm) and a sunny small front balcony (from 7 am until 1 pm) + a sunny communal garden. The main bedroom has a large kingsize bed and an ensuite bathroom with large bathtub and double rain shower. The second bedroom has a smaller double bed. There is also a study room.

name: Huize Harry & Gompie
description:
Fantastic centrally located ground floor apartment in the heart of Amsterdam right next to the famous Vondelpark. 145m2 of living pleasure with garden and balcony. Ideal for your family.

Two separate bedrooms: 1 master bedroom and 1 cozy children's room. The children's room is suitable for 2 children. Still working? Spacious office with desk at your disposal and double sofa bed.

And then we almost forget about Harry and Gompie. Our two red cats who love to cuddle! Crazy about cats? Then you're in the right place!

name: Bohemian Family House with Garden
description:
Charming 100 m2 house, perfect for families or friends (can be booked for 1 to maximum 4 persons).

In the middle of vibrant NDSM area, with trendy restaurants. City close by: 10 min by (free) ferry or bus. Supermarket and shops nearby.

Spacious guest room with double bed, study, extra sleeping options. Bright living room with garden. Wood stove & a beamer for cozy nights. Fresh bathroom and extra separate toilet.

Enjoy a memorable stay in vibrant Amsterdam!

name: Charming apartment in the center
description:
You are staying in the heart of beautiful Amsterdam!
With its enchanting old-world charm, high ceilings, big windows and unbeatable location, it's the perfect choice for an unforgettable stay in the city.

In less than 10 minutes from the central station you reach the apartment. From here, you're just a short stroll away from the city's most iconic landmarks, trendy cafes, and picturesque canals. The enchanting atmosphere of Amsterdam is right at your doorstep.

name: Private Studio - Modern Gallery Pierre
description: Welcome to Modern Gallery Pierre, a ground floor luxurious 2-person apartment located in a stunning central canal house on the Herengracht in Amsterdam. This elegant and sophisticated apartment perfectly combines modern comfort with charm, offering an ideal retreat for couples who wish to experience the heart of Amsterdam and business & leisure travelers who know that style, comfort and a good location serves them best when visiting a city like Amsterdam.

name: Extra Spacious Room
description:
Hotel Jansen Bajeskwartier has 200 fully furnished rooms, designed and built with sustainability top of mind. Our rooms have a super comfortable queen size bed, a kitchen pantry, en suite luxurious bathroom with rain-shower and a comfy dining, work and chill corner.

Each two floors have spacious Club Rooms which function as a living room and self-catering kitchen. On the ground floor you find Cafe Jansen and its terrace, a hybrid space with room for dining and working.

name: 2-Bedroom Condo with View of Amstel River
description: Experience the charm of Amsterdam from our centrally located two-bedroom apartment, with stunning Amstel River views. Just blocks away from the InterContinental Amstel Amsterdam Hotel, our spacious and convenient flat ensures a comfortable stay near the heart of the city.

name: Apartment overlooking amsterdam canal near jordaan
description:
This spacious B&B overlooking the beautiful Brouwersgracht is certainly unique! Centrally located in the historic center in the UNESCO-protected canal belt of Amsterdam. Suitable for families or couples up to a maximum of 4 people. Located on the 3rd floor, which is easily accessible via a wide staircase.

All the main attractions are within walking distance. As well as the best restaurants, bars, shops and clubs.

name: Cosy living&bedroom with nice energy
description:
Unique apartment in the center of Amsterdam in the middle of the greenery.
Everything within reach.

name: Canal View Stay Amsterdam
description: Experience stunning canal views from your cozy private room on the top floor of our charming historic canal house. A harmonious blend of relaxation, comfort, and convenience, with thoughtful touches, window bench, floating bed, and complimentary artisan goodies. Live like a local in the authentic Old‑South neighbourhood while overlooking the Schinkel Canal. Our personalized service includes a seamless check‑in and bespoke local recommendations, ensuring every detail feels effortlessly tailored.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Cargo Vessel now a Modern Studio
description: Enjoy the sounds of nature in this unique place to stay.

name: Overnachten aan de kade.
description:
This stylish space is located on the canal near must-see sights. Such as the canal belt of Amsterdam, the trendy district "de Pijp" with numerous bars, restaurants, shops and the Heineken brewery, the Museumplein with, among others, the Rijksmuseum and the Van Gogh museum.
No breakfast is served, there are plenty of options for breakfast in the area.
Early check-in and late check-out are always possible.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Bright apartment with garden (all private)
description:
Our apartment is located in a nice and easy going part of the city with plenty of bars, restaurants and shops around (De Baarsjes). We have a private garden with lounge set and dinner table, perfect for long summer nights outside. Due to the large windows, the apartment is very bright, perfect for an comfortable stay in Amsterdam.

We also have a special desk for remote working, the house has a fast and stable wifi connection

name: 5-star apartment & location in central Amsterdam
description:
Luxurious and fully renovated city apartment of 80 m2 in the middle of Amsterdam, within walking distance of all hotspots including the popular Bosboom Toussaintstraat (2 min) and the Vondelpark (5 min).

The apartment - located on the 2nd floor - is very tastefully designed and offers a unique view of the canals. Enjoy this lovely apartment and experience all that Amsterdam has to offer!

Check-in: from 1 p.m.
Check-out: before 12 noon

Registration number: 0363 BECF 025D F6A5 AB95

name: Sunny Jordaan - 2 Bedroom and Balcony
description:
Located in the heart of Amsterdam, our sunny 2 bedroom apartment in Jordaan is perfect to explore the city.

In the lively heart of the city, you are surrounded by cafes, bars and the Amsterdam canals, with the famous Prinsengracht canal at the end of the street. Anne Franks house is an easy stroll, the train station is 10 minutes walk and the central Dam square is also 10 minutes. The apartment has 2 bedrooms, french balcony at the front and a large balcony at rear.

This is our private home.

name: Recently build studio in lovely garden
description:
Nice newly build studio in convenient location to explore the city. 2 minutes from the lovely Westerpark and within 10 minutes in the center.
The studio is located in a spacious and beautiful backyard. Tramstop in front of the house, Schiphol airport easy access with train in 25 minutes. In the neighborhood you can find lots of restaurants and shops. Our host Marcia, will help you anytime. You can use a fridge. (the entrance to the studio is through the main building)

name: Prachtig herenhuis met tuin
description: A lovely luxury apartment with a central location, a 2-minute walk from the metro that takes you with a direct connection to the city center in 6 minutes. The apartment is a stone's throw away from the Amstel canal where there are many nice hotspots. The double downstairs house has all the comforts with a modern/classic comfortable decor. Enjoy the peace and quiet of the house with the coziness of the Weesperzijde around the corner, where you can walk beautifully along the Amsterdam canals.

name: Spacious garden villa in Amsterdam
description:
Spacious family house with garden in Amsterdam Zuid near the river Schinkel
- which is part of grachten of Amsterdam - the lake Nieuwe Meer. The house has an open living room and kitchen, a study, 3 bedrooms, 3 double beds, a shower and 2 toilets. The garden has a big picnic area. Close to museum quarter and excellent restaurants.

name: Kids friendly home next to park
description:
Welcome to our family home, nestled in the heart of Amsterdam, just a stone's throw away from the vibrant Westerpark. Experience the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this cozy haven, ideal for creating lasting memories with your loved ones. Explore the nearby park, soak in the local culture, and make our home your own during your Amsterdam adventure.

Perfect flat for a couple with (or without) kids

name: Luxurious | A+Location | 240m2 | Huge Roofterrace
description:
CLASSIC HOME, CLOSE TO VONDELPARK, MUSEUM DISTRICT & HIGH END SHOPPING

A unique 3 story home with 4 spacious bedrooms and an unforgettable view of Amsterdam!

Experience the joys of living in a luxurious & stylish house, located in the upscale, safe & historic neigborhood Old-South, while enjoying the tranquility of living in a residential area close to the Museum District.


★★★ 2 out of the 4 bedrooms have A/C! ★★★

name: Piece of paradise in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to my lovely home. It is a beautiful new apartment on the north side of Amsterdam where you are close to the city but can also enjoy the peace and greenery that Noord has to offer.

Minimum age for booking this apartment is 30.
It is an apartment in a residential building, so not suitable for throwing parties or having loud music.

There is floor heating for the colder days, a bathtub, a king-size bed with a cocomat mattress and a very relaxed atmosphere.

name: Private modern apartment next to Foodhallen/Centre
description: Very centrally-located and recently renovated apartment with 1 bedroom (Queen bed). It's the top floor apartment in a 1900's house minutes outside the busy centre of Amsterdam. Old West is a vibrant and happening area, the apartment is close to the city centre and has excellent public transport connections. Located in a quiet street next to Bellamyplein. Close to Vondelpark, Museumdistrict, Leidseplein. Next door: Foodhallen, Ten Katemarket, loads of shops, cafes and restaurants!

name: Canal House with a Unique View
description:
Ready to experience Amsterdam while staying in an iconic canal house with a breathtaking view of Prinsengracht?

The apartment is right in the city center. 10-minute walk to Anne Frank house, 15-minute walk to Dam Square, and 12-minute walk to Rijksmuseum. A multitude of great bars, restaurants and famous boutiques are within meters.

1 bedroom (2 large single beds), a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and a balcony. The whole place is yours!

Parties are not allowed.

name: Beautiful Apartment
description: This beautiful apartment has just been completely renovated with the most beautiful materials. Located in one of the most beautiful neighborhoods of Amsterdam and only a 10-minute walk from the city center. Relax in this bright and tasteful house like a real Amsterdammer. Equipped with every comfort.

name: Elegant Boutique Apartment 45m2 - Amazing Views
description: Modern and well-designed, newly renovated, 45m2 studio with separate bedroom, filled with art and abundant natural light. Bed 180 by 200. Large windows with beautiful sunset views. Ideally located in a quiet and chic neighborhood, close to the free ferry to the inner city. Just moments away from the city’s creative heart NDSM, which is home to a vibrant art scene, great restaurants, bars and scenic terraces overlooking the water. It's a favourite for long stays, too!

name: Ground floor + garden Rivierenbuurt
description: Welcome to our beautiful house on the Waalstraat! The location is ideal as it's close to the busy neighborhoods (10-15 min walk to de Pijp), but also quiet. Here you can enjoy a charming accommodation with a beautiful garden, a comfortable bedroom and a spacious kitchen/living room. There is a second bedroom in the gardenhouse. Start your day with a cup of coffee in the garden, and stroll into Amsterdam.  Prepare meals in the kitchen or visit the nice restaurants close by.

name: Central & spacious family house in hip area
description: This is a beautiful and peaceful house in Amsterdams greenest neighbourhood and perfect for a family stay. It is very central and just a 10 minute bike or tram ride from the city centre.  Amsterdam Oost / Watergraafsmeer is one of the city's hippest neighbourhoods with many cosy cafes, excellent restaurants,  great shops, parks, swimming pools and numerous sports facilities.

name: Family home Amsterdam
description: In this family home, you can stay quietly with young children. You can play in the garden, enjoy the BBQ outside or relax after a day in the city. The house is 20 minutes by bike from the central station, and with 5 minutes by bike you are in the meadows enjoying nature.

name: Huis Amsterdam vlakbij IJburg Strand met airco!
description:
This amazing accommodation of 160m2 guarantees fun with the whole family! The house is with garden, free parking space in an enclosed courtyard garden, 3 bicycles and air conditioning. Within walking distance of Blijburg beach, cozy restaurants and jetties where children can swim! The house is on the ground floor and 1st floor. The home can be easily reached for those with disabilities.

The house will be delivered tidy and clean!

name: Spacious family home with lovely garden and view
description: Have fun with the whole family in architect-designed house. Spacious garden on typical Dutch polder. The house is 15 minutes by bike from Amsterdam city center.

name: Lichte, goed gesitueerde loft
description: Bright and spacious apartment with a homey atmosphere, decorated with a mix of designer and vintage furniture. The open kitchen and cozy living room offer a nice place to relax. The bedroom is quiet and comfortable, ideal for a good night's sleep. Situated in a quiet neighborhood, within walking distance to shops, cafes and other facilities. Excellent public transport takes you directly to the city center and the WTC. Perfect for those looking for comfort and style in a relaxing environment!

name: Fijn appartement in Adam noord
description:
Nice and spacious apartment of 60m2 on the 1st and 2nd floor above a shop, with its own entrance.

The apartment is located in the hip Amsterdam Noord, close to the van der Pekmarkt, various cafes, restaurants and shops within 150m walking distance.

Within a 5-10 minute walk, you will find the metro to Central Station (Noord Zuid Lijn). Via that metro line, you can be in the city center, De Pijp or on the Zuidas in no time.

You are close to the Eye Film Museum, the Adam Tower and the ferry to Amsterdam Central.

name: Familyappt +jacuzzi&trampoline
description: In no time visiting all the good things of Amsterdam (tram stops in front of the door and a lot of things are on walking distance) and have relaxing time with your family in our house. Enjoy the garden with trampoline, small slide and bbq with a lot of shade options. Or relax in the jacuzzi, on our large couch or go local and have a glass of wine on our couch in front of the door. Go to the large outdoor pool on 7 min walking distance, playgrounds or several parks, enjoy the restaurants and ...

name: Cosy central 2 bed apartment
description:
Cosy and centrally located 2 bed apartment.

Located on a quiet street to ensure a good night's sleep.

Modern and plentiful facilities for guests

Easy to get into town (15 mins on tram, 10 mins on bike), supermarket, restaurants and bars 2 mins walk away

name: Ruim familiehuis met tuin & parking in Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our spacious family home in the green, child-friendly Amsterdam-Noord. Enjoy the tranquility, a private garden and free parking. Within walking distance you will find a supermarket and a bus stop with a quick connection to the metro. You can also reach the ferry to the city center in 5 minutes by bike. Swimming is possible in the nearby side canal of the IJ. Within 15 minutes you will be on Dam Square! Due to the fact that we ourselves live in this house, personal belongings (clothing) will be left behind.

name: Art Studio next to Rijksmuseum
description:
Welcome to my cozy nest!

A private studio in the souterrain (-1/5 stairs) with your own entrance in an amazing location.

The apartment is fully independent. You will have it privately for all your own.

It's an authentic old Amsterdam house in a well-situated location. The Leidseplein is one of the most famous districts in the midst of Amsterdam. From Van Gogh, Stedelijk, Rijksmuseum, Anne Frank house to Vondel park, you can get within 5 mins’ walking distance.


(RN :0363 BAFF 0F0F 23D3 CFA8)

name: Beautiful family apartment
description:
Featured in architectural magazines from all over the world, but in daily life this apartment functions as the perfect family home in the city in a friendly neighborhood with beautiful parks.
Close to all the main attractions and with perfect connection to all public transport. 10 minutes to Van Gogh museum or Central station; 20 mins to the airport.
Also with elevator and fantastic roof terrace.

name: Family-friendly home with free parking
description:
Welcome to our spacious and family-friendly home in Amsterdam Zuid-Oost! If you're looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay while exploring the beautiful city, our property is the perfect choice.

Located in the vibrant neighborhood of Amsterdam Zuid-Oost, you'll have easy access to the city's top attractions. The nearby Gaasperplas offers a stunning natural retreat, perfect for leisurely walks or picnics. Public transportation options are also within reach.

name: Enjoy Amsterdam: City Buzz & Beach Breeze
description:
Spacious and quiet 3-story townhouse, ideal for family or friends. It features a top-floor master bedroom, two children’s rooms, a sofa bed, a kitchen, a kitchenette, a living room, a bathroom, two toilets, and two terraces. Free and safe parking available.

Discover IJburg’s striking architecture, lively harbor, cafés, and shopping center at your doorstep.

Enjoy both city excitement and beach life just 15 minutes away—hop on the tram to the city center or take a scenic walk to the beach.

name: 55m2 Centraal gelegen luxe nabij Vondelpark
description:
Newly renovated apartment in Amsterdam.

Centrally located, right next to the metro station, bus station and 5 minutes walk from the Vondelpark.

Includes washing machine, luxury bathroom, double bed, office room, spacious living room with large sofa and large TV, large kitchen with fridge, water view and a spacious balcony.

name: Peaceful apartment with garden
description: This apartment is situated on a very quiet street in the heart of the Pijp. It's within walking distance of the city centre, museum square  and around the corner of metro 52 and several tram lines giving you easy access to all of Amsterdam. Enjoy all the bars and restaurants of the Pijp, or stay in and enjoy a homemade meal in the garden made in the fully equipped kitchen or on the BBQ. Relax in the hammock while listening to your music on the Sonos sound system, before you start your day.

name: Lovely appartment /w roofterrace
description:
Bright, spacious apartment in Amsterdam Zuid, 5 min walk to Rijksmuseum.

All the restaurants, bars, shops and highlights you need are around the corner, while the street itself is comfortably quiet.

The apartment at the 3rd and 4th floor has a sunny balcony and very big, private roofterrace.
The bedroom upstairs has a kingsize bed and modern ensuite bathroom.
The bedroom downstairs contains a queensize bed.

This appartment is smoke and pet free.

name: Modern Comfort Room in Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our Amsterdam abode! Just 10 min walk from Amsterdam Arena, Ziggo Dome, AFAS Live. Metro station Strandvliet is 1 min away for a quick trip to city center in 10 min. Two train stations, Duivendrecht & Bijlmer Arena, are walking distance. Bonus: they're linked to Schiphol Airport, a mere 10 min train ride away! Our ground-floor shared apartment ensures peace, no noisy neighbors! Bijlmer Arena area offers tasty eats & supermarkets. Book now & let the adventure begin!

name: Residence Oblomow.  Spacious apartment ( 90 m2)
description:
The fotoos speak for themselves
So do the more then 180 reviews . I want you to know that all those reviews are about this apartment and not about other
places .

name: Cozy 1BR Apartment @ De Pijp / close to museum sq.
description: Welcome to our cosy and charming apartment, nestled in the vibrant and popular neighbourhood of De Pijp. Perfectly located, the apartment offers easy access to public transport and is just a short distance from popular hotspots such as Leidseplein. The area is filled with charming cafés, lively bars, and excellent restaurants, giving you the perfect taste of Amsterdam living. The apartment is situated on the first floor and features one =bedroom, perfect for couples.

name: Well lit flat with canal views
description:
Relax in this naturally well-lit flat in the heart of Ams-West, just 10mins walk from the canal belt neighbourhood, Jordaan. On a canal on a quiet tree-lined street, steps from Erasmus park, you wont believe you're in a city.

It's my home, and I rent it when I'm away so expect a few personal items/touches.

*I'm fostering shy tabby cat, who you will share the space with. I have an automatic feeder and litter box, so you don't have to do anything. He is shy but sweet.

Permit # Z/24/2335226

name: Light and luxurious apartment next to Vondelpark
description: Wonderful apartment with its own balcony at the back. Is fully equipped; dishwasher, bath, shower, large bedroom and is the ideal base for exploring Amsterdam. A 5-minute walk from all the nice restaurants and places in Amsterdam Oud West. You will stay in a quiet neighborhood and in no time you will be in the hustle and bustle of the city and the Vondelpark

name: City Oasis in old-West
description:
Sunny and stylish apartment with large terrace located in the lively and popular old-West area. Walking distance to the city centre.

The apartment is very light due to the large windows and the there is a fully equipped kitchen (incl coffee machine). It comes with a large terrace (lounge set, outside dinner table). Enjoy the extra room for working from home, relax on the terrace and enjoy Amsterdam.

Very close to Vondelpark, Leidseplein, Canals , Rijksmuseum, Foodhallen and much more.

name: 5 star premium flat in the heart of Amsterdam
description: Highly appointed, fully equipped and newly renovated, boutique experience apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. With over 60M2 space to indulge and relax in after exploring the gems Amsterdam has to offer.  A large king bed upstairs, a beautiful lounge area with outside patio that has the summer sun well into the evening. A wonderfully highly spec'd kitchen and eat in dining area for those who feel like cooking.

name: Nice and quiet room in a modern Amsterdam house
description:
Quiet home in Amsterdam, 10 minutes from everything
in a quiet street, just outside of downtown. There is a shared garden, kitchen and refrigerator. The host, Simone, lives here herself and is happy to give you insider tips about the city that you won't find anywhere else. Ideal for a female solo traveler or a couple who want to experience the real Amsterdam. Downtown is 10 minutes away. Parking is possible (paid). Rented bicycles can be safely stored in front of the door.

name: Charming Central Appartement in Oud-West
description:
This charming, comfortable apartment offers a unique blend of style and location for exploring all Amsterdam has to offer.

Just a 15-minute walk from the canals and historic centre, and steps from the trendy Jordaan with its picturesque streets and cosy cafés. It's also next to De Hallen and the renowned Foodhallen, perfect for enjoying the city's best street food.

To make your stay even more special, I've included a curated list of local insider tips to help you explore the neighbourhood.

name: Playful, cozy home in The Pijp
description:
Welcome to our playful, unique home spread over two floors with a lovely roof terrace located in a central location in the popular "De Pijp".

You enter through the common entrance on the ground floor. The cozy, spacious kitchen is downstairs and is equipped with every comfort and more. From the ground floor, the staircase leads up to the cozy living room, where the unique sitting room is located with a lovely corner to relax.

name: Cozy and luminous artist apartment
description: Enjoy a cozy and stylish apartment in one of the most vivid neighborhoods of Amsterdam

name: appartement+garden in Amsterdam
description:
A unique place in Amsterdam with a quiet garden and veranda, the apartment is decorated with vintage design furniture and is located in a nice neighborhood near the Westerpark near the Jordaan.
The perfect place to relax and unwind after a day of fun in the hustle and bustle of the city.

name: Yacht The River
description:
Luxury Yacht for Charter in the area of Ijmeer-Markermeer, Gooimeer. Max 40 minutes by car to Amsterdam.
Great luxury experience with your family, friends, or colleagues. The yacht can host up to 8 sleeping guests, for day trips up to 25 persons. Ideal for celebrations, or to have some private time on the water. The price on Airbnb is without sailing, this will be an additional cost. The possibilities/location can be discussed in the chat. When sailing the captain and a crew member is including.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam Noord
description: Located in the heart of the trendy Noord neighbourhood - known for its bars, restaurants and clubs - this flat itself is in a quiet residential street. Noorderpark metro station is a 10 minute walk and just one stop away from Central, so it takes 15 minutes to arrive in the historical center of Amsterdam, home to the Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, Anne Frank House and the world famous canals. The flat comes with a double bedroom, modern kitchen, bathroom, living room and south facing balcony.

name: Cosy stylish family 4 bedroom apartment
description:
Our lovely 4 bedroom family apartment is spacious, cosy and comfortable. The house is close to the citycentre (1km) and is perfect for families who want to visit the city while feeling at home.
The balcony is looking into the inner garden. Situated in a quiet area, close to de Hallen, Rembrandpark, de Jordaan, etc.
With a quooker, bath, rain shower, dishwasher, washing/dryer and family games, you have all the facilities you'll need.

Welcome home!

We only rent out to families with children

name: Uniek familiehuis met tuin
description: Make new memories in this unique, family-friendly accommodation within walking distance of downtown and various cozy restaurants, bars and museums

name: Spacious, cozy, newly renovated family apartment
description:
Enjoy this light, spacious and stylish apartment in Amsterdam-West. The 107m2 apartment is fully renovated in November and is equipped with a luxurious open design-kitchen (incl all necessities you wish for), 2 bed rooms (space for 4 people) and a private garden.

Moreover, the neighborhood is a safe and nice area and offers lots of culinary restaurants, coffee spots, and public transport on walking distance. Previous guests loved our apartment because of our cozy interior and warm atmosphere.

name: Sunny spot in Amsterdam oost
description:
Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

Although the apartment is small it has everything you need for the perfect stay.

With 2 balconies front and back it feels much more spacious than it is, the front balcony is also south facing so you get the sun all day long.

Lots of cafes and restaurants to choose for within 5/10 minutes walking distance. If you need to go a bit further the tram and train are only around the corner and plenty of bike hiring options are available.

name: Modern and sunny apartment in vibrant "de Pijp"!
description: We are happy offer you our renovated and fully-equipped apartment! The apartment is located in the very popular neighborhood De Pijp. It is characterized as a young and vibrant neighborhood, with numerous cafes, restaurants and shops, close to the Sarphatipark as well as the Albert Cuyp Market, which can be visited 6 days a week.

name: Spacious and cosy apartment
description: Cosy and neat 2-bedroom apartment in the East of Amsterdam (‘Indische Buurt’). The recently renovated apartment features a kitchen with a comfortable cooking island and a nice balcony with sun all day. The appartement is very close to the vibrant Javastraat, the beautiful Flevopark, has a tram and bus stop to the city centre in front of the door, and the Amsterdam Muiderpoort train station at less than 10 minutes walking away.

name: Stylish Apartment + terrace near Vondelpark
description:
A charming and comfortable first floor Amsterdam style apartment with a lush and quiet terrace. The place is located in a serene street in the middle of the lively Hoofddorplein neighborhood.

The Vondelpark is only a 10 minute walk away - perfect for your early morning run or cycling expedition!

The apartment accommodates all that is needed for four people.

Don't look further for an unforgettable experience in a great location with tons of stuff to do in and around the neighborhood.

name: Cosy apartment near the Jordaan
description: A stylish and attractive apartment in a cozy, quiet neighbourhood in Amsterdam West, near the Jordaan. The house is located next to a park where you can swim, or lie by the water. It also has a wonderful kitchen, cozy living room, study and nice bedroom. In the morning you can drink a cup of coffee on the sunny balcony. Multiple public transport option are just around the corner. Towels, sheets and essentials are included!

name: Family place in the city center
description:
Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place. There is 1 double bed and one comfortable air bed. There is a big playground, swimming pool, musea (kids proof) and parks nearby. But also close to shopping area, bars, nightlife etc.

The appartement is in a quiet area. Please be so kind to respect our neighbors.

name: Bobbi’s luxe appartement
description:
This spacious apartment has a perfect location in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid, for exploring Amsterdam. In 5 minutes at the Vondelpark or in 10 at the Amsterdam forest. Direct (night) bus connection to Schiphol airport. Lovely open high-end kitchen, bath, balcony, walk-in closet! Everything you need for a great stay in Amsterdam.

The apartment is available for 2 adults and a child.

name: Urban family-friendly loft
description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally located family loft located in an old school building. Our house has a large kitchen with high standard equipment, living room, tv room, 2 office spaces, 1 master bedroom with bathroom (bath and shower), 3 children bedrooms and bathroom (shower and toilet), laundry room and 2 toilets. Our house has outside a terrace within the courtyard where kids can play. We have an indoor parking. At the roof we have a communal terrace.

name: Charmant 5 star City Home with sunny garden
description:
This 2-floor apartment house with all comfort and luxury in one of the most beautiful streets in the heart of high-end neighborhood OUD-ZUID. Perfect for those who love culture, musea and stay in a quiet neighborhood.

The apartment (120m2) consisting of the ground and first floor, 2 (sunny-) gardens, friendly street with grass and canal in front.
2 bedrooms:
- 1 master bedroom: double bed (180X200)
- 1 sleeping room: high end sleeping couch (140x200)

name: Prime Location in the cozy and bustling Pijp.
description: The apartment is in a great location in the bustling heart of De Pijp. It is located between countless restaurants, shops and the cozy cafes in De Pijp. The well-known Albert Cuyp market is just around the corner and within walking distance are Sarphatipark, Museumplein and Leidseplein. A great improvement for the accessibility of the Pijp is the North-South line with his own stop a few minutes walk away, which can be used to reach Central Station.

name: Amstel City B&B
description: Fresh and fashionable one bedroom apartment, sleeping up to four people in 2 double beds (4 people is incl. children/babies due to strict government rules), situated in the heart of Amsterdam close to the Rijksmuseum and the Rembrandtplein.

name: Ruime gezinswoning met tuin
description:
Lovely spacious and cozy family home in an ideal location. Quiet and 'hidden' among the greenery, but close to the hustle and bustle of the city. The house has a spacious living room with sliding doors to the sunny garden. Here is seating, a dining table, BBQ and a tropical lounge hut. Upstairs are three large bedrooms (1 with balcony) with large double beds.
The Amsterdamse Bos is around the corner. Amenities and Zuidas are within walking distance. Perfect tram connection to the city center.

name: Family home in Amsterdam city
description:
A nice, centrally located, family home in Amsterdam East with many amenities just around the corner. We live almost next to the Dappermarkt, a daily market with a varied selection. From clothes to food. Nearby are also supermarkets, many cafes and restaurants, the Oosterpark and Tropenmuseum, all within walking distance. A lively part of Amsterdam!
We also have a very friendly cat, Sammy.

name: Cozy Two Bedroom Apartment in Amsterdam (75m2)
description:
Fully furnished two bedroom apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. All amenities from coffee machine to 65 inch TV, comfortable boxspring double bed to hanging swing chair, this apartment is for people who would like to have a home away from home.

Only 5 minutes walk to Wibautstraat metro station which is an intersection of M51, M53, and M54 lines. 3 minutes walk tram station (Line 1, Line 3). Bus stop is also around the corner where direct night buses to Schiphol airport pass by.

name: Bright & sunny East apartment
description:
This recently renovated, bright and sunny Amsterdam East apartment (right next to Oosterpark) has beautiful high ceilings with original ornaments, two sunny balconies to enjoy your morning coffee or a glass of wine in the afternoon, and has everything you need for the perfect weekend in Amsterdam. The area is trendy and vibrant but relaxed, with lots of coffee spots and nice restaurants, all within walking distance from canals. Perfect for a couple or single (1 br)

Second floor (no elevator)

name: Een appartement in kindvriendelijke buurt
description:
Experience a relaxing visit with the whole family in Amsterdam in this bright and spacious 110 m2 accommodation with 3 bedrooms.

All the highlights, including the Museumplein, the Rijksmuseum, the Van Gogh Museum and the Stedelijk Museum, are within 2.5 km.

The Vondelpark and the Amsterdamse Bos are within walking distance.

The beach is within 30 km.

Parking is available in front of the door, and public transportation is within walking distance.

name: Bright & Spacious 2 BR. Apt. With Rooftop Terrace
description: This luxurious, bright and spacious house is fully equipped. The apartment is on the 3rd floor and is easy to reach. From the kitchen you have access to the roof terrace.  In the apartment, there is a spacious living room with also a large kitchen with a cooking island. From the living room, you have access to the 2 large bedrooms and bathroom with open walk-in shower and whirlpool bath. The apartment is fully equipped with all comforts. The location is quiet but in the center and within walking distance of all hotspots.

name: Room in green
description:
The area is surrounded by parks, there is green all around. The apartment is strategically placed between two major rail stations (Science Park and Amstelstation). It is very close to the Pijp and it takes around 20 minutes by bike to reach Amsterdam Central station.
The room is comparable to a small studio as it is quite big. It is in a shared apartment. For any further questions feel free to contact me.

name: Unique sfeervolle plek met terras in de Jordaan
description:
This unique accommodation has its own style.
The monumental building dates from 1641 and has been completely restored.
The apartment consists of 2 floors with a roof terrace of 26m2. It is the ideal place to explore the city. Located in the middle of the Jordaan, next to the Haarlemmerstraat, near Westerpark, the canal belt and the 9 streets. The street itself is very quiet with little traffic, so you can hear the birds chirping on the terrace. The ideal place to relax and unwind.

name: gezellig Amsterdams familie-appartement in Oost
description:
Cozy and child-friendly apartment in a quiet street, close to the bustling center. Suitable for up to 2 adults with 1, 2 (or possibly 3) children.
- Please note: no groups of friends -

We live here with our sons (6 and 8 years old) so everything for the children is in the house, lots of toys!
By bike or public transport, you can reach the central station, the Rijksmuseum, Artis, etc. in ten minutes.
The Flevopark (with a beautiful swimming pool) and the lively Javastraat are around the corner.

name: Near Arena Room in Amsterdam
description: Stay in a private room in a modern, quiet area of Amsterdam. Just 1 min to Strandvliet Metro: city center in ~10 mins. Amsterdam Arena, Ziggo Dome, and AFAS Live are steps away. Shops, restaurants, and supermarkets are 10 mins on foot or 2 mins by metro (one stop). Duivendrecht and Bijlmer Arena stations connect directly to Schiphol Airport. Comfort, convenience, and great transport links await!

name: Knus eenkamerappartement!
description:
This cozy one-room apartment is ideally suited for a couple or two friends. The apartment offers all the amenities you need for a wonderful stay in Amsterdam. Enjoy a relaxing stay at the Sloterplas, or visit the cozy, Amsterdam city center!

Normally I live here, so there will be private things of mine present. Of course, I will store these, and you will have everything you need for a pleasant stay!

name: Stijlvol gerenoveerd appartement Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to this lovely and bright apartment in the luxurious, lively neighborhood of Oud Zuid!

Discover the charm of the Vondelpark and the museums of the Museumplein. Shopping and dining nearby.

The stop for tram line 2 is in the street. According to the magazine National Geographic Traveler, line 2 is one of the most beautiful in the world.
It runs along all the high points of the city.

The airport and WTC Zuidas are 15 minutes away.

Enjoy the comfortable apartment and the splendor of Amsterdam.

name: 1bdr Apt in the Center
description: My home is located in the center of Amsterdam, a perfect location! It's right next to Ten Katemarkt (a lively street market), a step away from touristic areas with both local and international neighbours. Vondelpark is accessible in 6 mins (bike) / 15 mins (walk), Jordaan in 5 mins (bike) / 15 mins (walk). There are all kinds of cultural and fun activities around. You'll get to know the real Amsterdam.

name: Cosy appartment
description: Welcome to our nice apartment in Amsterdam East! Perfectly located near Oosterpark, beukenplein and Amstel station, with supermarkets, restaurants and public transport around the corner. Relax after a day in the city and enjoy our comfortable home with one spacious bedroom, a cozy living room, fully equipped kitchen and bathroom. Everything you need during your stay is there! With good wifi and workspaces, this home is also particularly suitable for working at home.

name: Family apartment in Amsterdam
description: A nice, 65 square meter apartment in the southern parts of Amsterdam. Within 30 minutes of city centre and a few minutes walk from the countryside and idyllic Dutch villages, this apartment is perfect for couples spending a few days in Amsterdam.

name: Modern | Jordaan Apartment | 2BR | 4P
description:
This 50m2 apartment is a great place to stay at during your time in Amsterdam! 

Located in an awesome street with a great atmosphere. There is a bright living room with lots of natural light, two bedrooms with comfortable beds and a bathroom & separate toilet.

The space is well located in the Jordaan area, within only minutes walking to famous markets and shopping streets in the Jordaan.

Professionaly cleaned! The apartment is fully private, what you see in the pictures is 100% yours.

name: Sophisticated Apt: Stunning Canal View & Balcony
description: Welcome to our charming apartment in the heart of Amsterdam! Experience the comfort and uniqueness of this recently renovated space, boasting a fairytale canal view. Enjoy the sun-drenched balcony from 16:00 until sunset, while the large windows and high ceilings fill the house with natural light. The open kitchen, complete with a beautiful kitchen island, is fully equipped. The spacious living room features a dining area and a cozy sitting area offering stunning views.

name: Charming floating houseboat
description: Charming and family-friendly houseboat (about 102m2) in the hip Amsterdam Noord. Only 10 minutes by bike from the city center of Amsterdam. The house is part of a unique residential area of 40 self-designed sustainable houseboats. The houseboat is divided into 3 floors. On the upper floor (split level) a TV and a roof terrace. On the ground floor, kitchen and living room. Downstairs bedroom for 2 adults and a children's room for 2 people. Bathroom with bath and spacious shower.

name: Light and Spacious Apartment
description: Forget your worries in this spacious & serene space. Located on the 3rd floor, this light, airy apartment has balconies on both sides. On a sunny day you are able to enjoy sun in both the morning & the evening. The spacious bedroom overlooks gardens at the back, guaranteeing a peaceful night's sleep. Located in the heart of Bos en Lommer - a 2min walk from cafes, supermarket & a tram to the center. 30min train & tram from Schipol or Centraal Station. Well equipped Kitchen. Bike rental close by.

name: Private luxury suite in Museum Quarter (40m2)
description:
Welcome to our luxury studio in the heart of Amsterdam! Located in the Museum Quarter, just a few minutes away from some of the city's most iconic sites (Vondelpark, Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, Concertgebouw and Leidse Square).

You’re surrounded by restaurants, (coffee) bars, and even a cozy neighbourhood market (Saturdays) - all within walking distance. And when you stay with us, you'll get our insider tips on our favourite hotspots in the area and beyond.

name: Ground-floor apt | By Artis Zoo, 10 min to Dam Sq
description: Stay in a freshly renovated ground-floor apartment, just minutes from Artis Zoo, the Amstel, and the metro. Enjoy a quiet neighborhood close to the city buzz. The apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, and a comfortable design — perfect for couples, friends, or solo travelers who want both convenience and charm.

name: Glamorous 3BR Apartment Dam Square
description:
Glamorous apartment, (137m2) centrally located in the heart of Amsterdam next to Dam Square. We are offering the entire bel étage of a monumental mansion. The huge windows and high ceilings provide beautiful light and a sense of luxury.


The grand front room is divided between a comfortable lounge with an original working fire place and a spacious semi-open dining room with a fully equipped modern kitchen. The apartment has three bedrooms and a luxury bathroom with a walk-in shower and a bath.

name: Parkview Family Apartment
description: Our comfortable family house close to the Amstel river combines the relaxed atmosphere of a communal garden and a beautiful open parkview yet is only 10 minutes by bike to the city centre and just in between hip and happening "Oost" and "de Pijp". We solely welcome families to our well equiped family home which is perfect for your stay with kids in Amsterdam; only a 3 minute walk to the metro that takes you to the airport in another 20 minutes

name: Uniek appartement in Amsterdam
description:
This unique accommodation has its own style.
A cozy two-story apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. The apartment has a large window on a nice little square. The location is super central, so a perfect home base to explore the city!

name: Spacious apartment with garden in the lively Pijp!
description:
Welcome to this spacious, centrally located ground-floor apartment in Amsterdam’s lovely neighbourhood De Pijp! This tastefull apartment features a cozy living room and a fully equipped kitchen and a bar area with a large table for loveley dining.

The master bedroom and dining area both open onto a sunny garden.

Located on a quiet street, the apartment is just a few minutes’ walk from numerous cafés, restaurants, boutique shops, and supermarkets.

name: Cosy renovated apartment in Amsterdam West
description: Don’t miss out! Stay in the lively and central neighbourhood De Baarsjes in Amsterdam West. This renovated apartment gives a perfect balance between urban inner city life and nature. The city centre is only a 10-minute bike ride away and easily reachable with public transport. There are multiple bus/tram-stops (with a direct connection to the city centre) 1 minute walking distance from the apartment. If you want to have a break from vibrant Amsterdam,  the Rembrandtpark is your perfect getaway.

name: Cosy Apartment - 1 minute walk to the RAI
description: This centrally located apartment is tastefully decorated. Cozy open kitchen with a lounge sofa and relax chair. Renovated bathroom + toilet. Ground floor with its own door. Everything is within walking distance + good public transport connection. 2-minute walk to RAI Amsterdam

name: Central, spacious and near the park
description: The accommodation is located in a quiet street, it is only 8 minutes by tram (around the corner) to Museumplein. You have a living room, a bedroom with a 160x200 cm bed, a pantry, a bathroom with rain shower and a toilet, with complete privacy. There is a camping bed for a baby. Located in one of the nicest neighborhoods in Amsterdam, with lots of shops, cafes and restaurants and the Vondelpark around the corner.

name: Ruim familiehuis in Amsterdam Zuid
description:
A beautiful big sunny house with garden, located at the Top Location: Amsterdam Buitenveldert / Zuidas.

Only 15 minutes away from the center of Amsterdam with public transportation/bike/car.

This home is child-friendly, and NOT for party people but rather for those who are looking for a, comfortable, home-like and tranquil stay in Amsterdam.
It is clean, cozy, spacious, designed for comfortable living.

Close to the Amsterdamse Bos, Gelderlandplein shopping mall and big public playgrounds.

name: Amsterdam Family Home
description: Our cozy family home is perfectly located in the Centre of beautiful Amsterdam. It's right in the middle of what they say is the 'Quartier Latin' of Amsterdam, called 'De Pijp'. Full of shops, restaurants, bars and offcourse the famous Albertcuyp Market. It is also next to the Museum Square. Aside from all the great museums (Van Gogh and the RijksMuseum) there is also a nice playground for the kids. I'm sure you'll feel right at home in our lovely family house. You might not even want to leave.

name: Uniek twee verdiepingen appartement met tuin.
description: A spacious two storey apartment with a garden adjacent to a beautiful green courtyard garden. Amsterdam's largest park around the corner and 10 min. from the bustling center.

name: NEW: kamer in modern huis met ontbijt
description:
Relax and unwind when you return from the city. The house is equipped with every comfort, such as a large television with PlayStation 5, computer, gym and luxury bathroom. On sunny, warm days you can relax in our garden with a cup of fresh coffee. If you love cooking, our kitchen has all the comforts.

Please note: two very cute dogs also live in our house! Not suitable for allergies or fear of dogs.

Simple breakfast included.

name: Cosy apartment near city center and Vondelpark!
description: Welcome to Amsterdam! This 1 bedroom appartement is located in the beautiful and quiet old west of the city. With restaurants, bars and het Vondelpark around the corner, there is so much to enjoy! With only a 5 minute walk to the tram, you can stroll through Amsterdam for the perfect weekend getaway. My apartment gives you the real local feeling.

name: The westerpark apartment
description:
Steps from Westerpark, this centrally-located Amsterdam home puts your family right where life happens. Just one block away: one of the city’s best bakeries, great restaurants, ice cream, playgrounds, and nature walks. The city center is less than 10 minutes away; peaceful neighborhood feel with everything at your doorstep.
We’d love to welcome guests who’ll treat our home with the same care and love we do.

name: Amsterdam family home
description: This entire house, located on a green and quiet family-friendly street, is a fantastic base for exploring Amsterdam. The city center is nearby, as are the metro and train, yet it’s still calm. The garden is a great place to relax, and the house is fully equipped. We love living here with our two teenage children and two small dogs. There is one bedroom with a large double bed and two smaller children’s rooms with single beds. Smoking and parties are not allowed.

name: Vrolijk Amsterdams Appartement
description: From this centrally located apartment, everything is within easy reach. 5-minute walk to Wibautstraat metro station. 10-minute walk to the Amstel and Oosterpark, Tropenmuseum.

name: The Garden Pied-à-terre - Quiet [Superb location]
description: Welcome to our beautiful garden Pied-à-terre (with your own private entrance, bathroom, bedroom, and kitchenette) located in the heart of Amsterdam's city centre. This suite, located in a 17th century old weavery house is perfect for anyone looking for an unforgettable stay in one of Europe's most charming cities. The house was built in 1672 and restored and maintenaned throughout the centuries.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Moderne kleurrijke kamer met klein terras
description: Welcome to Boutique Hotel Buiksloterham in Amsterdam Noord! The neighborhood is fully developing, with special new construction and also the roughness of former industry and shipyards. We are practically on the IJ and not far from Amsterdam Central Station. Nearby, there is also plenty to find such as restaurants/cafes, Street Art Museum and This is Holland. It is easy to reach much in the city by bike. There are also public transport connections. Affordable parking spaces available. See our travel guide

name: Duplex Luxury Apartment Rooftop
description:
Luxury (170m2) canal apartment, 2 floors, beautiful view with roof terrace. Two bedrooms (king size beds) and A/C, roof terrace (BBQ), study (extra screen).

Walking distance: Amsterdam-South train station (10 min), NZ line metro (7 min), Beatrixpark (4 minutes), the RAI (5 min). Neighborhoods: De Pijp (7min) and South (4min).

The apartment features: Quooker, oven, oven, microwave, toaster, KitchenAid mixer, washing machine, dryer, freezer, hair dryer, iron, TV (Netflix etc.) and wifi.

name: Apartment +beautiful roofterrace
description:
The apartment is very well located, 5 min drive from central station. The big roofterrace with several lounge spots, BBQ and sun all day is very unique in Amsterdam. It’s at the 4th floor, so you need to use the stairs
The street offers several nice cafes and restaurants. The bedroom is at the backside of the house and is therefore really quiet.
The kingsize bed offers room for 3, but it’s also possible to sleep on a large inflatable bed.
The lovely Westerpark is just a 2 min walk from the house

name: Waterfront family villa with free parking
description: Our family home is spacious and bright and suitable for families, to whom we only rent it out. It is located on water where people also swim. The upper and lower gardens are separated by a fence, allowing children to play outside safely while you are, for example, cooking. In the summer months, use can be made of the paddle boards and life jackets. A 15-minute walk away, there is a beach with dining options. You can be in the center of Amsterdam in 15 minutes; the tram stops right in front of the door and runs every 10 minutes.

name: Spacious and characteristic loft with canal view
description:
Comfortable fully furnished loft/apartment with a mix of quality designer and vintage furniture, complemented with artworks from the painter who lived here for decades.

At the front side of the apartment you have a great canal view and at the backside a view on the quiet garden with a beautiful Magnolia tree.

Although very centrally located in a lively neighbourhood in the city center, the street and the house is quiet, which is highly appreciated by the owners, two architects, as well.

name: Moderne kleurrijke kamer vlakbij de rivier het IJ.
description: Welcome to Boutique Hotel Buiksloterham in Amsterdam Noord! The neighborhood is fully developing, with special new construction and also the roughness of former industry and shipyards. We are practically on the IJ and not far from Amsterdam Central Station. Nearby, there is also plenty to find such as restaurants/cafes, Street Art Museum and This is Holland. It is easy to reach much in the city by bike. There are also public transport connections. Affordable parking spaces available. See our travel guide

name: Great apartment in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to my lovable apartment, located at a very good spot of Amsterdam in a quiet and pleasant neighborhood ''de rijnbuurt''.

The appartement is easy to reach with public transport and is on the first floor and has his own entrance. My property is very nice renovated, has lots of daylight. The balcony is located on the south which means that you can sit in the sun from the noon until sunset goes down.

It has a lot of natural light. Very organized, clean and comfortable.

name: Familie huis Amsterdam
description:
House is rented only to families!!
Welcome to our beautiful house, a perfect combination of stylish renovation and modern luxury.
The interior is designed with high quality materials. With a total of 260 m2, there is more than enough living space.

The garden is a true paradise for children, with a trampoline where they can jump and play to their heart's content. While the kids are having fun.

Five bedrooms, each bedroom has air conditioning.

name: Sweet Room with Balcony near RAI amsterdam
description: you will get a private room in a shared apartment,( 1 person only sorry no couples)  please don't ask for discounts the price is up to date.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Light & open 2 bedroom family apartment
description:
Entire apartment for a family or a couple.

A bright and open family apartment overlooking trees, a tennis park and a playground. A peaceful and creative place to relax together, with or without children.

There is a south-facing balcony with a hammock.

Suitable for up to 4 guests.

name: Designer two-story home
description:
Our home has been decorated and styled with a lot of love and colors - located next to major city highlights, the trendy and lively neighborhood De Pijp and from Museumplein, where all the major museums can be spotted (Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh , Stedelijk and Moco Museum).
It can be reached from the airport by bus or metro , and its well connected to major tourist points by tram.
We have 3 bedrooms, a great living/dinning space and a cosy terrace.

name: Townhouse in central Amsterdam | For families
description:
Perfect for families, (not for groups) our serene 1880s townhouse is nestled in Amsterdam's heart, offering an authentic Dutch experience. Enjoy the company of our resident cat who occasionally needs feeding and letting in.

You'll be steps away from a nice fenced childrens playground (50m) and the city's top attractions: the Rijksmuseum (750m), Van Gogh Museum (1.2km), Heineken Experience (160m), and Albert Cuyp market (350m).

Discover Amsterdam from our cozy, conveniently located family home!

name: Spacious apartment near CS
description:
Spacious, very pleasant apartment in the lively district of north Amsterdam. Two bedrooms, both with a king bed and an option for a cod, or small (toddler) bed.
A lovely spacious bathroom with a bath and a separate rain shower, 2 toilets, small kitchen with all the equipment, large living area and a work space.

Even though the center of Amsterdam (and CS) is just 5 minutes away, the north has a lot to offer. It is one of the hippest, most vibrant parts of Amsterdam these days!

name: Renovated Modern Spacious 2-Bedroom Apartment
description:
This comfy, freshly renovated, 2-bedroom 85m² apartment is your perfect Amsterdam escape.

Cook a leisurely breakfast using the fully stacked kitchen. Unwind on the lovely terrace with a glass of wine after a day of exploring, then slip into the comfy living area for a relaxing movie night.

Nestled in a calm yet lively neighbourhood with charming shops and cafes, you'll enjoy the tranquil atmosphere, while still being just a 10-minute bike or tram ride away from Amsterdam's vibrant city centre.

name: Modern Apartment in De Pijp Amsterdam Centre
description: Bright and modern apartment in De Pijp, centrally located in Amsterdam. White minimalist interior with flowers and contemporary art. Cafés, restaurants, shops, markets and parks within walking distance. Public transport right outside.

name: Spacious apartment in Amsterdam-Noord!
description:
This stylish and spacious 2-bedroom apartment gives the perfect place to call home during your stay in Amsterdam. Surrounded by nature, open-plan living area is filled with natural light, creating a bright and inviting ambiance that gives you the opportunity to relax and escape the busy center of Amsterdam.

Bars / restaurants / musea:
This location is not more than 10 min away from Amsterdam-Centraal + Amsterdam-Noord currently possesses to the best restaurants and bars in Amsterdam.

name: Family home close to city park and museum district
description:
This centrally located apartment is tastefully decorated. Located in a quiet street, in the popular district "Oud-Zuid", a 2-minute walk from the Vondelpark, a 5-minute bike ride from the Museumplein (Rijksmuseum) and Leidseplein and 1 minute from a popular area with nice restaurants, supermarket, bar, tram. All around the corner, making this the perfect hang-out for a stay in Amsterdam.

Suitable for 4 adults or 2 adults & one or two children. There are 3 bedrooms!

name: 2BR Apartment | Safe & residential | Balcony
description:
This is a great apartment for your stay in Amsterdam!

Located in a residential, safe and family friendly neighborhood.

There's a big and bright living room, dining area with lots of natural light, a modern and fully equipped kitchen, two bedrooms, a modern bathroom, and a small balcony!

If you ask us, the ideal location to start exploring Amsterdam as it's located close to the city centre, but far enough to assure a good night rest...

name: Lovely apartment city center
description: Welcome to my lovely apartment in Amsterdam. It is perfectly located in the city center, yet in a relatively quiet residential area. Many city centre attractions are close by, with a large choice and variety of food and drinks hospitality just around the corner. The apartment has everything for a comfortable stay to experience the city. It has a big open plan living and kitchen area, with fantastic windows and light, with a view over one of the nicest canals in Amsterdam.

name: Ground floor apartment near city center
description: Welcome to your perfect holiday getaway! This fully renovated, cozy home in the heart of Amsterdam has everything you need for a relaxing and comfortable stay. With a spacious bedroom, a stylish modern bathroom, and a warm, open living space that includes a fully equipped kitchen, you’ll feel right at home from the moment you arrive. Plus, the private patio is just the spot for some outdoor relaxation. Book now and get ready to enjoy an unforgettable holiday!

name: Cozy apartment in 'De Pijp'!
description:
Welcome to my apartment in the heart of De Pijp! It's the perfect base to explore Amsterdam, with great cafés, restaurants and bars just around the corner. If you're looking for recommendations, I'm always happy to share some of my favorite local spots.

I hope you'll have a wonderful stay and enjoy the city as much as I do!

Please note that the balcony is currently unavailable for use - apologies for the inconvenience.

name: De Zwaluw
description:
An almost 100-year-old ship near the center of Amsterdam, colorfully decorated, with all the comforts, large outdoor space and with swimming water all around.
You can easily use the city from here, but also relax. A unique place in the city!

name: Light & authentic city villa with garden
description: Spacious house with lovely garden close to the Vondelpark and other key highlights. Family friendly home with 2 large bedrooms, rain-shower, bath, 2 home-office rooms and kitchen with many equipment: 2 ovens, dishwasher, large fridge, 6-pan cooking stove. WiFi, BBQ, washingmachine, iron etc available

name: Da Costakade 125-C
description: In a beautiful location right on the waterfront is this bright two/three-room apartment with terrace and balcony, spacious living room, a kitchen, a well-sized bedroom and a modern bathroom. The Da Costakade is a quiet but very centrally located canal between the Nassaukade and the Bilderdijkstraat.

name: Amsterdam family home & tropical garden
description:
In our centrally located family home in Amsterdam Noord, all the sights of Amsterdam are within easy reach!

A nice house with spacious, sunny garden, 5 minutes by bike from the hip NDSM yard with restaurants & bars and the ferry to the center of Amsterdam.

10 minutes cycling/driving to nature reserve Het Twiske, with beaches, hiking trails and cozy restaurants.

Enjoy Amsterdam and relax at the same time. :) Our house is suitable for two adults with up to three children.

name: Secret Garden Studio, private suite!
description:
Ready for ultimate relaxation in a city where there is always something to do?
In Amsterdam Noord, in the circular district of Buiksloterham, the new "place to be" of Amsterdam, you will find the studio, an oasis of peace for visitors to bustling Amsterdam.
The bright studio has its own entrance and is located on a small "Japanese" courtyard garden. When you open the sliding door, you are in the garden.
In the cozy quiet room, there is a queen-size bed. The bathroom and suite is also located on the courtyard.

name: Prachtig appartement Amsterdam
description: Discover Amsterdam in this modern and beautifully renovated apartment in the bustling Frederik Hendrikbuurt, just steps away from the lively Jordaan with its numerous cafes, shops and cultural hotspots. Enjoy the cozy living room, the fully equipped kitchen with all necessary appliances, and the comfortable bedroom overlooking a quiet courtyard garden. I look forward to welcoming you to my lovely cottage!

name: Freshly Renovated Gem: 2 person studio in the Pijp
description: Brand-new space in a charming building, equipped with everything you need to explore the city! The room is completely private, with its own shower, sink, and separate toilet. "De Pijp" is the perfect neighbourhood to discover Amsterdam. Everything is within walking distance, without the street's noise to disrupt your sleep. Thanks to the recent renovation, with everything in the apartment brand new, you'll sleep soundly and recharge, ready to explore the city with full energy during the day!
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Cozy Private Studio In Amsterdam
description:
Discover vibrant Amsterdam from this perfectly situated accommodation in the very heart of the city. Just steps away, you’ll find an abundance of charming restaurants, historic landmarks, fascinating museums, and picturesque canal cruises waiting to be explored.

Enjoy the comfort and convenience of having everything you need for an unforgettable stay right at your doorstep. Welcome to your ideal home base for experiencing the energy, culture, and charm of this lively and captivating city.

name: Eengezinswoning met tuin
description: Beautiful house for a couple who wants to discover Amsterdam. Plenty of space in a beautifully located place. Surrounded by water and within 15 minutes at central station!

name: Spacious but cosy stylish home in a bougie suburb
description:
We’re Emma and Adam, welcome to our home!

We live in De Pijp, a bougie neighbourhood away from the tourists, the best way to truly experience Amsterdam as a local.

We’re located right next to Safartipark, with tons of incredible restaurants nearby, from cosy local secrets, to trendy burger bars and Michelin starred restaurants, De Pijp has it all!

The Heineken museum is a 10 minute walk away, with a metro also a short walk which will take you to all the tourist attractions very quickly!

name: Nordic Design Riverfront Apartment with Views
Centraal gezellig gastenverblijf, 40 m2
description:
0363C68A 9144 40D5 4ECF
Our house has 3 floors. The guestplace (40 m2) is located on the 2nd floor and consists of: bedroom, living area, bathroom, kitchenette (so NO kitchen). We stay on the 3rd and 4th floor. When there are no guests, we use the space as a work space. So you have privacy. It is a 5-minute bike ride or a 15-minute walk to the center.

We like to welcome QUIET people who respect the place. Read the principles for a pleasant stay!

name: luxurious | private | spacious app. with garden
description:
Stylish 3-room flat with private garden in Amsterdam-West, near Erasmus Park.
Luxury bathroom with bathtub, modern kitchen and cosy living room with French doors to the garden.

Perfect for couples or small families (cot available) looking to unwind and enjoy the city in autumn colours.

Fast Wi-Fi, comfy bedroom, lovely neighbourhood – warm and peaceful stay guaranteed.

name: Cosy private room in Amsterdam
description:
My apartment is located in a calm and green neighbourhood very close to Vondelpark.

You'll stay in a cozy room with a private balcony which has everything you need to have a comfy stay. The room is furnished with a top notch mattress, fresh linens and a wardrobe.

I live in the apartment so you'll be sharing the common spaces with me.

You will also have full access to the shared bathroom which is tidy and clean and has a spacious shower.

Tea and coffee are always there :)

See you soon!

name: Newly Renovated Apartment with Terrace | Amsterdam
description: Discover the essence of modern comfort in our newly renovated Amsterdam North apartment. With a spacious bedroom, stylish double-sink bathroom, and a cozy fireplace, it's an oasis of relaxation. The airy kitchen space features a large dining table. The living area gives you seamless access to the rooftop terrace where you can have diner or relax. Complete with washer/dryer and optional parking, it's the perfect urban retreat. Experience Amsterdam North in style – book your stay today!

name: Luxury Wellness - Boat & Boost Amsterdam
description:
Discover a world of luxury and relaxation in Boost Amsterdam's Luxury Wellness Suite.

Spend the night in style on our unique Luxury Wellness Houseboat and experience the freedom of life on the bustling waters of Amsterdam. Wake up to breathtaking views and enjoy the serene tranquility the water offers while surrounding yourself with luxury and comfort.

Don't miss this unique experience and book your magical wellness stay at Boost on the water of Amsterdam today.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Modern space in trendy Oost
description: Enjoy a relaxed experience in a vibrant and diverse area of Amsterdam Oost. Located between two parks and just 5 minutes train ride from Amsterdam Central, this hip area has everything you need on your door step. Local eateries, unique breweries and contemporary cultural spaces are all within walking distance, a little off the tourists-busy streets of the city center.

name: Cosy spacious space, great access to all of city
description: Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space.

name: Apartment in Stadsdeel West
description: A bright apartment situated in the west side area of Amsterdam called 'de Baarsjes". Located remarkably close to the city centre; 5 min. by bike and 10 min. with public transport. The tram and bus stop is a 1 min. walk from the apartment. The apartment is just 10 minutes away from Vondelpark, and it also has its own green and rambling Rembrandtpark. The area is very much on the rise as an up-and-coming Amsterdam neighbourhood. Plenty shops, restaurants, bars, cinema and the famous Foodhallen.

name: Canal view home in the heart of Amsterdam
description:
Dive into a unique blend of sustainable comfort and historical charm with a panoramic canal view.

Perfect for families or business travelers, this stylish 3rd-floor space in a 4-story apartment offers everything you might need.

Nestled in the heart of the city, our house offers unparalleled convenience to explore all the iconic spots within 10-minute walk like the Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, Vondelpark, 9 Streets, Flower Market, Jordaan, De Pijp, and many more.

name: Beautiful rooftop apartment in city center
description: You will immediately feel at home in my cozy apartment in one of the trendiest areas of Amsterdam! This stylish, bright and cozy apartment is centrally located in the popular neighborhood Oud West, with a daily local market at your doorstep, and the canals, the Vondelpark, Jordaan, Van Gogh/Rijksmuseum, Anne Frank House and Leidseplein within walking distance. The area is very walkable, and with public transport and bike rental around the corner it’s the perfect location to explore the city.

name: 2 bed flat in heart of amsterdam
description: Our beautiful flat is located in a peaceful area of Amsterdam,  just a 5 minute walk from de Pijp. Beatrix park is right around the corner, and our garden gets sun until 4pm. There are two double bedrooms, an open plan kitchen and living room, a bathroom with a bath (rare for Amsterdam!), and a garden that gets sun until 4pm (perfect for morning coffee). The metro is just two minutes away, making it easy to get around town —and it's just 15 minutes door to door from Schiphol airport!

name: Casa Rodrigues
description: Welcome to our spectacular mansion in Amsterdam! This architectural gem has four floors, connected by a glass staircase and a unique wooden closet of 14 meters high. Enjoy a spacious 55m² roof terrace, a lovely 70m² garden, and a fully open kitchen. The luxurious living room has an 85 inch 4K TV. The master bedroom has a patio and bathtub overlooking park and water.  Just 12 minutes from downtown by tram. Book now for an unforgettable stay!

name: Modern and cozy apartment
description: This modern and centrally located apartment is the perfect retreat for two people seeking an unforgettable stay in Amsterdam! Nestled just steps away from the iconic Vondelpark, this stylish apartment promises both convenience and comfort, making it an ideal choice for your city trip.

name: Calm spot in the city
description:
Welcome to your peaceful spot in the city. A 1-minute walk from Vondelpark, 5 min walk from Leidseplein, this spacious 2-bedroom apartment is a great place to relax while you enjoy your time in the city. Featuring a large kitchen, a garden with a sitting area and a large balcony/deck, you will have everything you need to escape the crowds and spend some quality time.
- 1 large bedroom with a king bed
- 1 smaller bedroom with a double bed (140x200cm)
- cat not included :)

name: family home with roof terrace
description:
Our house has two bedrooms (four sleeping places), two small gardens and a beautiful roof terrace with sun from 12:00 noon to 10:00 pm.
The location is great: in a quiet neighborhood, on a charming church square where there is no traffic (great for children). 500 meters from the house is a beautiful park and a lake with a city beach and restaurants, a fitness center and a large (indoor and outdoor) swimming pool. In front of the door stops a streetcar that takes you to the center in 20 minutes.

name: Stylish Stay in Oud-West
description:
Wake up near the city center and enjoy your morning coffee on a private balcony in one of Amsterdam’s most loved neighborhoods (Oud-West).

Perfect for couples or remote workers looking for a stylish, central stay within walking distance of everything.

name: family house in Amsterdam
description: Modern furnished, new townhouse (>155m2) within the ring of Amsterdam, quiet child-friendly neighborhood, 3 minutes from the Noord/Zuidlijn. The neighborhood and the house are just 3 years old.  Available: living room, 6 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a front and back garden facing southwest with a pergola plus trampoline for the children. Space only suitable for families who want space and are close to the city and other access roads. For rent, 4 bedrooms are available for 5 people.

name: Sfeervol appartement met zonnig terras
description:
Our lovely apartment in the vibrant Oud-West neighborhood is the perfect location from which to discover Amsterdam. Great restaurants, shops, and the local market are all within walking distance.

The apartment is modern, comfortable, and fully equipped. Within 10 minutes, you can reach popular spots like the Nine Streets, the Rijksmuseum, and the Anne Frank House.

If your preferred dates aren’t available, feel free to send me a message — we’ll see what we can do!

name: Trendy appartement met balkon
description:
A beautiful, cozy and trendy apartment with balcony in the center of Amsterdam. The apartment is located in a quiet street and is surrounded by trendy coffee cafes and wine bars. The area is very safe and friendly.

It is only a 5-minute walk to get to Westerpark or Erasmuspark and public transport takes you to the canals or Amsterdam CS in 10 minutes.

There is sufficient parking space (incl. electric charging).

Day at the beach? You can reach Zandvoort in 30 minutes via Sloterdijk Station!
