It is a beautiful location with endless things to do and see, overlooking the Hermitage Museum and next to the Opera House. There are several museums in the area and Utrechtsestraat is very close by with a good baker, butcher and excellent confectioner to hip clothing stores and specialty shops.

name: Spacious, cozy and modern house
description: Spacious, light and comfortable apartment close distance to the city center, the vibrant NDSM area and green surroundings. Large rooms, style-fully decorated, child and grown up friendly. Perfect for a family, a couple or friends looking for a quiet place for holidays or work. Free parking in front of the house. The apartment is located in a very green area, surrounded by trees and water. It is part of a quiet multicultural neighborhood, with a supermarket and other shops at walking distance.

name: Appartement vlakbij de Amstel (2 slaapkamers)
description: Beautifully renovated apartment in bustling Amsterdam East. Walking distance to the Amstel, cafes, restaurants, the park and the zoo.

name: Modern apartment in peaceful neighbourhood
description:
Lovely, spacious appartement with private garden. It's located in a very nice, cozy neighbourhood in Amsterdam. There are supermarkets, restaurants and shops at walking distance. The heart of the city center is only a 10 minute bike ride away. It’s also easily accessible by public transport.

The appartement has a bedroom with a kingsize bed for 2 persons, an extra room with workplace, a full equipped kitchen and a luxury bathroom.

name: Apartment 90m2 w/ balcony & bathtub
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place. Walking distance to Westerkerk and 9-streets only 2,0km. Tram and bus connections to everywhere in town. The apartment is located in a family-friendly and social environment. Travelers with party intentions are therefore not welcome.

name: Authentic Amsterdam canal house
description: Our luminious home is located in the vibrant old area of Amsterdam on one of the iconic quays. It is based on the ground floor and souterrain and has a small private garden. The space is light and has an open kitchen that instantly makes you feel at home. The location is very central, a 5 min walk to the Vondelpark and  the Jordaan. The area is vibrant with many restaurants and coffee places. A perfect place to discover Amsterdam from your new quiet home! Feel free to shoot a message anytime :)

name: Spacious and bright apartment in De Pijp
description:
Spacious private apartment in the heart of Amsterdam’s most popular neighborhood: De Pijp. A neighborhood full of great restaurants and cafés. The apartment is fully equipped, including a rooftop terrace. The living room is bright and spacious. The kitchen is fully equipped. The bedroom has air conditioning.
Museumplein is just a 20-minute walk away. A 10-minute walk takes you right to the world-famous canals. The tram to and from Central Station stops at the end of the street.

name: Stadsappartement met balkon
description:
Welcome to our charming Airbnb room located in the heart of the Jordaan neighborhood in Amsterdam.

Around the corner is the famous Anne Frank House, you'll find yourself immersed in the rich cultural heritage of Amsterdam. The area is steeped in history, with picturesque canals and quaint streets waiting to be explored.

The tram station is located around the corner from the Airbnb. So there is quick and flexible access to the city center.

One of the highlights of this Airbnb is the balcony.

name: Kamer in het Hart van de Jordaan
description:
Welcome to our charming Airbnb room located in the heart of the Jordaan neighborhood in Amsterdam. The building is from 1884.

Situated just a stone's throw away from the famous Anne Frank House, you'll find yourself immersed in the rich cultural heritage of Amsterdam. The area is steeped in history, with picturesque canals and quaint streets waiting to be explored.

The tram station is located around the corner from the Airbnb. So there is quick and flexible access to the city center.

name: Cozy studio close to Johan Cruijff Arena!
description: Surrounded by views of the quiet street, this room is a sustainable homestay in Amsterdam, offering guests an environmentally friendly accommodation close to Johan Cruijff Arena. Among the facilities at this property are luggage storage space, free WiFi and a private bathroom, parking on-site, (low tarif 7€ - 24h), bed linen, and towels. Guests will be able to enjoy activities in and around Amsterdam, like cycling.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Dubbele bovenwoning Oud-Zuid
description: This double upstairs apartment (140m2) in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid has just been renovated and consists of two floors, the 2nd and 3rd floor with stairs. The house has 2 bedrooms, so ideal for couples or families. There is 1 bathroom!! (so not 2!). The 2nd bedroom has a lovely double bed and no more inflatable bed (!). The house is located behind the Concertgebouw, close to everything Amsterdam has to offer. At the back, there is a balcony on each floor.

name: Velvet Charm
description:
Brand new renovated, beautifully situated appartment. Suited for 2 guests in a very quiet street, but just around the corner the Westerpark with its culture, art, coffee places, restaurants and lots of happenings. The Jordan area and city centre with its canals are on walking distance (max 15 min). Several supermarkets, a bakery and restaurants are just 2 streets away.
Both tram and busstop are on a 3 minute walking distance, taking you to the city centre or Central Train Station in 10 min.

name: Historic canal-side apartment in Central Amsterdam
description: Two bedrooms, each with its own full-bathroom, Amsterdam canal apartment in a historic monument building dating back to the 1500's, enjoying breathtaking views over one of Amsterdam's oldest and most beautiful canals. The apartment is in Amsterdam's coolest, most interesting and vibrant neighbourhood and combines historic architecture and inspired design.

name: One bedroom apartment in Amsterdam-East
description: The appartment is a 1 min walk to trainstation Muiderpoort and the tram/bus stop that can take you to centrum within 10-15 min. Nearby there is the Javastraat with lots of little restaurants and shops, the dappermarkt with lots of fresh food and the Oosterpark with some nice bars.

name: Cozy apartment in De Pijp
description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

name: Historic designer house in the heart of AMS
description:
A concept apartment, on a quiet beautiful hidden street in central Amsterdam.

5 mins cycle from Central Station, the Zoo, Nemo, botanical gardens and the best outdoor swim spot in the city. Some of the most hyped restaurants, bars and cafes in Amsterdam are all within a very short walking distance.

The apartment has its own entrance and is split over 2 levels. it's a smart automated home, with high end appliances; 3 x ovens, coffee machine, dishwasher, washing machine.

name: Appartement met tuin op de begane grond
description: Retreat to a peaceful apartament: ideal for relaxing and/or exploring the city. The property is steps away from the city's grandest park & and trendy JP Heijestraat. Foodhallen is a 5-minute walk, Canal Belt, Jordaan, Museumplein & Vondelpark within a 10-minute walk. Also many public transport options within a few minutes' walk. On the corner of the street there is the possibility to rent bikes. Individuals, couples or families with children are welcome.

name: Peacefull house inc. separate office & own garden
description:
Quiet and peacefull appartment in vibrant Amsterdam East area, near Amsterdam Center. With seperate bedroom, office and kitchen / living aread. Big garden to relax. Perfect for couples or a work trip.

Amsterdam East has everything you need for shops, bars & restaurants (especially Javastraat). It is 15 mins by bike or 10 mins by public transport to the Amsterdam Center. There is tram stop 100 meters from the house that takes you to the center, Muiderpoort Station is a 5 mins walk.

name: Amsterdam oost Privat room
description: The appartment is located in the east side of Amsterdam. Its a nice area with a lot of shops, restaurants, bars, Park, outdoor swimming pool, Zoo and more... in 2024 the whole appartement was renovated with floor heatning and fishbone pfc.

name: Apartment in the heart of Amsterdam
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

name: Stylish Riverfront Apartment with Stunning Views
Sfeervol huis in hip Amsterdam Noord incl. fietsen
description: Feel at home in this stylish little artistic house in a village setting with lovely large garden. After the hustle and bustle of the city, you will enter an oasis of peace. Close to the ndsm shipyard and ferry to Amsterdam central station. 7 minutes cycling to the IJ. Two bicycles are at your disposal. 15-minute walk. Bus stop around the corner and 10 min to the CS. Shops are in walking distance. Walking distance from the bustling NDSM yard with restaurants, street art museum, regular live performances, etc.

name: Zonnig beneden huis met tuin
description: Our sunny and spacious apartment is perfect for a pleasant stay in Amsterdam. It is the ideal base for exploring the city as a couple or with a friend! In this place, you can escape the hustle and bustle of the city for a while, thanks to the unique combination of a spacious and bright apartment with a green garden. The apartment is in the heart of bustling Amsterdam East. The Oosterpark, Flevopark and many restaurants and bars and famous museums are just around the corner.

name: Unique & Spacious Ground Floor
description:
This beautiful apartment has an open kitchen, living and dining room which then backs onto a large bedroom with a patio and an office room with an additional outdoor space.

The entire apartment has a beautiful wooden floor and underfloor heating.

It is wonderful to stay in the quiet Laurierstraat with all the cosiness that the Jordaan has to offer a stone's throw away. Including the popular shopping area "De Negen Straatjes", the Prinsengracht, the Noordermarkt and the Westerkerk.

name: Luxury apartment near the Amstel
description:
Welcome to our newly renovated design apartment nestled in the charming Pijp neighborhood of Amsterdam, just a stone's throw away from the serene Amstel river. This space combines design and comfort to offer you a pleasant stay in one of the city's most loved areas.

Discover the vibrant Pijp neighborhood, known for its lively atmosphere, boutique shops, and cafes. The Amstel river, just a short stroll away, offers an idyllic setting for walks or bike rides.

name: Cozy traditional house in Amsterdam-North
description:
This cozy house in Amsterdam-Noord is fully equipped with a nice spacious bedroom, an office room with good home working facilities, a bathroom with bathtub, and front and back garden. It is located in a quiet neighborhood that is characterized by traditional Dutch houses from the thirties.

The house is 13 minutes biking from Central Station and 15 minutes walking to Noorderpark Metro Station. There are many nice restaurants, cafes and bakeries around.

name: Appartement centrum Amsterdam
description: Spacious and very recently renovated apartment in the center of Amsterdam with one bedroom with double bed, a study with desk and two balconies. Never had any noise disturbance. Further, the apartment is located near a tram and bus stop, so public transport is easily accesible.

name: Momo’s Deluxe Apartment - De Pijp Amsterdam
description:
Tastefully furnished apartment in De Pijp, the hippest neighborhood in Amsterdam. The neighborhood has many coffee shops, bars, cafes, restaurants and shops within walking distance. The city center is only 10 minutes away by bicycle.

There is a master bedroom with a double bed of 1.80 m. The second bedroom has two single beds. There is good WiFi, a fully equipped kitchen and a luxurious bathroom. Enjoy your breakfast or a nice cup of cappuccino in the sun on the balcony.

name: Luxurious two-story apartment with Rooftop
description: Welcome to a two-story apartment located in the heart of Amsterdam. It offers a cozy, modern, and comfortable base for your stay in the city.

name: Cozy Getaway in Historic Spaarndammerbuurt
description:
Welcome to our cozy two-floor apartment nestled in the well-known Spaarndammerbuurt, right next to the renowned 'Het Schip' museum. Enjoy green views from the living room and experience a tiny house feeling where we keep everything delightfully simple. Our home is conveniently close to Jordaan, Westerpark, and the city center, and it also features a tranquil green rooftop terrace.

This is our personal space, and we can't wait to share it with you.

name: Corner house | Rooftop Terrace | 2BED | 2BATH
description: Welcome to your urban oasis in the city of Amsterdam! This stunning apartment offers a luxurious and inviting space, complete with a private rooftop terrace that promises to elevate your stay to new heights.

name: Sfeervol appartement in Amsterdam-Oost
description:
Welcome to the bustling heart of Amsterdam-Oost. This warm stay at the Oosterpark offers the opportunity to retreat for peace and comfort while discovering this special city.

Found in the midst of Amsterdam pearls such as the Oosterpark, the Dappermarkt, the Tropenmuseum and the many pubs and restaurants. Trams run at a 1-minute walk that will take you to the rest of the city.

name: Newly designed apartement Amsterdam
description:
A private unit, with separate access. Newly renovated and located in the authentic westerpark district within walking distance of the famous Jordaan area and always lively Westerpark.
The flat includes a bedroom with double bed, separate bathroom, a full kitchen, living room with a sitting area and a cosy balcony. It is on the second floor, accessible by 2 authentic Amsterdam steep stairs. There is NO elevator.
Experience Amsterdam like a true local!

name: Appartement in Amsterdam-West
description:
2-bedroom apartment (90m2) in Amsterdam West right behind the Rembrandt park.

Close to Metrostation Postjesweg and highway entrance.

Tram and metro to city centre on 5 minute walk.

Easy to park in front of the house (paid).

Supermarkets on 5 minute walk.

name: Woning in Amsterdam noord met tuin
description:
Entire house in Amsterdam Noord, 1 minute walk from the Noorderpark and the Noorderpark swimming pool. Within 5 minutes by bike, you are on the ferry, or you can take the metro, which is a 15-minute walk away. This will take you to the center of Amsterdam in 20 minutes.

In addition, it is 7 minutes by bike from NDSM wharf, and there are nice restaurants and bars nearby. For nice tips, just send a message. Often, it is advisable to book in advance.

name: Prachtig, groot huis in het centrum van de stad
description: This stylish, very spacious house is unique because of its central location on the Vondelpark. It is most suitable for large families.

name: Urban Hideaway Amsterdam Weesperzijde area
description:
This centrally located apartment combines style, comfort, and convenience in vibrant Amsterdam East, near the city center, De Pijp, and the Amstel River.

The bright, renovated space features a warm interior, an open kitchen connected to the living and dining area, and a spacious southwest-facing balcony — perfect for relaxing after a day in the city.

Shops, cafés, restaurants, and public transport are all within walking distance, making it an ideal base to explore Amsterdam.

name: Double Room: Historic Building, Local Area
description:
• Room

• One king bed
• Climate-neutral & fully carbon offset

• Access to communal co-working, kitchen and lounge spaces
• Weekly housekeeping
• Local gym access included

name: Beautiful luxurious CANAL apartment Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our luxurious apartment in the heart of Amsterdam! This high-end gem offers you an unforgettable stay just 5 minutes away from both Amsterdam Central Station and Dam Square. Dive into the city's history, with iconic landmarks like the Anne Frank House and charming Jordaan neighbourhood nearby. This luxurious apartment offers not only a place to stay, but a gateway to immerse yourself in the city's beauty and charm. Your unforgettable journey starts here.

name: Lovely Apartment Amsterdam West
description:
This amazing apartment is located in one of the nicest event locations in Amsterdam. You will find a variety of restaurants and cafes, local breweries/bars, a petting zoo. You are guaranteed to enjoy your time here!

The apartment is comfortable for 2 people and can accommodate up to 4 people with the sofa bed in the living room, so you can recover after exploring the lively city.
Everything is easily accessible by bike or public transportation.

name: Ruim en licht appartement
description:
Beautiful bright apartment in the bustling Indische Buurt in Amsterdam East. Located near the Flevopark and the bustling Javastraat with cozy restaurants, coffee shops and stores.

The apartment has a spacious bedroom with a large double bed of 2.20m x 1.80m with access to the sunny balcony.

By public transportation, you can reach the historic city center of Amsterdam in 15 minutes and the arterial roads of Amsterdam in 5 minutes.

name: Happy Family Home Amsterdam
description: In this centrally located accommodation, everything for your family is within reach. Very spacious with 4 bedrooms each with a private bathroom, in addition to 3 separate toilets. Very spacious kitchen with all possibilities and garden. That in the middle of Amsterdam, within walking distance of the Van Gogh Museum and the Vondelpark, to name but a few.

name: Modern spacious apartment
description: This spacious, renovated accommodation is tastefully decorated and within walking distance of Amstel train station and Wibautstraat metro station. Quiet location with a park in front of the door. West-facing balcony with evening sun.

name: Double Ground Floor Apartment with Garden
Nice Room in center of Amsterdam
description: Enjoy easy access to everything from this perfectly located heart of the city

name: Bright Apartment 10m Vondelpark
description:
Experience Amsterdam at its finest in this apartment with dual balconies, premium minimalist furnishings, and an alluring blend of cozy and romantic lighting.

The interior seamlessly marries sleek design with intimate lighting, casting a soft glow on luxurious furniture.

The serene bedroom features a lavish queen-sized bed. Nestled in a lively neighborhood, this apartment encapsulates the essence of Amsterdam's allure.

name: Charming house close to the RAI station
description:
EXTENDED RENTAL POSSIBLE - Please contact for more details.

Spacious apartment in a peaceful, child-friendly neighborhood, located within walking distance of the hustle and bustle of the city and just a short walk from the RAI Convention Centre, multiple parks, cafe's and restaurants and various modes of public transportation.

Open to extended stays, please contact for more information.

name: Inn Het Nest - Apartment 1 - Double Room
description:
- Free Parking & Bikes Included -

Inn het Nest is a farm on the green outskirts of Amsterdam. The house was renovated in 2023 and features 4 new apartments.

Apartment 1 is for two people. It has a comfortable bedroom, bathroom, and fully equipped kitchen. In the garden is a picnic area.

Park right in front of the house. Two bikes are included; you'll reach the shops in 5 min' and the city center in 30 min'. Tram and bus stops are also nearby.

Smoking outside; marijuana prohibited.

Welcome!

name: Spacious, centrally located 2-bed apt with terrace
description: Enjoy a getaway in my peaceful, centrally located apartment. Normally I live here myself, but I’ll likely be traveling! With 2 floors, it’s a spacious and charming home. The bedrooms are generous in size and the modern bathroom offers a bathtub and large shower. The apartment is fully equipped and perfect for two couples who want to explore! On sunny days, the rooftop terrace is a wonderful spot. The living room is filled with light from the large windows and the kitchen has everything you need!

name: NEW: Design 3BR family house + Garden in Amsterdam
description:
We invite you to our home in Amsterdam! This bright, spacious house is located in a green area in Amsterdam. It is the ideal place to stay with the family and discover the city and the beautiful surroundings!

You'll be in the center of Amsterdam in 15 minutes!

You can make use of all the toys and games of our kids, play in the garden and use the trampoline, feel at home! We will provide you with lots of local tips for things to do.

Washing machine, dishwasher, wifi, all available.

name: Awesome Canal View App @ City Center
description: Experience timeless charm in our 1902 corner apartment, boasting high ceilings, vintage vitreous doors, and a midcentury modern design. Renovated last year, it offers an authentic taste of Amsterdam living. Gaze upon the serene canal view from your balcony while enjoying the heart of the city without the tourist crowds. Nestled in the coveted local neighborhood, bathed in natural light all day. Live like a local with easy access to iconic sights and a peaceful retreat from the city buzz.

name: Corner appartement in Oud-Zuid
description:
Discover Amsterdam from this beautiful corner apartment in Oud-Zuid.

With a spacious living room full of natural light, a comfortable bedroom, modern kitchen and a sunny balcony.

Enjoy the tranquility in the middle of Amsterdam in this stately neighborhood with coffee shops and proximity to the Vondelpark and Museumplein. Ideal for people and business travelers.

Smoking, pets and parties are not allowed.

name: Cozy Modern 1BDR Apt (70m2)
description: Welcome to our centrally located  Airbnb 1BDR Apt where minimalistic design meets timeless Dutch architecture. Our comfy living room boasts a 70-inch TV and Sonos home cinema for entertainment. The modern kitchen adds convenience to your stay. In the hip and vibrant De Baarsjes neighbourhood, unwind in a king-size bed, basking in natural light through large windows. Pamper yourself with a soothing bath after a long day exploring Amsterdam. Your chic urban retreat awaits★

name: Charming apartment with canal view
description:
Welcome to our charming apartment in the heart of Amsterdam! We are thrilled to offer you a comfortable and unique space that is just steps away from all the must-see museums and the picturesque Jordaan neighbourhood.

Our apartment boasts an incredible view over the canals, and you will have your own roof terrace to take it all in. With plenty of natural light streaming in from the windows reflecting on the high ceilings, you will feel right at home in this bright space.

name: Newly Renovated Peaceful Penthouse
description:
We offer an extraordinary experience of comfort and style in the most luxurious neighborhood of the city near the Vondelpark and 10 min from the city center.

This 180m2 residence is newly renovated and fully equiped with all amenities and thoughtfully designed for 2-3 couples or a small family.

Located on a wide and quiet residential street, one wouldn't expect such a gem when exiting the dedicated elevator.

This is the ideal place to relax, dine and enjoy after a full day out in the City.

name: Family house with sunny garden

Discover Amsterdam’s best neighborhood with our luxurious Airbnb. Enjoy restaurants and trendy bars, or take a 2min walk to Vondelpark. With tram, bus stops and bike rentals close by, exploring the city is easy. A perfect mix of luxury, authenticity, ideal for culture lovers, foodies+nature enthusiasts.

name: Appartement avec jardin
description: Located in the center of Amsterdam, this apartment with garden is quiet and you will be awakened by the birds! Close to museums (Nemo and Scheepvaartmuseum), train station and transport. Spacious apartment with a large glass facade.

name: Lovely Apartment Amsterdam Zuid with garden
description: This luxurious apartment of 75 m2 is located in "Amsterdam-Zuid". The apartment is full of comforts so you don't have to worry about anything during your stay. The apartment has a sunny spacious terrace and garden where you can retreat quietly and privately. From the apartment it is a 10 minute walk to "de Pijp" and a 10 minutes bike ride to the Museum district and city center.  Furthermore, the house can be reached easily by both car and public transportation.

name: Ground Floor 2 Bed Corner Home - Kids welcome!
description:
Welcome to our charming apartment in the vibrant De Baarjes neighborhood of Amsterdam!

Nestled in the heart of one of the city's trendiest districts, our cozy two-bedroom apartment offers a true taste of Amsterdam living. With its eclectic mix of cultures, buzzing streets, and picturesque canals, De Baarjes is the perfect backdrop for your Amsterdam adventure.

name: Nice apartment in De Pijp
description: TOP location in De Pijp! Very bright 2-room apartment (65m2), sunny south-facing balcony and separate storage room in the basement! This charming apartment is located in a fantastic location in the popular neighborhood De Pijp, within walking distance of, among others, the Ferdinand Bolstraat, Frans Halsstraat, Albert Cuyp market and the Museumplein.

name: Beautiful penthouse with rooftop near the Jordaan
description: Guests love our place, because it’s our actual home. This means it has character, feel homey and is fully equipped with everything you would have in your place. Perfect for a trip abroad!

name: boutique design apartment
description:
Enjoy our colourful, centrally located, 2-floor apartment in Amsterdam Noord. Situated 10 minutes from central station you'll find this oasis of peace and quite, while easily venturing to all areas of the city.

The area is up and coming with heaps of trendy bars and restaurants. Our waterside apartment is fully equipped and includes a big master bedroom, kids bedroom, working space and en-suite bathroom.

We've designed our place with a lot of love and eye for detail, we hope you'll enjoy it!

name: Fabulous flat in the heart of Amsterdam
description:
PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS ONLY SUITABLE FOR A COUPLE (no second bed or couch sleeping arrangements)

It can't be more central! Light modern spacious appartment with one bedroom and roof terrace. This amazing place is all you need to have great time in Amsterdam!
Please NOTE: Apartment located on 3d floor and as with most apartment buildings and houses in Central Amsterdam our building DOES NOT have an elevator.

THIS APARTMENT has one locked room, not for guests use

name: Big townhouse, perfect location!
description:
This great accommodation guarantees fun with the whole family. There is plenty available for a game night or to dine together. The rooms are spacious and stylishly furnished and equipped with every comfort.
If you want to go into the city, you can take the ferry to Amsterdam Central Station. Convenient for IBC at Rai. Amsterdam Noord has so much to offer, you don't have to go far to eat well or enrich yourself culturally.
In addition, the Noorderpark is around the corner, an oasis of greenery and tranquility!

name: Stylish and Large City Apartment
description:
We recently renovated our apartment and tried to give it a luxurious finish! It's on the 3rd floor with lots of natural light flowing into the apartment. The apartment has a fully equipped open kitchen with a dining room! It has a master bedroom. Fully equipped bathroom with a separate toilet

Within 10/15 min you have lots of shops, restaurants/ coffee bars/ bakeries, and a big supermarket.

Public transport is within 5 min walk and takes you to city center in 20 minutes.

name: Inn Het Nest - Apartment 2 - Family Room
description:
- Free Parking & Bikes Included -

Inn het Nest is a farmhouse on the green outskirts of Amsterdam. The house was completely renovated in 2023.

Apartment 2 is for 4 people. It has a cozy kitchen, bathroom, master bedroom with sitting area, and a second bedroom with a bunk bed. In the garden is a picnic area.

Park right in front of the house. With our free bikes, you reach the city center in 30 minutes. Tram and bus stops are also nearby. Haarlem and the beach are easily accessible.

Welcome!

name: Luxury family apartment | De Pijp | AC
description:
[NEWLY RENOVATED IN 2025]

Just steps from Museum Square and the lively Albert Cuyp Market, this elegant home is surrounded by the best cafés, restaurants, and boutiques Amsterdam has to offer. The perfect base for travellers seeking a luxurious and central stay.

name: Riverside retreat Amstelkade with view on Canal
description: Welcome to our waterfront apartment on Amstelkade. Enjoy stunning views of Amstelkanaal from this 1-bedroom gem. Luxurious bathroom, stylish living room with a modern kitchen. Explore De Rivierenbuurt and De Pijp's vibrant culture. Book now!

name: Cosy Canal Front Flat near Vondelpark - Oud West
description:
Newly renovated apartment on a peaceful canal-side street in the heart of Amsterdam close to Kinkerstraat the popular local shops street.

Located just a 20-minute walk to the city center and a 10-minute stroll to FoodHallen, Amsterdam's famous food market. The Rijksmuseum is only 25 minutes away on foot. Enjoy modern amenities, a bright and airy space, and easy access to public transport. Perfect for exploring the best of Amsterdam!

Perfect to rent a bike and explore each corner of the city!

name: Gezellige hoekwoning in kindvriendelijke wijk
description: Cozy corner home in a green, child-friendly neighborhood in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. Right in front of and next to the house is a lawn where children can play soccer or hang out. There are several playgrounds within walking distance. By bike you will be in the center of Amsterdam in 20 minutes, and there are several buses, trams and metros going that way. Preference is for families, but please note; there is a staircase but no stair gate. Our cat, Stitch, goes to a boarding house during rentals.

name: Cozy beige apartment  in Amsterdam - 2 bedrooms
description: Are you ready to experience the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience in the heart of Amsterdam's vibrant De Baarjes neighborhood? Look no further! This modern and cozy 2-bedroom apartment is waiting to become your home away from home. Whether you're a remote worker seeking a productive environment or a city explorer ready to uncover Amsterdam's hidden gems, this is the ideal spot for you.

Super bright, charming duplex, under the roof, with a sunny terrace.
Perfect for a family (couple with 1 or 2 kids).
Centrally located in the heart of Amsterdam, 20 mn walk/5 mn by bus from Centraal Station. 15 mn drive to the airport.

1 m from tram 5 terminus. Calm but convenient!

description: Spacious, bright and modernly furnished apartment in the city center of Amsterdam. Equipped with a fully equipped kitchen, neat bathroom and good insulation for optimal comfort. Ideal for both short and longer stays, with all the comforts within reach.

This cozy home is located in a unique location in Oud-West, in the middle of the most up-and-coming neighborhood of Amsterdam. The house is in one of the quiet streets behind the bustling "Ten Kate Market." Where you can get your fresh products every day. Amsterdam Oud-West is bustling with many coffee bars, lunch hotspots, restaurants and many pubs.

But not only that. You can cycle to the city center, museum quarter, Jordaan & to the Pijp within 10 minutes.

Perfect for a family or 4 adults.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam
description: Apartment in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid

name: Very central cosy apartment
description: Super nice and practically laid out two-room apartment in the heart of Amsterdam! The apartment is located around the corner from De Hallen in a popular part of Oud-West. The lively neighborhood offers a variety of shops, cafes, and restaurants. Just around the corner from the flat is the Filmhallen cinema, a library, and various specialty shops and supermarkets. Jordaan, Ten Katemarkt are a 5-min walk away and the Vondelpark is a 10-minute walk. Public transport is located in front of the door.

name: Gezellig en fijn appartement
description:
Nice and cozy apartment in Amsterdam East, all to yourself! The apartment is in a quiet area. Muiderpoort train station and Wibaut metro station are both 10
minutes walk. To the city center, it is a 30-minute walk. On Sundays, you can park for free in the street.
For a walk, you can reach the Oosterpark within 5 minutes.
It is a cozy apartment with everything you need for a good time in Amsterdam. There is also a large screen available if you would like to work.

name: Modern sunny family-house near centre
description: A new, architecturally built house that is a perfect temporary home for a family or a couple. The ground floor is an open sunny space with high ceilings and then a cozy garden with lots of flowers. We have four floors. On the loft is our chill spot, where you have a lively view of the dike and the Ringvaart. A living painting. Within a 7/10-minute walk, you will be at shops, restaurants and public transportation.

name: Stijlvol luxe appartement
description:
Step into our beautifully designed and spacious two-story apartment in the vibrant Oud-West neighborhood. Where natural light floods through large windows, offering picturesque canal views.
Start your day with a sunlit morning coffee on the terrace, and in the evening, unwind in the cozy living room, thoughtfully furnished with a TV and access to all your favorite streaming subscriptions. Our fully equipped kitchen is a delight, complete with modern amenities like a dishwasher and coffeemaker.

name: Luxe appartement in hartje Pijp
description: This centrally located luxury apartment is tastefully furnished and fully equipped.

name: Vondelpark View Oasis
description:
Welcome to our charming Airbnb nestled next to the Vondelpark, located just a 5min walk from all the major museums, our cozy apartment offers the perfect blend of convenience and tranquillity.
Step inside and be greeted by two spacious full size bedrooms, or step out on one of two beautiful balconies that perfectly follow the path of the sun. The apartment is bathed in natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. Relax on the plush sofa,or utilize a fully equipped kitchen.

name: Luxury penthouse Museumquarter
description:
We offer an extraordinary loft with comfort and style located in the Museumquarter, a luxurious neighborhood of the city near the Vondelpark and 10 min walk from the city center.

This 150m2 residence is renovated and fully equiped with all amenities and designed for 2 couples or a small family.

Located on a wide and quiet residential street, one wouldn't expect such a gem when exiting the dedicated elevator.

This is the ideal place to relax, dine and enjoy after a full day out in the City.

name: Bolo Corner apartment
description:
Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.
Corner apartment with over 100m2 of living space and a large balcony. Great location in Amsterdam just 15 min by bike to the city center, with trams and buses at your doorstep (20 min to Central Station or Rijksmuseum ). Nearby, you’ll find parks, trendy restaurants, bars, and grocery stores. Unwind with a 65 inch 4K TV, PS5 and Switch.

WHEELHOUSE EUPHRATE HOUSEBOAT is a B&B aboard the former cargo ship Euphrate.

This room measures 30 m². The B&B is cool, romantic, and adventurous all at once, with a beautiful view over the water. In the backyard, you can enjoy the sunset. Quiet location in Amsterdam-IJburg on the Markermeer, where you can enjoy swimming in the summer.

name: Spacious appartment + Central + Canal view
description:
My bright cozy home with large windows and mirrors overlooks the Singelgracht. The tram, bus and almost all the sights are nearby. The house has a lively front (street) with balcony. Here I drink my coffee and look out over the canal, the people on their bikes on their way to something. The balcony at the back is quiet, with a view of trees and afternoon sun until 7 p.m.
There is 1 queen size bed. 210x190

It is not allowed to host or entertain guests.

name: Spacious apartment with Rooftop
description: Discover urban living at its finest in this spacious apartment nestled right next to a park. Enjoy the tranquility of the outdoors close to the city center. The highlight is the private rooftop terrace. Whether you're sipping your morning coffee, sunbathing, or stargazing at night. The apartment itself boasts generous living spaces, modern amenities, and comfortable furnishings. Easy access to all the city has to offer. public transport is around the corner so you can move around easily

name: Appartement in de mooiste straat van A'dam-Oost
description:
Stylish classic apartment with the largest and most beautiful roof terrace in Amsterdam, located in a quiet and green neighborhood close to the city center.

The totally renovated apartment (80 m2) with new furniture is very comfortable. 2 balconies and a very large roof terrace (65 m2) with always sun provide an ultimate holiday feeling.

100 m from Park Frankendael with star restaurant de Kas and Merkelbach.

Walking distance from Muiderpoort and Amstel station, trams and buses towards central (within 100m).

name: Kelly's room Euphrate Houseboat
description:
Kelly's room is a B&B aboard the former cargo ship Euphrate. It was converted into a houseboat in 2023 and has a new B&B. This room measures 15m2 with a double queen bed and an en-suite bathroom.
The B&B is cool, romantic and adventurous at the same time. The room has typical ship windows with a beautiful view over the water. In the backyard, you can enjoy the sunset. Quiet location in Amsterdam Ijburg on the Markermeer, nice swimming in the summer.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Stylish Ground Floor Apartment
description:
Stylish and spacious ground floor apartment in the South of Amsterdam. The apartment is in a family friendly neighborhood, while situated right in between - and within walking distance of - Amsterdams buzzing touristic center as well as its business districts.

The apartment perfectly suits a couple or a family with one kid. It has a bedroom with a king size bed and a kids' bedroom with a bed for kids up to 3 years old. The house is surrounded by parks, playgrounds, restaurants and cafés.

name: Cute Amsterdam Apartment easy city access
description:
Discover your own piece of cuteness in the trendy Baarsjes neighborhood! Enjoy the two room apartment in a central location.

- Prime Location: Explore the vibrant Baarsjes district with its cool cafes, parks, and easy access to Amsterdam's top attractions.
- Sunny Balcony: Enjoy afternoons in the sun on your cute, private balcony.

name: Cosy 2-person apartment close to Oost/Pijp/Center
description:
Cozy apartment close to the nicest neighborhoods of Amsterdam. With 10 - 20 minutes of walking, you will be in the bustling Pijp, you can walk over the canals to the city center, or you will find yourself in one of the nice restaurants/pubs at the Oosterpark. The Oosterpark is a 4-minute walk, where you can enjoy a walk.

The apartment itself has plenty of light, which can be enjoyed especially in the spacious living room. The kitchen has everything needed to cook a good meal.

Welcome!

Quiet non-smoking apartment located in a monument street in the trendy De Baarsjes.
Bedroom comprises a comfy queen bed (foam mattress) & a work from home office area (wifi up to 100Mbps). Guests are welcome to use the balcony during their stay.
Located around the corner from a lively street with supermarkets, bakeries, bars, restaurants, gym and an outdoor/indoor swimming pool.
Trams and buses are within 5min walk taking you to any part of Amsterdam; lovely park 2min walk away from the flat.

name: Luxury City & beach Amsterdam IJBurg
description: Discover our unique accommodation, built in 2022, in the picturesque IJburg, Amsterdam! Perfect for groups of up to 4 people, with 2 bathrooms, a large living room and a modern kitchen. Enjoy the comfort of a brand new home, just a 3-minute walk from the beach and 17 minutes by tram to Amsterdam Central. Includes free parking for 1 car. The ideal place where city life and coastal charm meet!

name: Stijlvol familiehuis in Amsterdam
description:
Entire, stylish family home in quiet residential area with garden, within walking distance of the Vondelpark and 15 minutes by bike from downtown Amsterdam.
4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, large living room with multiple seating areas, fully equipped kitchen, garden and a play cellar
Good (paid) parking in front of the door and tram and bus within walking distance. The nearest station is Amsterdam Lelylaan Station (2 stops by tram).

name: Heerlijk appartement met riante tuin en lieve kat
description:
A spacious and newly renovated apartment on the ground floor with a backyard where you can relax after a day in the bustling city.

Enjoy not only the comfort, but also the company of our dear pussycat Marie. We ask our guests to take care of her during their stay with some food and hugs.

The tram stop in front of the door makes traveling to the city center (10 min) easy. You can also explore the hotspots of Amsterdam West on foot or by bike!

The Rooms had 2 (connected with stairs) double beds and terrace (completely private with a lock) .The bathroom/ toilet and kitchen is shared with a neat young man. Location: it is located in the center of Amsterdam, all populair places in Amsterdam are within walking distance from the house or even closer on the Amsterdam bike ;) +public transport in Amsterdam is perfect, especially the metro and tram are extremely near by!

Guests have a private kitchen, bathroom and living room with a beautiful view over the river Amstel. The kitchen is equipped with a coffee maker, toaster, oven, microwave and everything you need for extensive cooking. Perfect for a trip to Amsterdam!

Familie huis ouders +2 kinderen

Nice base with a small square in front of the door from the quiet Rivierenbuurt but close to the bustling Pijp. Close to the bakery, shops, playgrounds, cafes and bars. At home, it is quiet and uncluttered with a small garden to enjoy the evening sun.

I live there myself with two small children aged 4 and 8. There is 1 king size bed for the parents and a double bed in the children's room. The lower bed for the children is quite low, maybe that's not nice for everyone

• 2 bedrooms with seating areas

Beautiful fully equipped studio in the heart of Amsterdam. Close by the Jordaan and Leidse square. Balcony with morning sun and views over a canal.

Separated bed from the living room via a modern wall. A lot of daylight coming in.

Public transport in front of the studio to all areas in Amsterdam including the airport.

For 4 persons max. One separated 2-person bedroom, 1 separated study with 2-person guest bed, separate toilet, luxury bathroom with bath and separate shower. Large kitchen with cooking island, Quooker, Nespresso machine, dishwasher etc.

A top floor apartment (with an elevator!) with great views over a large canal and leafy streets. This apartment is modern, eclectic and very comfortable. With a large open plan living, dining and kitchen area decorated with art and sculpture.

We have just opened up our house for Airbnb in march 2024, looking forward to welcoming you!

Located in a vibrant yet peaceful neighborhood, you’ll be close to parks, cafes, and excellent public transport connections to explore the city with ease.

name: Apartment in Calm Neighbourhoud

3 minutes walking distance to the tram station.
6 minutes walking distance to the metro station.

The Vondelpark is a 10-minute walk away, and Dam Square is a 15-minute walk away. Cafes and restaurants are around the corner. Outside you can visit the hustle and bustle, nice terraces, museums and nightlife. At home and in the garden, the crowds pass you by, and you don't hear anything outside. This newly renovated cozy apartment is equipped with everything you need!

name: Gezellig & ruim appartement
description: This stylish accommodation is extremely suitable for a pleasant stay for one or more (max. 4) people in Amsterdam-Noord. This cozy studio offers everything you need for a comfortable stay in the city. With a double bed, a fully equipped kitchen, a modern bathroom with washing machine and beautiful windows that let in a lot of natural light, you will immediately feel at home.

This is a very spacious apartment with funky corners and lot of windows and light. Bathroom and toilet are modern and big. Kitchen is fully equipped and you can use anything you need.

Layout

Via the stairs to the basement, you come to two large separate bedrooms equipped with a 2* double bed with a luxurious bathroom.

Cosy 2 bedrooms flat with garden in the heart of Amsterdam West (Baarjes).
Close to canals and 3min walk to Kinkerstraat - 5 min bike from Jordaan.
Supermarkets, buses and trams 2min walk.
Lovely Vondelpark and Rembrantpark near by.
15min by bike/bus/tram from Centraal station and Sloterdijk station.
For coffee and pastries lovers, you will find Mundi, Ulmus (best croissant in town) and Fort Negen within 5min walk.

name: Beautiful sunny flat in De Pijp
description: Stylish and chic Amsterdam apartment located in de Pijp, the trendiest neighbourhood in Amsterdam. Located on a quiet and beautiful street, and only walking distance from the city centre and main cultural attractions.

The location in Amsterdam South ensures that you have all the amenities around the corner and are in the city center, while enjoying tranquility and fantastic views.

description: 'David's Roof Terrace Apartment' is within a stone throw of the well-known: Van Gogh Museum, Rijksmuseum, Albert Cuypmarkt, Vondelpark, Sarphatipark, Heineken Experience and many more. The modern and cozy space makes it great for couples and business travellers.

name: Helmers House

Stylish apartment with own garden & communal garden.

2 minutes walk from Jordaan, Amsterdam canals. In a very quiet street but very central location. Supermarkets, great restaurants all at walking distance.

Rest of Amsterdam is easily reached by tram or bus which both stop within <1 minute walk from the apartment. Train station is 25 mins walk or 10 minutes by bus.

Any questions or tips about the neighborhood or Amsterdam in general we will happily answer & help you!

name: Private spacy studio next to Center and Vondelpark

Within 5-10 min. walk to the Center, Foodcourt, Museum Quarter with van Gogh Museum, Concert Hall, Leidseplein. Plenty of cozy restaurants, café's, coffee shops and stores. The 1st apartment has three bedrooms, bathroom, separate toilet, full kitchen and comfortable living room.

The 2nd apartment has two bedrooms, bathroom, separate toilet, full kitchen and comfortable living room.

The location is unsurpassed, surrounded by bustling markets, restaurants and museums, and easy access to public transportation. Experience Amsterdam in style and comfort with us. Modern kitchen and bathroom including everything you need for a comfortable stay.

The RAI conference center is also just 5 minutes away.

Our tasteful, two floor apartment of 90m2 has its own entrance on the 2nd floor featuring a spacious living room with an open kitchen, a workspace, and a balcony.

name: Beautiful Amsterdam Center Apart - close to Pijp
description: Beautiful, stylish and quiet apartment located in the center of Amsterdam, just a stone’s throw away from Oosterpark and 15 minutes walk from the buzzy neighbourhood of the Pijp. The apartment consists of a fully equipped kitchen and cosy living and dining area with an in-built bar. There is also a bedroom with queen-sized bed and a study with standing desk and screen, ideal for remote working.

name: Geheel huis in Amsterdam Noord
description: In a quiet residential area, but close to all the beauty of Amsterdam, and many nice restaurants and bars. My renovated house has 3 floors. The ground floor is an open space with a living room and kitchen. The 1st floor has a double bedroom, and a bathroom with bath and shower. On the 2nd floor is another large double bedroom with shower. With the metro station a 5-minute walk away, you can be in the city center of Amsterdam within 2 minutes.

name: Moderne woning in centrum met zonnig tuin.
description:
This centrally located ground floor is tastefully decorated and easily accessible.
In one of the most popular neighborhoods in beautiful Amsterdam.
Walking distance to Westerpark and Jordaan.
By train, you can reach the beach in 40 minutes.
The cozy neighborhood offers a lot of possibilities, and you are close to everything for the sights of Amsterdam.

name: De Rivierenbuurt ruimte
description: Welcome to this beautiful apartment in the quiet and charming streets of the Rivierenbuurt, one of the most popular neighborhoods in Amsterdam. One of the great advantages of this location is its proximity to the RAI (Amsterdam RAI Exhibition and Convention Center) and the metro station. You are literally in the bustling center of Amsterdam in just 5 minutes. The apartment itself is tastefully decorated and offers all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay.

name: Spacious 1920s home with terrace
description: Enjoy your stay in Amsterdam in this bright, family-friendly apartment. Nestled in a leafy, peaceful neighborhood, yet just 15 minutes from Central Station, it offers the perfect balance between city buzz and local charm. Explore all the main attractions nearby, then come home to unwind and relax after a day of adventure.

name: Cozy & Bright 16m private studio near Vondelpark
description: Welcome to this private studio in Hoofddorpplein, featuring your own entrance to make your stay comfortable. It’s a pleasure to host guests and be part of their Amsterdam experience.

name: Bright & cozy Jordaan apartment
description: The apartment is located in the Jordaan, one of Amsterdam's most beloved neighbourhoods. The street is lively but quiet with cozy restaurants right outside your door and a Saturday market literally in front of the building. Dam Square and Central Station are just a 15-minute walk away, and museums, parks and canals are all within easy reach.

name: New - Modern light apartment next to iconic Amstel
description: Apartment is suitable for 4 persons and a great starting point for a visit to Amsterdam. Due to its location very suitable for a business stay. Central location with a side view of the iconic Skinny Bridge and near the atmospheric Utrechtsestraat.

name: Tiny room | cozy small windows
description: You will find the tiny cosy private room with shared toilet and bathroom in my apartment of a local (on the 4th floor) in one of the most upcoming neighbourhoods in Amsterdam. Note that this is not an hotel, but my personal house that I share. Please only book my place  when you are an easy going person. The street where my place is situated is quiet and at the end you will find the Erasmus park. Around the corner you will find a bus and tram stop and all the stores and bars necessary.

name: Stylish Top Floor Apartment
description:
In the western part of Amsterdam located conveniently close to all amenities but away from all the tourist noise you will find a stylish apartment (remodelled fully in 2021) with a New York Loft vibe.

The neighbourhood is mixed and has been home to eastern expats for decades, giving you a look into a different type of Amsterdam experience. Many local shops as well as supermarkets open late until 10pm.


*Key loss will be charged $50*
*No Pets Allowed*

name: The Barn with Hot Tub
description: Inspired by the traditional Dutch rural barns. This two story cabin (60m2)  has two master bedrooms with queen size beds, a stylish unique interior and a bathroom on the first floor. On the ground floor is the kitchen and a lounge with a wood-burning stove where you have plenty of space to relax. Large sliding glass doors give access to the private deck in the garden with lounge chairs. The Barn is the ideal place to enjoy together.

name: Studio Mokem Amsterdam
description: Enjoy my studio when I am not there. I have very friendly neighbours and we live in an appartement community.

name: Luxe loft met dakterras
description: This unique accommodation in the heart of Amsterdam has its own style. The apartment is somewhat like a luxury loft with a rooftop as an extra floor. The roof terrace offers 360-degree views of Amsterdam. Because of the many windows, it is light in the house all day, in winter and summer. Location in the heart of Amsterdam with many shops and restaurants nearby. In the apartment, you can enjoy an oasis of peace!

name: Bright Studio with view on the Canal
description:
Bright and cosy studio with view on the canal.
Recently built, so you can enjoy the comfort of a modern flat with independent heaters.
In the studio you will find wifi, a table and 2 chairs.
No Party, No Smoking and No Pets allowed.
There is a terrace but it currently CANNOT BE USED
5 min walk to supermarkets.
Short walking distance to bus 18, tram 1, 2, 17, Metro Heemstedestraat and Train/Metro Lelylaan (only 1 stop from Schiphol Airport).
Permit number: Z/25/2908809

name: Amsterdam West Top Floor Apart
description:
Perfectly situated in the vibrant area of Amsterdam West. Surrounded by hotspot bars and restaurants including the must visit “Food Hallen” directly behind and the street itself is one of Amsterdam’s most popular markets. Dam Square is just 5 tram stops from the apartment.

The space renovated early 2023 to a very high standard and provides access to all appliances and amenities you would need.

Once you leave the hustle and bustle of Amsterdam into the apartment, it is quiet and relaxing.

name: At the Amstel Beach
description: A little appartment where you sleep quietly but can reach the lively part of town with a few steps, with nice restaurants and cafes, and perfect connection to public transport.

name: Udoban stan u mirnom kraju.
description: The apartment is located in a quiet area, close to shopping and WTC business centa. The tram stop is a 3-minute walk away and the metro line is 7 minutes away. This ride takes you to the city center in 15 minutes. The metro station is also reached by train from Schiphol Airport in 10 minutes. For nature lovers and bike rides, there is a lake and an Amsterdam forest nearby. Enjoy.

name: B&B Hakuna Matata
description: Beautiful private studio above our beautiful dike house in Amsterdam.  In this private studio you will find all the comfort that you need for a visit in Amsterdam and around the city. It is located in the north area of Amsterdam. only 5 km van A'DAM Lookout, 8 km from Rembrandthuis en 8,1 km from Stopera. there is a nice view on the river and the small nature area at the back of the house and free WIFI.

name: Charming apartment for 2 to 3 ppl
description:
Cozy apartment, with balcony - 15 mins away from the city center.

Multiple tram/bus stops around as well if cycling isn't an option for you. Lots of restaurants, bars, shops and supermarkets in the neighborhood (walking distance).

name: Spacious, light and stylish appartment
description: Spacious, comfortable and super bright apartment in Amsterdam West. The perfect place, for vacation or remote work. The location makes the apartment extra attractive, close to Westerpark, the Jordaan and the city center can be reached in 5-10 minutes by bike. The apartment is in the quiet, safe and popular Staatsliedenbuurt, with nice restaurants, cafes and coffee/lunch places around the corner. We are happy to give you unique tips, so that you can get to know Amsterdam at its best!

name: Appartement 165 m2 roofterrace
description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.

name: Sunny Apartment with private garden
description:
A beautiful ground floor apartment with lots of natural light located in Amsterdam west.

The cozy and bright space is right next to the Jordaan and within walking distance of the Bilderdijkstraat, Erasmuspark and Westerpark.

It is in a quiet neighbourhood with lots of cafes, restaurants and bars.

Easy access to public transportation. Bus 80 & 18 Tram 3 & 5

Towels and bed linen are provided
And there is a TV which you can with Chromecast to stream series & movies

name: Unique Royal basement residence
description:
This unique basement residence is right in the city centre . Only 15 minutes walk from the central station. Right on the oldest canal from Amsterdam. This is we’re you want to stay to get the real Amsterdam vibe. With lots of bars restaurants museums and shops on walking distance. The place is brand new decorated with one off the most comfortable bed you can wish for
Although the residence is downstairs you still have a nice view on the street and the beautiful canal.

name: Characteristic apartment near Vondelpark
description: This stylish and spacious apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood in Amsterdam near the Vondelpark and Rembrandtpark, within 15 minutes from Amsterdam city center. The apartment has all the classic elements (stained glass, ornaments) and is fully equipped.

name: Whole house in the ‘Pijp’ with garden and rooftop
description: Unique House in the middle of the "Pijp" in Amsterdam. This complete house, with both a garden and a roof terras, two bedrooms, a large kitchen and trendy living room, will serve as the perfect spot to enjoy your stay in Amsterdam. Feel the fantastic atmosphere the "Pijp" has to offer with its cosy restaurants, bars and shops, or take a walk to one of the nearby cultural attractions, such as the Museumsquare, the Albert Cuyp, Amstel or the Amsterdam Canals.

name: Vondelpark newly renovated apartment
description:
Enjoy staying in a centrally located and stylish apartment.

Located on an iconic Amsterdam street just a few minutes walk from the Nine Streets shopping district, museum district and Vondelpark (Amsterdam's Central Park).

The apartment features a spacious open living area and kitchen and two bedrooms with double beds.

name: Apartment in the best location! Pets allowed
description:
Welcome to our comfy apartment right in the heart of the city. It's super close to cool places like Vondelpark and Leidseplein, but it's also tucked away from the noisy crowds. You can walk to Vondelpark in just 4 minutes, and Leidseplein is nearby too. There's a lively market called Ten Kate just 2 minutes away!
Our apartment has two big bedrooms, each with a comfy queen-sized bed.

We're happy to host families, no groups of friends. We want to keep things quiet and cozy for everyone.

name: House Boat Johanna Engelina
description: Experience a romantic overnight stay in the former crew quarters of our historic sailing ship Johanna Engelina. The room features a kitchenette, a sitting area and a private bathroom. Stay on this traditional Dutch sailing clipper from 1897.  In summer, we sail with guests through our unique nature reserves, but in the winter months, you can comfortably spend the night in the heart of Amsterdam.

name: Comfortabel huis met ruime tuin.
description:
We really enjoy living with our three children in this wonderful house in Amsterdam-Noord and hope you will enjoy it as much as we do!

Registration number: 0363 CC26 0DC1 0EB6 21C4

name: Spacious family home next to park & lake
description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.

name: Spacious and Tidy Apartment | Near Metro
description: This spacious and tidy apartment is located in the northern part of Amsterdam. It features a fully equipped kitchen, one bedroom, and a large modern bathroom. The apartment is conveniently situated near a shopping center with a supermarket and other charming shops. The Noord metro stop is within walking distance and takes only 2 metro stops to be within Amsterdam Central Station. Nestled in a tranquil area, this apartment offers both peace and a swift connection to the city center.

name: Vondel 99 suites (V)
description: Vondel 99, 2 beautiful suites in the hart of Amsterdam near Vondelpark, museum district and Leidseplein. Just a short 15-minute journey to the city center, you can savor the peace and natural beauty of this Amsterdam neighborhood while being conveniently close to the lively city atmosphere whenever you're in the mood.

name: Cozy and light appartment
description: Relax and unwind in this peaceful, stylish space, close to the city center of Amsterdam.

name: Modern, luxury apt in Amsterdam
description:
Modern apartment, centrally located in Amsterdam. Fully equipped kitchen, two showers/sinks and airconditioning in all rooms.
This two-room apartment is on the first floor. The street is filled with nice restaurants, bars, shops and supermarkets. Three minutes walking distance to vondelpark. Trams 2 minutes walking distance and will take you to Amsterdam's highlights. The apartment is really close to Leidse square (+- 1 km).

name: Large house next to Vondelpark
description:
This spacious & luxurious house is located next to the iconic Vondelpark, making it the perfect place for families who want to be close to all city's highlights. With 150sqr meters, this house offers plenty of room: two spacious bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, a large kitchen and cozy fireplace

But the real highlight of this house is its location. You'll be just a short walk away from some of Amsterdam's best restaurants, cafes & shops, as well as world-famous museums (e.g., Rijksmuseum)

name: Colorful apartment in AMS center
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

Welcome to our newly renovated Amsterdam oasis, right at Vondelpark's doorstep. This 45 sqm gem has it all – a funky kitchen, a sun-soaked living room, a cozy bedroom, and a snappy bathroom with a shower. It's modern, bright, and perfectly set for your Amsterdam stay. Ready for your awesome Amsterdam adventure?

name: Stylish apartment, centrally located in Amsterdam
description: Beautiful  ground-floor apartment. Located in the Rivierenbuurt, Amsterdam-Zuid. One sleeping room with a two-person bed (180 cm), a spacious living room with open kitchen, a stylish bathroom, separate toilet, a study room with a monitor and good WiFi, and a south-west facing garden. Close to metro, tram and train station Amsterdam Rai and Amstel. Relaxed, quiet and cheerful neighborhood. Several nice bars, restaurants and coffee places within walking distance. Kitchen utensils available.

name: Cozy apartment near Oosterpark
description:
Discover the charm of our serene, leafy, and sun-kissed apartment nestled in the vibrant Amsterdam East - just a stone's throw from Oosterpark. Pedal or tram your way to the city center in just 10 minutes and soak in the lively atmosphere!

You will be able to enjoy the whole house except for the storage room and the nursery.

The bedroom provides a queen bed so the apartment is better suited for a couple or one traveler.

name: Vibrant Modern Apartment, Conveniently Located
description:
Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space.

Located just near to the Amstel on the East side of Amsterdam, vibrant area with variety of things in close quarters: parks , canals, restaurants, cafes, easy access into the canal district or explore the eastern parts of the city.

Residential area amongst the Amsterdam residents . Right near to the metro stop Wibautstraat, making it easy access to Centraal station or Schiphol airport

name: Sleep_in Gallery
description:
Artistically styled ground-floor L shaped studio. Located in a quiet, safe area with public transport around the corner. The space has a personal and relaxed atmosphere, decorated with original artwork by the host. Ideal for those who want comfort, everything needed for a independent stay.met Bus 21 : Jordaan, het centrum en Centraal Station. Tram 19 : Museumplein, Vondelpark en Leidseplein. there is no TV, but good WiFi.
Art at your home, see here on Insta “artica4art”.

name: Cozy flat + bikes in Amsterdam
description:
We are renting out our little apartment while we are on vacation ourselves.

Our apartment is the perfect place to make yourself feel at home and to get an authentic idea about what it is like to live in Amsterdam.

To dive into the full experience, you are welcome to use our bikes when you are here! Alternatively, a tram station is right around the corner.

name: Studio in Amsterdam West
description: Immerse yourself in Amsterdam's trendiest locale with our cozy studio situated in the heart of Old West! This comfortable space offers a kitchenette and a private bathroom, providing the ideal retreat after exploring nearby gems like The 9 Streets, Jordaan, and picturesque canals – all just a few blocks away. Enjoy the simplicity and comfort of our studio, making it the perfect base for your Amsterdam adventure!

name: Stijlvol familieverblijf in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our recently renovated and cozy home, located in a quiet street where you can really relax. You will stay in the perfect place: just outside the hustle and bustle of the city center, but close enough to be in the heart of the city within 15 minutes by free ferry or metro.

Start your day with a cup of coffee in the sunny garden, enjoy the space and comfort of your own home, and park for free in front of the door.

Within walking distance is the beautiful nature reserve 't Twiske.

name: Live like a local! Charming apt
description: Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space. Feel at home in this trendy apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. 15 mins walk from the Anne Frank house and a 5-10 min walk to the Jordaan (canal area). Ground floor apartment in a local neighborhood with plenty of great restaurants and small cafes! This is my home I rent out whilst away so it will feel homey. I have a guest house where I sometimes stay. Arrangements can be discussed. Welcome to the coolest neighborhood in Amsterdam & my cozy home

name: Romantic dike-house | 15 min to central AMS
description:
Welcome to our charming 3-story Dikehouse, nestled in the historic and picturesque neighborhood of Nieuwendammerdijk in Amsterdam.

This spacious and inviting retreat is the perfect choice for travelers looking to enjoy the best of the city while having a peaceful haven to return to.

name: Luxury Apartment Museumplein with rooftop terrace
description: Newly renovated luxury and spacious Amsterdam apartment in the city center next to the Concertbuilding & Rijksmuseum, as well as walking distance from the Vondelpark and countless restaurants. The apartment includes breathtaking views from the bedroom, the large rooftop terrace, and charming balcony. Finally, a spa-like bathroom with bronzen tiles, and a kitchen with top-notch amenities, such as built-in wine climate closet and instant boiled water, all radiating luxury and comfort.

Well maintained and very bright apartment (95 sq m) in modern building, right in amsterdam city centre, close to metro and tram. Located in a quiet street but close to the hustle.

Bright and big living area with a balcony, kitchen equipped with dishwasher, proper stove with oven and fridge, large master bedroom, second bed room, bathroom with bath incl. a shower and washing machine. Separate toilet in the hallway. Balcony & communal garden on ground floor at the rear of the building.

name: Amsterdams Dijkhuis
description:
Feel welcome in our beautiful dijk-house from 1890. The 145m2 house has been completely renovated and embodies luxury, beauty, and coziness.

Located in a green populair area of Amsterdam. Easy access to the center via nearby ferry or metro. Kid-friendly accommodation. A perfect place to explore the city - and then come home to relax in front of the fireplace.

Close to NDSM area, with many restaurants and other attractions.

The house is suitable for families, two beds are children's beds.

name: Beautiful Central Rooftop Apt.
description:
This central gorgeous apartment is located on the top floor, with a stunning private rooftop terrace that offers one of the most unique views in the city overlooking a serene meeting-point of 5 canals.

You are on the doorstep of all the exciting sights of the city, while also having a peaceful and quiet location for a good night's sleep!

The iconic "9 streets" containing sights like the Anne Frank House are an easy 5min cycle.

name: Stunning View Zen House private place Ams center
description:
360 degree window and double balconies. Stunning views and natural lights to heal your energy.
Peaceful chic neighborhood surrounded by parks and rivers.
Shopping center stores cafes restaurants right around the corner.
10/10 transportation —trams, buses, metro and EVEN the train station—making exploration a breeze.
We are so lucky!

The Prinsen - Canal Apartment

Additionally, the apartment provides a conducive environment for those looking to work remotely. Your home away from home awaits!

description:
Typical Amsterdam apartment, 3rd floor, with big windows offering lots of natural light and a peaceful neighborhood ambiance while still being very close to the city center action. Close to public transport.

Stay in the heart of Amsterdam and enjoy a cosy home with plenty of space to relax. The apartment features several comfortable seating areas and a private 35m² rooftop terrace — perfect for sunny days and peaceful evenings.

Come and stay in this beautiful apartment and explore the beauty of Amsterdam from a truly unique perspective!

Completely stripped down and modernly built-up. Spacious & serene (>75 m-2) with direct access to city life.

Located in a quiet street in Oud-West, within walking distance of the Vondelpark, the Foodhallen and the Jordaan. Perfect for those looking for comfort, style and the real Amsterdam experience.

Enjoy the luxury kitchen. The apartment features two bedrooms with comfortable double beds. The bathroom is equipped with both a shower and a bath.

name: Charming Studio in Amsterdam

This charming and comfortable space is perfect for a single person or couple.

name: Private studio center Amsterdam
description:
Discover vibrant Amsterdam from this perfectly situated accommodation in the very heart of the city. Just steps away, you’ll find an abundance of charming restaurants, historic landmarks, fascinating museums, and picturesque canal cruises waiting to be explored.

Enjoy the comfort and convenience of having everything you need for an unforgettable stay right at your doorstep. Welcome to your ideal home base for experiencing the energy, culture, and charm of this lively and captivating city.

name: Canal View Apartment in Oud West
description:
Enjoy a very stylish apartment in a prime location on a wide canal in Oud West.

Lively neighborhood offers a variety of shops, cafes and cozy restaurants. The Jordaan is a 5-min and the Vondelpark is 10-min walk away. Public transport is located nearby and offers direct connections to Central Station.

The living room offers canal view and is connected with an open kitchen and a balcony at the rear. Bedroom is stylish and comfy, while bathroom and toilets are recently renovated.located place.

name: Beautiful and spacious family apartment
description: Relax and make yourself at home in this spacious, serene family apartment in Amsterdam West. The open-plan living space is filled with natural light from both sides. A fully equipped kitchen has everything you need. Ideal for families - we have a baby or toddler bed, high chair, stair gates, baby bath, and plenty of toys. The master bedroom opens to a sunny patio. A separate bathroom and toilet, office, and washer/dryer complete the apartment, with a private rooftop offering panoramic views.

name: Hidden Gem Studio in De Jordaan
description:
Hidden Gem on Quiet Bloemstraat: Charm & Convenience in Amsterdam!

Seek refuge on the peaceful Bloemstraat in the middle of the Jordaan area, home to Amsterdam's oldest cafe, and yet steps away from the city's vibrant heart! Like the 9 streets for shopping and Anne Frank house on a stone throw away. This charming studio offers a unique blend of quiet charm and convenient access to all Amsterdam has to offer.

name: Appartement Oosterpark
description: This apartment is wonderfully centrally located and yet you can leave the hustle and bustle of the city behind you. The beautiful Oosterparkbuurt is green and has many nice coffee shops and stores. You can reach the canal belt within 10 minutes. Perfect for couples or solo travelers who want to enjoy the city. After a long day walking through the city, you can relax in the bath. I like to share my favorite places and restaurants in the city!

name: Perfectly located & pretty loft
description: This lovely, sunny townhouse is located in the Jordaan, in the heart of Amsterdam. Right in the city center, yet wonderfully quiet. Located on the Elandsgracht, named Amsterdam's most popular shopping street, with the best of the city just around the corner. Within walking distance of the Rijksmuseum (you even have a view of it from here!), Dam Square, and Amsterdam Central Station. The sleeping accommodations consist of a queen-sized bed, a spacious sofa bed, and a single bed in the loft. There's even a record player for enthusiasts :)

name: Luxury water-side flat in the Canal District
description:
Luxurious, fully equipped, 106m2 1st - floor apartment located in the Canal District and pinned to the famous 9 Streets.
Stunning views onto the best canal in Amsterdam. You have access to all the central and Jordaan shops & restaurants as well walking distance to the Anne Frank House.
Separate bedroom and bathroom with access to canal views by being very Dutch and sitting in the windows to enjoy the world pass by. Enjoy this sort-after famous interior-styled property.

name: Havenlodge 4 persoons Amsterdam
description: These comfortable and unique accommodations are located at the back of the marina, between the boats, making it a beautiful place. In about 15 minutes, you are in the center of Amsterdam by public transport.

name: Gezellig appartement in West (loopafstand Jordaan)
description:
This unique apartment is located in a quiet and child-friendly neighborhood in the western part of Amsterdam (Staatsliedenbuurt). The Jordaan and Westerpark are within walking distance. In addition, everything can be reached easily by public transportation.
The apartment has been very recently renovated and has a cozy, warm look, and as a cherry on top, it has a very spacious garden with lounge set. This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

name: Beloved Lindengracht Duplex
description: Our recently renovated duplex is situated in the beautiful neighborhood of the Jordaan, in the center of Amsterdam. It is one of the three architecturally famous and commonly photographed 'De Drie Linden' homes. Ours is located next door to one of the Jordaan's unique and beautiful 'hofjes' or internal gardens. We are extremely fortunate to have high ceilings and a private garden, all situated on the famous Lindengracht, which hosts the renowned, lively Saturday market.

name: Gastenverblijf de Volgermeer
description: On the edge of the village of Broek in Waterland is this nice, modern furnished cottage. The guest house is surrounded by meadows and adjacent to the Volgermeerpolder nature reserve: the ideal starting point for beautiful hiking and cycling trips through Waterland/Great Amsterdam. When you return to the cottage, you can enjoy the panoramic views and the most fantastic, colored sunsets both indoors and outdoors.

name: Cozy & spacious living room and kitchen apartment
description: A beautiful 4-person apartment in the centre of Amsterdam, in a calm, but lively neighborhood. With two double beds and a sofa bed when needed, a nice modern kitchen with a stove, microwave and a varation of spices. The apartment is within walking distance from public transport, the Pijp and multiple cafes. Inside the house there are various forms of entertainment present such: as boardgames, a tv with chromecast and a dartboard.

name: Cosy | Hidden | Private apartment near Dam Square
description:
Indulge in Amsterdam's charm at this cosy studio near Dam Square. Original features like exposed beams and characteristic windows create an inviting ambiance, marrying historic allure with modern convenience.

The compact kitchenette (no cooking stove!), cleverly arranged, offers a seamless culinary experience. Adjacent, the small bathroom maximizes space without sacrificing comfort, providing a private retreat with a well-appointed shower, toilet, and sink.

name: Cosy | Authentic | Private Gem @ Dam Square

The house has a perfect atmosphere, a real homely feeling with beautiful art and sculptures made by our friends and family. It is a cornerhouse with an unique wide view.

Cozy neighborhood with nice shops, cafes and terraces. Fantastic bakery/café down the street and a brewery with local beers opposite of the house.

If you like comfort, this is the place you want to be...€2850/month all incl. 1 year. A luxurious apartment with a delightful balcony, conveniently located near a shopping street and just a 5-minute bike ride to the picturesque canals.

The kitchen is fully equipped with plates, cutterly, glasses, pans, etc, WiFi, great shower, airco🤩

5 bike-minutes to the canals, 5 walking minutes to supermarkets, shops, public transportation.

The pictures speak louder than words... it's simply wonderful.

name: Modern ground floor flat with garden & 1 bedroom
description: Cozy and modern (59m2) flat located only 5 minutes by bike from Amsterdam central. Enjoy a coffee on the bench in front of the house or enjoy the sun in the very spacious garden (59m2). Bathroom with toilet, a lovely kitchen/dinning area and a cozy living room area.

just get away from it all in this soothing, centrally located accommodation.

This houseboat is a warm and dreamy getaway near the city center of Amsterdam.

You can expect a beautiful garden in the spring and summer to relax and bbq. We have two cats and a few chickens (Please note: we will ask you to feed them!)

The apartment features a spacious garden with all-day sun, ideal for relaxing and enjoying the sunshine. Enjoy the lively area with entertainment, restaurants, and the nearby RAI. We look forward to your stay and are happy to provide tips.

Enjoy your time, and live responsibly :)

In the middle of the vivid neighbourhood 'Oud-West' with all kind of nice restaurants, supermarkets and the famous Vondelpark at 500 meters!
Within 5 minutes cycling or 10 minutes walk (or public transport) to the bubbly Leidseplein and culturally Museumplein.

Luxury apartment in Ground Floor, with 1 bedroom with a king bed, 1 sofa bed, 1 office and a garden with lounge

Immerse yourself in the city's history with our extensive library, featuring volumes on Amsterdam's past and the works of philosopher Spinoza. Enjoy the well-equipped kitchen, and unwind in your private bathroom with a refreshing shower. Your Amsterdam adventure begins here!

Mi casa es su casa!

Behind our house is a parking lot of a business park where you can park your car for free. We have two cats in and around the house, and three chickens in the front yard.

Enjoy the breathtaking city views from our double rooms apartment, with free WiFi and parquet floors, equipped with flat-screen TVs, safe, bed linen and towels. Smoking outside; marijuana prohibited.

Welcome!

Discover Amsterdam from our home!
