Apartment is quiet inside. No noise pollution.

You have your own wheelhouse, bedroom with large bed, bathroom and pantry where you can make a nice cup of coffee/tea or pour a glass of wine. Take a seat in the wheelhouse or on the terrace and enjoy your day!

5 rooms, 4 beds (1x 2p, 3 x 1p). Our house is located in a quiet green neighborhood, with shops around the corner. You can park for free in front of the door. A fifteen-minute ferry ride takes you to the center of Amsterdam.

description: Welcome to our stylish family home! Whether you stay here to enjoy the garden, cook a family meal or play in the kids’ rooms or wander out to explore the Vondelpark, Museum Quarter or city centre - our home is the base you need for a wonderful stay in Amsterdam. We live in a family oriented neighborhood with many playgrounds but at the same time just a stones’ throw away from the action and high quality restaurants. Have a look at the pictures and feel free to ask us any questions!

name: Bright apartment

description:
Hi, from time to time i rent 1 room (10 square menter) in in my apartment located in the 'Leidseplein' area.
The museums are at walking distance and my house is located right next to the canals.
The bathroom is shared, there is no kitchen available and pets are not allowed.
Please note that i live in the apartment too with my family, so is very important that you are mindful and respectful of others.

description:
Enjoy a real Amsterdam experience in the heart of the Jordaan. This sun-drenched corner apartment of 38m2 is close to action but on a quiet street where you feel a world away from the busy center. Only a 400m walk to Anne Frank house and historical canals, 15 minutes walk to Dam Square and a multitude of great bars and restaurants within meters.

With one good sized double bedroom and large bathroom that are separate from the open living space, this house is either ideal for long or short stays.

name: Livia's Hideaway Canalbelt
description: Step into this beautiful one-bedroom apartment, which overlooks a delightful square in Amsterdam's famous Canal Belt. With its panoramic views of the Prinsengracht, one of the most charming spots in the heart of Amsterdam, this accommodation promises an unforgettable experience for your Amsterdam adventure. Enjoy the quaint balcony, perfect for relaxing moments. And don't forget the lovely town square just outside, ideal for soaking up the warm summer sun.

name: Fantastische villa met grote tuin
description:
This dream house is our private home where we are happy to welcome you. Located in one of the historic neighborhoods in Amsterdam-Noord. The house offers a lively city atmosphere with a picturesque village feel. Ideal for a couple or a family of four. Parking is free in the private driveway and public transport is around the corner.

The house is spacious, bright and welcoming with four bedrooms and two bathrooms. The large backyard is sunny and immediately gives you a holiday feeling when you eat or play in the greenery.

name: Casa Delea Attica -Luxury loft in De Pijp
description:
Casa Delea Attica (@CasaDelea) is a new, luxurious loft apartment, stylishly furnished with a spacious kitchen, bedroom with marble shower and washbasin, a double box spring bed and a separate toilet. The living area has a double sofa bed.

Casa Delea Attica (4p) and Casa Delea Cantina (2p) are located in the vibrant De Pijp district, the Quartier Latin of Amsterdam, nearby restaurants, cafés, shops, and public transport. We are happy to provide insider tips for a unique Amsterdam experience.

Spacious & bright apartment in Amsterdam.
Solar powered! Free parking included on demand (excl. summer).

Location (East)
- Quiet street, 5 mins walk max to all commodities (many tram & bus lines, supermarket, park...)
- Direct tram for the center (20 min)
- Great bars, coffee places and restaurants (we leave our tips guide)

- 1 parental bedroom
- 1 separate attic double bed (140x200)
- Big bathroom with shower + tub
- Very bright (that is rare in Amsterdam)
- Spacious living room

name: Cosy & spacious loft in Amsterdam
description:
My loft is very suitable for a group of friends or family to visit Amsterdam.

The location is pretty nearby the Amsterdam Central Station. Via public transports in the neighborhood you will arrive in 10 minutes in the center of Amsterdam or try the 24-hours free ferry (20 minuts walk from the loft).

Within 10 minutes walking you will find a shopping area with supermarkets and different kind of coffee shops and restaurants for lunch and diner.

Bedsheets and towels are included.

The house is furnished with all typical Amsterdam attributes, such as Heineken works of art that can be purchased 5 minutes away at the Heineken brewery. It is a 1-minute walk to Leidseplein and Rijksmuseum. The best time to visit Amsterdam is around Christmas the Canals in front of the house will be christmas Themed with stunning lights and trees every where, just like in the movies.

Indulge in the charm of our newly renovated canal suite nestled in the souterrain of a historic canal house in the renowned 9 Streets area.

Boasting its own street-level entrance, this luxurious retreat provides all the comforts you need for a delightful stay in Amsterdam.

Explore the city's highlights with ease, as charming shops, exquisite restaurants, and museums await just a stroll away from your doorstep.

description:
Discover the city from my lovely houseboat in Amsterdam-Noord! The place comfortably accommodates two guests and has all the amenities you need for a wonderful stay.

The houseboat is fully at your disposal. The kitchen is fully equipped. The bathroom has a shower, toilet and washing machine.

Discover Amsterdam Noord, with the NDSM Wharf, markets, trendy cafes, and cultural hotspots all within walking distance. The free ferry to the city center is a 10-minute walk away.

name: Spacious wooden apartment - Amsterdam
description:
Our unique place, located in a quiet street, is a wooden corner house, which radiates warmth and coziness. The spacious and light apartment has a balcony facing the South.

The city centre is a 15 min bike ride away, and there is a good bus and metro connection. A free ferry to Central Station is at walking distance from NDSM Wharf, the creative heart of North, with street art, restaurants and cafés.

The place comes with a friendly cat, who can walk in and out of the apartment when it pleases.

name: Beautiful appartment in Plantage
description: From this ideal home, you have beautiful views of the Kadijksplein, Entrepotdok, the National Maritime Museum and the Scharrebiersluis. The Schippersgracht owes its name to the fact that many skippers used to live here. A very popular location in Amsterdam. This charming house consists of a ground floor and a basement and has a lovely terrace at the back. The house has 4 (bed)rooms and a beautiful view over the water of the Schippersgracht. Ground floor!

name: Artful Penthouse studio with sunset
description:
In the middle of the Baarsjes, an oasis of light and tranquility on the top (4th) floor. View over the Amsterdam houses, with beautiful skies, sunset and bird shows! Compact and stylish. With an outdoor space of 15 m2, a balcony on the south-west: afternoon and evening sun! Plus another small balcony facing east, with sunrise.

There is no elevator available. So just climb up but wonderful views!

The kitchen has everything you need to cook extensively and dine together.

name: Beautiful Garden Home
description:
Beautiful garden home located in vibrant Amsterdam East! Typical old Dutch house in a classic Amsterdam style road. The ground floor apartment is 60sqm and offers all the amenities you need, including a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable living area, dedicated office with external monitors, high-speed Wi-Fi, a very comfortable queen size bed bedroom, a small bathroom and a large private garden for you to enjoy.

You’ll love my place because of the neighbourhood, ambience and accessibility.

name: Spacious apartment with private, tranquil garden
description: Relax in our spacious and serene garden flat. A short cycle to the centre of Amsterdam and a short walk to the bustling neighbourhoods of Zeeburg and Brazalie in East Amsterdam.

name: Bohemian stijl gezinswoning
description: Welcome to our unique and charming home on the most beautiful square in Amsterdam. Our house owes its character to its year of construction, 1889, and its warmth and coziness to the contemporary layout and Bohemian interior. Located in the bustling center of Amsterdam but in a quiet area near the green Oosterpark, our 100m2 house with 3 bedrooms is the ideal place for a family with 2/3 children. Lots of light, underfloor heating and fireplace make our cozy house a real pleasure.

name: Spacious & Calm Atelier in BoLo
description:
Spacious room for two in a modern Amsterdam apartment (shared with host). Your private room offers a relaxed double bed, workspace, storage drawers, mirror, books, and artwork.

Enjoy natural light, views via the large glass panel, and fresh air from the window.

Located on the third floor with elevator access, it's next to the metro/bus/tram stop with direct Central Station connections. Walk 5 mins to BoLo Center (cafes/shops) and 10 mins to Erasmus Park for calm walks.

name: Stunning villa with heated pool
description:
Have fun with the whole family at our stylish home, only a 15 minute bike ride to the city center, as well as a stone skip away to the countryside.

Our home is a beautifully decorated detached house in a quiet residential area, not far from the city center but still away from the crowds. Ideal for families with children who want to dip in and out of the city but have a more quiet base.

The house has a big garden, with a heated swimming pool (April/May - October) as well as a sauna.

name: Spacious & Modern 3BR Apartment @ Oud-West
description: Welcome to our spacious and modern apartment in Amsterdam Oud-West, ideally located near the city center with excellent public transport connections. Situated on a corner just steps from a tram stop, the apartment is bright and easily accessible. The apartment features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 3 toilets, and 3 private terraces. The neighborhood is lively yet charming, filled with great cafés, restaurants, and local shops. Ideal for families, couples, and cultural visitors. No party-goers.

description:
Discover the allure of Amsterdam from this charming 66 square meter apartment nestled in the vibrant neighborhood of Staadliedsburt. Located just one block away from the picturesque Westerpark, you can enjoy easy access to cafes, restaurants, and bars.

Enjoy a complete with a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable bedroom, and a terrace & balcony. With excellent transport links, including nearby tram lines, exploring the city and beyond is a breeze.

name: Charming, Renovated Apartment near Vondelpark
description: Experience the charm and comfort of my recently renovated apartment. Ideal for couples, solo travellers, or business visitors.

name: Hotel Espresso Amsterdam City Centre, Small Dou...
Aparthotel North, Spacious Suite for 6 Guests
description:
Discover Aparthotel North, steps from Adam Tower in vibrant Amsterdam. Strategically located, just 2.1 km from A'DAM Lookout and 5 km from Rembrandt House. Explore landmarks like Basilica of St. Nicholas, Dam Square, and Museum Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder, all within 7 km.

Unwind in modern comfort with amenities like flat-screen TV, microwave, kettle, and coffee maker. Immerse yourself in the city's charm in our smoke-free units. Book now for an unforgettable Amsterdam experience!

name: Gezellig huisje naast Erasmuspark
description: Lovely cottage in Amsterdam West, next to the Erasmus Park. The house has all the comforts, from a living room with a comfortable sofa and dining area to a lovely bedroom with a wonderful bed and an en-suite bathroom (don't worry, the toilet is separate). And, of course, a kitchen with all the essentials, from a coffee maker to a dishwasher. That's all you need for a wonderful trip to Amsterdam.

name: Bright Room for families and friends in A'dam 2
description: You can stay in this PRIVATE room by yourself or with your friends and family. When you book this room, you have the room for yourself, with private shower and toilet. We are an education center in Amsterdam-East. When you stay with us, you do not only get a comfortable, private room for an affordable price in Amsterdam, but also support a progressive institute organizing trainings on topics such as global justice, feminism, and LGBTQI liberation. No AC in the room.

name: Ground floor apartment with garden
description:
Home away from home. Enjoy open plan living with access to a private garden. Ideal for a single traveller or couple who want to explore Amsterdam but avoid the crowded centre. Note - there is only one bed.

Located in a lovely neighbourhood (Westindische Buurt) with two parks (Rembrandtpark and Vondelpark) within walking distance.

Easy access to Schiphol (trams 1, 17) or Central Station (trams 1,7,17). Schiphol is around 209 mins away and the Centre is a 13 mins bike ride away.

name: Kleurrijk en licht appartement
description:
Bright apartment with cheerful colors, furniture with beautiful views over the Bos en Lommer district in the multicultural Amsterdam Oud West. As soon as you walk out the door, there are nice restaurants, cafes, terraces and shops everywhere. You can also walk to both Westerpark and Erasmus Park within 5 minutes.

The house is within the ring, bus and tram stops are around the corner and will take you to the city center and central station in no time.

name: Monumentaal pand in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our beautiful house in the heart of Amsterdam! This spacious and stylish accommodation offers two bedrooms; a master bedroom and children's room (with crib or regular bed), ideal for families, couples or business travelers who want to explore the bustling capital of the Netherlands.

We look forward to welcoming you and making your time here unforgettable!

name: Hip apartment in cozy area
description:
Welcome to my stylish and cozy apartment in Amsterdam East! Enjoy a spacious, plant-filled space with a sunny balcony. Located on a quiet street, yet close to the center and the trendy Pijp area, it's perfect for exploring the city. With easy access to public transport and nearby parks like Oosterpark and Sarphatipark, your Amsterdam adventure awaits.

-60m2 apartment with big sunny balcony
-big bed (180x220cm)
-open kitchen
-rainshower

description:
Welcome to my place!

The flat consists of:
1 x cozy bedroom
1 x living room/open space kitchen with sleeping couch
1x toilette
1 x bathroom with modern shower

Within 5 min walking:
Erasmus Park, Metro Burgemeester de Vlugtlaan

Flat is ideal for couples, also with kids, or 2 friends

Area is quiet, same goes for the neighbors, therefore please bring respect with you! Looking forward reading your request, please add something about you and specify the number of guests

name: Homely 2-bed apartment
description: This is a homely, bright and spacious 2 bedroom apartment that overlooks the Vondelpark. It is in the sought-after neighbourhood called the Schinkelhaven, with local bars, restaurants and cafes just minutes away. It is a 15 minute tram to the museum district and another 5 minutes into the centre.

name: Charming Room at Max Brown Museum Square Centre
Room at Max Brown Museum Square Centre
Max Brown Hotel Museum Square, Sircle Collectio...
Johannes
description: This ship from 1886 used to be part of the Dutch sailing inland waterway, which was used to transport many building materials and foodstuffs. The Johannes has now been converted into a houseboat, of which three floors of the wheelhouse have been furnished for those of you who like to spend the night in the center of Amsterdam but also appreciate some peace and quiet. Cozy street & super central. You will stay privately in the back of the ship, which used to be the wheelhouse and engine room.

name: Ruim Familie Appartement in Rustig Amsterdam Oost
description:
A spacious apartment that is centrally located and adjacent to a quiet, beautiful park (Frankendael) with plenty of options for children. The tram to the city center stops right in front of the door, and the shops are within walking distance.

The apartment has two bedrooms. In the first bedroom, there is a 180 x 220 cm bed. In the other bedroom, there is a single bed (90x200), a crib (60x120), and a toddler bed (70x140 cm).

name: Private rooms Amsterdam Center
description: The two double rooms are located on the fourth floor of a historic building in the center of Amsterdam. There is no elevator, but the apartment is well furnished and equipped with amenities such as television, towels, complimentary toiletries and bedroom keys. You can also enjoy Netflix during your stay. The private bathroom is modern and well equipped. Despite the lack of an elevator, the central location of the apartment makes it easy to explore Amsterdam.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Triple Room, met ontbijt
description: From this charming accommodation, you can easily reach popular stores and restaurants.

name: Appartement Java
description:
In this centrally located accommodation, everything for your family is within reach.
Restaurants, park, swimming pool, shops all within walking distance.
A very lively neighborhood with a great diversity of inhabitants.
The city center is easily accessible by bicycle, bus or tram. About ten minutes travel time.
The house has been completely renovated and has two roof terraces. One with a beautiful view over the skyline of Amsterdam.
There is a cat present. The cat Appie is very friendly.

name: Numa | Large Studio with Kitchen
description:
This comfortable studio offers 29 sqm of space. Ideal for up to two people, its double bed (160x200) and modern bathroom with shower or bathtub make this stay a perfect way to experience Amsterdam. The room also offers a sofa, a dining table, and a kitchen, so you’ll have everything you need for maximum comfort and minimal stress.

name: Familyhouse with garden in Amsterdam North
description:
The building is located in a beautiful quiet street with park in trendy Amsterdam North. Close to ferry, Eye museum, Adam Tower and the hip and happening NDSM-area.

My house is a private unit on the ground floor and 1st floor and is exclusively for you. Although the garden is shared with other families (hence NO smoking and other disturbing things)

Come and experience Amsterdam from this side of the water. This is where an old industrial area is transforming into a vibrant residential hub.

name: Charming apartment with canal view!
description:
Charming Amsterdam Apartment with Stunning Canal Views!

Wake up to breathtaking canal views and enjoy your morning coffee while basking in the sunlight by the open window.

Ideally located in the heart of Amsterdam—just a 5-minute walk to the trendy 9 Streets and 10 minutes to the serene Vondelpark. The perfect spot to experience the city’s charm, culture, and vibrant atmosphere!

name: Stylish APT. | Balcony | Jordaan & Old-West
description:
Welcome to my beautiful apartment — your perfect home base for exploring Amsterdam like a local!

My apartment is located in the charming and popular Staatsliedenbuurt, known for offering a wonderful balance: it's a quiet, residential area that is still highly central. You'll enjoy peaceful surroundings and easy access to the expansive Westerpark, while the city center and all major sights are just a short tram or bike ride away.

name: Bright & cosy apartment Jordaan
description:
Enjoy a cosy (gezellig in Dutch) experience in this apartment decorated with love and some style ;) The apartment is double-sided and renovated. The living room is facing SE, meaning there is a lot of light! It is quite spacious, quiet with a lot of plants.

The neighbourhood is beautiful and the residents take care of all the plants on the street. There are a few very picturesque (but not so crowded) canals close by and the whole cafe/restaurant/shop district of the Jordaan is within 5min walk.

name: Beautiful luxurious apartment in Amsterdam
description:
Beautiful, luxurious apartment in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid.

Close to the famous Vondelpark in one of the most beautiful neighborhoods with good public transport connections to both the airport and the city center.

name: Canal house Egelantiersgracht ground floor+garden
description:
Immerse yourself in Amsterdam's Jordaan district at our stylish ground floor apartment on Egelantiersgracht. With 70m² of space, our hip one-bedroom abode blends modern comfort with Dutch charm.

Relax in the cozy lounge with canal views, sipping tea or wine as boats pass by. Retreat to the tranquil bedroom with a plush bed and private garden access.

Featured in international magazines, our apartment offers a vibrant Amsterdam lifestyle. Minimum 1 month stay. Experience Jordaan's vibes..

name: Gezellig Grachtenpand: Amsterdam
description: Everything for your family is at your fingertips at this centrally-located accommodation. Discover this beautifully located apartment on the Nieuwe Prinsengracht. Enjoy the natural light and breathtaking views of the canals. Located near the Skinny Bridge, Amstelhotel, Rembrandtplein and Waterlooplein. Metro and supermarket are a 3-minute walk away. Spacious and comfortably furnished apartment, ideal for families with children, in the heart of Amsterdam city center.

name: My Bright Home in Amsterdam - Market Park Windmill
description: Discover your cozy retreat in vibrant Amsterdam East! 10 min away from Central, this 55 sqm apartment offers city buzz & tranquil courtyard views. Enjoy Dappermarkt from the front balcony & peaceful nights in the bedroom's back balcony. Fully equipped kitchen, home office setup, and streaming services for relaxation. Book now for an unforgettable Amsterdam experience!

name: centrally located gem for two,
description: Welcome to our cozy 1-bedroom apartment, Situated in Amsterdam's center, it's ideal for exploring the city. Designed for comfort, it's child-friendly and offers a baby cot upon request. With a double bed, well-equipped kitchen, and cozy seating area, it's perfect for couples. Enjoy nearby cafes, restaurants, and attractions like the Anne Frank House and Rijksmuseum. Whether you're here for history, nightlife, or relaxation, our apartment offers the perfect base for your Amsterdam adventure.

name: Room Joni,  not for parties
description:
We offer 1 bedroom only with your own private bathroom (11,4 square meters) in a centrally located apartment. The room is for a maximum of 2 guests. You can choose between 2 singles beds (80x200cm) or a double bed (160x200cm).

No access to the Kitchen and Living room (as local authority requests).

name: NEW! Authentic and Stylish Jordaan Apartment
description: This cosy and stylish apartment is located right in the heart of the famous Jordaan neighborhood at the best location you can get! It has just been professionally renovated into a stylish and luxury apartment where the space has been optimally used. Situated in a building that dates back to the 17th this authentic apartment is entirely private and ideal for couples or solo travelers who are ready to explore Amsterdam by foot as most city hot spots are within walking distance!
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Luxury Designer Canal Apartment
description:
This popular Designer Amsterdam Canal Apartment is back on the market for an occasional short stay.
A real Amsterdam experience on the canal. This large luxury floor (110 m2) has two bedrooms (very quiet as they are located at the back overlooking the gardens), 1.5 bathrooms and an open kitchen and dining area.
The location is extremely central with many trendy restaurants and the best museums within walking distance.
No parties or loud music.

name: Dijkhuis in Amsterdam Noord
description: Built in 1905 on the Nieuwendammerdijk in Amsterdam Noord, this charming house offers a wonderful combination of complete renovation and authentic canal-side charm.  Located on a quiet street with a small garden and a large playground at the back. Within walking distance of Noorderpark station (Noord-Zuid metro line), just one stop to Amsterdam Centraal. Ideal for couples or families with 2 children, with the natural beauty of Vliegenbos around the corner and the bustling city center within easy reach.

name: Cosy, Mid-Century Modern Flat
description: Our cosy one-bedroom apartment is perfect for a weekend of easily exploring Amsterdam, but also well-equipped for longer stays requiring remote work. Sandwiched between two of Amsterdam’s most beautiful parks, you can go for a peaceful walk or make your way to the centre in no time to enjoy all the fine things the city has to offer!

name: Cosy luminous flat with 360 rooftop views
description:
Stylish and spacious property, ideal for group getaways, nestled in one of Amsterdam's most vibrant neighbourhoods. Embrace the beauty of Amsterdam from our 360-degree rooftop, offering breathtaking sunset views of the west, recently acclaimed by Time Out Magazine as one of the world's finest places to live. .
Please note, like many traditional Amsterdam buildings, our property does not feature an elevator, so it would not be suitable for people with mobility issues.

name: Appartement in de Pijp Amsterdam
description: This cozy, cozy apartment has all the necessary facilities and is located in the heart of the bustling neighborhood of Amsterdam: de Pijp. This is the place to be when you are in Amsterdam. It is a lively and trendy neighborhood with many restaurants, bars, shops, and famous places such as the Albert Cuyp market,  Museumplein and Sarphatipark. In addition, there is a tram stop + metro station within a two-minute walk, so there is a great connection to all of Amsterdam.

name: Modern/calm 3 br family house - nearby NDSM wharf
description:
Our cozy, bright, child-friendly house will suit all your needs during your stay in Amsterdam! Enjoy our calm and green neigbourhood whilst being at walking/cycling distance from the city. Cheap parking in front of the house.
Please note: our house is only suitable for couples or a family. We have space for 2 adults and 2 (young) children.

name: Rijtjeshuis in Amsterdam Noord
description: Terraced house with 3 floors and garden in Amsterdam Noord. Located in a car-free street that leads to the IJ water for swimming. Close to the ferry to go to Central Station. Close to NDSM shipyard, walking distance to supermarkets, shopping street and trendy restaurants.

name: Boutique stay: rustig, centraal & comfortabel
description:
Enjoy a relaxing stay in a quiet neighborhood close to the city center.

We've given the room a small upgrade with some extra cozy decorations to make your stay even more comfortable. Everything else remains just as the photos.

name: Two (2) independent studios @ Amsterdam Dam Square
description:
Indulge in Amsterdam's charm at this accommodation near Dam Square.

Original features like exposed beams and characteristic windows create an inviting ambiance, marrying historic allure with modern convenience.

The airbnb consists out of two apartments, located on the 1st and second floor of the building.

Both with their own bathroom, providing a private retreat with a well-appointed shower, toilet, and sink.

There is also a washer/dryer, freely available for use.

name: Canal-view studio in the Jordaan
description: This design-led Jordaan studio sits inside a historic canal house overlooking the Prinsengracht, with tall windows and a quiet, restful feel. Blackout blinds make for a proper lie-in, while Anne Frank House (5 min walk) and the Nine Streets are a 10/15 minute walk. With a Smart TV, kitchenette, walk-in rain shower and a sunny window bench, your days flow easily. Ideal for couples or solo travellers seeking authentic Amsterdam.

name: 2-level Amsterdam city center townhouse!
description:
Perfect base to recharge while exploring Amsterdam with a warm living room, fully equipped kitchen (2023 build), big windows ensuring lots of light while still private (no opposite buildings), all amenities at hand with fast WiFi, voice controlled lighting and sound system, a bathroom with bath and finally a peaceful private sun-drenched roof terrace with bbq, lounge and hammock.

Free private parking.
Swimming dock, public transport. Board games, streaming options, a record player.

name: Bright and zen city centre place
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.
1 bedroom apartment on a quiet street, situated in a convenient location so you can walk to the centre and reach both Central and Zuid stations by metro.
It has restaurants, supermarkets, museums, yoga and training studios all in a short walking distance as well as several picturesque routes to go for a walk.
I’m looking to host 1-2 people max and prefer someone who is tidy and respectful of the neighbours and their peace.

name: Private guest suite in our home with bikes
description:
Our private guest suite with two bikes is part of our home. Located just a 3-minute walk from the metro and about 10 minutes from the city center.

The guest space is reached via the shared building staircase (please be quiet for our neighbors). The suite has a private bathroom and its own space, but it remains part of our home and is not a separate apartment.

You’ll be surrounded by cafés, shops and bars, with Oosterpark just around the corner.

name: Contemporary private BR near RAI
description: Private room in a fresh Japandi Style appartement with a nod to Dutch memorabilia. Situated in a quiet neighborhood near to RAI convention centre and main railway stations to Schiphol Airport.  Only a few minutes away from the heart of the city. Rent a bike and explore the city center. You will have your own (double) bed and bathroom on the ground floor. On the first floor you will find the shared living room and kitchen free to use if you leave it the way you find it.

name: Prachtige woning met tuin naast het Westerpark
description:
It is a real Amsterdam house from 1903 with high ceilings. From the kitchen, you have access to a spacious private garden.

The apartment is located on a quiet street, with private entrance, without stairs. It is next to the Westerpark with eateries and nice cafes. But also close to the Jordaan. The most beloved part of Amsterdam. It is easily accessible with public transportation.

Furthermore, the house is equipped with all comforts such as a Smart TV, rain shower, dishwasher and washing machine.

name: Spacious loft close to Jordaan
description: Enjoy our loft-like apartment between the city center and Westerpark!  The room has a 3.5 meter high ceiling and is very spacious (90 m2) and flooded with light. You will find everything you need: a fully equipped kitchen, a king-size bed (2 x 2 m) in the room, a living area and a dining table with 5 chairs. The city center is within walking distance, so you have both: the tourist attractions combined with the unique experience of living in Amsterdam. Pets are not allowed.

name: House with 2 private independent studio's 120 m2
description: You will find this apartment in a prime location in Amsterdam, just 300 meters from the Rijksmuseum and Leidseplein. It is divided into 2 separate, lockable units. Both with their own bedroom and sitting area and their own television. The spacious kitchen is fully equipped for preparing a meal. Very spacious and luxuriously finished. Perfect for 2 couples, expats.The location is unique, you are just in the quiet area. If you walk straight out the door, the cafes start after 100 meters.

name: Idyllic family house with garden
description: Experience the warmth of our home at the Stoombootweg in De Kadoelen! Nestled in a serene setting, our idyllic family home boasts a spacious garden, perfect for relaxation, family time and outdoor gatherings. Situated just a stone's throw away from the subway and ferry, guests enjoy seamless connectivity to explore the city's treasures. Whether you're seeking urban adventures or tranquil retreats, our home offers the perfect balance for your stay. Welcome to your home away from home!

name: Huis met de krul
description:
Hoi, wij zijn Cees en Cathalijne, en bieden onze bovenverdieping met veel plezier aan.

Het appartement ligt in Centrumeiland, een nieuwe wijk in Amsterdam. Op loopafstand zijn winkels, supermarkten, terrasjes, restaurants en het strand!

Het appartement heeft een woonkamer met pantry, 2 slaapkamers, een badkamer en 2 balkons.

Direct achter de gedeelde voordeur is de trap naar boven naar het appartement: deze is apart van de rest van het huis. Wij wonen zelf beneden, dus je hebt veel privacy.

name: Fully renovated light apartment
description:
- Fully Renovated Space with Brand New Kitchen in Amsterdam West with 2 large balconies.
- Perfect for a couple exploring/visiting Amsterdam.
- Fast internet suited for remote working.
- Close to Rembrandt Park and Erasmus Park and numerous of restaurants and bars.
- Direct connection to bus, tram and metro.

name: Cosy apartment in “de Pijp”
description: Enjoy what Amsterdam has to offer from this centrally located 1 bedroom apartment in the vibrant neighbourhood - de Pijp. Just step outside the door and you will find yourself surrounded  by numerous cafes and restaurants. Albert Cuijp market, the Museum Square, Heineken Museum and the most of the touristic sites are within 5-15 minutes walking distance. The metro station which will take you to the Central station  is only 100 meters away.

name: Charming Garden Home | Excellent Connections
description:
Welcome to our spacious ground-floor apartment in Amsterdam Noord! Unwind in our large, sunny garden, perfect for relaxing days and alfresco dining. You're just minutes from Noorderpark, where you can enjoy lunch and drinks at the lovely Sans. You'll also be surrounded by hip local restaurants (Barracuda, Corner Store, Goudfazant, Europizza, Metro, Coba & Bacalar)!

A 10-min stroll through the park takes you to the North-South metro line for quick and easy access to the city center!

name: Quiet and modern appartement close to Schiphol
description: Beautifully renovated apartment located in a quiet residential complex in the Nieuw-sloten district. Parking is available in front of the door (paid), supermarket close by and good public transportation. Perfect base for Amsterdam.

name: Bohemian apartment with balcony
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place. Sunny apartment with a cozy ambiance. Perfect for a couple or duo who want to get to know the city.

name: Duplex apartment in de Pijp
description:
Two-story fully renovated modern apartment with >100m2 space. Sunny top floor with spacious living room and roof terrace. Perfect location in de Pijp with lots of nice restaurants and bars. Also, 15min walking distance from convention centre the Amsterdam RAI and Rijksmuseum.

This is your hotspot for a relaxed stay in beautiful Amsterdam!

name: Spacious and beautiful apartment
description: Spread across 120m2, this spacious abode features 2 spacious bedrooms, a sleek study for work or relaxation, and breathtaking waterfront views with no intrusive neighbors in sight. The recently renovated bathroom enyoys a walk-in shower and separate bathtub. Also, make sure to take in some sun on the  rooftop terrace! With the tram line a mere 2-minute walk away, whisking you to the city center in just 10 minutes. Plus, the airport is just a 15-minute Uber ride away, ensuring hassle-free travel.

name: Light, spacious apartment, two balconies
description: Light, spacious, and modern apartment in Amsterdam. The living room is large with windows on both sides. We have two balconies for all-day sun enjoyment. Optional two bedrooms. It's located in a quiet neighborhood with a lot of parks nearby, and public transport around the corner. A 10-minute bike ride will bring you to the Vondelpark, and with 5 min extra you'll arrive at the museum quarter and city center. Many nice restaurants, (coffee) shops, nightlife, and other activities nearby!

name: Numa | Large 1 Bedroom Apartment with Canal view
description:
This comfortable apartment offers 44 sqm of space. Ideal for up to four people, its two double beds (180x200), living room, and modern bathroom with bathtub and shower make this stay a perfect way to experience Amsterdam. The apartment also offers a built-in kitchen, a dining table, and a sofa, so you’ll have everything you need for maximum comfort and minimal stress.

Please note that the second bed is on the open space on the top floor.

name: Numa | Large Accessible 1 Bedroom Apartment
description:
This accessible apartment offers 44 sqm of space. Ideal for up to four people, its two double beds (180x200), living room, and modern bathroom with accessible shower make this stay a perfect way to experience Amsterdam. The apartment also offers a built-in kitchen, a dining table, and a sofa, so you’ll have everything you need for maximum comfort and minimal stress.

Please note that the second bed is on the open space on the top floor and it is not accessible.

description: This comfortable apartment offers 46 sqm of space. The apartment also offers a built-in kitchen and a dining table, so you’ll have everything you need for maximum comfort and minimal stress.

name: Numa | 2 Bedroom Apartment in Amsterdam East
description: This comfortable apartment offers 41 sqm of space. Ideal for up to four people, its double bed (180x200), two single beds (90x200), living room, and modern bathroom with bathtub and shower make this stay a perfect way to experience Amsterdam. The apartment also offers a built-in kitchen, a dining table, and a sofa, so you’ll have everything you need for maximum comfort and minimal stress.

name: Ground-floor Canal Apartment
description:
This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit. This beautiful apartment is very centrally located in the center of Amsterdam. You no longer need a bike, because all the nice bars, restaurants, supermarket and shops are within walking distance.

The apartment is 60m2 with a nice private backyard where you can relax after a nice walk in the bustling city.
It is nicely decorated and offers everything you will need on your city trip!

name: Boutique 4P Houseboat Apartment with Terrace & A/C
description:
Welcome aboard this brand new & private houseboat apartment, where modern comfort meets the tranquility of waterfront living!

Nestled along the shimmering waters, this charming retreat promises a unique getaway experience like no other.

Whether you're seeking a romantic escape or a peaceful retreat with loved ones, this houseboat apartment provides the perfect blend of luxury and serenity for an unforgettable stay.

Experience the magic of waterfront living!

A/C & Heating are present!

name: Historic family home, central location
description:
Welcome to our beautiful family home on the oldest 'dijk' of Amsterdam-Noord, ten minutes biking from the city centre. Centrally located in the neighborhood, next to Noorderpark.

Two comfortable seating areas, a fully equiped kitchen, three bedrooms, full bathroom with tub and seperate shower, second toilet upstairs. Spacious, private garden suitable for outdoor dining.

Free Wifi and free parking behind a locked gate (with electric car charging possible).

name: Amsterdam loft apartment
description:
Welcome to your stylish urban retreat in the heart of Amsterdam!

description:
This nice, bright and comfortable apartment with a great balcony overseeing lovely gardens has 1 bedroom and a bathroom with a bath and shower. The apartment is equipped with everything you need!

Enjoy the hip neighborhood Old West (Oud-West), have nice long walks in the Westerpark or Erasmuspark which is close by and exploit the nice Westergasfabriek. The beautiful old Neighborhood, The Jordaan, is 3 minutes on the bike and The Dam square is 10 minutes away.

name: The Grutto
description: Welcome to our charming Bed & Breakfast, located 20 minutes by bike from the historic center of Amsterdam. What makes our place truly unique is the breathtaking view we offer of a breeding bird-rich polder in Amsterdam in the vibrant Amsterdam-Noord. This lively district is known for its artistic flair and vibrant cultural scene. Our B&B is easily accessible by public transport and by bike.

name: Appartement in de Rivierenbuurt
description:
Light and comfortable apartment in the quiet Rivierenbuurt.

Just a stone's throw away from the RAI and close to cafes, shops and the Amstel. The city center and De Pijp can be reached quickly by tram, bus or metro.

Modernly furnished, ideal for couples or solo travelers. Easily accessible from Schiphol, Zuidas and RAI Station.

name: Cozy and colourful apartment
description: Feel right at home at our lovely 1-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam Zuidoost. Immerse yourself in the rich cultural tapestry of the city, from vibrant markets and eateries to full fledged dining experiences. With easy access to public transportation and iconic landmarks, our haven offers convenience and tranquility for your unforgettable stay. Book now and elevate your Amsterdam experience.

name: Family home
description: Our stylish family home has all the comforts. This spacious house is located in the quiet, child-friendly neighborhood of de Bongerd, close to the bustling NDSM area. A stone's throw away from a large supermarket, public transportation and nature reserve.

name: Calm haven for lovers of art and books
description:
A cozy room in a carefully decorated 76-sq-m apartment.
Your room is small but very comfortable, with a stylish shared bathroom next door.
Guests love the comfort of the bed, the quiet neighbourhood, interior details and good location.
You'll be sharing the apartment with our small family: Jamie, Judy, baby Fae and Baloo, a large, friendly dog.
A scenic walk from the Central Station and the charming Jordaan, I think you'll be pleasantly surprised by this little corner of the city.

name: Eastern Eclectic Palace
description:
101sqm space with 2 bedrooms and 1.5 bathroom.

Large couch and a very comfy inflatable (queen) mattress for additional guest if there is more than 2 bed needed.

Available for February with both rooms OR if only 1 guest, can be shared with owner for a discounted rate. Can provide a bike if needed.

Coffee, tea, matcha included.

Two patios, one facing the north and the other south.

Extremely sunny location!

name: Stylish Boutique Apt. | Garden | Vondelpark
description: Explore our boutique and luxury apartment (ground floor/100m2) next to Vondelpark in charming, lush and peaceful Old-West. Step inside a uniquely designed living room, fully equipped open kitchen, two bedrooms, and two bathrooms (incl. bath). Relax in the serene garden after a day of city exploration. Within a short walking distance, you'll find a vibrant array of cafes, restaurants, and boutiques. The Rijksmuseum & Van Gogh are only a five-minute bike ride away or a walk through the Vondelpark.

name: Zonnig appartement
description:
This apartment is located in a quiet street within walking distance of the city center (20 minutes walk to Anne Frank House). Bus and tram nearby (10 min to Sloterdijk Station, 15 min to Central Station and 35 min to Schiphol). Several restaurants, coffee bars and supermarkets nearby. The apartment (55 square meters) is on the first floor with a living room and open kitchen and two bedrooms each with a double bed.
Only available for families or couples.

name: Stylish Home w/4 Balconies/3BR/garage/city Center
description:
A unique and light-filled home in the heart of Amsterdam – with 4 balconies, a stunning corner window overlooking the canal and the iconic Westertoren (next to Anne Frank House). Watch the sun rise and set from your living room — truly magical.

The apartment is centrally located: all museums, the Jordaan, canals, playgrounds, shops, cafés and even a small central park are just steps away.
-3x stylish bedrooms 2x dbl bed
-Direct access garage with elevator/optional use
-perfect for families

name: Apt with Garden in Westerpark
description: Peaceful and centrally-located place, with a nice garden in the back where to enjoy some quiet from the hectic Amterdam. 5 mins walk from Westerpark, 10 mins walk from Jordaan and 10 mins by direct bus from Central Station. There is one king bed and a single sofa-bed suitable for kids or adults who are used to sleeping anywhere. Groceries stores around the corner, friendly neighbourhood and super cozy loft. The apartment is very light with lots of sun entering in the morning.

name: 2-room apartment in Amsterdam-Centrum
description: This centrally located accommodation is stylishly decorated and features 2 bedrooms, a bathroom with rain shower and a brand new kitchen. Located in a quiet neighborhood, but only 7 minutes walk to the Jordaan and 20 minutes to the Dam. The central station can be reached within 15 minutes by public transport. The apartment also has a spacious balcony with sun from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m., including a large lounge set and a dining table for 4 to 6 people.

name: Luxury home on the Elandsgracht, Center Amsterdam
description: The space feels very open, and the two-bedroom distribution makes the apartment suitable for a wide audience. The building and the home were qualitatively and tastefully renovated in 2010, which is still visible. The location, right in the middle of the chic center's lively part, is perfect, and all amenities are within walking distance. This includes the Vondelpark, gyms, trendy coffee bars, cozy restaurants, and various fashion and vintage clothing stores. The building was built in 1882!

name: Fijn, sfeervol, recent gerenoveerd appartement
description: In this very recently renovated apartment, with garden in the sun, it is wonderful to stay. A nice space in a pleasant, cozy neighborhood in Amsterdam West. Located between the Erasmus Park and Westerpark, plenty of greenery nearby. In addition to the greenery, there are also many nice bars and restaurants within walking distance. On Bos en Lommerweg, you will find everything you need in stores. With 15 minutes of cycling you are in the heart of Amsterdam, with 5 minutes of cycling in the cozy old west.

name: Modern & new appartment - 2 bedroom
description:
Charming 2-Bedroom Apartment by Rembrandtpark!

Discover Amsterdam from our serene, well-located apartment. We love living here and are happy to share our home with you. Steps from Metro Postjesweg and Rembrandtpark, it features cozy bedrooms, a stylish living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and excellent Wi-Fi. Perfect for friends, couples, and families (note: 3rd floor without elevator).

name: Oud-West Oasis
description: Discover your own "Oud-West Oasis" in this characteristic 2-room apartment from 1901. Located on the first floor in vibrant Oud-West, this residence forms a peaceful haven near the iconic Vondelpark. The apartment features a French balcony in the living room and a balcony at the rear, both accessible from the first floor.

various vietnamese, Italian, sushi, ramen, Indian & Kosjer restaurants in close proximity as well as a shopping center with 2major supermarket chains

Spacious apartment on the 3rd floor in the heart of the famous De Pijp district! The house is easily accessible with a wide staircase to the top.

Around the corner from boutiques, cafes, restaurants and famous museums, but in a quiet and peaceful street. Convenient tram stops and bike rentals nearby make exploring easy.

name: Charming canal apartment in Museum Area
description:
The house is located along the scenic Hobbemakade canal in Amsterdam. It is newly renovated so it ensures a comfortable stay!

You're in the heart of Oud-Zuid, surrounded by cozy cafes, trendy boutiques, and cultural attractions. Explore the charming streets, wander through the nearby Vondelpark, or immerse yourself in the city's rich history at the nearby museums.

name: Charming House at the Vondelpark
description:
Cosy and modern family home (sleeps 2 to 4 adults or 2/3 kids) on the doorstep of the Vondelpark, the most beautiful and centrally located park in Amsterdam. The house itself was built in 1913 and is located on a cul-de-sac which leads directly into the park.

Close to a tram stop to take you into the heart of Amsterdam but awaiting nearby is the very best of Oud-West incl local shops, coffee spots and restaurants. Museum quarter also close by and walkable within 20 minutes through the park.

name: Appartement in hartje Amsterdam
description: Experience our sunny apartment in the heart of Amsterdam, ideally located at Oostenburgerpark! With a sunny balcony to relax on and a comfortable bedroom for restful nights, this apartment is perfect for your stay. Enjoy a beer at Brouwerij 't IJ under Amsterdam's largest windmill. Top restaurants like Coulisse and Trattoria Breda are within walking distance, as well as several supermarkets. In short, this apartment offers the perfect combination of vibrant city life and serene park tranquility!

name: Cozy Amsterdam Family Home With Rooftop & Bikes
description:
Welcome to our cozy Amsterdam house - your family's home to explore the city!

In 110 m2 across 3 floors you have bedrooms, offices, bathroom with tub and shower, a full kitchen, a big living room and a rooftop terrace all to yourself. Our home is all decked out for families - cot, highchair, toys, ... all included.

Located in peaceful Amsterdam-Oost with parks, shops, restaurants, and public transport at your fingertips - yet only 20 mins by bike or tram to the center.

name: Beautiful Apartment in the Center of Amsterdam
description: Welcome to your beautifully renovated 73m² (785ft²) haven in the heart of Amsterdam. This charming first-floor apartment, nestled near the vibrant Jordaan neighborhood, features a spacious bedroom, a cozy kitchen-living area, a lovely balcony, and all modern conveniences. The large kitchen table is perfect for dining or working. You’ll be staying on a quiet street, yet immersed in the trendy and charming atmosphere of the Jordaan, surrounded by hip coffee bars and local shops.

name: Cosy & modern full equipped apartment - Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our stylish apartment located in vibrant Amsterdam East! Perfect for both short and long stays, our cozy space is ideal for up to 2 guests (babies allowed). The apartment offers all the amenities you need, including a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable living area, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a modern bathroom. Enjoy the lively neighborhood with trendy cafes, parks, and easy access to public transport, making it a perfect base to explore the city!

Admire the elegant herringbone floor and the beautiful wooden table that together create a warm, inviting atmosphere. The highlight of the apartment is undoubtedly the French terrace with five large windows, which seamlessly connects to the living level and offers a quiet retreat in the middle of the city.

In the spacious kitchen, there are all the built-in appliances you need. The apartment has a balcony and large garden with Jacuzzi!

name: Central Luxury Apartment

This charming accommodation has its own entrance with key safe, is within walking distance of the city center and is located directly on one of the most beautiful canals in the city. Enjoy comfort in this beautiful apartment, equipped with a cozy living room, a modern kitchen, a handy clothes rack, a stylish bathroom and a separate toilet.

name: Prachtige woning in Westerpark
description:
Stylish living at the Westerpark, near the Jordaan

Stay in a spacious and stylish house in one of Amsterdam's most beloved neighborhoods: Westerpark. The house is located directly on the green Westerpark and only a 10-minute walk from the city center and the Jordaan.

You can enjoy peace, space and luxury here, with cafes, restaurants, culture and museums around the corner. The perfect base for those who want to experience Amsterdam as a local, with the best of the city and nature within reach.

name: Nice home near Kinkerstraat
description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

Location is strategic in a quiet area and also very close to the city center and well-connected by public transportation.

It is for us important: no parties as neighbors can get disturbed.

Please note that we have a dog and there might be some allergens. He will not be at home during the stay.

name: Romantisch grachtenhuis in Amsterdam centrum
description: Welcome to our romantic canal house on the edge of the Jordaan, Amsterdam. This charming stay combines historic details with modern comforts. Enjoy a bright living room with canal views and a fully equipped kitchen. Discover nearby attractions such as the Nine Streets and the Anne Frank House. Perfect for a romantic getaway or a city break. We look forward to welcoming you for an unforgettable stay in the heart of Amsterdam!

name: Ground-level apartment with garden
description: Nice apartment on the ground floor with backyard and front facade, in the middle of the Rivierenbuurt. Ideal for a couple or single, for a stay in Amsterdam or during a conference in the RAI, close to the RAI and easily accessible by tram/bus from Amsterdam-Zuid, Amsterdam-Rai or Amsterdam Amstel train stations.

name: Mi Casa You Casa
description: Enjoy a warm and inviting stay in this stylish ground-floor apartment with spacious open kitchen, cozy bar and patio. Nestled in the peaceful Rivierenbuurt, perfectly located between the Amstel River, Zuidas and RAI, with lively De Pijp neighborhood just around the corner. Parks are within walking distance. Excellent transport links with Amstel and RAI stations, quick access to A10/A2, plus bus and tram stops only 10 minutes away make exploring the whole of Amsterdam easy and convenient.

name: Casey's Lake View House Boat
description: This stylish and unique space has a private shower, toilet, kitchenette is private and independent. A stone's throw from the city center but in the tranquility of Amsterdam Landelijk Noord. Located on one of Amsterdam's most beautiful berths, you can enjoy Casey's House Boat in peace. The accommodation is not shared! The view over the (approved swimming) water is breathtaking. The best of both worlds; the city around the corner and the tranquility of water. Top!

description:
This accommodation is unique.
Our Beachcraft motorboat with shower is in a beautiful location and is suitable for couples, solo adventurers and business travelers. On the boat, there is an outdoor deck where you can relax and enjoy the view. Inside, there is a small kitchen, toilet and a sofa. At the front of the boat is the sleeping cabin with a double bed suitable for 2 people.

Enjoy the cosy living room with smart TV and access to a private garden. The bedroom offers comfort and privacy. Just a short walk from the beautiful Vondelpark and easily accessible by public transport. An ideal base to explore Amsterdam!

name: Stadswoning met tuintje

Centrally located with Amsterdam's shops, cafes, and cultural landmarks all a short walk away. Experience the best of Amsterdam!

⭐ A unique place:

Our family home for families is located on the quiet island of Cruquiuseiland. Around the corner you will find a supermarket and a cozy beer brewery. The house is ideal for families who want to stay comfortably close to the city.

description: The location is perfect. The apartment is located on the popular Hoofdweg on the edge of Oud-West and the Baarsjes. In the neighborhood you will find the lively Ten Katemarkt and cultural center 'de Hallen',the trendy Jan Pieter Heijestraat, various cafes and restaurants. City center is 10 min by bike of public transport.

name: Lovely 2-BR villa with garden
description:
Lovely holiday house in the picturesque and quiet district of Kadoelen, max. 10 minutes by bike from NDSM Pont or Buiksloterweg.

The sunny villa is located on the water and with the kayak or sup you can sail a bit towards the nature park 't Twiske.

The relaxed sun beds and luxury gas BBQ at the jetty ensure the optimal summer atmosphere.

The spacious living room with adjoining kitchen is equipped with all the comforts (oven, microwave and dishwasher). You can also relax in the conservatory.

name: Spacious Penthouse w/ Private Rooftop near Jordaan
description:
Enjoy a unique Amsterdam experience away from the tourist crowds, in a vibrant neighborhood loved by locals and artists — yet just minutes from Jordaan and the historic canals.

This bright and spacious 102 sqm penthouse offers a calm city retreat with a comfortable living area, fully equipped kitchen, high end espresso machine (we love coffee), two cozy bedrooms, a modern bathroom with bathtub, and a private & sunny rooftop terrace. Westerpark, cafés, galleries, and shops are all close by.

name: Luxe en stijlvol stadshuis met zonnige tuin
description: Double ground floor apartment (120m2) in the heart of Amsterdam, located on the Amstel, close to the Albert Cuyp market and the Sarphatipark. The house is very high-end finished down to the smallest details. The warm atmosphere invites you to cook, dine or have a drink in the living room kitchen with cooking island and large table. Exploring the city is also easy due to the very convenient location. The house is very spacious and is located in a quiet street in the bustling Pijp and has a sunny south-facing garden.

name: Amsterdam Loft with roof terrace
description:
This typical Amsterdam Loft with roof terrace & balcony is the ideal Summer get-away! Its roof terrace and balcony net to the living room make it a great place for outdoor days, and its stylish interior makes it a great place for indoor days.

It is also perfect for exploring the city as it is located in a very green and quiet neighborhood, while only being 5 minutes away from De Pijp en 10 minutes from the City Center (canals).

I live in the apartment so it's very well taken care of.

name: Cozy familyhouse in north
description:
This home is perfect for couples with or without children. It is a 10-minute bike ride to the ferry. Noord is a lot to experience! Peaceful neighborhood with little traffic. We have a cat. Pets are not allowed. There is a baby cot.

This home is perfect for couples, with or without children. It is only a 10-minute bike ride to the ferry. And there is a lot to do in the north. Peaceful neighborhood with little traffic. We have a cat, bringing your own pets is not possible. There is a baby cot.

name: Luxurious ground floor apt Amsterdam
description:
This luxurious ground-floor apartment has it all: a fully equipped open-plan kitchen, a spacious bedroom with ample closet space, and a bright living area with doors opening onto a private garden/patio.

It also features a stylishly renovated bathroom and a washing machine. The entire apartment is exclusively yours—no sharing.

Shops, supermarkets, and restaurants are within a 5–10 minute walk, and Tram 2 takes you to Amsterdam city centre in just 12 minutes.

A true hidden gem!

name: Sfeervol appartement aan het water
description:
Charming apartment on the quay in the lively neighborhood "de Pijp". It is a quiet street with beautiful views of the water, but at the same time is around the corner from many shops, cafes and restaurants. It is also within walking distance of public transportation, the RAI, the Albert Cuyp market and both Sarphati and Beatrix parks.

It is a house with 2 bedrooms and 2 balconies. The living room has French doors to the sunny balcony, which is sunny all day. There is a separate bathroom and toilet.

name: Apartment with stunning garden
description: This unique accommodation has a beautiful garden with overpacking and BBQ.

name: Jordaan 4 Person Suite • Next to Leidseplein
description: This Apartment Suite is situated in the picturesque area called the Jordaan, one of downtown Amsterdam's most charming neighborhoods. The interior is stylish and modern, and overall the apartment is spacious and will make you feel right at home. This apartment is located in the heart of Amsterdam which will provide you a true local experience while being close to all major sights.

name: Twin Room with Canal View
description:
Spend the night in an authentic Amsterdam canal house – centrally located yet quiet.

You will be staying in the bustling heart of the city, a 10-minute walk from Central Station. Museums, shops, restaurants and attractions are within easy reach, while you enjoy a quiet and comfortable place to stay.

The double room has two separate beds, a private bathroom with shower, sink and toilet, and a nice view of the canal.

name: Modern loft, amazing canal view
description:
In a quiet corner of the buzzling Jordaan area, you find this modern lof with an amazing view on the prettiest of all canals, the Brouwersgracht.

This modern apartment has ceiling to floor windows (french balcony) facing the canal.
The living includes on open and modern kitchen.
There is a spacious bedroom (180cm/king size) with a balcony.
Bathroom with shower, and separate toilet.
The living has a Swedish design sleeping sofa (140 cm /queen) , ultra easy to change from sofa into bed.

name: Sunny villa in the center
description:
Unique property in the center of Amsterdams.

A peaceful villa full of light with private entrance and green garden.

3 bedrooms, all on 1 level makes it perfect for families:
- Master (Double bed)
- Teen room (expends into Double bed)
- Kid room (expends into Double bed)
- Couch in the living room (solo)

In the heart of vibrant De pijp in walking distance from Michelin restaurants, buzzing bars and weekend markets.

Well connected to public transport.

name: Stylish Central Heritage Home
description:
Discover the charm of Amsterdam from my cozy, stylish house located in the trendy Van der Pek Buurt. This 45 m² gem offers a peaceful retreat with all the comforts of home, just minutes away from the hustle of the city (5 min from CS
stations)

Completely renovated house but sounds carries in these old buildings. Preference for couples and respectful people. Please note this is my private home and I only accept guest with reviews wit h a preference for working adults and couples

name: Charming Apartment Next to Rembrandt Park
description:
Welcome to our beautiful apartment located next to Rembrandt Park, one of Amsterdam’s most stunning green areas. Perfect for couples, friends, or a small family, this stylish space features:

One double bed and one single bed
-A fully-equipped kitchen
-An elegant living room to relax in
-A sunny morning balcony

Situated in the West neighborhood, you'll be close to trendy cafes, shops, and attractions. The nearby tram and bus stations offer direct lines to the Jordaan, city center, and De Pijp.

name: Cosy apartment near the city centre
description:
Be surprised by an oasis of peace, in the heart of Amsterdam, where all tourist attractions are easily accessible.

Rent a bike or ride the tram that takes you through the city.

In the apartment you will find everything for a carefree stay. Wifi, duvets, towels and fresh coffee are available to you.

Preparing an extensive dinner in the well-maintained kitchen or floating in the bath all day?

This is your chance to experience Amsterdam like a local!

name: Lovely apartment in De Pijp
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place. De Pijp is an area of trendy cafes, restaurants, and small boutiques. It is 25 minutes walking distance to the Dam Square and shopping area of Amsterdam and there is a metro and a tram station nearby.

name: Canal Bridge Suite (2nd)
description: From this charming accommodation, you can easily reach popular stores and restaurants.

name: Amstel l Family friendly l Fully equipped l Unit D
description: Welcome to our lovely recently renovated apartment, right by the famous Amstel river. Situated in a peaceful courtyard, this spacious and bright apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay.

name: Amstel l Family friendly l Fully equipped l Unit F
description: Welcome to our lovely recently renovated apartment, right by the famous Amstel river. Situated in a peaceful courtyard, this spacious and bright apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay.

name: Amsterdam city center Apartment
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place. The location within walking distance of the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum and MOCO is brilliant. Located within the old canal belt, in the middle of the Arts & Antiques District. Charming apartment with typical Amsterdam steep canal house stairs. Features a private kitchen and bathroom with walk-in shower.

name: Roze Kamer
description:
🏠 Self renovated room within a 19th century house (located on 1nd floor at the front side of the bulding)
🛏️ King-size bed 160 x 200cm with four comfortable pillows
