name: Ruim tophuis Amsterdam, minimaal 1 werk
description: Quietly located, close to Amsterdam city center and sea/Haarlem. Book at least 3 weeks

name: Spacious apartment in Amsterdam
description:
This bright and cozy first-floor apartment is just 10 minutes from the city center, close to the Vondelpark, and around the corner from the peaceful Rembrandtpark.
Located in a quiet neighborhood, this apartment is the ideal spot to relax and unwind. You'll find plenty of great dining options nearby, offering a variety of cuisines. Whether you're looking to explore the city or simply enjoy a quiet escape, this apartment provides a comfortable and convenient base for your stay in Amsterdam.

name: Woning bij grachten en museumkwartier
description: Lovely spacious apartment (140m2) on the ground floor and 1 high with 2 nice bedrooms, living room, open kitchen, bathroom and 2 toilets. Super centrally located in a quiet street. Located in Oud-West, on the edge of the Jordaan. Leidseplein is a 5-minute walk, 9 streets as well and Museum District 10 minutes. Around the corner, cozy restaurants, supermarkets and shops.

name: Zeer licht en ruim appartement
description: The apartment is located on the 3rd and 4th floor (134m2). The living room/living kitchen are large, the space is very bright and sunny due to the 7 large windows. On the top floor there is a large master bedroom with bathroom. On the other side is another spacious bathroom with bath and separate shower cubicle. There is also a room with a 140x200 bed and a nursery (which also fits an Aerobed). Suitable for family with 2 parents, two children (2 kids in 140m bed) and a baby.

name: Govert Flinck
description: Enjoy easy access to everything from this perfectly located home base.

name: Moderne eengezinswoning vlakbij NDSM-werf & Twiske
description: Recently completely renovated single-family home in Amsterdam Noord within the ring. The house has two bedrooms for adults, both with a double bed. We also have a bedroom for a small child/baby. There are two bathrooms. 8 minutes cycling to NDSM and within 5 minutes cycling in the beautiful large nature reserve Het Twiske, where there are many restaurants in both places. With the ferry you are very quickly in the city - perfect combination of green and city. Has all the comforts!

name: Charming home in Oud-West
description:
A calm cool base in a vibrant neighborhood

Guests of my home in a pocket of Amsterdam’s Bellamybuurt can expect a quiet and inspiring stay, enjoying literature and warm lighting with modern comfort. Features a private bedroom with a comfortable bed, modern kitchen, appliances and bright dining area. Located in the Kinkerbuurt near De Hallen, Ten Katemarkt and wine bars and eateries just steps away :)

name: Charming, bright and quiet home.
description:
Welcome!

We value a peaceful and serene living environment, making our home ideal for those who appreciate design and relaxed atmosphere. This charming and bright Amsterdam apartment is my home, and I hope you'll feel it's yours too.

Its full of light and appears to be a perfect start to explore the city by foot or bike. Due its warm feel, comfortable big bed and handy kitchen its a good place to relax on moments when you aren't exploring the city. Suitable for couples or solo travellers.

name: Casa Nana - New House & Perfect for Working Online
description:
Available Short&Long term stay with Affordable Price!
Feel Free to ask us :)

NEW stunning 2 story apartment!
Natural light fills the cosy living room, modern fully-equipped style kitchen, comfy bedroom & Balcony.

Work&play seamlessly!
Dedicated office(standing desk&2 Monitors+Apple Keyboard+Sonos Beam Soundbar)

*ROOFTOP Terrace*

Central gem!
Steps from shops, parks, restaurants & bars.
City convenience in a quiet Neighbourhood.

Modern perks: rain shower, washing machine, smart lights.

name: Casa Java
description:
Apartment located in the heart of the bustling Indian Neighborhood in Amsterdam East, an environment with a unique mix of cultural diversity and historical charm. The apartment is surrounded by local shops, cozy cafes, and international eateries where the flavors of the world come together. The green oasis of the Flevopark is a stone's throw away (8 min walk) and the Oosterpark (15 min walk).
By bus, you can reach Amsterdam Central Station in 12 min.

name: Nicely renovated canal apartment
description:
Stylish Apartment in Amsterdam

Welcome to this beautifully situated apartment in the vibrant the Baarsjes neighborhood, located on Admiralengracht. Enjoy a cozy living area with plenty of natural light, a modern bathroom, a well-equipped kitchen, and comfortable sleeping arrangements. The area offers charming canals, cafes, and green spaces, with easy access to public transport. Experience the best of Amsterdam like a local. The apartment is on the 3rd floor with no elevator

name: Big apartment Amsterdam west
description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun. There are at least 4 beds in 2 different bedrooms. There is also air conditioning, WiFi, TV, washing machine, dryer.

name: Charmant dijkhuis in Amsterdam Noord
description:
Welcome to our charming dike house in Amsterdam-Noord!

This characteristic family home, renovated with love and attention to detail, is the perfect retreat for a family vacation in the bustling capital of the Netherlands. We only rent out our house to families with children.

Enjoy our private garden and, in front, a playground with picnic tables.

The city center is only 15 minutes away by bike, but when you come home, you will experience the peace and quiet of our neighborhood.

name: Modern One-Bedroom Apartment
description:
Located in a tranquil yet convenient area, this apartment offers the best of both worlds! Just a short walk from the bustling city center and easily accessible by public transport, it combines modern living with a charming twist on Amsterdam architecture.

It is equipped with smart lights and fun features like Sonos and Bathroom Disco Light (just for fun 😅).

It is also possible to use a bike during your stay - as long as you keep it save and treat it well.

name: Entire Luxury Garden House
description:
Expirience chic and luxurious stay in Amsterdam in our family house (180m2) with a beautiful garden. Located in the heart of Oud-Zuid next to the Vondelpark and within walking distance of the PC Hooftstraat, the Museum Square and the Concert Hall.

This two-story house features four bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a spacious living/dining area.

The modern kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line Miele and Siemens appliances. Garden has a trampoline and a BBQ setup.

name: Appartement met ruime tuin in Amsterdam Zuid
description: Enjoy my spacious and quiet apartment with a large garden in Amsterdam Zuid and relax. Equipped with all comforts. The garden has a lounge area, a barbecue and a ping-pong table. Close to the city center, within walking distance of Zuid Station and easily accessible by public transportation. Parking in front of the door. The apartment has 3 bedrooms, a master bedroom, a room with a single bed and a room with a loft bed for 1 person, particularly suitable for families.

name: Studio near the city center
description: Fully furnished studio apartment in a new and trendy neighbourhood. Located directly in front of the Spaklerweg metro station, allowing you to reach Amsterdam city center within 10 minutes. The metro also takes you to Johan Cruyff Arena (via Amsterdam Bijlmer ArenA station) in just 10 minutes. Perfect for both city trips and events.

name: Belly Hop Canal View Room
description:
Welcome to our stylish and homey Canal Room, located on the first floor of a historic canal house in the heart of Amsterdam. In this UNESCO-protected neighborhood, you are surrounded by a wide range of cozy cafes, restaurants, markets, shops, and sights. All of this is within walking distance, and just a 5-minute walk from Central Station!

This canal house is a national monument, built in 1790 and fully renovated in 2023.

name: Belly Hop Beamer Room
description:
Stylish & homey apartment, located on the first floor of a historic canal house in the heart of Amsterdam. In this UNESCO-protected neighborhood, you are surrounded by a wide range of cozy cafes, restaurants, markets, shops, and sights. All of this is within walking distance, and just a 5-minute walk from Central Station!

This canal house is a national monument built in 1790 and completely renovated in 2023.

name: Sunny appartment in central Adam
description: This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated and recently completely renovated. It is a bright and cozy apartment with all the amenities you need during your stay, such as an extensive kitchen and a pleasant bathroom. The apartment is in a great location: in the middle of Amsterdam but in a quiet neighborhood. Within 5 minutes you are in the Vondelpark, within 10 on the Leidseplein and within 15 on the famous canals. Perfect for a weekend or week in Amsterdam!

name: Unique A’dam Druïde Tree House Experience
description: We as a family are so greatfull to be able to help out our guests in Amsterdam. Our small warm druïde cabin with a real living tree is built for a peaceful healing sleep and  sacred space. It has 3 heaters and a private sauna…

name: Unieke locatie in centrum van Amsterdam
description: Spacious and bright apartment in the heart of Amsterdam, with high ceilings and modern decor. Within walking distance of Artis, the canal belt, museums and 15 minutes walk from Central Station. Enjoy breathtaking views of the National Maritime Museum and the water, perfect for a refreshing dip. Includes fast Wi-Fi, fully equipped kitchen, washing machine and workspace. Located in a historic neighborhood with cozy cafes and restaurants. Ideal for experiencing real Amsterdam culture.

name: Luxe appartement met dakterras dichtbij de RAI
description: Beautiful, recently renovated apartment with roof terrace. It is located in a quiet neighborhood in the river neighborhood, within walking distance of both tram, train and bus stops. You can quickly get to the city, and there is a shopping street around the corner. The apartment has all the comforts (including air conditioning in the bedroom). In addition to the facilities and high-quality bed, it also has a roof terrace of no less than 35m2 where you have sun from sunrise to sunset. Enjoy our cozy apartment!

name: Light, spacious home with sunny garden & two cats
description: We offer a wonderfully spacious house in a quiet neighbourhood near the center. We moved to this part of the city five years ago and wouldn't change it for a thing! Its has the best of all worlds; it's a quiet residential area with a lot of interesting architecture and just about 15 minutes from the city centre. Also close to the former NDSM wharf which hosts the largest flea market of Europe and some great venues along the IJ river.

name: Luxurious 4 bedroom family house
description: Relax with the whole family in this peaceful accommodation in the most beautiful and chic neighborhood of Amsterdam.

name: Luxurious Amsterdam home with canalview & garden
description:
An apartment with a spacious living room, luxurious kitchen, large bathroom, and delightful sunny garden.

The master bedroom is equipped with a king-size double bed and a wardrobe.

The second bedroom will be locked to store our personal belongings, ensuring closets are empty for you during your stay.

If desired, we will set up a nice additional bed for a third person/child.

Lastly, there is a very spacious bathroom with a double sink, walk-in shower, and bathtub.

name: AMS West Gem: Style Awaits
description:
Perfectly situated, this centrally located accommodation offers your group effortless access to all Amsterdam has to show. Discover the beauty of two nearby parks, or hop on a quick 10-minute tram or bus ride to the city center. The vibrant neighbourhood comes alive with artisan bakeries, inviting restaurants, and lively bars, promising a delightful taste of local life.

No parties - No smoking inside - No drugs

name: Cozy studio apartment on vibrant street
description:
Welcome to my colorful studio apartment on the vibrant and neighborly Javastraat, known for its many mixed cultures and cuisines. Drink coffee on the south facing balcony while people watching, or visit the next door neighbor for fresh produce. The neighborhood offers endless opportunities, but the city center is just 10(bike)/20(tram) minutes away. Staying in? Turn on the home cinema.

This 1st floor apartment is recently renovated, well isolated and has a spacious feel due to the high ceiling.

name: Water view | 3 BR | Art & Food
description: Enjoy the city with a view. 3 bedrooms, office space and rooftop pool 🏊,   yoga 🧘‍♀️ sauna next door (& free parking). Nestled in a trendy neighborhood, you'll be surrounded by the best of Amsterdam's creative scene. Step out and explore hip cafes, gourmet restaurants and our roof top swimming pool and cafe next door.  Enjoy the rest you need on a holiday & with a 5 min beautiful free ferry ride you are in the tourist heart of Amsterdam. Or Bike into the country side spotting windmills

name: Appartement/Studio Amsterdam
description: This apartment in Amsterdam city center is very quietly located in a bustling part of Amsterdam.

name: Lovely light house on beautiful peaceful street
description:
Tucked away on one of the most beautiful monumental streets in Amsterdam-Noord, this quiet and green retreat offers a unique balance of calm and centrality. Recently renovated with love and care, the house uses natural, sustainable materials throughout—perfect for a peaceful stay.
Parking is possible in front of the house.

name: Ruim en licht appartement.
description:
Located in the heart of Amsterdam but in peace we offer this spacious and bright apartment. The house spread over the bell floor and the basement features a spacious living room with open kitchen, 2 spacious bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 separate toilets. The house also has a garden of almost 100 m2.

We do not rent our house to everyone, we would like to hear from you why you want to rent our home.

name: Spacious and Bright Apartment
description: Stylish apartment in Amsterdam West, on the edge of the Jordaan. Enjoy the space and natural light. Walking distance to the charming Jordaan, Noordermarkt, and Westerpark, ideal for discovering the city. Modern decor with all amenities for a comfortable stay. The perfect place to relax after a day full of adventure. Book now and experience an unforgettable stay in lively Amsterdam West!

name: NH Collection Amsterdam Barbizon Palace- Family
description: Ideal for families, our Family Room offers ample space and comfort for everyone. Enjoy modern amenities like a rain shower, Air Conditioning and an espresso machine. The plush beds and friendly staff make for a welcoming atmosphere for a memorable family getaway. Room size 30 m2.

description: A little extra space and comfort for your trip to Amsterdam, this Junior Suite offers a bathrobe (for the sauna in the hotel!), Air Condition, an Espresso Machine and a seating corner. The plush beds and friendly staff make for a welcoming atmosphere for a memorable family getaway. Room size 45 m2.

description: A little extra space and comfort for your trip to Amsterdam, this room offers a bathrobe (for the sauna in the hotel!), Air Condition and plush beds. name: Studio in the heart of de Pijp
description: Clean and well equipped studio in De Pijp. Next to Sarphatipark and Albert Cuyp market.  De studio has everything you need and it is located in a lovely street on walking distance to all the hot spots in Amsterdam.

name: Luxury apartment Amsterdam zuid
description:
Apartment is located near Amstel river. It’s just totally renovated and has new kitchen/bathroom. It is furnished with designer furniture like Hästens bed. This is a high-end apartment with one bedroom, suitable for 2 people. 1 bathroom with rainshower and toilet. Livingroom.

Public transport 3 minutes walking. Biking distance of 10-15 minutes to all museums, theatres, shopping areas and restaurants.

Free high speed wifi. It is on the third floor, no elevator. I have a boat and bike to rent

name: Appartement  Hart of Amsterdam
description: This elegant light apartment blends classic charm with modern comfort. It features a bedroom with a queen-size bed, a fully equipped kitchen and cozy living room with a dining table, desk with computer, and a TV corner with a comfortable sofa. Enjoy Wi-Fi and a Sonos sound system. The apartment also includes a stylish bathroom and a separate toilet, ensuring a pleasant stay. (SEND MESSAGE FOR LONG-STAY PRICING)

name: Canal house + Big garden @ Canals
description:
Stunning family house at the back at the canals. The place features 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and huge living room. The modern design kitchen which gives acces to the 230 sqm garden completes it all.

The house is big and offers enough space for everybody so all can enjoy and relax. At the same time you get a homie feel due to the split level layout.

Its location at the back of the building also gives you the peace and relaxation in the hart of the city, you only hear birds chirping when @home

name: easyHotel Amsterdam City Center, Accessible Fam...
Loft design apartment in Centre Museum Quarter
description:
Very spacious and elegant design loft in prime location. The loft is equipped with a luxury kitchen, a great roof terrace with sun all day, equipped with a bbq and big eating area.

The house has been elegantly furnished with art, high quality furniture, a SONOS system on both floors, newest tv's with all international Chanels, floor heating in every room and a great rain shower.

name: Light apartment in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our charming and light-filled apartment located in the West district of Amsterdam. It's our home so expect joyful and personal vibes. The space is perfect for couples or solo travellers, with or without children, looking for a peaceful and cozy place to stay.
A vibrant area with lots of nice bars, the best bakeries & Erasmuspark at walking distance.

name: NEW! Casa Bilyve
description: Enjoy our house in a quiet neighborhood of Amsterdam, 15 min from city center. The ground floor has a large office and garden. The 1st floor offers a spacious living room with open kitchen and access to a terrace. There are 2 children's rooms with luxury bathroom on the 2nd floor. The penthouse on the 3rd floor has a luxury bathroom and gym. Only for cat lovers: you will be sharing it with our Blue Russian cats, Kendi and Bowie, who are independent but like to get a hug and food.

name: Spacious family friendly apartment incl. nursery
description:
Discover Amsterdam from our spacious and bright apartment in East. Within walking distance of De Pijp and the Amstel River, and just a 10-minute bike ride from the city center. Well-connected with public transport, including the subway and Amstel Station nearby.

Enjoy a fully equipped family home offering all you need for a great stay including a nursery

Experience the best of Amsterdam with its vibrant local charm and modern amenities. Book now for a memorable stay!

name: Bright renovated 2Bdr. Great families + couples!
description:
Bright 2-bedroom apartment in lively Amsterdam West, 10–15 min to museums and major hotspots. Cozy in winter underfloor heating.
Great for families or couples: king-bed master, smart kids/guest room with adult bunk and pull-down double. Fully equipped living, kitchen and dining area.

* two real bedrooms
* new bathroom with bath, rain shower & separate WC
* fast Wi-Fi + dedicated workspace
* registered AMS holiday rental

Located on the 3rd floor (traditional Amsterdam stairs, no lift).

name: Renovated Stylish Apartment @ Amsterdam West
description: Welcome to our cozy and spacious apartment in Amsterdam West! Enjoy our beautiful apartment with plenty of natural light, and modern decor. The apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, a stylish living area, and a clean, modern bathroom. Located in a peaceful neighborhood with easy access to public transport, it's perfect for exploring Amsterdam's vibrant city center. Nearby amenities include parks, cafes, and shops. Ideal for solo travelers or couples seeking a relaxing stay!

name: Private room 3 persons shared ap
description: The room is for 3 persons in my shared apartment that is shared with me and possible other guests. Note that I live in the place myself and that you cannot compare it with an hotel. You should know my place is like living with a local. Easy going, everybody is welcome and not very luxurious. A place for free minds. I can give you all the recommendations you like and you can ask me me anything.  We have shops, bars, parks and public transport to any location in Amsterdam 1 minute from my place.

name: Funky house boat
description:
This unique and romantic accommodation right in the city center of Amsterdam gives you the ultimate city experience. You will be staying just a stone's throw from Carré, the Magere Brug, the Utrechtsestraat and have a wonderful view of the Prinsengracht & the Amstel.

By the way, during Gay Pride you are right on the sailing route!

name: Unique loft in Old West
description:
Classic romantic loft on a fantastic location in Amsterdam.

The old west neighbourhood is the most popular place to live for local Amsterdam people, due to it’s central location and proximity to both the city centre as the beautiful Vondelpark.

The romantic loft is fully equipped with bathroom including bath and shower, the newest kitchen equipment and both a wash- and drying machine.

Lovely kingsize bed of the finest quality for a good night’s sleep and a welcome bottle of wine.

name: studio imber
description: Cozy space with private entrance, on the outskirts of Amsterdam. The room features a private bathroom and free parking. You can sit outside on a terrace with lots of greenery and flowers.

name: Large private studio Amsterdam Center, Canal View
description: Spacious studio with private entrance, in the city center, close to Nieuwmarkt with the coziest cafes and restaurants. Located on the oldest and widest canal in Amsterdam, quiet and yet close to restaurants, cafes and shops. Studio with private entrance, kitchen, bathroom, toilet.  Good connection to Schiphol and within walking distance of Centraal Station.

name: Arthouse in de Pijp
description:
Welcome to our peaceful oasis in the vibrant 'De Pijp' neighborhood. This two-story 160m² house features a generous 100m² garden, blending indoor and outdoor living perfectly. Enjoy the porch on the ground floor. At street level, there's space for parking bicycles.
The open-concept main living area includes the kitchen and dining room, leading to the lush garden with an elevated terrace and cozy seating area.
The first floor houses the bedroom, large bathroom, a study and a balcony.

name: Let Your Soul Fly In The Heart Of Amsterdam
description: Let your luxury soul fly at this A-location in Amsterdam's Elandsgracht. This elegant two-bedroom apartment combines classical grace with modern comfort, featuring stained glass windows, plush mattresses, and a sunny south-facing balcony. The apartment accommodates up to 4 guests, it's perfect for both relaxation and exploration. Enjoy artisanal shops and nearby landmarks like the Anne Frank House, then unwind in this tranquil haven in that you can now call 'your home away from home'.

name: Amsterdam city center
description:
This house is a beautiful home in the heart of Amsterdam. Its view of the city will take your breath away: located on the fourth flour in the middle of the city center, you'll get a picturesque peek of Amsterdam just by looking out the windows.

This home has two bedrooms (one with a double bed and one with a sofa bed that definitely works as a double bed).

The living area is spacious, the kitchen is complete and even has a dishwasher, the tv is equipped with smart functions (Netflix etc)

name: Design house with garden & cat
description:
A quiet 3-story dijkhouse, fully renovated by us; an interior designer and artist from Amsterdam. It has a private garden and is located 10 minutes from NDSM ferry to centraal.

We live here full-time, and the house is available when we are away.

Our cat Jonas lives here full-time. We kindly ask guests to feed him each morning (we provide his food). He is very independent and free to come and go by himself. He does like being around people when they are home .

name: Bright 1930s apartment
description:
My home is a characteristic 1930's bright apartment with bay-window and west-facing balcony. It has a spacious kitchen with doors opening towards the balcony. There is a separate office space.
It is located in a quiet, green and safe street within walking distance from the Vondelpark and the popular Oud-West area. Lots of bars, restaurants and good public transport connection to the city center are around the corner.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam-West met 1 kingsize bed
description: Welcome to our charming apartment, ideally located in the lively Mercatorbuurt of Amsterdam-West. This cozy accommodation on the second floor offers everything you need for a comfortable and unforgettable stay in the beautiful capital of the Netherlands. Whether you are a solo traveler or traveling with a partner, this apartment offers a cozy and well-equipped place to stay.

name: Appartement in de Pijp
description: Lovely bright apartment with balcony and spacious kitchen with bar, in the popular De Pijp district in Amsterdam. In this neighborhood, there are many restaurants, pubs, wine bars and shopping streets. It is close to the Albert Cuyp market, the Amstel river, the Sarphatipark and several other parks. The apartment is centrally located in Amsterdam with supermarkets, trams, metro, bus around the corner. Rijksmuseum is also within walking distance!

name: Casa Sereno
description:
Relax and unwind in this peaceful, stylish space.
Welcome to Casa Sereno!

Upon entering, you will be welcomed by a spacious and bright living room, where large windows let in the natural light and offer a beautiful view of the surrounding nature. The decor is minimalist and refined, with carefully selected furniture that embodies comfort and style. Soft colors and good materials dominate the interior, which contributes to a harmonious and warm atmosphere.

name: Appartement adjacent to Vondelpark for 4 guests
description: This unique accommodation has its own style. Located on the Vondelpark in Amsterdam. The apartment consists of 2 bedrooms with 1 bathroom.

name: Westerpark Appartement
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

name: Luxury Family House centre of Amsterdam
description:
In this centrally located accommodation, everything for your family is within reach. Welcome to our cozy family home in the heart of Amsterdam! Our house, located at Nicolaas Maesstraat 115, offers a perfect base for an unforgettable stay in this bustling city.
Space: Our home has three bedrooms, ideal for families. The rooms are bright with ample space and air conditioning.
Kitchen: The fully equipped kitchen is ideal for preparing meals.

name: Apartamento lindo y 3 min del encantador Jordaan
description:
Relax and unwind in this quiet and elegant accommodation. It's ideal for a couple. The location is in a quiet area, without tourists but at the same time very close to everything. Anne Frank's house is just 700 meters away. In just a 3-minute walk you can reach the charming Jordaan neighborhood, with the famous canals and dreamlike architecture.
There is a large supermarket 50 meters away and a greengrocer 20 meters away. Also on the same block as the apartment there is a place that rents bicycles per day.

name: Amsterdam cannel apartment
description: Experience Amsterdam in our bright and spacious apartment on Mauritskade, featuring 5 large front-facing windows that fill the space with natural light. The highlight is the cozy and stylish living room, perfect for relaxing or spending time with friends. Sleeps 4 comfortably with a king-size and a 1.40. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, fast WiFi, a washing machine, and a bath. Conveniently located just 14 minutes by tram from the city center. Hosted by 2 friends excited to welcome you!

name: Heerlijke gezinswoning met tuin
description: In the large, high-ceilinged living room, you can relax with the whole family on the comfortable sofa after a day in the city, play a game at the dining table or have a drink at the bar of the kitchen island. The sun shines all afternoon in the lovely garden, and the park across the street from the house is very suitable for children of all ages to play in the playground, on the soccer field or on the large lawn before bedtime. Our house is located 20 minutes from the city center.

name: Canal Loft in de Pijp
description: Welcome to our bright, stylish apartment on the canals of Amsterdam! This modern 50m² accommodation is located in the bustling Pijp, within walking distance of the Rijksmuseum and countless trendy cafes and boutiques. A metro station is only a 2-minute walk away. Enjoy a quiet environment with beautiful views over the canals. Our neighborhood is lively and diverse; the women downstairs are ladies of the night, but extremely friendly.

name: Elegant apartment in Amsterdam
description:
This elegant apartment is a perfect home base for a single person or a couple on your stay in Amsterdam.

You will have full access to the entire apartment, including a separate bedroom with a queen size bed, a stylish living room with Smart TV (Netflix and Amazon prime included).

The kitchen is equipped with plenty of appliances, cooking stove, oven, Nespresso machine, etc.,

The apartment is located in a peaceful and lovely area with an excellent connection to the city centre (10-15m) .

name: Cosy apartment in Amsterdam-West
description: Our Cosy apartment of 50 sqm is located in De Baarsjes, a vibrant neighbourhood from the 1920s in Amsterdam-West. Around the corner are two green parks (Erasmuspark and Rembrandpark) and the apartment is a 1 min walk from Mercatorplein. Mercatorplein hosts a variety of restaurants, supermarkets and other shops. From there, public trams and busses take you to the centre or museum district in 15 min, departing frequently.

name: Prinsengracht
description:
Beautifully decorated apartment located on the second floor on the famous Prinsengracht in Amsterdam, more center is not possible. A few steps away next to the Anna Frank House. Within walking distance of the Central Station and easily accessible by taxi from Schiphol airport.
Indoor parking space under the house can be rented for an additional €80 per day, but please note that reversing into the parking space is not easy.

name: Modern en licht appartement
description:
Beautiful bright and modern apartment in the Westlandgracht neighborhood. Because of its central location, you can be in the city center, at the airport or other parts of the city in no time. With plenty of restaurants and entertainment venues nearby!

The metro stop is a 5-minute walk away, the tram stop is in front of the door, and by car you can easily reach the highway (A10).

The apartment is located on the fourth floor and can be reached by elevator or stairs. It is single-story and stylishly decorated. The kitchen is fully equipped.

name: Appartement in het centrum van Amsterdam
description: Welcome to my charming two-story apartment in the iconic Jordaan, just 10 minutes from Central Station. Enjoy the nearby Noordermarkt, Westerpark, and picturesque canals. My cozy living room, fully equipped kitchen, and two bedrooms offer a warm atmosphere. The bathroom includes all necessary amenities. The apartment has Wi-Fi, a washing machine, and fresh linens and towels. Perfect for a quiet, comfortable stay in the heart of Amsterdam.

name: Cozy corner apartment parkview
description: This stylish place is perfect for families / couples who are visting the city of Amsterdam. It is centrally located and easy to reach with transport. Closely to the Amstel canal and viewing the Martin Luther King park. The house has been recently renovated and cozy decorated. The location of the house (corner) brings lots of light into the space.

name: Modern cozy two bedroom Amsterdam apartment
description:
Welcome to our two bedroom ground-floor apartment in the heart of cozy Rivierenbuurt! Enjoy downtime in our 60 sqm newly renovated apartment, and explore Amsterdam's best attractions, just a walk, tram, metro or bike ride away.

Located in the most well connected suburb of Amsterdam, this place is perfect for a weekend getaway as well as a family or business trip.
Local recommendations and a manual provided upon booking.

We look forward to hosting you in our lovely apartment!

Z/25/2912228

name: Bright apartment in De Pijp
description:
On the 3rd floor, a 2 bedroom, bright living room with balcony, equipped kitchen, bathroom with shower: 65m2 of calm and comfort, ideally located in the heart of the city!

In a very peaceful street in the sought-after De Pijp district, filled with bars and restaurants, 50m from supermarkets and public transport connecting all the important points of A'dam (train station, museums...) in about 10 minutes, 150m from the Amstel river, 300m from Sarphati park, 500m from the Albert Cuijp market..

name: Stylish flat in Amsterdam Center
description:
A stylish experience at centrally-top located place. Lovely bright and well laid apartment with a spacious sunny balcony at the rear and a french balcony at the front. 3 people can accommodate. 2 in the bedroom, and 1 on the couch in living room.

The neighbourhood is characterised by many great restaurants, cafes, a wide variety of boutique shops. For culture lovers, the Rijksmuseum, Stedelijk Museum, Van Gogh Museum and Concertgebouw are in walking distance. Night out: Pijp is 2 min walk.

name: Modern apartment with garden
description: Enjoy our newly renovated, spacious apartment with a big garden. It's equipped with everything you need to enjoy your stay in Amsterdam! Centrally located in the popular area in Amsterdam West "De Baarsjes", with the Vondelpark, the Rembrandtpark as well as many shops & restaurant at the Overtoom and Helmersbuurt at your doorstep.

name: Sunny 76m² Apartment in Amsterdam Old South
description:
Welcome to our bright, sunny 76m² one-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam Old South!

Enjoy morning & evening sunlight, with views of the peaceful courtyard and historic Olympic Stadium.

Conveniently located near a bus stop (140m from apartment) with direct routes to Schiphol (22 min) & Leidseplein (13 min). 8-min bike to Vondelpark, Amsterdamse Bos & Station Zuid.

Modern amenities, high-speed Wi-Fi, Large (55") smart TV, full kitchen & a cozy atmosphere.

name: Luxueus appartement Amsterdam Zuid
description: Welcome to your home away from home! This stylish and modernly furnished apartment of 85 m² covers the third and fourth floors, has a lovely roof terrace and was completely renovated in 2024. Located in the cozy Hoofddorppleinbuurt, a stone's throw away from the beautiful Vondelpark, it is the ideal base for both a relaxing weekend and a longer stay. Here you can enjoy a perfect mix of comfort, convenience and elegance.

name: Family-Friendly 3-Bed Authentic Home & Garden
description:
Welcome to our charming and authentic 3-bedroom family home! Nestled in a peaceful neighborhood, this spacious retreat offers a modern kitchen, a stylish bathroom, and a cozy living area.

The beautiful garden and patio are perfect for family gatherings and relaxation. Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and tranquility. Enjoy the blend of classic charm and contemporary amenities.

Perfect for families seeking a serene getaway.

Book your stay and make wonderful memories!

name: Charming, light and spacious
description: Stay at this stylish and cozy apartment in a central, charming and non-touristy part of Amsterdam. Recently renovated with love, this flat is clean and equipped with all you need. Enjoy dinner at the long kitchen table, have a cup of coffee at either of 2 balconies in the sun or walk 2 minutes to go for a swim together with many Amsterdam locals. With lots of green and water nearby, this area is a quiet place near the buzz of central Amsterdam. It’s on the 3rd floor, there is no elevator.

name: Familyhome 5 rooms, garden & nearby the city
description:
Welcome to our family home. It is a spacious and comfortable corner house in the green and child-friendly Bos en Lommer area. Featuring four bedrooms (1 children's bedroom), two toilets, and a modern bathroom, kitchen, and garden. It is a child-friendly neighborhood just 15 minutes from the city center.

Supermarkets, bakery, butcher, coffee shops and public transport are within walking distance. After a day in the city, you can enjoy comfort, space and relaxation here.

The perfect base for exploring Amsterdam.

name: Stylish apartment close 2 centre
description:
The appartment is next to the center West-side and is spacious, luxorous and has one bedroom and one officeroom.

Direct area is lively with nice local bars, restaurants and stores just around the cornerstreet Jan van Galenstraat. Within 10-15 cycling minutes distance away from :

- popular Food hall in Oud-west area
- beautiful old Jordaan (centre area) and canals
- Central heart, Dam square or Leidseplein , Museum Quarterarea.
- Or visit the Westerpark and exploit the old Westergasfactory.

name: Lovely and light Amsterdam Apartment
description: Experience the best of Amsterdam in our light and spacious De Pijp apartment! With high ceilings and a serene ambiance, this charming space features a luxurious hotel-style bathroom, a fully equipped kitchen, and a delightful outdoor area. Located next to Sarphatipark and the bustling Albert Cuyp Market, you'll be steps away from trendy cafes, boutique shops, and vibrant local culture. Ideal for couples or solo travelers, book now for a memorable Amsterdam adventure!

name: modern appartement
description: Hello, I would like to welcome you to my apartment. The house is located on the water, has been recently renovated and equipped with every comfort. From the apartment, you can reach the city center within 15 minutes by public transportation and Schiphol Airport within 20 minutes by train. Bicycles can be rented around the corner, and don't forget to take a walk along the banks of the Sloterplas. Feel free to contact me if you have any other questions!

name: Charming & authentic dike house
description: A hidden gem: authentic, charming dike house at the beautiful and peaceful Nieuwendammerdijk in popular Amsterdam Noord. Surrounded by nature and water, with good and quick connections to the city centre (by subway, ferry or bike). A modern interior design, fully equiped and with an all-day sunny rooftop terrace. Available for a family of 3 including one bedroom and one nursery. Option to place a camping bed in nursery to add a 3rd adult.

name: Studio Rapenburg
description:
Enjoy the calmer side of Amsterdam at this beautiful 1 bedroom apartment in a quiet street in the center!
Close to all amenities, bike rentals, tourist locations, and canals, this quaint musicians house is a perfect place to create, recharge, relax, sight-see, enjoy the summer sunshine, and discover a new side of this magical city.

name: Familie appartement in het park
description:
Relax in this bright, spacious and stylish apartment in Amsterdam-West, surrounded by greenery. The 100 m2 apartment is equipped with a luxurious open kitchen (including all necessities), with 2 bedrooms and a sunny balcony. The apartment is stylish and modernly furnished, and the office space offers the possibility for a 3rd bedroom.

The house is located in the popular district of Baarsjes, with many coffee shops, restaurants, stores and public transportation within walking distance.

name: Fijne gezinswoning in Amsterdam!
description:
Relax with the whole family in this lovely house in Amsterdam Noord, with all the comforts! The house has a front and back garden, 3 bedrooms.
We live here happily with our children and would like to let other families enjoy our house and Amsterdam!
You can reach the ferry in 10 minutes, which takes you directly to the city center in 10 minutes! Nearby you will find various restaurants and in nature reserve Twiske you can enjoy cycling and swimming!

name: Gerenoveerd appartement in Amsterdam zuid
description:
This completely renovated apartment in Amsterdam South is now available for rent.
Do you want to enjoy Amsterdam but still stay in a quiet area? Then this is your place! Public transport takes you easily and quickly to the city center.
The amsterdam forest is around the corner. Also, the Gelderlandplein is within walking distance, here you will find all your daily necessities.

NO SMOKING (also not on the balcony) and parties/loud music ALLOWED.

name: Apartment in Amsterdam with airco
description: Renovated apartment in Amsterdam-West, close to bus stop and Rembrandt Park. A supermarket is just 50 meters away, also a lot of coffee spots. This charming apartment offers a cozy retreat while still being near the city's vibrant attractions. The bedroom, located at the rear, ensures a peaceful night's sleep and features air conditioning. Enjoy the west-facing balcony with afternoon/evening sun. Stream your favorite shows with Chromecast. Ideal for both relaxation and exploring Amsterdam.

name: Bright central apartment by Museum square
description:
Bright and stylish Dutch apartment right next to Museum square. Walking distance to the Pijp, Vondelpark, and public transport stops.

Close to many good restaurants and bars, for any tips let me know and I’ll share my top list with you :)

name: Cosy apartment - Vondelpark
description: Located in the vibrant Oud-West neighborhood of Amsterdam, this apartment offers a small but cozy bedroom (bed 160x200), a dining room with a canal view, a comfortable sitting room, a fully equipped kitchen, a balcony, and a bathroom. Nestled in a peaceful yet central area near Vondelpark, you'll be just two blocks away from some of the city’s finest restaurants, bars, and cafes. Convenient tram access is also nearby. The 9 streets - 25 min walk / 15 min tram

name: NLS Amsterdam
description: Enjoy a stylish entire home experience, located in the Jordaan-heart of Amsterdam.

name: Lovely Family Home w. Garden
description:
Breathe in, out and settle down in our lovely family home in Amsterdam's quietest residential area 'Tuindorp'. With a spacious garden, reseverd parking and a stone's throw from 'NDSM' (with a 13 min ferry ride into Central Station) this is the perfect refuge for your family's Amsterdam visit.

Our place has a master bedroom, a bedroom with 2 toddler beds, and a 3rd bedroom with a single bed that can be transformed into a double.

name: Zimmer in einem charmanten Grachtenhaus (33)
description:
Stay where all Amsterdam residents want to live. Small private room in a historic canal house. Close to many museums, Rembrandsplein and yet wonderfully quiet. Room with shower and toilet en suite.

This room is part of a licensed guesthouse.

name: Wilhelmina Garden Home
description: In this centrally located accommodation you can find everthing you need. From the beautifull Vondelpark where you can enjoy the nice peacefull atmosphere, to Leidseplein where you can go shopping or enjoy the nightlife. The public transport is also within reach if you want to enjoy the whole of Amsterdam. The neighbourhood is vibrant, with many trendy bars and restaurants where you can enjoy many different kind of cuisines.

name: Lovely Apartment with Garden for Family/Friends
description:
Welcome to our delightful 90m² apartment, perfectly situated in the vibrant southwest of Amsterdam! Ideal for families, friends, business travelers, offering comfort for up to 4 guests.
- **Prime Location:**
- **Sunny Terrace and Garden:**
- **Spacious Living Area:**
- **Fully Equipped Kitchen:**
- **Two Comfortable Bedrooms:**
- **Modern Bathroom:**
- **Convenient Amenities:**
**Excellent Connectivity to airport and central station**
Experience the charm of Amsterdam from our lovely apartment!

name: Boutique Amsterdam Room
description: Nice room in a quiet neighborhood, close to the center. Beautiful place to unwind in the evening after a wonderful day of sightseeing in Amsterdam. Picturesque restaurants nearby offer the possibility for an intimate dinner.

name: Fam house city center musea area
description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place. Parks, markets,culture, canals, musea,play gardens,all Theaters. Room/Beds for 5. 2x beds 120/160/200 1x 80/140cm. Parking/elevator/public transport

name: Super central apartment sleeps 4
description: Entire apartment, sleeps 4. Right in the heart of the city center overlooking Nieuwmarkt, Amsterdam's oldest square! This centrally located entire appartement offers privacy and everything for your family or group of friends. Perfect for 4 people, fully equipped kitchen! 5 minutes walk to Dam Square and Central Station. The apartment is located on the second floor of a monumental building with lots of charm and offering stunning views over Nieuwmarkt area and  the castle! Steep stairs.

name: Houseboat Josja
description:
Beautiful houseboat from 1925, in the center of Amsterdam

Our houseboat Josja is one of the most characteristic boats on the canals of Amsterdam. Although it is over 100 years old, we take good care of it. Enjoy the beautiful neighborhood, De Jordaan, and all of Amsterdam is easily accessible on foot. Please note: we live on this boat most of the year, and we appreciate you treating it with the respect it deserves.

name: Stylish apartment on a canal in Central Amsterdam
description:
1 bedroom apartment on the outskirts of the Jordaan

Centrally located with easy access to everything in the city. Quiet inside and you can enjoy views of the city from the roof terrace.

Getting here:
By car - carpark on our road called Q Park Europarking
By flight - 397 bus to Elandsgracht
By train - 17 tram from Centraal station to Kinkerstraat

*There are currently roadworks on our road the Marnixstraat which are causing disruption with travel and access

name: Houseboat "Ajuna" | Stay on the City Center Canals
description: Charming and cozy houseboat with two patios located in the city center of Amsterdam. The boat is situated in a delightful neighborhood, with all the city's highlights within walking distance. It's the perfect base to experience this beautiful city and enjoy the unique living on the water. Ideal for solo travelers or couples.

name: Aparthotel North, Cozy Studio for 2 Guests
description:
Discover Aparthotel North, steps from Adam Tower in vibrant Amsterdam. Strategically located, just 2.1 km from A'DAM Lookout and 5 km from Rembrandt House. Explore landmarks like Basilica of St. Nicholas, Dam Square, and Museum Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder, all within 7 km.

Unwind in modern comfort with amenities like flat-screen TV, microwave, kettle, and coffee maker. Immerse yourself in the city's charm in our smoke-free units. Book now for an unforgettable Amsterdam experience!

name: Characteristic 1BR Apartment @ Amsterdam Oud-West
description: A spacious 1-bedroom apartment of 68m², featuring high ceilings, a large bedroom, and balconies at the front and back. It boasts a classic style with ceiling ornaments and fireplaces. The apartment is fully equipped for an extended stay, including kitchen supplies, a desk, washer/dryer, iron & board, and more. Located in a great area, it’s within walking distance to the Jordaan, Vondelpark and more. The neighborhood is vibrant, with excellent restaurants and bars.

name: Houseboat for rent in Amsterdam!
description:
Houseboat for rent in Amsterdam!

Would you also like to experience what it is like to walk through the bustling center of Amsterdam one day and wake up on a houseboat the next day? On the houseboat where you can enjoy your breakfast outside on the deck, dive straight into the water, go paddle boarding and enjoy the Markermeer!

name: Peaceful Urban Oasis Near Parks, Water & City Life
description: Enjoy our peaceful urban oasis in Amsterdam West with easy access to vibrant city life. This spacious (169 m2) home offers a bright living area, modern kitchen, 4 bedrooms, two bathrooms, a library/TV-room and a large private garden. Just a few steps away from Sloterpark and Sloterplas, and close to shops, cafés, and public transport for easy trips to the city centre. Perfect for couples, small groups or families seeking comfort, space, and convenience.

name: Great views, city center, sleeps 4 people!
description: This entire apartment right at Nieuwmarkt in city center has everything you need for a great stay in Amsterdam! Everything Amsterdam has to offer is within walking distance. Apartment at 1st floor. You have the entire apartment. Some stairs to climb, there is no elevator. One large bed and 2 single beds (bunk bed). Fully equipped kitchen, modern (open) bathroom, very comfortable, situated at the 1st floor. Please keep in mind the bathroom has no door, but the bedroom door can be locked.

name: Serene Modern Design Apt @ Park in Trendy Center
description:
Stay in a beautiful romantic Amsterdam apartment in the city center/De Pijp (very trendy neighbourhood), with a private entrance, rooftop terrace at the Sarphatipark.

Features 2 bedrooms; with a large king-size bed for 2 persons and with a normal 2 person bed. Elegant herringbone floors, a designer kitchen, and a stylish bathroom. Dedicated workspace. Prime De Pijp location near Sarphatipark, cafés, and the Albert Cuyp Market.

Needs to be quiet/calm inside after 10:00 PM due to neighbors

name: Amsterdam Lakeview House
description:
Big townhouse, carefully designed and tastefully furnished. A home away from home. Quiet neighborhood, near shops, restaurants, a beach and the trams that takes you to Central Station in 15 minutes. 40 min by car to the Keukenhof and the tulip and bulb fields, which start blooming in march.
Suitable for a familie of 4, or 2 couples. We have 2 cats who hope you'll take care of them.

name: Garage BnB
description:
Garage BnB is located in a former garage. Centrally, yet quietly located. Wenoffer everything you can expect from a luxury stay. From the perfect king size bed with
beautiful percale bedding to a luxurious bathroom with rain shower. And from drinking your Nespresso from handmade tableware to the green city terrace. Garage BnB has a unique location
in the lovely Weesperzijdebuurt. Lots of nice bars and restaurants around the corner and less than a 5-minute walk from Amstel Station.

name: Modern Canal Villa Amsterdam
description: Large, modern, spacious and architecturally renovated villa of 185m2 in Amsterdam Noord.  Large living room with lots of plants, modern kitchen and large windows to enjoy the panoramic views over a lush large garden and the water. 4 spacious bedrooms overlooking the garden and 2 modern bathrooms. On the beautiful Landsmeerdijk, dating from 1410, part of the old sea dikes in Amsterdam. A quiet, charming neighborhood just 15 minutes by bike from Amsterdam CS and 10 minutes from NDSM.

name: Gezinswoning
description:
Great family home east of the city centre with garden. Nice, quiet area with lots of green area and also nice restaurants, bars and shops nearby.

We have 2 cats that live mainly outside, but would be great if you can feed them (and give a cuddle 😊)

name: Charming 3 bed appartment with luxury mattress
description:
3 room, first floor appartment in the middle of the Pijp.

Hall with access to all rooms. Spacious and bright living room at the front with French doors. Fully equipped kitchen with 4-burner gas stove, coffee machine, dishwasher, oven, washing machine, dryer. Spacious balcony's, fitted wardrobes, luxury latex mattress, 2 very comfortable double air mattress.

Located in the cozy Pijp, lots of shops, restaurants, deli's & supermarkets around the corner. Easily accessible by public transport.

name: Charmant & licht appartement - Amsterdam West
description:
Welcome to our nice apartment in the Baarsjes, Amsterdam West!

This open house has just been renovated and combines a fully equipped country kitchen with a bright living room. There is one spacious bedroom with a comfortable queen size bed. The bedroom is adjacent to a balcony on the inner gardens, with luxury chairs where you can enjoy the sun. The modern bathroom is also new and has a lovely rain shower.
Enjoy the Vondelpark, nice cafes and coffee shops nearby.

name: Unique Canal House
description: Very spacious Canal House located in the city centre on the Amstel river. Best views of the city. Located on walking distance of all the sights of the city (Museumsquare, Heineken Experience, Anne Frank house, etc). House consists of a large living room w. balcony and unique canalview,  luxurious kitchen w. outside dining area, 4 large bedrooms (2 w. kingsize beds), large bathroom w. bathtub and 2 separate toilets. Many restaurants and terraces nearby. Perfect for a couples or a family holiday.

name: Modern City Apartment
description:
Beautiful 50 m2 apartment centrally located, 3 minute walk from the Leidse square & 5 minute walk from the Museum district. It has a village feel with the buzz of lots of nice coffee places and restaurants. Located on the first floor of a typical Dutch building from the 1910’s. You have the entire floor to yourself. You can open the balcony doors to let the sounds of the city in. If you prefer more stillness, just close the soundproof windows.
Available: wifi, chromecast, washing/drying machine

name: Fab Stay With Rooftop Terrace
description:
Welcome to our charming apartment in the heart of the trendy Amsterdam neighborhood, Het Barsjes!

Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space after exploring the busy streets of Amsterdam! It is located right next to Rembrandtpark and only 10 mins away by public transport from Leidseplein and the historical center of Amsterdam. This one bedroom, one bathroom apartment with a roof-top terrace offers style, convenience and tranquility at the same time.

name: Apartment next to the canal
description:
This unique accommodation has its own style on the canal. Enjoy your coffee in the morning overlooking the ringdijk. Fully equipped and right in the center of Amsterdam East. The tram that takes you to the city center within 15 minutes is less than a 3-minute walk. Parks and cafes are all within easy reach.
The study behind the stained glass doors, which is depicted between the photos, is also the second bedroom, which I build when there are guests.

name: Spacious Apartment with Garden
description:
Welcome to your stylish retreat in the heart of Amsterdam Zuid!
This cozy, renovated ground-floor apartment is perfect for couples or couples with children. Make yourself at home in the living room with open kitchen or relax in the sunny 75m2 garden. The house has a large bedroom, a modern bathroom with a seperate toilet and second bedroom with sleeping bed. Perfectly situated close to shops, cafes, Vondelpark, and busy areas such as the Pijp, West and Zuidas making it easy to explore the city.

name: JoyJoyJoy design studio/Lucky Living/Canal terrace
description:
Make your stay in Amsterdam unforgettable by staying at this uniquely ecolicious boutique studio with the joyjoyjoy lifestyle. Filled with an eclectic mix of art and design.
Located at the most picturesque canal, famous for his seven bridges, in a local setting with the Amstelveld as your garden, the most romantic square in the city.
But next to the hot spots like Rembrandtplein, Leidseplein, Rijksmuseum and Dam Square. And also next to the hippest area the Pijp and the gentrificated area East.

name: Licht en warm appartement in het pittoreske West
description:
Bright and distinctive apartment in the quiet area of the Erasmus Park, with everything you need for a wonderful stay.

The apartment is located in the picturesque Amsterdam-West area, surrounded by a wide range of restaurants, bars, parks, and shops. It is the perfect combination of the vibrancy of the city and the tranquility of the apartment.

Sloterdijk train station is close by and several public transport lines bring you to the city centre within 15 minutes.

name: Licht appartement met zonnige tuin
description:
An oasis of peace in the busy city! This beautifully renovated apartment features a sunny south-facing backyard.
Located in the quiet Rivierenbuurt, with all the facilities you need around the corner, including a wide range of restaurants and shops. The apartment is a 4-minute walk from the RAI Conference Center. Public transportation is nearby, with easy access to the city (7 minutes by metro) or the airport. Free parking on Sundays.

name: easyHotel Amsterdam Arena Boulevard, Family Qua...
Bright room for families and friends in A'dam 3
description: You can stay in this PRIVATE room by yourself or with your friends and family.  When you book this room, you have the room for yourself, with private shower and toilet. We are an education center in Amsterdam-East. When you stay with us, you do not only get a comfortable, private room for an affordable price in Amsterdam, but also support a progressive institute organizing trainings on topics such as global justice, feminism, and LGBTQI liberation. No AC in the room.

name: Stijlvol appartement aan het water in Amsterdam
description:
Fantastic waterfront apartment. Spacious and modern home offers comfort, space and tranquility and is located in the middle of the city. View of the greenery and the water of the canal, two bedrooms, a spacious living room, open kitchen and balcony.

The Rijpgracht is in a very good location on the city center side of Amsterdam West. Diversity of shops, coffee shops, restaurants and city parks in the immediate vicinity. Jordaan and city center are a few minutes away by bike.

Permit number: Z/25/2909691

name: Renovated Jordaan house with portable a/c units
description:
*Brand new renovated house*

This beautiful, luxuriously-renovated, historic house is located in heart of the Jordaan, one of Amsterdam's most beautiful neighbourhoods and a Unesco World Heritage Site.

name: Cosy appartement in the city center!
description: Enjoy easy access to everything from this perfectly located home base.

name: Sunny Apartment with Garden
description:
We warmly welcome you to our cozy house in Amsterdam West, chosen by Time Out as one of the 10 coolest neighborhoods in the world!

The house is located in a quiet neighborhood, next to the always lively Westerpark. The area also features many shops and restaurants. Public transport around the corner quickly connects you to all corners of Amsterdam, including the City Center, de Pijp, Noord, and Oost.

Our house is a wonderful base to explore the city.

name: Spacious, clean apartment in the heart of the city
description:
Live like a local in the Nine Streets in this recently renovated, spacious first floor apartment.

Perfect location for the UNESCO world heritage canal ring, the Rijksmuseum & Van Gogh museums, Anne Frank's house etc. Step right outside and you're in the centre of the city, nestled among leading hotels, restaurants, cafes and shops.

Key pick up between 15:00 and 19:00. Key pick up may be possible after 19:00 for an additional fee but must be confirmed in advance of arrival.

name: Ruime woning in groen Amsterdam
description:
Relax with the whole family in this peaceful accommodation.

This spacious bright house is a lovely family home with a unique location in the quiet green Amsterdam Noord. Experience the perfect mix of city and nature in this ideally located home.
The house has a large garden that borders a large playing field. It is only 3 kilometers by bike from the city and within 5 minutes you can cycle to the beautiful nature of Waterland.

name: Amsterdam Appartement
description: Tastefully and completely newly renovated 1930s apartment centrally located in Amsterdam. Very spacious for 2 people, nice, sunny and just like home. Perfect for a workaway or a long weekend enjoying Amsterdam. Close to the water and to Amstel Station. There is always a parking space, and there are many restaurants, cafes, and shops within walking distance.

name: Family home Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our cozy family home at Johan Herman Doornstraat 27! This charming home offers comfort and convenience for the whole family. Enjoy the spacious living room, fully equipped kitchen and cozy bedrooms. The sunny garden is perfect for relaxation and games. Located in a quiet neighborhood, close to shops, parks and public transportation, this is the ideal base for your stay. Feel at home and enjoy an unforgettable time!

name: Charming canal-view apartment in Jordaan
description:
My charming, bright and modern 2-bedroom apartment with canal view is the perfect base to experience Amsterdam. The apartment is smoke-free and has no pets.

Located in a quiet corner of the Jordaan near Oud-West and Vondelpark, it combines a peaceful setting with all the city’s highlights within walking distance. From here you can easily reach the Anne Frank House, Nine Streets, Dam Square, Ten Katemarkt, Vondelpark and the major museums.

Ideal for solo travellers, couples or a small family.

name: Airy Amsterdam Apartment
description: Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space.  Located in the adorable Maasstraat neighbourhood.  Minutes walk to bike rental, bakery, wine shop, grocers, and excellent coffee.  Well connected by transit, it's 2 minute walk to the tram or subway.   Inside the city ring, but stay where the locals live.  A few tram stops from the lively de Pijp neighbourhood, but come home to sleep in a quiet space.

name: Special house Amsterdam North
description:

Wonderful bright apartment with south-facing balcony, located in the charming Rivierenbuurt. The spacious home with an open kitchen and dining and living room offers you a warm home during your stay in Amsterdam.

The cozy neighborhood offers various restaurants, parks and the Albert Cuyp market is within walking distance. With good connections by public transport and bicycle rental around the corner, all of Amsterdam is easy to explore.

The city center is less than 10 minutes away by bike, and Schiphol is also easy to reach.

name: Bright canal-facing apartment
description:
Enjoy your time in Amsterdam by staying right on the canal in the amazing Jordaan area. This comfortable and spacious apartment dates back to 1916. Ever since, it has been renovated in an industrial style with a concrete floor and several wooden accents.

In summer you’re able to sit out front on the canal and enjoy all-day sun the Amsterdam way. Outside of the summer, there’s a patio in the back for the city’s inevitable cooler days. The apartment has natural lighting from both sides.

You will stay in one of the most beautiful places on the canal in the popular neighborhood of the Jordaan. Experience what it's like to stay here, right in the city center and with the nicest shops, bars and restaurants a few minutes' walk away, in our cozy B&B of 15m2 and a spacious bathroom of 5m2. It is our honor to let you experience the charm and liveliness of Amsterdam in optima forma.
