description:
Charming studio apartment located in the vibrant and lively De Pijp area of Amsterdam! Situated on the first floor, featuring its own entrance.

Inside, you’ll find everything you need for comfortable urban living. The well-equipped kitchen boasts modern amenities, including an oven, dishwasher, and induction cooktop. The space features a cozy queen bed (140x200 cm).

The studio also includes a compact yet functional bathroom, toilet, you have all the essentials at your fingertips.

name: Stylish Amsterdam Oud-West Apartment
description:
Welcome to our comfortable apartment in the heart of De Baarsjes area in Amsterdam Oud-West, one of the city's most beloved districts.

Surrounded by charming cafes and boutiques, you’ll experience the best of Amsterdam right at your doorstep. Other iconic areas such as De Jordaan or Vondelpark are just a short walk away. Convenient bus and tram stops around the corner make exploring even easier.

name: Jordaan 2P Capsule • Private Bathroom & Toilet
description: This amazing Suite is situated in the picturesque area called the Jordaan, one of downtown Amsterdam's most charming neighborhoods. The interior is stylish and modern, and overall the Suite is suitable for 2 guests. This suite is located in the heart of Amsterdam which will provide you a true local experience while being close to all major sights.

name: Jordaan 4 Person Suite • Next to Leidseplein
description: This amazing apartment is situated in the picturesque area called the Jordaan, one of downtown Amsterdam's most charming neighborhoods. The interior is stylish and modern, and overall the apartment is spacious and will make you feel right at home. This apartment is located in the heart of Amsterdam which will provide you a true local experience while being close to all major sights.

name: Boat suite, A Unique Houseboat Stay - Amsterdam BB
description: Hello! We’re Renske and Tim, and we warmly welcome you to Amsterdam BB (Bed&Boat), our cozy and modern b&b located on our houseboat, Kadans. Nestled on the peaceful KNSM Island at Levantkade, our home offers the unique experience of staying on the water while still being close to the heart of Amsterdam.

name: Cozy apartment with canal view in a quiet street
description:
We are happy to rent out our apartment. Centrally located and you can discover the entire city by bike, on foot or by public transport. Close to everything there is to see in Amsterdam, but in a quiet street.
From the balcony there is a view of the Admiralengracht. There are several catering establishments within walking distance, but there is also good public transport nearby.
Perfect for a couple who wants to discover Amsterdam!
We are very flexible so feel free to reach out!

name: Groot, gezellig appartement bij het Oosterpark
description: Spacious and pleasant light upstairs house with two spacious bedrooms, living room and lots of outdoor space. Our nice apartment is located in the middle of the lively Oosterparkbuurt around the corner from the Oosterpark and Park Frankendael. Nearby are many nice restaurants and close to the metro and the trams that go to downtown. Please note: not suitable for people with walking difficulties, the apartment is accessible via 3 steep Amsterdam stairs without elevator. NOT suitable for parties or smoking

name: Luxury apartment with garden, sauna & work space
description:
Luxury apartment with private garden, sauna and workplace in a quiet street of bustling Amsterdam West.

The apartment is equipped with everything, and you will find that you can relax in the middle of the city.

From the centrally located location, you can be in the city center of Amsterdam within 10 minutes by bike or public transportation. But the neighborhood itself also has plenty to offer, from green parks and cozy breakfast spots to the best bakeries & coffee shops in the city.

name: Live like a local in Amsterdam
description: Live like a local in Hoofddorppleinbuurt, a hidden gem in Amsterdam’s vibrant south. This family-friendly neighbourhood offers the perfect blend of convenience and charm, with bars, restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacies and boutique shops all within walking distance. Easy access to public transport puts you minutes away from the city centre, museums and shopping districts.

name: Historical Vondelpark Apartment
description: This beautiful apartment in the center of Amsterdam has a lovely outdoor terrace and is located next to the Vondelpark. Nearby are the nicest restaurants and coffee shops in Amsterdam. With a large new kitchen, cozy dining area and the supermarket at 150m walk, you can also prepare delicious meals at home. Also there is a nice light sitting area and workplace.

name: Rosie’s Renovated Apartment nearby the Vondelpark
Woning in Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our spacious and cozy house on the water in Amsterdam. Enjoy the tranquility of the neighborhood while still being close to the bustling city life. With multiple bedrooms and a sunny roof terrace, this is the perfect place for families and friends. Relax with stunning views and take advantage of the nature around you, ideal for walks and bike rides. Book your stay now and experience the unique combination of comfort, tranquility and the charm of Amsterdam!

name: Lovely room in central Amsterdam
description:
Charming and cozy room in an apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. I am offering a great room to experience a central, yet not touristy neighborhood of Amsterdam, for a fun, yet peaceful experience. The apartment is very close to Amsterdam Centraal, is within walking distance to grocery stores, cafes and public transportation in the lovely neighborhood of Plantage/ Weesperbuurt. The apartment is 5 minutes away from Artis and the Holocaust Museum.

Registration Number: 0363 045B D331 103E 3AE4

name: Spacious Apartment with a Dedicated Workspace
description:
Spacious apartment in the beautiful Rivierenbuurt, located on a quite street directly facing a small park. Restaurants and shops are just around the corner and it's only a 10 minute walk to the hip de Pijp neighbourhood. The location is well connected with a metro station, tram station and a train station couple minutes away.

The apartment is fully renovated, has a dedicated work place, spacious garden and is located on the first floor with it's own entrance (no stairs which is a big plus).

name: Modern & cosy apartment in the heart of Amsterdam
description: Bright, cozy apartment in the Heart of Amsterdam. Centrally located, Enjoy trendy restaurants, bars, boutique shops, and the daily Dappermarkt nearby. Steps away from the green Oosterpark, perfect for relaxation. A comfortable space ideal for exploring Amsterdam while enjoying a lively and local vibe.

name: Luxe groot appartement nabij RAI
description:
The central location is just a 2-minute walk to the RAI (for trade fairs and public transportation) and around the corner from the cozy Maasstraat & Scheldestraat.

The double upstairs apartment has a bright, quiet appearance and has every comfort. The apartment has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and 2 separate toilets. On the top floor, there is a spacious roof terrace with a seating area, dining table and barbecue. The apartment starts on the 2nd floor.

name: Living on the waterfront
description: The spacious living room with spectacular waterfront view and combined open kitchen is a place where everybody feels at home.

name: Cozy and stylish loft in the Jordaan area
description: Experience true Amsterdam charm in our cozy 2-bedroom apartment in the heart of Jordaan, perfect for up to 3 guests. With its traditional steep staircase, stylish, comfortable interior, and slightly lower ceilings, this apartment captures the essence of Amsterdam’s heritage with a cozy and authentic charm. Step outside to explore the iconic canals, unique boutiques, cafes, and renowned attractions—all just moments away. Enjoy an authentic stay in one of Amsterdam’s most beloved neighborhoods!

name: Boutique-Style Apartment in The Pijp
description:
Step into this warm, light-filled home where elegance meets creativity. The space blends contemporary design with charming details—ornate mirrors, curated artwork, and warm wooden floors.

The bedroom is a light-filled sanctuary overlooking leafy streets. Large windows, high ceilings, and soft neutral tones make it a calming retreat after a day of exploring.

With its central location, welcoming vibe, and a touch of artistic flair, this is more than just a stay—it’s an experience.

name: Heerlijk appartement (90m2) dichtbij Vondelpark
description: Comfortable and quiet apartment 90m2 with sheltered city garden on the ground floor in the cozy neighborhood 'Oud-West'. The neighborhood has a wide variety of restaurants, cafes and shops. Museums (including Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh), cinema, galleries, food halls and concept stores within walking or cycling distance. The Vondelpark and public transportation are within 2-4 minutes walking distance. Tram goes around the corner to Leidseplein (5 minutes) or NS/Metro station from where Schiphol can be reached in about 10 minutes.

name: Luxe apartment with garden&bath
description: Luxe apartment on the ground floor with 2 bedrooms. One has a bath and show, the smaller room have only a shower.  Large living area with kitchen island and garden connected. Situated in quiet street in the popular Olympic neighborhood (few minutes walking from the olympic stadium) and 15 minutes walking from the lovely Vondelpark.

name: 2-bedroom Renovated Apartment 80m2
description:
Beautiful, fully renovated apartment in Amsterdam!

Spacious apartment of 80m², renovated in June 2024. The apartment overlooks a quiet, green neighborhood, close to the city center. The Flevopark is within 3 minutes' walking distance.

Equipped with a luxury kitchen with cooking island, electric hob, combi-steam oven, Quooker tap and large freezer.

The bathroom has a spacious rain shower and separate bathtub.

1.5 bedroom, with desk and workspace

Located on the 3rd floor with elevator.

name: Ruime familiewoning aan het park
description: This stylish ground floor house is quiet and centrally located in one of the most beautiful streets of Amsterdam on the famous Vondelpark. Restaurants, the major museums, the Concertgebouw and city center are all within walking distance.

name: Modern appartement
description:
Looking for a comfortable apartment with lots of privacy, well laid out and a nice location?!

The apartment is on the ground floor, so no stairs with luggage.
The sunny living room has an open kitchen and is equipped with a combi microwave/oven, and a 4-burner gas stove. There is also a washing machine. The bathroom is equipped with a toilet and a rain shower.

name: Cityloftbolo
description:
Cityloftbolo
Contact me before sending a request (I don't always meet the 24-hour deadline).
Cityloftbolo for videos and discount.
Feel at home in my loft-style apartment in Bos & Lommer. Renovated end of 2024, with a bright living room opening to the hallway and adjacent bedroom. No door, but thick curtains provide privacy and block light. Kitchen with dishwasher, oven, washing machine. Smart thermostat, central heating, robot and stick vacuum. 100 Mbps internet.

name: Stylish 1BR apt ground floor
description:
This newly renovated apartment is on the ground floor, it has a fully equipped open plan kitchen. French doors opening up to a beautiful private garden with patio and 2 comfortable chairs.

The bedroom is spacious, and also has doors leading in to the private garden.

Supermarkets, shops, restaurants, coffee places are all within a 5 to 10min walk. The apartment is in a safe and quiet area very close to the city center.

A true hidden gem!

name: Amsterdam Chic Budget Studio 1 Bedroomonly
description:
Welcome to our beautifully renovated home at Jaap Edenstraat 24, perfect for your Amsterdam getaway! This cozy house offers comfortable accommodations for 2 people, with own bathroom and own Kitchen on the Top floor and all the modern comforts you need for a relaxing stay.

ATTENTION IT IS ONLY ONE BEDROOM

name: Sunny and Vibrant Home in Amsterdam
description: A sunlit, stylish one-bedroom tucked into a quiet corner of Bos en Lommer. A long private balcony runs the length of the apartment, with doors from both the living room and the bedroom: your own outdoor strip for morning coffee and slow evenings. Fully renovated kitchen, walk-in rainfall shower, light wood floors, and warm mid-century touches throughout. Two minutes from Erasmuspark, ten from Westerpark, fifteen by bike to the canals. Sleeps up to four. My actual home, not a rental property.

name: Luxurious appartment in centre
description:
Luxurious 1-Bedroom Apartment in Amsterdam Centre

Experience the charm and comfort of this elegant 1-bedroom apartment in a quiet yet central Amsterdam location, nestled between Utrechtsestraat and the Amstel River. Ideal for both relaxation and productivity, this apartment offers a perfect blend of modern amenities and historic charm. With a spacious living room, luxurious bathroom, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private rooftop terrace, this apartment is designed for both leisure and work.

name: Charming & spacious 2-bedroom with garden
description:
Experience Amsterdam like a local in our stylish 2-bedroom apartment, perfectly located in the vibrant Baarsjes neighborhood.

On the ground floor with a cozy souterrain, this fully furnished home blends charm, comfort, and convenience — ideal for couples, friends, or families.

Two spacious souterrain bedrooms offer peaceful nights, while upstairs you’ll find a bright living space, fully equipped kitchen, and tasteful décor that makes you feel at home.

name: Japandi Zen Sanctuary
description:
This mid century modern home combines the tranquility of nature with the warmth of thoughtfully designed interiors. Relax in the spacious living room, unwind with a movie on the projector or settle into the cozy lounge chair with a good book.

The kitchen is a blend of sophistication and functionality, complete with high-end appliances, marble countertops, and curated art.

There's a bright, functional workspace offering a comfortable setup with an ergonomic chair and a monitor for productivity.

name: Top Apartment in Museum Quarter
description: The apartment is located Museums area in Amsterdam - top location - very classy and quite - but still in the middle of everything. It is located near all the famous museums (Van Gogh, Rijks, Stedelijk etc), the schick area of De Pijp where you can find lot of restaurant, bars, and the famous market of Albert Cuyp. It is also very close to Leidsplein and other touristic attractions. And in case you don't want to walk there is high availability of near-by public transport to basically everywhere.

name: Bright & Spacious - Ground Floor + Garden
description:
Be welcome in our spacious, bright apartment which will suit a couple, two friends or relatives. A private space for you to relax while discovering Amsterdam. Very close to the metro taking you into the city center within minutes, in a quiet neighborhood.

Please note our cat is mentioned in the reviews, but she doesn’t live here anymore. So no cat!

Amsterdam-Noord itself is the new place to be with great restaurants and bars, and not touristy. The apartment has everything you may need.

name: Luxury Duplex by Rijksmuseum with Roof Terrace
description: Luxury 125 m² duplex in the Museum Quarter with two king bedrooms, a marble kitchen with sparkling and boiling water taps, a bright living area and a private rooftop terrace. Located on a quiet residential street next to Museumplein, PC Hooftstraat and Vondelpark. Fully equipped with fast wifi, air conditioning, washer, dryer and designer interiors. A calm and elegant base in Amsterdam’s most exclusive neighborhood.

name: Appartement in de Jordaan
description:
Welcome in our home in the centre of the Jordaan. The apartment is located in the quiet area of the Jordaan, but within 1 minute walking distance you'll be at the Lindengracht market or the Noordermarkt. Also the canals, Dam square and the Anne Frank house are within a couple of minutes walking distance.

Facilities
- First floor (stairs only)
- Kitchen incl. Quooker and Espresso machine
- Projector and chromecast to watch movies in bed
- Rain shower
- Wifi

name: Canalfront Chic in City Heart
description: Tucked beside a tranquil Amsterdam canal, my property promises a one-of-a-kind stay. With modern, stylish interior, it's a space where elegance meets warmth. Conveniently located, you can easily wander to nearby cafes and attractions for a taste of local life. Whether you seek a romantic getaway or solo exploration, our retreat ensures a memorable Amsterdam experience. Can't wait to welcome you and offer you an unforgettable stay!

name: Canalstreet Chic + Open Shower
description: Tucked beside a tranquil Amsterdam canal, my property promises a one-of-a-kind stay. With modern, stylish interior, it's a space where elegance meets warmth. Conveniently located, you can easily wander to nearby cafes and attractions for a taste of local life. Whether you seek a romantic getaway or solo exploration, our retreat ensures a memorable Amsterdam experience. Can't wait to welcome you and offer you an unforgettable stay!

name: The Sarphati
description:
Located in a monumental building on Sarphatistraat, next to the iconic Amstel Hotel, this stunning and spacious apartment offers a perfect blend of historical charm and modern convenience. The property boasts a central location, ideal for professionals or couples. With excellent transport links, you can reach Zuidas in just 12 minutes and Schiphol Airport in 20 minutes.

Enjoy living in the heart of Amsterdam with easy access to parks, restaurants, and all the city has to offer.

name: Houseboat Bnb in Amsterdam
description: Welcome to the Captains Quarters, a unique Amsterdam houseboat retreat blending comfort and Dutch charm in a peaceful harbor near the city centre. Enjoy two cozy bedrooms with double bed (1.40x2.00m), a spacious living room with smart TV, and free WiFi. Relax in your private bathroom with a full bathtub, and make use of the dining area with fridge and eletric stove- perfect for onboard meals. With a private entrance and 1.92m ceilings, this invinting space promises a memorable stay.

name: NIEUW! Herenhuis in het Museumkwartier
description:
Atmospheric mansion consisting of five floors (300 m2) located in a quiet street of the Museum Quarter. The house features numerous beautiful style elements such as high ceilings with ornaments, original panel doors and ensuite doors. The house has four bedrooms, three bathrooms and a gym with sauna.

Located in the middle of the Museum Quarter. Walking distance to museums, concert hall and Vondelpark.

name: Cozy & quiet 2-bedroom apartment
description: Enjoy your stay in Amsterdam in a different way, staying in this newly and beautifully renovated 2-bedroom apartment (60m²) in Amsterdam (Zuidoost). Just a 10-minute walk from Gaasperplas metro station and 5-minute walk from Gaasperpark, a lovely park for runners and swimmers (in the summer). This apartment is located in a residential area, very green, safe and peaceful, just a 10-min car/Uber ride to the buzzy areas of Amsterdam. Ideal for singles, couples or small families (max. 4 persons).

name: 2-story roof terrace apartment
description:
Centrally located, spacious and stylish 2-story apartment with roof terrace in a quiet side street in Amsterdam Oud West.

Fireplace, bathtub, floor heating, fully equipped kitchen island, you‘ll be fully set for a great time in Amsterdam‘s most vibrant neighborhood & close to all major tourist attractions as de Jordaan or Vondelpark.

I have a canal boat close by, if i‘m around or you‘re an experienced skipper we can include a trip around Amsterdam for free :)

name: Cozy apartment with balcony in Oud-West
description: Cozy, light-filled apartment in Amsterdam’s lively Oud-West, just a short walk from Vondelpark. Surrounded by trendy cafés, shops, and restaurants. Enjoy a peaceful stay with a bright living area, fully equipped kitchen, and a sunny balcony. Great public transport links and easy access to the city center. Perfect for exploring Amsterdam like a local!

name: New: South residence at Rai area
description:
Reception by owner.

The apartment is located under the owner's house and can be reached via a private entrance in the central hall.

The independent floor can be reached via a staircase and consists of a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate toilet room. The entire apartment overlooks the garden. All rooms are centrally heated and equipped with Wi-Fi with a speed of 750 MB.

name: Historical Amsterdam apartment
description: Welcome to a peaceful retreat in the heart of Amsterdam, ideal for couples or friends seeking a quiet stay with easy access to the city’s best. This bright apartment offers a cozy retreat perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. The full kitchen invites you to enjoy homemade meals, while the spacious lounge area is set up for comfort. A standing desk provides a dedicated workspace,. This apartment is a true Amsterdam experience.

name: Spacious Apartment in Amsterdam with Park View
description: Very spacious apartment in the heart of Rembrandtpark. With a big living room, fully equipped kitchen, work room and two bedrooms, you have everything you need to enjoy a beautiful stay in Amsterdam. It features one queen bed, two single beds that are stacked, that can also be combined to make a second twin bed, and a 1.5 sofa bed. You can enjoy the amazing view from every room, or dive into the fresh air at the balcony.

name: Luxury high end flat in hip area
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place. You have the best restaurants, bars, cafés and museums within few minutes walk. Stay at home and enjoy the sun on your private rooftop and have a bath in the XL bath after exploring all Amsterdam in walking distance.
Smart lights and high end amenities for a luxurious stay.

name: Gezellig familiehuis met tuin
description:
This cozy family home has a front and backyard, large living room, bathroom with separate toilet and 3 bedrooms (1x adult, 2x children's rooms).

The house is in a quiet, child-friendly street. Nearby are the Amstel, the Oosterpark, Frankendael Park and the Pijp. The city center of Amsterdam can be reached within 10 minutes by bike.

The street has plenty of parking spaces, Amstel station is a 5-minute walk away and Wibautstraat metro stop is a 3-minute walk away.

name: Gezellig appartement NDSM-werf
description:
Quietly located on the bustling NDSM shipyard. Many museums and restaurants around the corner. In 5 minutes walk to the ferry to Central Station (about 12 minutes by boat) and within 15 minutes in: Jordaan, West district and the Center!

Recently completed new construction apartment (2024) of approx. 60 m2. Eclectic mix of modern and antique furniture. Fully equipped: modern kitchen and bathroom, separate toilet, large and comfortable bed, underfloor heating.

name: History and luxury
description: Charming studio located in Amsterdam's historic center, just a 2 minute walk from Dam Square and 5 minute walk from Central Station. The space features a comfortable double bed, a modern bathroom, and everything you need for a relaxing stay. While there are no cooking facilities, you'll be surrounded by a wide variety of excellent restaurants and cafés, offering endless dining options. Perfect for exploring the city, this studio is a great choice for your Amsterdam adventure!

name: In front of canal, near city centre cosy apartment
description: This centrally located waterfront accommodation is tastefully decorated. The house was renovated this year, where a lot of attention has been paid to the modern but also cozy appearance. Located on the canal, this is the ideal quiet place to stay, and you can sit by the water at the end of the day. Many nice restaurants, bakeries and parks nearby, and you are in the tourist center of Amsterdam in no time. This is the ideal place to stay!

name: Family Apartment | The July - Twenty Eight
description: Nestled in the heart of leafy Amsterdam South, The July - Twenty Eight location takes it’s name from the Olympic Games hosted in the neighbourhood in 1928. An effortless mix of hotel style and service with the comforts of an apartment.

name: Iconic 1632 Canal House (1900+ sq ft, Renovated)
description:
Classic Amsterdam canal house built in 1632, recently restored to its former glory.

This 180m2 (~1.900 sq ft) multi-floor apartment is nestled on the Prinsengracht, one of the most beautiful canals in the city. Because of the ideal location, this stunning apartment, known as 'the Red Rose', is just a stone's throw from all the city has to offer.

The apartment is fully equipped and incredibly spacious and seriously cozy. Live like 'een echte Amsterdammer' from your perch on the Prince's Canal!

name: Family Apartment | The July - Boat & Co
description: The July’s Family Apartment is the backdrop to your family's next chapter. From pillow fights to bedtime stories, this is where unforgettable moments are made.  Our Family Apartment, with 61 m² of space, is perfect for your needs. It features 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and a living room with a fully equipped kitchen, ensuring everyone has room to unwind after a day of exploring the city. Plenty of space to sleep, sit down in front of the TV, sort emails, or serve up dinner.

name: Appartement naast het Vondelpark
description: Experience the unique charm of our cozy apartment next to the Vondelpark. The apartment of 73m2 is located on the Overtoom and offers 2 bedrooms, large living room, 2 balconies, kitchen, bathroom and separate toilet. Enjoy a beautiful wooden herringbone floor in the house, cozy fitted wardrobes and ceiling ornaments. Located in the lively Cremerbuurt, Oud-West, with a plenty of nice terraces, museums, shops and public transport within walking distance. The center of Amsterdam is 5 minutes away.

name: Sunny room with gorgeous views
description:
Charming Top-Floor Room with Beautiful views ☀️

My cozy apartment is on the top floor, giving you lovely views over the Amsterdamse Bos 🌳

🏠 The bright guest room has a comfy King Size bed with a dedicated workspace and wardrobe.

📍 The metro is just 2-min walk, and the tram stop is only 5-min away. The city centre is just four metro stops away, and the airport is 10 min by taxi or 25 min on public transport. A couple of supermarkets are just a short walk away for anything you might need.

name: Fully equipped, cosy appartment in De Baarsjes
description: In my cozy apartment you will stay, together with my disco ball and all my plants, in the middle of the "De Baarsjes" neighborhood in Amsterdam. Tram and bus stop around the corner, which takes you to the center of Amsterdam within 15 minutes. Also within walking distance are plenty of museums, restaurants, shops and bars. Are you coming by car? Then you don't have to go through the city center! You are only 5 minutes away from the A10, and there is always enough space to park (paid).

name: Knus appartement
description: Experience the charm of this cozy, Moroccan-style apartment (44 m²) in Amsterdam. This cozy and unique accommodation is the host's own living space and features a cozy living area and a raised sleeping area. Located on a quiet street, but just a stone's throw away from lively cafés, restaurants, Amsterdam Amstel train station, and the Amstel River. The perfect place to unwind after a day in the city!

name: Rembrandt & Vermeer | luxe kamers bij Museumplein
description: Welcome to our rooms, completely renovated in 2024, on the 4th floor of an authentic Amsterdam house. The rooms are both equipped with every comfort: comfortable box spring bed, air conditioning, WiFi, luxury rain shower and coffee corner. The studios are located in the very popular neighborhood "de Pijp" next to Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh museum, concert building, Albert Cuyp market and also countless restaurants and bars. The old town can be reached within 5 minutes. We live on the 3rd floor ourselves.

name: Stylish 2 BR in Amsterdam West
description: Discover this brand-new, modern 2-bedroom apartment in the heart of Amsterdam West! With a sleek, fully equipped kitchen, generous closet space, and two large TVs, it’s designed for comfort and convenience. Relax in the small garden area or explore the lively neighborhood, filled with trendy cafes, shops, and excellent transit links. Perfect for families, friends, or business travelers seeking a stylish and well-connected stay in Amsterdam!

name: Houseboat Woezel
description: This unique and authentic houseboat is undoubtedly appealing. On the side canal I in Amsterdam Noord, lies this spacious houseboat with 140 m2 of living pleasure. A spacious kitchen, cozy living room with fireplace, two large bedrooms each with its own bathroom and of course plenty of outdoor space. You can use canoes and a sub to enjoy the water. Within a 10-minute walk, you will be on the ferry that takes you to Amsterdam CS, and from there you can walk into the beautiful city center.

name: Stijlvolle Beganegrondwoning
description:
Welcome to our modern home, ideally located in the authentic Amsterdam East. Perfect for both relaxation and work, with the liveliness of the city at your fingertips!

The neighborhood is known for its cafes, restaurants and the beautiful Oosterpark, all within a short walking distance. Discover the local Dappermarkt, and enjoy the relaxed Amsterdam atmosphere.

With tram and bus stops within walking distance, you can reach the city center of Amsterdam in minutes and easily explore the city.

name: appartement in centrum (Jordaan)
description:
Cozy, comfortable and non-smoking apartment in a quiet street in the Jordaan. The location is great: within walking distance of central station and cafes, restaurants, shops and the markets on the Lindengracht and Noordermarkt.
The apartment has a separate bedroom with a double bed and a well-equipped kitchen.

name: Cosy apartment in Amsterdam
description: Discover Amsterdam from our charming apartment in the trendy De Baarsjes district. This cozy space is equipped with all the modern comforts you need. It features a snug bedroom and a relaxing living area, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploration. Just steps away, you'll find lively cafes, unique shops, and beautiful parks. Whether you're visiting for a few days or planning a longer stay, our apartment offers a blend of comfort and convenience in one of Amsterdam's most vibrant areas

name: Spacious Amstel Apartment
description: Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space next to the water. Our home has been thoughtfully designed and renovated, so now we can invite you to come and enjoy the view of the Amstel and the beautiful city of Amsterdam

name: Cosy apartment in quiet area
description:
Enjoy a lovely 86m² apartment nestled in one of Amsterdam's most beautiful areas. The unique location is very central yet peaceful and quiet, with Vondelpark, Museumplein & Leidseplein all within close walking distance.

Fantastic array of shops and restaurants nearby including Gertrude, Toussaint, de Italiaan & Pastis. The spacious living room features a cozy side room currently used as an office that can easily be used as a 2nd bedroom. Experience the best of Amsterdam in a prime location!

name: Ruim appartement in hippe buurt
description: Welcome to our beautiful, spacious apartment in Amsterdam, located on the border of the lively neighborhoods of Oud-West and De Baarsjes. Our quiet street offers the perfect base to fully explore the city. Enjoy the bustling culture, restaurants and shops just a stone's throw away. Our tastefully decorated apartment is the ideal place to relax after a day of adventures in Amsterdam. Come and discover the unique charm of this city from our comfortable retreat.

name: Spacious and light apartment with roof terrace
description:
Spacious, light two-floor apartment with roof terrace close to Vondelpark!

The large, cosy kitchen & living give great home vibes and you can enjoy the sun on the rooftop terrace from mid morning till sunset.

The street is quiet but the apartment is in the midst of the vibrant life of Amsterdam. Supermarkets, shops, coffee shops and restaurants are within walking distance. A 5 minute cycle brings you to the Jordaan and within a few extra minutes you are in the city centre of Amsterdam.

name: Bright & Cozy Apartmnt Near Park
description:
Welcome to this bright apartment in the heart of Amsterdam East! This cozy space boasts high 3-meter ceilings and large French doors that open onto a sunny, south-facing balcony, perfect for enjoying the sun all day long. With abundant natural light, this apartment feels both airy and inviting, offering a calm retreat in a lively neighborhood.

Located just a 9-minute walk from Muiderpoort Station. The apartment is close to a beautiful park and surrounded by trendy shops, cafes, and restaurants.

name: A cozy palace, Amstel river view
description: Feel at home in this beautiful & charming one bedroom apartment located at the Amstel river in Amsterdam Oost. This is a really authentic place along the Amstel riverside with original features like high moulded ceilings, herringbone oak floor and a French southwest facing balcony. Enjoy a coffee or a glass of wine facing the Amstel river and watch every sunset here! Metro is 2 mins, Amstel station is 5 mins by foot. Perfect for one person or a couple.

name: Long stay, Bright & beautifully finished studio
description:
Beautifully bright, highly sustainable, and elegantly finished studio for long stays (approx. 39m²) with high ceilings (approx. 3.66m), an industrial, modern look, and a lovely balcony where you can enjoy the morning sun. Located in a quiet neighborhood, just a 5-minute bike ride from the Vondelpark.

The former office building was redeveloped in 2018 into 24 trendy studios.

For expats for long stays. For stays longer than one month, the price is reduced. Send me a message for more information.

name: Cosy apartment in Amsterdam
description: Enjoy a culinary experience at this centrally-located place in Amsterdam East. Our apartment is on the second floor and built in typical Dutch architecture from 1900. The bathroom includes a bathtub and washer-dryer, the master bedroom has a king-size bed, and there is a baby room. Enjoy modern amenities, a spacious terrace and direct access to the water for swimming or canoeing. Within walking distance, you will find the cozy Indische Buurt with trendy cafes, restaurants and boutiques. The center of Amsterdam is just 10 minutes away by bicycle or public transport.

Quietly located ground floor apartment with sunny south facing garden. Spacious and tastefully decorated with a comfortable living room, dining room, kitchen and bathroom.

Ideal location: easily accessible from the city center of Amsterdam, Schiphol Airport and the highway. Perfect for a relaxing stay!

name: Light-filled, spacious family home

Bright & Spacious Corner Oasis Near RAI

Welcome to a stunning, light-filled retreat in trendy Rivierenbuurt, just steps from RAI, Europaplein & Metro lines. This expansive ground-floor corner apartment features a magnificent, luxurious lower bedroom, a spacious lounge with a huge TV, a separate dining and work area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a bath!

With easy access to cafes and transport, it’s a perfect blend of comfort and elegance for an unforgettable Amsterdam stay!

Located next to each other, the two fully furnished apartments offer a spacious living area, a private balcony, and a well-equipped kitchen. With two modern bathrooms, plus 2 half bathroom and plenty of room to relax and socialize, it's an ideal home base for those looking to experience the city in comfort and style.

Perfect place for families who wants to enjoy the city of Amsterdam. 120 Square meters apartment, with 2 bedrrooms and great facilities.

The apartmet located in the lively de pijp area, walking distance from Albert cuyp market and nearby public trasportation.

Enjoy fast Wi-Fi, Smart TV, and a fully equipped kitchen for cozy nights in. A washer and dryer make it ideal for longer stays. Take advantage of seasonal discounts and experience authentic Amsterdam living.

name: Sunny and modern home Amsterdam
description:
A newly renovated two-bedroom apartment in the heart of Amsterdam!

Bright and airy living space: With large windows and balconies on both sides, enjoy sunlight and fresh air all day long.

Cozy, modern design: Thoughtfully designed with heated floors, a rain shower head, and stylish touches to make you feel at home.

Fully equipped kitchen: Stainless steel appliances, a boiling water tap, wine fridge, and a central island with bar seating.

We are renting out our lovely and newly renovated apartment of 103 square meters in Amsterdam, including:

name: Urban Cozy Oasis Amsterdam
description: Welcome to my cozy 3-room apartment in Amsterdam West, a quiet and green neighborhood near Vondelpark. The charming space, filled with plants, offers a relaxing retreat after a day in the city. Bikes are available for rent, and public transport is just a 3-minute walk away. The apartment is perfect for travelers and remote workers, featuring fast internet. Nearby, you'll find supermarkets, cafés, and shops. I'm happy to share tips for an authentic Amsterdam experience. Perfect for work/leisure!

name: Ruime en lichte woning bij zwemplek en de stad
description: The house is in a quiet neighborhood, but very close (7 minutes by bike) to the creative and popular NDSM area with lots of art, museums and trendy restaurants and shops. The ferry on the NDSM site takes you free and directly (in 15 minutes) to the center of Amsterdam. For swimmers, there is a swimming jetty around the corner (2 minutes walk). Finally, you will find a large and beautiful nature reserve (Het Twiske) with mini beaches, mills and children's activities within 15 minutes cycling distance.

name: Cosy Rooftop Apartment
description:
Cosy Apartment with Rooftop Terrace by Vondelpark

A warm and inviting space, perfect for two. This fully furnished apartment is on the 4th floor (no elevator) and comes with a private rooftop terrace.

Vondelpark is right at your doorstep, great for a morning walk or a quiet escape from the city's buzz. Trams and buses are just a two-minute walk away, making it easy to reach places like Leidseplein, Dam Square, and the Museum Quarter.

Please smoke only outside on the terrace and no parties.

name: Cosy apartment near Vondelpark
description: Bright apartment in the popular West Area walking distance from the Vondelpark and easy to reach via public transport. The apartment is in a quiet neighbourhood and has all utilities you need. One of the best features is the spacious open kitchen that seamlessly connects to the living area - you can cook while chatting together or enjoy a glass of wine at the counter, making every meal a shared experience. Doors can be opened to the French balcony, perfect for sunny days!

name: Charming Amsterdam flat Jordaan
description: Discover Amsterdam from this recently renovated apartment, located in the vibrant Amsterdam Oud-West neighborhood, just steps away from the city center and the scenic canal district. Tucked away on a peaceful side street near Jordaan, this apartment offers the perfect blend of cozy comfort and close proximity to the city’s must-see spots. Recently updated, it comes with a queen-sized bed, a spacious dining area, a welcoming living room complete with a TV, and a brand new bathroom with shower.

name: Luxury private studio, own entrance, own bathroom
description:
Luxury ground floor private studio. You'll have the entire studio including the bathroom for yourself!

Own entrance and very centrally located in a monumental building in the heart of Amsterdam. It's a 33m2 studio with a king size bed.

B&B licence, but guest don't share anything.High ceilings, renovated in 2025. Nespresso machine, watercooker, fridge and luxury products.

Near the canals, Amstel River, museums, theaters & shops, Waterlooplein, Nieuwmarkt, Magere Bug and Artis Zoo

name: Familiehuis met tuin in levendig Amsterdam Oost
description: Unique, spacious home for 4 people with a cozy garden and a perfect location.

name: Apartment with private garden
description: A spacious apartment with a large kitchen, a home office, and a private garden - at a walking distance to two city parks and public transport, and at a biking distance to Amsterdam's highlights. The neighbourhood is quite, with some nice bars and restaurants nearby.

name: Gezinshuis/Family home
description: Our family home in the quiet and green neighborhood of Elzenhagen offers everything for a comfortable stay in Amsterdam. It is only a 5-minute walk from the metro that takes you to the city center of Amsterdam within 5 minutes. Located next to the A10, the house is also easily accessible by car. The neighborhood is car-free and perfect for families.

name: Bootje Jordaan
description: This unique and romantic accommodation is undoubtedly appealing. In the middle of Amsterdam on one of the quietest canals of the Jordaan.  Base for Amsterdam. Close to central station.

name: Modern penthouse apartment with large roof terrace
description:
Stylish & modern apartment with roofterrace, close to city centre located in South neighborhood. Just a stone’s throw away from the beautiful Vondelpark and 20 mins from Schiphol airport.

When weather allows, there’s a spacious roof terrace with seating area overseeing the city.

Located in a vibrant area with shops, grocery stores, bars and a large variety of restaurants at your doorstep.

Connecting tramstops close by as well as popular vibrant West area.

name: City center house with garden close to canal
description: Stylishly furnished house with garden. A street next to a beautiful Amsterdam canal. Around the corner from Amsterdam's most popular baker (Fort9). With a beautiful Big Green Egg Large grill in the garden. Right in the center.

name: Pais en vree
description: Just have a relaxed time in this quiet very central ground floor house. Situated near the river Amstel in the heart of the city center. At walking distances of the H*art museum, Jewish museum and monument, the Waterlooplein market, the Albert Cuyp area and of course the river Amstel with its restaurants, swimming area and beautiful sunsets. Guests who take care of our lovely 2 cats will get a discount price!

name: Beautiful home 10 min from Centraal
description: Beautiful home 10 min from Centraal

Enjoy a one-of-a-kind vacation on this renovated houseboat, just a 10-minute walk from a charming canal in central Amsterdam. Fully equipped, it offers a stylish and comfortable ambiance.

Relax in the bright living room with water views, use the fully equipped kitchen, and unwind on the outdoor terrace. With restaurants, museums, and shops nearby, this houseboat is the perfect base for an unforgettable Amsterdam experience!

name: Authentic houseboat Amalia
description:
Enjoy a one-of-a-kind vacation on this renovated houseboat, just a 10-minute walk from a charming canal in central Amsterdam. Fully equipped, it offers a stylish and comfortable ambiance.

Relax in the bright living room with water views, use the fully equipped kitchen, and unwind on the outdoor terrace. With restaurants, museums, and shops nearby, this houseboat is the perfect base for an unforgettable Amsterdam experience!

name: Colorful & Cozy Retreat
description:
This stylishly furnished apartment is located in a vibrant neighbourhood full of cosy eateries. Situated within walking distance of Oosterpark and Flevopark, and only a 10-minute bike ride from the city centre, it offers the perfect base to explore the lively Amsterdam East.

Theres a bike rental shop under the house.

Please note: the second bedroom currently has a sofa consisting of 2 mattresses that can be folded out to a 160cm wide mattress. This is on the floor, see photos

name: Stay in the Heart of Amsterdam!
description: Welcome to My Happy Place in Amsterdam!  My cozy flat is the perfect place to relax after exploring the city. Here’s what makes it special: Fully-equipped kitchen with an oven, microwave, and dishwasher—perfect for cooking your favorite meals. Spacious dining area with a large table. Comfy living room with a large sofa (fits three people) and a sofa bed. Bathroom & toilet: Like in most Dutch homes, the toilet is separate from the bathroom.

name: Cozy appartment in Amsterdam
description:
Charming 1 bedroom apartment of 70 sq.m. with a garden, located on the groundfloor of a classic building with plenty of natural light. Situated in the lively neighborhood of de Baarsjes, that offers a vibrant mix of residential charm, trendy cafes, and easy access to green spaces like Erasmuspark. 2 min walking distance from the French Café, and trams.
The apartment is fully furnished and comes with all necessary amenities. It also comes with Lila, our discreet cat that will need to be fed.

name: Bright 1BR Apt w/ 2 Balconies
description:
The apartment features a spacious living room with a comfy couch that can be used as an extra bed, a fully equipped bathroom, and a bedroom designed for relaxation. Just a 5-minute walk to Lelylaan Station, you’ll have easy access to trams, metro, buses, and trains—perfect for exploring the city. Essential shops like a supermarket, pharmacy, and bakery are also within a short walk.

Enjoy a peaceful stay with all the city’s conveniences at your doorstep!

name: Luxe woning aan de Amstel
description:
From this beautiful apartment in the Weesperzijde area by the Amstel, you can explore Amsterdam while enjoying the sunny privacy of the south-facing balcony, a well-equipped kitchen, a spacious living room, a luxurious bathroom and a very comfortable bedroom.

The location is as good as it gets, not only in the heart of Amsterdam, but with public transport right in front of the house, stores around the corner and every beautiful spot you want to visit within walking distance.

name: Modern & Cosy Apartment
description: Comfortable and super accessible apartment with Tram and Bus right in front of the door, taking you to every attraction in Amsterdam in 15mins. Best coffee in Amsterdam 2mins walk, best croissants 3mins and THE best mexican food (Lupe) 5mins walking distance. Apartment has all the modern amenities that you require, such as a boiling water at the tap for tea and an induction stove. We also have a portable air-conditioner for those warm days!

name: Luxury whole appartement centrum amsterdam
description: Authentic old Amsterdam building in a quiet place right in the city center of Amsterdam. This luxury apartment has all the facilities you need for a pleasant time in Amsterdam. Central Station is a 10-minute walk away, and the metro to the rest of the city is nearby. The famous walls of Amsterdam are within walking distance, and the Nieuwmarkt with its striking old Waag offers a wide range of restaurants and drinking places.

name: High-end house with garden at Vondelpark
description: This freshly renovated, high-end home is a hidden gem in Amsterdam’s elegant Oud-Zuid. Just a minute from the Vondelpark and canals, in a quiet street with amazing restaurants and cafés just around the corner. Stylishly designed, fully equipped with all modern comforts, and featuring a peaceful private garden—it has everything you need and more for a unforgettable work or leisure stay.

name: Amsterdam Gardenhouse
description: Maximum 3-4 adults and kids. Depending on the age of the kids. Forget your worries in this spacious and serene space.

name: Beautiful Appartment in A’dam Oud Zuid
description:
This stunning mansion is situated in a villa on the prestigious Apollolaan, a location that offers both access to the city center and a route out of Amsterdam.

The penthouse what we offer is on the ground floor, seperated from the entire mansion. It is designed in the Amsterdamse Stijl, blending vintage elements with modern eye-catchers.

Within a 250-meter radius, you’ll find supermarkets, bars, restaurants, charming boutique stores, and luxurious shops, making this an ideal place to stay.

name: Luxury 3 BDR in Amsterdam Center
description:
3 Bedroom Luxury Home in the Heart of Amsterdam

Stay in a spacious, stylish home on a charming cobblestone street near canals, top restaurants, and attractions. This luxury retreat features 3 bedrooms (2 queen, 1 double in attic), 2 full bathrooms, and a sunny balcony. Enjoy the magic of Amsterdam with everything just steps away. Strict no parties. Ideal for a peaceful, upscale stay in the city’s vibrant center!

name: Boetiek appartement Amsterdam-Oost
description: Explore Amsterdam from this tasteful, spacious and bright apartment. An oasis of peace 10 minutes from the bustling city center! Enjoy 2 balconies, all amenities and the fun, diverse neighborhood with lots of restaurants and culture. You will get a good night's sleep with the bedroom adjacent to the quiet courtyard. It is very easily accessible: 300m from the train/tram/bus station.

name: Cosy, spacious apartment
description: Welcome to our cozy yet spacious apartment in the heart of Amsterdam! Nestled near beautiful parks and charming cafés, our home offers a peaceful retreat while keeping you close to the city's vibrant energy. Public transport is easily accessed, making it simple to explore Amsterdam’s sights. Whether you're here to unwind or adventure, our bright and inviting space provides the perfect base for your stay. We look forward to hosting you!

name: Appartement met tuin
description: This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated. It is within walking distance of the Jordaan (Noordermarkt) and Westerpark. There is a parking garage in front of the door. The apartment features a garden with late afternoon sun.

name: Erasmuspark Sunrise Balcony Apartment
description: Wonderful stay in Amsterdam in this quiet yet centrally located apartment. Enjoy coffee in the morning sun and a drink in the evening sun, overlooking the park.

name: Luxurious wellness houseboat - Captains Cabin
description:
Our historic houseboat has recently been transformed into a luxurious, elegant and extremely fully furnished place in the heart of Amsterdam.

Located in one of the widest canals of the city, close to the Central Station, the bustling city center with the many restaurants, shops, museums and parks within walking distance.

You will stay in a unique, tasteful private suite with all the luxuries with a beautiful view of the canal.

Enjoy Amsterdam from the inside in an exceptional, unforgettable way!

name: Appartement in hartje centrum
description:
The location is unique and very central. The 19th century apartment has its Amsterdam charm. The layout consists of 3 floors. A living room and kitchen on the first floor, on the 2nd floor 1 bedroom with an ensuite bathroom and on the 3rd floor the master bedroom, a small walk-in closet and the bathroom. Beds: 220x200 and 200x200.

In the street, there are many nice bars and restaurants, the supermarket around the corner, and public transportation to the whole city within a 1-minute walk.

name: Luxury Canal Apartment in Amsterdam City Central
description:
Cozy and Stylish Canal House on Keizersgracht

Welcome to our charming house on the iconic Keizersgracht, located in the heart of Amsterdam!
Whether you’re planning a longer stay to live like a local, work remotely, or enjoy an extended visit or a shorter getaway of just a few days, our home offers a warm, stylish, and convenient base.

name: Stylish 3-Bedroom Home with Canal View & Garden
description:
Stay in this stunning recently renovated 110m² ground-floor home with a private south-facing garden - your oasis in the city!

Features:
- Prime Jordaan location: city’s top highlights, boutiques, & restaurants just minutes away on foot
- 3 bedrooms: 2 with queen beds, 1 baby room (optional air mattress)
- Luxurious bathroom + extra toilet
- Designer kitchen opening to a stylish outdoor dining/lounge area
- Bright living with garden views, smart TV & sound system
- Dedicated workspace + monitor

name: Apartment in Amsterdam West
description: A fully furnished apartment is centrally located in West Amsterdam. The apartment features 2 bedrooms and kitchen with a large balcony. You have easy access to local cafes like Podium Mozaiek, Sloterdijk station, Westerpark, Tuinen van West and Erasmus park and also close to the centre of Amsterdam. 15 mins biking distance and 30 mins walking distance to Dam Square.  2 people on double bed in a room, 3rd person in small room with own bed and 4rd person can sleep on the  couch.

name: Quiet and private place near RAI-Museumplein
description: Come and experience the best of Amsterdam at this centrally located place. It’s just an 10 minute walk to the RAI and the famous AlbertCuijp market. You’ll find a wide selection of books, as well as Netflix, Disney+, and Amazon Prime. It’s the perfect spot those attending conventions or couples who like privacy and comfort. The place is fully renovated with double glass windows and soundproofing for a restful night’s sleep. Just be prepared for some narrow stairs, though, they are worth it!

name: Amstel Riverview appartement
description: Overlooking the Nieuwe Amstelburg, this authentic nineteenth century apartment of over 100 square meters is a unique place for a special stay in Amsterdam. This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated, equipped with everything you need, within walking distance of shops, restaurants, theatres and canal belt.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our sunny apartment in the cozy Bos en Lommer, just a short distance from downtown Amsterdam and Westerpark.
The ideal base for those who want to discover the city, but also want to enjoy peace and comfort.
Our apartment is carefully decorated and features a spacious living room (including a projector for a movie night), a separate bedroom with a comfortable double bed, a fully equipped kitchen and a balcony with afternoon and evening sun!

name: Klassiek grachtenhuis in Amsterdam
description:
Between the historic canals, lies a breathtaking monumental canal house from 1645. The Recht Boomssloot, one of Amsterdam's most idyllic canals, offers a unique combination of tranquility and liveliness, a stone's throw away from the bustling Nieuwmarkt, one of the most central locations in Amsterdam.

This piece of hidden Amsterdam, you wake up every morning with the soft rippling of the water and the sight of bridges and ships.

(We are redecorating)

name: Cozy House in Amsterdam
description:
Family-Friendly House with Garden – Perfect for Your Stay!

Our cozy home offers 2 bedrooms & 1 children's room – ideal for families. Fully equipped kitchen, modern bathroom, fast Wi-Fi & free parking. The garden with a terrace invites you to relax. Child-friendly amenities such as a high chair & toys are available. Quiet location with shopping and leisure activities nearby. Book now & feel at home!

We prefer to rent to families with children.

name: Canalzicht & Garage – Wittenkade
description: Stylish apartment on the characteristic Wittenkade, named after Johan de Witt, with beautiful views over the Kostverlorenvaart. With a parking garage unique for the heart of Amsterdam. Only a 2-minute walk to the green Westerpark full of cafes and culture, and 5 minutes to the atmospheric Jordaan and the bustling city center with boutiques, restaurants and markets. The perfect mix of history, water, greenery and urban comfort! +Sofa bed available for any 3rd guest.

name: Sky-level top apartment inside park with city view
description:
Our 16th-floor penthouse is bright and full of natural light all day, thanks to its south-facing windows. With 125 m² of space, it feels open and spacious. One side offers views of Amsterdam’s buildings, while the other overlooks the park.

We’re just one station from Schiphol airport, about 20 min to the flat. The elevator makes getting up easy! Close to train, metro, and tram stations. The city center is 30 min by public transport or 17 min by bike. Shops nearby for all your needs!

name: 4-bedrooms Central Apart with Balcony&Roofterras
description: Featuring a private entrance, this spacious apartment also is comprised of 4 bedrooms, a seating area and 1 bathroom with a walk-in shower and a hairdryer. The well-fitted kitchen features a refrigerator, a dishwasher, kitchenware and an oven. Boasting a terrace with garden views, this apartment also offers a washing machine and a flat-screen TV with streaming services. The unit offers 4 queensized beds

name: Chic & Spacious Apt Amsterdam East
description: Spacious and stylish apartment with 2 bedrooms, a large living room and an open kitchen. One bedroom has a queen-size bed; the other a single bed. Fully equipped kitchen. Sunny garden with a lounge area. Completely renovated bathroom with rain shower, toilet, and washing machine, plus an extra shower and separate toilet. Located next to Oosterpark, perfect for a walk or picnic. A 15-minute walk to the city center or 5 minutes by tram. Local market, cafés, and restaurants just around the corner.

name: Luxury | Bright | Spacious | Modern | Garden | 2BR
description: Welcome to our luxurious and fully renovated house in the heart of Amsterdam West. This stylish two-bedroom apartment offers an open-concept living area filled with natural light and a 5 meter high palm tree, a large and lush garden, a modern kitchen with high-end appliances, two spacious bed rooms and a bathroom with a 2-person tub and shower. Situated in a prime location with easy access to trendy cafes, restaurants, and transport, this house combines comfort, luxury, and convenience.

name: Amsterdam oost lovely & spacious home
description:
My newly renovated apartment is 125 square meters, on the ground floor, has a sunny garden and in a quite area yet still of many fun and good restaurants and shops! Next to us is the cutest bakery and on the corner of our street an Amsterdam brewery with the best beers. If you want Amsterdam city center its 15 min by bike.

In the bedroom we have closets and for clothes but the fronts (doors) of the closets have not been placed yet. Tiny house does not yet have a closet.

name: Family apartment in A'dam Oost
description:
Cozy 4-Bedroom Apartment in Vibrant Amsterdam Oost.

Stay in our newly renovated apartment in Indische Buurt, perfect for up to 4 guests! Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen and cozy living space.

Walk to Javastraat (shops and cafés), Oosterpark, and Wereld museum. 15 min by public transport to Amsterdam Centraal and the city center. Paid parking available.

Your perfect Amsterdam base!

name: Cozy & Charming Home @ Noord
description: Welcome to our cozy and charming home in Amsterdam Noord! Nestled in a peaceful neighborhood with friendly locals, our home offers a relaxing retreat while keeping you close to the city. Amsterdam Central Station is just 20–25 minutes away by public transport. Ideal for families and couples!

name: Stijlvol appartement nabij Vondelpark
description: Bright and cozy apartment in De Baarsjes!  This nice stay has a spacious living room with south-facing garden, a bathroom with bath and two bedrooms (one with a doubter, ideal for two children). Located near the Vondelpark and Rembrandtpark, perfect for relaxation. Walking distance to restaurants, bars, De Hallen and the Ten Katemarkt. Family friendly and well connected to the center. The ideal place to explore Amsterdam!

name: The Vega 1909 – Historic Schooner Stay, Amsterdam
description:
Experience a one-of-a-kind stay aboard the historic schooner Vega, built in 1909 in Sweden.
Moored in the artistic district of NDSM, this vessel combines maritime heritage, Scandinavian craftsmanship, and the charm of Amsterdam’s creative waterfront.
Just a 15-minute free ferry ride from Central Station, the Vega offers an unforgettable mix of adventure and history on the water.

name: Cozy, luxurious apartment
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.
The apartment was completely renovated last year, so everything you need to have a pleasant is there. A comfortable boxspring bed, fully equipped kitchen, garden with morning sun. description:

Located just 15 minutes from the city centre, this hotel offers a balance between tranquillity and dynamism. A supermarket and lunchroom are within walking distance, ideal for a relaxing start to the day.

name: Beautiful bright apartment in trendy Baarsjes area

Perfectly located in quiet street, but close to the shopping, bars and restaurants in De Baarsjes and Oud-West, city centre and Hallen Quarter. You can walk into Rembrandtpark at the end of our street. Walking/cycling distance to city centre, museums, concert halls and night life. Bike rental around the corner. Easy to reach from Schiphol airport; only 30 minutes with public transport.

name: Luxe en ruim appartement op goede locatie
description:

Equipped with all comfortabilities and amenities and stylish decorated. Perfect for a couple who want to spend a great time in Amsterdam!

name: Cozy & Comfortable Apartment in Local Amsterdam
description: Welcome to your cozy Amsterdam home, located on a quiet, charming street in the Rivierenbuurt. A green, safe and relaxed neighborhood loved by locals. This bright and thoughtfully styled apartment features a comfortable living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and one inviting bedroom with a balcony. Well connected by public transport and bike, it’s the perfect balance between peaceful living and easy access to the city.

name: Kg320
description:
KG320, Cosy Stay in the Heart of Amsterdam

name: Ruim appartement met dakterras
description:

name: Apartment Overtoom
description: Perfect 2 person apartment for couples to explore the city. The apartment is next to Vondelpark, and the popular areas such as the jordaan, leidseplein and museumplein are all at walking distances.

name: Appartement in de buurt van het centrum
description:
Modern & spacious apartment – 10 min cycling to the ferry!

Located in Amsterdam Noord, just 10 minutes by bike from the ferry and 5 minutes from the Noord/Zuidlijn. Cheap parking, quick access to shops and Waterland nature reserve. Perfect for a comfortable stay in the city!

name: Family houseboat in the east of Amsterdam
description:
The view and the quiet surroundings of this boat is fantastic!

There are two bedrooms and two bathrooms but we only accept two guests.

Perfect for couples, it provides a great balance of tranquility and accessibility, making it the ideal base for exploring Amsterdam.

name: Cozy apartment in Amsterdam Oost

description: Welcome to our home! This beautifully renovated apartment is located in Amsterdam’s sought-after Oud-West neighborhood. With excellent public transport connections, you can easily reach all the city’s highlights, including renowned museums and the historic city center. The area is also filled with plenty of shops for groceries, making your stay even more convenient. The apartment is easy to reach and within a 5-minute walk from metro station De Pijp. There is a bicycle to borrow!

name: Bright peaceful apartment

No parties, please respect the neighbours. No pets.

Public transportation is also close, making it easy to explore the city.

name: Magical houseboat with garden

The Sailors Suite is a serene, design-forward retreat with a private waterside terrace, warm interiors and the gentle presence of a ship that has stories to tell. "Where intimacy, aesthetics and wonder blend together"

This house is very nice and bright. With a nice garden. The house is in a quiet neighborhood. Anything you need is present. This house is lived in, and you can see that. There is a cat in the house, which must be fed in the morning. So you have to like a cat and not be allergic to it.

Located in a quiet, upscale area, it's just a 10-minute walk to Vondelpark, the Museum Quarter, & designer boutiques. With cafés, groceries, and tram stops nearby, it's the perfect place to relax, explore, and enjoy the local Amsterdam life in comfort and style.

The apartment offers all the necessary amenities to make you feel right at home.

name: Charming renewed North Stay, close to city center
description: Charming Noord Stay is your cozy city retreat—fully renovated in 2025 and tucked away in a peaceful, local neighborhood next to the park. Enjoy a bright open living space, modern kitchen, sunny balcony, and two spacious bedrooms with workspaces. Just 10 minutes from Central Station, and steps from cafés, green spaces, and hidden gems in vibrant Amsterdam Noord.

name: Appartement in Centrum Amsterdam (Jordaan)
description: A quiet authentic apartment in the city center of Amsterdam (the Jordaan). It is a bright and quiet apartment in the middle of the nicest neighborhood in Amsterdam. Here you can escape from the hustle. The popular nine streets, many nice restaurants, gym, shops, supermarkets and museums (such as the Anne Frank House) are within walking distance, and it is around the corner from the most beautiful canal in Amsterdam (Lauriergracht). Public transportation (Elandsgracht stop) is also within walking distance.

name: Elegant Studio on the Canal Ring
description:
Charming studio on Amsterdam’s historic canal ring with its own entrance.

Unwind in the comfortable king bed, refresh in the modern bathroom, or relax in the cozy lounge. Enjoy your morning coffee, light cooking, or a peaceful remote work session with natural light and fast Wi-Fi.

Stays very cool in the summer and comfortably warm in the winter due to floor heating.

Bedroom with windows on two sides including a luxury Auping mattress and TV at bed. Located in green Amsteldorp near the Amstel station (large station). In no time you will be in town. name: light and modern apartment in cosy oost
description:
We hope you will enjoy the light & peaceful 70m² home!

A workspace / projector can be setup on request.

name: 5-person private ensuite (non-balcony)
description:
Our 5-person room comes with a 3-layer-bunk and one simple double bunk bed, a full private bathroom and toilet.

description:
Quiet Residential Loft – No Parties

This is a quiet residential building, therefore parties, celebrations, bachelor/bachelorette groups, and loud gatherings are strictly not allowed.

The apartment is intended for guests who enjoy the city during the day and return to a peaceful home in the evening.

name: Private apartment with Canal view
description: Beautiful 1 bedroom 80m2 corner apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. With canal views overlooking one of the four main canals in the quiet part of the canal district. The apartment is warm and full of light, offers a lot of space. Right by fancy bars, shops and some of Amsterdams most beautiful places to discover. The apartment has a balcony on the backside.

name: Cozy, centrally located apartment
description: This 35m2 apartment in the first Floor is cozy and excellently furnished. It has a central location close to the amstel, the city center and only 10 minutes walking from the Albert Cuypmarkt. There is a double bed (1.6x2m) in the bedroom and half of the wardrobe can be used to hang clothes. In the bathroom there is a sink, shower cubicle & toilet. An excellent place to stay for two!

name: Apartment next to Vondel Park
description:
Welcome to our charming apartment next to Vondelpark!

Our newly renovated apartment on Frederiksstraat 18-2 is the perfect hideaway for couples looking to enjoy Amsterdam. Located in the lively yet peaceful Oud-West neighborhood, right by Vondelpark, you’ll be surrounded by great cafés, local shops, and green space—just minutes from the city’s heart. Enjoy our private watching the Vondel Park and a beautiful old building.

Come relax and experience the best of Amsterdam!

name: Premium Studio
description: Spacious 30m² Premium Studio with city views, ideal for singles or sharing. Features a cozy lounge space, separate bedroom, private bathroom with rainshower, and fully equipped kitchen. Enjoy weekly housekeeping, 24/7 reception, laundry facilities, parking, bikes and vibrant community events. Hang out at Café Jansen with a 20% discount, or cook, work, and connect in our stylish clubrooms. Comfort, privacy, and city life—all in one place.

name: Studio
description: Our 24 m² Studio is perfect for privacy seekers. Features a combined lounge and bedroom, private bathroom with rain shower, and cooking facilities inside the room. Enjoy weekly housekeeping, 24/7 reception, laundry facilities, parking, bikes and vibrant community events. Hang out at Café Jansen with a 20% discount, or cook, work, and connect in our stylish clubrooms. Comfort, privacy, and city life—all in one place.

name: cosy city center apt with AIRCO
description:
This cozy and cozy apartment is located on the ground floor on a quiet side street in the middle of the historic center. This unique location combines the liveliness of the city with the tranquility of a sheltered street. Everything like Dam Square, Kalverstraat, museums, shops, restaurants, bars and coffee shops, is within walking distance.

The apt has a comfortable double bed and a double sofa bed. A dishwasher, coffee maker, microwave and air conditioning make your stay extra pleasant.

name: Cosy apartment in Amsterdam West
description: Spacious 2/3-room apartment (approx. 53 m²) on the first floor of a quiet street, overlooking a green square. Conveniently located near the Admiralengracht, Rembrandtpark, and Jan Evertsenstraat. Bright living room at the front; well-sized bedroom at the back. Also at the rear: a new open kitchen with a 4-burner gas stove, oven, dishwasher, fridge with freezer, and ample storage. Private balcony included.

name: Ground floor apartment |4P| @De Pijp
description:
Charming Stylish Urban Retreat @the Heart of De Pijp, Amsterdam!

Welcome to my stylish and cozy 2 bedroom apartment, perfectly nestled in the vibrant De Pijp district— Amsterdam’s most dynamic and sought-after neighborhoods.

This modern yet charming space offers a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and local culture.

Located just minutes from the famous Albert Cuyp Market, Sarphatipark, and trendy cafés, my apartment is ideal for those looking to experience the true essence of Amsterdam.

name: Family home Amsterdam Zuid/South
description:
Nestled in the heart of Amsterdam’s most coveted residential enclave—aptly named the Gold Coast—this exquisite five-bedroom townhouse presents a rare opportunity to indulge in sophisticated urban living, where elegance meets everyday convenience.

Spanning 165 square meters across three thoughtfully designed floors, this refined family home blends understated luxury with comfort. The property boasts a beautifully landscaped garden of 70 square meters, offering a serene retreat in the city.

name: Light-Filled Loft In City Center
description: Charming two-level apartment full of light and authentic Amsterdam character, located in vibrant Czaar Peterbuurt. Enjoy a bright living area with large windows and a cozy window seat, a modern kitchen with stone countertop, and a stylish brick wall. Upstairs is a spacious bedroom with wooden beams and big windows. The bathroom has a walk-in shower. A perfect base to explore the city’s culture, cafés, and hotspots.

name: Beautifully designed home in Amsterdam-NDSM
description:
An unforgettable experience in a quiet place in a cozy, nice and light village house. Very suitable for couples, friends or families who want to visit Amsterdam and also enjoy peace and quiet. 15 minutes' walk to NDSM where the ferries go to the city center.
Enjoy the garden, the large sliding door, the complete bathroom and the 2 double beds. The cooking island is equipped with a Quooker, a dishwasher, an oven, an induction hob and a Moccamaster!
Zaanse Schans and Twiske around the corner!

name: Luxurious 4-Room Water Villa in Amsterdam
description:
Long Stay!

This luxurious, fully furnished water villa features a beautifully designed living area with an open kitchen, two bedrooms, a versatile office/lounge space, and a spacious rooftop terrace.

Experience the best of Amsterdam from this exceptional IJburg water villa — the perfect home base for expats seeking comfort, style, and convenience.

Schedule a viewing and see it for yourself!

name: Amazing house with garden in De Pijp
description:
Experience Amsterdam as a local in this beautiful house with garden in the middle of De Pijp, Amsterdam's most vibrant neihborhood. The shops, restaurants, bars and terraces are just around the corner. Metro and supermarket are on walking distance. And If you want to escape the hustle and bustle of the city enjoy the garden to relax.
The house has everything to make your stay very comfortable: 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, fast wifi, 2 TVs (incl Netflix), fully equiped kitchen, garden with BBQ.

name: Modern Amsterdam Apartment with Rooftop Terrace
description:
Stylish top-floor apartment just 2 mins from public transport. Amenities include a private rooftop terrace, A/C in all rooms, underfloor heating, and a fully equipped kitchen with high-end appliances.

Includes 2 bedrooms (one with a pull-out double bed), a modern rain shower bathroom, washer/dryer, smart TV, fast Wi-Fi, and a dining area for 6. Located on the 4th floor—stairs only.

Close to shops, cafés, restaurants, and a grocery stores—ideal for comfort, work and leisure.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam-West
description: A recently renovated apartment with two bedrooms and a garden in a quiet street in the middle of Amsterdam-West. Close to many amenities (supermarket, parks, swimming pool, cafes and restaurants) and public transportation. There is a baby cot, a high chair, stroller and two bicycles (with child seat).

name: Stijlvol appartement Amsterdam Baarsjes
description:
This bright and comfortable apartment is perfect for couples, families or friends who want to explore the city.

Wake up with views of the canal and enjoy the real Amsterdam feeling. Thanks to its central location, you can quickly reach all the famous sights, while still staying in a quiet, local neighborhood.

Whether you come to relax or to discover all that Amsterdam has to offer, this apartment is your perfect home base!

name: Dijk Loft Amsterdam North
description:
Welcome to The Dijk Loft — Your Peaceful Retreat in Amsterdam.
Escape the bustle and unwind in this stylish, serene studio in Nieuwendam; a charming, local neighborhood just a short ride from the city center.
Enjoy a cozy sleeping loft, fully equipped kitchenette, spacious dining/work table, high-top breakfast bar, lounge with 65-inch Smart TV, and a modern bathroom with walk-in shower and separate toilet.

name: Sunny garden apt, good location

The tram stops in front of our door to bring you quickly into the centre of Amsterdam. The Metro, to go to Sail is close by. Walking distance from the Albert Cuyp Market (2 km) and the museum district (3 km). Our house will be your peacefull haven, yet within easy reach of all the city has to offer. Close to the Okura restaurant forJapanese food and Rai.

name: Ruim familie appartement
description:
Spacious and child-friendly apartment in the bustling Amsterdam-Noord!

Welcome to our bright and spacious apartment, perfect for families or couple who want to discover Amsterdam! Located in the lively and up-and-coming Amsterdam-North, here you will find the perfect balance between tranquility, space and city dynamics.

description:
Fancy, specious, two floor house with front & backyard with jacuzzi and 2 kitchens.

This house has everything you need and more, with just that extra touch of luxury.

Peaceful, yet close to the city center.

description:
Short Stay!

it’s the perfect base to experience authentic Amsterdam while staying connected to the city’s highlights.

Enjoy refined comfort in one of Amsterdam’s most desirable neighborhoods.

name: Cute Studio in Jordaan | Bright, Chic & All Yours
description:
Welcome to my charming and light-filled 30m² studio right in the heart of the Jordaan and a stone's throw from the Anne Frank House.

The small space is smartly designed: a colorful raised box bed with curtains (and a little stool to climb in), a separate modern bathroom, full kitchen, and a cozy workspace by the window. You'll look out on Café Chris the oldest bar in Amsterdam (since 1624!).

name: Comfortable boat city center 5
description:
Unique Houseboat Experience in the Heart of Amsterdam
Enjoy an unforgettable stay on this charming houseboat, just a 5–10 minute walk from the iconic canals in central Amsterdam. The location is peaceful yet close to all the city’s highlights.

The boat offers everything you need for a comfortable stay, with a cozy interior and beautiful views over the water. Perfect for those looking for something different than a standard hotel.

name: Prachtig licht & ruim appartement op toplocatie
description:
Relax and unwind in this quiet and stylish space. The apartment is bright and spacious, with beautiful views of greenery.

Located in peacefull and trendy Amsterdam North, here you have both charming sights and hip dining spots at your fingertips. You are very quickly at Central Station, as well as in pictoresque North Holland for a bike ride in nature.

An ideal base for an unforgettable experience in Amsterdam!

name: Gezellig appartement met tuin
description:
The 49 m² apartment is situated in a quiet, friendly neighborhood near Westerpark. Ideal for those who want to discover the city and enjoy peace and comfort.
The apartment is cleverly laid out with an open kitchen, a dining area and a comfortable seating area. The French doors give access to a sunny private garden facing south, where you can sit in the sun from about 2:00 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. Perfect for breakfast, a book or a drink in the evening sun.

name: Stylish luxury apartment with garden
description:
Welcome to this stylish, recently renovated ground-floor apartment in Amsterdam.

Perfect for a city break or business stay, this comfortable and modern home offers privacy and a relaxed atmosphere. Located in a quiet area with great restaurants nearby, two beautiful parks within walking distance, and the trendy Linnaeusstraat just around the corner.

Excellent public transport connections make it easy to explore the city.

This bright and spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment is located right on the lively Maasstraat, in the heart of Rivierenbuurt.

With large windows, high ceilings, and tasteful decor, the space feels open and cozy, ideal for families, friends, or business travelers. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, two modern bathrooms, and plenty of room to relax or work.

Moments away from local bakeries, cafés, parks and excellent public transport connections to the city center, RAI, and Schiphol Airport.

name: Trendy De Baarsjes Apartment – Great Location
description:
Modern 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment in Amsterdam with a private outdoor area—perfect for relaxing after a day exploring. Just 14 minutes from Schiphol Airport and close to public transport, shops, and cafes. Comfortable, stylish, and ideal for couples, friends, or business travelers.

name: Cozy stay with garden in De Pijp
