Enter this lovely 2-bedroom apartment with a nice sunny garden! Here you live in the tranquility of the Dusartstraat with its beautiful classical buildings, but also close to the charming Amsterdam de Pijp.
The great location in this residential street, the good finishing level and layout make this house an ideal, comfortable city apartment with numerous nice shops, the Albert Cuyp market, restaurants and other entertainment venues within walking distance.

name: stijlvol luxe appartement op de begane grond
description:
Have fun with the whole family in this stylish space. Central area, very popular Amstel river and Weesperzijde neighborhood. The apartment is situated on the fourth floor of a typical Amsterdam building.

name: Garden Apartment in De Pijp
description: Cozy and stylish garden apartment in the heart of De Pijp, one of Amsterdam’s best neighborhoods. Just steps from Sarphatipark and the Albert Cuyp Market. Relax in the sunny private garden, cook in the fully equipped kitchen, or chill in the comfy living room. The main bedroom is peaceful, and the second room works great as a bedroom and office. Close to great food, shops, and public transport — perfect for a laid-back city stay!

name: Spacious appartment 'de Pijp'

name: Stylish & Cosy Amsterdam House
description:

Stylishly decorated and fully equipped, it offers all modern comforts, including a beautiful open kitchen and a spa-like bathroom with a freestanding tub. The city centre and major attractions are within 15 minutes’ reach, ideal for exploring, then returning to peace and comfort.

A hidden gem to unwind after a day in the city.

description: New on Airbnb – this apartment was completed in March 2025 and therefore has no reviews yet. Stylish 70m² apartment in the popular De Pijp district. Features include new windows, well isolated, underfloor heating, spacious king-size bed, modern kitchen and luxurious bathroom with double sinks and large walk-in shower. Ideal for a couple (with baby), expats, and business travelers looking for a central stay without sacrificing peace and comfort.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam oost
description:
This apartment is perfect for couples and is located in a lovely neighborhood.

The neighborhood is calm but very close to the more lively areas such as the city center. It takes about 20 to 30 minutes to reach the city center by tram, or 10 to 15 minutes by bike.
Park Frankendael is just around the corner and the Oosterpark is nearby as well.

There are many bars and restaurants within walking distance.

name: Stylish & Spacious Duplex with Rooftop terrace
description:
Refined 2-floor apartment in trendy Frederik Hendrikbuurt, just outside central Amsterdam.

Minimalist design with curated interior, open-plan living with south-facing balcony, fully equipped kitchen with central bar & premium coffee setup, dining area with vibrant street views.

Upstairs: serene bedroom with super king bed, workspace, spa-style bathroom with bathtub & separate shower. Private rooftop terrace with 360° views, lounge & BBQ. A high-end, peaceful city retreat.

This stylishly renovated space combines unique design elements with a spacious bedroom and ensuite. The stunning roof terrace offers breathtaking views of Amsterdam. The neighbourhood is equally inviting, with quiet, friendly enhancing the charm of this beautiful location.

name: Stadsappartement met dakterras
description:
This bright and stylish 85 m² apartment offers a perfect mix of comfort, space and has an ideal location for exploring Amsterdam.

Located in the bustling Oud-Zuid, next to the Vondelpark. Excellent access by public transport to cultural hotspots such as the Rijksmuseum and the Concertgebouw.

Meanwhile, enjoy the spacious private roof terrace of 30 m² on the southwest with a BBQ. An oasis in the city.

Apartment is on the 3rd floor. There is no elevator.

name: Charming Apartment in City Centre
description: Stylish apartment in vibrant De Pijp, just minutes from the Albert Cuyp Market and Rijksmuseum. It features a bright living area, dining space, and fully equipped kitchen. The bedroom has a queen-size bed, open wardrobe, ambient lighting, and balcony access. Includes a modern bathroom with shower, separate toilet and a washing machine — all in a quiet yet central location.

name: Cosy apartment near Jordaan and Westerpark
description:
Beautiful apartment in a cozy neighborhood, close to the park and the city center of Amsterdam. A quiet street, but still around the corner from nice cafes, restaurants and shops, within walking and cycling distance of the bustling city center, De Jordaan and the hip Westerpark. Public transportation is just around the corner.
Discover Amsterdam and come back among the locals in this great neighborhood. In the park, you can relax, but there are also bustling events, markets, cafes, and restaurants.

name: Spacious Studio Apartment
description: Spacious studio flat on a pretty and peaceful street full with independent shops, restaurants and cafes. Easy access to the city centre by bike, tram or metro.

name: Sunny Apartment with Unique Touches
description: Bright and thoughtfully designed apartment just steps from Westerpark. The space combines comfort with clean design details, natural light, and a fully equipped kitchen. Ideal for relaxing or working during your stay in the city. Close to cafes, cultural spots, and great green spaces, all within walking distance.

name: Cosy & light - Artist home
description: The unique thing about this property is its location: close to the Central Station and yet in Amsterdam-Noord. This means that you have all the advantages of the city within reach, while you are also in nature, such as in the Vliegenbos. Amsterdam-Noord also offers countless nice restaurants, cozy cafes and hip clubs. A lovely place to get away from it all, whether you come for peace or to fully enjoy everything Amsterdam has to offer.

name: Studio aan het IJ met gratis fietsen
description: Privacy in a bright, modern studio on a quiet street in the popular Oostelijk Havengebied area near the city center. No stove, but fridge, Nespresso, milk frother, kettle and egg cooker. Clean modern bathroom with a shower and wc. Please note: the studio has high ceilings, and you will sleep on a mezzanine without headroom. Not recommended for the elderly or people with limited mobility. If desired, they can request bedding for the sofa bed downstairs for an additional fee. 2 bicycles are included.

Experience historic charm combined with modern comforts: two bathrooms,, double glazing, and a large sunny rooftop terrace. A unique and stylish place to enjoy the best of Amsterdam’s famous canal district.

name: Gezellig privé-appartement
description:
Welcome to our warm and charming home, located in the lively Hugo de Groot neighborhood. Just minutes from the Jordaan and the historic city center, you’ll find yourself surrounded by cafés, boutiques, and local markets.

Our apartment is bright, spacious, and thoughtfully decorated to make you feel at home. Whether you’re relaxing in the cozy living room or enjoying a morning coffee on the balcony, this is the perfect base for your stay in Amsterdam.

name: Two floor apartment near Jordaan with rooftop
description:
Fully renovated two floor apartment in the Staatsliedenbuurt five minutes walking to Westerpark and Jordaan.

The apartment has a bright and spacious living room on the first floor with open kitchen and two balconies. The kitchen has all amenities. One bedroom on the second floor with a comfortable double bed, towels and bed linen are included. A bathroom with shower and a spacious bathtub.

In case you're allergic: please note that we have a cat. He will not be there during your stay.

name: Family-Friendly Apt w/ amazing lake view
description:
Peaceful family-friendly apartment in Amsterdam, right by Sloterplas Park! 🌳 ⛵️

Enjoy nature views from the balcony, relax in the spacious living room, and sleep comfortably in two cozy bedrooms. Fully equipped apartment.

4 min walking to access the lake. Sloterplas is perfect for swimming, morning runs, or chilling at the city beach 🏖️

Perfect for a quiet stay with easy access to all the city offers!

name: Ruim en licht appartement
description:
This completely renovated space is bathed in light thanks to large windows on both sides. The stylish open kitchen with bar forms the heart of the house, while the spacious bedroom with luxurious ensuite bathroom provides ultimate comfort.

Located on the beautiful Churchill avenue with lots of greenery and cozy coffee bars and restaurants.

By tram, you can reach all central locations in Amsterdam, such as De Dam or Amsterdam Central Station, in no time.

name: studio next to RAI
description: This unique place has a style all its own. It has a basketball court, a rooftop, front and back gardens with a hammock, pool table, pin pon table, gym, darts and gaming consoles you can rent per hour as well as a lounge with multiple couches and TV's. It is located between RAI metro station and ZUIDAS making it really easy to access all forms of public transport 10 min by foot.

name: Stijlvolle, ruime woning
description: Spacious family home in a quiet new development in Amsterdam Noord, within walking distance of the NDSM site and ferries to the city center. Four bedrooms (including children's and baby room), study, garden with lounge, fully equipped kitchen, luxury bathroom with bath and rain shower, separate toilet, Sonos speaker system, smart TV and lighting plan. Includes linens, washing machine and free parking.

name: Parkside family home
description:
Stylish and spacious family home in Amsterdam Oud-Oost, right at Oosterpark. Features 3 large bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a sunny south-facing garden. Perfect for a family with 2 kids. Stylish yet practical interior. Steps from cafés, public transport, and the Tropenmuseum (KIT).
A peaceful retreat with the park as your front yard – enjoy the best of Amsterdam with the comfort of home.

Book now and experience the best of Amsterdam – with all the comfort of home.

Stay in a bright and comfortable guest room in Amsterdam’s charming Rivierenbuurt, hosted by an experienced Superhost.

description: Welcome to our cosy apartment with a view over the Amstel river! Situated in the eastern part of the city, this is the perfect spot to relax, while also being close to the city center and popular neighborhoods like 'De Pijp'  and 'De Indische Buurt'. We really enjoy living here and when we're away, we like to share it with others.

description: Casa Columbus is a  spaceous, light place of 2 stories, centrally located in Amsterdam on a large quiet square, in a neighbourhood full of services and only 10 minutes bike from centre. A living with balcony, a fully equipped kitchen and a modern bathroom. 2 bedrooms offer place to 4 persons.  Enjoy Amsterdam to the max with your partner and/or children.

name: Newly renovated Family-Friendly Riverside Home

Spacious 215 m² family home on the Amstel River, just minutes from Amsterdam’s center.

Three bedrooms (incl. master with ensuite), two bathrooms, a laundry room, kids’ playroom with PlayStation, TV, Football table and a separate adult living room. Enjoy the private garden with ping pong table.

Stylish, comfy, and full of space to relax and play.

In the master bedroom there is a king size bed - in addition there is a separate study with 2 seats. The large, sunny garden is ideal for dining at the garden table or relaxing on the lounge sofas, equipped with a BBQ.

name: Spacious apartment at the canals with rooftop
Fantastic Ground Floor with Sunny garden
description: Unique apartment with sunny garden in the most beautiful neighborhood of Amsterdam. Museums, restaurants and the Vondelpark are just around the corner. Enjoy the tranquility at home with all the facilities that the city has to offer just a stone's throw away.

name: Modern family home
description: Light-filled modern home with stunning waterfront views — perfect for families! Kids will love the spacious playroom, nearby playgrounds, and Europe’s largest skate park just steps away. Located in quiet, kid-friendly Zeeburgereiland, with cafes, public sports fields, and swimming spots nearby. Only 10 – 15 min to Amsterdam’s city center by bike, tram, or bus!

name: Writer's Apartment in Amsterdam Oost
description:
Quiet, spacious, exceedingly peaceful apartment in charming, laid-back Amsterdam Oost (East). One bedroom, one bathroom, many books. Minutes on foot from number 19 tram, which will bring you to the city center in about 15 mins.

The neighborhood has lovely parks, shops, and restaurants. I'm a writer and live and work in this space as my main residence; I am looking for guests who will care for my home like their own.

name: Sunny apartment with roof terrace!
description:
This unique place in West is perfect to discover Amsterdam. Close to the city centre, 15 minute bike or tram ride to Central station and all other main attractions like the museums, the canal boat rides and parks. Many coffee places and restaurants around, with convenience stores and a supermarket around the corner.

It's on the fourth floor, normal stairs (no lift). The bedrooms are on the quiet side. Enjoy the roof terrace and take care of the place, it is not just an Airbnb, it's our house!

Looking for a unique overnight stay for two? Our charming gypsy wagon is located in the peaceful outskirts of Amsterdam, surrounded by meadows, birds, and silence. A cosy spot where you can relax together, far from the hustle and bustle, yet with the city within easy reach.

- Large dinner table

It’s a recently renovated, ground floor apartment in a classic 1920’s building.

We moved here recently and live here with our (hypo allergenic) cat Flo. Don’t worry, we’ll take him with us during your stay.

The apartment is at walking distance from the free ferry to Amsterdam Central Station and the metro, which has a direct line through the city and takes apx. 7 minutes.

name: Private & cosy apartment at park
description:
Bright and quiet 3rd and 4th floor corner apartment overlooking a green park in Amsterdam West.

This warm home features oak wooden floors, Philips Hue lighting, a cozy TV corner, a balcony and a recently renovated toilet & bathroom. Neighbours are generally quiet.

Surrounded by greenery, Erasmuspark is right outside with a petting zoo and swimming spot. Public transport directly to the city centre and bike rental is a 3-5 minute walk away. Ideal for couples seeking a relaxed Amsterdam stay.

description:

- Sleeps 7 with 3 king beds & Smart TVs and 1 single bed
- Bright living area & full kitchen with dining for 6 chairs

- Enjoy central Amsterdam with low-season rates

description:

There are 2 bedrooms with fine king and queen size double beds and a loft with bath and projector. Outside you will find a lovely south-facing garden.

During your stay, you will also take care of our two sweet cats (Sonic & Shadow) and a quiet snake. They ask little; water and love is enough.

name: New design apartment next to Jordaan
description:
Welcome to my newly renovated designer apartment, perfectly located next to the beautiful Westerpark.

The space features a stylish kitchen with all essentials, a modern bathroom, a comfortable bed, and a cozy balcony. Convenient tram access makes getting around the city easy.

Tucked away on a quiet street beside Westerpark, yet only a 6-minute walk from the charming Jordaan district! Our neighborhood is vibrant, with amazing bars, restaurants, and shops just around the corner.

description:
Stylish 2 floor apartment in Amsterdam’s Old West. Enjoy a bright living room with a modern kitchen and access to a private rooftop terrace to enjoy your morning coffee or evening wine.

The lower level features a cozy bedroom with an ensuite bathroom, complete with a bathtub and walk-in shower. Step out into your own garden oasis, perfect for relaxing. This apartment offers a perfect blend of comfort and charm in a prime location.

Three floors with its own entrance. The best baker is within walking distance!

!! Minimum stay of 2 nights !!

After a day of shopping in the 9 Streets or exploring museums, you can relax here in complete tranquility. Shops, cafés, and cultural attractions are all within walking distance.

description: Enjoy comfy capsule-style beds or private ensuites, a cozy vibe, gym and laundry access, and sparkling clean facilities. name: Charmant 16e eeuws appartement op toplocatie
description:
From your own 16th-century apartment in the heart of the city center, you can enjoy what makes Amsterdam so unique: the 17th-century canal houses across the street and the occasional sailing of boats in the canals and through the Haarlemmersluis.

Thanks to six large windows, there is an unobstructed view from the living room over the water of the Singel and Brouwergracht. The Stromarkt is located in the heart of Amsterdam, a few minutes' walk from the Centraal Station.

Quiet and safe neighborhood full of cafes, shops and public transport, with direct connection to the city center (10 min) and the Pijp (5 min).

Perfect for relaxing, working in Amsterdam or for couples who want to discover Amsterdam. Book your stay now!

Please note: parties or drug use are absolutely not allowed!

description:
Welcome to our cozy and quiet apartment in the heart of Amsterdam’s chic De Pijp district. Bright and stylish with brand-new furniture, this 1-bedroom flat is perfect for couples. Just steps from the Albert Cuyp Market, trendy cafés, and boutiques, and a short walk or bike ride to major museums and attractions. Strategically located for easy access to the entire city by bike or public transport.
No pets allowed.

description: Beautiful apartment in one of the best areas of Amsterdam Jordaan. Very close to Central Station and Dam Square. Excellent transport links. Jordaan is one of the most vibrant and popular neighborhoods in Amsterdam. It is known for its narrow canals, cozy cafes, and unique atmosphere. The area is home to many art galleries, antique shops, and boutiques. The Jordaan is also famous for its markets, like the ‘Westermarkt’ and ‘Noordermarkt,’ where you can find fresh produce and various goods.

The apartment is fully furnished for a relaxing stay, with a bright living room, a comfortable bed, a modern bathroom and a fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for couples, solo travelers or business travelers.

description: Cozy, comfortable and bright corner house with garden near the NDSM and Noord-Zuid line in Amsterdam Noord. A village feeling 20 minutes away from the city center of Amsterdam! Renovated two years ago with a stylish cast floor with underfloor heating, a new kitchen and a lovely sofa. Our sweet cat Mila makes the house even more homely. Upstairs there are two bedrooms  and a bathroom with a toilet. There is also a separate toilet downstairs. The garden is wonderfully green and sunny.

A spacious home in a wonderful & quiet part of Amsterdam. Two luscious gardens and a sun-drenched kitchen make for a true tropical paradise.

Many cozy corners all around the house and garden. Two friendly chickens and a bunny roam the backgarden. Yes, you're welcome to eat their eggs!

With three double bedrooms, a stargazing bathtub and just a 15min bike-ride to the ferry into the city center, you will surely make some special memories at this unique & family-friendly place.

This charming corner apartment offers beautiful views of the park, historical museum and is located in one of the most desirable and greenest parts of central Amsterdam – often referred to as “the garden of Amsterdam.” Surrounded by water and nature, it’s the perfect spot to relax while still being close to everything.

You’ll have the entire apartment to yourself, including a living room, a study, a fully equipped kitchen, a cozy bedroom, and a comfortable bathroom.

name: Familiehuis aan het water in de Houthavens
description: Entire house with four floors directly on the IJ. Quiet but centrally located in the Houthavens in a car-free street. Swimming opportunities everywhere. Within 10 minutes you can be in the Jordaan or at the station. There is comfortable floor cooling, three bedrooms, two bathrooms.

name: The Elephant Hostel - Ladies Only Dorm 15 Beds
description:
Welcome to our 15-bed female-only dorm at The Elephant Hostel. Designed with comfort and privacy in mind, each bed features a personal reading light, charging socket, privacy curtain, and lockable storage. Enjoy a clean shared bathroom and fast Wi-Fi.

We're just steps from the tram stop to Central Station, and you'll love our on-site gym and cozy café—perfect for relaxing or working remotely.

Ideal for solo travellers or friends looking for a safe and sociable place to stay in Amsterdam!

name: Great ground flour house Jordaan
description: Stylish 83m² home in the heart of the Jordaan, perfect for a couple. Located on a peaceful canal street, yet just steps from cafés, shops, and markets. Enjoy a beautifully designed space with everything you need for a comfortable stay in central Amsterdam.

name: Appartement bij het Vondelpark
description:
Bright & Peaceful Apartment with Canal View and Roof Terrace
Welcome to our recently renovated 60m² apartment in the heart of Amsterdam Oud-West, just around the corner from Vondelpark. The space is filled with natural light, offers beautiful canal views, and features a large private roof terrace, perfect for relaxing after a day in the city. Modern and fully equipped, the apartment is designed to offer comfort and calm in a lively yet peaceful neighborhood.

name: 2-Bedroom Apt. (108m²) w/ Rooftop -Family-Friendly
description:
Welcome to our spacious 108m² apartment, perfectly located in calm and charming Amsterdam West — just a short walk from cafes, shops, and tram connections to the city center.

The apartment is ideal for families or two couples, and thoughtfully equipped with baby and toddler amenities.

Enjoy the best of indoor-outdoor living with both a balcony and a large private roof terrace (21m²) — complete with a BBQ, lounge set, and outdoor dining area. It’s the perfect spot for relaxing summer evenings.

name: Sunny Apartment with Rooftop
description:
70 m² apartment in the beloved Rivierenbuurt with a rare private rooftop terrace (26 m²!) that’s all yours to enjoy.
The apartment boasts a generous living room, a kitchen island, a balcony and plenty of space to relax after a day exploring the city.
- 5 minutes by bike to De Pijp
- 10 minutes by bike to the city centre
- 5 minutes on foot to the Amstel River, where you’ll find some of the city's most beautiful summer terraces, buzzing bars, and stylish restaurants — a true local favorite.

name: Mooi appartement Rivierenbuurt
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

name: Amstel river & Garden view
description: Tastefully furnished, art filled house alongside the Amstel river, with a 20 meter long garden and several dining, chill, comfortable spaces to unwind.

name: Family house in the Pijp with roof terrace
description: Spacious, bright family home in lively De Pijp with 3 bedrooms, a large living room with 2 balconies, modern kitchen, sunny roof terrace with sandbox, bbq, and a 2-person bedcloset in the living room. Perfect for families, with toys and kids amenities. Playgrounds, a petting zoo, shops, restaurants, and the market nearby. Metro and tram stops within walking distance. Two sweet cats live in the house, requiring care (or a cat-free home on request). An ideal base for exploring Amsterdam with kids!

name: Cozy appartment in de Pijp
description: The spacious 90 m2 two-bedroom apartment in the Pijp Amsterdam offers you the opportunity to taste Amsterdam life. The corner apartment is located on the ground floor with an east-facing garden. With windows around the house, it gives a lot of light during the day, and this colorful apartment feels like a quiet oasis in bustling Amsterdam.

name: Cozy Apartment in the Vibrant De Pijp Neighborhood
description: A cozy apartment in the vibrant “De Pijp” neighborhood, perfectly located in central Amsterdam with lots of nice shops, restaurants, and bars within walking distance. It is also easily accessible by public transport.

name: Herenstraat Residence (Room 1)
description: Stay in a beautifully renovated studio in the heart of Amsterdam’s Jordaan, one of the city’s most iconic neighborhoods. Enjoy modern comfort with a rain shower, cozy bed, and fast Wi-Fi, all just steps away from picturesque canals, boutique shops, cafés, and top restaurants. Famous museums and attractions are within walking distance, making it the perfect base to explore Amsterdam.

name: Volledige woning aan de gracht
description: This entire apartment is located on a quiet canal, centrally located in the historical center of Amsterdam, just a stone's throw from the bustling Nieuwmarkt.

name: Nice apartment in cosy Jordaan area
description: This centrally located accommodation is full of comforts and has a sunny balcony and a lovely bedroom.

name: Charming Apt in Historic Canal House
description:
Our beautiful, bright, cozy and fully equipped apartment in a historic canal house is the perfect home base to experience Amsterdam like a local.

Set right on the canal but overlooking a peaceful inner courtyard, it offers the best of both worlds: a calm retreat in the middle of the lively and iconic “Negen Straatjes” (Nine Streets) district. Cafés, boutiques, galleries, restaurants, and major sights are all within walking distance.

name: Cosy flat next to Westerpark
description: Welcome to your home away from home in Amsterdam! This charming first-floor flat is perfect for couples, friends or solo travelers, just a short stroll from the vibrant Jordaan district and right next to the beautiful Westerpark. Surrounded by great restaurants, cafés, and bars, you’ll enjoy the best of local life while being close to the city center. Ideal for a relaxing and authentic Amsterdam stay.

name: Great family apartment
description:
Welcome to our family home!

This is a great place to retreat after a buzzing day in the city. The apartment is located on the ground floor, with it's own front door and picnic table for morning brunch and evening drinks!

We live here with our 18 months old daughter, so there's plenty of equipment for kids; a baby stroller/prem, cleaning table, baby cot, play area and more. If you prefer us to stow away some of the items, please let us know in advance.

We hope you enjoy Amsterdam!

name: Luxe en stijlvol AP @Amsterdam Oud-West
description:
Welcome to our home! This beautifully renovated apartment is located in the popular Oud-West neighborhood in Amsterdam, and is within walking distance of the Vondelpark.

The neighborhood is lively, with cozy cafes and restaurants around the corner. In addition, you can quickly reach all the hotspots of Amsterdam (such as the Jordaan, Rijksmuseum, heart of the city center, etc.) by public transportation.

The house has been completely renovated over the past year, so the kitchen and bathroom are brand new.

name: Charming apt calm Central Street
description: A charming apartment situated on one of Amsterdam’s most beautiful and peaceful streets, perfectly central. Just a 5-minute walk from the Museum District, Vondelpark, the canals, and the popular Oud-West neighborhood.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam-Noord
description:
Apartment in a quiet, green area in Amsterdam Noord. Via the Noord Zuid metro line (5 min. cycling) in 5 minutes to Amsterdam Centraal but at the same time also within 10 minutes walking in the polder outside the built-up area. Perfect middle ground between tranquility and the city of Amsterdam.

Supermarket is a 4-minute walk, park is a 2-minute walk.

Apartment has a newly renovated kitchen and bathroom. Both are completely new.

name: Dok Apartment
description:
From this perfectly located home base, everything is within reach.
Cetral located apartment near Nemo Museum

name: Historisch huis vlakbij centrum
description:
Private house with garden, near city centre.

Our house combines original features like wooden beams with modern elements we’ve added ourselves. There’s a front terrace and a private garden in the back for relaxing. Your host would be Frenkie, our cuddly orange cat, who will probably come say hi :-)

- Double bed
- Terrace & private garden
- Working kitchen with oven + dishwasher
- Washing machine
- TV
- Bedding & towels included
- Near city centre
- Quiet area

No smoking or party's allowed.

name: Houseboat Studio Mar B&B
description:
This memorable place is anything but ordinary.

This is a lovely and romantic studio, very cozy and bright with all the comforts.

It is located in one of the oldest and widest canals in Amsterdam, in the very center of the city, although in a quiet area.

It has huge windows that can be wide opened, where you can enjoy a wonderful view of the canal!

The studio has a double bed, a small table with two chairs, two armchairs and a complete private bathroom.

name: Central beautiful spacious flat
description: Welcome to our bright and peaceful apartment on Martin Vlaarkade—a hidden gem nestled along the water in one of Amsterdam’s most authentic neighborhoods. Surrounded by trees and greenery, this stylish home offers the perfect blend of calm and convenience, just minutes from the city’s most vibrant areas.

name: Sunny roof-apartment Amsterdam
description: This special place is located in one of the most popular neighborhoods of Amsterdam. The Ten Kate market is right downstairs as well as the Hallen, where you can find great food, go see movies or shop. The famous ‘negen straatjes’ and the Jordaan are right around the corner. If you’re not necessarily here to explore the city, this peaceful and sunny apartment is the best place to just relax on the couch, find your peace on the roof terrace or work from home on the broad dining room table.

name: Cozy couple's apartment and young kids' paradise
description: Welcome to our beloved family home, a cozy 70m2 two bedroom apartment in the heart of Amsterdam with garden. Ideal for 1 couple or families with young kids.

name: Bright 1BR apartment in Oost
description:
☀️ Sunny Apartment with Balcony in Trendy Amsterdam-Oost

Wake up to sunlight and enjoy your coffee on the spacious south-facing balcony! This bright 1-bedroom apartment is perfect for solo travelers or couples. Just steps from a beautiful park and great local spots. Cook up a storm in the fully equipped kitchen and unwind in a peaceful space after exploring the city.

Located on the 3rd floor (No elevator, just classic Amsterdam charm)

name: Oostenburgje
description: Stay in my eco-friendly studio in Houtrak, a stunning wooden building in Amsterdam's trendy Oostenburg ("Little Berlin"). Access our shared green courtyard, secure bike parking, and a rooftop garden offering panoramic city views. You are steps from waterfront dining, boutique shopping on Czaar Peterstraat, and craft beer at Brouwerij 't IJ. Very well-connected: Tram 26 is a 5-minute walk away, taking you to Central Station in under 10 minutes.

name: luxurious house with jacuzzi!
description:
This luxurious house has it all, its in a quiet and safe area close to Amsterdam city centre. It has an open plan fully equipped modern kitchen, and a garden with a jacuzzi!

Upstairs are 2 large bedrooms both with AC and a modern luxurious bathroom.

This house is newly renovated, and had style and class. This is the place to be!

A true hidden gem!

name: Spacious wooden home in the city
description:
Our unique place, located in a quiet street, is a wooden corner house, which radiates warmth and coziness. It has a ground floor and upper floor, both with a fully equipped kitchen and three separate bedrooms and bathrooms.

The city centre is a 15 min bike ride away, and there is a good bus and metro connection as well. A free ferry to Central Station is at walking distance at the NDSM Wharf, the creative heart of North, where you find street art and a variety of nice restaurants and cafés.

name: De Pijp
description: Located in the heart of De Pijp, this apartment offers the perfect blend of culture, comfort, and city life. Step outside and you find yourself surrounded by cozy cafe's, restaurants and boutique shops. Just a short stroll away, you'll discover some of Amsterdam's most iconic attractions including the world famous Rijksmuseum, the lively Albert Cuyp market, and the beautiful green spaces of the Vondelpark and Sarphatipark.

name: Lovely House in Amsterdam East
description:
This special, cosy summer house in Amsterdam is a special place in Amsterdam: easy going, 7 minute cycle to the city center and 5 minute walk to the train station (Amstel station).

Only reservations are possible for 5+ nights.

Enjoy your stay in Amsterdam!

name: Luxury Private Apt Next to RAI - Spacious/Stylish
description:
Luxurious private apartment – next to RAI & near the city centre 🛌 🌇 🍷

Welcome to our beautifully renovated, stylish, spacious (80m²) apartment on the third floor in Amsterdam’s Rivierenbuurt. Recently renovated and tastefully furnished, offering luxury and comfort. Situated right next to the RAI Convention Centre, the Maassraat and just minutes from the city centre.

Ideal whether you're visiting Amsterdam for business, culture, or relaxation – this is your perfect home away from home!

name: Charmante 1BR appartement in de Baarsjes
description: Cozy and charming 1-bedroom apartment in De Baarsjes, right next to the green Erasmus Park. Equipped with bathroom with rain shower, separate toilet, modern kitchen with dishwasher, combi microwave, washer/dryer and air conditioning. Enjoy the beautiful view of the west tower. Tram stop in front of the door, and within 10 minutes by bike you are in the bustling city center. Area with cozy restaurants, bakers, Noordermarkt, Jordaan and Foodhallen

name: Family Home & Garden in Oud-Zuid
description:
Stylish three-story home in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid, just steps from Vondelpark.

Features a sunny private garden, open kitchen, spacious living room, 2 large bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a dedicated baby room with crib. Perfect for couples or families looking for space, comfort, and a top location.

name: Charming souterrain studio at Bloemgracht 30
description: Charming, fully renovated souterrain in a 17th-century canal house on nr 30 of the iconic Bloemgracht. Enjoy a king-size bed, spacious private bathroom, separate toilet, sofa bed, and smart TV. Located in the heart of the Jordaan, just steps from the 9 Streets, Anne Frank House, and cozy cafés and boutiques. A stylish, peaceful hideaway in the city – perfect for couples, solo travelers, or friends.

name: Moderne Woning In De Pijp
description:
The house is on the ground floor; you don't have to use any steep stairs.

Step inside this bright family house of 100 m², The modern kitchen with 4 meter high ceiling invites you to long, cozy cooking sessions, while the playful split-level living room creates a lovely, open atmosphere.

Furthermore, there is a lovely 50 m² balcony + garden where you can have breakfast in the morning, let the children play freely, and enjoy dinner in the evening.

P.S.: Longer-term rentals are possible: please get in touch.

name: Stylish comfy family apartment
description:
Welcome to our spacious (140sqm), charming apartment located in lively Oud-West. Just a short walk from the city center and it’s iconic canals. It’s the perfect home base for a family looking for comfort and convenience.
We have created an unique, colorful bubble in the middle of Amsterdam. Surrounded by many places for a nice brunch/lunch, restaurants with a variety of different kitchens and vivid bars. Enough choice to meet everyone’s needs.
Public transport stops for tram and bus at 150m

name: Epic family loft aan het water
description: Luxury family loft on Levantplein. Peace, space and comfort in the heart of Amsterdam with a swimming jetty on the doorstep. It is a large house with many sleeping places, but local regulations only allow you to advertise for rent to a maximum of four people.

name: Appartement in Rivierenbuurt, close to RAI & Pijp
description: Fully renovated and bright one-bedroom apartment of 61m2 in the Rivierenbuurt, within walking distance of the RAI and Pijp. Featuring air conditioning in the bedroom, a bathroom with walk-in shower, an open kitchen, a separate office, and a washing machine and dryer. Enjoy the balcony and the lively Rijnstraat and Maasstraat just around the corner, with supermarkets only one minute away. Just a few minutes’ walk to the tram that takes you directly to the city centre and Amsterdam Central Station

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay on this quiet and stylish street in a central location.

name: The Vondel Nest / Spacious & Family-Friendly
description:
Nestled just steps away from Vondelpark, this bright and spacious apartment is the perfect retreat to enjoy the city in comfort and style.

Start your day with coffee by the window, take a morning stroll through the park, or explore the nearby museums and cafés, all within walking distance. Whether you're traveling with kids or just want extra space to unwind, you'll feel right at home.

name: Central Apartment With Sunny Terrace
description:
Welcome in our own apartment with sunny terrace in Amsterdam!

It's situated in the lively Oost neighbourhood, with all the facilities you wish for close by, including:

*public transport (bus, tram, train)
* a shopping street with supermarkets, drug shops and amazing cafe's & restaurants from all over the world (famous "Javastraat")
* various parks
* walking distance into the city

As hosts, David and Olly, we value good hygiene, so you can accept a clean and well organized apartment.

name: Cozy Home in City Center
description:
Welcome to my cozy first-floor apartment located in Amsterdam's quiet neighborhood in the heart of the city. Ideal for adult couples or business guests, who want to wind down after a busy day of sightseeing or work.

It is equipped with high-speed WiFi, great for a business call or call to your loved ones back home.

name: Chic & Sunny flat with Balcony near the park
description:
This charming one bedroom apartment is situated just two blocks away from the picturesque Westerpark in the center of Amsterdam.

Featuring a cosy and inviting atmosphere, the apartment boasts a comfortable living area, a fully equipped kitchen, a bright bedroom with a comfortable bed, and a small bathroom.
With its prime location, guests can easily explore the vibrant Haarlemmerdijk street, take a stroll through the park, or venture out to discover all the city has to offer.

name: Huis met tuin in Baarsjes
description:
Design 80m² apartment on the ground floor with private entrance and garden (sunny & ready from Sept). Between Vondel- and Rembrandtpark, in a quiet local area full of cozyness.

Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel island, espresso machine and big dining table. Floor heating, and fast WiFi.

Bedroom with 1.80m Auping bed and en-suite. Separate toilet. Washer/dryer available.

I always check you in myself and love to share tips!

Allergies? A dog lives here (not during your stay

name: Luxurious flat Amsterdam Oud West-Centre
description: Right in the middle of the bustling and popular Oud-West, next to the Vondelpark. Within walking distance of the PC main street. Many trendy restaurants nearby, easily accessible (many public transport options) and paid parking in front of the door. It is a central location, and yet you enjoy all the peace and quiet. The street is surrounded by many nice boutiques, wine shops and florists. Perfect for everyday necessities or a fun outing. Nice place for 2 people who want to stay comfortably and centrally in the heart of Amsterdam!

description: Easily access local hot spots from this hip place.

name: Stylish & Cozy 1BR Apt @ Jordaan (City Center)
description: Welcome to our beautifully designed apartment in the heart of the Jordaan, one of Amsterdam's most popular neighborhoods. The apartment features one bedroom with a queen-size bed and a private terrace complete with a comfortable lounge set. The cozy, thoughtfully designed living area overlooks the vibrant streets of the Jordaan, and the fully equipped kitchen offers everything you need for your convenience. The modern bathroom adds to the comfort. Perfect for couples or business travelers alike.

name: Houseboat center amsterdam
description:
Discover Amsterdam from a truly unique perspective—your very own houseboat! Just a 10-minute walk from Central Station and the charming Jordaan district, this peaceful waterside retreat offers the perfect mix of tranquility and city excitement.

Whether you're planning a romantic escape or an unforgettable city break, this houseboat promises a one-of-a-kind experience in Amsterdam.

name: Country Calm, City Close
description:
Escape the city without leaving it. Just 10 mins from Amsterdam-East, this cozy green retreat sits by a small harbor, next to a tiny church, with chickens in the garden and wide skies all around. Walk or cycle the dikes, explore village life in the city, and relax in a spacious garden oasis—just 20 mins by bike from the heart of Amsterdam. Peace, charm, and connection await.

Kom met het hele gezin tot rust in deze vredige accommodatie.

name: 2BR Condo with Amstel River View
description: Experience the charm of Amsterdam from our centrally located two-bedroom apartment, with stunning Amstel River views. Just blocks away from the InterContinental Amstel Amsterdam Hotel, our spacious and convenient flat ensures a comfortable stay near the heart of the city.

name: Family Appartement in Museum District
description: A tastefully furnished and generously laid-out apartment featuring three spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms, ideal for a family, in a Triple A location in the heart of the Museum District (within walking distance of the Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum), just steps away from Amsterdam’s luxury shopping street with Chanel and Hermès and De Pijp (Amsterdam’s Latin Quarter, home to the Albert Cuyp Market and many bars and trendy lunch spots). A wonderful family home with every modern convenience.

name: Modern ingericht appartement.
description: Modernly furnished apartment, fully available. Centrally located, 10 min from Schiphol. Tram line 2 stops in front of the door and takes you directly to the city center, including Leidseplein, Central Station. Walking distance to a shopping mall. Ideal for a couple, an expat or travelers. Quiet, easily accessible location.

name: Luxury Loft in Central Amsterdam
description: Spacious, stylish, and luxurious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom loft in central Amsterdam. Perfect for business trips or high-end holidays, the loft features elegant interiors, a bright open living area, fully equipped kitchen, and premium finishes throughout. Walk to iconic sights, shops, and dining within reach of a few hundred meters . With high-speed WiFi, dedicated workspace, and a prime location, it’s the ideal stay for comfort, convenience, and style in the heart of the city.

name: Herengracht 204 Souterrain Studio Apt. w/o kitchen
description:
Great central location that sleeps up to 4 persons. Located directly on the most prestigious canal: Herengracht. Comes with your own private entrance to the canal. Close to Dam Square / Royal Palace (400m, 5 min), Anne Frank House (400m, 5 min) and Nine streets shopping area 100 meters / 1 min.

BRING YOUR OWN BREAKFAST: please note this accommodation does not provide any breakfast and has no kitchen. There are multiple food options nearby.
Ideal for families with children.
Pink friendly.

name: Sunny Amstel Appartment
description: Beautiful stylish appartment in a quiet area. Start your morning coffee on the sunny balcony, before walking into the city. Very centre located, in the local area ‘de pijp’, where the best restaurants and bars are located. When the city is too hot go for a swim in the Amstel, which is a 5 min walk. Feel like a local!

name: NEW Luxury Stay in Central Monumental Apartment
description:
Brand-new luxury apartment in a stunning monumental building on one of Amsterdam's cutest — yet quiet — streets. Walking distance to all major sights.

Bright, stylish, and fully renovated with premium finishes. Features a serene bedroom, dedicated home office and a sunny south-facing balcony — perfect for a quick lunch or afternoon drink.

Vondelpark, museums, shops, and restaurants are less than 10 minutes away. Fast WiFi, underfloor heating, and excellent public transport nearby.

name: luxery studio
description:
Recently renovated luxurious small studio just outside the centrum of Amsterdam. In a charming building on the grand floor. Near Nature park "De nieuwe meer"
Only a 15 - minute bus ride from the airport and within walking distance of the trap stop, which takes you directly to Amsterdams city center in 20 minutes.

description: Stylish and bright apartment in the middle of the bustling Pijp, right on the Albert Cuypmarkt. Enjoy a sunny balcony, hot tub and open kitchen. Walk to the Rijksmuseum or take the metro (5 min walk) to explore the city. Ideal for a city trip or workation: a separate study with double monitors is available upon request. When booking, you will receive a list of tips and my favorite places in the city in advance to prepare your stay perfectly!

Newly renovated apartment in a nice location in Amsterdam, close to the Vondelpark. Ideal for a couple or a solo work trip.
