name: Unique and cosy appartement
description:
Authentic and bright 1-bedroom apartment with two balconies, located in a beautiful historic building in charming Oud-West.
At the front you’ll find a spacious living room with a comfortable sofa, connected to the bedroom. At the back, there is a dining kitchen with French doors opening onto the balcony overlooking the courtyard garden. The Vondelpark, the lively 9 Streets and the canals are all within a five-minute walk. In short, a wonderful place to discover Amsterdam!

name: Botanical Haven – Deluxe Garden Room
description: Experience the serenity of our Silent Garden from the comfort of your charming room, where life takes on a rosy hue. The Deluxe Room with Garden View, located in the Main House, welcomes you with its inviting ambiance and lush surroundings.

name: Canal View Deluxe Room
description: For an unparalleled Amsterdam experience, indulge in the Deluxe Room with Canal View. Relax in the spacious and elegant ambiance while enjoying breathtaking vistas of the iconic Keizersgracht, one of the city's most renowned canals.

name: Luxury apartment Amsterdam
description: This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated. Next to the Rijksmuseum, a 5-minute walk away, in the middle of the bustling city. Lots of nice restaurants within walking distance and other fun activities.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square - Deluxe Loft suite
description:
Deluxe Suite with private bathroom.

A perfect stay in a historic Amsterdam setting. This stylish suite combines modern comfort with the charm of a monumental building, featuring high ceilings, a spacious open-plan layout, and a luxurious lofted double bed. Relax in the comfortable sitting area and enjoy views of the city’s vibrant atmosphere just outside your window. Ideal for couples, friends, or business travelers seeking a memorable stay and perfectly suited for longer visits.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square - Deluxe double room
description:
Deluxe Twin/Double Room with private bathroom.

Enjoy comfort and contemporary design in the heart of Amsterdam. This stylish room features either a luxurious double bed or two separate twin beds - perfect for couples, friends, or colleagues traveling together.

name: Special Deluxe Room with a Canal View
description: Relax in a stylish modern room with captivating canal views. Featuring an in-room Whirlpool bath overlooking the picturesque Keizersgracht canal, this room promises a truly rejuvenating break.

name: The Royal Suite
description: For those seeking the royal treatment, our Royal Suite offers a one-of-a-kind experience with an open-plan sitting area. Reflecting the celebrated history of our stately canal house, The Toren stands out as one of the few hotels in Amsterdam to provide guests with the indulgence of a private Whirlpool bath in its Royal Suite.

name: Gezellig, licht appartement Amsterdam-Oost
description:
Great apartment for the whole family! Ideally located in the quiet and cozy Amsterdam East area, with public transportation to the city center right at your doorstep (within 20–30 minutes to Centraal Station, Museumplein, Dam Square, etc.). Plenty of dining options around the corner and a beautiful green park right next door. Nice terrace facing south.

Perfect for a couple with a baby/young child, as the second bedroom is a baby room. If desired, the crib can also be exchanged for a 90 x 200 cm folding bed.

name: Lovely apartment in Amsterdam (2p)
description: Our stylish and light-filled apartment offers all the comfort needed for a pleasant stay. Located in a quiet street in popular Oud-Zuid, it is within walking distance of Vondelpark, shops, cafés, and restaurants. The bright living room has a beautiful view of the Schinkel. It features one bedrooms, separate work-room, a fully equipped kitchen, a sunny south-facing balcony and a modern bathroom. Well-connected by public transport, it’s perfect for a comfortable stay in the hart of Amsterdam.

name: Generator - Bed in 4 Bed Deluxe Dorm
description: Easily access local hot spots from this hip place.

name: Generator - Bed in 4 bed Deluxe Dorm
description: Overlooking the beautiful Oosterpark, Generator Amsterdam offers a unique blend of style, comfort, and affordability. Housed in a former zoological university, our property features a range of accommodations from shared dorms to private rooms, catering to all types of travellers.

name: Appartement aan de gracht
description: Fantastic sunny apartment on the canal in Amsterdam-West

name: Stylish Garden Home in De Pijp | Walk to Museums
description:
Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located charming Amsterdam
home. Enjoy easy access to local Tram and Metro stations. Close to museums, restaurants, and bars. Private garden for outdoor dining.

name: Warm Jordanees huisje
description: We look forward to welcoming you to our charming and characteristic cottage from 1725, in the middle of the cozy Jordaan. Authentic, cozy and full of history – a unique place to truly experience Amsterdam. From this ideally located accommodation, you can do all kinds of activities: the famous nine streets, visit the local markets or discover the rich culture in nearby museums. Everything is within walking distance, while you come home in a quiet, cozy neighborhood full of Amsterdam charm.

name: Luxury Apartment & Private Garden in the Centre
Licht & modern appartement in De Baarsjes
description: Welcome to this bright and stylish apartment on the Hoofdweg! Enjoy the spacious living room with designer sofa, a modern kitchen with everything you need and a cozy dining table. The bedroom and bathroom are sleek and comfortable, perfect for a relaxing stay. Within walking distance you will find nice cafes (Barbaarsch, Neef van Fred), shops and the Rembrandtpark. Ideally located, with good tram connections to the city center. Perfect for a city trip to Amsterdam!

name: Stylish 3BR apartment with terrace near RAI
description:
In the heart of Amsterdam Zuid, the ‘Rivierenbuurt’, we offer our spacious apartment. One of the gems is the 36m2 leafy and quiet roof terrace.

Only a two minutes’ walk to the Scheldestraat with its lovely restaurants and bars. Very near RAI conference center and just minutes from public transport.

Our apartment is especially suited for families who want to explore Amsterdam and stay in a comfortable, child friendly house. The apartment is also certainly perfect for business trips.

name: Luxurious & spacious - AMS-East!
description: Spacious, newly renovated apartment with luxurious amenities for a comfy stay - close to trendy Amsterdam East. Ideal for couples or young families!

name: Charming 2 Bedroom Retreat in Trendy Oud-West!
description:
This cozy two-bedroom apartment is the ideal spot for travelers looking for a genuine local experience without sacrificing proximity to the city's highlights. Walking distance to Vondelpark, Jordaan and Central Amsterdam!

Apartment is designed with a blend of classic Amsterdam character and modern comfort.

Happy to provide LinkedIn for ID check.

Note: As this is a historic building, please be prepared for a typical steep Amsterdam staircase up to the apartment.

name: Sunny&Spacious–Rare in Amsterdam
description:
This stylish and spacious apartment is a rare gem in Amsterdam — perfect for group trips, friends, or families.
One of the highlights is the beautiful balcony. Overlooking a canal and surrounded by lush greenery, old trees, and even parrots. Perfect spot to sip your morning coffee and unwind.
Inside, the apartment is full of natural light and designed for both comfort and style. Whether you're cooking dinner, lounging with friends, or working remotely, the space feels warm, and welcoming.

name: Historic House on the canal (gracht)
description:
This beautiful monumental building is a former police and fire station. It's located at a canal, in Amsterdam Baarsjes/Old-West district.
You have a spacious room with kingsize bed or two separate beds (on request), a couch and dining table. Through your own hallway you enter your private bathroom and kitchenette (no stove). All privat and located on the ground floor. I live on the second floor. There is a possibility to add a crib.
Walk, or take one of the trams, into the center.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: The Almond Blossom Room
description:
Our luxury guest suite is carefully furnished and equipped with:
A comfortable king size box spring.
Private bathroom with rain shower and luxury toiletries.
Smart TV, super fast WiFi, Sonos speaker, coffee and tea making facilities.
Mini fridge available.

Only 15–20 minutes by tram or metro to the city center, Museumplein, Jordaan and Leidseplein.
Close to Lelylaan Station (direct connection to Schiphol – 7 minutes!)
Cheap parking nearby (ask for availability).

name: Cozy apartment in East Amsterdam
description: Our charming 2-bedroom home in the vibrant Eastern Docklands is  Ideal for couples, small families, or remote workers looking for a peaceful base close to the city center.

name: Rustig, centraal gelegen in hartje Amsterdam
description: Our apartment is in a very nice neighborhood, quite quiet but close to the center of Amsterdam. Within walking distance of Museumplein, Rijksmuseum, De Jordaan and Negen Straatjes. Surrounded by the beautiful Amsterdam canals.

name: Cosy A’dam house with Park view
description: Cozy two-bedroom apartment in a quiet, green neighborhood in vibrant Amsterdam. Overlooking a park and public swimming pool, with a sunny balcony off the kitchen. Suitable for 4 people with two double beds, plus a cozy living room and modern bathroom. Just a 10-min walk to the metro or 10-min bike ride to the ferry to Central Station. Surrounded by nature, cafes, and restaurants — peaceful yet centrally located. Perfect for a relaxing city stay!

name: 2 bedroom suite, Amsterdam Zuid
description:
Welcome to your private 2-bedroom suite in the heart of Amsterdam! This bright and cozy space features a rooftop terrace with beautiful panoramic views over the city. Centrally located: 5 min walk to Vondelpark, 7 min by bike to Museumplein, and 8 min to the Zuidas business district. The suite is part of a private home but has its own entrance, so you’ll have the entire floor to yourself.
Perfect for couples, families, friends, or business travelers looking for a peaceful stay in Amsterdam.

name: Urban Jungle with Canal View & Balcony
description: Stylish, sun-drenched apartment with canal views in lively Westerpark. Just 15 min walk to Dam Square, 5 min to the Jordaan and Westerpark. Surrounded by cozy cafés and water, yet peaceful and relaxing. Unwind on the sunny balcony under the stars, with daily visits from colorful parakeets. Bright interior with a beachy-urban vibe, bathtub, and one cozy bedroom. Perfect for couples or small families looking to enjoy both city life and calm.

name: Serene canal retreat & workspace
description:
Discover your sanctuary on a quiet canal in Amsterdam's heart. This bright and spacious top floor appartment offers a rare blend of central convenience and tranquil privacy

A professional workspace, with its large desk, extra monitor, and canal view, ensures productivity

Unwind in the spa-like bathroom, featuring a deep soaking tub and separate shower, before retiring to a plush king-size bed

Explore the city's finest sites by foot, then return to the unmatched peace of your exclusive retreat

name: Cozy apartment near Erasmuspark, Amsterdam West
description:
Cozy house ideal for enjoying amsterdam, ideal for couples, small families or (small) groups.

The apartment has everything you need in order to have a pleasant stay in Amsterdam. It is close to many different shops and easy access to public transport. Situated in a very calm street.

name: Luxe appartement Amsterdam-Zuid
description:
Luxury Apartment with Garden in the Heart of Amsterdam-Zuid
Welcome to our beautiful, stylish apartment located in the beloved and quiet Amsterdam-Zuid. This luxurious two-bedroom accommodation with a spacious private garden is the perfect base for both city trippers and business travelers who want to combine comfort, tranquility and the charm of the city. What to expect
2 spacious bedrooms

name: Spacious Junior Suite
description: Indulge in the ‘suite’ life with our Junior Suite, boasting luxurious and stylish decor that sets it apart from any other room in the hotel. Located on the top floor of our Main House, this unique abode serves as the perfect hideout for a delightful escape.

name: Recent gerenoveerd appartement in mooie wijk
description: Recently renovated 3 bedroom apartment in quiet complex.

name: Executive Elegance Suite
description: If you're in search of a serene and peaceful escape, our Executive Suites are the perfect choice, whether your travels are for business or pleasure. The Toren features three luxurious and elegantly decorated Executive Suites.

name: Cosy Double Room in the Canal Belt
description: Guests on the move will find our Cosy Double Canal View Rooms compact but fully equipped with all the essentials for a delightful getaway while exploring the sights of Amsterdam.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square - Executive twin room
description:
Executive Twin/Double Room with private bathroom.
Featuring a luxurious king-size bed (or two separate twin beds upon request), this room is ideal for both business and leisure travelers who value comfort with a touch of sophistication.

name: The Jordaan - Canal Souterrain Studio
description: Charming canal-side studio. Wake up to serene water views in this cozy, stylish space with a comfy double bed, private entrance, and a mini coffee/tea station. Located in the heart of Jordaan, just steps from shops, cafés, and key attractions. Perfect for solo travelers or couples looking to experience authentic Amsterdam living with modern comfort.

name: Central design studio-appartement
description: Enjoy a stylish stay in a 18th-century canal house, perfectly located in the lively heart of Amsterdam. The room is on the 1st floor (accessed via a traditional steep staircase) and offers a smart HDTV with streaming services, iPad-controlled lighting, and an optional kitchenette. A washer and dryer are available upon request, and your attentive host is nearby to assist with anything you may need. Cafés, shops, museums, and canals are all just steps away.

name: Het Grachtenhuis
description:
Enjoy a luxurious stay in our fully restored 70 m² apartment on the Nieuwe Prinsengracht, one of Amsterdam’s most beautiful and tranquil canals. Perfectly located in the city center yet away from the crowds, close to all major attractions. The apartment features a spacious bedroom, walk-in closet, a luxury bathroom with double rain shower, and a fully equipped kitchen. Large windows offer a stunning canal view, creating a bright, calm and elegant place to stay.

We prefer a stay of 2 to 5 weeks

name: Charming Jordaan Apartment
description:
Stay in the heart of the Jordaan, Amsterdam’s most charming neighborhood, known for its quiet canals, cozy cafés, local markets, and boutique shops. Just steps from the;

Anne Frank House, Westerkerk, and the trendy Nine Streets.

Explore Haarlemmerdijk, enjoy weekend farmers' markets at Noordermarkt, or relax by the canals. Central Station, Dam Square, and museums are all within walking distance. Experience the city like a local.

name: [NIEUW] Cozy, modern luxe appartement in ‘De Pijp’
description: Cozy, stylish and fully renovated apartment on the first floor in the heart of De Pijp. Centrally located within walking distance of museums, public transport, shops, cafés, restaurants, Sarphatipark and the Amstel River. Quiet and comfortable, with fast Wi-Fi, underfloor heating and a high-quality bed. Modern kitchen with Bora cooktop, Quooker boiling-water tap and wine fridge.

name: Spacious apartment city centre
description:
The house is modernly furnished and offers everything you need for a comfortable stay. The new kitchen is fully equipped and has every comfort.

Start your day with a cup of coffee on the French balcony at the front and end it with the evening sun on the spacious back balcony.

The Jordaan, the Foodhallen and the Vondelpark are all within walking distance. Thanks to its central location, you can easily discover everything Amsterdam has to offer.

name: Klassiek appartement oud zuid
description: Cozy, warm, classic apartment next to the Vondelpark in a quiet and safe neighborhood. Centrally located: 10-15 min by tram to the city center, or 30 min walk. Original details such as stained glass and ceiling ornaments give the house character. Only 30 minutes from Schiphol.

name: Nice Full modern Apartment in Ams
description: Great apartment in amsterdam - easy access to the centre, Parc, museum, restaurants,...  Green, safe, best Bakkery of Ams,... New Kitchen, Giga Screen,  lux finishing -

name: Bright 2BR w/ Garden | Peaceful Stay in South
description:
- Peaceful home near cafés & trams
- Private garden & bright living area
- King and double bed – sleeps 4
- Full kitchen & laundry for longer stays
- Close to great cafes and restaurants
- Great value stay in local area

name: Centre Amsterdam, CS & Jordaan!
description: Stylish Canal-Side Retreat! Stay in a historic Amsterdam canal house, right in the vibrant city center yet quietly tucked away. Enjoy charming interiors, peaceful views of passing boats, and cafés, restaurants, parks, supermarkets and museums just steps from your door. Perfect for couples or solo travelers seeking an authentic city experience.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam
description:
Wake up in a bright and colorful apartment in the heart of vibrant Amsterdam West.

Relax in the sunny garden perfect for a leisurely breakfast in the morning light or a cozy dinner under the stars. You’ll be staying in a lively neighborhood filled with green parks, charming cafés, trendy restaurants, local markets, and boutique cinemas.

With a bike or public transport, you’ll be in the city center in minutes. Ideal for two adults, with or without a child the perfect to experience Amsterdam.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square - Executive twin room
description:
Executive Twin/Double Room with private bathroom.
Featuring a luxurious king-size bed (or two separate twin beds upon request), this room is ideal for both business and leisure travelers who value comfort with a touch of sophistication.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square - Double or Twin room
description:
Deluxe Twin/Double Room with private bathroom.
Enjoy comfort and contemporary design in the heart of Amsterdam. This stylish room features either a luxurious double bed or two separate twin beds - perfect for couples, friends, or colleagues traveling together.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square - Deluxe twin
description:
Deluxe Twin/Double Room with private bathroom.
Enjoy comfort and contemporary design in the heart of Amsterdam. This stylish room features either a luxurious double bed or two separate twin beds - perfect for couples, friends, or colleagues traveling together.

name: Warm verblijf bij het Flevopark
description: Enjoy a quiet stay in our cozy apartment in Amsterdam East! Right next to the Flevopark is our spacious and bright apartment, which is equipped with all comforts. The cozy living room has a modern kitchen (including a SMEG stove), there is high-speed Wi-Fi, and plenty of space to relax. And as a cherry on the cake, a lovely south-facing balcony! Perfect for couples or solo travelers. Within walking distance of Flevopark, trams, and local cafés in the vibrant Indische Buurt.

name: Bright flat in East Amsterdam
description: Bright apartment in Amsterdam Oost, just off a lively street with great restaurants, cafés and bars. The Dappermarkt and Oosterpark are a short walk away, and the city centre is only 10–15 minutes by tram or bike. A great base to explore the city while enjoying the local atmosphere. Recently renovated with a modern kitchen, bathroom and well-insulated for comfort.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square-Deluxe twin w/ balcony
description: Deluxe Twin/Double Room with balcony and private bathroom. Experience a luxurious stay in the heart of Amsterdam. This elegant room features a private balcony and a choice between a double bed or two single beds. Ideal for couples, friends, or colleagues. Perfect for relaxing after a day in Amsterdam.

name: Gezellige en kleurrijke woning
description: Cozy apartment that is super centrally located in Amsterdam, 5 minutes walk to Rijksmuseum & the canal belt. Our house is located in the coziest street of Amsterdam with lots of greenery, tranquility and cozy restaurants. PLEASE NOTE: This is a residential home, we live here and rent out our house in this fantastic location when we are not there ourselves.

name: Magical Sunset Suite
description:
Welcome to my modern apartment, a stylish place to unwind. The interior is sleek and comfortably furnished, with an eye for detail and equipped with every comfort you need.

The fully equipped kitchen has a dishwasher, oven, large fridge and coffee machine.

The highlight? The large roof terrace with a beautiful view over the city. Perfect for a glass of wine at sunset or a quiet morning with coffee.

name: Unique Stay in Centre of A’dam
description:
This charming and comfortable apartment offers a warm atmosphere and a fantastic location—perfect for exploring everything Amsterdam has to offer.

You’re just a 15-minute walk from the canals and the historic city center. The lively Jordaan—with its picturesque streets and cozy cafés—is right around the corner. You’ll also be next to De Hallen and the popular Foodhallen, the ideal spot to enjoy some of the best street food in the city.

name: Stylish Sunny Apartment w/ Terrace near Vondelpark
description: Sunny and serene apartment in vibrant Oud-West, just 1 min from Vondelpark. Enjoy a private southwest-facing terrace, spacious living room, and a fully equipped kitchen with espresso machine and wine fridge. Includes Sonos sound system, king-size bed, and a luxurious bathroom with rain shower and bathtub. Ideal for couples, solo travelers, and remote workers: fast WiFi, curved monitor (on request), and smart TV with streaming + channels. Close to trendy restaurants, cafés, tram and bike rental.

name: Westerhofje
description: Relax with the whole family in this peaceful accommodation. In the middle of bustling Amsterdam, lies this unique oasis of peace. In a small courtyard behind the Westerstraat, you step into a green garden, from which you reach the apartment.

name: Erasmuspark Apartment
description: I look forward to sharing my little piece of Amsterdam with you. Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space. Right next to Erasmuspark and Erasmusgracht canal where you can relax under a tree or take a dip in the canal. Also easy to access the city center by public transport or by bicycle (15min bike ride)

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square-Deluxe twin w/ balcony
description:
Deluxe Twin/Double Room with balcony and private bathroom.
Experience a luxurious stay in the heart of Amsterdam. This elegant room features a private balcony and a choice between a double bed or two single beds. Ideal for couples, friends, or colleagues. Perfect for relaxing after a day in Amsterdam.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square - Superior Loft Suite
description:
Superior Loft Suite with private bathroom.
Experience luxury & comfort in the heart of historic Amsterdam. Unwind in the sitting area or relax on the lofted double bed. Perfect for couples, friends, or solo travelers looking for a stylish and comfortable stay in the center of the city.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square - Executive loft suite
description:
Executive Loft Suite with private bathroom.
A truly exceptional stay in a historic Amsterdam setting. The Executive Loft Suite offers refined luxury in a comfortable, split-level layout, featuring high ceilings and a sleek, modern design. Relax in the elegant sitting area and have a peceaful night's sleep in the lofted double bed. With direct views over Rembrandt Square, this suite is perfect for couples, friends or solo travelers who seek comfort, style, and an unforgettable city experience.

name: City Hotel Rembrandt Square - Deluxe single room
description:
Single room with private bathroom.
Designed for solo business or leisure travelers, the Deluxe Single Room combines efficiency with elegance.

name: Centraal modern appartement
description: Welcome to this beautiful apartment located on the Van Woustraat in the popular De Pijp neighborhood. Here you stay in a perfect location: close to the city center, but also easily accessible by public transportation and car. This bright apartment has been recently renovated and equipped with all comforts. The open kitchen is fully equipped: oven, dishwasher, induction cooktop and luxury coffee machine. Enjoy the underfloor heating throughout the apartment and quiet office with desk.

name: Green Heaven & Canal in Amsterdam
description:
Build in an old Light Factory with a modern feel. Typical Amsterdam view on the canal, but the build is way more modern and you will hear no noise.

We have a garden that is bigger than the house. We got 2 bedrooms, 3 floors (we have a lot of stairs!) and 1 huge living, with 2 balconies and a view over the canal.

Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

name: K&M panoramic triplex apartment with roof terrace
description: 3 stories apartment  Cozy balcony on the canal. Large roof terrace on the canal viewing Dam and the centrum. Large bathroom. Easy access to everything. You’re located in the heart of Amsterdam. Within walking distance to every museum, restaurant, bar, Dam, red light, madam Tussaud, Rembrandtplein, clubs and everything else.

name: Bright De Pijp Apartment near Metro & Park
description: Welcome to our beautifully renovated 55 m² apartment in the heart of Amsterdam’s lively De Pijp. Located in a traditional 1903 building with a monument at the entrance, it combines historic charm with modern comfort. Relax on the spacious 12 m² balcony, enjoy the stylish living room, or cook in the modern kitchen with island. Just steps from GlouGlou Wine Bar, Massimo Gelato, Sarphatipark, and Albert Cuyp Market, with Metro De Pijp and tram stops nearby.

name: Single Room
description:
Our Single Room is a cosy sanctuary for solo travellers. Infused with the charm of Amsterdam and accented by artistic touches from Bram Reijnders, it's the perfect space to relax and reflect after a day of city exploration.

8m2
Single bed (90cm x 200cm)

name: Family house in Amsterdam
description:
We offer a comfortable house of 110 square meters with a beautiful garden in the most family friendly area of Amsterdam; the Watergraafsmeer.
Only 5 minutes away from the city centre by bike or tram, this area has a residential vibe and still feels tranquil like a village. There is a childrens’ playground directly in front of our house and an animal farm nearby.

The apartment is located on the ground floor and is recently renovated.

You’ll enjoy the spacious and fully equiped open kitchen!

name: Authentic sunny Jordaan apartment
description:
Located in an idyllic spot in the Jordaan, surrounded by canals, monumental buildings and hidden courtyards. Sunny modern apartment.

Walking distance to Noordermarkt, Westerkerk, the 9 Streets, Anne Frank House and countless cafes, restaurants and boutiques.

Private boat tour possible with the boat next to the apartment.

2 additional guests are possible.

name: Calm Hoofddorppleinbuurt Apt
description: Calm 55 m² flat in Hoofddorppleinbuurt, set in a classic 1930s building. One bedroom, one bathroom and a private balcony. Living room with large sofa, art and TV; sliding doors to a cosy dining nook. Simple, well-equipped kitchen with gas hob and oven. Quiet bedroom opens to the balcony. Dark wooden floors and soft tones. Vondelpark ~10 mins’ walk; Rembrandtpark ~5 mins. Cafés, shops and trams nearby

name: Laurier Apartment - in the Jordaan
description: Stay in the heart of Amsterdam’s iconic Jordaan district in this stylish one-bedroom apartment. Just a short stroll from the Anne Frank House. It features a cozy living area, a private bathroom, and a compact kitchen. Soak up beautiful city views and enjoy a peaceful, authentic Amsterdam experience, with cafes, touristic hotspots and canals right outside your door.

name: Serene, green, boho, central apartment
description:
In this serene, bohemian accommodation you can plot your Amsterdam adventures.

You will be walking distance from the centre, the main museums, the famous Vondelpark and so on. Around the corner you will find a number of cafe's, cozy brunch and diner places, bakeries, supermarket, plant shop and other necessities.

This space is perfect for a small family (pets are welcome), or for a couple or friends.

name: K&M Royal Stay!
description: It’s spacious, bright, central to everything in Amsterdam, within walking distance to every bar, restaurant, museum, Leidseplein, Rembrandtplein, every museum, Anne Frank House, Rozengracht and everything else you name it.

name: Quiet Studio - Vondelpark area
description:
Lovely, cosy and quiet studio in a monumental old Amsterdam building right at the central Vondelpark entrance.

Great location within walking distance to all main Amsterdam tourist attractions with lots of quality restaurants and bars in the area.

Located on the 4rd (top) floor this studio offers a wonderful and quiet place for relaxing & resting.

The kitchen includes a refrigerator as well as a coffee machine, water kettle, cutlery and a toaster for guests to enjoy a breakfast on the spot.

name: Apartment with rooftop terrace
description:
This stylish accommodation is perfect for couples or groups of 3 who want to enjoy the rooftop terrace and balcony for a pleasant stay.
The street is quiet and there are plenty of small convenience stores right next door. Guests can park your bike or car on the street. The tram station is a 3 minute walk.
You are 30 Minutes by public transit from Central Station and Shiphol Airport.

name: Lovely appartment near center
description:
Stay in a stylish, light-filled apartment in Amsterdam’s popular Old-West, just steps from Jan Pieter Heijestraat’s cafés, boutiques, and bakeries. Enjoy a calm, spacious home with high ceilings, comfortable living space, a fully equipped kitchen, and a serene bedroom for restful nights.

Perfect location: 10 minutes walk to the city center, close to Vondelpark, museums, and canals. Experience the charm of a local neighborhood with easy access to all Amsterdam has to offer.

name: Luxe design appartement in de Rivierenbuurt
description: Modern, bright and stylish apartment in the quiet Rivierenbuurt, within walking distance of De Pijp and the city center. Equipped with a comfortable bedroom, luxurious bathroom with rain shower, fully equipped kitchen and a balcony overlooking a green courtyard garden. Ideal for couples or business travelers looking for comfort and atmosphere in Amsterdam.

name: Canal Art House Oude-West (Room)
description:
Welcome to our canal front art house in the heart of Amsterdam. We are Eva, Philip and Fluff (our Labradoodle puppy🐶 ).

Location, location, location!
*5 min walk to the iconic Vondelpark
*3 min walk to tram and bus stations
*8 min walk to De Hallen and Ten Kate market , and many other attractions
*1 min walk to various restaurants, cafes and shops

FYI we offer a convertible car if you’d like to explore cities in a style. This will cost additionally please text us if you have any wishes.

name: Cozy apartment with terrace
description:
Enjoy the best of Amsterdam in this bright 1-bedroom apartment in the lively De Baarsjes neighborhood. This home offers a comfortable living area, fully equipped kitchen and kingsize bed. Step outside onto a private terrace for morning coffee or evening drinks.

Located on the main street of De Baarsjes surrounded by hotspots like Fort Negen, White Label Coffee and various parks. You'll be a short bike ride (10 min), tram trip (15 min) or walk (25 min) from De Negen Straatjes and city center.

name: Cozy vintage apartment
description: Beautiful, spacious and very bright apartment in the Amsterdam neighborhood of Baarsjes, 10 minutes away from downtown. My balcony is south facing, adjacent to the bedroom and kitchen. Very stylishly furnished and equipped with every comfort such as internet, television, DVD player (with large DVD collection) and Hue lighting.

name: Prachtig appartement in het centrum
description: Bright and stylish 1-bedroom apartment (55 m²) in central Amsterdam, perfect for couples or friends. Just 10 minutes by bike or tram to Dam Square and the historic canals. Spacious living room, fully equipped kitchen, cozy bedroom with sliding doors to a balcony, modern bathroom, and free high-speed WiFi. Lively neighborhood by day, peaceful at night. Next to the park. The ideal base for exploring the city.

name: 18e-eeuws Appartement Dam
description:
Step back in time in this monumental apartment from 1743, located just steps from the famous Dam.
Enjoy the charm of high ceilings, historic views combined with the comfort of modern amenities.

Wake up in the heart of Amsterdam, with cafes, museums, shops and canals right on your doorstep. Within a few minutes, you can walk to the Royal Palace, the Jordaan or the canal belt.

name: Spacious Amsterdam Hideaway
description: Welcome to our renovated, light-filled home in Amsterdam! This warm and sunny 5-bedroom house offers the perfect balance of space, comfort, and convenience. Nestled in a quiet yet lively neighborhood, you’ll enjoy peaceful mornings in the garden and serre and easy access to the vibrant city center—just 25 minutes away. Whether you're visiting with family, friends, or colleagues, this home is your peaceful retreat just minutes from the buzz of the city. Come experience the best of both worlds!

name: Sfeervol appartement in Oud-West
description: Welcome to our cozy apartment on the lively Staringplein, 500 meters from the Vondelpark. Leave the hustle and bustle of the city behind you and experience the village feeling in the city. The modern, luxurious apartment offers unobstructed views, a sunny balcony, fully equipped kitchen with island, stylish bathroom and an office set-up for remote work. Discover the cafes, bakeries, markets and restaurants nearby with our tips. Good public transport connection to the city center. We look forward to welcoming you to our home!

name: Garden apartment near RAI & Zuidas
description:
Bright and cool apartment in peaceful Buitenveldert, a short walk from the Zuidas, RAI, and Gelderlandplein.

Perfect for 1–2 guests, with a private garden and sun until 3 PM – ideal for morning coffee or an evening BBQ.

Near Amsterdamse Bos for nature walks and the Amstel River for scenic cycling. Enjoy the city’s energy close by with the comfort of a calm, green neighborhood.

name: Stylish & Modern Apartment in Amsterdam North
description:
Modern and stylish apartment in the vibrant heart of Amsterdam Noord.
Within walking distance to the city center (15 min incl. ferry) and Metro line 52 from Noorderpark station. Just around the corner from cultural and culinary hotspots such as Eye Filmmuseum, Skatecafé, FC Hyena, Klaproos, and Barracuda. Supermarkets, cafés, and parks are all close by. An ideal base for exploring both Noord and the city center - feel free to ask me for more tips!

name: Wyelle Amsterdam Penthouse (2 bedrooms)
description:
Stay in a top-floor apartment (elevator available) in a historic canal house right in the center of Amsterdam. It’s a quiet place where you can relax — yet just steps away, you’ll find great restaurants, cafés, and shops all around you.

The apartment features two king-size beds, a fully equipped kitchen, and a modern loft feeling with high ceilings and artistic touches. You’ll enjoy natural sunlight from daytime through the evening, creating a bright and warm atmosphere throughout your stay.

name: New! Unique canal view house
description:
Wake up to boats gliding by your window in this beautifully renovated ground-floor canal house. Bright, cozy, and full of charm, it features large canal-view windows and a peaceful inside patio.

Located in the Jordaan, on one of Amsterdam’s prettiest canals in the historic canal belt and just a 10-minute walk from Central Station, it’s the perfect balance of comfort and history to experience Amsterdam like a local!

name: Charming & Cozy 1BR Apartment @ Oud-West
description: Welcome to our charming and cozy one-bedroom apartment in the popular Amsterdam Oud-West neighborhood. Featuring a private entrance, the apartment offers excellent connections to the rest of the city. The area is full of great restaurants, cafés, and bakeries, with Vondelpark, Museumplein, the Jordaan, Anne Frank House, and the Nine Streets all nearby. Perfect for couples, business travelers, and cultural visitors. No partygoers.

name: Room in appartment, close to Schiphol
description:
Room with double bed in beautifully renovated apartment located in a quiet residential complex in the Nieuw-sloten district. Parking is available in front of the door (paid), supermarket close by and good public transportation. Perfect base for Amsterdam.

You will be sharing the house with Wouter and me, there is a private room available.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

name: Veel licht en groot dakterras
description: Welcome to our spacious apartment with a unique look. The house is colorful, and because of the high ceilings with windows, there is a lot of light. In good weather, you can enjoy a large and quiet roof terrace with all-day sun.  Located on the 3rd and 4th floor. We normally live here and rent out our house when we are on vacation.

name: Sunny and Spacious AMS West Home
description:
Stylish and spacious apartment in vibrant Amsterdam West with high ceilings, colorful design, and elegant ensuite doors.

Enjoy two sunny balconies, ideal for dining or relaxing.

The living areas are full of natural light, while the quiet bedroom at the back guarantees restful sleep.

Located in the beautiful Amsterdam-West neighborhood with cozy cafés, lively bars, shops, and culture nearby.

name: Light and cosy Oud-West apartment
description: Charming and bright apartment in the heart of Amsterdam’s Oud-West district. Located near Ten Kate-market, this stylish space offers a cozy living area, a fully equipped kitchen and a comfortable bedroom all with plenty of natural light. Just steps away from the bustling Kinkerstraat, Foodhallen and the lively Jordaan, yet tucked away on a quiet residential street. Perfect for couples or solo travelers who want to explore the city like a local. Also a great place to work remotely!

name: Room Annette | close to city center & Vondelpark
description: Private room in a prime location! Directly opposite the Vondelpark, with a tram stop in front of the door. In 7 minutes you can be on Leidseplein or in the heart of the city center. Restaurants, coffee shops (and coffee shop) can be found in the street and surrounding area. Supermarket is a 5-minute walk, evening store and laundromat within 2 minutes. Everything you need for a relaxing stay.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Luxe appartement Rivierenbuurt
description: Luxurious and stylish apartment in the heart of the Rivierenbuurt. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, a quiet bedroom and a spacious workplace for work or study. Just a 5-minute walk from the North-South Line, which will take you to the bustling city center within 10 minutes. Everything you need, shops, cafes and parks are within easy reach. Ideal for comfort, tranquility and a central location.

name: Spacious & Bright 2BR Apartment @ Amsterdam East
description: Welcome to our bright and spacious apartment in Amsterdam East, offering excellent connections to the city center. The apartment features a modern design with two bedrooms, each with a comfortable double bed. Enjoy a spacious living room and a fully equipped open kitchen. Perfect for cultural visitors, couples, families, and business travelers. No partygoers.

name: Modern and Spacious Design Loft
description:
Welcome to my 65m² loft on the top floor (7th) with a large private balcony that gets sun all afternoon until evening — perfect for enjoying a glass of wine or a coffee in the sun

The apartment is located in Amsterdam West, a vibrant neighborhood close to the Jordaan. You can walk through the beautiful Westerpark to reach the Jordaan (city centre) or hop on a bike and be there in under 10 minutes — truly the Dutch way!

name: Our cozy two bedroom apartment
description: The apartment is in a quiet street within a lively neighborhood (Oosterparkbuurt), close to our favorite park to walk around in, and within walking distance of the city center of Amsterdam. Next to a grocery store and close to many cafés and museums. Spacious living room with a well-equipped kitchen, bathroom, and toilet are separated, and a south-facing (sunny!) balcony.

name: Cozy Ground-Floor Apartment
description:
Freshly renovated in 2024, this stylish ground-floor apartment features custom furniture, a cozy dining nook, and an Emma® mattress for ultimate comfort.

Enjoy a bright modern space with a fully equipped kitchen — including a Quooker tap for instant boiling water! and a sleek bathroom with separate tub and shower.

Perfect for couples or solo travelers, steps from canals, cafés, the Jordaan and public transport – your ideal Amsterdam base.

name: Canal Art House Oude-West
description:
Welcome to our charming canal front flat in the heart of Amsterdam. Nestled in the vibrant Oud-West neighbourhood, our stylish and inviting space is the perfect base for exploring all that this beautiful city has to offer.

Location, location, location!
*5 min walk to the iconic Vondelpark
*3 min walk to tram and bus stations, 20 min to Schiphol Airport
*8 min walk to De Hallen and Ten Kate market , and many other attractions
*a wide array of restaurants, cafes and shops right at your doors

name: Chic & Light Design Studio with Quiet Garden
description: Bright and stylish ground-floor apartment in Amsterdam’s vibrant Oosterpark district. Features high ceilings, a modern well equipped kitchen, serene bedroom, a spa-like bathroom with a tub, a private south-facing garden, and a beamer to watch movies at night - perfect for relaxing. Just steps from Oosterpark, trendy cafés, shops, and excellent transit with quick access to the city center and Schiphol. Ideal for couples or solo travelers seeking comfort, charm, and a vibrant neighborhood vibe.

name: Stunning first floor apartment
description:
✨ Stylish Ground-Floor Apartment in Central Amsterdam

1 bedroom with seperate loft for hosting up to 4 people.

Welcome to your Amsterdam home-away-from-home! 🌷
This cozy ground-floor apartment is perfectly located on the charming Bosboom Toussaintstraat, a lively yet peaceful street known for its cafés, restaurants, and quintessential Amsterdam atmosphere.

You’ll be just a short walk from the Rijksmuseum and all major attractions, all within minutes on foot

name: Stijlvol Amsterdams Huis aan het water met tuin
description: Unique Amsterdam house (105m²) on the Transvaalkade in hip Amsterdam East. The house has two bedrooms, a cozy living room, a green garden at the back and views of the water at the front. The location is quiet, with the Dappermarkt, Oosterpark and Park Frankendael within walking distance. Nearby you will find many shops, cozy pubs and restaurants. Fitness around the corner, the tram is 2 minutes away and a train station is a 10-minute walk away.

name: Design boutique apartment Amsterdam – Studio CNQ
description:
Apartment in De Baarsjes with a serene, design-focused interior: clean lines, warm neutral tones, and selfmade art. Sculptural architecture and natural materials create a welcoming atmosphere.

Open living area, separate kitchen, comfortable spacious bedroom, and fresh bathroom.

Close to the Jordaan and the city center, perfect for travelers who value comfort, creativity, and aesthetics. Ideal for relaxing after a day exploring Amsterdam, with plenty of light and inspiration.

name: Villa Lollipop, Amsterdam North
description: Bright and spacious home in lively Amsterdam North with plenty of natural light. Relax on the sunny roof terrace or balcony, surrounded by parks and nature, yet only 20 minutes to Central Station by public transport. The house offers a modern open kitchen, 2 bedrooms,  2 modern bathrooms, and all comforts for a great stay. Easy self check-in with lock-box. Two cuddly Maine Coon cats add a warm and homely touch, making your Amsterdam experience extra unique.

name: Zonnig appartement in Amsterdam
description: This accommodation is ideal for couples or people on a business trip. Centrally located in Amsterdam West. A stone's throw from the Vondelpark and within twenty minutes by public transport you are at the airport. It is a bright, spacious and fully renovated apartment. Nice open kitchen that is equipped with all comforts. Possible use of an extra bedroom with sofa bed and workplace is in consultation (at an additional cost).

name: Elegant home w/ garden and sauna
description: Spacious and stylish apartment elevated Amsterdam South, spread over 3 floors. Enjoy a bright living room with fireplace, french doors to the private garden and dining area with open kitchen, luxurious bathroom with tub upstairs, and a relaxing free sauna in the basement. Perfectly located with fast access to the city center, this home offers peace, comfort, and elegance. Ideal for families or couples looking for a serene stay in one of Amsterdam’s most desirable neighborhoods.

name: Boutique Apartment in the Green Heart of Amsterdam
description: Escape to this serene, fully equipped apartment in Amsterdam’s lush Plantage neighborhood. Enjoy a peaceful retreat near museums, cafés, and iconic sights. Inside, relax in a spacious living area with a king-size bed, modern kitchen, and washer/dryer. Stream Netflix or Prime, and enjoy fast Wi-Fi, a walk-in shower, and thoughtful amenities. Whether for a weekend or longer, this tranquil hideaway makes your stay effortless. Feel free to message me with any questions!

name: Luxurious large 2BR house near city centre!
description:
This fantastic luxurious house is on the ground floor and 1st floor. Its situated in the east part of Amsterdam with super fast connection to the city center with a direct tram. Closeby you find supermarkets, shops, coffee paces restaurants etc.

The house is 2 floors, 2 bedrooms ( max 4 guests) 1 large bathroom, a private garden with furniture.

A true hidden gem! deze ideaal gelegen accommodatie kun je allerlei activiteiten ondernemen.

name: Cozy apartment in Amsterdam with big roofterrace
description:
Hi! 😊 We rent out our centrally located and tastefully furnished apartment, which includes a large roof terrace. It is for 2 persons (double bed), not a sofa bed.
Located in a quiet family-oriented street in a cozy neighborhood with the nicest coffee shops. In a few minutes by bike, tram or bus you are in the nicest neighborhoods such as the Jordaan, Westerpark and downtown. We look forward to seeing you at the check-in time and the times are in consultation and flexible
No parties allowed

name: Romantic Houseboat with Jacuzzi • Historic Canals
description:
Experience life on Amsterdam’s historic canals from a modern houseboat studio with a hidden jacuzzi revealed beneath the bed.

Wake up at canal level and watch boats glide past your window, enjoy a quiet morning coffee by the water, and end the day relaxing in your hidden spa. Located in the charming Jordaan district, this modern studio offers a unique stay directly on Amsterdam’s canals and is part of The Amsterdam Houseboat Family.

name: Romantic Houseboat w/ Jacuzzi • Historic Canals
description:
Romantic houseboat studio in Amsterdam’s historic canal belt with a private jacuzzi revealed beneath the bed.

Wake up at canal level and watch boats drift past your window, enjoy a coffee with your feet almost above the water, and end the day relaxing in your hidden spa. Located in the charming Jordaan district, this modern studio offers a unique stay directly on Amsterdam’s canals and is part of The Amsterdam Houseboat Family.

name: Charming 2BR apartment with a spacious garden
description:
Stay in a beautiful 75m² apartment right next to Vondelpark. Featuring a spacious open kitchen, cozy bedroom, dedicated home office and a rare 55m² private garden.

Perfect for relaxing after exploring Amsterdam, enjoying a perfect morning espresso, or working in peace.

Cafés, shops, and the city center are all within easy reach!

name: Peaceful apartment in Amsterdam’s vibrant Jordaan
description:
A small but lovely home with large windows in one of the best locations in Amsterdam. It's incredibly central – everything you need is just around the corner – yet the apartment is tucked away just outside the hustle and bustle, making it a peaceful place to relax.

At just 26m², the apartment makes great use of its space and includes everything you need for a comfortable stay.

name: Luxury house, centrally located
description: Experience Amsterdam like a local in our beloved apartment in trendy Noord. Our charming apartment was recently renovated. It features a fully equipped kitchen, stylish living room, master bedroom, babyroom (<3y)/office, fast WiFi & balcony. Nestled in the lively Vogelbuurt with markets, cafés & NDSM nearby. Enjoy super easy access to Central Station (5 min) and Schiphol Airport (30 min). Receive our local tips for an authentic Amsterdam experience. Your perfect home base for exploring the city!

name: Appartement in Amsterdam
description:
My home is located in the bustling Indische Buurt, with the cozy Javastraat literally around the corner. Here you can enjoy food from different cuisines and there are a lot of nice cafes and bars within walking distance. A few personal favorites: Bar Joost, De Jonge Admiraal, and at Chantilly you should definitely stop by for breakfast, lunch or a nice cake.

If you want to find peace, you are within walking distance of the Flevopark. Take tram 14 or bus 22 towards the city center.

Have fun!

name: Bright Canal-Front Retreat in Historic Building
description:
Historic Canal-View Duplex in the Heart of Amsterdam

Welcome to your bright and charming home, one of Amsterdam’s smallest and most picturesque canals. This beautifully designed home sits in a quiet, historic part of the city center. Steps from Haarlemmerstraat, cafés, restaurants, and a 5-min walk to Central Station. Perfect for travelers seeking beauty, convenience, and an authentic Amsterdam experience.

name: Ruim en sfeervol appartement Amsterdam
description:
A lovely relaxed neighborhood with its own character, and you are in the city center in no time by tram or on foot. Also nearby are fine restaurants, cafes and terraces.

The house is spacious (100m2) and has two balconies. There is an extensive kitchen with everything to cook, a queen size bed in the bedroom and a sofa bed in our office that can be used for extra guests. The whole is attractively and cozily furnished, a place where you will quickly feel at home.

name: Charming Suite in City Center Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to this beautifully renovated room, right in the bustling center of Amsterdam!

The room has recently been completely renovated with an eye for detail and comfort. It is decorated with modern furniture and offers all the comforts you need for a pleasant stay.
You will be within walking distance of the Jordaan, the Nine Streets and the canals. Public transportation is also easily accessible, allowing you to explore the rest of Amsterdam in no time.

name: Luxe Farm met Spa in Amsterdam
description:
Dating back to 1790, the farmhouse brings history and authentic charm to your stay.

Wide-open meadows, rustic calm, and mornings filled with birdsong create a serene retreat, while flocks of geese drift gracefully across the sky.

As dusk falls, golden skies and drifting mist awaken the witte wieven folklore — mythical spirits of wise women.

End your day by the fire pit or in the heated patio, watching tranquil sunsets and enjoying comfort with sweeping views over the countryside of Amsterdam.

name: Gallery Nassau Canal Suite
description:
Welcome to Our Cozy Amsterdam Studio on Nassaukade

Welcome to our stylish studio apartments, perfectly situated on the Nassaukade in central Amsterdam. Ideal for couples or solo travelers seeking comfort, privacy, and a touch of city charm. Each studio features an en suite bathroom, a comfortable bed, and a Smart TV for relaxing evenings. Step outside and you’re moments away from Amsterdam’s vibrant canals, cafes, and cultural hotspots.

name: Modern Nassau Canal Suite
description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

name: Cozy Nassau Canal Suite
description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

name: Charmant appartement in hartje Amsterdam
description: This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated and renovated last year. A quiet street among the locals. Within a 2-minute walk of nice cafes and bars. Metro, tram and train station (Rai) nearby.

name: Spacious Nassau Canal Suite
description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

name: Private charming apartment in heart of Amsterdam
description:
Enjoy private apartment with modern facilities in Amsterdam’s iconic De Pijp neighbourhood.

There are two bedrooms, but only the one shown in the photos is for guests. The second, will remain unlocked, and you’re welcome to enjoy the outdoor patio connected to it.

The apartment is situated on the famous Albert Cuyp Market — the perfect base to relax and explore. Step outside to trendy cafés, the lively market, and Sarphatipark. Excellent public transport is just 3 minutes walk away!

name: Luxurious park-side apartment
description: Bright and spacious apartment next to Oosterpark, one of Amsterdam’s most beautiful green areas. Walk to Artis Zoo, the Tropenmuseum and lively Dapper Market. Rent bikes around the corner or hop on a boat in 1 min to explore the canals. Perfect for couples, families or friends who want comfort, culture and local vibes in the heart of the city.

name: Amster Houseboat Canal View (upstairs apartment)
description: You rent the top floor of our houseboat: a quiet place with beautiful views over the water, close to Amsterdam Central. With the free ferry, you can reach the bustling city center in 15 minutes, while on the boat you experience the silence. Extra nice: free private parking spaces right in front of the door – unique in Amsterdam, where parking is normally very expensive.

name: Cheerful&vibrant one bedroom apartment in De Pijp!
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

Albert Cuyp Market, Sarphati Park, tons of cafe's and restaurants are around the corner.

Easy to commute: tram and metro connections are 5 minutes away.

Although it is in the heart of De Pijp, the street is quiet so you can have a good night sleep as well!

name: Executive Houseboat-Apartment Bluewater
description:
This exclusive large Houseboat is nicely decorated and located at one of the best locations in this part of Amsterdam and 5 minutes’ walking distance from the city centre near the famous area "The Jordaan”.

The Houseboat is large with a living room with a large sofa and flat screen TV. There is a separate large bedroom with a fully equipped bathroom. This Houseboat features a second bedroom with a King-size bed with attached bathroom.

name: Budget room close city
description: Take a break and unwind at this peaceful oasis.

name: Cosy one bedroom apartment in Amsterdam Noord
description:
Experience the perfect balance of calm and city life in trendy Amsterdam-Noord.

This cosy 40 m² apartment on the top (2nd) floor (stairs only) is ideal for a solo traveller, couple or friends.

- An open plan south-facing kitchen and living room with a sunny balcony
- A separate bedroom
- Comfortable double sofa bed

The neighborhood offers plenty of restaurants, cafés, supermarkets, and even a pool. There is parking available in front of the building and bike racks for any rental bikes.

name: Historic rooftop apartment with big terrace
description: Welcome to your Amsterdam home-away-from-home! This bright, modern duplex penthouse offers 3 bedrooms, one modern bathroom, and a large west-facing terrace (~28 m²) — ideal for relaxing in the sun or enjoying evening drinks. Situated in the neighborhoud Oostenburg.  Set across two levels in the iconic historic building, this apartment blends character and comfort. You'll feel immersed in Amsterdam’s charm while being close to the city highlights.

name: The Staal House
description: Welcome to The Staal House, your cozy Amsterdam getaway nestled in the heart of the city. This charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Enjoy essential amenities like a fully equipped kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a washing machine, all wrapped up in a warm, inviting atmosphere with general heating. Whether you're exploring the vibrant streets of Amsterdam or enjoying a quiet night in, The Staal House is the ideal base for your adventures.

name: Numa | 1 Bedroom Apartment with Balcony & Sofa Bed
description:
- Apartment with 39sqm / 420sq ft of space and a balcony
- Ideal for up to 4 people
- Double bed (180x200cm / 71x79in) and sofa bed (160x200cm / 63x79in)
- Modern bathroom with a shower
- Fully-equipped kitchen with tea and coffee-making essentials, and a dining table

Please note that the actual room may differ from photos.

name: New Luxe privat house Vondelpark, 3 sleeping rooms
description:
Enjoy a newly renovated and super-sustainable apartment in the heart of Amsterdam! It features two comfortable bedrooms with walk-in closets, a large bathroom with real marble, and underfloor heating that keeps the entire house cozy. The modern kitchen, featuring a cooking island and two bar stools, is perfect for an intimate dinner or a cozy breakfast. From the balcony, you have a beautiful view of Vondelpark, a unique place to relax after a day full of Amsterdam experiences.
Experienced host available

name: Bright studio with canal view
description:
This bright and stylish, fully furnished studio offers a wonderful open view over the nearby park and side canal.

The space is fully equipped with all amenities for a comfortable stay. Located in the vibrant, up-and-coming BoLo (Bos en Lommer): an inspiring district in Amsterdam-West known for its diverse shops, cafes, and restaurants.

For neighborhood tips, check our Insta: @amsterdam_homestay_bolo

name: Family home parc view
description: The perfect place to stay with your family.

name: Bright and Spacious Ground Floor App. with Garden
description: Enjoy a bright and modern one-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam with a rare private garden (20 m²). The space offers a sunny living room, fully equipped kitchen, cozy double bedroom, and bathroom with fresh towels. Perfectly located in a quiet area yet close to shops, cafés, and public transport. Explore the city center and canals within minutes, then return to your own peaceful garden retreat.

name: Budget double/twin room with private facilities
Ruim en comfortabel luxe familiehuis in Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our cozy and modern family home in the quiet, green neighborhood of Watergraafsmeer, just outside the bustling center of Amsterdam. This spacious house is ideal for families of up to 4 people who want to enjoy the comforts of home, with the city center within easy reach. Outside you will find a nice private garden, perfect to relax after a day in the city. Our house is spread over 3 floors and offers plenty of space and privacy.

name: Sfeervol appartement met tuin in Amsterdam West
description:
Cozy apartment located on a square in a quiet location in the Baarsjes district in the west. Public transportation is around the corner, and within 15 minutes you can be in Amsterdam central or south by bike. It is a 20-minute walk to the Jordaan and 30 minutes to the city center.

The apartment is on the ground floor, has a lovely sunny garden and is equipped with all comforts. There is a brand new kitchen with bar, built-in appliances and a coffee machine (beans).

name: Gezellig appartement in hartje Amsterdam
description: Cozy and spacious apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. The apartment has fantastic views over Amsterdam's famous Western Islands. In a unique and quiet part of the city. Only a 2-minute walk from a cozy shopping street and 8 minutes to the Jordaan and to the Westerpark. The apartment offers comfort and atmosphere. It features a neat bedroom, a spacious bathroom and two toilets. In addition, it has a balcony and a kitchen with all the essentials for a cooking fanatic.

name: Budget room
description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

name: Charming 1-Bedroom Apartment near City Center
description:
Enjoy the best of Amsterdam from this bright and comfortable 1-bedroom apartment, just minutes from the heart of the city. The space combines modern comfort with a touch of local charm.

Spacious living room with plenty of natural light

Cozy bedroom with a comfortable double bed

Fully equipped kitchen

Quiet neighborhood, yet only a short walk, bike ride, or tram ride to the city center.

name: Elegant 2 bedroom with roof terrace by Vondelpark
description:
Spacious 140m² apartment next to Vondelpark (Museum district) with 2 bedrooms (2 beds), an office, 1 bathroom, balcony and private roof terrace. Bright living spaces with high ceilings, large windows, and a fully equipped kitchen. Perfect for families, friends, or professionals. Cafés, shops, and museums are nearby. Located in a quiet residential area.

🚫 No parties, loud music, or events. No additional guests beyond the booked number are allowed.

📹 For commercial/ TV: Grace Locations.

name: Olympic's Little Palace
description:
Enjoy this bright and stylishly designed apartment with wide views over Stadionsplein. Experience everything Amsterdam has to offer while staying in a child friendly and welcoming neighborhood.

The Museumplein, the Vondelpark and the lively city center are just 10 minutes away by bus. Schiphol Airport is also only 15 minutes away by public transport, making it easy to explore and connect.

Come and experience what it’s like to live in this vibrant city!

name: Stylish 4p ground floor apartment with garden
description:
Welcome to our newly renovated apartment! This 95m2 ground floor apartment with lush garden is the perfect place to discover the vibrant city of Amsterdam.

Our house is located in the area Rivierenbuurt: away from the hustle to wind down, and very well connected to any place in/around Amsterdam as all local transport options are only a few steps away.

RAI convention center is on 5 min walking distance. With two desk areas, this could be the perfect workation location for you!

name: Geweldig appartement in Amsterdam-Noord
description:
Welcome to our cozy apartment in Amsterdam-Noord, one of the most relaxed and centrally located neighborhoods of the city.

About our house:

Ground floor apartment, easily accessible to everyone;

Open living room with a fully equipped open kitchen and bar;

Two spacious bedrooms, both with a comfortable double bed;

Large garden of 55 m² to enjoy the sun!

name: Enjoy peace in the middle of the city
description: Enjoy comfort and peace in our lovely home in the Olympic Stadium neighborhood. Relax in the spacious garden or sleep soundly in the comfortable king size bed. Perfect for remote work with fast Wi-Fi and an extra screen. Just 15 min from Schiphol Airport, 10 min to Vondelpark, and 15 min to Museumplein, with public transport, supermarkets, and excellent restaurants all within a short walk. Ideal for exploring Amsterdam with ease.

name: Bright open-plan design apartment near Oosterpark
description:
Light-filled apartment on the third floor, designed with a mix of Scandi calm and Japanese simplicity. An open-plan layout with design classics, lots of white, and personal touches makes it feel both sophisticated and homely.

The south-facing balcony brings sun all day, perfect for an espresso, your morning pages, a late night glass. Fully equipped kitchen and bathroom add comfort. Located in lively Amsterdam East near Oosterpark and Beukenplein, surrounded by restaurants and cafés.

name: Downtown
description: Come in and be surprised by exceptional style, warmth, classic elements and high-quality finish, lovely bedding and fluffy towels. Welcome to Amsterdam!

name: Beleef Amsterdam het best! Rustig, karakteristiek
description:
✨ Enjoy the best of Amsterdam in this unique monumental townhouse ✨

Looking for a special place to stay in Amsterdam? This is the perfect spot. Our historic property is located right in the famous canal district and combines authentic charm with modern comfort. Please note: due to its exclusive character, this stay is not suited for every budget.

Despite the central location, the suite is situated on a quiet street, ensuring a restful night’s sleep.

name: Sophisticated & Quiet Apartment
description:
Welcome to our beautiful ground floor house with high ceilings, lots of light and a charming private patio. Here you will stay in a quiet, green street in bustling Amsterdam East: a neighborhood full of lively cafes, cozy restaurants, unique shops and a daily market.
After a day of exploration, you can walk to the park in one minute to catch your breath, or enjoy a drink in your own garden in peace.
This apartment is the perfect base for your time in Amsterdam.

name: Charming apartment in Amsterdam
description: Stay in a bright and cozy apartment in lively Amsterdam Oost, just minutes from the city center. The neighborhood is full of cafés, bars, and local shops,  with the Dappermarket and beautiful parks around the corner and with great public transport connections to explore the rest of the city. Perfect for a comfortable stay in a vibrant, authentic part of Amsterdam!

name: Cozy & Sunny apartment in Amsterdam west
description: This cozy and stylish apartment is perfectly located near all types of transportation and within walking distance of supermarkets, shopping centres, and lively bars. It features a comfortable bed and a fluffy couch, an air fryer, and a big fridge for your convenience. With two sunny balconies overlooking the main street, the apartment is full of natural light and has a welcoming, relaxed atmosphere.

name: Westerpark view Apartment
description:
Charming, light-filled apartment on the first floor, right across from Westerpark!

In the park you can find great restaurants, cafes, a brewery, museum, cinema, and even a theater. Just a walk away from the Center, especially close by the famous Jordaan area, and a short bus ride to/from Central or Sloterdijk Station for easy airport access.

Enjoy the modern kitchen, the warm and cozy living space, spacious balcony, and the homey vibe in one of Amsterdam’s most vibrant neighborhoods!

name: Stylish & Comfortable Apartment in De Pijp
description: Cozy and stylish ground-floor apartment in the heart of De Pijp, Amsterdam, just steps from Sarphatipark. Stay in my personal home with a warm and welcoming atmosphere, featuring a spacious bedroom, bright living room, modern bathroom, separate toilet, and fully equipped kitchen. Surrounded by trendy cafés, restaurants, boutiques, and excellent public transport, it’s the perfect base to explore Amsterdam while enjoying the comfort of a real local home.

name: Sfeervol appartement met tuin in Amsterdam Oost
description: Light and stylish apartment with sunny garden in Amsterdam East. Recently renovated and equipped with modern kitchen with cooking island, spacious dining room with skylight and luxurious bathroom with bath and walk-in shower. Comfortable bedroom and plenty of daylight. Located in a nice, quiet neighborhood with parks, cafes and restaurants around the corner. Walking distance to Amstel Station and quickly in the city center. Perfect for a relaxing city trip!

name: Luxury triple room with garden view
Bright Room Private bathroom 15 min city center
description: Newly renovated private space in Amsterdam with private ensuite bathroom. Metro station Ganzenhoef is on 5 min walking distance from the house and will take you in 15 min to the city center. The space contains a queen sized bed, table/desk with two stools, lockable entrance door, an electric heating system, portable fan, watercooker and some other amenities needed for a great short stay. Also access to a shared area with fridge/freezer, sink, dishes and silverware.

name: Grachtenhuis (1870) met tuin & privé-steiger

Monumental canal house (1870) with garden & private jetty – Amsterdam city center

Unique monument (1870) with 3.5 m high ceilings, fireplace and rare city garden directly on the Lijnbaansgracht. Dock your own boat at the private jetty. Two spacious bedrooms (both with 50" TV), bathroom with bathtub, two toilets. Outside: gas and coal BBQ plus garden fireplace. Top location near Reguliersgracht and Utrechtsestraat; everything within walking distance.

name: Casa del Koetjeboe - in het centrum van Amsterdam
description:
A lovely apartment centrally located in Amsterdam. Between the Amstel and the Oosterpark, with a large terrace located on a quiet green oasis in the middle of the city. The house is cozy, so you immediately feel completely at home.

If you wish to stay for a longer period, we can discuss a better price. :)

name: Luxury Canal Suite on Houseboat
description: Luxury boutique suite on houseboat, ideally located in Amsterdam city centre. Superb canal view. A unique experience.

name: Stylish 2 bedroom apartment next to Westerpark
description:
Stylish, 2 room apartment next to Westerpark.
Good connection with public transport. Recently renovated.

description: Cozy and tastefully decorated apartment in Amsterdam West, centrally located

name: Family home in child-friendly neighborhood
description: Escape the rush and relax with your family in our family home in Amsterdam-Noord. A spacious family home where children can play outside and still be close to the city. A unique combination of peace and coziness. Amsterdam-Noord has lots of greenery and nature and is a perfect base for families with children. Plenty of entertainment in and around the house. Our home will come with a dedicated parking spot and a cargo bike for you and your family to use to move around the city.

name: The Cozy Canal Apartment - At Centrum
description:

- Sleeps 3: king + single bed, ideal for couples or small families

name: The Homely Houseboat Amsterdam Centre
description: Stay at The Homely Houseboat, a cozy floating home in Amsterdam’s lively Oud-West. Enjoy a bright living space with a full kitchen, comfy bedroom, and sofa bed. Relax by the canal or explore nearby cafés and bars. Just a 5-minute walk to the Anne Frank house, 20 minutes to Leidseplein, and 24 minutes to Dam Square — the perfect mix of local charm and central convenience.

name: Bright & Calm Apartment on Ten Katemarkt
description: Wake up in a bright and peaceful apartment right above Ten Katemarkt, one of Amsterdam’s most loved local markets. Step outside to fresh bread, flowers and warm stroopwafels in the morning. Despite the lively street below, the apartment itself is calm, light and quiet, a perfect place to recharge after exploring the city. Located in vibrant Amsterdam West, you’re just a short walk from the famous Foodhallen, great coffee spots, restaurants, boutiques and Vondelpark.

description:
Modern luxury apartment centrally located in the popular neighborhood of De Pijp (For: locals, tourists). New building with modern kitchen, bathroom, balcony, spacious sofa, lots of natural light, spacious friendly staircase.

name: Designers Loft

name: Light & spacious, A/C bedrooms, family/couple only
description:
This centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated and is incredibly bright and cozy. Bordering the popular Jordaan district, but without the crowds. Large bathroom, 2 separate toilets. Spacious master bedroom.

A quiet neighborhood close to all famous landmarks, but also conveniently located to the airport, highway and public transport. Nice quiet neighborhood with small shops, restaurants and specialty stores. Park and canals around the corner.

Family/couples only due to available beds.

name: Traditional Amsterdam Town House in Old Amsterdam
description: Rare opportunity to stay in one of the oldest parts of Amsterdam, in the top two floors of a beautifully restored merchants' townhouse, dating back to 1789.  You will experience living life in the centre of one of the most vibrant cities in the world, with everything literally on your doorstep.  You are 5 minutes walk from Amsterdam Centraal.  1 minute walk to the Damrak.  1 minute to the beautiful Jordaan canal area.  30 seconds to Nieuwezijds Kolk tram station for 2, 12, 13, 17 trams.

name: Boathouse with garden en beautiful view
description:
This memorable place is anything but ordinary.

Set in Amsterdam North my house offers the most amazing views over the water. Chill in the sauna and jump in the canal afterwards or sit by the woodstove. The city center is just 15/20 minutes away but here it's very serene. Also there is plenty to do in the north of Amsterdams which is buzzing.

name: Stylish Amsterdam Apartment – in the Jordaan
description:
Modern and stylish apartment in the heart of Amsterdam’s Jordaan. Quiet street, yet steps from cafés, restaurants, boutiques, and Nordermarkt market. 20-min walk to Central Station, canals, and Anne Frank House. Perfect for families, friends, or business travelers.

Highlights:
• 2 bedrooms, bathroom + 1 toilet, 1 workspace
• Fully equipped kitchen: coffee machines, air fryer, rice cooker, juicer
• Modern, stylish design
• Calm yet central location

name: Charming Centrally-Located Apartment
description:
Recently renovated with modern comforts but full of character, it’s the perfect spot to relax after a day of exploring Amsterdam.

Within walking distance of the Jordaan where you'll find plenty of cafés, restaurants, canals, and shops.

Inside, you’ll find a comfortable living area filled with lots of natural light, a fully equipped kitchen for home-cooked meals, and a cozy bedroom designed for a good night’s sleep (and a comfortable sofa bed).

name: 4 pers heart of ams
description: Stay in the heart of Amsterdam’s most authentic neighborhood, De Pijp. This simple yet comfortable apartment has everything you need for a city trip: a cozy living space, fully equipped kitchen, clean bathroom, and comfy double bed. Just steps from cafés, canals, and the famous Albert Cuyp Market, it’s the perfect base to explore the city like a local.

name: Modern Apartment in Amsterdam West
description:
This bright and renovated apartment is located in the popular West area, just a short walk from the Jordaan and the canal belt. It’s the ideal spot for professionals or couples staying in the city for a couple of months.

One important note: my friendly cat will stay in the apartment during your stay. I will cover all food and litter supplies – you only need to enjoy his company. He is easygoing and used to guests, and will make you feel at home right away.

name: Top floor apt w/rooftop terrace in Amsterdam West
description:
Welcome to a top floor apartment in the heart of Amsterdam West which offers a cozy living area filled with natural light, a fully equipped kitchen, and a sunlit bedroom. Its highlight: a spacious rooftop terrace overlooking Amsterdam.

Situated in a prime location with easy access to cozy cafés and bakeries, restaurants, public transport, supermarkets and bike rental shops. Enjoy the authentic local vibe away from the busy crowds, while still being a 10-min bike ride from the historic center.

name: *Perfect* city apartment in Amsterdam West!
description: Located in popular Oud West/De Baarsjes this apartment is perfect for a couple or a single. The space is warm, calm, relaxed and clean with a stylish mid-century, meets bohemian vibe.

name: Christina Host
description:
Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space.
Quiet and silent room
Enjoy a relaxing stay in a quiet room, ideal to relax and unwind after a busy day. The room is bright, neat and equipped with a comfortable bed. Perfect for guests who appreciate privacy and quiet. Close to [transportation/shop/center.

name: Cozy top floor apt in West Amsterdam
description:
A perfect place to get the best of the center of Amsterdam, while staying away from the messy crowd.
4th floor of an old Amsterdam building, the apt has a open space kitchen+living, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom and a roof terrace.
Located in West, at walking distance from the Joordan, and perfectly connected with myby bus and trams.

name: Quiet 2 person apartment for remote work & couples
description: A perfect spot for a weekend of exploring Amsterdam and the surrounding area

Enjoy a bedroom with private bathroom, a closed veranda with sofa, fridge, coffee machine, kettle, microwave and mini oven. Private street entrance through the garden. The veranda closes with glass doors and heaters but can also be fully open to connect to the patio and garden. Quiet local area near cafés, shops, and 3 km from Anne Frank House — perfect for couples or solo travelers

name: Appartement in Amsterdam

name: Luxury Apartment in De Pijp - Central & Stylish
description: What makes this apartment special is its rare mix of luxury, space, and calm in the heart of Amsterdam’s De Pijp. Designed with marble finishes, oak floors, and soft lighting, it feels both elegant and relaxing. Guests love being steps from the Albert Cuyp Market and the city’s best cafés — yet coming home to a quiet, beautifully designed space that feels truly private.

name: Licht & modern appartement met privé dakterras
description: Stylish apartment in vibrant Amsterdam Oud-West, featuring one cozy bedroom, a sleek modern bathroom, and a sunny private rooftop terrace. Located within walking distance of Vondelpark, trendy cafés, and boutiques. Ideal for couples or solo travelers seeking comfort, design, and a central location to explore the city like a local.

name: Private room in Central Amsterdam

Minimalist and fully private 1-bedroom with its own bathroom—perfect for solo travelers or couples. Located in a vibrant area just 20 minutes’ walk to the city center and 10 minutes to De Pijp, known for its great restaurants and bars.
Plenty of cafés and a supermarket are just around the corner. Metro and tram stops are 5 minutes away, making it easy to explore the city. A calm, comfortable base in a lively neighborhood.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam-Zuid
description: Relax with the family or friends at this peaceful place to stay.
