The apartment is located in a family-friendly neighbourhood but close to everything you need. We have a newly renovated bathroom, one large bedroom on the second floor, and a bedroom on the first floor with a dedicated work space (including a standing desk!) - and a fantastic huge roof terrace..! We hope you will treat our home like you’d treat yours.

name: Luxe en stijlvol appartement in Amsterdam-West
description: Stay in a beautiful, cozy, recently renovated apartment in Amsterdam West. Located in a quiet street, with a luxurious kitchen, a modern ensuite bathroom and a spacious, green garden. Close to the Rembrandtpark, Vondelpark and the Ten Katemarkt, surrounded by trendy bakeries, cozy cafes and restaurants. Within 10 minutes by bike, you are in the bustling city center.

name: Spacious appartement de Pijp (roof terrace/ AC)
description: Welcome to your bright, newly renovated De Pijp home base—central yet on a quiet residential street so you’re close to the buzz without the late-night noise. This spacious ≈85 m² apartment pairs warm, modern design with rare outdoor space: a private 30 m² roof terrace with sunset views toward the Rijksmuseum, plus a 12 m² balcony off the living room to start of your day with a cup of coffee. Cooling is easy thanks to air-conditioning.

name: Boho Botanica Oost
description:
This charming mid-century apartment is filled with warmth, greenery, and character, perfect for small families, couples, or anyone traveling. The south-facing balcony is a little urban jungle where you can enjoy your morning coffee or evening glass of wine under soft string lights.

Located just steps from Oosterpark, and close to cafés, bakeries, and family-friendly spots, this is the perfect base to explore Amsterdam like a local.

name: Apartment in front of Vondelpark
description: Perfectly located right in front of Vondelpark, in Amsterdam’s best neighborhood. This cozy, recently renovated 35 m² apartment has a balcony and all the comforts for an amazing stay. Ideal for exploring the city by bike or on foot — everything is just around the corner. It’s also my home 🏡♥️

The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need to cook. From the living room, you have access to the private terrace. The bedroom features a double bed. The bathroom has a bathtub, a walk-in shower and a toilet. In addition, there is a separate second toilet.

description: Enjoy your stay in this centrally located, light, and modern apartment. The space features large windows, a fully equipped kitchen, fast Wi-Fi (400 Mbps download / 40 Mbps upload), and a comfortable living area — perfect for relaxing or working remotely. Steps away from cafés, shops, and public transport, it’s the ideal base to explore the center of Amsterdam!

name: Stijlvol appartement in de Pijp
description:
Quietly located accommodation in the heart of Pijp. Spacious and tastefully furnished apartment with balcony spread over two floors.

The entire apartment was completely renovated in 2025 and decorated with great attention to detail. We are a creative couple and our house is full of design and art. It is the ideal base for couples or young families. Situated in a quiet neighborhood but a stone's throw away from bars, restaurants, supermarkets and all the amenities of the city.

name: Licht en ruim appartement in hartje Amsterdam
description: This bright and spacious apartment is located in the center of Amsterdam, within walking distance of the most beautiful places in the city. The high ceilings and large windows provide a pleasant, sunny atmosphere throughout the day. You overlook the charming Amsterdam canal, while enjoying peace and comfort inside.

name: Dyke house in Amsterdam-Durgerdam, free parking
description: A traditional dutch wooden house. In the green area of Amsterdam. Close to the City. Ideal location for visiting Amsterdam, watersport, hiking and cycling. The village is national heritage, build on a 600 years old dike. Nice view at a the old port, Y lake and the isle Vuurtoreneiland (UNESCO heritage). And a nice view on open meadow area and the 500 years old Ransdorp’s church, drawn by Rembrandt. The house has a livingroom, 3 bedrooms (2 double bed, 1 single bed), a studyroom, and 2 bathrooms.

name: Modern and luxury apartment near Vondel & Jordaan
description:
Enjoy a relaxing stay in this centrally located, stylish apartment in Amsterdam.

The recently renovated apartment is modernly furnished and equipped with a spacious kitchen and luxurious bathroom. Relax with a coffee on the sunny front balcony or by the fireplace on the spacious back balcony.

Located on the Bilderdijkstraat, within walking distance of the Jordaan and Vondelpark, with shops, restaurants and public transportation.

name: Modern appartement in levendig Amsterdam Oost
description: Stylish 60m² apartment in bustling Amsterdam East, just a 5-minute walk from the metro. Relax on the sunny south-facing balcony or in the luxurious bathroom with rain shower and bathtub. Sleep well on the king size box spring. Within walking distance you will find the Oosterpark and numerous cozy cafes and restaurants. Perfect for couples or solo travelers looking for comfort and city vibrancy.

name: Bright 1BR Maisonette with Canal Views @ Oud-West
description: Welcome to our bright and charming maisonette in a classic Amsterdam canal house. Spread over two floors, the apartment features a living area, kitchen, dining space, and bathroom on the lower level, with the bedroom and laundry room upstairs. Located in Oud-West, a vibrant neighborhood popular with locals, it offers excellent public transport connections. Perfect for couples or business travelers.

name: Stylish 2-Bed Canal View Apartment in Amsterdam
description:
Discover Amsterdam like a local from our cozy and recently renovated home, just steps from the charming Jordaan and Nine Streets neighborhoods. Stroll along the Elandsgracht for cafés, restaurants, bakeries, and boutique shops.

Visit the Anne Frank House, wander the weekend farmers’ market, or enjoy a 10–15 minute walk to Vondelpark and the Rijksmuseum.

The main bedroom features a queen-size bed, while the second bedroom has a twin trundle that easily converts into a double bed.

name: Amsterdam globalboat
description: You'll love this unique and romantic escape.

name: Bright, spacious apartment with sunny balcony

Spacious and bright apartment with a private balcony in a quiet street of vibrant Amsterdam West.

The apartment is fully equipped and offers a peaceful retreat right in the heart of the city.

From this central location, you can reach Amsterdam’s city centre within 10 minutes by bike or public transport. But the neighbourhood itself has plenty to offer – from green parks and cosy breakfast cafés to some of the city’s best bakeries and coffee spots.

name: Spacious Family Apartment with Garden in Amsterdam
description: Our spacious family home in Amsterdam Oost offers the perfect mix of comfort and city living. Enjoy a private garden, two bedrooms, and baby-friendly amenities in a peaceful neighbourhood close to parks, cafes, and local shops. You’ll feel like a local - just minutes from the city centre, yet surrounded by green spaces and great food. Ideal for families or couples looking for a relaxing Amsterdam stay.

name: Luxurious house in South of Amsterdam!
description: Make some memories at this unique and family-friendly design house in the south of Amsterdam. Located in one of the best areas of Amsterdam, this luxurious ground-level floor apartment offers quiet elegance in Amsterdam. Long Stay!

Every detail has been carefully considered to ensure a practical, stylish, and enjoyable stay.

A quiet, stylish base in one of Amsterdam’s most vibrant neighborhoods.

The spacious apartment of 65m2 is equipped with every comfort and is wonderfully sheltered, on the first floor with its own entrance and with the most beautiful view of the entire farm! Fine beds with crisp fresh bedding. Kitchen with hob, small fridge, dishwasher. Bathroom with spacious walk-in shower, washbasins, toilet. The living room is bright and offers spectacular views of the river, mill and greenery.

name: Spacious City Center Rooftop Apartment
description:
This spacious 125m2 (2 kingsize beds) rooftop apartment is located right in the heart of cultural Amsterdam.

In between Vondelpark; Leidse Square; Jordaan and the Museum district (all +/- 5 min walk), its located in The Bosboom Toussaintstraat, one of Amsterdams' most characteristic streets with nice bars and restaurants.

It's 3m high ceilings and all around windows give you a great living experience and view. Very well isolated and has air conditioning in both the bedrooms.

At the back of the property, a sunny south-facing garden leads to a quiet, fully insulated garden house bedroom with air conditioning. Located on a quiet street just steps from Westerpark, the Jordaan, and great cafés and restaurants, it offers the ideal balance of comfort and city living.

Bright and peaceful apartment in Amsterdam East, right next to Oosterpark. Designed with warm, natural tones and large windows overlooking a green courtyard, a great base in the middle of the city.

All lights are dimmable and color-adjustable. There’s no Wi-Fi, but mobile reception is strong for using your own hotspot. Perfect.

Step outside to cafés, coffee spots, and the park, super convenient for a morning walk or an easy evening out. Ideal for a solo traveler, work trip, or a stay for two.

description:
Style meets location! Steps from the big 3 museums, in the historic CANAL BELT, the most beautiful neighborhood in the world. Stumble to cafes, shops, restaurants, 6 (!) tram lines and the new metro.

Our GROUND FLOOR house (no stairs) is beautiful, comfortable and practical, with high ceilings, great style and an incredible back yard garden that's quiet ...IN THE MIDDLE OF THE CITY! The winter atrium has a fireplace.

Perfect for a couple, with or without two kids or two couples.

Within a few minutes, you’ll discover the neighborhood is filled with lovely restaurants, shops, bakeries, bars and museums. Easy access to trams and buses for Museumplein, De Pijp and Central Station, and only 15 mins by car from Schiphol

name: Gezellig appartement in de Jordaan

The bedroom is cozy and peaceful with a large bed for a great night of rest.

Enjoy peace and privacy while city life is within walking distance. Fully equipped kitchen and sleek design make this the perfect place for a comfortable and stylish stay in the heart of Amsterdam.

description:
Beautifully Renovated Apartment in the Heart of Amsterdam Oud-Zuid

This fully furnished 54 m2 first floor apartment has been renovated and combines comfort, style, and location.The apartment features a spacious bedroom with ample wardrobe space, a home office and a view of the private balcony and a modern bathroom. The living room and new kitchen offer a welcoming space with high-quality finishes. Located in Adam Oud-Zuid, just a walk from Amsterdam Zuid station and the Zuidas business district

name: Appartement in Centrum Oost
description:
Modern apartment with balcony in Amsterdam Centrum-Oost

Discover this stylish apartment in the Dapperbuurt, within walking distance of the market, Artis and Oosterpark. Ideal for couples or solo travelers.
The apartment has a bright living room with an open kitchen, a balcony, and a spacious bedroom with a comfortable bed and a walk-in closet.
The neighborhood is lively but quiet: full of cozy cafes, shops and market stalls. Excellent public transport connections will take you to the city center or De Pijp in 10 minutes.

name: Bohemien City Center Art Loft
description:
This warm and spacious bohemian loft for a couple or a family. — just a few minute walk (or two bus stops) from Central Station and steps from the Jordaan. Arty eclectic decor, this unique home features one bedroom in the main loft and a separate apartment area with a double bunk bed and lounge.

With two modern bathrooms and space for up to six guests only family , it’s the perfect stay for anyone seeking comfort, design, and atmosphere — not a party place, but an inspiring city retreat.

name: Cozy bright apartment in old Amsterdam centre
description: Just get away from it all in this soothing, centrally located accommodation with many sights, lunch spots and restaurants within walking distance.

name: Charming and Light Two-bedroom Apartment
description:
🔍 Details:
* 59 m2 total living space
* Two bedrooms, one double bed each
* Washer/dryer combination, Smart TV, WiFi present
* Bedding and towels present
* Quiet neighborhood in bustling Bos en Lommer
* Small balcony spanning the entire facade

📍 Excellent location:
* 200 meter from the nearest supermarket and other essential shops
* 400 meter from Erasmuspark
* 250 meter from the nearest busstop connecting to Amsterdam center, Sloterdijk Station, and Amsterdam Centraal

name: Perfect gelegen luxe appartement naast Vondelpark
description: Bright and stylish apartment next to the Vondelpark, featuring a comfortable bedroom, a separate workspace, a sunny roof terrace, and a balcony. The house has been recently renovated and furnished with a lot of love and care. A quiet and stylish place in Amsterdam, perfect for those who want to experience the city but also value comfort, tranquility, and a well-kept, homey feel. Located in one of the most beautiful neighborhoods of Amsterdam, with public transportation nearby and the city center just a short distance away.

name: Charming stay in De Baarsjes by Rembrandtpark
description: Charming apartment in vibrant Amsterdam West, right next to Rembrandtpark, ideal for morning walks or picnics. Just a short stroll from De Hallen’s buzzing food hall, cinema, and boutiques. Dam Square is 12 minutes by bike, Central Station 15 by tram. The area is full of cozy cafés, bakeries, and local shops. Whether you're here to relax, explore, or work remotely, this well-connected and green neighborhood offers the perfect base to experience Amsterdam like a local.

name: 3-Storey Cosy Home in the Heart of Amsterdam
description: Just 20 minutes by public transport from Schiphol airport and 2 metro stops from Central Station, our lovely home is ideally located to explore Amsterdam. Everything is within walking distance, we are surrounded by great restaurants and bars, yet our home is quiet and  ideal for a relaxing stay in this beautiful city. Metro stop Vijzelgracht is the main stop for the museums and the Concertgebouw which are less than a 10 minute walk from the house.

name: Amstel House
description:
Bright & Quiet Apartment by the Amstel.

Light-filled 1-bedroom apartment on the top (4th) floor, just steps from the Amstel river. The 30sqm flat includes a fully equipped kitchen, a comfortable living area, and a private bathroom.

Located on a peaceful street with cafés, bars, and restaurants around the corner.
Great transport links: the metro and train station are a 5-minute walk away; the city center is only 15 minutes by bike or 5 minutes by metro.

Perfect to experience local Amsterdam.

name: Spacious, light and central Amsterdam maisonette
description: Bright, peaceful, and close to Vondelpark and the centre, this modern three-level home offers comfort just minutes from cafés, restaurants, shops, bakeries, parks, and the historic centre. Enjoy two cosy bedrooms, fast Wi-Fi, two workstations, a fully equipped kitchen, a sunny terrace with outdoor dining, and a light-filled living room. Perfect for work or leisure, with easy access, a welcoming feel, and a quiet atmosphere to relax after exploring Amsterdam.

name: Light-Filled Designer Duplex in Historic Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our peaceful design home in the heart of Amsterdam.

This newly renovated, light-filled duplex is located on the third floor of a historic canal house in the green Plantage district. Stairs only (no elevator), rewarded with exceptional light, privacy and calm, high ceilings, and large windows overlooking the neighbourhood’s trees and rooftops.

Next to metro (5mon from central station) and the Amstel river; it is perfect for couples, remote workers or small families.

name: A light, spacious and renovated apartment
description: Enjoy our light, recently renovated apartment just steps from the beautiful Weesperzijde. In a quiet neighborhood in the city centre yet only 5 minutes’ walk from the canals, it’s the perfect base for exploring Amsterdam. The apartment features a cozy bedroom for two, a spacious living room, a modern kitchen, and a lovely French balcony — ideal for morning coffee or evening wine.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam
description:
Tastefully decorated (entire) apartment of 45m2. Private bedroom, private bathroom and private toilet. Very functionally furnished. A few minutes from downtown and highway. 9 minutes cycling to Rozengracht.

Modern kitchen with induction, underfloor heating, tram stops in front of the door. The bedroom has a king size bed.

name: Brouwers Canal House
description: Experience authentic Amsterdam living in our beautifull canal apartment, with a front and backhouse, dating back to 1720. Located on the picturesque  Brouwersgracht, one of the city’s most beloved canals. You’ll have a living room with canal view, 2 quiet bedrooms  in the back of the house. Step outside and you’re surrounded by charming cafes, local boutiques, cozy restaurants and vibrant markets. Central Station, the Anne Frank House and the famous Nine Streets are all just a stroll away.

name: Large room in Amsterdam NDSM
description:
Large guestroom (18m2) in my lovely home.
Use of the bright living room and kitchen.
Kitchen is fully equipped, and also you can use the base ingredients like oil, flour, herbs and spices, sugar, etc. that you need.

When the weather is good, you can relax in the garden or have a BBQ.

Location is quiet, but with public transport very close to the city center.

name: Family Studio + Free parking
description:
+ FREE PARKING
Perfect for families or small groups, this cozy room offers everything you need for a comfortable stay in Amsterdam. It features a king-size bed and a bunk bed, a private bathroom with shower, and a kitchenette with a fridge, microwave, coffee maker, and kettle.
Enjoy the warm, homey atmosphere with a small seating area, perfect for relaxing after a day in the city. The room also includes free WiFi, toiletries, and all essentials for a pleasant, hassle-free stay.

name: Beautifully renovated apartment facing the park
description: A newly renovated 3-bedroom apartment facing Rembrandtpark. The spacious, light-filled living room and kitchen make you feel at home instantly. Close to the city center and easily reachable by tram. Prefer staying local? Enjoy the park or rooftop terrace. Perfect for families. Pets allowed. This is a lived-in home, not a standard rental—expect a personal, cozy space, with things like cooking herbs available. If you prefer a neutral hotel-style stay, this may not be for you.

name: Bright & Cozy Home in Central Amsterdam
description: Spacious and bright 120m² home in the heart of Amsterdam. The high ceilings and large windows make the ground floor feel open and relaxed. There are two comfortable bedrooms and a small garden where you can enjoy breakfast or dinner on warm days. Located just a 5-minute walk from the canals and Vondelpark, and surrounded by cozy cafés and great restaurants on Bosboom Toussaintstraat. A warm, welcoming place to experience authentic Amsterdam living.

name: Cozy Room Steps Away from Museum Square
description:
You will have one private bedroom + attached private shower in our beautiful, centrally-located apartment, around the corner from Rijksmuseum!

THIS IS A SHARED APARTMENT - the other bedroom is occupied by us, Christina & Arno, and we're happy to give you tips to best enjoy your stay!

The apartment itself is quiet and peaceful but is within a 10 minute walk to top Amsterdam tourist attractions such as the Van Gogh Museum, Vondelpark, and more.

name: Elegant City Hideaway by Vondelpark & Museumplein
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.Step into your private Amsterdam retreat. A bright and thoughtfully designed one-bedroom apartment on the prestigious P.C. Hooftstraat, next to Vondelpark and steps from Museumplein’s world-famous Van Gogh, Rijksmuseum, Stedelijk, and Moco museums.

name: Spacious high end apartment
description:
Feel right at home in our beautiful and spacious apartment.

The well-maintained building from 1882 gives you a unique feeling.

There is a bedroom with a double bed that sleeps 2 adults. There is another bedroom with a sofa bed.

Restaurants, bars, supermarkets and Westerpark are all on walking distance.

Neighborhood Jordaan is 5 minute walk

Apartment is complete with everything you need including:
- equipped kitchen
- office with fast wifi
- tv with Netflix
- washing machine and de

name: Stylish Amsterdam Zuid Apartment + Private Rooftop
description:
< Available for long term >>

Stylish 80 m² apartment in Amsterdam Zuid, steps from Museum Square and easy tram/metro links. Enjoy a bright living room with a fully equipped kitchen, pantry, dining area and 49” TV. Upstairs are a serene bedroom, extra study/bedroom, modern bathroom and separate toilet. Finish your day on the private rooftop terrace with lounge seating, BBQ and sweeping views over Amsterdam’s rooftops.

name: Cosy 1 bedroom apartment with balcony
description:
A tastefully decorated and cosy one-bedroom apartment filled with art and musical character. The space is thoughtfully arranged to offer both comfort and functionality.

Located in the vibrant and up-and-coming Javaplein neighbourhood, the apartment is well connected by public transport, providing easy access to the rest of the city. You’ll find supermarkets, cafés, and bars right on your doorstep, while still enjoying that neighborhood feel.

name: Sunny 2BR Apartment · Dual Balconies & Vondelpark
description:
A real Amsterdam home, lived-in year-round. Bright and warm, with artwork and plants. Two balconies — one for morning coffee, one for dining outside.
Fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, shower and separate bathtub.
Two bedrooms: queen-size bed in the main, extendable single in the second, 2 desks and a monitor.
Steps away from Vondelpark, local cafés, restaurants and supermarkets nearby. Tram down the street and direct bus to Schiphol Airport.

0363 A33C 45BD E27A 0332

name: Nieuwe heren 5
description: Cozy ground-floor home, with French windows, in the city center and on the canals of Amsterdam.

name: Bohemian luxurious home + garden central city
description:
Experience elegant Amsterdam living on ground floor spacious apartment with private garden. Steps from the Amstel, Albert Cuyp market, canals and Sarphatipark, surrounded by cafés and boutiques.

Easy check-in, close to trams, just 15 minutes from Schiphol.

The space
• Bright living and dining area
• Peaceful bedroom
• 4K beamer and sound system
• Garden with lounge set and table

Please note: no parties & no pets

name: Charming Apartment with Roof Terrace
description: Our bright and cozy duplex in the heart of the Jordaan is just steps from the Noordermarkt and Anne Frank House. Light-filled and comfortable, it features a fully equipped kitchen, modern bathroom, and a private roof terrace with a stunning view of the Noorderkerk, perfect for morning coffee or sunset drinks. The ideal base for exploring Amsterdam on foot or by bike.

name: Cozy room with private bathroom in Oud West
description:
Cozy Room in Oldwest offers a guest house experience in Amsterdam. The property features a sun terrace and free WiFi, ensuring a pleasant stay.
The room includes a private bathroom, balcony with garden views, and a work desk with screen. Additional facilities include a tea and coffee maker, hairdryer, and free toiletries.
Located 13 km from Schiphol Airport, the guest house is close to attractions such as the Van Gogh Museum (8-minute walk), , and Vondelpark (4-minute walk).

name: Budget 10P Bunk Room + Free Parking
description:
Our Budget 10-Pack Room is perfect for big groups of friends or travelers looking for a fun and affordable stay in Amsterdam.
The room has five bunk beds, a small kitchenette, and two private rooms with a bathroom and shower inside — everything you need for a comfortable group stay.
Enjoy free parking and access to our lively lobby with table tennis, free popcorn, and a PlayStation racing simulator!

name: Apartment with rooftop terrace in Amsterdam
description:
Bright and fully renovated apartment in Amsterdam West, featuring beautiful wooden beams and stylish finishes. Located on a quiet street near the Kinkerstraat, with cozy cafés, restaurants, bakeries, and excellent public transport connections.

Highlights:
🍽️ Private rooftop terrace with jacuzzi & BBQ
🌞 Balcony & bright living area
🛁 Modern kitchen & bathroom with bathtub
🌳 Rembrandtpark & Vondelpark within walking distance
🏡 Quiet, central location in Amsterdam West

name: Retro-Chic Luxury Apartment in Amsterdam Oud-West
description: Retro-chic luxury in the heart of Amsterdam’s Oud-West. This bright designer apartment blends mid-century style with modern comfort—featuring a green statement kitchen, vintage accents, and a private balcony overlooking lively Jan Pieter Heijestraat . Steps from De Hallen, Vondelpark, and Jordaan, it’s the perfect blend of elegance, charm, and city energy.

name: Bright & Cozy Apartment Near Oosterpark
description: Welcome to this recently renovated and thoughtfully designed apartment (50m2) on the third floor, located in one of the most charming streets of Amsterdam Oost. This bright and comfortable home offers a calm retreat right in the middle of a vibrant neighbourhood filled with parks, cafés and local hotspots. With a sunny balcony, a modern open kitchen and a spacious bedroom with a French balcony, this apartment is the perfect base for an extended stay in Amsterdam.

name: Lady, Relax in Amsterdam Quiet Room!
description:
Only one Lady Welcome !

Please read All the House Rules FIRST.

Female Hostess.
Quiet Private Room for 1 Lady Only, welcome.
Come, Chill & Relax! Walking distance, Famous Windmill with AMSTERDAM Brewery IJBEER.
Coffeeshops, Fresh Daily Market, a lot of Food & drinks everywhere! Gasstation open 24 hours for Sigarets and Snacks. When you come from the Busy City, you can get a good Warm Rest! Italian, Thai, Indonesian, Mexican food all around.

name: Spacious 3-Room Stay | Ideal For Families
description: Enjoy a stylish and comfortable stay in this centrally located 3-room apartment, ideal for families or groups. Sleeps up to 7 guests with 3 king-size beds and 1 single bed across spacious rooms. Features two living areas, a kitchenette, and two modern bathrooms. Fast Wi-Fi, Smart TVs, and easy self check-in ensure a smooth stay. Set in peaceful Amsterdam Zuid, close to parks, cafés, and public transport—perfect for longer stays or work trips.

name: Bright and spacious penthouse with sunny terraces
description: Welcome to our modern and renovated penthouse in Amsterdam, located in a upcoming neighbourhood surrounded by restaurants and cafes. There is a tram stop in front of the house that brings you in 5 min to the city centre. From the airport it is a 15 min drive.

name: Bright & Charming Home in Amsterdam
description: Welcome to your bright and stylish home in one of Amsterdam’s most loved neighbourhoods: De Rivierenbuurt! This charming and modern apartment is close to the Amstel river, great cafés and restaurants, and the RAI CONVENTION Centre, ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Excellent transport connections: trams and the North–South metro line take you quickly around the city and to Amsterdam Central and South. We look forward to welcoming you and making your stay in Amsterdam feel like home!

name: Appartement Amsterdam-Oost Mid-Century Interieur
description: Warm and stylish apartment in Amsterdam East with garden near the Javastraat. Fully furnished in mid-century style with an industrial character.

name: Apartment in Amsterdam West across from Vondelpark
description:
Modern, minimalistic one-bedroom apartment located on Staringplein, a quiet and beautiful square in Amsterdam Oud-West. The apartment includes a spacious living room with a fully equipped open kitchen, one bedroom, one bathroom with bath tub, and two balconies with view over the square.

Vondelpark is directly across the street, and the city centre is within walking distance. The area offers many cafés, restaurants, and bars, and has a friendly, local atmosphere.

name: Canal view appartement in the Jordaan
description: From this perfectly located home base, the Jordaan and the city center are within walking distance.

name: Quirky, cosy and spacious apartment, good location
description:
Welcome to our bright, quirky two-floor apartment in the heart of De Pijp! Step outside to great cafés, restaurants, and shops—Museumplein is a short walk away.

We're both artists, so you'll find unique wooden furniture and ceramics we made ourselves. Two comfy bedrooms, a spacious living room full of colour and character, plus a fully equipped kitchen (with dishwasher).

It's on a peaceful side street—enjoy De Pijp's buzz with a calm place to come home to. We'd love to host you!

name: Amsterdam Center: Apartment with Private Garden
description: Newly renovated 60m² apartment in peaceful Oostenburgerpark, close to Central Station and the Maritime Museum. Features a king-size bedroom, dedicated workspace with fast WiFi, open living/kitchen area, and floor heating. Enjoy a private south-facing garden ideal for breakfast in the sun. Supermarket and tram 1 minute away. Calm central location.

name: Modern familyhouse in the best area of Amsterdam
description:
A modern family home in the heart of Amsterdam in the popular De Pijp district.
It is located in a quiet street, and all popular amenities are within walking distance. Supermarket, shops and restaurants (2 min.). Child-friendly park with playground (5 min.). Heineken museum (10 min.), Museumplein, Rijks museum and Van Gogh museum (15 min.). Metro station (3 min). Popular Albert Cuyp Market (5 min). A perfect base for exploring the city!

name: Maisonette Amsterdam
description:
My two-floor-apartment is situated in a very green neighbourhood outside the city centre (approximately 20min by metro. Station is 600m away).
It's a bright and quiet place, where I live with my 5-years-old daughter. It's composed of a living room, a kitchen, a balcony, 2 bedrooms, a toilet and a bathroom (with both a shower and a bathtub).

I rent out the apartment when we are not there, but most of our stuff stays in the place. Please be mindful about that.

No smoking, no party, no drugs.

name: Light 2-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam West
description:
Light apartment with 2 bedrooms - close to Westerpark and many nice cafés and restaurants. Walking distance to De Baarsjes and biking distance to Jordaan (10min), Oud-Zuid (15min), and De Pijp (20min).

A dedicated workspace in one of the bedrooms and a big kitchen table - good co-working location for 4 people.

Public transport brings you directly to the ArenA for your concert or soccer night - it’s just 15min if you take an Uber back.

name: Cozy apartment by the canal in Amsterdam
description:
Cozy apartment by the canal in a quiet neighbourhood, but close to the city centre. Close to multiple sights; Anne Frank house, Vondelpark, Leidseplein. Especially by bike :) But the apartment is also right next to tram/ bus station.

1 bedroom with a double bed, own bathroom, kitchen and living/ dining area! No shared spaces. There is also a balcony with sun the whole afternoon and evening.

name: Centraal gelegen sfeervolle huis met veel ruimte.
description:
From this centrally located space, everything is within reach for the whole group. The apartment is located above shops, market and two supermarkets. The city center is a 15-minute walk away, the metro is 5 minutes away, and the neighborhood is lovely.
Noord is growing into a new center where spatial freedom is a relief while the crowds and tourist attractions are very easily connected to this area by the ferry or great North-South metro line.

name: Charming & Spacious Family Home w/ Private Garden
description:
Stay in a true piece of Amsterdam history! 🌷

Bright & spacious 1930s home in Amsterdam ✨ With oak floors, marble details & a sunny private garden 🪵 3 bedrooms, modern kitchen & baby cot available 👶 Perfect for families or couples seeking authentic charm near De Pijp & cafés 🚲 Walk to the historic city center in minutes! Historic character meets modern comfort ❤️

Enjoy peaceful mornings with coffee in the garden, cozy evenings inside & the feeling of living like a true Amsterdam local 🙏

name: Prachtig appartement - Dakterras & haard Oud-West
description: Experience a cozy Amsterdam winter escape in this spacious and beautifully designed Oud-West apartment. Warm up by the fireplace after a day exploring the city, then unwind with a glass of wine on your private rooftop terrace under the winter lights. Just moments from cafés, boutiques, and Vondelpark, this stylish home offers comfort, charm, and the perfect winter retreat.

name: Bright Modern Apartment near Oosterpark Amsterdam
description: Enjoy a stylish 55 m² apartment in a quiet, central area of Amsterdam. Fully renovated with a spacious living room, cozy bedroom, modern bathroom, and a small office. Just a short walk from Oosterpark and about 15–20 minutes from the city centre. Perfect for couples or remote workers looking for comfort and convenience.

name: Gezellig appartement centrum Amsterdam
description: Welcome to my bright and cosy apartment in the Staatsliedenbuurt, one of Amsterdam’s most charming neighbourhoods. Just a few minutes’ walk away, you’ll find Westerpark with its great restaurants, cafés, and lively atmosphere. The area has everything you need — a bakery, supermarkets, cosy coffee spots, and boutique shops.

name: Bright De Pjip 1-bedroom apt
description:
Make the best of your Amsterdam experience
Situated in the trendy neighborhood of De Pjip, on the famous Albert Cuypstraat market, while conveniently 10m from the Van Woustraat exit
We are 8-min walk from the M52 metro, 30 second walk from the tram, 5 minutes biking to Museumplein (Rijks, Van Gogh…), 7 minutes to 9-Straatjes (with cute boutiques)
The bedroom is super quiet as it is on the inner courtyard side. The apartment comes with all needed amenities (including. washing machine, dishwasher)

name: Bright & Spacious Amsterdam West
description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

name: OTYS Hideaway
description:
Experience a unique stay at OTYS Hideaway, a charming 67 m² apartment located in a beautiful classic Amsterdam building from 1881.

This cozy ground-floor souterrain with a private entrance directly from the street combines historic character with modern comfort. The location is perfectly situated between Amsterdam’s vibrant City Center and the trendy Pijp district, giving you easy access to both Amsterdam’s top attractions and the local hotspots.

name: Ruim en licht appartement van 80m2
description:
Enjoy a spacious and bright apartment of 80m² in the quiet Amsterdam West. Perfectly located: within walking distance of tram and metro stops to Amsterdam city center. Within 8 minutes by bike, you are in the Vondelpark or the lively Oud-West with numerous hip cafes and restaurants.
Feel like a night out? Lofi, Sissy and Radion are all within 15 minutes by bike. For a relaxing walk, you can walk into the Rembrandtpark or towards the Sloterplas. The ideal base for exploring Amsterdam!

name: Stijlvol & Comfortabel Appartement
description: New! Fully renovated and stylish apartment in Amsterdam-Zuid. 10-minute drive from Schiphol Airport. Close to Vondelpark and city center. Comfortable 80m2 house on the ground floor. High ceilings, lots of color and art. Modern kitchen and bathroom. A private workplace in separate office space, and a facade garden with bench in the sun. Cafes and shops around the corner. Quietly located on the waterfront. Public transport (tram and bus stop) around the corner.

name: Charming flat in a cute & quiet area
description: Enjoy a cosy stay in this nicely decorated 39m2 one bed appartement based on the first floor of a monument Amsterdam house. The space feels comfortable and well looked after with all the amenities you need. The bathroom is small but compact and functions very well with a hot high pressure shower. The flat is located on a quiet street of Amsterdam Central East area, with cafés and restaurants near by. Also, easily reachable with the direct tram line from Centraal station.

name: Apartment in Museumplein
description: Our apartment is centrally located with Museumplein on one side and De Pijp on the other. De Pijp is a trendy neighbourhood with bars and restaurants and Museumplein has all the mjor museums (Van Gough museum, Rijksmuseum, Stedelijk museum). Besides this everything in the city center is reachable within 15 minutes via public transport (metro/tram). Or better yet take a stroll to Dam Square/Red light district/Canal Cruise pickup points etc.

name: Expats house Amsterdam 272
description: Features a modern kitchen, elegant bathroom with walk-in shower, and comfortable living room with large windows. Includes multiple cozy bedrooms, separate toilet, and bright interiors. Ideal for families or shared living in a calm, green neighborhood near amenities. A longer stay is possible

name: Spacious apartment in trendy Amsterdam West
description:
Welcome to your home away from home in vibrant Amsterdam West! Our bright and spacious apartment is ideal for couples or two friends exploring the city. Close to public transport and within walking distance of cozy cafés, unique shops, and great local restaurants.

The apartment is fully equipped and all yours, relax in the living area, cook in the kitchen and unwind on our sunny balcony that catches the afternoon sun from 2pm until sunset!

name: Cozy Apartment with Beautiful Vondelpark Views
description: Welcome to my home in Amsterdam! This bright 4th-floor apartment sits right in front of Vondelpark — perfect for relaxing, enjoying a coffee by the window, and watching the park come alive. Ideal for up to 4 guests, with a bedroom, spare room with sofa bed, spacious living area, and fully equipped kitchen.

name: Stylish and warm home with garden on Javaplein
description:
We’re renting out our recently renovated apartment in a friendly area (Javaplein) while we’re off to Patagonia. It’s a comfortable home with all amenities, ideal for working from home, and has a spacious garden.

Location is perfect: off the main streets yet close to cafés, parks, and with easy access in/out of town.

We’re looking for a responsible person or couple who’ll take good care of our home (and plants), ideally for a slightly longer stay.

Send us a message to discuss, we’re flexible!

name: Karakteristiek Dijkhuis in Amsterdam Noord
description:
Welcome to our cozy dike house in Amsterdam-Noord

This characteristic dike house is an oasis of peace, spread over three floors and located in a unique spot on the water. A wonderful base for those who want to enjoy nature and silence, while the liveliness of Amsterdam is surprisingly close.

name: Modern luxe appartement naast het Museumplein
description:
Modern apartment in a prime location in De Pijp. Situated on the first floor in the heart of one of Amsterdam’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Within walking distance of the Albert Cuyp Market, Museumplein, and the canals. Tram and metro stops are just around the corner.

The apartment is spacious, modernly finished, and recently renovated. It is equipped with fast Wi-Fi, modern built-in appliances, and a recently fully renovated bathroom.

Clean towels and bed linen are included.

name: Cozyplace – Sauna, Fire place & Groen in Amsterdam
description:
Enjoy the bustling city of Amsterdam and relax in this bright and cozy 70s home, located in Amsterdam Noord.

The perfect place for those who want to enjoy the city of Amsterdam and to come to yourself in the quiet house and the surroundings.

Unique is that there is a private sauna in the house!
Enjoy the warmth by the fireplace,
A walk through the green surroundings
Painting on the easel, reading books, games and playing on the grand piano.

name: Apartment in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our comfortable and stylish home located in the Amsterdam-East neighborhood. The apartment offers two bedrooms, a private terrace and accommodates up to three guests.

Enjoy a spacious living room that’s ideal for relaxing after a day of exploring the city & the open kitchen that is fully equipped.

Situated in a lively yet relaxed area, you’ll be close to cafes, restaurants, parks, and excellent public transport connections to the city center.

name: Luxe Verblijf in Hartje De Pijp – Nabij Amstel
description: A bright and quiet 80m² apartment in the heart of De Pijp. Perfect to relax at home during your visit to Amsterdam, while walking everywhere. Enjoy silence, space and comfort, with cafes, supermarkets and the best Italian cuisine literally around the corner. The ideal combination of central location and a serene, stylish home base.

name: Spacious design loft on canal with balconies
description: Wake up in a sun-filled artist residence designed for true design and art lovers. This unique loft blends curated pieces, bold details and a calm, inspiring atmosphere. Enjoy a spacious open-plan living area with high ceilings, large windows, a cozy fireplace and a big dining table for long dinners. Two unique sleeping spaces: a serene master bedroom and a playful elevated nook (double bed, via ladder). Includes a luxurious bathroom, walk-in closet and two sunny private balconys .

name: Unique Urban Bungalow in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to a rare find in Amsterdam: a freestanding private bungalow in the heart of Bos & Lommer.

This stylish home is normally our personal residence, filled with warmth and personality. We only rent it out when we travel, so it feels more like a boutique home than a typical rental.

Enjoy a true live-like-a-local experience, complete with a striking industrial touch: the large overhead door that recalls the building’s former life as a storage. All super insulated for maximum comfort.

name: Modern & Cosy city apt -2BR
description:
This stylish newly renovated apartment is in a great neighborhood, close to shops and supermarket. Its a very safe and nice area and only 15 min away ( by tram) from the city center:)

It has 2 bedrooms. 1 bedroom with a double bed and a small balcony and 1 bedroom with a bunkbed that can sleep 2.

A nice open plan fully equipped kitchen and a living room with SMART TV.

Its a true hidden gem!

name: Charming historic apartment on the Amstel river
description: Wake up in a piece of Amsterdam history. Our beautifully restored canal apartment sits directly on the river Amstel, offering unobstructed views of the famous Magere Brug—one of the city’s most iconic landmarks. Watch boats glide by from your window, enjoy the soft glow of the bridge’s lights in the evening, and feel completely immersed in the atmosphere that makes Amsterdam so special.

name: Apartment Amsterdam - max. 4 people, 2 bathrooms
description:
Hi there! I am Airbnb-ing my comfortable apartment in Amsterdam. The apartment is 134m2 with 2 bedrooms, a large kitchen and living area, 2 bathrooms, a home office and laundry room with free parking. Tram 26 to Amsterdam Central Station and bus 360 to Amsterdam Bijlmer Arena are nearby.

It is a new neighborhood so there is a lot of construction going on. Fortunately, you will not notice any of that once you are within my apartment.

I have a very friendly cat, Tony, who will be there :).

name: Private design apartment near Jordaan

description: Bright, cosy 1-Bedroom flat on the Jacob van Lennepkade canal. Flooded with light and perfectly central! Walk 5 mins to Vondelpark or De Hallen food market. Easy public transport (Trams 3, 7, 17) nearby, though most highlights are walkable. The perfect "gezellig" home base to live like a local in Amsterdam. Includes full kitchen & WiFi.

name: Cozy and bright studio near the Amsterdam centre
description: Charming and cozy studio next to Bos en Lommerplantsoen, perfect for a romantic getaway or city trip. Located just minutes from Amsterdam’s city center, it offers a great mix of urban life and green surroundings. Step outside into the park or explore trendy cafés, local shops, and cultural spots nearby. With excellent public transport connections, you can easily reach the canals, museums, and nightlife areas. A comfortable and stylish base to discover Amsterdam at your own pace.

name: Het Groene Huys-Amsterdam
description: A peaceful B&B in Amsterdam on the Gaasp River, surrounded by nature. Here you'll enjoy comfort, privacy, and a warm, homely feeling. Our charming 35m² B&B features a double bed, private bathroom, kitchen, sitting area, terrace, veranda, several lounge sets, and a jetty where you can moor your boat for free. Your stay includes our breakfast with fresh products. Explore nature or enjoy the ideal location near Amsterdam's vibrant city center.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Spacious Amsterdam central 2-bedroom apartment
description:
Welcome to my spacious apartment on the Prinsenstraat, tucked into the heart of the Jordaan. Two comfortable bedrooms and a spacious living area make it the perfect retreat after exploring the city.
Step outside to canals, cosy cafés, and charming local shops. The Anne Frank House is just around the corner, Central Station a 10-minute stroll, and the rest of Amsterdam unfolds easily on foot or by tram.
An authentic base in one of Amsterdam's most beloved neighbourhoods.

Can't wait to host you!

name: rustige stadswoning
description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place. This house is on the fourth floor; there is no elevator. At the back is a balcony, and there is a beautiful roof terrace with a tremendously beautiful view. The bedroom is at the rear and is very quiet. There is also a small bedroom, but the cat flap is in this bedroom. That's why this house is only rented to 2 people. There are two parks nearby, and the city center is easily accessible.

name: NEW: Cosy & Stylish | 4P | Family-friendly
description:
Cosy and bright apartment in lively Amsterdam West, perfect for 4 guests.

Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, balcony views, and a cozy living room with a comfortable couch.

One bedroom features a queen-size bed, and a work desk + balcony access.

The other features also a queen sized bed and is ensuite to the living room, including sliding doors.

A modern bathroom includes a walk-in shower, sink, and toilet.

A stylish, comfortable base to explore Amsterdam with family or friends!

name: Spacious and cozy apartment on prime location
description:
Spacious apartment in Amsterdam Oud-West. Located next to the Vondelpark and close to neighborhood cafe’s, supermarkets and restaurants with good public transport connection.

Modern and stylish one bedroom apartment perfect for a couple (with baby or toddler) to enjoy their stay in Amsterdam.

name: Apartment in Amsterdam
description: Spacious apartment with balconies at the front and back, located on the most popular street in Amsterdam-Oost. Located in one of the nicest neighborhoods in Amsterdam, close to the city center.

name: Cosy apartment with garden in the Java district
description:
Comfortable and personal apartment with garden in the Java neighborhood (incl. sweet cat 🐾)

Welcome to our lovely and bright ground-floor apartment in the cozy Java neighborhood in Amsterdam East. This is our personal home, where we live with great pleasure, and which we are happy to temporarily share with guests during our travels who want to experience Amsterdam in an authentic way. The apartment was fully renovated in 2025.

name: Cozy apartment for rent in the centre of Amsterdam
description:
Cozy apartment available with one bedroom. The home is fully equipped and features a spacious kitchen with a dishwasher, washing machine, a (small) bathroom, a large bedroom, and an extra small room where you can retreat to read a book.

On the lively square downstairs there is a bakery with the best pastries in Amsterdam, perfect to start your day. If you prefer to stay in, good coffee is available in the house.

The apartment is located just around the corner from Westerpark and the Jordaan.

name: Exclusief luxe appartement - met 30m2 dakterras
description: This high-quality and stylishly furnished apartment is in the beloved A'dam-West, ideal for those looking for comfort, luxury and privacy. The apartment has one spacious bedroom with en-suite and walk-in closet, an elegant living room and luxurious bathrooms. The interior is modern and refined. The highlight is the private 30 m² roof terrace, complemented by two balconies. The fully equipped kitchen features, among other things, a climate cabinet. Quietly located, with excellent connections and restaurants within walking distance.

name: Luxury apartment in most loved center area Jordaan
description:
Located in the heart of Amsterdam's iconic Jordaan district, this bright and elevated apartment offers the perfect city lifestyle near the canal district.

- Luxurious bathroom with bathtub & shower
- Sunny balcony & peaceful quiet bedroom at the back
- Beautiful 1906 authentic house w/ stained glass windows
- Next to the Mon & Sat markets: organic food & antiques & vintage clothes
- Steps from charming cafés & top restaurants

Tram lines, daily shops, and Ams Central within walking distance.

name: Villa M
description: This cozy, sunlit studio is located in a brand-new building that features a few terraces and a nice green area downstairs. It's just a 2-minute walk from Spaklerweg station, whisking you into the city center in under 10 minutes. Enjoy the tranquility of the Amstel river nearby and the convenience of local shops and restaurants right at your doorstep. The apartment features high-end appliances, a powerful heating system and a safe, neighborhood feel.

name: Compleet en stijlvol appartement Amsterdam-west
description:
Stylish and bright apartment, perfect for a comfortable stay to discover Amsterdam. Located in a quiet street, but in the middle of lively Amsterdam-West.

By public transportation, you'll be in Leidseplein in 15 minutes. Nearby are many hip restaurants, cafes and coffee shops, all within walking distance.

The apartment features a separate study, a sunny balcony, and a fully equipped kitchen. Ideal for city trips, longer stays or remote work in Amsterdam.

name: Cozy apartment, closed to Zuid station
description: Bright and comfortable first-floor apartment, ideally located just 500 meters from Amsterdam Zuid Station with excellent public transport connections. The apartment features two bedrooms, a combined living and dining area with a dedicated home office space, a semi-open kitchen, and a sunny balcony that fills the home with natural light.

name: 200m2 house in Amsterdam-Noord
description: Spacious and quiet family home in Amsterdam-Noord, within cycling distance of Central Station (20 min).

name: Spacious & Stylish apartment City Center
description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

name: One Bed Apartment in West Amsterdam
description:
Together with my girlfriend (and dog) I live in this two-bedroom apartment in West Amsterdam. We are now making the apartment available for short-term rent when we are out of town.

The apartment has two bedrooms but we have closed one off to enable the storage of personal items (clothes, etc.). This is primarily to facilitate full guest access to the remaining space. The apartment entials an open kitchen, bathroom, balcony and a large terrace with seating/a BBQ.

*Better photos are forthcoming

name: Terrace Boat - Amsterdam City
description: Step aboard The Solace, a distinctive and lovingly restored 10-meter Dutch cabin cruiser, perfect for a memorable getaway in Amsterdam—whether with your partner, friends, or family. This classic boat, moored in a secure harbor just 10 minutes by bus from the lively city center, offers a cozy and comfortable retreat on the water. Fully equipped to accommodate up to four guests, it has everything you need for a relaxing and enjoyable stay.

name: City Center Monumental Amsterdam Apartment
description: Stay in a beautifully renovated monumental apartment in the heart of Amsterdam. This high-end city retreat blends historic charm with modern luxury, featuring premium finishes, high ceilings, and airconditioning throughout — a rare comfort in the city center. Quiet, stylish, and perfectly located for canals, culture, dining, and shopping.

name: Cosy appartment in the Pijp
description:
Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay close to the city centre. Its very well connected with metro and tram, so places like Vondelpark, Museumplein, Central Station and the Airport are all very easy to reach. Perfect for tourists wishing to explore the city, I love to give recommendations on places to visit! 😊

The house has two bedrooms with a double bed in each. A spacious kitchen and living room, and a separate office.

name: Gezellige, rustige studio nabij centrum.
description:
This quiet and centrally located accommodation is tastefully decorated.
The studio is close to a shopping center, restaurants and public transport.
Historical center and museums are 20 minutes away.
Open swimming water in the immediate vicinity.

name: Spacious family home, quiet, terrace, near city,P+
description: This comfortable fully equipped family home in a quiet green child-friendly neighborhood is the perfect base for exploring, 15 minutes from downtown Amsterdam. Cultural highlights, historic center, but also the green and quiet character of Nieuw West, near the Sloterplas where you can swim and play sports. A house in a dead-end car-free courtyard with a playground around the corner where children can walk safely. Includes a private south-facing roof terrace.

name: Bright & Cozy Stay in the Heart of De Pijp
description:
Stay in the heart of Amsterdam’s De Pijp at Gerard Doustraat 228H. This cozy apartment hosts up to 4 guests, with a private bedroom and a comfy futon in the living area. Bright, welcoming, and fully equipped, it’s steps from the Albert Cuyp Market, cafés, shops, and Sarphatipark. Enjoy the lively neighborhood and quick access to the historic center.

2 Mins walk from the Albert Cuyp market.

Permit number: Z/26/3101110

name: Peaceful Family Houseboat with Roof Terrace
description: Welcome to houseboat Helios: a bright and stylish 100 m² home on the water in a quiet area of Amsterdam. The boat has a spacious living kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom with bath and shower. You can swim from the nearby swimming ladder and relax on the sunny roof terrace. Wake up to birds and greenery while the city centre is only 15-20 minutes away by metro or tram.

name: Cute apartment close to the Jordaan
description:
Enjoy a charming 45m2 one-bedroom apartment between the Jordaan and Westerpark. Located close to the tram or bus, and only a 10-minute walk to the canals, market, cafes and restaurants.

The place is perfect for a couple or a single person with a double bed (140x200cm). Bed linen/ towels included. A fully equipped kitchen.

Guest access: Check in 2PM; check out 11AM, but can be flexible.

Parties are strictly forbidden. No smoking.

The apartment is on the second floor. No lift.

name: Modern house in Noord - NDSM
description:
Enjoy the vibrant, creative energy of Amsterdam Noord while staying in this bright home. You’ll have access to two large bedrooms with comfortable double beds and storage space, a fully equipped kitchen, a cosy living room, and a sunny garden. The house also features a modern bathroom and a separate toilet. Workspace (desks) and baby bed upon request.

15mn biking (including free ferry mini cruise ;)) to the hypercenter / Centraal Station.

name: Pretty appartment near Amstel with roofterrace
description:
This place is located in a beautiful street and only a 1 min walk to the Amstel river. You can easily walk to Oosterpark or cross the bridge walking to the Pijp area, all with lots of bars and restaurants at walking distance. Bikes included!

The appartment is very bright with an open living room with stairs leading to a big roof terrace! Also full kitchen & separate bed- and bathroom.

Any area (Pijp, RAI business, Jordaan) is very easily accessible by metro/tram, departure from Wibautstraat.

name: De Stadse Buitenplek, woning in Amsterdam-Noord
description:
Welcome to this nice family home in a quiet, green neighborhood in Amsterdam-Noord. A lovely place where you combine the space and tranquility of the outdoors with the liveliness of Amsterdam within reach.

Whether you come for nature, culture or quality time with the family, this home offers the best of both worlds — tranquility and greenery, with the city around the corner.

name: Stylish design apartment in city centre
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place. Close to museums, restaurants, cinema, food center, market. Fully equipped. Everything is provided.

Large south-facing balcony.

Museums, a movie theater, and shopping are within walking distance.

Lots of good restaurants nearby.

Modern apartment. Insulated. Quiet.

name: Appartement lumineux, parfaitement situé
description: Simplify your life in this peaceful, central space.

name: Duplex flat with rooftop next to Vondelpark
description: Located just one minute from Vondelpark, this bright apartment is set in Overtoom, one of Amsterdam’s most charming neighborhoods. Enjoy a beautiful view of the Vondel Church, adding a truly local feel to your stay. Leidseplein and Museumplein are both only a 10-minute walk away, offering easy access to nightlife and world-class museums, while the apartment remains calm and residential. An ideal base to explore Amsterdam on foot or by bike.

name: Gezellig en knus appartement nabij het Vondelpark.
description: It is an apartment on the 2nd floor just a stone's throw away from the Vondelpark. Close to shops and supermarkets, but in a quiet street. With a comfortable sitting area, nice (floor-heated) bathroom, spacious bedroom, well-equipped kitchen and a washing machine and dryer, it is a good and complete apartment. It is a house from 1914 and has a balcony at the back and small French balcony at the front. Public transport around the corner and 15 min from Schiphol.

name: Artsy Apartment Amsterdam Noord
description:
Recharge from the buzz of Amsterdam in our cozy, creative home in Noord.

20 minutes from Centraal Station by public transport or bike, our flat is perfect for discovering the city and its surrounding areas, then having a quiet, peaceful night’s sleep.

Supermarkets and a drugstore are a 5-minute walk away, a larger shopping quarter a 15-minute walk away.

Feel free to bring up to two pets; I myself am an occasional dog sitter.

name: Quiet 145m2 + garden in top location in centre!
description:
Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place :
-5 to10 minutes walk to :
+museum district (Rijks-, Van Gogh- & Stedelijk museum)
+Albert Cuyp food market
+Many restaurants
+Grocery
+Vondel Park
+ Heineken brewery
+Leidseplein, Museum plein & Rembrandt's plein
- 5 minute walk to canal boat tours etc.
Private garden ; BBQ ; 3 balconies ; large playground & subway connection to airport at the end of the street
Please no smoking / no candles / no parties

name: Appartement in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our comfortable apartment in a perfect location.

Enjoy the tranquility in a quiet neighborhood, while you are within walking distance of everything Amsterdam has to offer. The apartment is located near the Vondelpark and the atmospheric canals, but just outside the busy tourist area. Within a 15-minute walk, you are in the heart of the city center and the most famous sights. The private garden is ideal for a quiet breakfast in the morning or to relax after a day in the city.

name: Luxury, ground floor Apt with garden in 'de Pijp'
description: Spacious and bright, ground floor apartment, located in an authentic, Amsterdam house from 1910. The house consists of 1 floor and is located in a quiet street in the center of Amsterdam: De Pijp/Amsterdam South. This is the perfect area to stay; De Pijp, Sarphati park, the Albert Cuyp market, bars, restaurants, supermarkets and Amsterdam's nightlife are within walking distance.

name: Elegent Bedroom Apartment with Amstel view
description:
Cosy apartment with a view of the Amstel. Just a 5-minute walk to Amstel Station, making it easy to reach Amsterdam’s city centre. Within 6 minutes by train from the station, you can reach the Johan Cruijff Arena. Stroll to nearby cafés, terraces, and shops for a true local experience!

There is one king-size bedroom and two air mattresses available!

name: Backstage Hotel, Triple room with private bathroom
Backstage Hotel, Quadruple room with private ba...
Backstage Hotel, Family room with private bathroom
Canal view @Wittenkade
description: Bright and comfortable B&B apartment on the first floor, beautifully located on a canal with views over both the water and a quiet garden. Situated next to Westerpark and within walking distance of the Jordaan, you’ll enjoy the best of Amsterdam’s culture, food, and greenery. Please check our other listing for guest reviews and hosting history.

name: Bright studio in Oud West
description:
Our cozy top (4th) floor studio apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay in one of the nicest neighbourhoods in the city. It acommodates two people comfortably and has a double bed (or sofa), a little kitchen, a seating area to enjoy a coffee or a meal, a shower and a toilet.
Just a stone throw away from beautiful Vondelpark and with lots to see and do in the area, you will not get bored easily. Welcome to our cozy and peaceful hideway.

name: Local 2-bedroom apartment close to center.
description:
Cozy apartment located in vibrant Amsterdam Oost, close to the city center, Wereldmuseum en Oosterpaark (2-minute walk away). Linnaeusstraat offers great cafés, bars, and dinner spots. Public transport is nearby, making it easy to explore the city. Fully equipped, full kitchen, and more. We love living here and are sure it can be a perfect spot for your stay in Amsterdam!

If you plan to request a booking, please let us know why you are traveling to Amsterdam and who is traveling with you.

name: Elegant garden home, ground floor (Museumkwartier)
description:
This stylish ground floor house is located in the heart of the Museum Quarter and combines tranquility, space and character.

What makes this place really special is the garden.

Inside you will find a bright and comfortable living room, a cozy dining room and a nice bedroom. In the basement there is an extra bedroom, where a child's bed can also be placed.

Within walking distance are museums, Vondelpark cafes and restaurants.
the apartment is nice and quiet. Lovely after a long day.

name: Heerlijke benedenwoning aan de mooiste gracht!
description: Stylish and spacious canal home with private garden in Amsterdam West!

name: 2 bedroom appt with waterview
description:
Beautiful view & sunsets
Beautiful ( free) ferry ride of 12min takes you to central station. Ferry goes every 10 min

name: Unique loft in the best street of town.
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.
The apartment has high ceilings, a luxurious decor, an outdoor residence adjacent to the bedroom and also offers all the privacy. You experience peace and a wonderful atmosphere when you stay in this house. It is located in the center in the most beautiful street of the city, surrounded by nice shops, cafes and local entrepreneurs. From this location, you can discover the city on foot and by bike, and the tram stops in front of the door.

name: 8 persons best kamer amsterdam
description:
It's a nice private Room situated in the North of Amsterdam suitable for 8 people. It's on the First floor . Easily reachable with public transport. (around 15 minutes with the Bus to reach the centre.)
It's in a nice neighbourhood, with a Shops Super market nearby.
It has a few restaurants and Coffee shops nearby too.
It's a one Private room with 8 single Bed.
It has a shearing bathroom with a spacious shower and a toilet.
It's got Center heating for nice and warm.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Local Living in Amsterdam-West
description:
A bright family home in De Baarsjes, set in a classic building with beautiful three meter high ceilings.

There is a king size bedroom, an optional baby or toddler room, a recently renovated bathroom, and a fully equipped kitchen with Quooker.

The area is vibrant, local and lively.

You may occasionally hear the city outside, as it is a historic home, though we have double glazing. we have cats, who will not be present during stays and the apartment is professionally cleaned before each visit.

name: Stylish Hideaway for Two — Amsterdam West
description:
Escape the tourist crowds without leaving the city behind. This carefully curated one-bedroom apartment in Amsterdam West is perfect for couples who appreciate good taste and a slower pace while still being ten minutes from the center.

Step inside and you'll feel it right away: warm walnut tones, original art on the walls and a coffee machine for your morning ritual. This is our home and you'll feel the love we have put into it.

name: Het GroeneHuys-Amsterdam
description: Be in the bustling center of Amsterdam in a short time and then completely relax at B&B Het Groene Huys-Amsterdam. This cozy B&B is located on the river Gaasp, in the middle of the greenery and surrounded by meadows and animals. Enjoy comfort, privacy and a warm home feeling. Dock your boat at the jetty, take a refreshing dip in the river and start the day with a fresh breakfast. The perfect balance between nature, tranquility and city.

name: Romantic Lakeside Home with Private Sauna & Garden
description: Unique waterfront home in a quiet part of Amsterdam Noord, just 15 minutes by bike from the city center, yet feeling fully immersed in nature. Light and comfortable, with a fireplace, freestanding bath, and luxury kitchen with electric AGA. Outside, enjoy a 200 m² private garden by the water with fire pit, BBQ, and private sauna. Free parking included. Guusje, our friendly cat, adds a warm home feeling (not suitable for cat allergies).

name: Big Apartment City Center (Jordaan/Westerpark)
description: Stay in a comfortable and cozy house in the heart of Amsterdam.

name: Luxe studio in rustige wijk van Amsterdam
description:
Complete private floor of 35m2 on the top floor with private facilities: terrace, kitchen, bathroom and bedroom/living room. The floor is part of a large family home of an older Dutch couple. And fits two people comfortably.

Very luxurious with separate underfloor heating, air conditioning, TV and WiFi. Quiet neighborhood and yet in 20 minutes in Amsterdam-Centrum.

Express tram connection and shopping facilities at the door. Parking is available under the house (extra).

name: Luxe residentie in Museumkwartier
description: This centrally located apartment is tastefully decorated and offers all the comfort for an unforgettable stay in the heart of the Museum Quarter. A stone's throw from the Concertgebouw, Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh museum, PC Hooftstraat, star restaurants, the Vondelpark and the Spiegelgracht. The high-end apartment features a spacious living room with fireplace and French doors to the balcony, bathroom with bath and two comfortable bedrooms, one with electric king-size bed.

name: 3 bedroom city apartment with garden
description: Spacious and modern family apartment in the cozy Bos en Lommer. Located on the ground floor and spread over two floors, with 3 bedrooms and plenty of living space. Enjoy the sunny garden on the southwest. Ideal for families: child-friendly, safe neighborhood with parks, cafes and playgrounds around the corner. By bike or public transport, you can reach the city center of Amsterdam in 10 minutes. Comfort, tranquility and city within reach.

name: Light corner apartment, 5-min walk to Vondelpark
description:
Bright and stylish corner apartment in Amsterdam Zuid, just a 5-minute walk from Vondelpark. Filled with natural light, this apartment was recently renovated to a high standard and features a modern interior, underfloor heating, fast Wi-Fi, a designer kitchen and a spacious bedroom.

Located in Amsterdam Zuid, a pleasant and safe neighborhood with great cafés, restaurants and shops nearby. Tram 2 stops close to the apartment and takes you directly to Museumplein and the city centre.

name: Bright Amsterdam stay with private backyard
description:
Enjoy a bright, fully renovated Amsterdam apartment with a rare private garden and BBQ, ideal for families, couples, or friends who want extra space and a comfortable home base. After a day in the city, relax outdoors in the sunny backyard or unwind in the living room with a 70” TV and soundbar. The apartment also offers a fully equipped kitchen, dedicated workspace, and a bathtub for a more comfortable stay.

Located in Rivierenbuurt, with easy tram/bike access to the city center in 15 minutes.

name: Central Nieuwmarkt Luxury Apartment
description: Experience Amsterdam from the heart of the historic Nieuwmarkt district in this elegant, fully renovated 2-bedroom apartment. With high-end finishes, open-plan kitchen, underfloor heating and quick access to transport. This space is perfect for couples, business travelers and small groups exploring the city’s vibrant culture.

name: Ruim appartement in rustige buurt
description: This lovely spacious apartment is perfect for 2 to 4 people. It has two bedrooms: one with a very spacious double bed, and one with a comfortable pull-out bed. The apartment has a roof terrace, balcony and garden for the summer.

name: Warrior house
description: The place is centrally located close to Artis, Central Station, Brewery 't Ij, the accommodation is tastefully decorated and has a garden. It is in the center but is a quiet neighborhood to unwind from the hustle and bustle of the city and with 3 min walk you are right in the middle again!

name: Maison familiale au calme, avec jardin sur parc
description:
Welcome to this bright and warm family home, located in a very quiet pedestrian area, ideal for families, couples or travelers looking for greenery and tranquility.

The house has a private northwest-facing garden that overlooks the central park of Gaasperdam. Just behind the house, a wooded lawn offers a feeling of nature, silence and rare privacy, while remaining close to all amenities.

name: Cozy Studio Central Location
description:
This is a luxurious canal studio, located right in the middle of Amsterdam Jordaan.

- 1 minute walking distance to the Jordaan / Amsterdam Canals
- 5 minutes walking distance to the Anne Frank house
- 10 minutes walking distance to Dam Square
- 12 minutes walking distance to the Vondelpark
- 15 minutes walking distance to Central Station
- 15 minutes walking distance to Museum District
- 15 minute walking distance to Heineken Brewery
- 15 minutes walking distance to Amsterdam de Pijp

name: Bright Apartment & south facing balcony in De Pijp
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located apartment in the hip neighbourhood of De Pijp.  Bright and airy apartment on iconic Rustenbergerstraat, featuring a spacious dining area with large doors opening out onto south-facing terrace (morning-to-evening sun). Open kitchen — perfect for relaxed dining and work-friendly stays.

name: Cozy room near Museumplein
description:
Room in De Pijp – Perfect for Couples | Central Location

Private room available in De Pijp, one of the most vibrant and central neighborhoods of the city. Ideal for couples looking for a comfortable stay close to everything.

The apartment is very well located, with metro, tram, and bus stops just a few minutes away, making it easy to explore the entire city. You’ll also find many cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, and local markets within walking distance.

name: Ruim appartement in Amsterdam dichtbij centrum
description: This apartment is a perfect base for a weekend or vacation in Amsterdam. Luxury apartment with all the comforts. It is located in a cozy, quiet neighborhood. Excellent connection by public transportation, with a bus and tram stop right outside the door. In principle for 2 people, but possible for 3 or 4 people upon request.

name: Comfortable guestroom with own bathroom
description:
Before booking, please note: this accommodation is only suitable for quiet, non-smoking guests. No loud behavior, smoking, drugs (including marijuana), or unregistered visitors. Violation will result in immediate cancellation without refund and a €250 penalty.

If you are looking for a calm and comfortable stay in a residential area of Amsterdam, this is a good fit. It is a private guestroom in a house, with only the hallway shared. The metro is nearby, and the ride to the city center is 20 min.

name: The Little Loft
description:
A beautiful, bright and private loft apartment situated just a stone's throw from the cultural hotspot NDSM Wharf.

Located on the first floor with a view to the water, the apartment has a luxurious and spacious feel. It has an en suite bathroom, a beautiful fully equipped kitchen and a comfortable outdoor terrace.

The location is well connected to all parts of the city, either by bus, boat or by bike.

name: Cozy room in ground floor apartment.
description:
A cozy room located in the heart of Amsterdam-West, ten to fifteen minutes away from the city center by public transport. Apartment is located on the ground floor.

The neighborhood is great, with all sorts of places to grab a bite or a drink only a minute's walk away from the apartment. There are two supermarkets nearby, and at the end of the street there is a lovely park to enjoy as well.

This room is available to three people. There will be an additional charge for every extra guest.

name: Sun filled Amsterdam home by Erasmus Park
description: Our bright, fully renovated home is designed for comfort and calm, with natural light in every room and a cozy, plant filled atmosphere. Enjoy air conditioning, balcony, and soon a rooftop. Located in quiet Amsterdam West near a canal and Erasmus Park, you are close to cafés, shops, and transport yet away from the crowds. Ideal for couples or travelers seeking a peaceful stay with easy access to the city.

name: Magnifique Appartement idéalement situé
description:
Welcome to this bright apartment, located close to the Jordaan district, the central train station and Westerpark.

Perfect for a couple, it offers a large bedroom, a spacious living room, a modern kitchen and a bright bathroom.

In a quiet neighborhood, it is a stone's throw from the entertainment of Jordaan, with its bars, restaurants and shops. Enjoy the front balcony and the back terrace for a perfect stay in Amsterdam.

name: appartement 30 m² gratis parkeren / Schiphol
description:
You arrive at your accommodation where you can park your car for free in front of the door and your bed is made and the towels are ready. The rooms consist of a living room/kitchen/bedroom and bathroom (private). The accommodation is centrally located at the park where you can enjoy hiking/picnicking and swimming.
Amsterdam city center: Tram 20 min / Bike 10 min
RAI metro 15 min.
Schiphol car 10 min / 15 min train

We use a key lockbox. I will share the code with you before you arrive.

name: Stylish & cozy apt. in trendy Staatsliedenbuurt
description:
Stylish 41m² apartment in lively Staatsliedenbuurt on the third floor. Warm, cosy interior with natural tones and lots of light. Newly renovated, hotel-style bathroom with walk-in shower. Kitchen is older but fully functional. Amazing location near plenty of cafés, restaurants, Westerpark (<500m) and easy access to the Jordaan and city center. Perfect for couples or solo travelers.

Street parking available at lower rate (~€2 per hour) and free parking at 15 min walk.

name: Luxe appartement in de Pijp (dichtbij de RAI)
description:
Welcome to our newly renovated, luxurious and spacious home spread over 2 floors located in the heart of the city ‘De Pijp’ - most popular area full of vibrant restaurants and pubs.

The appartement is literally a 10 seconds walk to the subway and 4 min away from the RAI.

We have a fully equipped spacious kitchen and living room downstairs and the bedroom, bathroom, seperate toilet and laundryarea are upstairs.

Airconditioning, wasmachine, dryer, dishwasher available.

name: Appartement in Amsterdam-Zuid (Rivierenbuurt)
description:
Welcome to this bright apartment in Amsterdam South (Rivierenbuurt). The apartment is on the second floor and has daylight on both sides.

Within a 2-minute walk you will be in De Pijp, with plenty of cafes, restaurants and shops. The tram stop is also 2 minutes away, allowing you to quickly reach the city center or the Museum Quarter.

name: Sphinx Hotel Triple Room

Within walking distance you’ll find great cafés, restaurants, local markets, Artis Zoo and the beautiful Oosterpark. The city center is easily reachable by foot, bike or public transport within minutes.

Great cafés and restaurants are just around the corner.

Wake up to serene canal views, unwind in a cozy living area, and make use of the convenient washer/dryer. A unique and peaceful retreat just minutes from the city’s vibrant cafés and culture.
