This charming guesthouse for up to 4 people was lovingly paneled by Peter himself and exudes warmth, character, and authenticity. With two bedrooms, a wheelhouse, a tea house, and views of Durgerdam and Lake Markermeer, you will stay in a unique location on the water here. When the weather is nice, you can swim directly from the boat. Perfect for guests who love peace, views, and a special stay.

name: Spacious and cosy home in Amsterdam-Centrum/East
description: I rent out my lovely apartment located in the Center/East. The apartment (second floor) is entirely for your use and equipped with every comfort: dishwasher, washing machine, dryer, 2 toilets, bathtub, and shower. Cozily furnished and with a nice, large balcony.  The area is lively; you are right in the city here, with nice restaurants/cafés, parks, and sports facilities just around the corner. The trams stop right outside the door, and the train to Amsterdam Centraal Station (takes 5 minutes) is a 5-minute walk away.

name: Unique houseboat experience near Central Station
description: Stay in a stylish split-level private apartment aboard a beautiful houseboat in the heart of Amsterdam. Tucked away in a charming, quiet harbor just a short walk from Central Station, this unique stay blends peaceful water views with the city’s vibrant energy. Enjoy the magic of living on the water while exploring canals, cafés and culture. Ideal for travelers seeking a memorable, one-of-a-kind Amsterdam experience.

name: Heerlijk zonnig appartement in Amsterdam Zuid
description:
Welcome to our lovely apartment in Amsterdam Zuid, a quiet, stylish place where you will feel at home right away, yet you are right in the middle of the city.
The apartment is within walking distance of the Olympic Stadium and the Zuidas, so you have both the tranquility of the neighborhood and the vibrancy of the city at your fingertips.
The apartment is brightly and modernly furnished and equipped with every comfort. Perfect for a weekend getaway, a city trip, or a longer stay.

name: Gezellig appartement in Amsterdam-Oost
description:
Cozy apartment with a balcony and a view over the water.

Experience a bright, stylish apartment in Amsterdam-Oost. You will stay on a quiet residential street overlooking a beautiful quay. Stroll along the quay or the Amstel, or explore the popular Pijp district with its cafés, restaurants, and shops. The ideal place to relax and discover the city.


House rules:
- No smoking
- No parties.
- No pets
- Up to 2 guests
- Treat the property with care. This is a beloved home.

name: Cozy Apartment with Sunny Balcony in Westerpark
description:
Cozy one-bedroom apartment on a quiet street, right next to Westerpark and within walking distance of the Jordaan, one of Amsterdam’s most charming areas.

Small but well designed, with plenty of natural light.

Includes a comfortable living area, dining table, fully equipped kitchen, bedroom, and modern bathroom. The balcony is perfect for morning coffee or relaxing after a day in the city.

Ideal for a solo traveler or a couple.

name: Eenpersoonskamer - Amsterdam Lake Hotel
description: Located on Amsterdam Lake across from Amsterdam Forest, you can experience modern luxury and comfort for your trip to the Dutch capital. Offering an exclusive panoramic view over Amsterdam Lake the hotel is perfectly situated between the City of Amsterdam (15 min) and Schiphol Airport (10 min).

name: Stylish apartment in De Baarsjes
description:
Welcome to my peaceful home in Amsterdam’s Baarsjes neighborhood. This 72m² ground-floor apartment combines comfort with a rare feature in the city: a private 20m² garden with plenty of sun. It’s an ideal setting for couples looking to enjoy both the energy of Amsterdam and a calm place to unwind.

The city centre is only 15 min away by bike/public transport.

name: The Keizersgracht Cottage
description: Unique garden house in the heart of Amsterdam, hidden behind a historic canal house on the Keizersgracht. This stylish cottage is a quiet and charming retreat in the city center. Thoughtfully designed with character, art, and warm details, it feels like a small fairytale home. Enjoy the peaceful private garden while staying steps away from Amsterdam’s canals, museums, cafés, and culture.

name: Spacious apartment in the middle of the city
description: Unwind in this unique, peaceful accommodation after walking through the bustling center of Amsterdam.

name: A Shiny and comfort private room near Metro/Train
description: Comfortable stay and relax in this calm and stylish space in Amsterdam! One single bed (80*190cm), table and build-in closet in a private bedroom (10M2 on 2nd floor)in 3-floor house, it's bright with a big window. Bathroom/Toilet are shared. 500 meter away from metro 50/51 station,15 mins walk to nearest Lelylaan train station,Schiphol airport:25 min, City centre by tram/bike: 15-20 min. 2 supermarkets within 5 min walking, lots of restaurants (Pizzeria,Turkey’s) and lovely park, and a lot more.

name: Our Little Amsterdam Escape
description:
Enjoy a peaceful stay in this charming and well‑maintained corner house, located on a quiet courtyard. The house has a sunny private garden, lots of natural light.
In a village‑like neighborhood just outside Amsterdam, you’re close to the city center, with excellent public transport connections, and close to the Johan Cruijff Arena and Ziggo Dome.

Guests love the calm atmosphere, friendly neighbors, and the unique combination of quiet living while being minutes away from Amsterdam’s buzz.

name: Private Room in a Warm and Quiet Home
description:
A spacious double bedroom with a comfortable bed, wardrobe, and a small workspace with a natural oak desk - ideal for both rest and focus.

You’ll be staying in a three-bedroom apartment shared solely with me.

Metro Bijlmer Arena is nearby, connecting you quickly to the airport, Amsterdam Central Station, and other regions of the Netherlands.

This space is best suited for guests who appreciate a quiet, comfortable stay and treat the home with care.

name: Gezellig appartement midden in de Jordaan
description: Hi! We are renting out our lovely place in the heart of the Jordaan. Unlike many other properties in the Jordaan, the apartment is very bright because the façade is entirely made of glass, so it's truly a unique place in Amsterdam! We are located in a slightly quieter part of the bustling Jordaan district, but within a few steps, you can reach the canal ring and the Noordermarkt, for example!

name: Big central luxury canal house with sunny garden
description:
Our home is a beautiful two floor apartment located in the center of Amsterdam. Close to everything but just out of the busy tourist area.

We live here with our two young daughters, so the house is fully equipped for a family to stay.

We have a beautiful newly renovated garden that extends the living room on sunny days.

The kitchen is fully equipped and there is a washing machine and dryer available.

name: Benedenwoning met tuin nabij Westerpark
description:
Stylish ground-floor apartment near Westerpark, ideal for 2 people. Features a spacious bedroom with a luxurious en-suite bathroom, a fully equipped kitchen, and a bar that is also perfect as a workspace.

Enjoy the peaceful garden and dine comfortably at the table or at the bar. Located in a lively neighborhood with cafes, restaurants, and cultural attractions, and within a short cycling distance from the city center.

The perfect blend of tranquility, comfort, and urban energy.

name: Appartement Amsterdam, De Baarsjes
description:
Bright & stylish apartment in De Baarsjes – perfect for 2 people

Enjoy a bright and spacious apartment in the popular De Baarsjes area (Amsterdam West). This modern one-bedroom apartment is ideal for couples, friends, or family. Situated in a quiet neighborhood, with cozy cafés, restaurants, and shops just around the corner. Easily accessible by public transport and in the city center within a short time. The perfect base for exploring Amsterdam.

name: Waterfront Villa w. terrace, private gym & parking
description: Peaceful waterfront living just 12 minutes from Amsterdam city centre. This stylish 167m2 family home located at a car-free dock on Steigereiland offers space, privacy and rare outdoor luxury: direct swimming access, a large terrace, private parking, and a private gym. Ideal for families or a group of friends seeking a calm, upscale Amsterdam stay.

name: Knusse en gezellige privéstudio in het centrum
description: Personal service is our top priority: we make sure your stay runs smoothly and hassle-free from start to finish. This charming studio is located in an authentic canal house, right in the heart of Amsterdam, within walking distance of the bustling Leidseplein. Enjoy a private bathroom, free use of the washing machine and dryer, a smart TV with Netflix, Disney, and Prime, and a soundbar. Surrounded by restaurants, bars, cafes, and plenty of shopping options. Always available for tips and help.

name: Lux House on Water/ Spa & Canal Terrace | De Pijp
description:
Experience Amsterdam’s most memorable stays - a newly renovated luxury private houseboat in vibrant De Pijp. Mixing waterfront charm, modern design, wellness, and tranquility, this unique home offers an experience few visitors have.
Enjoy morning coffee on your canal terrace, explore the city by day, then return to unwind in your infrared sauna or massage chair.
Two spacious bedrooms, an extra sofa bed, WiFi, W/D, 3 AC's - ideal for couples, families, friends, seeking something truly special.

name: Stylish apartment with park view Amsterdam West
description: Welcome to our beautifully fully renovated apartment in vibrant Amsterdam West! This bright and modern 60m² apartment is located on the second floor and offers everything you need for a comfortable and relaxing stay.

name: Beautiful apartment in the heart of the Jordaan
description: Stylish 2-bedroom apartment in the heart of the Jordaan, full of character with exposed brick walls, wooden beams, dark wood floors, and a warm, elegant interior. Features a spacious designer kitchen with large dining area, cozy living room, and bathroom with tub. Enjoy two outdoor spaces: a large sunny terrace by the kitchen and a rooftop terrace with open views. A perfect base for exploring Amsterdam’s canals, cafés, boutiques, and local markets.

name: Amsterdam RAI
description: Stay in our comfortable B&B room on the ground floor overlooking a park, with its own entrance for maximum privacy. The room has two separate beds, a modern private bathroom, and a kitchenette with a refrigerator and microwave, ideal for breakfast or a light meal. Located a 5-minute walk from the RAI, 10 minutes from the train station with a direct train to Schiphol, and by metro you can reach the center of Amsterdam in 6 minutes.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Bright artist’s loft - central, views & rooftop
description:
The flat is on Bosboom Toussaintstraat, widely considered Amsterdam’s most beautiful street. Calm and village-like, yet central, with the Vondelpark, Jordaan, Museum quarter and theater district all walkable.

4th-floor duplex with private rooftop terrace, high ceilings, exposed beams, herringbone floors, and great light. Quooker, wine fridge, induction hob, floor heating and A/C.

Bedroom faces a quiet interior garden, no street noise, great sleep. No elevator.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

name: Stijlvolle woning in authentiek Amsterdam (180m2)
description:
Welcome to a unique and charming home in the Baarsjes! This stylish and very spacious home combines character with modern comfort. Located in a lively but laid-back neighborhood. Enjoy the bright interior, cozy décor, and all amenities within easy reach! Also ideal for families: it offers plenty of space in a pleasant environment.

Perfect for those who want to experience Amsterdam like a local, with cafés, shops, and public transportation within walking distance. A place where you feel right at home!

name: Sunny Apartment close to Vondelpark & City Center
description: Live as a local in the beautiful Amsterdam Oud- Zuid - one of the most desired places to live. A location where everything - Museums, de Pijp, the Canals & Vondelpark - can be easily reached by foot. Located in a quiet street with 2 large bedrooms, a bathroom, separate toilet, walk-in closet and large balkony with afternoon & evening sun, our apartment serves as the perfect home base for your trip to Amsterdam.

name: Charming studio in the heart of Amsterdam
description:
This studio offers the perfect mix of central location and comfort in Amsterdam. All major highlights are within walking or biking distance, making it an ideal base to explore the city.

Fully equipped with all modern amenities, including a comfortable 180 cm bed and a bright living space with French doors. The apartment is located on the ground floor and situated in a quiet street, perfect for relaxing after a day in the city.

name: Stijlvol & ruim appartement in Amsterdam West
description:
Welcome to our spacious and modernly furnished 86 m² (925 sq. ft.) apartment in the popular Amsterdam West area. Located on the second floor in a quiet neighborhood right next to the Erasmus Park, this is the perfect place to explore the city and to relax and unwind.

The spacious open-plan living area is the heart of the apartment, featuring a large dining table that is perfect for both dining and working remotely. Thanks to the high-speed Wi-Fi and the abundant natural light, this is also an ideal place for remote work.

name: Sunny bedroom in public traffic friendly location
description: Sunny, south-facing 15 m² room in a safe, quiet area next to Wibautstraat metro and Oosterpark. Good soundproofing, ideal for sleep. Fully furnished with double boxspring bed and all utilities + fast WiFi included. Shared clean apartment with 1 work professional and 2 possible short-term- stay guests . 5 Min walk to metro station, Direct metro/tram to Central Station, Dam Square, museums and main sights in 5 minutes

name: Vrijstaand familiehuis in Amsterdam
description: This is a beautiful detached house with a south-facing garden for a wonderful family vacation in a trendy and green part of the city, close to the city center! Comfort for your family and everything you need within reach! It is a 6-minute walk to the metro (Noorderpark/Gare du Nord stop), which takes you directly to the historic city center. Or a 10-minute bike ride to the (free) ferry, which also takes you to the city center. The house is only available for rent to families. Cleaning fee not included.

name: Amsterdam-Zuid Family Apartment with Garden
description:
At a beautiful location in Amsterdam Zuid, you can find our beloved family home. The area and the house is family friendly and is close to the Beethovenstraat, Cornelis Schuytstraat, Vondelpark, Beatrixpark and Museum district.

The house contains 3 different floors; souterrain, ground floor and 1st floor. The apartment feels spacious with an authentic, warm and stylish interior.

name: Vondelpark appartment
description: Modern and stylish apartment for 4 people in the heart of Amsterdam Oud-West. Located on the popular Eerste Helmersstraat, surrounded by trendy cafes, restaurants and boutiques. The Vondelpark, the canals and famous museums are only a few minutes' walk away. The perfect base for exploring Amsterdam.

name: Cozy Private canalviewRetreat in Heart of the City
description: Cozy canal side very central and fully equipped, non smoking. apartment with 2 bedrooms and a sleeping sofa in the living room. Located in the middle of the centre by one of the famous canals. Ideal for short stays, offering a quiet, cozy space to relax after exploring the city, with modern amenities and characteristic to Amsterdam.

name: Historical dikehouse with garden near city centre
description:
Spacious, charming home on the beloved Nieuwendammerdijk in Amsterdam North! The Amsterdam tourists do not get to see. Here you can enjoy authentic details combined with modern comfort, quit and green and one metri stop from central station
The house has three floors and us very spacious.

Outside, there’s a sunny garden where you can relax, and next door is a large playground. Just a few minutes’ walk away, you’ll find the city forest area, home to many trendy restaurants, a cinema and bars.

name: Museumplein | 2 Private Rooms+Kitchen | 2–4 Guests
description:
Calm comfortable stay near Museumplein in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid, ideal for women, couples and families with children.

Compact, clean guest rooms in a shared home. There are 2 rooms: one with an extra-long (210 cm) adjustable electric boxspring double bed, and one with a bunk bed. Shared bathroom (shower, bathtub, double sink), separate toilet and shared kitchen.

Walking distance to Museumplein, Vondelpark, museums and public transport. Ideal for guests looking for a calm, safe & comfortable stay.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

name: Cosy Canal Apartment
description:
Bright Canal-Side Apartment – Central Amsterdam

South-facing one-bedroom apartment on the first floor overlooking a canal, Large windows provide strong natural light throughout the day.

Located within a 5-minute walk of the main canals, De Negen Straatjes, and the Anne Frank House. Public transport (tram) is one block away.

name: Spacious Studio with your own kitchen & bathroom
description:
Newly Renovated interiors. 

If you have any questions, please feel free to send us a message.

Early luggage drop off & luggage storage after check out possible.

name: Cozy & bright stay in vibrant Amsterdam Oud-West
description: Cozy and stylish apartment in Amsterdam West, perfect for a couple exploring the city. Featuring a separate bedroom, bright living room, fully equipped kitchen, and modern bathroom for comfort and privacy. Located in a vibrant neighborhood with great cafés, restaurants, and easy access to the city center. The perfect base for your Amsterdam getaway.

name: A quiet loft in the heart of Amsterdam.
description: A quiet unique, tiny loft in the heart of Amsterdam, between the Zeeheldenbuurt and Prinseneiland, near Haarlemmerplein and Westerpark. Newly renovated and designed by a graphic artist, with Japanese and Asian influences: minimal, warm and refined. A calm, curated space for those who appreciate art, detail and stillness — and treat the space with care and respect. Not a standard stay, but an experience.

name: Kleurrijk city appartement
description: Enjoy a stylish and colourful experience at this centrally-located place.

name: Spacious Family Home with 2 gardens near hotspots
description:
A sunny family home with 2 gardens and 3 bedrooms.

AREA:
- 15 min. from city center
- 15 min. from hotspot Jordaan
- 5 min. from ferry by bike
- 5 min. from NDSM / 10 min. by foot
- 5 min. from a local swimming spot
- 15 minutes from Twiske (nature & swimming hotspot)

Located in the North of Amsterdam, which is the upcoming curtural neighborhood of Amsterdam, here you find the best bars and restaurants often located in transformed old fabrics, and still very close to the city center.

name: Peaceful home in the lively North
description: Welcome! The house is suitable for a couple, possibly with a baby and/or an older child. Since the house is not yet childproof, it is unfortunately not suitable for young children. The house was completely renovated in 2023 with much love and attention. The unity of warm colors, natural materials, and luxurious appearance ensure that this house gives us a great sense of peace. The house offers three bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and a fantastic bathroom with a walk-in shower and bathtub.

name: Watervilla Inspire
description: This Amsterdam watervilla is truly unique, featuring a private walled garden, multiple terraces, two bathrooms, a spacious living area, stylish interior, and private parking spaces. Jump straight from the floating terrace into the Amstel or enjoy fishing. Conveniently located just 5 minutes walk from Overamstel Metro Station and a 15-minute bike ride from the city centre of Amsterdam. Perfect for families, as we live here ourselves with our two children.

name: Tuinkamer Noord
description: Lovely quiet spot on the water in Amsterdam Noord. Independent Tiny House, fully furnished with shared garden/terrace. Great base for visiting all the amenities in Amsterdam and the rural nature north of the city.

name: Helmersbuurt - Wilhelminastraat
description: Beautifully located apartment in the Helmersbuurt area of Amsterdam. Modern and comfortable 51-m² (549-ft²) apartment with a separate bedroom. Enjoy a bright living room, a nice kitchen, and a peaceful setting. Ideal for couples or solo travelers looking to explore Amsterdam, with hotspots, restaurants, and public transportation nearby.

name: Row house in floradorp
description: A gezellig family home in a beautiful historical neighbourhood in amsterdam noord

name: Charming 1BR near Westerpark & Jordaan
description: Experience "gezellig" in this stylish 1BR sanctuary. Relax on the mustard corduroy sofa or enjoy coffee on your private balcony overlooking the bike-filled streets of Staatsliedenbuurt. With reclaimed wood, bold colors, and floor-to-ceiling light, this 35sqm nest feels like a true home. Just 3 mins to the culture of Westerpark and a 10-min stroll to the Jordaan canals. A perfect, quiet base for those who want authentic Amsterdam experience.

name: Recently renovated, easy acces to city center
description:
Enjoy a bright and stylish stay for two in the peaceful Rivierenbuurt neighborhood. Start your day with coffee on the sunny balcony, relax in the cozy living room, and cook in the modern kitchen. The perfect balance between tranquility and city life: cozy cafés around the corner and the city center within easy reach. A comfortable, relaxed base for exploring Amsterdam.
Also within walking distance of the RAI (convention center).

name: Villa with garden, 15 min from historical centre
description: Stay in a peaceful, family-friendly part of Amsterdam Noord, where space, greenery and city access come together. Our home is a great base for families who want to enjoy Amsterdam without staying in the busy centre. NDSM, the ferry to the historic city centre and the lakes and walking trails of ’t Twiske are all close by. Shops and daily amenities are within walking distance, and the area feels calm, safe and residential.

name: NEW: 4BR Luxury City House + Garden @ Museum area
description:
Experience refined living in this elegant four-bedroom residence just moments from Amsterdam’s Museum District.

Designed for comfort and style, the home features a bright, spacious living and dining area, a fully equipped kitchen, and two beautifully appointed bathrooms, including a serene ensuite in the master bedroom.

Step outside to a private garden—perfect for quiet mornings or evening gatherings—offering a rare sense of tranquility in the heart of the city.

name: Luxury A'dam Oasis, Walking Distance City Centre
description: Our apartment is set on a peaceful, charming street just moments from the city’s vibrant heart. With serene water views, it offers the perfect retreat to unwind after a day exploring Amsterdam. All major sights are within easy walking distance, while the tram just around the corner makes getting around the rest of the city effortless. Thoughtfully designed and fully equipped, the apartment has everything you need for a comfortable and stylish stay.

name: Luxe woonboot in Amsterdam
description: The freedom and charm of living on the water, with the luxury of a residential home. That's our houseboat! As a family, we enjoy our beautiful home all year round, but we would like to share this experience. Located in a quiet residential area, but close enough to the city center (15 minutes by tram). On the terrace, enjoy the setting sun and the view of other houseboats. Swim among the waterfowl. The house is completely kid-proof, so it is definitely ideal for families. Toys and cots are available!

name: Iconic Luxurious Canal House in Famous Canal Area
description: Experience ultimate luxury in the heart of Amsterdam in an exclusive duplex apartment located in an 18th-century canal house, offering breathtaking views over the iconic canal district. Recently completed and designed by The Collective Studio, featuring high ceilings, spacious rooms, and a sophisticated, custom interior. Enjoy a marble designer kitchen, luxurious en-suite bathrooms, and a serene private patio—the perfect blend of history, design, comfort, and exclusive privacy.

name: Charming Cozy 1920s House in Amsterdam East
description: Welcome to this charming and cozy 1920s house in the peaceful and authentic neighborhood of Betondorp, Amsterdam East. Enjoy a quiet residential area with a village-like feel, while staying close to the vibrant city center. Perfect for couples, solo travelers, digital nomads, or small families. Easy access to Oosterpark, Dappermarkt, Artis Zoo, and Amsterdam East by bike or public transport. Relax in a warm, cozy atmosphere surrounded by greenery and local cafés.

name: Appartement Amsterdam-West
description:
Enjoy a tastefully furnished apartment in a prime location in Amsterdam-West. The bright living area, modern kitchen, and comfortable bedroom ensure a relaxing stay with all the comforts of home.
Within walking distance, you will find hotspots such as De Hallen Amsterdam, the Foodhallen, and the green Vondelpark. Perfect for anyone looking to explore the city and stay in comfort.

name: Cosy house in Amsterdam North
description:
Step into a one-of-a-kind Dutch character home full of warmth, art and story
This beautifully eclectic home in a quiet Dutch canal-side neighbourhood is unlike anything you’ll find on Airbnb. Built in 1910, the house retains all its original charm

name: Modern gerenoveerd appartement
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

The tram and the Albert Heijn (supermarket) are within walking distance.
Central Station and the city center are 15 minutes away by bike.

The laundromat is around the corner. For €10, you can have your laundry washed and dried as well.

name: Cozy Canal Home | Ideal for Families & Friends (6)
description:
- Spacious 3-bedroom duplex on iconic Rembrandtplein
- Sleeps 6 with 2 double beds + two-person bunk bed
- Bright living area & full kitchen with dining for 6
- Ideal for families, friends & work trips
- Enjoy central Amsterdam with low-season rates, canal view!

name: 13 min from central station apartment
description: Take a break and unwind at this peaceful oasis. Located in a very cozy area only 3 min walking from restaurants coffeshops and pubs . The apartment is located at 4th floor steep ditch stairs

name: Design apartment with roof terrace in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our home — a place we truly love and are happy to share with you.
Our home is bright and spacious, with high wooden ceilings and lots of character and a fireplace. There are 2 bedrooms with queensize beds and a bath and a separate shower.
One of our favourite parts of the house is the rooftop space. It has an open kitchen with a bar and big doors that open onto 2 roof terraces with amazing views. It’s perfect for enjoying a morning coffee or having a drink as the sun goes down.

name: Wooden Mill: Mill 2 - near Vondel Park Amsterdam
description: B&B Wooden Mill is in a residential area of Amsterdam, officially called as Amsterdam 'Oud Zuid' (meaning: oldest quarter build in southern direction). This area is from the beginning of the 20th century and exists of beautiful streets and houses, characteristic for that time.

name: Charming & Cozy Apartment in Erasmuspark
description:
Enjoy a bright and cozy stay in Amsterdam West! Located just 2 blocks from the green Erasmus Park and 3 blocks from the Bos en Lommer shopping hub, this 1-bedroom retreat sleeps up to 3 guests. It features a fully equipped kitchen, a full bathroom, and tons of natural light. With trams, buses, and the metro just steps away, you can reach the city center in minutes. The perfect blend of local tranquility and urban convenience.
Your ideal home base in central Amsterdam!

name: Modern en charmant appartement in Amsterdam-Oost
description: This apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, two balconies, high-speed Wi-Fi, and an amazing sofa where you can relax. The Indische Buurt offers many different possibilities. Within walking distance, you will find a wide selection of cafés, restaurants, coffee shops, stores, and supermarkets. The apartment is a 5-minute walk from Oosterpark, Flevopark, and Muiderpoort train station. In addition, you can be in the city center, on Dam Square, within 10 minutes by tram. Suitable for couples.

name: Bright Modern Apt w/ Balcony near Vondelpark
description:
Welcome to one of Amsterdam’s most desirable neighborhoods. Bright and spacious one-bedroom apartment on the 4th floor (with elevator) offers comfort, style, and an unbeatable location in Oud-West.

Clean and modern design, features a generous living space filled with natural light, a fully equipped kitchen, and a comfortable bedroom ideal for relaxing after a day exploring the city.

Step out onto your private south facing and sunny balcony — perfect for morning coffee or an evening drink.

name: Modern Appartement naast het Rembrandt Park
description: A recently completely renovated and spacious home, where simplicity, comfort and Scandinavian atmosphere come together. The home is thoughtfully decorated and exudes peace, light and quality: the perfect place to work remotely or discover the city with your family!

name: Charming appartment in Amsterdam South
description:
Welcome to our apartment in the Rivierenbuurt! It’s next to De Pijp, Amsterdam Oud-Zuid, and the metro to the city centre. Both Amsterdam Amstel Station and Amsterdam Zuid Station are also easily accessible (15 minutes on foot or just one metro stop away).

The neighbourhood and street are quiet, giving you a peaceful place to retreat after experiencing the lively and sometimes chaotic side of Amsterdam.

We still enjoy living here every day, and we hope you will enjoy too!

Best,
Eline & Tim

name: Hotel room with twin or double bed + free parking
description: Located on Amsterdam Lake across from Amsterdam Forest, you can experience modern luxury and comfort for your trip to the Dutch capital. Offering an exclusive panoramic view over Amsterdam Lake the hotel is perfectly situated between the City of Amsterdam and Schiphol Airport.

name: Exceptional townhouse directly at the Vondelpark
description: A fully renovated classical Amsterdam townhouse, in a cul-de-sac with its front door a stone’s throw from the Vondelpark entrance, in the lovely ‘Old West’. This is Amsterdam at it’s finest. Featuring a master bedroom, a children’s bedroom, a nursery and a guest bed. Equipped with an indoor fireplace, luxurious bathroom with freestanding bath, fully equipped designer kitchen, private garden, underfloor heating throughout, and a dedicated workstation. We hope to welcome you to our home soon.

name: Lovely Private room with terrace
description: In the middle of Amsterdam with a stunning view.

name: Amazing 3-bedroom loft in centre of Amsterdam
description: Lovely whole apartment in the center of Amsterdam. The apartment is 150 square meters and has 3 bedrooms with large beds. There is a large living room area that can be opened up to a big kitchen / dining area.

name: Elegant sunlit apartment with balcony in Amsterdam
description:
Welcome to our warm and thoughtfully designed apartment, ideally located between the neighborhoods of De Baarsjes and the Jordaan.

This third-floor apartment features a private balcony and is set on a quiet residential street, close to several parks, cafés, restaurants and has excellent public transport to the city centre. Central Station is only 20 minutes away.

Whether you're here for a romantic getaway, a work stay, or a longer visit, this apartment offers the comfort of an Amsterdam home.

name: Stylish and Spacious 140 sqm Apartment in Oost
description:
Super big 140 sqm apartment in Oost.

Two bedrooms, 1 study room, 1 big kitchen, 1 living room, 1 dining room, 1 roof terrace and 3 balconies.

Quiet street, right next to Park Frankendael and 2 minutes walk from the city buzz with all cafes, shops and restaurants that you will need.

Very chique and beautiful building. Authentic charm, high ceilings and loads of original details. Renovated to modern standards. Make this place your home and enjoy an comforting and unique experience.

name: Spacious Waterfront Apartment in City Center
description: Fully furnished and spacious (60m²) waterfront apartment in Amsterdam, suitable for 4 adults. Bright living area with large windows, lots of natural light, and a balcony overlooking the canal. Fully equipped kitchen with all appliances, cookware, and complete cutlery. Two comfortable bedrooms with a lot of storage. Modern bathroom with shower, sink and toilet. Includes washer and dryer. Quiet yet central location near shops, cafés, parks, and major city highlights.

name: Canal View | Family & Group Stay | City Center
description:
- Spacious 3-bedroom duplex on iconic Rembrandtplein
- Sleeps 6 with 3 double beds
- Bright living area & full kitchen with dining for 6
- Ideal for families, friends & work trips

name: Ruim familiehuis met knusse buitenruimte
description:
Our spacious family home was built in 1904 and has many original details, but it is also modernly furnished and well equipped. Our patio is a quiet spot, and the Frankendael Park is a few minutes' walk away. A supermarket and bakery are also nearby.
The location is great for visiting Amsterdam and the surrounding area; a visit to the beach is also possible. Our house is easy to reach by car and public transport. Tram 19 takes you directly to Leidseplein.

name: Quiet, stylish and sunny apartment near Centre
description:
Located in Oost, on the edge of the city center, is this peaceful apartment, where sunlight streams in throughout the day and the city becomes quiet for a moment.

The space is carefully decorated with beautiful items. There is an open kitchen, a large table for long conversations and a sofa that turns into two extra sleeping places in the evening.

You are in a lively, hip neighborhood – good coffee shops, restaurants and the Oosterpark – but without the crowds. The city center is close by bike or public transport.

It's on the 5th floor without an elevator.

name: A stylish and comfortable family home with garden
description:
This modern airy home is in a tranquil location on the edge of a park in Amsterdam North. The house one of 11 other houses facing a private mews. On the ground floor there is an open plan living-dining-kitchen area, with all the mod cons and decorated with an eye for design. There is also a washroom and a utility room.
Upstairs there are two bedrooms and a spacious, stylish 4 piece bathroom. At the back the garden, perfect for summer dining, overlooks the park.

name: Vondel appartment
description: Charming renovated apartment in the heart of Amsterdam Oud-West. 59m², One bedroom, modern open kitchen, walk-in shower, bathtub & sunny balcony. Beautiful herringbone floors & tall windows for lots of natural light. Steps from Vondelpark, Leidseplein, the Jordaan & the best cafés and restaurants the city has to offer. A quiet, central base to experience Amsterdam like a local.

name: Family home
description: Excellent for families with small children who want to see Amsterdam while staying in a quiet street. The extra bedroom means you can bring the grandparents.

name: Stylish Renovated 1BR Apartment @ Vondelpark
description: Bright and modern apartment with a warm, stylish interior and high-quality finishes. Located in a lively neighborhood with great cafés, restaurants and shops just around the corner. Enjoy a comfortable stay with everything you need for a relaxed city trip, whether you’re exploring Amsterdam or unwinding after a day out. Perfect for couples or business guests.

name: Beautiful Modern Apartment in Amsterdam West
description:
Enjoy a stylish stay in our modern 80m² apartment in Amsterdam West.

Bright and beautifully designed, with a spacious bedroom featuring a desk, a luxurious rain shower, and a small private balcony.

Just a 3 minute walk to metro, tram, and bus, bringing you to the city center in around 15 minutes.

Supermarket nearby, and close to Westerpark and Erasmuspark.

One king size bed but extra guest(s) possible on the sofa or an air mattress in the living room.

Great reviews from my previous listing.

name: Gezellig appartement bij NDSM (Amsterdam-Noord)
description:
Entire apartment in Amsterdam Noord. One double bed and two twin beds that can be pushed together. There is an extra sink in one of the bedrooms. Ideal for a family or two couples!

The kitchen is fully equipped and includes a coffee maker, kettle, toaster, dishwasher, oven, air fryer, and washing machine.

The apartment is a 10-minute walk to the ferry that takes you to Amsterdam Centraal. Quiet, friendly neighborhood.

name: Studio Vincent, Amsterdam
description: Welcome to Roses of Jordan! Studio Vincent is a comfortable room with a view of the Rozengracht, in the middle of the Jordaan. From the property, you can walk to cozy cafés, shops, canals, and famous spots in the city center of Amsterdam in no time. Around the corner, you will find trams, bike rentals, taxis, Ubers, and canal boats, making it easy to explore the city.
property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.Enjoy a stylish stay in this beautifully designed ground floor apartment next to Vondelpark. Filled with natural light, the space features a warm modern interior, a fully equipped kitchen with a marble island, and a unique dining area surrounded by glass overlooking a small private garden. Quiet yet central, it’s perfect for couples, families, or longer stays.

name: Rembrandt Suite, Amsterdam

Around the corner, you will find trams, bike rentals, taxis, Ubers, and canal boats, making it easy to explore the city.

Ideal for a comfortable and centrally located stay

name: 19e-eeuws loft met dakterras en uitzicht op Amstel
description: Beautiful spacious and bright loft with balcony and rooftop terrace. Has modern perfectly outfitted kitchen, coffee machine, kitchen appliances. Also a (standing) desk workspace with two screens and high-speed wireless internet. Rooftop terrace has dining area and lounge area.

name: The Bellamy House
description:
A spacious, design-forward home at iconic Bellamyplein in vibrant Oud-West. Three bedrooms, 160m² of thoughtfully furnished living space, and a private garden.
The fully-equipped kitchen features a Quooker tap and Jura coffee machine. Unwind in front of an 82-inch screen with surround sound, or let Sonos set the mood throughout the house.
Outside, a private garden with dining area and BBQ, rare in central Amsterdam.

name: Las Beas!
description:
Welcome to our house! We would love you to experience the oasis of our water-surrounded neighborhood. Placed in a unique, central and quiet atmosphere, our house is a throw stone away from iconic restaurants and bakeries in the vibrant Amsterdam West. In just 5 min cycling you'll be in the beautiful Jordaan, or Vondelpark.
You have access to a bright living room, 1 bedroom, 1 office/guest room, 2 workspaces, fully equipped kitchen, bathtub and shower, and a sunny terrace overlooking the canal.

name: 1950s design family home. Garden & green area
description: Have fun with the whole family at this stylish home. The property exudes a 1950s atmosphere but still has all the comforts, plenty of rooms, and is close to transportation. By train, bus, or tram, you can reach the city center within 20 minutes. By bike too! Parking in front of the door, at the lowest rate in Amsterdam. Lovely garden that is directly adjacent to a quiet children's playground.

name: Tiefa's spot Registration number: Z/26/3114899
description: Bright top-floor apartment with a stunning rooftop terrace overlooking Amsterdam. Enjoy a spacious, light-filled living area, modern kitchen, and serene bedroom with open bathroom. The large terrace is perfect for relaxing or dining in the sun. Located just 250m from Vondelpark and around the corner from lively Jan Pieter Heijestraat street with great cafés and restaurants. Ideal for a stylish city stay. Registration number: Z/26/3114899

name: Designer Family Home and Sunny Garden in De Pijp
description:
Recently renovated, architecturally designed 3 bedroom 150m² home in vibrant De Pijp area, yet very quiet and peaceful inside.

A rare highlight in central Amsterdam is the large 50m² south-facing garden, perfect for breakfast in the sun, relaxing with a drink, or dining outdoors after a day exploring the city.

Just around the corner you’ll find the famous Albert Cuyp Market, Sarphatipark, and many cafés and restaurants. The canals and historic city centre are within easy walking distance.

name: Moderne, ruime woning, 15 minuten van stadscentrum
description: Enjoy peace and space in this modern family home in IJburg! By tram, you can be at Amsterdam Centraal in 15 minutes. The beach, park, shops, and restaurants are within walking distance. The property offers a fully equipped kitchen and a lovely garden with a seating area. Please note: the children's rooms are private (locked); you have full access to the master bedroom and the rest of the house. Ideal for those who want to combine city and beach in a relaxed, waterfront neighborhood.

name: Historisch schip en tuin Amsterdam
description:
A rare place to arrive, unwind, and stay a little longer.

Hidden behind a lush green hedge along a quiet path, the Vrouwe Jacoba (1895) offers a truly unique stay: a fully restored historic ship with a private garden estate, just 20 minutes from the heart of Amsterdam.

This is not just accommodation — it’s a private world on the water.

name: Heritage Home in the Museum Quarter
description:
Located in the heart of historic Amsterdam; you'll find the canals, Rijksmuseum, antique shops and the Vondelpark at our doorstep.

18century home, renovated with style and comfort. 2 floor apartment, with a bright and spacious living room, open kitchen and garden. 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom with a double shower. Toilets on each floor. Ideal for families or couples who are looking to experience Amsterdam like locals

Please be respectful to our neighbours, they are part of making this place special

name: Zonnig appartement 10 minuten van centrum
description:
Comfortable, spacious apartment with all the amenities for your perfect city break or extended stay. In our home, you have sun and light all day long. The home features a spacious, modern kitchen for true cooking enthusiasts and a separate upstairs floor for a peaceful night's sleep.

Prime location: You are within walking distance of the lively Jordaan district, Westerpark, and the city center. The ideal base for exploring Amsterdam from an oasis of peace and style!

name: Huize Ortelius A'dam
description: A wonderful and fully equipped apartment with all the comforts for your stay in Amsterdam. Right around the corner from the Rembrandtpark and Vondelpark. With the tram and bus just around the corner, you can be at Dam Square within fifteen minutes. The apartment is located on a quiet street. Parking available in front of the door on the street (for a fee).

name: Charming, cozy dykehouse, 15 mns from city center!
description:
Welcome to the Nieuwendammerdijk, a picturesque and charming dyke on the North side of Amsterdam, considered by some to be one of the most beautiful streets in Amsterdam.

Our renovated dykehouse originally built in 1912 offers a unique blend of traditional Dutch charm, nature and modern comfort, making it the perfect retreat for your stay in the vibrant city of Amsterdam.

Forget your worries in this spacious and serene space. It's close to public transport that will take you to the middle of the city in 20 minutes.

Enjoy the quiet of an Amsterdam suburb while still being a drop away from where everything is happening.

enough space for a small group of friends or a small family.

with a washer and dryer if this is a stop on a longer trip.

Supermarket, gym, and a nice place where you can play darts and pool are around the corner, public transportation is right at your doorstep, and in about 15 minutes, you can reach Centraal Station metro station by public transportation. Cafes, shops, and other amenities are within walking distance.

There are two workspaces, ideal for remote work. A personal, stylish home right in the middle of the city.

Stylish 120m² designer home in Amsterdam Noord, perfect for families or couples.

Set across 3 levels with a private sun-drenched roof terrace and BBQ. Bright open living space with 3m ceilings, Scandinavian interiors, 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Includes fast WiFi, smart home and Sonos.

Quiet, green location just minutes from the city centre.

Family apartment in lively Hoofddorppleinbuurt, perfect for exploring Amsterdam. 1 min walk to tram line 2 with direct access to city centre/main museums and attractions, 10 min walk to the Vondelpark.

Two bedrooms: master Auping double bed (180x200) and children’s room (2 beds). Bright living/dining area, fully equipped kitchen with Quooker. Playroom with toys and second TV.

Spread over 3 floors with 2 toilets, bathroom with walk-in shower and separate bath, washer/dryer, and baby gate.

Hi :)! We rent out our centrally located and cozy classical canal Amsterdam apartment, which includes two bedrooms and a garden. It is for 4p (two double beds).

In a few minutes by bike, tram or bus you are in the nicest neighborhoods such as the Jordaan and downtown. We look forward to seeing you at the check-in time. Times are in consultation and flexible.

No parties or smoking allowed.

The room features a workspace with 2 screens, plug & play USB-C connection and high-speed internet. It is right next to metro, tram and bus stops, with excellent connections. You can reach Central Station within 20 minutes and Leidseplein within 25 minutes. Nearby you will find various restaurants, cafes and shops.

description:
Bright and comfy family home looking out over canal. Spread over two floors + stunning roof terrace with 360 views. Two large double bedrooms and one single that will best suit a family or a couple. Enjoy!

Well-connected & central, on the edge of the Jordaan area, less than 5 minutes walk from lovely and lively Westerpark. 25 mins (by taxi) from Schiphol and 15 mins (bus+walk) from Centraal Station - a great base to spend a few days enjoying and exploring the city (or beyond).

name: Appartement complet ou chambre unique - Amsterdam

The apartment can accommodate up to 4 guests.
Fully equipped and thoughtfully designed, it provides everything you need for a comfortable and convenient stay. You’ll appreciate the generous space and warm atmosphere, from the moment you arrive.

The bathroom has a walk-in shower and a bathtub. Two separate toilets are available. Beautiful outdoor area. Suitable for a comfortable stay for multiple guests, with all the amenities for both short and longer stays. Modern amenities and easy access to the surrounding area. Wibautstraat metro station 3 minutes away.

Great apartment on the ground floor in the nice Oosterpark neighbourhood.

The bay windows overlook the garden, offering a peaceful green view and plenty of natural daylight.Original wooden beams with subtle floral designs add warmth and authenticity. A Delft Blue fireplace (decorative, not in use) enhances the historic atmosphere.

Stylish Top-Floor Apartment with Stunning Rooftop Terrace Views over Amsterdam

Welcome to this beautiful two-floor apartment (3rd and 4th floor), featuring a spacious rooftop terrace with breathtaking panoramic views over Amsterdam.

The apartment is stylishly yet warmly decorated, creating a cozy and comfortable home away from home, with everything you need.

The apartment is spread across two floors and offers a cozy and comfortable stay, perfect for couples.

description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

The house with garden is located close to Westerpark. There are many different restaurants and cafes nearby, and you can reach Central Station in 10 minutes.

name: Amsterdam Canal Gem
description:
Escape to a romantic hideaway in Amsterdam, ideal for couples looking for a cozy and memorable stay. This bright and stylish apartment offers everything you need for a relaxing weekend away—plus one of the most beautiful sunset views in the city.
Easy and quick connection to Schiphol airport in 20 min by public transport. Walking distance from the center, shops, restaurants, parks nearby.
Unwind in the comfortable living space and watch the sky turn golden over the canal right from your window.

name: Zonnig appartement in Amsterdam Oud-West
description:
Stay in a cozy and sunny apartment in the popular West, a stone's throw away from the Jordaan. The house combines peace and comfort with the liveliness of the city: cozy cafes and good restaurants are all within walking distance.
The apartment is completely private and suitable for two people. After a day in Amsterdam, you can relax in the comfortable living room or enjoy a coffee on the balcony. The warm and homely decor makes you feel right at home.

And all that in the perfect location, with the entire city at your feet.

* Johan Cruijff Arena

description: Welcome to our retreat in Amsterdam Oud-West. We rent out the two main levels while traveling, offering a stylish stay in a warm, light-filled space. The ground floor features a fully equipped kitchen, dining area, open living room, south-facing garden, and gas fireplace. Upstairs has a spacious master bedroom, balcony and ensuite bathroom with shower and bathtub. Steps from Vondelpark, cafés, restaurants, and boutiques. You sleep in the back, which almost makes you forget you're in the city. There is also a large desk that allows you to work.

Enjoy a bright living space, comfortable sleeping arrangements, and a kitchen that opens onto a lovely terrace. The apartment also has a second rooftop terrace, ideal for relaxing after a day in the city. Close to cafés, shops, parks, and public transport.

name: Canal House Elegance
description:
Stylish and bright apartment in a prime location in Amsterdam.

name: Gezellig appartement in de levendige wijk de Pijp.

It is a stylish apartment that is fully equipped with every comfort.

The bathroom is spacious and clean, and the location of the house is enchanting.

name: Gezellig appartement in Amsterdam Oost
description:
Nice, quiet apartment on the bustling Javaplein in the popular but as yet undiscovered neighborhood of Amsterdam-Oost, with a quiet bedroom at the back.

☀️ Enjoy the sun on the balcony in the morning and afternoon

The master bedroom has floor to ceiling windows on to the cosy garden which has a seating area. There is 1 very large bathroom with a shower, bath and washing machine.

name: Casa Jacob
description: Spacious 70 m² canal apartment in Oud-West — one of Amsterdam's best neighbourhoods. Large by Amsterdam standards, with a private balcony and a quiet canal setting. Vondelpark, the city centre, and top museums are all within walking distance, alongside great bars and restaurants. Central yet peaceful — you'll sleep well here. name: Villa Ruysch - Parkside East + garden
description:
This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit. The house is located next to the Oosterpark on one side and the Amstel River on the other. Everything is within walking distance, but there is also a tram stop right outside the door and a metro station around the corner.

Bathroom with shower and bathtub, well-equipped kitchen, lovely sofa, and a peaceful garden where you can sit and enjoy the sun. Bedroom adjoins the garden.

name: Prachtig apartement in het hart van Amsterdam

Enjoy underfloor heating and a sunny west-facing garden offering privacy and comfort. Prime location near top cafés, boutiques, and transport.

Perfectly located near Oud-West, Oud-Zuid, Leidseplein and the city centre. Minimum stay: 2 nights.

name: Licht appartement in Amsterdam (Jordaan)
description: Beautiful bright apartment in the heart of Amsterdam, located in the popular Frederik Hendrik neighborhood. Within walking distance of the Jordaan, Oud-West, and the city center. From here, you can easily explore various highlights of the city or enjoy the vibrant restaurants and bars just around the corner. Whether you want to discover the city by foot or by public transport, it’s all possible! Thus: something for everyone and definitely the perfect place to stay and discover this lovely city!

name: Lovely spacious canal house in Amsterdam
description:
Stay in our stylish canal-side apartment in the vibrant Baarsjes neighborhood, just a short walk from downtown Amsterdam. With 3 bedrooms, it is perfect for families or a couple. Relax in the spacious living room, cook in the fully equipped kitchen, and enjoy the large, sunny garden. Surrounded by great restaurants and parks, with excellent public transport connections to all the main attractions.

Toys available on request.

We live in a wonderfully spacious and bright house in a very quiet neighbourhood. The walls are extra high, so the house breathes a lot of space. All 3 bedrooms have double beds (1 king size).

The house has underfloor heating, so the temperature is always pleasant (even in winter).

We have a spacious kitchen island, a rain shower, a large dining table and a relaxing sofa with large screen television and fast WiFi throughout the house.

We have a private (free) parking in front of the house.

name: Luxury Penthouse In Heart of Amsterdam
description: This apartment has been designed with great attention to detail and feels more like a boutique hotel than a standard Airbnb. The combination of warm materials, custom furniture and subtle colors creates a peaceful and luxurious atmosphere. The living space is bright and open, with large windows that provide pleasant, natural light throughout the day. The kitchen and dining area flow seamlessly into the living room, ideal for long meals or simply enjoying a good glass of wine.

name: Lovely house in central Amsterdam
description:
A quiet street in one of Amsterdam's most loved neighbourhoods, five minutes from the canals and right next to the Jordaan.

Westerpark is a short stroll away, and the city's best museums, restaurants, and shops are within fifteen minutes on foot. Lovely coffee spots sit around the corner.

Central, calm, and close to everything.

name: Cozy Little Apartment In The Heart Of Amsterdam
description: Charming little apartment located in the very heart of Amsterdam. Super close to the Rijksmuseum and multiple popular squares. Walk along the many historic canals to enjoy the capital of the Netherlands.

name: Casa Dam | Stylish City Loft + Balcony
description: This brand-new 2024 apartment offers a fresh, modern stay in a quiet, local Amsterdam neighborhood. Designed with a clean, stylish interior and high-quality finishes, it has everything you need for comfort. Beautiful parks, local shops and cozy restaurants are within walking distance. Schiphol Airport is just 6 minutes by train, and the city center can be reached within 15 minutes by tram or metro. Perfect for a relaxed stay with easy access to everything Amsterdam has to offer.

Charming 1930s apartment in quiet Amsterdam-West, 10 min by bike to the centre. Renovated in 2022, blending original details stained glass, fireplace, herringbone floors with modern comfort. Set in a friendly neighbourhood near parks, shops and playgrounds, with easy access to Amsterdam’s museums, canals and family-friendly attractions.

name: Bright & Calm Amsterdam West Stay

Located in a lively but local neighborhood close to cafés, restaurants and easy public transport connections. Perfect for couples, solo travelers or remote workers looking for a relaxed city stay.

Located in the vibrant Amsterdam-Oost district, surrounded by trendy cafés, restaurants, and local hotspots, this is the ideal base for exploring the city and for relaxing and unwinding.

description:
This homy old Amsterdam house is in the centre of the city and De Jordaan district. It's a very vibrant, cute and typical Amsterdam neighbourhood, very central. This area is close to almost every other part of the city and it’s a good combination of some calm canals and the buzz of the city centre.

This bright retreat is built for two, with a sunny window seat overlooking the water, fast Wi-Fi, and a smart TV for slow evenings in. You'll find the Anne Frank House and Westerkerk a one-minute walk away, with the Nine Streets and cosy brown cafés just around the corner. Ideal for couples or solo travellers exploring the city by foot or bike.

name: Bright apartment in Amsterdam West (Rembrandtpark)

Charming, bright one-bedroom apartment with a spacious balcony and beautiful natural light throughout the day!

Located in lively yet relaxed De Baarsjes, with Rembrandtpark less than 200 meters away and Vondelpark just 15 minutes by tram or bus, you’re also close to great food spots, about 15 minutes from Schiphol by car (25 minutes by public transport), with tram and bus stops just around the corner.

Enjoy your morning coffee from the Smeg coffee machine or relax on the private balcony after a day in the city.
