name: Light-Filled Apartment near De Pijp & Metro
description:
Bright and stylish 1-bedroom apartment in a quiet street near the lively Weesperzijde, De Pijp and Utrechtsestraat.

Large windows fill the space with natural light, creating a warm and relaxed Amsterdam atmosphere. Features a modern open kitchen, comfortable bedroom, balcony with green views and fast WiFi.

Metro Wibautstraat is around the corner, offering quick access to the city center and Schiphol.

Perfect for couples, solo travelers and remote workers.

name: Family appartment (3) w. balcony & rooftop terrace
description:
105 m2 / sqm residential appartement of and for family of 3. Offers 1 large bedroom (airco) with double bed and 1 bedroom with bed for 1 child.
Fully equiped. Personal belongings removed where possible. Very close to Rembrandpark and Vondelpark. Very quiet street. Green neighbourhood.

name: Sunny Canal Apartment with Balcony & Full Kitchen
description: Modern two-bedroom apartment on the Baarsjesweg canal in Amsterdam. Located on the second floor, with morning sun at the front and afternoon sun on the private back balcony. Includes a king bed, double sofa bed, full kitchen with dishwasher and coffee machine, washer, and fast Wi-Fi. Just a 10-minute walk to Vondelpark, close to trams, and surrounded by great cafés and bars within a 1-minute walk.

name: Free standing family home with big garden.
description:
Located in Amsterdam Noord, our free standing house offers everything a family needs. It's only a 6 min walk to the metro, which directly takes you to the historical city centre.

We offer 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a large sunny, green garden. There's an outdoor lounge area, BBQ, hammock and playground area directly behind our yard. If desired, there's 4 bikes (2x adult 2x children).

We're renting to pet friendly people, as we have 3 sweet outdoor cats who love to cuddle and need to be fed.

name: [NIEUW] Luxe & Modern Appartement met Dakterras
description:
Welcome to our spacious and stylish apartment in Amsterdam Zuid, complete with a sunny private roof terrace where you can relax after a day in the city.

The location is ideal: within walking distance of the Vondelpark, close to the Museumplein, the famous museums, and cozy restaurants.

The Amsterdamse Bos is also within easy reach for a hike or bike ride in the countryside. Perfect for families or couples who want to explore Amsterdam from a quiet and atmospheric environment.

name: Large family home in beautiful area of Amsterdam
description: We have a nice family home in a peaceful little neighborhood. Just 10-15min by bike or public transport to the ferry or subway that brings you to heart of the historical city center of Amsterdam within 5 minutes. The house is only 6 years old, very comfortable, spacious and has all you need. You can sit outside with sun every hour of the day. Enjoy the beautiful and exiting city of Amsterdam and come back ‘home’ to the calm atmosphere of our nice home. A lot of hip and happening restaurants near

name: Stylish Family apartment Oud-Zuid
description:
Bright and spacious family apartment with a master bedroom and two bedrooms suitable for children and a large garden in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid, within walking distance of the Vondelpark. An ideal place for families who want to explore the city and come home to a quiet place.

Thanks to its location close to the Vondelpark, public transportation and various nice neighborhoods, you can get everywhere quickly:
• Museumplein
• De Pijp
• the city center of Amsterdam
• Schiphol

name: Centrally based Quiet and Cozy Amsterdam escape
description: Welcome to my bright apartment in a central but quiet neighborhood close to bars, cafés, and parks. The space is full of natural light and features a stylish open kitchen and comfortable modern design. This is my personal home, so it feels warm and lived-in. A cat normally lives here but will not be present during your stay—important for allergy sufferers. The renovation is nearly finished, so the price is currently reduced to reflect minor final touches.

name: Brand New City Center Home
description:
Welcome in this stunning 150m2 design home in the middle of the center!
Enjoy its many windows, three bedrooms with brand new kingsize boxspring beds, fresh linen and three bathrooms all for your own use ;-)
You will find yourself in the middle of the center with all modern amenities you need, such as fully equipped kitchens, airconditioning in the top three bedrooms, smart tvs and wifi throughout the entire house.. Hope to welcome you soon!

name: Canal house apartment, Westertoren and canal view
description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place in the heart of Amsterdam. Plenty of amenities included. Feel free to reach out in case of questions.

name: Executive Houseboat-Apartment Waterview
description:
Short stay!

This beautiful luxury large Houseboat-Apartment, with full air conditioning, is nicely decorated and located at one of the best locations in this part of Amsterdam and 5 minutes’ walking distance from the Amsterdam City Center district, close to Basilica of St. Nicholas, Nemo Science Museum and many nice restaurants.

This Houseboat-Apartment has beautiful water view and spacious terrace with many facilities!

name: Bright and Cosy Balcony Apartment by Vondelpark
description: Welcome to our bright and stylish apartment in Amsterdam Oud-West, just a short walk from Vondelpark. Enjoy a peaceful stay with a sunny balcony, modern interior, and lots of natural light. Located in a quiet street, yet close to cafés, restaurants, shops, and public transport. Perfect for exploring the city while relaxing in comfort. Ideal for couples or friends looking for a cozy and well-located home base in Amsterdam.

name: Ruim appartement naast de Amstel en het centrum
description:
Perfect on the edge of some of Amsterdam's beloved neighbourhoods, this spacious home lets you walk to Amsterdam Oost, De Pijp, Amstel river, the canals, and the city centre with ease. Step outside and you're surrounded by great restaurants, cosy coffee bars, and beautiful walking routes. Getting further afield is just as simple — the metro and tram are nearby and connections (also to Schiphol Airport) are excellent.

The kitchen is fully equipped. The garden is sunny. Working from home is easy.

name: Cosy apartment between city center and Westerpark
description: Recently renovated spacious apartment with green garden and lounge right between the city centre and Westerpark

name: Loft Atelier - Jordaan
description: This was once a studio, and you can still feel that. Ceilings over 5 meters, raw steel, red and terrazzo floors. I've made it my home, with art and personal items on the walls. The living room has a conversation pit where you can linger. The kitchen is important, because I like to cook. The bedroom is on a mezzanine overlooking the Jordaan. There is a nice bathroom and a balcony. The Westermarkt is 100 meters away. The rest of Amsterdam is within walking distance.

name: Amsterdam Angel; unique authentic tiny boat
description: This authentic cozy  accommodation has an amazing historical view on the maritime museum. Walking distance to Central Station, the red light district, several museums, local restaurants, coffeeshops, the Zoo, Parcs, Hortus Botanicus and an official swimming area nearby. Amsterdam Angel is a small private boat and feel free to Njoy this  local experience on the canal.

name: Zonovergoten appartement op de vierde verdieping.
description:
Unique 'tree house' apartment with spacious roof terrace!

Enjoy peace and privacy on the 4th floor. As soon as you get upstairs, you immediately experience a wonderful feeling of freedom. The bright apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, one cozy bedroom with an ensuite bathroom, and a separate toilet. The real eye-catcher is the spacious roof terrace for sunny evenings.

Top location: within 5 minutes you can walk to the Erasmus Park, and in just 10 minutes you can cycle to the cozy Jordaan!

name: Rustic Loft in the heart of De Pijp, Amsterdam
description: Welcome to our authentic Amsterdam home, a 113 sqm refurbished former bike factory on a quiet street in buzzing De Pijp. This rustic loft has exposed brick, wooden beams, and industrial details, with two bedrooms (two king beds), two bathrooms, a sofabed, spacious living areas, a fully equipped kitchen, and other amenities. Right next to Sarphatipark, trendy cafes and bars are around the corner, a 15 minute walk or direct tram connects you to the rest of the city.

name: Cozy apartment in the heart of De Pijp
description: Cozy apartment in the heart of de pijp overlooking canal. Only 5 min walking distance from tram and metro station.

name: Cosy Home with Soul in the Heart of Oud-West
description:
A soulful little home in Oud-West — wooden floors, warm lights, handmade shelves, plants. Small but full of character and love. The kind of place that took time to build and feels like it.

This is the place I live in and it means a lot to me. I’m looking for guests who will respect it as such. I rent it out while I’m away. Please drop me a message when you request a booking, I’d love to know a little about you before confirming.

name: Zen treasure in DE PIJP
description:
High ceilings, very comfortable bed, office space, yoga mat and private balconies. Perfect hideaway when you're exploring the city or need a place for rest. Remarkably quiet for the centre of the city.

Utilities: yogamat, herbal teas, towels, sheets, Wi-Fi, and kitchen supplies.

Close: Sarphatipark, Van Gogh and Stedelijk Museum, Albert Cuyp, RAI, organic stores and restaurants, trams and metro (2 min walk)

You are most welcome in my sweet 'French' apartment

name: Chic 1BR Apt near Vondelpark, 3 Min Walk to Canals
description:
NEW - Renovated Amsterdam Oasis Near Vondelpark

Experience the city like a local from this bright, fully updated apt steps from the Canal Belt & Museum Square.

THE SPACE
• Fully equipped modern kitchen
• Plush Queen bed & stylish living area
• Modern bathroom with rain shower
• Fast Wi-Fi & laptop-friendly workspace

THE LOCATION
Located in a prime neighbourhood next to cozy cafes & trams.
• Vondelpark: 10 min walk
• Canals: 10 min walk

Book your ultimate Amsterdam getaway today!

name: Bright family house close to NDSM ferry to centre
description:
Spacious and comfortable family home with garden in Amsterdam Noord, located in a quiet and family-friendly area, next to the vibrant NDSM Wharf area.

The ferry is a 15- minute walk and takes you to Amsterdam central station in 10-15 minutes.

Nearby, you’ll find great cafés, restaurants, playgrounds, supermarkets.

It’s an ideal base for families who want to explore Amsterdam while staying in a quieter, greener and more spacious environment away from the busy crowds.

name: Heerlijk appartement (80m) centrum Amsterdam
description: This lovely apartment (second floor, elevator available) is located near the metro (100 m) and tram and train connections in a lively neighborhood with many shops, cafes and restaurants. The large Oosterpark is also around the corner. The apartment is tastefully decorated. A spacious living room with French doors to a French balcony. A spacious kitchen with all appliances and necessities, a bathroom with a separate shower and a bath, and two bedrooms, each with a double bed.

name: The Orange Canals Suite - Bed No Breakfast
description: The Orange Canals Studio Suite is a stylish bed no breakfast in a historic Amsterdam canal house with a unique view of two intersecting canals. Located in the charming Lastage district, it offers a peaceful yet central setting. The modern studio features 1 GB Wi-Fi, work amenities on request, streaming services, a large flatscreen TV, air conditioning, and floor heating. Guests enjoy a private canal-view terrace, bike rental, and easy access to the city centre for an ideal stay.

name: Luxe stadswoning privétuin & studio bij Vondelpark
description:
Atmospheric ground floor apartment from 1900 in the Helmersbuurt. Within walking distance of Vondelpark, Leidseplein and the Jordaan, surprisingly quiet location. Spacious living room with ornamental ceilings, luxurious marble kitchen, modern walk-in shower. Private garden with heated gazebo as your own workspace or studio.
Ideal for professionals and remote workers who really want to experience Amsterdam.

Available in July and August.

name: Modern apartment Amsterdam Pijp nearby Rijksmuseum
description:
Bright and modern apartment for 2, located beside the Amstel River in the vibrant De Pijp district.

Just a 10-minute walk from the famous Albert Cuyp Market, with excellent restaurants, cafés, and shops nearby. The perfect base for exploring Amsterdam or working remotely.

Enjoy cooking, relaxing in the spacious living room, or dining on the sunny balcony. The apartment includes Wi-Fi, Sonos speakers, and a smart TV.

name: Traditional Boat In Amsterdam
description: Discover Amsterdam in a different way. Stay on an authentic, traditional Dutch boat, cozy and full of charm, in a prime location. Enjoy the tranquility of the water, the unique atmosphere of the canals and an unforgettable experience that combines comfort, history and adventure.

name: Central Design Home
description:
Stay at the very heart of the center and enjoy the many windows with views on the city buzz!
Experience its old Amsterdam atmosphere with modern amenities such as large boxspring beds, a cosy living room with smart tv, fully equipped kitchen and fast wifi throughout the entire 100m2 home.

name: Cozy Apartment - Walk to Everything
description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

name: Jordaan home with garden: 2 bed 2 bath 130m2
description:
4-floors in the heart of the Jordaan, on a quiet street. The house comfortably fits 4 guests: 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a separate toilet, a large kitchen and living area.
One of the best parts is the garden with BBQ.
1-minute walk to the canals and the 9 Streets. Very close to Noordermarkt, Leidseplein and museums.

Highlights
* Spacious home for up to 4 guests
* 2 bedrooms
* 2 bathrooms + separate toilet
* Large kitchen and living room
* Private garden
* Central location

name: Prinsen Canal House
description:
Welcome in our beautiful 180m2 monumental canal house in the middle of the center!
You will have the entire canal house to yourself with three bedrooms with boxspring beds, two design bathrooms, 3 toilets, a fully equipped kitchen, comfy living room with smart tv and fast wifi throughout the entire house..

name: Cosy appartment near Bijlmer-Arena
description: This new apartment is ideally located. Away from the hustle and bustle of the city, but close to the metro and train stations so you can quickly get to the center. With high ceilings and a large terrace, you have a wonderful feeling of space. Good starting point to go into the city, attend concerts in the Arena or make day trips from Bijlmer-Arena station.

name: Roof Terrace Boat - Amsterdam City
description: Welcome aboard Hensa, a 12-meter classic Dutch cabin cruiser, fully equipped for a cozy and unforgettable stay in Amsterdam. The boat accommodates up to 6 guests, features all modern amenities, and is moored in a secure harbor just 10 minutes by bus from the city center. Enjoy the spacious roof terrace with a lounge set perfect for drinks, boat-watching, and stunning sunsets.

name: Canal side bedroom & private bathroom
description:
The room is designed for a maximum of 2 adults and 1 children (up to 12 years old). Groups of 3 or 4 adults are not suitable.

Cosy private bedroom & ensuite bathroom in a family home, steps from NDSM Wharf in Amsterdam Noord. Relax on our canal-side patio or unwind in the jacuzzi (€10 per use extra). Double bed + option to add single beds for children under 12. Full baby & toddler kit included: travel cot, high chair, toys, and books. The perfect Amsterdam base for couples and young families.

name: The Canal Residence
description:
The Canal Residence. Luxury Stay in the Heart of Amsterdam
Newly renovated luxury apartment in one of Amsterdam’s most historic neighborhoods. Quietly located across from the beautiful Wertheimpark, while the canals, museums, cafés, and shopping streets are all within walking distance. Perfect for a peaceful and stylish stay in the city center.

name: Luxurious 2BR-apt city center
description:
Wake up to Amsterdam’s most iconic canal.

This beautifully finished two-bedroom apartment (with AC in the bedrooms) overlooks the stunning Leidsegracht, putting you at the heart of Amsterdam’s most vibrant neighborhood. Unwind on your private terrace, then step out to Leidseplein, Paradiso, the Melkweg and the Nine Streets. The Jordaan’s finest restaurants, Vondelpark, the city’s best theaters — all at your doorstep.

Book before someone else does.

name: Big Family house 20 minutes centre
description:
Our bright modern home is best suited for a quiet and comfortable stay for up to max 4 guests, for example 2 adults and 2 children or teenagers, plus a baby.

It is located near NDSM Wharf, with easy access by ferry to the city centre. This area offers restaurants, creative places and a lively local atmosphere. Amsterdam North is vibrant, relaxed and full of character.

The neighbourhood is very child friendly and peaceful. Our two cat usually stay outside and occasionally come by for food.

name: Central Canal Residence
description: Bright loft-style apartment with warm wood accents, modern interiors, and comfortable sleeping space for up to 6 guests. Designed for relaxing stays with a clean, contemporary feel. 2 bedrooms and a sleeping sofa. All basic amenities provided.

name: Cute monumental house in trendy Amsterdam Noord
description: Stay in a beautifully designed home in Vogeldorp, a unique village-like neighborhood in Amsterdam Noord, just 1 metro stop from Central Station. Enjoy a private garden, a fully equipped kitchen, and peaceful views of the Vliegenbos, where locals swim in summer. Walk to trendy spots like Skatecafe, Coba Taqueria, Garage Noord and De Goudfazant. A bicycle is available so you can explore Amsterdam like a local.

name: Cozy Renovated 1BR Apartment @ Amsterdam West
description: Welcome to our cozy apartment in Amsterdam West. Recently renovated, the apartment features one comfortable bedroom with a queen-size bed, an ensuite bathroom, and a separate toilet for your convenience. Guests can also enjoy a private balcony, perfect for relaxing after a day in the city. Conveniently located close to public transport, it’s the ideal stay for couples looking to explore Amsterdam in comfort.

name: Mooie grote woning met tuin en parkeerplaats.
description: After the hustle and bustle of the city, rest in this peaceful, centrally located home with a garden and free parking.

name: The Crooked House
description:
The accommodation with private access is in the souterrain of this authentic national monument built in 1700.
The house has become crooked in the past due to the piles on which it was built.
From this ideally located accommodation, you can undertake all kinds of activities.
The cozy neighborhood "De Pijp" with cozy coffee shops, the Albert Cuyp daily market and restaurants is very close by.
Shopping streets such as the Kalverstraat and the 9 Straatjes are also within walking distance.

name: Stijlvol ruim appartement Centrum (Oud-West)
description: Unique and stylish two-person apartment in Amsterdam Oud West with a recently renovated kitchen and bathroom. Stay on a quiet street with the food halls, daily market and lively Kinkerstraat around the corner. Walk 100 meters to the tram to easily reach the city center, central station and airport, or walk to the city in 15 minutes. Walk to the beautiful Vondelpark in 10 minutes to take a walk in nature there.

name: Luxe appartement met guesthouse & zonnige tuin
description:
Luxury apartment (72 m²) with a sunny garden and a private guesthouse (18 m²) in quiet Amsterdam-West, near the Jordaan and the Erasmus Park. Perfect for 2 couples thanks to 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and plenty of privacy. Enjoy a luxurious kitchen-diner, comfortable living room, air conditioning in the guesthouse and quick connections to the city center. Restaurants, cafes and supermarkets are within walking distance. This is a perfect place for two couples, families or friends on a trip to Amsterdam!

More photos to follow!

name: Beautiful 3BR Design Home w/ Garden & Cats @ AMS
description: Welcome to our beautiful and spacious designer home in Oud-West. Set in a former warehouse that was thoughtfully transformed into a residence by an architect, the home features a unique industrial character combined with modern design. The house is ideally located along a canal and close to public transport, with direct connections to the city center. Perfect for families or couples looking for a comfortable stay in Amsterdam. Please note that our two cats will be staying in the home.

name: Central Amsterdam appartmemt with garden
description:
Spacious apartment near the city centre/ Jordaan (10min bike / 25min walk). Ideal for couple or young family. Walking distance (5min) to shops and cafes with terraces. Park around the corner with playground, cafe and where you can swim.

- Open kitchen with induction, quooker, microwave and oven
- Living room with smart TV
- 1x Kingsize bed
- ⁠1x Kids bedroom (incl. changing mat, kids chair, box en bed)
- ⁠1x Bath / shower
- ⁠2x Toilets
- ⁠Sunny garden with table and lounge chairs

name: Ruime luxe woning in Amsterdam
description:
Spacious and luxurious home on a quiet street. By bike or public transportation, you can reach the city center and the canals in 10 minutes. The apartment has a lovely roof terrace where you can sit in the sun all day!

You can choose between 1 bedroom with a double bed and a study, or 2 bedrooms with double beds, in which case the study cannot be used. If you have any questions, please feel free to send me a message.

name: Zonnig appartement tussen westerpark en de jordaan
description: Enjoy easy access to everything from this perfectly located home base.

name: Rustig en charmant apartement in Amsterdam -Zuid
description:
Step into a spacious and elegant apartment designed for effortless comfort. The master bedroom features a king-size bed and a luxurious en-suite bathroom, while a second bedroom offers a double bed, dedicated workspace and private bathroom.

Enjoy the bright open-plan living area with a fully equipped kitchen, dining and lounge space, plus a cosy balcony for quiet moments.

A laundry room with washer and dryer and two separate toilets complete this thoughtfully designed retreat.

name: Singel Canal Home
description:
Welcome to this stunning 350m2 monumental canal house on beautiful Singel.
Enjoy its many windows, four bedrooms with brand new kingsize boxspring beds, fresh linen and four bathrooms all for your own private use ;-)
You will find yourself in the middle of the center with all modern amenities you need, such as fully equipped kitchens, a roof terrace, smart tvs and wifi throughout the entire house.. I am sure you will love it!

name: Ruime kamer met airco in Amsterdam
description:
Spacious room with air conditioning in an upstairs apartment on Lauernessestraat in Amsterdam, built in 1951. Located in De Kolenkit, quiet and central. Supermarket, restaurants and train station within walking distance, highway within 1 minute.
The house is on the second floor, after 3 steps. There is a video doorbell by the front door.
Shared bathroom and toilet. Air conditioning, electric heating, 2-in-1 carbon monoxide and smoke detector, first aid kit. Pets present. No lock on the door at the landlord's request.

name: Spacious bright apt in a top Amsterdam location
description: Bright & spacious 80 m² apartment in beautiful Rivierenbuurt, one of Amsterdam’s most desirable neighborhoods. The apartment has 2 bedrooms: a king-size bed in the master bedroom and a children’s bed. Ideal for a couple or a small family. Fully renovated and filled with natural light. Quiet third-floor location (no elevator but stairs), close to De Pijp, public transport, parks, playgrounds, cafés, restaurants, bakeries, shops, and supermarkets. Ideal for families and city explorers.

name: NassauCasa
description: Stay in our stylish apartment for 2 people on the Nassaukade, within walking distance of the Vondelpark, Leidseplein and the Jordaan. The absolute highlight is the unique roof terrace with a comfortable lounge set and barbecue, a rare luxury in the heart of Amsterdam. Enjoy the vibrant city and then relax in your own apartment. Perfect for a weekend getaway, a relaxing city trip or a business trip.

name: Luxe Canal House • Private Garden • 4br • Centre
description: A monumental canal house on the Leidsegracht, in the heart of Amsterdam’s UNESCO canal ring, reimagined by architects and interior designers. Four serene bedrooms over five floors, a chef’s kitchen, light-filled south-facing rooms with canal views, plus a private garden. Steps from the Nine Streets, the antiques quarter and the city’s best tables. A turnkey, design-led home for families who travel well.

name: Een fijn huis in het bruisende Amsterdam-Noord!
description: Kick back and relax in this calm, stylish space. The house is in Amsterdam-Noord, in a quiet green area. The park is 100 meters away, and cafes, restaurants, museums and cinemas are nearby. If you want to go to the city center, it's only a 7-minute walk to the metro, which takes you to Amsterdam Centraal in 3 minutes. A 20-minute walk to the ferry is also possible. A nice experience to sail across the IJ!

name: Bright Canal Apartment with Garden
description: Enjoy a calm stay in this bright 1-bedroom apartment on Hugo de Grootkade, near the Jordaan and Amsterdam city centre. Recently renovated and fully furnished, it offers a lovely canal view, great natural light, a comfortable bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, fast Wi-Fi, and a rare private backyard. Ideal for one person or a couple looking for a peaceful, central Amsterdam stay.

name: Modern grachtenappartement + zonnig terras
description: Located in the heart of the bustling Oud-West neighborhood, our home offers the rare combination of canal views and tranquility, while being close to countless restaurants, cafes, and shops. The "Ten Katemarkt" and the famous De Hallen – a cultural hotspot with a trendy food hall, cinema, and local markets – are less than a 3-minute walk away. Our apartment is relatively new and well insulated. (Almost) no city noise here. In addition, it is fully accessible because we have a modern elevator.

name: Licht appartement met fantastisch dakterras
description:
Bright studio style apartment with private rooftop terrace and stunning city views.

Located on the popular Weesperzijde area by the Amstel river, in a cozy, safe area loved by locals. Next to 5* Amstel Hotel.

Great restaurants and bistros just around the corner like the “Ysbreeker” with its large terrace at the Amstel river.

Walking distance to Albert Cuyp Market, Carré, Hermitage, City center. Metro/tram around the corner takes you to city center and Museum-plein (Rijksmuseum) in minutes.

name: Spacious house with garden next to Amstel canals!
description: Discover Amsterdam from this brand-new renovated house, located in the beautiful Rivierenbuurt neighborhood, right next to the Amstel and a stone's throw from the city center and the picturesque canal belt. Tucked away in a quiet side street, this house offers the perfect blend of cozy comfort and proximity to the city's must-see spots. Queen-size bed, spacious dining area, large living room with comfortable sofa and large TV, and a brand-new bathroom with bathtub and shower.

name: NEW: Luxurious Watervilla | Familyfriendly | Sauna
description:
Wake up surrounded by spectacular waterside scenery in this exceptional three-level residence designed for relaxation and memorable moments.

Thoughtfully created for families and groups, this unique getaway combines elegance, comfort, and breathtaking views from sunrise to sunset.

With luxurious amenities, generous accommodation, and a one-of-a-kind waterfront setting, this remarkable retreat offers the ideal balance of privacy, entertainment, and relaxation for an unforgettable escape.

name: La pause Nomade
description: We are spending a night in Amsterdam. We are pleased to welcome you to our motorhome 🙂

name: Spacious Bright Loft
description:
Bright and stylish apartment with amazing views over the Sunset and Sunrise.

Spacious and light filled featuring 2 comfortable bedrooms (one queen bed 180x200 and one extensible 160x200), a large open kitchen fully equipped and living room with all modern amenities.

Ideally located in a quiet area with excellent tram and metro connections, just a short walk away making it easy to explore the city while enjoying a relaxing day.

name: Cozy flat in Amsterdam
description:
A cozy home, located right next to the metro station taking you directly into the city centre in less than 15 minutes!

Johan Cruif Arena, Ziggodome and AFAS are all just a 10-minute walk away. Direct public transport connection to Central Station and Schipol.

The home has a bedroom with a king size bed, a bathroom with a separate toilet, and a spacious living room with a fully equipped kitchen.

The unit is located on the ground floor of the building and has a big garden.

name: Bright & Spacious 2R Family Home @ AMS Noord
description: Welcome to our family home, a bright and spacious home located on 'Amsterdam’s most beautiful street'. Situated in a serene neighborhood in Amsterdam North, the home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and convenience, just a 10-minute walk from the metrostation with easy access to the city center. Featuring 3 bedrooms, a spacious garden, and plenty of room to relax, it is the ideal choice for families, and business travelers. Please note: no partygoers

name: Beautiful apartment in Amsterdam South
description: Enjoy a getaway in Amsterdam in this calm, stylish space. This apartment is in a quiet neighbourhood, with Vondelpark around the corner and good connection to the city center.

name: Stay in a Beautiful High-Ceiling City-Center Flat
description: Enjoy a bright and beautiful city-centre flat with charming high ceilings and a calm, tucked-away location. You are close to Amsterdam’s best cafés, canals, shops and museums, but away from the busiest crowds. The living room has an open kitchen, creating a cosy and practical space to relax, cook and feel at home. The flat also includes a bathroom, separate toilet room and a balcony, perfect for a quiet morning coffee or evening drink.

name: Cozy Retreat with View 2 Amsterdam Center
description: Unwind in this bright, cozy private room with peaceful sunrise views. Sleep comfortably on a double bed with crisp linens and enjoy modern décor, soft lighting, and a full-length mirror. Large windows fill the space with natural light. Fresh towels, slippers, and fast WiFi are included. Downtown is just 15 minutes away by bus and metro. Shared bathrooms are professionally cleaned daily to ensure excellent hygiene and comfort throughout your stay.

name: Bright Room with View 3 Amsterdam Center
description: Relax in this bright, welcoming room designed for comfort and tranquility. Enjoy a restful sleep on a cozy double bed with crisp white linens, surrounded by clean, modern décor and soft ambient lighting. Large windows provide beautiful sunrise views and plenty of natural light. Amenities include fast WiFi, charging ports, a full-length mirror, chair, fresh towels, slippers, and toiletries. Downtown is just 15 minutes away by bus and metro. Bathrooms are professionally cleaned daily.

name: Central private room
description:
Private Room in the Heart of the City with Private External Bathroom.

Enjoy a comfortable stay in the very center of the city, within walking distance of major attractions (Dam square and Jordaan neighborhood) , restaurants, cafés, shops, and Amsterdam central station.

name: Canal Studio, Historic Charm & Balcony
description:
****IMPORTANT: BOOKINGS WITH MINIMAL 3 NIGHTS ONLY!!! ***

Live the definitive Amsterdam experience. Located directly on the historic Prinsengracht, this sun-drenched 30m² studio perfectly blends classic character with a crisp, modern aesthetic.

The main living area features soaring ceilings and floor-to-ceiling French doors that open to beautiful greenery and afternoon sunlight. Includes a separate, fully equipped galley kitchen and a private storage room downstairs.

name: Modern garden guesthouse
description: Escape to this beautifully designed private guesthouse surrounded by peaceful gardens. The bright studio features a 180 cm bed, lounge seating, Smart TV, skylight, and floor-to-ceiling doors opening onto a private terrace. Enjoy a kitchenette with coffee station and fridge, plus a spa-inspired bathroom with a freestanding tub and rainfall shower. Relax on the stone patio amid lush landscaping and seasonal flowers. Perfect for couples, remote workers, or anyone seeking a quiet retreat in nature.

name: Spacious Master Bedroom in De Pijp for Couples
description: Enjoy a spacious master bedroom in the heart of De Pijp, one of Amsterdam’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Perfect for couples or solo travelers, the room offers a comfortable double bed, fast WiFi, and plenty of natural light. Within walking distance of Albert Cuyp Market, Museumplein, cafés, restaurants, canals, and public transport. Experience Amsterdam like a local in one of the city's most sought-after areas.

name: Epic 1710's Canal front Luxury stay in a monument
description:
NEW LISTING! (31+ day stays)
Step inside a living piece of Amsterdam's heritage. Enclosed within the original walls of a registered 1710's national monument, The home has been fully renovated to meet the highest standards of modern luxury while fiercely protecting its original charm. The aesthetic is defined by an uncompromising, sophisticated eye for detail.

Situated on a premier, prestigious stretch of the Prinsengracht, you are positioned at the absolute center of Amsterdam's cultural heart.

name: Cozy Apartment in Amsterdam-West | Close to center
description: Welcome to our bright and stylish apartment in Amsterdam-West. The home combines authentic Amsterdam charm with modern comfort. You have a spacious living room, fully equipped kitchen, comfortable bedroom and modern bathroom. Thanks to the central location, you can quickly reach the city center and public transportation. Please note: the balcony is currently closed for maintenance and not accessible to guests. The apartment is rented without a balcony.

name: Licht & ruim appartement naast RAI/Europaplein
description: Enjoy a comfortable stay in our bright and spacious apartment in Amsterdam. Located just a 5-minute walk from Europaplein and the RAI, ideal for both business and leisure travelers. The apartment offers plenty of natural light, a spacious living room, a fully equipped kitchen and excellent connections to the center. A quiet base for exploring Amsterdam.

name: A modern 2 bedroom apartment with canal views
description:
Modern, stylish, and cozy two-bedroom apartment with stunning canal views in one of Amsterdam’s most charming neighborhoods. The apartment is tastefully decorated and features a fully equipped kitchen for a comfortable stay.

Ideally located, Vondelpark is just a 5-minute walk away, Albert Heijn supermarket is only 3 minutes away, and numerous cafés, restaurants, and shops are right around the corner.

The perfect base for exploring Amsterdam while enjoying authentic canal-side living.

name: Unique 100m² Loft with Rooftop Terrace and Parking
description: Welcome to our unique 100 m² family apartment in green Nellestein, Amsterdam. This spacious duplex features 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a rooftop terrace, and a private parking space. Located in car-free Gaasperpark, you can swim, SUP, walk, or cycle right outside your door. Fresh-water swimming spots are just 2 minutes away. Metro station Gaasperplas is an 8-minute walk, taking you to the city centre in only 10 minutes.

name: Museum Quarter Residence
description: Stay in a stylish townhouse apartment in Amsterdam’s prestigious Museum Quarter. Featuring high ceilings, stained-glass windows, herringbone wooden floors, and a warm contemporary interior, it perfectly blends historic charm with modern comfort. Just a short walk from the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, Vondelpark, and excellent cafés and restaurants. A peaceful, family-friendly retreat in one of Amsterdam’s most beautiful neighborhoods.

name: Charming & Spacious Apartment in Amsterdam
description:
Experience the best of Amsterdam from our spacious and characterful 135 m² apartment in a beautiful historic building from 1894. Ideally located in Oud-West, just 400 metres from the famous canals and within walking distance of the Anne Frank House.
The area offers the perfect balance of peace and city life: quiet and authentic, yet just around the corner lies the lively Jordaan, known for its cosy cafés, great restaurants and boutique shops.

name: Stijlvol en zonnig appartement in Amsterdam-Oost
description: Spacious and bright 90 m² apartment with two bedrooms, a sunny south-facing balcony, and stylish, tasteful decor. Located in lively Amsterdam-Oost, close to the Oosterpark and countless cafes, restaurants and terraces. De Pijp, Utrechtsestraat, Plantagebuurt and the city center are quickly accessible by bike or public transportation. Ideal for, for example, two couples or a family. Muiderpoort Station is at the end of the street, with a direct train to Schiphol.

name: Apartment in Amsterdam Zuid | De Pijp
description: The apartment features a stylish and welcoming living area with comfortable seating and a dining space, perfect for relaxing after exploring Amsterdam. The kitchen is modern and fully equipped with everything needed for light cooking. The bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with a comfortable bed and a calm atmosphere. The bathroom is contemporary and well maintained, featuring a walk-in shower and essential amenities. The overall space is thoughtfully designed with comfort and style in mind.

name: Luxe familiehuis in Amsterdam met tuin
description: This modern and cozy family home in Amsterdam offers a quiet, stylish place to stay. The house is bright, spacious and finished to a high standard, with an open living area, several bedrooms, two luxurious bathrooms and a sunny outdoor space. Thanks to the warm decor, large windows and thoughtful layout, the house immediately feels like home.

name: Mooi appartement met zonnig tuintje
description:
This centrally located apartment is on the ground floor, on a quiet street exclusively for pedestrians.
The apartment has a bright living room with a sofa bed, a fully equipped kitchen, one bedroom with a double bed, and an en-suite bathroom.
Also a sunny outdoor area with seating.
The location is close to the city center, the canals, restaurants, shops and pleasant markets.
Free Wi-Fi and TV.
Tram and metro station within walking distance.

name: Nice and cosy apartment 11th floor in Amsterdam
description: Surround yourself with style in this standout space.Wake up above the city and enjoy your coffee on a spacious balcony surrounded by treetops and skyline views. This stylish and cozy 11th-floor apartment combines comfort, convenience, and a peaceful atmosphere. Relax in the bright living space, prepare meals in the fully equipped kitchen, and enjoy amenities such as free parking, fast Wi-Fi, and a washing machine. This apartment offers the perfect balance between urban living and tranquility.

name: Luxury Penthouse with Iconic Amsterdam Views
description: Penthouse located on the top floor in the tranquil section of Spuistraat, situated between Dam Square and Central Station. The living room has floor-to-ceiling windows that provide a view of iconic Amsterdam landmarks, including the Bijenkorf and several churches. Located on the top (6th) floor with no neighbors to the sides or above (only one neighbor below) and double glazing, this apartment provides an relatively tranquil and quiet living experience for a central Amsterdam location.

name: Stylish family home in Amsterdam with friendly cat
description: Light-filled and recently renovated, our stylish family home offers the perfect balance of comfort and character. Enjoy a sunny private garden, beautiful skylights, a spacious living area and a stunning walk-in shower. Located in the charming Vogelbuurt neighbourhood of Amsterdam Noord, just a short walk from the North/South metro line. During your stay, you'll also care for Pepper, our friendly family cat, who is easy to look after and loves a little company.

name: Private Patio Boat in Amsterdam
description: Step aboard The Solace, a distinctive and lovingly restored 10-meter Dutch cabin cruiser, perfect for a memorable getaway in Amsterdam—whether with your partner, friends, or family. This classic boat, moored in a secure harbor just 10 minutes by bus from the lively city center, offers a cozy and comfortable retreat on the water. Fully equipped to accommodate up to four guests, it has everything you need for a relaxing and enjoyable stay.

name: Rooftop Boat In Amsterdam
description: Welcome aboard Hensa, a 12-meter classic Dutch cabin cruiser, fully equipped for a cozy and unforgettable stay in Amsterdam. The boat accommodates up to 6 guests, features all modern amenities, and is moored in a secure harbor just 10 minutes by bus from the city center. Enjoy the spacious roof terrace with a lounge set perfect for drinks, boat-watching, and stunning sunsets.

name: Rooftop Houseboat in Amsterdam
description:
Step back in time on Lucky, a beautifully restored trekschuit, a traditional Dutch canal boat once pulled by horses along the towpaths. Built around 1900, Lucky originally served local farmers, carrying cargo and passengers through the quiet waterways of the countryside.

Since those early days, Lucky has been lovingly preserved and transformed into a cozy houseboat.

name: Apartment in Amsterdam city centre
description: In the heart of Amsterdam, this light-filled apartment sits right on the Oudeschans, one of the city's oldest canals. Couldn't be more central. 2 bedrooms with double beds (sleeps 4) and 2 full bathrooms, so no waiting your turn. Large windows, airy throughout, with a classic canal view. Perfect for families, couples, or two pairs of friends wanting a real central Amsterdam base.

name: Bright 70m² apartment with big balcony - De Pijp
description: Bright and spacious (70m²) apartment in De Pijp, Amsterdam's most loved neighbourhood. Quiet street, yet everything on your doorstep: countless restaurants and cafés, the famous Albert Cuyp market, Sarphatipark and the metro all within a 5-minute walk. Big sunny balcony with lounge chairs and a BBQ, a king-size bed, rain shower and a bathtub. This is our own home, so expect a real home rather than an anonymous rental - you'll find everything you need for a comfortable stay.

name: Luxury Canal House with Spectacular Roof Garden
description: A stylish, peaceful family home in Amsterdam’s center. Enjoy a rare 4BR/3BA layout featuring a stunning, private rooftop garden with a BBQ. Because this is our loved personal home, it is fully equipped with premium mod-cons, air filters, and a chef’s kitchen. Uniquely for Amsterdam, our classic stairs are comfortably wide (1m+), making the walk up to our sky sanctuary a spacious, rewarding workout! We welcome strictly respectful guests who will cherish our space.

name: Large, homely  houseboat in Amsterdam North
description: This memorable place is anything but ordinary. A large homely houseboat on the edge of Amsterdam. Overlooking the buitenij close to the idyllic village of Durgerdam and a 15 min bike ride from Amsterdam Oost 25 minutes to Central station

name: East Side Story: Stylish appartment by Oosterpark
description:
This charming, bright, and modern 2-person apartment is located next to the Oosterpark, in the heart of Amsterdam East neighborhood.

Just a 5-minute walk from the Oosterpark, surrounded by plenty of cozy restaurants, cafés, and shops!

The perfect home base for a visit to Amsterdam, in one of the city's most beloved neighborhoods. Also great for working, cooking, or enjoying a meal on the sunny balcony or in the spacious living room.

The apartment is equipped with Wi-Fi, Sonos, and a smart TV.

name: Lovely room in a spacious apartment near Metro
description:
Our new renovated home offers the perfect comfort to relax and explore the city:
5min walk to wibaustraat metro station
3minutes walk to oosterpark
Big and fully equipped kitchen. Large bedroom with queen size bed and big closet.
You'll find plenty of cafes,bar,restaurant and supermarkets nearby

name: Ruim en licht huis
description:
Welcome to our bright and beautiful family home, located in one of Amsterdam’s newest, most vibrant, and family-friendly neighbourhoods. Our home is ideal those looking for a comfortable Amsterdam experience.

Situated directly on the water, a setting where locals often swim during the warmer months. The home is located on a traffic-free street, making it a safe and relaxing environment for children to play and families to unwind. we have to adorable cats that need to be taken care of!

name: Room with balcony near Metro station
description:
Sunny room with balcony in a safe, quiet area next to Wibautstraat metro and Oosterpark. Direct metro/tram to Central Station, Dam Square, museums and main sights. Good soundproofing. Fully furnished with double boxspring bed and all utilities + fast WiFi included.
Spacious living room and fully equipped kitchen

name: Quiet room near Metro station and centrum
description: Sunny room in a safe, quiet area next to Wibautstraat metro and Oosterpark. Direct metro/tram to Central Station, Dam Square, museums and main sights. Good soundproofing. Fully furnished with double boxspring bed and all utilities + fast WiFi included

name: Lovely room in de pijp near Metro
description:
The apartment is on the first floor of a charming, historic building in the vibrant De Pijp neighborhood. It is tastefully decorated and offers all the comforts of home.
It is easy to access and very well connected across the city. Metro M52 and tram lines are just a few steps away, which connected directly to most of the sightseeing points in Amsterdam

name: Elegant smoker friendly apartment
description:
Elegant smoker-friendly apartment in the heart of Amsterdam, ideally located just moments from Dam Square, Amsterdam Central Station, and the charming Jordaan district. Situated in one of the city’s most prestigious and vibrant areas, this apartment offers the perfect blend of comfort and authentic Amsterdam living.

The apartment features three spacious bedrooms and three bathrooms. One of the bedrooms has direct access to the terrace. The property also includes a fully equipped kitchen.

name: Gerenoveerd appartement in hartje Amsterdam
description:
Our nice apartment is in the center of Amsterdam but away from the tourist crowds. On foot or by bike, you can reach the city's famous attractions and nice restaurants within a few minutes. Public transportation is also just steps away.

The house has recently been completely renovated and features a brand new bathroom and kitchen, a large bedroom and a small extra room with the possibility of a single sleeping space on a comfortable sofa bed.

name: Bright Family Home near NDSM • Bikes, SUP & swim
description: Modern family home in Amsterdam North, close to NDSM. Explore the city by bike, paddle on the water with our SUP, enjoy nearby swimming spots, and relax in a quiet green neighborhood just minutes from Amsterdam’s vibrant creative district.

name: Bright loft appartement close to Vondelpark
description: We adore our house with its high ceiling, lots of windows and light, a comfortable living room, and a cozy sleeping loft. The location is perfect, a cozy residential neighborhood but with all the conveniences of nice shops, cafes and restaurants. In front of the door, you can sit on the grass with a picnic blanket and even swim in the canal. You can easily get to the center of the city on foot or by public transportation.

name: TheSanctuaryZuidas new business/leisure apartment
description: The Sanctuary offers a unique blend of luxury, space, and functionality in Amsterdam’s prestigious Zuidas district. With 188 m² of beautifully designed Japandi-inspired living space, guests enjoy hotel-level comfort with the privacy of a high-end residence. Ideal for both leisure and business stays, the home features large screens for meetings and presentations, three bedrooms, two luxury bathrooms, a private terrace, and easy access to restaurants, parks, Schiphol, and Amsterdam’s city centre.

name: Cozy Amsterdam Flat with Forest Views & Bathtub
description:
Wind down in the warm evening glow of this stylish Amsterdam apartment. As the sun sets, golden light fills the living room the perfect end to a day in the city.
Enjoy an open-plan living area, fully equipped kitchen, and a quiet bedroom with balcony access. After exploring, relax in the luxurious bathtub with rain shower.
A beautiful forest is right on your doorstep rare in Amsterdam. The city centre is just 15 minutes away by bike or tram.

name: Dam Center Oasis
description:
Come and feel welcome in our 100m2 design home in the middle of the center behind Dam square.
Enjoy the kingsize beds with bathrooms ensuite, its many windows and experience the old Amsterdam style with all modern amenities you need such as a fully equipped kitchen, cosy living room with smart tv and wifi throughout the entire house ;-)

description:

name: Keizers Canal Home
description:
Welcome in our beautiful 100m2 canal house in the middle of the center on Keizersgracht!
Enjoy the canal view from each of the three bedrooms and its new comfortable boxspring beds and design bathrooms with tub and rain shower..
Experience its authentic feel with all modern amenities you need such as a fully equipped kitchen, two smart tv's and wifi throughout the entire home.. ;)
